abstract.text: An inverse relationship between job insecurity and sickness absence has been established in the literature, which is explained by employees avoiding to send signals of both poor health and uncooperative behavior towards the employer. In this paper, we focus on whether the same mechanism applies to the demand for medical rehabilitation measures. This question has recently gained much interest in the context of the current public debate on presenteeism. Using county-level unemployment rates as instrument for the employees' fear of job loss on the individual level, we find that an increase in subjective job insecurity substantially decreases the probability of participating in medical rehabilitation.

10.1002/hec.2995.abstractZh: 文献中已证实工作不安全感与病假缺席之间存在负相关关系，这可能是由于员工为了避免表现出健康状况不佳或不合作的行为而选择不请假。在本文中，我们关注同样的机制是否也适用于对医疗康复措施的需求。这一问题在当前关于出勤问题的公共讨论中引起了广泛关注。通过以县级失业率作为衡量员工对失业恐惧的指标，我们发现主观工作不安全感的增加会显著降低员工参与医疗康复的可能性。

abstract.text: In recent years, many states and localities in the USA have enacted bicycle helmet laws. We estimate the effects of these laws on injuries requiring emergency department treatment. Using hospital-level panel data and triple difference models, we find helmet laws are associated with reductions in bicycle-related head injuries among children. However, laws also are associated with decreases in non-head cycling injuries, as well as increases in head injuries from other wheeled sports. Thus, the observed reduction in bicycle-related head injuries may be due to reductions in bicycle riding induced by the laws.

10.1002/hec.2997.abstractZh: 近年来，美国许多州和地方政府都制定了自行车头盔法规。我们估算了这些法规对需要急诊治疗的伤害的影响。通过医院级面板数据和三重差异模型分析，我们发现头盔法规与儿童因自行车导致的头部伤害减少有关。然而，这些法规也导致了非头部自行车伤害的减少，以及其他轮式运动导致的头部伤害的增加。因此，观察到的自行车相关头部伤害减少可能是由于法规导致的骑自行车行为的减少所致。

abstract.text: This paper describes the development of a methodology for the case-mix adjustment of patient-reported outcome measures (PROMs) data permitting the comparison of outcomes between providers on a like-for-like basis. Statistical models that take account of provider-specific effects form the basis of the proposed case-mix adjustment methodology. Indirect standardisation provides a transparent means of case mix adjusting the PROMs data, which are updated on a monthly basis. Recently published PROMs data for patients undergoing unilateral knee replacement are used to estimate empirical models and to demonstrate the application of the proposed case-mix adjustment methodology in practice. The results are illustrative and are used to highlight a number of theoretical and empirical issues that warrant further exploration. For example, because of differences between PROMs instruments, case-mix adjustment methodologies may require instrument-specific approaches. A number of key assumptions are made in estimating the empirical models, which could be open to challenge. The covariates of post-operative health status could be expanded, and alternative econometric methods could be employed.

10.1002/hec.2999.abstractZh: 本文描述了一种用于患者报告结果指标（PROMs）数据案例混合调整的方法论的发展，该方法论能够允许在类似基础上比较不同医疗服务提供者之间的结果。所提出的案例混合调整方法论基于考虑医疗服务提供者特定效应的统计模型。间接标准化为PROMs数据的案例混合调整提供了一种透明的方法，这些数据每月更新一次。本文使用了最近发布的接受单侧膝关节置换手术患者的PROMs数据来估计经验模型，并展示了所提出的案例混合调整方法论在实践中的应用。研究结果具有说明性，并揭示了若干需要进一步探讨的理论和实证问题。例如，由于PROMs工具之间的差异，案例混合调整方法论可能需要采用特定于工具的解决方案。在估计经验模型时，做出了一些关键假设，这些假设可能受到质疑。术后健康状况的协变量可以扩展，并且可以采用其他计量经济学方法。

abstract.text: Effective January 1, 2011, individual market health insurers must meet a minimum medical loss ratio (MLR) of 80%. This law aims to encourage 'productive' forms of competition by increasing the proportion of premium dollars spent on clinical benefits. To date, very little is known about the performance of firms in the individual health insurance market, including how MLRs are related to insurer and market characteristics. The MLR comprises one component of the price-cost margin, a traditional gauge of market power; the other component is percent of premiums spent on administrative expenses. We use data from the National Association of Insurance Commissioners (2001-2009) to evaluate whether the MLR is a good target measure for regulation by comparing the two components of the price-cost margin between markets that are more competitive versus those that are not, accounting for firm and market characteristics. We find that insurers with monopoly power have lower MLRs. Moreover, we find no evidence suggesting that insurers' administrative expenses are lower in more concentrated insurance markets. Thus, our results are largely consistent with the interpretation that the MLR could serve as a target measure of market power in regulating the individual market for health insurance but with notable limited ability to capture product and firm heterogeneity.

10.1002/hec.3002.abstractZh: 自2011年1月1日起，个人市场健康保险公司必须达到至少80%的最低医疗损失比率。该法律旨在通过增加用于临床福利的保费比例来鼓励“有效”的竞争形式。迄今为止，关于个人健康保险市场公司的表现知之甚少，包括医疗损失比率与保险公司和市场特征之间的关系。医疗损失比率是价格成本利润率的一个组成部分，而价格成本利润率是衡量市场力量的传统指标；另一个组成部分是用于行政费用的保费百分比。我们利用全国保险委员会协会的数据（2001-2009年）来评估医疗损失比率是否可以作为监管的目标指标，通过比较竞争程度较高的市场与较低的市场之间的价格成本利润率的这两个组成部分，同时考虑公司和市场特征。我们发现，具有垄断力量的保险公司拥有较低的医疗损失比率。此外，我们没有发现证据表明在竞争更为集中的保险市场中，保险公司的行政费用会更低。因此，我们的研究结果与这样一种解释大体一致：医疗损失比率可以作为监管个人健康保险市场时衡量市场力量的目标指标，但其捕捉产品和公司异质性的能力明显有限。

abstract.text: When fitting an econometric model, it is well known that we pick up part of the idiosyncratic characteristics of the data along with the systematic relationship between dependent and explanatory variables. This phenomenon is known as overfitting and generally occurs when a model is excessively complex relative to the amount of data available. Overfitting is a major threat to regression analysis in terms of both inference and prediction. We start by showing that the Copas measure becomes confounded by shrinkage or expansion arising from in-sample bias when applied to the untransformed scale of nonlinear models, which is typically the scale of interest when assessing behaviors or analyzing policies. We then propose a new measure of overfitting that is both expressed on the scale of interest and immune to this problem. We also show how to measure the respective contributions of in-sample bias and overfitting to the overall predictive bias when applying an estimated model to new data. We finally illustrate the properties of our new measure through both a simulation study and a real-data illustration based on inpatient healthcare expenditure data, which shows that the distinctions can be important.

10.1002/hec.3003.abstractZh: 在拟合计量经济模型时，众所周知，我们会同时捕捉到数据的某些特异性特征以及因变量和解释变量之间的系统关系。这种现象被称为过拟合，通常发生在模型过于复杂，相对于可用的数据量而言时。过拟合对回归分析在推断和预测方面都是一个重大威胁。我们首先指出，当将Copas度量应用于非线性模型的未转换尺度时，该度量会因样本内偏差的收缩或扩张而变得混乱，而通常评估行为或分析政策时，我们关注的是这种未转换的尺度。然后，我们提出了一种新的过拟合度量方法，该方法既适用于感兴趣的尺度，又能免疫于这一问题。我们还展示了如何测量样本内偏差和过拟合对整体预测偏差的贡献，当将估计模型应用于新数据时。最后，我们通过模拟研究和基于住院医疗支出数据的真实数据示例，说明了我们新度量方法的特性，这表明这些区别可能非常重要。

abstract.text: In addition to quitting and cutting consumption, smokers faced with higher cigarette prices may compensate in several ways that mute the health impact of cigarette taxes. This study examines three price avoidance strategies among adult male smokers in Thailand: trading down to a lower-priced brand, buying individual sticks of cigarettes instead of packs, and substituting roll-your-own tobacco for factory-manufactured cigarettes. Using two panels of microlevel data from the International Tobacco Control Southeast Asia Study, collected in 2005 and 2006, we estimate the effects of a substantial excise tax increase implemented throughout Thailand in December 2005. We present estimates of the marginal effects and price elasticities for each of five consumer behaviors. We find that, controlling for baseline smoking characteristics, sociodemographics, and policy variables, quitting is highly sensitive to changes in cigarette prices, but so are brand choice, stick-buying, and use of roll-your-own tobacco. Neglecting such strategic responses leads to overestimates of a sin tax's health impact, and neglecting product substitution distorts estimates of the price elasticity of cigarette demand. We discuss the implications for consumer welfare and several policies that mitigate the adverse impact of consumer responses.

10.1002/hec.3004.abstractZh: 除了戒烟和减少消费外，面对更高香烟价格的吸烟者可能会采取几种方式来抵消香烟税对健康的负面影响。本研究考察了泰国成年男性吸烟者三种价格规避策略：选择价格较低的品牌、购买单支香烟而非整包香烟，以及用自制烟草替代工厂制造的香烟。我们利用2005年和2006年国际烟草控制东南亚研究收集的两组微观数据，估算了2005年12月泰国全面实施大幅消费税增加的影响。我们给出了五种消费行为的边际效应和价格弹性估计值。研究发现，在控制基线吸烟特征、社会人口统计和政策变量后，戒烟对香烟价格变化的敏感度很高，但品牌选择、购买单支香烟以及使用自制烟草的敏感度也较高。忽略这些策略性反应会导致对香烟税健康影响的过高估计，而忽略产品替代也会扭曲对香烟需求价格弹性的估计。我们讨论了这些发现对消费者福利的影响，以及几种能够减轻消费者反应负面影响的政策。

abstract.text: Understanding competition in the US drug market requires knowing how sensitive demand is to prices. The relevant prices for insured consumers are copayments. There are many studies of copayment elasticity in the health literature, but they are of limited applicability for studies of competition. Because of a paucity of data, such studies typically control for neither competitor copayment nor advertising. Whereas previous studies examined copayment sensitivity when copayments for branded drugs move in unison, this study examines copayment sensitivity when copayments diverge. This study uses unique panel data of insurance copayments and utilization for 77 insurance groups, as well as data on advertising. The results indicate that demand can be much more sensitive to copayment than previously recognized. Manufacturers selling drugs with higher copayments than branded competitors can lose substantial market share. Manufacturers can offset the loss of demand by increasing advertising to physicians, but it is costly.

10.1002/hec.3005.abstractZh: 要理解美国药品市场的竞争情况，就需要了解需求对价格的敏感程度。对于参保消费者来说，相关的价格就是共付额。在健康领域的文献中，有许多关于共付额弹性的研究，但这些研究在竞争分析中的适用性有限。由于数据不足，这些研究通常既没有考虑竞争对手的共付额，也没有考虑广告因素。而以往的研究通常只关注品牌药品共付额同步变动时需求对共付额的敏感性，本研究则关注共付额出现差异时需求的变化。本研究使用了77个保险群体的保险共付额和利用率的独特面板数据，以及广告相关数据。研究结果表明，需求对共付额的敏感性远高于以往的认识。那些销售比品牌竞争对手共付额更高的药品的企业可能会失去大量市场份额。企业可以通过增加向医生提供的广告来弥补需求的损失，但这成本很高。

abstract.text: To combat growing levels of obesity, health-related taxes have been suggested with taxes on foods high in fat or sugar. Such taxes have been criticised on the basis of their regressivity and potentially adverse impact upon poverty. This paper analyses the effect of such taxes on a range of poverty measures and also examines the effect of a revenue-neutral tax subsidy mixed with a tax on unhealthy food combined with a subsidy on more healthy food. Using Irish expenditure data, the results indicate that taxes on high fat/sugar goods on their own will be regressive but that a tax-subsidy combination can be broadly neutral with respect to poverty.

10.1002/hec.3006.abstractZh: 为了应对日益严重的肥胖问题，有人建议对高脂肪或高糖食品征收税收。然而，这类税收因其逆向性以及对贫困可能产生的负面影响而受到批评。本文分析了此类税收对一系列贫困指标的影响，并探讨了将税收补贴与针对不健康食品的税收相结合，同时提供健康食品补贴的税收中性方案的效果。利用爱尔兰的支出数据，研究结果表明，单独对高脂肪/高糖商品征税会具有逆向性，而税收补贴组合则可以在贫困问题上保持大致中性。

abstract.text: Primary care physicians play a substantial role in diagnosing and treating children's mental health disorders, but Medicaid managed care policies may limit these physicians' ability to serve low-income children. Using data from the universe of Medicaid recipients in three states, I evaluate how Medicaid managed care policies impact primary care diagnosis and treatment of children's mental health disorders. Specific policies examined include the presence of a behavioral carve-out, traditional health maintenance organization, or primary care case management program. To alleviate concerns of endogenous patient sorting, my preferred identification strategy uses variation in Medicaid policy penetration to instrument for individual plan choices. I show that while health maintenance organizations reduce diagnosis and non-drug treatment of mental health disorders, primary care case management program policies shift in diagnosis and treatment from within primary care to specialist providers such as psychiatrists, where serious mental health conditions are more likely to be identified.

10.1002/hec.3007.abstractZh: 初级保健医生在诊断和治疗儿童心理健康障碍方面发挥着重要作用，但医疗补助管理政策可能会限制这些医生为低收入儿童提供服务的机会。我利用三个州医疗补助受助者数据，评估医疗补助管理政策对儿童心理健康障碍的初级保健诊断和治疗的影响。具体考察的政策包括行为分割条款、传统健康维护组织或初级保健病例管理计划。为了缓解关于患者内生排序的担忧，我采用医疗补助政策渗透率差异作为个体计划选择的工具变量。研究表明，虽然健康维护组织减少了心理健康障碍的诊断和非药物治疗，但初级保健病例管理计划政策将诊断和治疗从初级保健转向专科医生，如精神科医生，这样更有可能识别出严重的心理健康问题。

abstract.text: This paper investigates whether patient-level factors, in particular cost considerations, affect the physicians' prescribing decisions. In the context of a natural experiment, we examine the effect of the first US commercial free-antibiotics program on retail antibiotic sales. We find an overall increase in antibiotic prescriptions under the program and substitutions to covered antibiotics from not-covered antibiotics. The shift away from not-covered antibiotics, particularly from those without covered equivalents, indicates a change in the physicians' prescribing decisions. We locate stronger program effects in low-income areas. Our findings, robust to a variety of specifications, are in contrast with previous literature.

10.1002/hec.3008.abstractZh: 本文探讨了患者层面的因素，尤其是成本考虑因素，是否会影响医生的处方决策。在一个自然实验的框架下，我们研究了美国首个免费抗生素计划对零售抗生素销售的影响。我们发现，在该计划实施期间，抗生素处方数量总体增加，且使用覆盖抗生素的频率高于未覆盖抗生素。从未覆盖抗生素转向使用覆盖抗生素的现象，表明医生的处方决策发生了变化。我们在低收入地区发现了更强的计划效果。我们的研究结果经多种假设检验验证，与以往的研究结果有所不同。

abstract.text: The literature on the effects of public smoking bans on smoking behaviour presents conflicting results and there is limited evidence on their impact on active smoking. This paper evaluates the impact of smoking bans on active smoking using data from the British Household Panel Survey and exploiting the policy experiment provided by the differential timing of the introduction of the bans in Scotland and England. We assess the short-term impact of the smoking bans by employing a series of flexible difference-in-differences fixed effects panel data models. We find that the introduction of the public smoking bans in England and Scotland had limited short-run effects on both smoking prevalence and the total level of smoking. Although we identify significant differences in trends in smoking consumption across the survey period by population sub-groups, we find insufficient evidence to conclude that these were affected by the introduction of the smoking bans. These results challenge those found in the public health literature but are in line with the most recent strand of economic literature indicating that there is no firm evidence on the effects of smoking bans on smoking.

10.1002/hec.3009.abstractZh: 关于公共禁烟令对吸烟行为影响的文献存在矛盾的结果，关于其对实际吸烟行为的影响的证据也十分有限。本文利用英国家庭面板调查的数据，并借助苏格兰和英格兰不同时间实施禁烟令这一政策实验，评估了禁烟令对实际吸烟行为的影响。我们通过一系列灵活的差分差分固定效应面板数据模型，对禁烟令的短期影响进行了分析。研究发现，英格兰和苏格兰实施公共禁烟令对吸烟率及总吸烟水平的影响较为有限。尽管我们发现了不同人口子群体在调查期间吸烟消费趋势上的显著差异，但缺乏足够的证据表明这些差异受到了禁烟令实施的影响。这些结果与公共卫生领域的研究结果相矛盾，但与最新的经济文献观点一致，即目前尚无确凿证据表明禁烟令对吸烟行为有显著影响。

abstract.text: Populations' structures and sizes can be a result of healthcare policy decisions. We use a two-period theoretical framework and a dynamic microsimulation model to examine the consequences of this assertion on the appraisal of alternative health policy options. Results show that standard welfare-in-health measures are sensitive to changes in populations' sizes, in that taking into account the (virtual) existence of the dead can alter the ranking of policy options. Disregarding differences in the survivals induced by alternative policies can bias programmes' ranking in favour of less live-saving policies. The paper alerts on the risk of policy misranking by the use of ex-post cross-sectional analyses, neglecting deaths occurring in the past as well as counterfactual deaths in alternative policy scenarios.

10.1002/hec.3010.abstractZh: 人口结构和规模可能是医疗政策决策的结果。我们采用两期理论框架和动态微观模拟模型来研究这一论断对评估不同医疗政策选项的影响。结果表明，标准的健康福利指标对人口规模的变化非常敏感，因为考虑到死者的存在会改变政策选项的排名。忽略不同政策导致的生存差异可能会使项目的排名偏向于那些对生命拯救作用较小的政策。本文通过事后横截面分析来警示政策排名错误的风险，这种分析忽略了过去发生的死亡情况以及替代政策情景中的反事实死亡情况。

abstract.text: This paper investigates the impact of the macroeconomy on the health insurance coverage of Americans using panel data from the Survey of Income and Program Participation for 2004-2010, a period that includes the Great Recession of 2007-2009. We find that a one percentage point increase in the state unemployment rate is associated with a 1.67 percentage point (2.12%) reduction in the probability that men have health insurance; this effect is strongest among college-educated, white, and older (50-64 years old) men. For women and children, health insurance coverage is not significantly correlated with the unemployment rate, which may be the result of public health insurance acting as a social safety net. Compared with the previous recession, the health insurance coverage of men is more sensitive to the unemployment rate, which may be due to the nature of the Great Recession.

10.1002/hec.3011.abstractZh: 本文利用2004-2010年的收入与计划参与调查中的面板数据，研究了宏观经济对美国人医疗保险覆盖程度的影响。研究期间包括2007-2009年的大衰退。研究发现，州失业率每上升一个百分点，男性拥有医疗保险的概率就会下降1.67个百分点（或2.12个百分点）。这一效应在受过大学教育、白人以及年龄较大（50-64岁）的男性中最为明显。对于女性和儿童而言，医疗保险覆盖程度与失业率的关联性并不显著，这可能是由于公共医疗保险作为社会保障体系的作用所致。与之前的经济衰退相比，男性医疗保险覆盖程度对失业率的敏感性更高，这可能是由于大衰退的性质所导致的。

abstract.text: This study aims to measure the causal effect of informal caregiving on the health and health care use of women who are caregivers, using instrumental variables. We use data from South Korea, where daughters and daughters-in-law are the prevalent source of caregivers for frail elderly parents and parents-in-law. A key insight of our instrumental variable approach is that having a parent-in-law with functional limitations increases the probability of providing informal care to that parent-in-law, but a parent-in-law's functional limitation does not directly affect the daughter-in-law's health. We compare results for the daughter-in-law and daughter samples to check the assumption of the excludability of the instruments for the daughter sample. Our results show that providing informal care has significant adverse effects along multiple dimensions of health for daughter-in-law and daughter caregivers in South Korea.

10.1002/hec.3012.abstractZh: 本研究旨在利用工具变量来衡量非正式照顾对女性照顾者健康和医疗使用的因果效应。我们采用了韩国的数据，在该国，女儿和儿媳是照顾体弱多病的父母和岳父岳母的主要来源。我们的工具变量方法的一个关键发现是，有功能受限的岳父岳母会增加提供非正式照顾的可能性，但岳父岳母的功能受限并不直接影响儿媳的健康状况。我们通过比较女儿和儿媳样本的结果，来验证工具变量对女儿样本的可排除性假设。研究结果表明，在韩国，为女儿和儿媳提供非正式照顾会在多个健康维度上产生显著的负面影响。

abstract.text: This paper analyzes determinants of ex-manufacturer prices for originator and generic drugs across countries. We focus on drugs to treat HIV/AIDS, TB, and malaria in middle and low-income countries (MLICs), with robustness checks to other therapeutic categories and the full income range of countries. We examine the effects of per capita income, income dispersion, competition from originator and generic substitutes, and whether the drugs are sold to retail pharmacies versus tendered procurement by non-government organizations. The cross-national income elasticity of prices is 0.27 across the full income range of countries but is 0.0-0.10 between MLICs, implying that drugs are least affordable relative to income in the lowest income countries. Within-country income inequality contributes to relatively high prices in MLICs. Although generics are priced roughly 30% lower than originators on average, the variance is large. Additional generic competitors only weakly affect prices, plausibly because generic quality uncertainty leads to competition on brand rather than price. Tendered procurement that imposes quality standards attracts multinational generic suppliers and significantly reduces prices of originator and generic drugs, compared with their respective prices to retail pharmacies.

10.1002/hec.3013.abstractZh: 本文分析了不同国家中原创药与仿制药价格的决定因素。我们重点关注中低收入国家用于治疗艾滋病、结核病和疟疾的药物，并对其他治疗类别以及各国的全部收入范围进行了稳健性检验。我们研究了人均收入、收入分布、原创药及仿制药替代品之间的竞争，以及这些药物是通过零售药店销售还是通过非政府组织招标采购的方式获得的。在全部收入范围内，跨国价格收入弹性为0.27，但在中低收入国家之间这一数值为0.0-0.10，这表明在最低收入国家，药物相对于收入而言是最难以负担的。国内收入不平等导致中低收入国家的价格相对较高。尽管仿制药的平均价格比原创药低约30%，但价格差异较大。额外的仿制药竞争者对价格的影响较弱，这可能是因为仿制药质量的不确定性导致竞争集中在品牌而非价格上。通过招标采购并设定质量标准，可以吸引跨国仿制药供应商，从而显著降低原创药和仿制药的价格，使其比在零售药店的价格更为优惠。

abstract.text: This paper reports the results of a best-worst scaling (BWS) study to value the Investigating Choice Experiments Capability Measure for Adults (ICECAP-A), a new capability measure among adults, in a UK setting. A main effects plan plus its foldover was used to estimate weights for each of the four levels of all five attributes. The BWS study was administered to 413 randomly sampled individuals, together with sociodemographic and other questions. Scale-adjusted latent class analyses identified two preference and two (variance) scale classes. Ability to characterize preference and scale heterogeneity was limited, but data quality was good, and the final model exhibited a high pseudo-r-squared. After adjusting for heterogeneity, a population tariff was estimated. This showed that 'attachment' and 'stability' each account for around 22% of the space, and 'autonomy', 'achievement' and 'enjoyment' account for around 18% each. Across all attributes, greater value was placed on the difference between the lowest levels of capability than between the highest. This tariff will enable ICECAP-A to be used in economic evaluation both within the field of health and across public policy generally.

10.1002/hec.3014.abstractZh: 本文报告了一项最佳-最差排序研究的结果，该研究旨在评估“成人探索性选择实验能力度量”（ICECAP-A）这一新的成人能力度量方法在英国的适用性。研究采用了主效应计划及其折叠法来估计五个属性中每个属性的权重。对413名随机抽样的个体进行了调查，同时收集了社会人口学信息及其他相关数据。尺度调整后的潜在类分析识别出两个偏好类和两个尺度类（用于描述差异）。尽管对偏好和尺度异质性的描述存在局限性，但数据质量良好，最终模型显示出较高的伪R平方值。在调整了异质性后，估计了总体关税。结果显示，“依附性”和“稳定性”分别占空间的大约22%，而“自主性”、“成就”和“享受”分别占约18%。在所有属性中，人们更看重能力最低水平之间的差异，而不是最高水平之间的差异。这一关税将有助于ICECAP-A在健康领域以及公共政策领域的经济评估中得到应用。

abstract.text: The growth of healthcare expenditure provokes constant comments and discussions, as countries battle the issues on cost containment and cost effectiveness. Prior to 1978, medical institutions in China were either state-owned or were collective public hospitals. Since 1978, China has been trying to rebuild its healthcare system, which was destroyed during the 'cultural revolution', allowing private medical institutions to deliver healthcare services. As a result, private medical institutions have grown from 0% to 28.57% between 1978 and 2010. In this context, we compare outpatient healthcare expenditures between public and private medical institutions. The central problem of this comparison is that the choice of medical institution is endogenous. So we apply an instrumental variable (IV) framework utilizing geographic information (whether the closest medical institution is private) as the instrument while controlling for severity of health and other relevant confounding factors. Using China's Urban Resident Basic Medical Insurance Survey 2008-2010, we found that there is no difference in expenditure between public and private medical institutions when IV framework is used. Our econometric tests suggest that our IV model is specified appropriately. However, the ordinary least square model, which is inconsistent in the presence of endogenous regressor(s), reveals that public medical institutions are more expensive.

10.1002/hec.3015.abstractZh: 医疗支出的增长引发了不断的评论和讨论，各国都在努力应对成本控制和成本效益问题。1978年之前，中国的医疗机构要么属于国有性质，要么是集体性质的公立医院。自1978年以来，中国一直在努力重建在“文化大革命”期间被摧毁的医疗体系，允许私人医疗机构提供医疗服务。因此，从1978年到2010年，私人医疗机构的比例从0%增长到28.57%。在此背景下，我们比较了公立和私人医疗机构的门诊医疗支出。这一比较的核心问题是医疗机构的选择是内生性的。因此，我们采用了工具变量框架，利用地理信息（如最近的医疗机构是私人性质）作为工具变量，同时控制健康严重程度和其他相关混杂因素。根据2008-2010年中国城市居民基本医疗保险调查数据，我们发现使用工具变量框架时，公立和私人医疗机构之间的支出没有差异。我们的计量经济学测试表明，我们的工具变量模型设定得当。然而，普通最小二乘法模型在存在内生回归变量时并不一致，结果显示公立医疗机构的医疗费用更高。

abstract.text: We estimate the causal labour market impacts of disability onset by gender, age and education levels up to 4 years after onset using longitudinal data from the Household Income and Labour Dynamics Australia survey and difference-in-difference propensity score matching techniques. We find lasting negative impacts on employment, especially full-time employment, which is due more to reduced movement into full-time employment than downshifting from full-time to part-time work following onset. Those without post-school education qualifications are particularly vulnerable to the impacts of onset and are more likely to be out of work and on income support than those with qualifications up to 4 years after onset, due in part because they have greater difficulty adjusting.

10.1002/hec.3017.abstractZh: 我们利用澳大利亚家庭收入与劳动动态调查提供的纵向数据，并通过差异-差异倾向得分匹配技术，研究了残疾发生对劳动力市场影响的性别、年龄和教育水平差异。研究发现，残疾发生后的4年内，就业状况受到持续负面影响，尤其是全职就业。这种负面影响更多是由于残疾发生后，人们难以重新进入全职就业市场，而非从全职工作转向兼职工作。那些没有接受过高等教育的人，在残疾发生后的4年内尤其容易陷入失业或依赖收入支持的状态，部分原因是他们更难以适应新的就业环境。

abstract.text: Background The appropriate thresholds for decisions on the cost-effectiveness of medical interventions remain controversial, especially in 'end-of-life' situations. Evidence of the values placed on different types of health gain by the general public is limited. Methods Across nine European countries, 17,657 people were presented with different hypothetical health scenarios each involving a gain of one quality adjusted life year (QALY) and asked about their willingness to pay (WTP) for that gain. The questions included quality of life (QoL) enhancing and life extending health gains, and a scenario where respondents faced imminent, premature death. Results The mean WTP values for a one-QALY gain composed of QoL improvements were modest (PPP$11,000). When comparing QALY gains obtained in the near future, the valuation of life extension exceeded the valuation of QoL enhancing gains (mean WTP PPP$19,000 for a scenario in which a coma is avoided). The mean WTP values were higher still when respondents faced imminent, premature death (PPP$29,000). Conclusions Evidence from the largest survey on the value of health gains by the general public indicated a higher value for life extending gains compared with QoL enhancing gains. A further modest premium may be indicated for life extension when facing imminent, premature death.

10.1002/hec.3018.abstractZh:
背景  
关于医疗干预的成本效益决策，合适的阈值仍然存在争议，尤其是在“临终”情况下。关于公众对不同类型健康收益价值的认知，现有证据有限。  

方法  
在九个欧洲国家，共有17,657人面临不同的假设健康情景，每种情景都涉及一个质量调整生命年（QALY）的收益，并询问他们对该收益的支付意愿。问题包括提升生活质量（QoL）和延长寿命的健康收益，以及受访者面临即将发生的早逝情景。  

结果  
对于由生活质量改善构成的单个QALY收益，平均支付意愿为11,000英镑。当比较近期获得的QALY收益时，延长寿命的估值高于提升生活质量收益的估值（在避免昏迷的情景中，平均支付意愿为19,000英镑）。当受访者面临即将发生的早逝时，平均支付意愿更高，达到29,000英镑。  

结论  
来自最大规模关于公众对健康收益价值的调查表明，与提升生活质量相比，延长寿命的收益具有更高的价值。在面临即将发生的早逝时，延长寿命的支付意愿可能还会进一步增加。

abstract.text: Universal public finance (UPF)-government financing of an intervention irrespective of who is receiving it-for a health intervention entails consequences in multiple domains. First, UPF increases intervention uptake and hence the extent of consequent health gains. Second, UPF generates financial consequences including the crowding out of private expenditures. Finally, UPF provides insurance either by covering catastrophic expenditures, which would otherwise throw households into poverty or by preventing diseases that cause them. This paper develops a method-extended cost-effectiveness analysis (ECEA)-for evaluating the consequences of UPF in each of these domains. It then illustrates ECEA with an evaluation of UPF for tuberculosis treatment in India. Using plausible values for key parameters, our base case ECEA concludes that the health gains and insurance value of UPF would accrue primarily to the poor. Reductions in out-of-pocket expenditures are more uniformly distributed across income quintiles. A variant on our base case suggests that lowering costs of borrowing for the poor could potentially achieve some of the health gains of UPF, but at the cost of leaving the poor more deeply in debt.

10.1002/hec.3019.abstractZh: 普遍公共财政——即政府为任何干预措施提供资金，无论资金由谁接收——对于健康干预措施而言，会在多个领域产生后果。首先，普遍公共财政能够增加干预措施的实施，从而提升健康收益的程度。其次，这种财政支持会带来一些财务后果，包括挤占私人支出。最后，普遍公共财政通过承担灾难性支出或预防疾病来提供保险，从而避免家庭陷入贫困。本文提出了一种扩展的成本效益分析方法来评估普遍公共财政在这些领域的后果。以印度结核病治疗为例，通过关键参数的合理取值，我们的基础案例分析表明，普遍公共财政带来的健康收益和保险价值主要惠及贫困人口。个人支出的减少在收入五分位数之间分布更为均匀。我们的基础案例分析的一个变体表明，降低贫困人口的借贷成本可能会带来部分健康收益，但代价是让贫困人口陷入更深的债务之中。

abstract.text: According to the justification hypothesis, non-employed individuals may over-report their level of work limitation, leading to biased census/survey estimates of the prevalence of severe disabilities and the associated labor force participation rate. For researchers studying policies which impact the disabled or elderly (e.g., Supplemental Security Income, Disability Insurance, and Early Retirement), this could lead to significant bias in key parameters of interest. Using the American Community Survey, we examine the potential for both inflated and deflated reported disability status and generate a general index of disability, which can be used to reduce the bias of these self-reports in other studies. We find that at least 4.8 million individuals have left the labor force because of a work-limiting disability, at least four times greater than the impact implied by our replication of previous models.

10.1002/hec.3020.abstractZh: 根据假设性解释，未就业人士可能会过度报告自己的工作限制程度，从而导致人口普查或调查中对严重残疾的患病率以及相关劳动力参与率的估计出现偏差。对于研究影响残疾人或老年人的政策的研究人员来说，这可能会导致关键参数的显著偏差。利用美国社区调查数据，我们研究了报告中的残疾状况可能被夸大或低估的可能性，并创建了一个通用的残疾指数，可用于减少其他研究中这些自我报告的偏差。我们发现，至少有480万人因为工作限制而离开了劳动力市场，这一数字至少是之前模型所暗示的影响的四倍。

abstract.text: This paper analyzes pharmaceutical pricing between and within countries to achieve second-best static and dynamic efficiency. We distinguish countries with and without universal insurance, because insurance undermines patients' price sensitivity, potentially leading to prices above second-best efficient levels. In countries with universal insurance, if each payer unilaterally sets an incremental cost-effectiveness ratio (ICER) threshold based on its citizens' willingness-to-pay for health; manufacturers price to that ICER threshold; and payers limit reimbursement to patients for whom a drug is cost-effective at that price and ICER, then the resulting price levels and use within each country and price differentials across countries are roughly consistent with second-best static and dynamic efficiency. These value-based prices are expected to differ cross-nationally with per capita income and be broadly consistent with Ramsey optimal prices. Countries without comprehensive insurance avoid its distorting effects on prices but also lack financial protection and affordability for the poor. Improving pricing efficiency in these self-pay countries includes improving regulation and consumer information about product quality and enabling firms to price discriminate within and between countries.

10.1002/hec.3021.abstractZh: 本文分析了不同国家之间的药品定价问题，旨在实现次优的静态和动态效率。我们区分了有全民保险和无全民保险的国家，因为保险会降低患者对价格的敏感度，可能导致价格高于次优效率水平。在有全民保险的国家，如果每个支付方根据其公民支付健康服务的意愿单方面设定增量成本效益比阈值；制造商根据该阈值定价；而支付方仅对在该价格下具有成本效益的药物给予患者报销，那么每个国家内的价格水平以及国家间的价格差异大致符合次优静态和动态效率。这些基于价值的定价预计会在国家间存在差异，并大致与拉姆齐最优价格一致。没有全民保险的国家虽然避免了保险对价格的扭曲效应，但缺乏为穷人提供财务保障和负担能力。在这些自付国家提高定价效率包括改进监管、提供有关产品质量的消费者信息，以及使企业在国家内部和国家之间能够实行价格歧视。

abstract.text: We investigate whether and how a change in performance-related payment motivated General Practitioners (GPs) in Scotland. We evaluate the effect of increases in the performance thresholds required for maximum payment under the Quality and Outcomes Framework in April 2006. A difference-in-differences estimator with fixed effects was employed to examine the number of patients treated under clinical indicators whose payment schedules were revised and to compare these with the figures for those indicators whose schedules remained unchanged. The results suggest that the increase in the maximum performance thresholds increased GPs' performance by 1.77% on average. Low-performing GPs improved significantly more (13.22%) than their high-performing counterparts (0.24%). Changes to maximum performance thresholds are differentially effective in incentivising GPs and could be used further to raise GPs' performance across all indicators.

10.1002/hec.3022.abstractZh: 我们研究了与绩效相关的支付变化是否以及如何激励苏格兰的全科医生。我们评估了2006年4月《质量与成果框架》下提高最大支付绩效门槛的影响。采用固定效应差分估计方法，研究在绩效指标下接受治疗的病人数量，并比较这些指标与那些支付计划保持不变的指标的数据。结果表明，提高最大绩效门槛使全科医生的绩效平均提高了1.77%。表现较低的全科医生比表现较高的全科医生有显著更多的改进（13.22%），而后者仅提高了0.24%。对最大绩效门槛的调整在激励全科医生方面具有差异性效果，并可以进一步用于提升所有指标的绩效。

abstract.text: Community-based health insurance in Lao People's Democratic Republic targets the informal workforce. Estimates of the program's impact on utilization and out-of-pocket expenditures (OOPs) were obtained using a case-comparison study of 3000 households (14 804 individuals) in urban and semi-urban areas. We used propensity score matching to control for bias on observables and to account for heterogeneity. We check the sensitivity of the results using a weighted regression combined with propensity score matching, which leads to doubly robust treatment effect estimates. The results are robust across the two approaches and show that the insured have significantly higher utilization, lower OOPs and lower incidence of catastrophic expenditures, and are less likely to employ coping mechanisms. However, coverage of the scheme is extremely low, indicating negligible population level impact. Furthermore, the results show that the scheme provides greater protection to the better off than to the poor: the poor are less likely to enrol, and among the poor who are enrolled, there has been no significant impact on utilization of outpatient services, total OOPs or catastrophic expenditures. We discuss the policy implications in the context of the international debate regarding the prospects for the role of community-based health insurance in national financing strategies.

10.1002/hec.3023.abstractZh: 老挝人民民主共和国的社区基础医疗保险主要面向非正式劳动力。通过一项针对3000户家庭（14,804人）的城市和半城市地区的案例对比研究，我们获得了该计划对使用率和自付支出影响的估计。我们使用倾向得分匹配方法来控制可观测变量的偏差，并考虑异质性。通过结合倾向得分匹配的加权回归方法，我们检验了结果的敏感性，从而得到了双重稳健的处理效应估计。两种方法的结果都具有稳健性，表明参保者使用率显著更高，自付支出更低，灾难性支出的发生率也更低，且不太可能采用应对机制。然而，该计划的覆盖率极低，表明其对人口层面的影响微乎其微。此外，研究结果表明，该计划对较富裕人群的保护作用大于对贫困人群：贫困人群参保的可能性较低，而在参保的贫困人群中，对门诊服务的使用率、总自付支出或灾难性支出的影响并不显著。我们在国际关于社区基础医疗保险在国家融资战略中作用的讨论背景下，讨论了该政策的意义。

abstract.text: Minimum legal drinking age (MLDA) laws are known to reduce alcohol consumption among young adults. One additional benefit of higher MLDAs may be that they improve health outcomes among infants born to young mothers. We estimate the impact of MLDAs on infant health in the USA by comparing birth outcomes among 14-20 year old mothers who were exposed to different MLDAs because of when and where they gave birth. Infants born to mothers who were between the ages of 21 and 24 years are included as a control group. We find that low MLDAs are associated with very small birth weight reductions, but have a little relationship with other traditional measures of infant health. We find compelling evidence, however, that a low MLDA increases the probability of a female birth, which suggests that restricting alcohol access to young mothers may reduce fetal deaths.

10.1002/hec.3026.abstractZh: 最低法定饮酒年龄法律被认为可以减少年轻成年人的酒精消费。提高最低法定饮酒年龄的另一个好处可能是，它能改善年轻母亲所生育的婴儿的健康状况。我们通过比较14至20岁母亲在因时间和地点不同而面临不同最低法定饮酒年龄情况下的出生结果，来估算最低法定饮酒年龄对婴儿健康的影响。将21至24岁母亲所生育的婴儿作为对照组。我们发现，较低的最低法定饮酒年龄与出生体重的显著下降关系不大，但与其他传统的婴儿健康指标有轻微关联。然而，我们发现一个令人信服的证据是，较低的最低法定饮酒年龄会增加女性婴儿出生的概率，这表明限制年轻母亲的酒精摄入可能会减少胎儿死亡。

abstract.text: This paper estimates the effect of alcohol use on consumption of hard drugs using the exogenous decrease in the cost of accessing alcohol that occurs when individuals reach the minimum legal drinking age. By using a regression discontinuity design and the National Longitudinal Study of Youth 1997, I find that all measures of alcohol consumption, even alcohol initiation increase discontinuously at age 21 years. I also find evidence that consumption of hard drugs decreased by 1.5 to 2 percentage points and the probability of initiating the use of hard drugs decreased by 1 percentage point at the age of 21 years, while the intensity of use among users remained unchanged. These estimates are robust to a variety of specifications and also remain robust across different subsamples.

10.1002/hec.3027.abstractZh: 本文通过估计酒精使用对硬性药物消费的影响，其中考虑了个体达到最低法定饮酒年龄时获取酒精的成本下降这一外部因素。采用回归不连续设计以及1997年青少年全国纵向研究的数据，我发现所有酒精消费指标，包括开始饮酒的年龄，在21岁时都呈现出不连续的下降趋势。我还发现，硬性药物的消费减少了1.5至2个百分点，开始使用硬性药物的概率也减少了1个百分点，而使用者的使用强度则保持不变。这些估计结果在不同参数设定下仍然具有稳健性，并且在不同子样本中也保持一致。

abstract.text: Resource use measures, including forms, diaries and questionnaires, are ubiquitous in trial-based economic evaluations in the UK. However, there are concerns about the accuracy of how they are described, which limits the transparency of reporting. We developed a simple and structured taxonomy for methods of resource use measurement by examining 94 resource use measures (RUMs) employed within clinical trials, conducting a descriptive synthesis of the extracted data and soliciting wider opinion during a period of consultation. The reporting of RUMs was found to be varied and inconsistent. Our new taxonomy, which considered the views of 20 consultees, requires that RUMs are reported with a description of the following: (i) the source of data (patient; patient proxy, e.g. carer, parent or guardian; observation of contemporary events; medical records; or other databases); (ii) who completes the RUM (patient or their proxy, and researcher or health care professional); (iii) how it is administered (to self [the patient], face to face or telephone); (iv) how it is recorded (form, questionnaire, log or diary); and (v) medium of recording (e.g. paper or electronically). Based on the present analysis, we have developed a taxonomy for RUMs that should result in data collection methods being described more accurately.

10.1002/hec.3029.abstractZh: 在英国，基于试验的经济评估中，资源使用测量方法包括表格、日志和问卷等，这些工具非常常见。然而，人们对这些测量方法的描述准确性存在担忧，这限制了报告的透明度。我们通过研究临床试验中使用的94种资源使用测量方法，对提取的数据进行了描述性综合分析，并在咨询期间征求了更多人的意见。结果发现，资源使用测量的报告存在多样性和不一致性。我们新的分类法考虑了20位咨询者的意见，要求资源使用测量方法在报告中包含以下信息：(i) 数据来源（患者本人、患者代理人，如护理者、父母或监护人；对当前事件的观察；医疗记录；或其他数据库）；(ii) 完成测量的人是谁（患者本人或其代理人，以及研究人员或医疗保健专业人员）；(iii) 测量方式（自我完成、面对面或电话）；(iv) 记录方式（表格、问卷、日志或日记）；以及(v) 记录媒介（纸质或电子形式）。基于当前的分析，我们为资源使用测量方法制定了一个分类法，这将使数据收集方法的描述更加准确。

abstract.text: In 2005, a Dutch health insurer introduced a financial incentive directed to general practitioners to promote rational prescribing of statins and proton pump inhibitors (PPIs). Concomitantly, a regional institution that develops pharmacotherapeutic guidelines implemented two educational interventions also aiming at promoting rational statin and PPI prescribing. Utilizing a prescription database, we estimated the effect of the interventions on drug utilization and cost of statins and PPIs over time. We measured the effect of the interventions within an implementation and a control region. The implementation region included prescriptions from the province of Groningen where the educational intervention was implemented and where the health insurer is most active. The control region comprised all other provinces covered by the database. We modelled the effect of the intervention using a state-space approach. Significant differences in prescribing and cost patterns between regions were observed for statins and PPIs. These differences however were mostly related to the concurrent interventions of Proeftuin Farmacie Groningen. We found no evidence indicating a significant effect of the rational prescribing intervention on the prescription patterns of statins and PPIs. Our estimates on the economic impact of the Proeftuin Farmacie Groningen interventions indicate that educational activities as such can achieve significant cost savings.

10.1002/hec.3030.abstractZh: 2005年，一家荷兰健康保险公司推出了针对全科医生的经济激励措施，以促进他汀类药物和质子泵抑制剂的合理处方。与此同时，一家负责制定药物治疗指南的地区性机构也实施了两项旨在促进他汀类药物和质子泵抑制剂合理处方的教育干预措施。我们利用处方数据库，评估了这些干预措施对他汀类药物和质子泵抑制剂使用及成本的影响。我们在实施区和控制区分别进行了干预效果的测量。实施区包括格罗宁根省的处方数据，该省是实施教育干预的地区，也是该健康保险公司活动最活跃的地区。控制区则包括数据库覆盖的所有其他省份。我们使用状态空间方法对干预效果进行了建模。结果显示，他汀类药物和质子泵抑制剂的处方模式及成本模式在不同地区存在显著差异。不过，这些差异主要与格罗宁根药物试验项目的同期干预措施有关。我们没有发现合理处方干预措施对他汀类药物和质子泵抑制剂处方模式产生显著影响的证据。关于格罗宁根药物试验项目干预措施的经济影响估计表明，此类教育活动本身能够带来显著的成本节约。

abstract.text: This study investigates whether the diagnosis-related group (DRG)-based payment method motivates hospitals to adjust output mix in order to maximise profits. The hypothesis is that when there is an increase in profitability of a DRG, hospitals will increase the proportion of that DRG (own-price effects) and decrease those of other DRGs (cross-price effects), except in cases where there are scope economies in producing two different DRGs. This conjecture is tested in the context of the case payment scheme (CPS) under Taiwan's National Health Insurance programme over the period of July 1999 to December 2004. To tackle endogeneity of DRG profitability and treatment policy, a fixed-effects three-stage least squares method is applied. The results support the hypothesised own-price and cross-price effects, showing that DRGs which share similar resources appear to be complements rather substitutes. For-profit hospitals do not appear to be more responsive to DRG profitability, possibly because of their institutional characteristics and bonds with local communities. The key conclusion is that DRG-based payments will encourage a type of 'product-range' specialisation, which may improve hospital efficiency in the long run. However, further research is needed on how changes in output mix impact patient access and pay-outs of health insurance.

10.1002/hec.3033.abstractZh: 本研究探讨了基于诊断相关分组（DRG）的支付方式是否能够促使医院调整产出结构以最大化利润。假设是，当某个DRG的盈利能力提高时，医院会增加该DRG的产出比例（自身价格效应），并减少其他DRG的产出比例（交叉价格效应），除非在两种不同DRG的生产中存在规模经济。这一假设在1999年7月至2004年12月期间台湾国家健康保险计划下的病例支付制度（CPS）背景下进行了检验。为了处理DRG盈利能力和治疗政策的内生性问题，采用了固定效应三阶段最小二乘法。研究结果支持了假设的自身价格效应和交叉价格效应，表明共享相似资源的DRG似乎是互补关系而非替代关系。营利性医院似乎对DRG盈利能力的变化反应不够敏感，这可能是由于它们的机构特性以及与当地社区的关系。关键结论是，基于DRG的支付方式将促进一种“产品范围”的专门化，这可能在长期内提高医院的效率。然而，需要进一步研究产出结构的变化如何影响患者的就医机会和健康保险支付。

abstract.text: We use British panel data to determine the exogenous impact of income on a number of individual health outcomes: general health status, mental health, physical health problems, and health behaviours (drinking and smoking). Lottery winnings allow us to make causal statements regarding the effect of income on health, as the amount won by winners is largely exogenous. Positive income shocks have no significant effect on self-assessed overall health, but a significant positive effect on mental health. This result seems paradoxical on two levels. First, there is a well-known gradient in health status in cross-sectional data, and second, general health should partly reflect mental health, so that we may expect both variables to move in the same direction. We propose a solution to the first apparent paradox by underlining the endogeneity of income. For the second, we show that lottery winnings are also associated with more smoking and social drinking. General health will reflect both mental health and the effect of these behaviours and so may not improve following a positive income shock.

10.1002/hec.3035.abstractZh: 我们使用英国面板数据来研究收入对一系列个人健康结果的外生影响：一般健康状况、心理健康、身体健康问题以及健康行为（如饮酒和吸烟）。彩票奖金使我们能够就收入对健康的效应做出因果推断，因为中奖者获得的奖金在很大程度上是外生的。正向的收入冲击对自我评估的整体健康没有显著影响，但对心理健康有显著的积极影响。这一结果在两个方面显得矛盾。首先，在横截面数据中，健康状况存在明显的梯度变化；其次，一般健康状况应部分反映心理健康状况，因此我们预计这两个变量会朝着相同的方向变化。针对第一个矛盾，我们提出了一种解决方案，即强调收入的内生性。对于第二个矛盾，我们发现彩票奖金也与更多的吸烟和社会饮酒有关。一般健康状况会同时反映心理健康状况以及这些行为的影响，因此即使经历正向的收入冲击，健康状况也可能不会得到改善。

abstract.text: The medical-care sector often experiences changes in medical protocols and technologies that cause shifts in treatments. However, the commonly used medical-care price indexes reported by the Bureau of Labor Statistics hold the mix of medical services fixed. In contrast, episode expenditure indexes, advocated by many health economists, track the full cost of disease treatment, even as treatments shift across service categories (e.g., inpatient to outpatient hospital). In our data, we find that these two conceptually different measures of price growth show similar aggregate rates of inflation over the 2003-2007 period. Although aggregate trends are similar, we observe differences when looking at specific disease categories.

10.1002/hec.3036.abstractZh: 医疗行业经常面临医疗协议和技术的变化，这导致治疗方式的转变。然而，劳工统计局报告的常用医疗价格指数将医疗服务的总体构成固定下来。相比之下，许多健康经济学家所倡导的病例支出指数则追踪了疾病治疗的全部成本，即使治疗方法在服务类别之间发生变化（例如，从住院到门诊治疗）。在我们的数据中，我们发现这两种概念上不同的价格增长指标在2003-2007年期间显示出相似的总体通胀率。尽管总体趋势相似，但在观察特定疾病类别时，我们观察到差异。

abstract.text: This paper considers the effect of mental health insurance mandates on the supply of cadaveric donors. We find that enacting a mental health mandate decreases the count of organ donors from suicides and results are driven by female donors. Using a number of empirical specifications, we calculate that the mental health parity laws are responsible for an approximately 0.52% decrease in cadaveric donors. Additional regression results show that the mandates are not related to other types of organ donations, ruling out the possibility that the mandates are related to an overall trend in the supply of organ donations. The findings suggest that future policies aimed at reducing suicide in a large and significant way can potentially increase the inefficiency that currently exists in the organ donor market.

10.1002/hec.3037.abstractZh: 本文探讨了心理健康保险强制规定对尸体捐赠者供应的影响。研究发现，实施心理健康强制规定会减少自杀者成为器官捐赠者的数量，且这一影响主要由女性捐赠者承担。通过多项实证分析，我们计算出心理健康平等法导致尸体捐赠者数量减少了约0.52%。进一步的回归分析表明，这些强制规定与其他类型的器官捐赠无关，从而排除了这些规定与器官捐赠总量趋势相关的可能性。研究结果表明，未来旨在大幅减少自杀行为的政策可能会加剧目前器官捐赠市场存在的效率低下问题。

abstract.text: Risky health behaviours substantially increase medical and social costs. We document the extent to which a sample of European students (from Denmark, France, Italy and Sweden) consider that individuals should assume the financial burden of paying the costs of risky behaviour. We test the acceptability of different ways of financing costs because of ill health that is more or less associated with risky behaviour in accordance with a normative framework relating to responsibility-sensitive fairness. We find that the majority of students agree with assuming financial responsibility for risky behaviours and that there should be compensation for unfavourable circumstances. Students agree that two individuals with the same responsibility variables should make an equal financial contribution and that more effort in maintaining health for given circumstances should be rewarded with a lower financial contribution. The specific health context and the type of risky behaviours involved matter in determining perceptions of justice in health financing.

10.1002/hec.3038.abstractZh: 危险的健康行为会大幅增加医疗和社会成本。我们调查了来自丹麦、法国、意大利和瑞典的欧洲学生样本中，有多少人认为个人应该承担支付危险行为相关费用的经济负担。我们根据责任敏感公平性的规范框架，测试了因健康不良而需要承担费用的不同融资方式的可接受性。研究发现，大多数学生同意为危险行为承担经济责任，并且认为在不利情况下应给予补偿。学生们认为，具有相同责任变量的两个个体应承担相同的经济负担，并且在特定情况下为保持健康付出更多努力的人应获得较低的经济负担。具体的健康背景以及涉及的危险行为类型，对人们对健康融资公平性的看法有着重要影响。

abstract.text: The paper discusses the impact of centre selection on the generalisability of randomised controlled trial (RCT)-based economic evaluations and suggests a future research agenda. The first section briefly reviews the current methods for addressing generalisability. We argue that these methods make no verifiable assumptions about how representative the recruiting centres are to the population of centres in the jurisdiction. The second section uses data from a multicentre RCT to illustrate that cost-effectiveness estimates can be influenced by the sample of recruiting centres. Finally, we propose two concepts that may advance generalisability research. First, we distinguish between the 'research space' and the 'policy space' and argue that policy makers are interested in the latter, while current methods describe the former. Second, we propose a centre-specific generalisability index used at RCT design stage to address generalisability. We conclude that future research should focus on generalisability at RCT design stage rather than on post hoc analyses.

10.1002/hec.3039.abstractZh: 本文探讨了中心选择对随机对照试验（RCT）基础经济评估的泛化能力的影响，并提出了未来的研究方向。第一部分简要回顾了当前用于解决泛化问题的方法。我们认为，这些方法并未对招募中心对所在地区中心总体的代表性做出可验证的假设。第二部分利用多中心RCT的数据表明，招募中心样本的选择会影响成本效益估计的结果。最后，我们提出了两个可能促进泛化能力研究的理念：首先，我们将“研究领域”与“政策领域”区分开来，认为政策制定者更关注后者，而当前的方法仅描述了前者。其次，我们提出了一种在RCT设计阶段使用的特定中心泛化指数，以评估泛化能力。我们得出结论，未来的研究应集中在RCT设计阶段的泛化问题上，而非事后分析。

abstract.text: For products such as tobacco and junk food, where policy interventions are often designed to decrease consumption, affected consumers gain utility from improvements in lifetime health and longevity but also lose utility associated with the activity of consuming the product. In the case of anti-smoking policies, even though published estimates of gross health and longevity benefits are up to 900 times higher than the net consumer benefits suggested by a more direct willingness-to-pay estimation approach, there is little recognition in the cost-benefit and cost-effectiveness literature that gross estimates will overstate intrapersonal welfare improvements when utility losses are not netted out. This paper presents a general framework for analyzing policies that are designed to reduce inefficiently high consumption and provides a rule of thumb for the relationship between net and gross consumer welfare effects: where there exists a plausible estimate of the tax that would allow consumers to fully internalize health costs, the ratio of the tax to the per-unit long-term cost can provide an upper bound on the ratio of net to gross benefits.

10.1002/hec.3040.abstractZh: 对于烟草和垃圾食品这类产品，政策干预通常旨在减少消费。受影响的消费者从改善的终身健康和寿命中获得效用，但同时也失去了消费这些产品所带来的效用。在反吸烟政策的情况下，尽管公布的关于健康和寿命的净收益估计值比直接意愿支付估计方法所建议的净消费者收益高出900倍，但在成本效益和成本效果文献中，很少有人认识到，当效用损失未被扣除时，总体估计值会高估个人福利的改善。本文提出了一个分析旨在减少过度高消费的政策的一般框架，并提供了一个关于净消费者福利与总体消费者福利之间关系的经验法则：如果存在一个合理的税收估计值，使得消费者能够完全内部化健康成本，那么税收与单位长期成本的比率可以作为一个上限，用于确定净福利与总体福利的比率。

abstract.text: The Institute for Quality and Efficiency in Health Care (IQWiG) developed-in a consultation process with an international expert panel-the efficiency frontier (EF) approach to satisfy a range of legal requirements for economic evaluation in Germany's statutory health insurance system. The EF approach is distinctly different from other health economic approaches. Here, we evaluate established tools for assessing and communicating parameter uncertainty in terms of their applicability to the EF approach. Among these are tools that perform the following: (i) graphically display overall uncertainty within the IQWiG EF (scatter plots, confidence bands, and contour plots) and (ii) communicate the uncertainty around the reimbursable price. We found that, within the EF approach, most established plots were not always easy to interpret. Hence, we propose the use of price reimbursement acceptability curves-a modification of the well-known cost-effectiveness acceptability curves. Furthermore, it emerges that the net monetary benefit allows an intuitive interpretation of parameter uncertainty within the EF approach. This research closes a gap for handling uncertainty in the economic evaluation approach of the IQWiG methods when using the EF. However, the precise consequences of uncertainty when determining prices are yet to be defined.

10.1002/hec.3041.abstractZh: 德国医疗保健质量与效率研究所（IQWiG）在与国际专家小组的咨询过程中，开发了效率前沿（EF）方法，以满足德国法定健康保险体系中对经济评估的多种法律要求。该EF方法与其他健康经济分析方法截然不同。本文评估了用于评估和传达参数不确定性的现有工具，以确定这些工具是否适用于EF方法。这些工具能够：(i) 以图形方式展示IQWiG EF框架内的总体不确定性（散点图、置信带和等高线图）；(ii) 传达与可报销价格相关的不确定性。研究发现，在EF方法中使用这些工具时，大多数图表并不容易解读。因此，我们建议使用价格报销可接受性曲线——这是对众所周知的成本效益可接受性曲线的改进。此外，净货币收益使得参数不确定性在EF方法中的解释更加直观。这项研究填补了在使用EF方法时处理经济评估中不确定性的空白。然而，在确定价格时不确定性的具体影响尚未明确。

abstract.text: All states provide Medicaid until the age of 19 years. After 19 years, young adults may become ineligible for Medicaid. Using the Medical Expenditure Panel Survey, we find that the resulting loss of Medicaid coverage causes substantial changes to the level and composition of health care use. The total number of visits to health care providers falls by over 60%, two-thirds of which is due to a decline in office visits. Expenditures, in particular inpatient expenditures, also appear to fall sharply.

10.1002/hec.3042.abstractZh: 所有国家都提供 Medicaid 服务，直至19岁。19岁之后，年轻人可能不再符合 Medicaid 的资格。通过医疗支出调查数据，我们发现 Medicaid 覆盖范围的丧失导致医疗服务的使用水平和构成发生了显著变化。患者就诊的总次数减少了60%以上，其中三分之二的减少是由于门诊就诊次数的下降。特别是住院费用也出现了明显的下降。

abstract.text: The conventional model for the use of cost-effectiveness analysis for health programs involves determining whether the cost per unit of effectiveness of the program is lower than some socially determined maximum acceptable cost per unit of effectiveness. If a program is better by this criterion, the policy implication is that it should be implemented by full coverage of its cost by insurance; if not, the program should not be implemented. This paper examines the unanswered question of how cost-effectiveness analysis should be performed and interpreted when insurance coverage may involve cost sharing. It explores the question of how cost sharing should be related to the magnitude of a cost-effectiveness ratio. A common view that cost sharing should vary inversely with program cost-effectiveness is shown to be incorrect. A key issue in correct analysis is whether there is heterogeneity in marginal effectiveness of care that cannot be perceived by the social planner but is known by the demander. It is possible that some programs that would fail the social efficiency test at full coverage will be acceptable with positive cost sharing. Combining individual and social preferences affects both the choice of programs and the extent of cost sharing.

10.1002/hec.3044.abstractZh: 传统的成本效益分析在健康项目中的应用模型，涉及确定该项目的每单位效益成本是否低于社会认定的最大可接受成本。如果该项目符合这一标准，则政策建议是应通过保险全额覆盖其成本来实施该项目；反之，则不应实施该项目。本文探讨了在保险覆盖可能涉及成本分担的情况下，如何执行和解释成本效益分析这一未解决的问题。文章还探讨了成本分担应如何与成本效益比率的大小相关联的问题。一种常见的观点认为，成本分担应与项目成本效益成反比，但这一观点是不正确的。正确分析的一个关键问题是，是否存在护理边际效益的异质性，这种异质性社会规划者无法感知，但需求者却能够了解。有可能一些在全额覆盖下无法通过社会效率测试的项目，在成本分担的情况下仍可以被接受。个体和社会偏好相结合，会影响项目的选择以及成本分担的程度。

abstract.text: The potential health impacts of imposing large taxes on soda to improve population health have been of interest for over a decade. As estimates of the effects of existing soda taxes with low rates suggest little health improvements, recent proposals suggest that large taxes may be effective in reducing weight because of non-linear consumption responses or threshold effects. This paper tests this hypothesis in two ways. First, we estimate non-linear effects of taxes using the range of current rates. Second, we leverage the sudden, relatively large soda tax increase in two states during the early 1990s combined with new synthetic control methods useful for comparative case studies. Our findings suggest virtually no evidence of non-linear or threshold effects.

10.1002/hec.3045.abstractZh: 对苏打水征收高额税收以改善民众健康的潜在健康影响已经引起了十多年的关注。根据现有低税率苏打水税收对健康的改善效果评估，近期的一些提议认为，高额税收可能通过非线性消费反应或阈值效应来有效降低体重。本文通过两种方式验证这一假设。首先，我们使用当前税率范围来估算税收的非线性效应。其次，我们利用20世纪90年代初两个州突然实施的较高苏打水税收，并结合适用于比较案例研究的新合成控制方法。我们的研究结果表明，几乎没有非线性或阈值效应的证据。

abstract.text: The majority of the UK population is either overweight or obese. Health economists, nutritionists and doctors are calling for the UK to follow the example of other European countries and introduce a tax on soft drinks as a result of the perception that high intakes contribute to diet-related disease. We use a demand model estimated with household-level data on beverage purchases in the UK to investigate the effects of a tax on soft drink consumption. The model is a Quadratic Almost Ideal Demand System, and censoring is handled by applying a double hurdle. Separate models are estimated for low, moderate and high consumers to allow for a differential impact on consumption between these groups. Applying different hypothetical tax rates, we conclude that understanding the nature of substitute/complement relationships is crucial in designing an effective policy as these relationships differ between consumers depending on their consumption level. The overall impact of a soft drink tax on calorie consumption is likely to be small.

10.1002/hec.3046.abstractZh: 英国大多数人口存在超重或肥胖的问题。健康经济学家、营养学家和医生呼吁英国效仿其他欧洲国家，对软饮料征收税，因为人们认为过量摄入这类饮料会导致与饮食相关的疾病。我们利用基于英国家庭饮料购买数据估算的需求模型，来研究对软饮料消费征税的影响。该模型是一种二次近似理想需求系统，采用双重障碍法处理数据缺失问题。针对低、中、高消费群体分别建立了模型，以区分这些群体之间的消费差异。通过不同的假设税率分析，我们发现了解替代品/互补品关系的性质对于设计有效的政策至关重要，因为这些关系因消费者的消费水平而异。总体而言，对软饮料征税对卡路里消费的影响可能较小。

abstract.text: How do fertility control policies contribute to the welfare of women, and their husbands, particularly as they get older? We consider whether the reduction in fertility resulting from population control policies has had any effect on the health of elderly parents in China. In particular, we examine the influence of this fertility decline, experienced due to China's one-child policy, on several measures of the health of parents in middle and old age. Overall, our results suggest that having fewer children has a positive effect on self-reported parental health but generally no effect on other measures of health. The results also suggest that upstream financial transfers have a positive effect on several measures of parental health.

10.1002/hec.3047.abstractZh: 生育控制政策如何有助于女性及其丈夫的福祉，尤其是在他们年龄增长的情况下？我们探讨了由于人口控制政策导致的生育率下降是否对中国老年父母的健康产生了影响。具体来说，我们研究了由于中国的独生子女政策而导致的生育率下降对中年和老年父母健康状况的若干指标的影响。总体而言，我们的研究结果表明，生育子女数量较少对父母自我报告的健康状况有积极影响，但对其他健康指标则一般没有显著影响。研究结果还表明，上游的财政转移对父母健康的若干指标有积极影响。

abstract.text: International differences in long-term care (LTC) use are well documented, but not well understood. Using comparable data from two countries with universal public LTC insurance, the Netherlands and Germany, we examine how institutional differences relate to differences in the choice for informal and formal LTC. Although the overall LTC utilization rate is similar in both countries, use of formal care is more prevalent in the Netherlands and informal care use in Germany. Decomposition of the between-country differences in formal and informal LTC use reveals that these differences are not chiefly the result of differences in population characteristics but mainly derive from differences in the effects of these characteristics that are associated with between-country institutional differences. These findings demonstrate that system features such as eligibility rules and coverage generosity and, indirectly, social preferences can influence the choice between formal and informal care. Less comprehensive coverage also has equity implications: for the poor, access to formal LTC is more difficult in Germany than in the Netherlands.

10.1002/hec.3050.abstractZh: 关于长期护理（LTC）使用的国际差异已有大量文献记载，但对其本质的理解仍不深入。本研究利用荷兰和德国这两个拥有全民公共LTC保险制度的国家的可比数据，探讨了制度差异如何影响非正式与正式LTC的选择。尽管两国的整体LTC利用率相似，但荷兰更倾向于使用正式护理，而德国则更偏好非正式护理。对两国在正式与非正式LTC使用上的差异进行分解后发现，这些差异并非主要源于人口特征的差异，而是源于与制度差异相关的特征效应差异。这些发现表明，诸如资格规则、保险覆盖程度以及间接的社会偏好等系统特征能够影响人们对正式与非正式护理的选择。此外，覆盖范围的不足也会对公平性产生影响：对于贫困人群而言，在德国获得正式LTC护理比在荷兰更为困难。

abstract.text: For decades, there is an ongoing discussion about the quality of hospital care leading i.a. to the introduction of minimum volume standards in various countries. In this paper, we analyze the volume-outcome relationship for patients with intact abdominal aortic aneurysm and hip fracture. We define hypothetical minimum volume standards in both conditions and assess consequences for access to hospital services in Germany. The results show clearly that patients treated in hospitals with a higher case volume have on average a significant lower probability of death in both conditions. Furthermore, we show that the hypothetical minimum volume standards do not compromise overall access measured with changes in travel times.

10.1002/hec.3051.abstractZh: 几十年来，关于医院护理质量的讨论一直持续着，这导致许多国家引入了最低诊疗量标准。在本文中，我们分析了腹主动脉瘤和髋部骨折患者的诊疗量-治疗效果关系。我们为这两种情况定义了假设的最低诊疗量标准，并评估了这些标准对德国医院服务可及性的影响。研究结果表明，在较高诊疗量的医院接受治疗的患者，在这两种情况下，死亡概率均显著较低。此外，我们还发现，假设的最低诊疗量标准并不会影响整体可及性，即不会增加患者的出行时间。

abstract.text: While migraine headache can be physically debilitating, no study has attempted to estimate its effects on labor market outcomes. Using data drawn from the National Longitudinal Study of Adolescent Health, we estimate the effect of being diagnosed with migraine headache on labor force participation, hours worked, and wages. Ordinary least squares (OLS) estimates suggest that migraines are associated with reduced labor force participation and lower wages among females. A negative association between migraine headache and the wages of female respondents is also obtained using an instrumental variables (IV) approach, although the IV estimates are imprecise relative to the OLS estimates.

10.1002/hec.3052.abstractZh: 虽然偏头痛可能会给身体带来极大的负担，但还没有研究试图评估其对劳动力市场结果的影响。我们利用《全国青少年健康纵向研究》的数据，估计了被诊断出患有偏头痛对劳动力参与率、工作小时数和工资的影响。普通最小二乘法估计表明，偏头痛与女性劳动力参与率的降低和工资的下降有关。使用工具变量方法也得出偏头痛与女性受访者工资之间存在负相关关系，不过工具变量估计的精确度不如普通最小二乘法估计。

abstract.text: This paper investigates the effects of China's New Cooperative Medical Scheme (NCMS) on health outcomes and healthcare expenditure of the elderly in rural China, using panel data from the 2005 and 2008 waves of the Chinese Longitudinal Healthy Longevity Survey. We employ a strategy that combines propensity score matching with a difference-in-differences approach to address selection bias. Results show that the NCMS has significantly improved the elderly enrollees' activities of daily living and cognitive function but has not led to better self-assessed general health status. We find no significant effect of NCMS on mortality for the previously uninsured elderly in NCMS counties, although there is moderate evidence that it is associated with reduced mortality for the elderly enrollees. We also find that the elderly participants are more likely to get adequate medical services when sick, which provides a good explanation for the beneficial health effects of NCMS. However, there is no evidence that the NCMS has reduced their out-of-pocket spending. Furthermore, we also find that low-income seniors benefit more from NCMS participation in terms of health outcomes and perceived access to health care, suggesting that the NCMS helps reduce health inequalities among the rural elderly.

10.1002/hec.3053.abstractZh: 本文利用2005年和2008年中国纵向健康长寿调查的面板数据，研究中国新型合作医疗计划对农村老年人健康结果和医疗支出的影响。我们采用 propensity score 匹配与差异-差异方法相结合的策略来应对选择偏差问题。结果显示，新型合作医疗计划显著改善了老年人日常生活能力和认知功能，但并未提升其自我评估的整体健康状况。对于之前未参加保险的老龄人口，新型合作医疗计划在NCMS县中并未对死亡率产生显著影响，尽管有证据表明该计划有助于降低老年参保者的死亡率。我们还发现，老年参与者在患病时更有可能获得足够的医疗服务，这为新型合作医疗计划带来的健康效益提供了有力解释。然而，没有证据表明新型合作医疗计划减少了老年人的自付支出。此外，我们发现低收入老年人从参与新型合作医疗计划中获得了更多的健康成果和更好的医疗服务获取体验，这表明该计划有助于减少农村老年人的健康不平等现象。

abstract.text: The procyclical nature of sickness absence has been documented by many scholars in literature. So far, explanations have been based on labor force composition and reduced moral hazard caused by fear of job loss during recessions. In this paper, we propose and test a third mechanism caused by reduced moral hazard during booms and infections. We suggest that the workload is higher during economic booms and thus employees have to go to work despite being sick. In a theoretical model focusing on infectious diseases, we show that this will provoke infections of coworkers leading to overall higher sickness absence during economic upturns. Using state-level aggregated data from 112 German public health insurance funds (out of 145 in total), we find that sickness absence due to infectious diseases shows the largest procyclical pattern, as predicted by our theoretical model.

10.1002/hec.3054.abstractZh: 许多学者在文献中记录了疾病缺勤的顺周期性。迄今为止，这些解释主要基于劳动力构成以及经济衰退期间因担心失业而产生的道德风险降低。在本文中，我们提出了第三种机制，即经济繁荣和疫情爆发期间道德风险降低所导致的现象。我们认为，在经济繁荣时期，工作量会增加，因此即使员工生病了，也不得不继续工作。在一个专注于传染病的理论模型中，我们发现这种情况会导致同事感染疾病，从而在经济上升期导致整体疾病缺勤率上升。通过利用德国112个公共健康保险基金（总共145个）的省级汇总数据，我们发现由于传染病导致的疾病缺勤呈现出最大的顺周期性特征，这与我们的理论预测一致。

abstract.text: I use Danish survey and administrative data to examine the impact of maternal employment during pregnancy on birth outcomes. As healthier mothers are more likely to work and health shocks to mothers may impact employment and birth outcomes, I combine two strategies: First, I control extensively for time-varying factors that may correlate with employment and birth outcomes, such as pre-pregnancy family income and maternal occupation, pregnancy-related health shocks, maternal sick listing, and health behaviors (smoking and alcohol consumption). Second, to account for remaining time-invariant heterogeneity between mothers, I compare outcomes of mothers' consecutive children. Mothers who work during the first pregnancy trimester have a lower risk of preterm birth. I find no effect on the probability of having a baby of small size for gestational age. To rule out that health selection of mothers between pregnancies drives the results, I focus on mothers whose change in employment status is likely not to be driven by underlying health (mothers who are students in one of their pregnancies and mothers with closely spaced births). Given generous welfare benefits and strict workplace regulations in Denmark, my findings support a residual explanation, namely, that exclusion from employment may stress mothers in countries with high-female employment rates.

10.1002/hec.3056.abstractZh: 我利用丹麦的调查数据和行政数据来研究母亲在孕期就业对分娩结果的影响。由于健康的母亲更有可能工作，而健康方面的冲击可能会影响母亲的就业和分娩结果，因此我采用了两种策略：首先，我广泛控制了可能与就业和分娩结果相关的随时间变化的因素，例如孕前家庭收入、母亲的职业、与孕期相关的健康冲击、母亲的疾病记录以及健康行为（吸烟和饮酒）。其次，为了考虑母亲之间剩余的不变性差异，我比较了母亲连续生育子女的结果。在第一个孕期工作的母亲，早产的风险较低。我没有发现她们生育的婴儿体重偏轻的情况有所增加。为了排除母亲在两次怀孕之间因健康原因而选择不就业的情况对结果的影响，我重点关注那些就业状态变化可能不是由潜在健康问题引起的母亲——比如在一次怀孕期间是学生的母亲，以及生育间隔较近的母亲。鉴于丹麦的福利政策较为优厚且工作场所监管严格，我的研究结果支持一种剩余解释，即在没有高女性就业率的国家的背景下，被排除在就业市场之外可能会给母亲带来压力。

abstract.text: This paper analyzes the profit maximizing capacity choice of a monopolistic vaccine producer facing the uncertain event of a pandemic in a homogenous population of forward-looking individuals. For any capacity level, the monopolist solves the intertemporal price discrimination problem within the dynamic setting generated by the standard mathematical epidemiological model of infectious diseases. Even though consumers are assumed to be identical, the monopolist will be able to exploit the ex post heterogeneity between infected and susceptible individuals by raising the price of vaccine in response to the increasing hazard rate. The monopolist thus bases its investment decision on the expected profits from the optimal price path given the infection dynamics. It is shown that the monopolist will always choose to invest in a lower production capacity than the social planner. Through numerical simulation, it is demonstrated how the loss to society of having a monopoly producer decreases with the speed of infection transmission. Moreover, it is illustrated how the monopolist's optimal vaccination rate increases as its discount rate rises for cost parameters based on Swedish data. However, the effect of the firm discount rate on its investment decision is sensitive to assumptions regarding the cost of production capacity.

10.1002/hec.3057.abstractZh: 本文分析了一个垄断疫苗生产商在面临疫情不确定事件时的利润最大化产能选择问题，研究对象为具有前瞻性思维的同质人群。对于任何产能水平，垄断者都在由标准数学流行病学模型生成的动态环境中解决跨时价格歧视问题。尽管假设消费者是相同的，垄断者仍能够通过提高疫苗价格来利用感染者与易感者之间的异质性，以应对不断增加的感染风险。因此，垄断者的投资决策基于在感染动态下的最优价格路径所带来的预期利润。研究表明，垄断者总是会选择比社会最优方案更低的生产能力进行投资。通过数值模拟，可以看出随着感染传播速度的增加，垄断者对社会的损失会逐渐减少。此外，基于瑞典数据的研究表明，随着折现率的上升，垄断者的最优疫苗接种率也会随之增加。然而，企业折现率对其投资决策的影响取决于关于生产能力成本的假设。

abstract.text: This paper presents an application of a new methodological framework for undertaking distributional cost-effectiveness analysis to combine the objectives of maximising health and minimising unfair variation in health when evaluating population health interventions. The National Health Service bowel cancer screening programme introduced in 2006 is expected to improve population health on average and to worsen population health inequalities associated with deprivation and ethnicity--a classic case of 'intervention-generated inequality'. We demonstrate the distributional cost-effectiveness analysis framework by examining two redesign options for the bowel cancer screening programme: (i) the introduction of an enhanced targeted reminder aimed at increasing screening uptake in deprived and ethnically diverse neighbourhoods and (ii) the introduction of a basic universal reminder aimed at increasing screening uptake across the whole population. Our analysis indicates that the universal reminder is the strategy that maximises population health, while the targeted reminder is the screening strategy that minimises unfair variation in health. The framework is used to demonstrate how these two objectives can be traded off against each other, and how alternative social value judgements influence the assessment of which strategy is best, including judgements about which dimensions of health variation are considered unfair and judgements about societal levels of inequality aversion.

10.1002/hec.3058.abstractZh: 本文介绍了一种新的方法论框架在分配成本效益分析中的应用，该框架旨在在评估人群健康干预措施时，同时实现健康最大化与减少健康方面的不公平差异。2006年引入的英国国家卫生服务系统结肠癌筛查计划，预计能够改善人群健康状况，但也会加剧与贫困和种族相关的健康不平等问题——这正是一种典型的“干预产生的不平等”现象。我们通过考察结肠癌筛查计划的两种重新设计方案来演示这一分配成本效益分析框架：(i)引入一种增强型目标提醒机制，旨在提高贫困和种族多样性社区中的筛查覆盖率；(ii)引入一种基础性的普遍提醒机制，旨在提高整个人群的筛查覆盖率。我们的分析表明，普遍性提醒机制是最大化人群健康状况的策略，而目标提醒机制则是最小化健康方面不公平差异的策略。该框架还展示了如何权衡这两个目标，以及不同的社会价值判断如何影响对哪种策略最优的评估，包括关于哪些健康差异维度被认为是不公平的判断，以及关于社会对不平等厌恶程度的判断。

abstract.text: An extensive literature has established that it is common for respondents to ignore attributes of the alternatives within choice experiments. In most of the studies on attribute non-attendance, it is assumed that respondents consciously (or unconsciously) ignore one or more attributes of the alternatives, regardless of their levels. In this paper, we present a new line of enquiry and approach for modelling non-attendance in the context of investigating preferences for health service innovations. This approach recognises that non-attendance may not just be associated with attributes but may also apply to the attribute's levels. Our results show that respondents process each level of an attribute differently: while attending to the attribute, they ignore a subset of the attribute's levels. In such cases, the usual approach of assuming that respondents either attend to the attribute or not, irrespective of its levels, is erroneous and could lead to misguided policy recommendations. Our results indicate that allowing for attribute-level non-attendance leads to substantial improvements in the model fit and has an impact on estimated marginal willingness to pay and choice predictions.

10.1002/hec.3059.abstractZh: 大量文献表明，在选择实验中，受访者常常忽略备选方案的属性特征。在多数关于属性忽略现象的研究中，人们假设受访者会自觉或不自觉地忽略一个或多个备选方案的属性特征，而并不考虑这些属性的不同水平。在本文中，我们提出了一种新的研究方法和模型构建方式，用于分析在探究对卫生服务创新偏好时出现的属性忽略现象。这种方法认识到，属性忽略现象可能不仅仅与属性本身有关，也可能与属性的不同水平有关。我们的研究结果表明，受访者对属性的不同水平处理方式不同：在关注某个属性时，他们会忽略该属性的部分水平。在这种情况下，通常假设受访者要么关注该属性，要么不关注，而不考虑其不同水平的方法是错误的，可能会导致错误的政策建议。我们的研究指出，考虑属性水平上的忽略现象可以显著改善模型拟合度，并对估计的边际支付意愿和选择预测产生积极影响。

abstract.text: China's recent and ambitious health care reform involves a shift from the reliance on markets to the reaffirmation of the central role of the state in the financing and provision of services. In collaboration with the Government of the Ningxia province, we examined the impact of two key features of the reform on health care utilisation using panel household data. The first policy change was a redesign of the rural insurance benefit package, with an emphasis on reorientating incentives away from inpatient towards outpatient care. The second policy change involved a shift from a fee-for-service payment method to a capitation budget with pay-for-performance amongst primary care providers. We find that the insurance intervention, in isolation, led to a 47% increase in the use of outpatient care at village clinics and greater intensity of treatment (e.g. injections). By contrast, the two interventions in combination showed no effect on health care use over and above that generated by the redesign of the insurance benefit package.

10.1002/hec.3060.abstractZh: 中国近期进行的雄心勃勃的医疗保健改革，涉及从依赖市场转向重新确认国家在资金筹措和服务提供中的核心作用。我们与宁夏省政府合作，利用面板家庭数据研究了改革中两个关键特征对医疗保健利用的影响。第一个政策变化是对农村保险福利方案进行了重新设计，重点是将激励措施从住院护理转向门诊护理。第二个政策变化是从按服务收费的方式转变为初级医疗服务提供者采用按绩效计费的预算模式。我们发现，单独实施保险干预措施时，村庄诊所的门诊护理使用率增加了47%，治疗强度也有所提高（例如注射治疗）。相比之下，这两种干预措施结合使用时，对医疗保健利用的影响并未超过保险福利方案重新设计所带来的效果。

abstract.text: If patients are discharged from the hospital prematurely, many may need to return within a short period of time. This paper investigates the relationship between length of stay and readmission within 30 days of discharge from an acute care hospitalization. It applies a two-part model to data on Medicare patients treated for heart attack in New York state hospitals during 2008 to obtain the expected cost of readmission associated with length of stay. The expected cost of a readmission is compared with the marginal cost of an additional day in the initial stay to examine the cost trade-off between an extra day of care and the expected cost of readmission. The cost of an additional day of stay was offset by expected cost savings from an avoided readmission in the range of 15% to 65%. Results have implications for payment reform based on bundled payment reimbursement mechanisms.

10.1002/hec.3061.abstractZh: 如果患者过早出院，许多人可能需要在较短时间内再次入院。本文研究了从急性护理医院出院后30天内再次住院与住院时间之间的关系。采用双部分模型对2008年在纽约州医院因心脏病发作而接受治疗的Medicare患者数据进行分析，以计算与住院时间相关的再次住院预期成本。将再次住院的预期成本与初始住院期间增加一天的边际成本进行比较，以评估额外一天护理与再次住院预期成本之间的成本权衡。研究表明，额外一天住院的费用可以通过避免再次住院而节省的15%至65%的预期成本来抵消。研究结果对基于捆绑支付报销机制的支付改革具有启示意义。

abstract.text: We investigate how risky health behaviors and self-reported health vary with the Dow Jones Industrial Average (DJIA) and during stock market crashes. Because stock market indices are leading indicators of economic performance, this research contributes to our understanding of the macroeconomic determinants of health. Existing studies typically rely on the unemployment rate to proxy for economic performance, but this measure captures only one of many channels through which the economic environment may influence individual health decisions. We find that large, negative monthly DJIA returns, decreases in the level of the DJIA, and stock market crashes are widely associated with worsening self-reported mental health and more cigarette smoking, binge drinking, and fatal car accidents involving alcohol. These results are consistent with predictions from rational addiction models and have implications for research on the association between consumption and stock prices.

10.1002/hec.3062.abstractZh: 我们研究了风险性健康行为与自我报告的健康状况如何随着道琼斯工业平均指数（DJIA）的变化以及股市崩盘期间发生变化。由于股市指数是衡量经济表现的主要指标，这项研究有助于我们理解健康状况的宏观经济决定因素。现有研究通常依赖失业率来代表经济表现，但这一指标仅捕捉了经济环境可能影响个人健康决策的一个渠道。我们发现，较大的月度DJIA跌幅、DJIA指数的下降以及股市崩盘与自我报告的心理健康状况恶化、吸烟频率增加、酗酒行为增多以及涉及酒精的致命车祸之间存在广泛关联。这些结果与理性成瘾模型的预测一致，并对研究消费与股票价格之间关系具有重要意义。

abstract.text: Staffing is the dominant input in the production of nursing home services. Because of concerns about understaffing in many US nursing homes, a number of states have adopted minimum staffing standards. Focusing on policy changes in California and Ohio, this paper examined the effects of minimum nursing hours per resident day regulations on nursing home staffing levels and care quality. Panel data analyses of facility-level nursing inputs and quality revealed that minimum staffing standards increased total nursing hours per resident day by 5% on average. However, because the minimum staffing standards treated all direct care staff uniformly and ignored indirect care staff, the regulation had the unintended consequences of both lowering the direct care nursing skill mix (i.e., fewer professional nurses relative to nurse aides) and reducing the absolute level of indirect care staff. Overall, the staffing regulations led to a reduction in severe deficiency citations and improvement in certain health conditions that required intensive nursing care.

10.1002/hec.3063.abstractZh: 人员配置是护理院服务生产中的主要投入要素。由于美国许多护理院存在人员不足的问题，一些州已经制定了最低人员配置标准。本文以加利福尼亚州和俄亥俄州的政策变化为研究对象，探讨了每居民日最低护理时数规定对护理院人员配置水平和护理质量的影响。通过对护理院人员配置及服务质量的数据分析发现，最低人员配置标准平均使每居民日的护理时数增加了5%。然而，由于最低人员配置标准对所有直接护理人员一视同仁，而忽略了间接护理人员，这一规定反而导致了两个意想不到的后果：一方面，直接护理人员的技能组合减少（即专业护士相对于护理助理的数量减少）；另一方面，间接护理人员的绝对数量也减少了。总体而言，人员配置规定使得严重缺陷问题的报告数量减少，同时某些需要密集护理的健康状况也有所改善。

abstract.text: We evaluate the impact of dental insurance on the use of dental services using a potential outcomes identification framework designed to handle uncertainty created by unknown counterfactuals-that is, the endogenous selection problem-and uncertainty about the reliability of self-reported insurance status. Using data from the health and retirement study, we estimate that utilization rates of adults older than 50 years would increase from 75% to around 80% under universal dental coverage.

10.1002/hec.3064.abstractZh: 我们采用潜在结果识别框架来评估牙科保险对牙科服务使用的影响，该框架能够处理由未知反事实所引发的不确定性，即内生选择问题，以及关于自我报告的保险状态可靠性的不确定性。利用健康与退休研究的数据，我们估计，在普遍实施牙科保险政策的情况下，50岁以上成年人的使用率将从75%增加到约80%。

abstract.text: Many South African children experience maltreatment, but we know little about the effects on long-term child development. Using the only representative dataset that includes a module on childhood maltreatment for a metropolitan city in South Africa, we explore the association between different measures of childhood maltreatment and two educational outcomes (numeracy test scores and dropout). Our study provides an estimate of the association between childhood maltreatment and educational outcomes in a developing country where maltreatment is high. We control for potential confounders using a range of statistical techniques and add several robustness checks to evaluate the strength of our findings. Our results indicate that children who are maltreated suffer large adverse consequences in terms of their numeracy test scores and probability of dropout and that the estimated effects of maltreatment are larger and more consistent for the most severe type of maltreatment.

10.1002/hec.3065.abstractZh: 许多南非儿童遭受过虐待，但我们对这种虐待对儿童长期发展的影响知之甚少。我们利用南非一个大城市唯一包含儿童虐待相关数据的代表性数据集，探讨了不同形式的儿童虐待与两种教育成果（数学测试成绩和辍学率）之间的关联。我们的研究为在虐待率较高的发展中国家，儿童虐待与教育成果之间的关联提供了估计值。我们通过多种统计技术控制了潜在的混杂因素，并进行了多项稳健性检验以评估研究结果的可靠性。研究结果表明，遭受虐待的儿童在数学测试成绩和辍学概率方面面临较大的负面影响，而且对于最严重类型的虐待，其影响更为显著且更为一致。

abstract.text: Nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs) are one of the most important classes of prescription drugs used by primary care physicians to manage pain. The NSAID class of products has a somewhat controversial history, around which a complex regulatory and informational environment has developed. This history includes a boxed warning mandated by the Food and Drug Administration (FDA) for all NSAIDs in 2005. We investigate the impact that various information shocks have had on the use of prescription medications for pain in primary care in the USA. We accomplish this by extracting data on nearly 600,000 patients from a unique nationwide electronic medical record database and estimate the probability of any active prescription for the four types of pain medications as a function of FDA actions, advertising, media coverage, and patient characteristics. We find that even after accounting for multiple sources of information, the FDA label changes and boxed warnings had a significant effect on pain medication prescribing. The boxed warning did not have the same impact on the use of all NSAID inhibitors. We find that the boxed warning reduced the use of NSAID COX-2 inhibitor use, which was the focus of much of the press attention. In contrast, however, the warning actually increased the use of non-COX-2 NSAID inhibitors. Thus, the efficacy of the FDA's black box warning is clearly mixed.

10.1002/hec.3067.abstractZh: 非甾体抗炎药（NSAIDs）是初级保健医生用于缓解疼痛的重要处方药之一。NSAIDs类药物的历史存在争议，这导致了一个复杂的监管和信息披露环境。这一历史包括美国食品药品监督管理局（FDA）在2005年对所有NSAIDs类药物规定的警示信息。我们研究了各种信息冲击对美国初级保健中疼痛治疗用药的影响。我们通过从全国性的电子病历数据库中提取近60万患者的数据，并估算了FDA的法规变化、广告、媒体报道以及患者特征等因素对四种类型疼痛药物处方概率的影响。研究发现，即使考虑到多种信息来源，FDA的标签变更和警示信息对疼痛药物处方仍有显著影响。然而，警示信息对所有NSAIDs抑制剂的使用并没有同样的影响。我们发现，警示信息减少了NSAIDs COX-2抑制剂的使用，而后者是媒体关注的焦点。相比之下，该警示信息实际上增加了非COX-2 NSAIDs抑制剂的使用。因此，FDA的警示信息效果存在明显的差异。

abstract.text: We take explicit account of the way in which the supply of physicians and patients in the economy affects the design of physician remuneration schemes, highlighting the three-way trade-off between quality of care, access, and cost. Both physicians and patients are heterogeneous. Physicians choose both the number of patients and the quality of care to provide to their patients.
