When determining physician payment rates, the principal must ensure access to care for all patients. When physicians can adjust the number of patients seen, there is no incentive to over-treat. In contrast, altruistic physicians always quality stint: they prefer to add an additional patient, rather than to increase the quality of service provided. A mixed payment mechanism does not increase the quality of service provided with respect to capitation. Offering a menu of compensation schemes may constitute a cost-effective strategy for inducing physicians to choose a given overall caseload but may also generate difficulties with access to care for frail patients.

10.1002/hec.3069.abstractZh: 我们明确考虑了经济中医生和患者的供应如何影响医生薪酬方案的设计，强调了护理质量、就医机会和成本之间的三重权衡。医生和患者都是异质性的个体。医生在决定为患者提供的患者数量和服务质量时具有选择权。在确定医生薪酬时，管理者必须确保所有患者都能获得医疗服务。当医生可以调整接诊患者数量时，他们就没有过度治疗的动机。相反，利他的医生总是倾向于降低服务质量：他们更愿意多接待一个患者，而不是提高服务质量。混合式薪酬机制并不会像按人头付费那样提升服务质量。提供多种补偿方案可能是一种成本效益高的策略，能够促使医生选择特定的患者数量，但也可能给体弱患者带来就医困难。

abstract.text: Using a matched insurant-general practitioner panel data set, we estimate the effect of a general health-screening program on individuals' health status and health-care cost. To account for selection into treatment, we use regional variation in the intensity of exposure to supply-determined screening recommendations as an instrumental variable. We find that screening participation increases inpatient and outpatient health-care costs up to 2 years after treatment substantially. In the medium run, we find cost savings in the outpatient sector, whereas in the long run, no statistically significant effects of screening on either health-care cost component can be discerned. In sum, screening participation increases health-care cost. Given that we do not find any statistically significant effect of screening participation on insurants' health status (at any point in time), we do not recommend a general health-screening program. However, given that we find some evidence for cost-saving potential for the sub-sample of younger insurants, we suggest more targeted screening programs.

10.1002/hec.3072.abstractZh: 我们利用匹配的投保人-全科医生面板数据集，估计了一般健康筛查计划对个体健康状况和医疗成本的影响。为了考虑治疗选择的影响，我们使用地区间对供应确定的筛查建议接受程度的差异作为工具变量。我们发现，筛查参与率在治疗后两年内显著增加了住院和门诊医疗成本。从中期来看，我们发现门诊部门存在成本节约现象，但从长期来看，筛查对医疗成本两个组成部分都没有显著的统计影响。总之，筛查参与率增加了医疗成本。鉴于我们没有发现筛查参与对投保人的健康状况有任何显著的统计影响（在任何时间点），我们不建议实施一般健康筛查计划。然而，鉴于我们发现年轻投保人的子样本中存在一定的成本节约潜力，我们建议实施更有针对性的筛查计划。

abstract.text: This paper addresses the influence of economic activity on suicide mortality in Europe. To this end, it employs a new panel data set of 275 regions in 29 countries over the period 1999-2010. The results suggest that unemployment does have a significantly positive influence on suicides. In line with economic theory, this influence varies among gender and age groups. Men of working age are particularly sensitive, while old-age suicide mortality (older than 65 years old) hardly responds to unemployment. Moreover, real economic growth negatively affects the suicide rates of working-age men. The results withstand several robustness checks, such as sample variations, and after controlling for serial and spatial autocorrelation.

10.1002/hec.3073.abstractZh: 本文探讨了经济活动对欧洲自杀死亡率的影响。为此，本文采用了1999年至2010年间29个国家275个地区的新型面板数据集。研究结果表明，失业确实对自杀率有显著的积极影响。与经济理论一致，这种影响在不同性别和年龄组间存在差异。工作年龄的男性尤为敏感，而老年自杀死亡率（65岁以上）对失业的响应较弱。此外，实际经济增长对工作年龄男性的自杀率有负面影响。这些结果在进行了多种稳健性检验后仍然成立，例如样本差异的检验，并在控制了序列和空间自相关后依然有效。

abstract.text: This paper examines the effect of the regulations restricting price increases on the evolution of pharmaceutical prices. A novel theoretical model shows that this policy leads firms to price new drugs with uncertain demand above the expected value initially. Price decreases after drug launch are more likely, the higher the uncertainty. We empirically test the model's predictions using data from the Canadian pharmaceutical market. The level of uncertainty is shown to play a crucial role in drug pricing strategies.

10.1002/hec.3075.abstractZh: 本文探讨了限制价格上涨的法规对药品价格演变的影响。一项新的理论模型表明，这一政策会导致制药企业最初以高于预期价值的定价来销售需求不确定的新药。药品上市后的降价可能性随着不确定性的增加而增加。我们通过加拿大药品市场的数据对模型的预测进行了实证检验。结果表明，不确定性在药品定价策略中起着至关重要的作用。

abstract.text: There is an increasing use of the discrete choice experiment (DCE) method in health care to estimate preferences of individuals and the public for different services. Despite this increasing use, there are few studies that investigate the validity of the DCE in health. This study investigates the external validity of DCE by comparing the predicted treatment choices from the DCE to the actual treatment choices made by the same respondents using a decision board (DB) approach. The sample includes 140 patients who came for a sleep apnea routine visit in a hospital setting. Each respondent answered 10 DCE tasks and 1 DB task. The preferences were estimated with a generalized multinomial logit model and the predicted and actual treatment choices were compared both at the sample and individual levels. The results raise questions about the external validity of DCE in health. At the sample level, the comparison showed large but not significant differences between the two methods. This can be explained in part by the aggregation process that obscures variability in the individuals' preferences. At the individual level, the comparison showed that the two methods led to significantly different patterns of choices.

10.1002/hec.3076.abstractZh: 在医疗保健领域，离散选择实验（DCE）方法被越来越多地用于估计个体和公众对不同服务的偏好。尽管这种使用日益增多，但关于DCE在健康领域的有效性的研究却很少。本研究通过比较DCE预测的治疗选择与同一受访者使用决策板方法实际做出的治疗选择，来探讨DCE的外部有效性。样本包括140名在医院接受睡眠呼吸暂停常规检查的患者。每位受访者完成了10项DCE任务和1项决策板任务。偏好通过广义多项式逻辑模型进行估计，并比较了样本层面和个体层面的预测与实际治疗选择。研究结果对DCE在健康领域的外部有效性提出了质疑。在样本层面，两种方法的比较显示出了较大但不显著的差异。这在一定程度上可以归因于聚合过程对个体偏好变异的掩盖。在个体层面，比较结果显示两种方法得出的选择模式存在显著差异。

abstract.text: This paper analyzes the timing decisions of pharmaceutical firms to launch a new drug in countries involved in international reference pricing. We show three important features of launch timing when all countries refer to the prices in all other countries and in all previous periods of time. First, there is no withdrawal of drugs in any country and in any period. Second, whenever the drug is sold in a country, it is also sold in all countries with larger willingness to pay. Third, there is no strict incentive to delay the launch of a drug in any country. We then show that the first and third results continue to hold when the countries only refer to the prices of a subset of all countries in a transitive way and in any period. We also show that the second result continues to hold when the reference is on the last period prices only. Last, we show that the seller's profits increase as the sets of reference countries decrease with respect to inclusion.

10.1002/hec.3078.abstractZh: 本文分析了在涉及国际参考定价的国家中，制药公司推出新药的时机选择。我们指出了在各国均参考其他所有国家及以往所有时期的价格时，推出新药的三个重要特征。首先，任何国家在任何时期都不会撤回药品。其次，当某种药品在一个国家销售时，它也会在其他支付意愿更高的国家销售。第三，没有任何严格的激励措施促使制药公司推迟在任何一个国家推出新药。随后，我们指出，当各国仅参考部分国家的价格，且时间跨度为任意时期时，上述第一个和第三个特征仍然成立。我们还发现，仅参考最后时期的价格时，第二个特征仍然成立。最后，我们表明，随着参考国家集合的缩小，销售者的利润会增加。

abstract.text: Regulatory entry barriers to hospital service markets, namely Certificate of Need (CON) regulations, are enforced in many US states. Policy makers in other states are considering reinstating CON policies in tandem with service expansions mandated under the Affordable Care Act. Although previous studies examined the volume effects of CON, demand responses to actual entry into local hospital markets are not well understood. In this paper, we empirically examine the demand-augmenting, demand-redistribution, and risk-allocation effects of hospital entry by studying the cardiac revascularization markets in Pennsylvania, a state in which dynamic market entry occurred after repeal of CON in 1996. Results from interrupted time-series analyses indicate demand-augmenting effects for coronary artery bypass graft (CABG) and business-stealing effects for percutaneous coronary intervention (PCI) procedures: high entrant market share mitigated the declining incidence of CABG, but it had no significant effect on the rising trend in PCI use, among patients with coronary artery disease. We further find evidence that entry by new cardiac surgery centers tended to sort high-severity patients into the more invasive CABG procedure and low-severity patients into the less invasive PCI procedures. These findings underscore the importance of considering market-level strategic responses by hospitals when regulatory barriers are rescinded.

10.1002/hec.3079.abstractZh: 美国许多州都实施了医院服务市场的监管准入壁垒，即需求认证法规。其他州的政策制定者正在考虑在《平价医疗法案》规定的服务扩展政策中重新实施需求认证法规。尽管先前的研究探讨了需求认证法规对市场规模的影响，但人们对实际进入当地医院市场的需求反应了解甚少。本文通过研究宾夕法尼亚州的心脏血管重建市场，来实证分析医院进入对市场需求的提升、重新分配和风险分配效应。该州在1996年废除需求认证法规后出现了动态的市场进入现象。间断时间序列分析的结果表明，冠状动脉旁路移植术的需求得到了提升，而经皮冠状动脉介入治疗则出现了“抢夺业务”效应：高进入市场份额减轻了冠状动脉疾病患者冠状动脉旁路移植术的减少，但对经皮冠状动脉介入治疗使用的增加没有显著影响。我们还发现，新的心脏手术中心进入市场时，倾向于将重症患者安排进行更具侵入性的冠状动脉旁路移植术，而将轻症患者安排进行较不侵入性的经皮冠状动脉介入治疗。这些发现强调了在解除监管壁垒时，需要考虑医院在市场层面的战略反应的重要性。

abstract.text: Under Medicare Part B, adjustments to the fee schedule are made under the assumption that physicians and hospitals make up for fee reductions through increased service provision called 'volume offsetting'. While historically, researchers have found evidence of volume offsetting, more recent studies have called into question its magnitude and existence. This study is the first to propose and empirically evaluate an alternative hypothesis of offsetting, namely the alteration of billed or provided services as a means of 'intensity offsetting'. Evaluating both forms of offsetting, it finds strong evidence of intensity offsetting and little to no evidence of volume offsetting. Simulating a 10% reduction in the Medicare fee schedule, this study estimates that across different procedures between 22% and 59% of a fee reduction will be offset through alterations in service intensity.

10.1002/hec.3081.abstractZh: 在Medicare Part B的框架下，对费用表的调整是基于这样一种假设：医生和医院通过增加服务量来弥补费用减少，这种机制被称为“服务量抵消”。虽然历史上有研究发现了服务量抵消的现象，但最近的研究对这一现象的规模和存在性提出了质疑。本研究首次提出并实证评估了一种替代的抵消机制，即通过改变计费或提供的服务量来实现“服务强度抵消”。通过对两种抵消机制进行评估，研究发现服务强度抵消具有较强证据支持，而服务量抵消则几乎没有证据支持。通过模拟Medicare费用表减少10%的情况，本研究估计在不同手术中，有22%到59%的费用减少可以通过改变服务强度来抵消。

abstract.text: This paper seeks to identify the effect of the implementation of the European Working Time Directive on the working hours of UK doctors. The Labour Force Survey is used to compare the working hours of doctors with a variety of control groups before and after the implementation of the directive. The controls include those unconstrained by the directive and doctor counterparts working in Europe. We use differences-in-differences and matching methods to estimate the impact of this natural experiment, distinguishing between the anticipation and enactment of the European Working Time Directive. We find that the legislation reduced the hours of senior doctors by around 8 hours in total including the component attributable to anticipation effects and allowing for (exogenously set) rising wages.

10.1002/hec.3082.abstractZh: 本文旨在研究欧洲工作时间指令的实施对英国医生工作时间的影响。通过劳动力调查，在指令实施前后，将医生的工作时间与多个对照组进行比较。对照组包括不受该指令约束的医生以及在欧洲工作的医生同行。我们采用差异差分和匹配方法，来估计这一自然实验的影响，并区分欧洲工作时间指令的预期实施与实际实施两个阶段。研究发现，该立法使得资深医生的总工作时间减少了约8小时，其中部分减少是由于预期效应所致，另一部分则是因为工资的提高。

abstract.text: This paper examines how Chinese smokers respond to tax-driven cigarette price increases by estimating a discrete choice model of demand for differentiated products, using annual nationwide brand-level cigarette sales data in China from 2005 to 2010. We allow for substitution between different cigarette brands and also incorporate key features of rational addiction theory into the model. Results show that the average own-price elasticity of demand for cigarettes at the brand level is -0.807, and the overall price elasticity of cigarettes at the market level is -0.488 in China. We find tax-induced substitution toward low-price cigarettes as well as high-tar cigarettes and that tax hikes encourage within-class substitution more than across-class substitution. These results have important policy implications for the potential effects of cigarette taxation.

10.1002/hec.3084.abstractZh: 本文通过构建离散选择模型，利用2005至2010年中国全国范围内的品牌级香烟销售数据，研究中国吸烟者如何应对税收导致的香烟价格上涨。模型考虑了不同品牌香烟之间的替代关系，并纳入了理性成瘾理论的关键特征。研究结果显示，中国品牌级香烟的平均自身价格需求弹性为-0.807，而整体市场价格需求弹性为-0.488。研究发现，税收促使消费者转向价格较低的香烟以及低焦油香烟，并且税收增加更倾向于促进同类品牌之间的替代，而非不同品牌之间的替代。这些研究结果对香烟税收政策的潜在影响具有重要的政策意义。

abstract.text: There has been a rapid increase in the use of cost-effectiveness analysis, with quality adjusted life years (QALYs) as an outcome measure, in evaluating both medical technologies and public health interventions. Alongside, there is a growing literature on the monetary value of a QALY based on estimates of the willingness to pay (WTP). This paper conducts a review of the literature on the WTP for a QALY. In total, 24 studies containing 383 unique estimates of the WTP for a QALY are identified. Trimmed mean and median estimates amount to 74,159 and 24,226 Euros (2010 price level), respectively. In regression analyses, the results indicate that the WTP for a QALY is significantly higher if the QALY gain comes from life extension rather than quality of life improvements. The results also show that the WTP for a QALY is dependent on the size of the QALY gain valued.

10.1002/hec.3085.abstractZh: 在评估医疗技术和公共卫生干预措施时，成本效益分析的使用速度迅速增加，其中质量调整生命年（QALYs）被作为结果衡量指标。与此同时，关于基于支付意愿估计的QALY货币价值的文献也日益增多。本文对关于QALY支付意愿的文献进行了综述。共识别出24项研究，包含383个关于QALY支付意愿的独特估计值。经过调整后的平均值和中位数分别为74,159欧元和24,226欧元（以2010年价格水平计算）。回归分析结果显示，如果QALY的增益来自延长寿命而非提高生活质量，那么对QALY的支付意愿会显著更高。研究结果还表明，QALY的支付意愿取决于所评估的QALY增益的大小。

abstract.text: The National Institute for Health and Care Excellence (NICE) emphasises that cost-effectiveness is not the only consideration in health technology appraisal and is increasingly explicit about other factors considered relevant but not the weight attached to each. The objective of this study is to investigate the influence of cost-effectiveness and other factors on NICE decisions and whether NICE's decision-making has changed over time. We model NICE's decisions as binary choices for or against a health care technology in a specific patient group. Independent variables comprised of the following: clinical and economic evidence; characteristics of patients, disease or treatment; and contextual factors potentially affecting decision-making. Data on all NICE decisions published by December 2011 were obtained from HTAinSite [www.htainsite.com]. Cost-effectiveness alone correctly predicted 82% of decisions; few other variables were significant and alternative model specifications had similar performance. There was no evidence that the threshold has changed significantly over time. The model with highest prediction accuracy suggested that technologies costing £40 000 per quality-adjusted life-year (QALY) have a 50% chance of NICE rejection (75% at £52 000/QALY; 25% at £27 000/QALY). Past NICE decisions appear to have been based on a higher threshold than £20 000-£30 000/QALY. However, this may reflect consideration of other factors that cannot be easily quantified.

10.1002/hec.3086.abstractZh: 英国国家健康与护理卓越研究所强调，成本效益并非评估健康技术的唯一考量因素，并且越来越明确地指出其他相关因素的重要性，但并未对每项因素给予相同的权重。本研究旨在探讨成本效益及其他因素对NICE决策的影响，以及NICE的决策方式是否随时间发生了变化。我们将NICE的决策建模为针对特定患者群体是否采用某种健康技术的二元选择。独立变量包括：临床和经济证据、患者、疾病或治疗的特征，以及可能影响决策的情境因素。截至2011年12月发布的NICE所有决策数据均来自HTAinSite [www.htainsite.com]。仅成本效益一项指标能够准确预测82%的决策结果；其他变量的重要性较低，不同模型规格的表现也相似。没有证据表明阈值随时间发生了显著变化。预测准确率最高的模型表明，每质量调整生命年成本达到40,000英镑的技术有50%的可能性被NICE拒绝（在52,000英镑/质量调整生命年的情况下为75%，在27,000英镑/质量调整生命年的情况下为25%）。过去的NICE决策似乎基于高于20,000至30,000英镑/质量调整生命年的阈值。然而，这可能反映了对难以量化的其他因素的考虑。

abstract.text: The self-employed are often reported to be healthier than wageworkers; however, the cause of this health difference is largely unknown. The longitudinal nature of the US Health and Retirement Study allows us to gauge the plausibility of two competing explanations for this difference: a contextual effect of self-employment on health (benefit effect), or a health-related selection of individuals into self-employment (barrier effect). Our main finding is that the selection of comparatively healthier individuals into self-employment accounts for the positive cross-sectional difference. The results rule out a positive contextual effect of self-employment on health, and we present tentative evidence that, if anything, engaging in self-employment is bad for one's health. Given the importance of the self-employed in the economy, these findings contribute to our understanding of the vitality of the labor force.

10.1002/hec.3087.abstractZh: 据报道，自雇人士通常比有固定工资的劳动者更健康；然而，这种健康差异的原因尚不清楚。美国健康与退休研究的纵向性质使我们能够评估两种相互竞争的解释的合理性：一种是对健康具有情境效应的自雇行为（福利效应），另一种则是个体因健康原因而选择自雇（障碍效应）。我们的主要发现是，相对健康的人选择自雇行为解释了这种积极的横截面差异。研究结果排除了自雇行为对健康具有积极情境效应的可能性，并且我们有初步证据表明，自雇行为实际上可能对健康不利。鉴于自雇人士在经济中的重要性，这些发现有助于我们理解劳动力的活力。

abstract.text: Technology is believed to be a major determinant of increasing health spending. The main difficulty to quantify its effect is to find suitable proxies to measure medical technological innovation. This paper's main contribution is the use of data on approved medical devices and drugs to proxy for medical technology. The effects of these variables on total real per capita health spending are estimated using a panel model for 18 Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development (OECD) countries covering the period 1981-2012. The results confirm the substantial cost-increasing effect of medical technology, which accounts for almost 50% of the explained historical growth of spending. Despite the overall net positive effect of technology, the effect of two subgroups of approvals on expenditure is significantly negative. These subgroups can be thought of as representing 'incremental medical innovation', whereas the positive effects are related to radically innovative pharmaceutical products and devices. A separate time series model was estimated for the USA because the FDA approval data in fact only apply to the USA, while they serve as proxies for the other OECD countries. Our empirical model includes an indicator of obesity, and estimations confirm the substantial contribution of this lifestyle variable to health spending growth in the countries studied.

10.1002/hec.3089.abstractZh: 技术被认为是增加医疗支出的重要决定因素。量化其影响的主要困难在于找到合适的指标来衡量医疗技术创新。本文的主要贡献在于使用已批准的医疗设备和药品数据作为医疗技术的替代指标。通过采用面板模型，对1981年至2012年期间18个经济合作与发展组织成员国的实际人均医疗支出进行了分析，以评估这些变量对总医疗支出的影响。研究结果证实，医疗技术的成本增加效应非常显著，几乎占医疗支出历史增长额的50%。尽管技术总体上具有正向影响，但两类批准产品对支出的影响却显著为负。这两类批准产品可以被视为“渐进式医疗创新”的代表，而正向影响则与具有突破性创新的药品和设备相关。由于美国食品药品监督管理局的数据实际上仅适用于美国，因此本文还针对美国建立了独立的时序模型，以作为其他经合组织国家的替代指标。我们的实证模型还包括了肥胖指标，相关估计结果证实，这一生活方式变量对研究国家医疗支出增长具有显著贡献。

abstract.text: This paper estimates the effects of higher cigarette prices and smoke-free policies on the prevalence of Sudden Infant Death Syndrome (SIDS). Using a panel of developed countries over a 20 year period, we find that higher cigarette prices are associated with reductions in the prevalence of SIDS. However, we find no evidence that smoke-free policies are associated with declines in SIDS.

10.1002/hec.3090.abstractZh: 本文估计了香烟价格上升和无烟政策对婴儿猝死综合症（SIDS）发病率的影响。通过选取20个发达国家的数据进行分析，我们发现香烟价格上升与SIDS发病率的下降有关。然而，我们没有发现无烟政策与SIDS发病率下降之间存在关联。

abstract.text: The coexistence of social health insurance and private health insurance in Germany is subject to intense public debate. As only few have the opportunity to choose between the two systems, they are often regarded as privileged by the health insurance system. Applying a hazard model in discrete time, this paper examines the role of incentives set by the regulatory framework and the influence of individual personality characteristics on the decision to opt out of the statutory system. To address potential endogeneity of one of the key explanatory variables, an instrumental variable approach is also applied. The estimation results yield robust evidence on the choice of health insurance type that is consistent with pragmatic decision making, with both incentives set by regulation and personality traits as relevant determinants.

10.1002/hec.3091.abstractZh: 德国社会医疗保险与私人医疗保险的并存引发了激烈的公众讨论。由于很少有人有机会在这两个体系之间做出选择，人们往往认为私人医疗保险体系是特权性的。本文采用离散时间下的风险模型，研究了监管框架所设定的激励措施以及个人性格特征对选择退出法定医疗保险体系的影响。为了处理其中一个关键解释变量的潜在内生性问题，还采用了工具变量方法。估计结果提供了关于医疗保险类型选择的稳健证据，这些结果与务实的决策方式一致，表明监管设定的激励措施和个人性格特征都是重要的决定因素。

abstract.text: We apply the theory of inequality of opportunity to the measurement of inequity in mortality. Using a rich data set linking records of mortality and health events to survey data on lifestyles for the Netherlands (1998-2007), we test the sensitivity of estimated inequity to different normative choices and conclude that the location of the responsibility cut is of vital importance. Traditional measures of inequity (such as socioeconomic and regional inequalities) only capture part of more comprehensive notions of unfairness. We show that distinguishing between different routes via which variables might be associated to mortality is essential to the application of different normative positions. Using the fairness gap (direct unfairness), measured inequity according to our implementation of the 'control' and 'preference' approaches ranges between 0.0229 and 0.0239 (0.0102-0.0218), while regional and socioeconomic inequalities are smaller than 0.0020 (0.0001). The usual practice of standardizing for age and gender has large effects on measured inequity. Finally, we use our model to measure inequity in simulated counterfactual situations. While it is a big challenge to identify all causal relationships involved in this empirical context, this does not affect our main conclusions regarding the importance of normative choices in the measurement of inequity.

10.1002/hec.3092.abstractZh: 我们将机会不平等理论应用于死亡率不公平的测量。通过利用一个包含大量数据的集合，该集合将死亡记录与健康事件与荷兰1998-2007年的生活方式调查数据联系起来，我们测试了估计的不公平程度对不同规范选择的敏感性，并得出结论：责任划分的位置至关重要。传统的不公平度量方法（如社会经济和地区性不平等）仅能捕捉到更全面的不公平概念的一部分。我们发现，区分变量与死亡可能相关的不同途径，对于应用不同的规范立场至关重要。根据我们实施的“控制”和“偏好”方法，直接不公平程度测量的不公平范围在0.0229到0.0239之间（0.0102-0.0218），而地区性和社会经济不平等则小于0.0020（0.0001）。通常的做法对年龄和性别进行标准化处理，这对测量的不公平程度有显著影响。最后，我们使用我们的模型来测量模拟反事实情境下的不公平程度。尽管在这种实证背景下识别所有因果关系是一项巨大的挑战，但这并不影响我们关于规范选择在衡量不公平中的重要性这一主要结论。

abstract.text: Malaria remains a devastating disease in Zambia, responsible for about 13% of deaths among children under age 5. Lack of malaria-specific knowledge has been commonly assumed to be an important barrier to engagement in behaviors that prevent malaria. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first study that accounts for the endogeneity of maternal knowledge in household's ownership of insecticide-treated nets (ITN), child's use of ITN, and household's protection against mosquitos (HSP). We account for the endogeneity of maternal knowledge through discrete factor and standard instrumental variable estimators. We find significant causal effects of maternal knowledge on the child's use of ITN and HSP but no significant effect on ownership of ITN. The causal effects of maternal knowledge on the use of ITN and HSP are strikingly larger in magnitude than the effects in the reduced form models.

10.1002/hec.3093.abstractZh: 疟疾在赞比亚仍然是一种毁灭性的疾病，导致约13%的5岁以下儿童死亡。通常认为，缺乏关于疟疾的知识是阻碍人们采取预防疟疾行为的重要障碍。据我们所知，这是第一项研究探讨母亲知识对家庭拥有杀虫剂处理蚊帐、儿童使用蚊帐以及家庭防蚊措施之间内生关系的研究。我们通过离散因子和标准工具变量估计方法，探讨了母亲知识的内生性。研究发现，母亲知识对儿童使用蚊帐和防蚊措施有显著的影响，但对家庭拥有蚊帐则没有显著影响。母亲知识对蚊帐和防蚊措施使用的因果效应，比简化模型中的效应更为显著。

abstract.text: Obesity, like many health conditions, is more prevalent among the socioeconomically disadvantaged. In our data, very poor women are three times more likely to be obese and five times more likely to be severely obese than rich women. Despite this strong correlation, it remains unclear whether higher wealth causes lower obesity. In this paper, we use nationally representative panel data and exogenous wealth shocks (primarily inheritances and lottery wins) to shed light on this issue. Our estimates show that wealth improvements increase weight for women, but not men. This effect differs by initial wealth and weight-an average-sized wealth shock received by initially poor and obese women is estimated to increase weight by almost 10 lb. Importantly, for some females, the effects appear permanent. We also find that a change in diet is the most likely explanation for the weight gain. Overall, the results suggest that additional wealth may exacerbate rather than alleviate weight problems.

10.1002/hec.3094.abstractZh: 肥胖与许多健康状况一样，在社会经济地位较低的群体中更为普遍。在我们的数据中，非常贫困的女性肥胖的可能性是富裕女性的三倍，而严重肥胖的可能性则是富裕女性的五倍。尽管存在这种强烈的关联，但尚不清楚较高的财富是否会导致较低的肥胖率。在本文中，我们使用了具有全国代表性的面板数据以及外部财富冲击（主要是遗产和彩票中奖）来探讨这一问题。我们的估计结果显示，财富的增加确实会促使女性体重增加，但男性则不会。这种效应因初始财富的不同而有所差异，最初贫困且肥胖的女性在经历一次中等规模的财富冲击后，体重平均会增加近10磅。重要的是，对于某些女性来说，这种体重增加似乎是永久性的。我们还发现，饮食变化是最有可能解释体重增加的原因。总体而言，这些结果表明，额外的财富可能会加剧而非缓解体重问题。

abstract.text: Global budget payment is one of the most effective strategies for cost containment, but its impacts on provider behavior have not been explored in detail. This study examines the theoretical and empirical role of global budget payment on provider behavior. The study proposes that global budget payment with price adjustment is a form of common-pool resources. A two-product game theoretic model is derived, and simulations demonstrate that hospitals are expected to expand service volumes, with an emphasis on products with higher price-marginal cost ratios. Next, the study examines the early effects of Taiwan's global budget payment system using a difference-in-difference strategy and finds that Taiwanese hospitals exhibited such behavior, where the pursuit of individual interests led to an increase in treatment intensities. Furthermore, hospitals significantly increased inpatient service volume for regional hospitals and medical centers. In contrast, local hospitals, particularly for those without teaching status designation, faced a negative impact on service volume, as larger hospitals were better positioned to induce demand and pulled volume away from their smaller counterparts through more profitable services and products such as radiology and pharmaceuticals.

10.1002/hec.3095.abstractZh: 全球预算支付是控制成本的最有效策略之一，但其对医疗服务提供者行为的影响尚未得到详细研究。本研究探讨了全球预算支付对医疗服务提供者行为的理论和实证影响。研究提出，带有价格调整的全球预算支付是一种公共资源的分配方式。通过构建两产品博弈理论模型，模拟结果显示，医院会扩大服务规模，尤其是那些价格与边际成本比率较高的产品。此外，研究利用差异-差异策略分析了台湾全球预算支付系统的早期效果，发现台湾的医院也表现出类似行为，即追求个人利益导致治疗强度增加。同时，地区性医院和医疗中心的住院服务规模显著增加。相比之下，没有教学资质的地方医院则面临服务规模下降的负面影响，因为规模较大的医院能够通过更有利可图的服务和产品，如放射科和药品，吸引更多患者，从而挤占小型医院的业务量。

abstract.text: This paper examines an under-explored unintended consequence of public reporting: the potential for demand rationing. Public reporting, although intended to increase consumer access to high-quality products, may have provided the perverse incentive for high-quality providers facing fixed capacity and administrative pricing to avoid less profitable types of residents. Using data from the nursing home industry before and after the implementation of the public reporting system in 2002, we find that high-quality nursing homes facing capacity constraints reduced admissions of less profitable Medicaid residents while increasing the more profitable Medicare and private-pay admissions, relative to low-quality nursing homes facing no capacity constraints. These effects, although small in magnitude, are consistent with provider rationing of demand on the basis of profitability and underscore the important role of institutional details in designing effective public reporting systems for regulated industries.

10.1002/hec.3097.abstractZh: 本文探讨了公共报告这一未被充分探索的意外后果：需求配给的可能性。虽然公共报告旨在提高消费者获得高质量产品的机会，但它可能为那些面临固定产能和行政定价的高品质服务提供者提供了反向激励，使他们避免服务利润较低的居民。通过对比2002年公共报告制度实施前后护理院行业的数据，我们发现，面临产能限制的高质量护理院减少了利润较低的医疗补助居民的入住量，同时增加了利润较高的医疗保险和私人付费居民的入住量，这一结果与没有产能限制的低质量护理院相比有所不同。尽管这些影响的幅度较小，但它们与基于盈利能力的需求配给相一致，并强调了在为受监管行业设计有效的公共报告系统时，机构细节的重要性。

abstract.text: We provide new evidence on the effects of increasingly common driver cellphone bans on self-reported overall, handheld, and hands-free cellphone use while driving by studying Ontario, Canada, which instituted a 3-month education campaign in November 2009 followed by a binding driver cellphone ban in February 2010. Using residents of Alberta as a control group in a difference-in-differences framework, we find visual and regression-based evidence that Ontario's cellphone ban significantly reduced overall and handheld cellphone use. We also find that the policies significantly increased hands-free cellphone use. The reductions in overall and handheld use are driven exclusively by women, whereas the increases in hands-free use are much larger for men. Our results provide the first direct evidence that cellphone bans have the unintended effect of inducing substitution to hands-free devices.

10.1002/hec.3098.abstractZh: 我们通过研究加拿大安大略省在2009年11月开展为期3个月的教育宣传活动，并于2010年2月实施强制性的手机禁令，得出了关于日益普遍的移动电话禁令对驾驶时整体、手持和免提手机使用行为影响的新的证据。以阿尔伯塔省的居民作为对照组，在差异-差异框架中，我们发现视觉和回归分析的结果表明，安大略省的手机禁令显著减少了整体和手持手机的使用。此外，该政策还显著增加了免提手机的使用。整体和手持手机使用的减少主要出现在女性中，而免提手机使用的增加则更多地出现在男性中。我们的研究结果首次直接证明了手机禁令会产生诱导人们使用免提设备的意外效果。

abstract.text: Certain nutrients can stimulate appetite making them fattening in a way that is not fully conveyed by the calorie content on the label. For rational eaters, this information gap could be corrected by more labeling. As an alternative, this paper proposes a set of positive and negative taxes on the fattening and slimming nutrients in food rather than on the food itself. There are conditions under which this tax plus subsidy system could increase welfare by stopping unwanted weight gain while leaving the final retail price of food unchanged. A nutrient tax system could improve welfare if fattening nutrients, net of their effect on weight, are inferior goods and the fiscal cost of administering the tax is sufficiently low. More data on the price elasticity of demand for nutrients as well as data on how specific nutrients affect satiety and how total calorie intake would be necessary before one could be sure a nutrient tax would work in practice.

10.1002/hec.3101.abstractZh: 某些营养素能够刺激食欲，从而以一种不完全通过标签上的卡路里含量来体现的方式导致肥胖。对于理性饮食的人来说，这种信息缺失可以通过更多的标签标注来弥补。作为替代方案，本文提出了对食品中导致肥胖和减肥的营养素征收正面和负面税的方法，而不是对食品本身征税。在某些条件下，这种税收与补贴制度可以通过阻止不必要的体重增加来提高福利，同时保持食品的最终零售价格不变。如果导致肥胖的营养素在扣除其对体重的影响后属于劣质商品，并且征收税收的财政成本足够低，那么营养素税收制度可以提高福利。在确保营养素税收在实际中能够发挥作用之前，还需要更多关于营养素需求价格弹性数据，以及关于特定营养素如何影响饱腹感以及总卡路里摄入量的数据。

abstract.text: This paper aims to explore potential associations between health inequalities related to socioeconomic deprivation at the individual and the small area level. We use German cross-sectional survey data for the years 2002 and 2006, and measure small area deprivation via the German Index of Multiple Deprivation. We test the differences between concentration indices of income-related and small area deprivation related inequalities in obesity, hypertension, and diabetes. Our results suggest that small area deprivation and individual income both yield inequalities in health favoring the better-off, where individual income-related inequalities are significantly more pronounced than those related to small area deprivation. We then apply a semiparametric extension of Wagstaff's corrected concentration index to explore how individual-level health inequalities vary with the degree of regional deprivation. We find that the concentration of obesity, hypertension, and diabetes among lower income groups also exists at the small area level. The degree of deprivation-specific income-related inequalities in the three health outcomes exhibits only little variations across different levels of multiple deprivation for both sexes.

10.1002/hec.3102.abstractZh: 本文旨在探讨与社会经济贫困相关的健康不平等在个体和小区域层面上的潜在关联。我们使用了2002年和2006年的德国横断面调查数据，并通过德国多重贫困指数来衡量小区域的贫困状况。我们测试了与收入相关的小区域贫困和不平等与肥胖、高血压和糖尿病之间的差异。研究结果表明，小区域贫困和个人收入都导致了有利于富裕群体的健康不平等，其中与收入相关的不平等明显比与小区域贫困相关的不平等更为显著。随后，我们应用Wagstaff修正后的浓度指数进行半参数扩展分析，以探讨个体层面的健康不平等如何随区域贫困程度的变化而变化。研究发现，低收入群体在肥胖、高血压和糖尿病方面的集中程度也存在于小区域层面。在这三种健康指标上，特定贫困程度下的收入相关不平等在不同多重贫困水平下仅表现出很小的变化。

abstract.text: Our aim was to adapt the traditional framework for expected net benefit of sampling (ENBS) to be more compatible with drug development trials from the pharmaceutical perspective. We modify the traditional framework for conducting ENBS and assume that the price of the drug is conditional on the trial outcomes. We use a value-based pricing (VBP) criterion to determine price conditional on trial data using Bayesian updating of cost-effectiveness (CE) model parameters. We assume that there is a threshold price below which the company would not market the new intervention. We present a case study in which a phase III trial sample size and trial duration are varied. For each trial design, we sampled 10,000 trial outcomes and estimated VBP using a CE model. The expected commercial net benefit is calculated as the expected profits minus the trial costs. A clinical trial with shorter follow-up, and larger sample size, generated the greatest expected commercial net benefit. Increasing the duration of follow-up had a modest impact on profit forecasts. Expected net benefit of sampling can be adapted to value clinical trials in the pharmaceutical industry to optimise the expected commercial net benefit. However, the analyses can be very time consuming for complex CE models.

10.1002/hec.3103.abstractZh: 我们的目标是将传统的预期净收益抽样框架进行调整，使其更符合制药行业在药物开发试验中的需求。我们修改了传统的预期净收益抽样框架，并假设药物价格取决于试验结果。我们采用基于价值的定价标准，通过贝叶斯更新成本效益模型参数来确定价格条件。我们假设存在一个阈值价格，低于该价格公司不会推广新的干预措施。我们通过一个案例研究来展示，在III期试验的不同样本量和试验持续时间下的结果。对于每种试验设计，我们抽样了10,000个试验结果，并使用成本效益模型估算价值定价。预期商业净收益计算为预期利润减去试验成本。持续时间较短且样本量较大的临床试验产生了最大的预期商业净收益。延长随访时间对利润预测的影响较小。预期净收益抽样框架可以适用于制药行业的价值临床试验，以优化预期商业净收益。然而，对于复杂的成本效益模型，这些分析可能会非常耗时。

abstract.text: In the Netherlands, cannabis use is quasi-legalized. Small quantities of cannabis can be bought in cannabis shops. We investigate how the distance to the nearest cannabis shop affects the age of onset of cannabis use. We use a mixed proportional hazard rate framework to take account of observable as well as unobservable characteristics that influence the uptake of cannabis. We find that distance matters. Individuals who grow up within 20 km of a cannabis shop have a lower age of onset.

10.1002/hec.3104.abstractZh: 在荷兰，大麻的使用几乎属于合法化状态。人们可以在大麻商店购买少量大麻。我们研究了距离最近的大麻商店的距离如何影响人们开始使用大麻的年龄。我们采用了混合比例风险模型框架，以考虑那些可观测和不可观测的因素，这些因素会影响人们对大麻的接受程度。研究发现，距离确实是一个重要因素。那些在距离大麻商店20公里范围内成长起来的人，开始使用大麻的年龄较低。

abstract.text: This methodology paper sets out a mathematical description of the Sheffield Alcohol Policy Model version 2.0, a model to evaluate public health strategies for alcohol harm reduction in the UK. Policies that can be appraised include a minimum price per unit of alcohol, restrictions on price discounting, and broader public health measures. The model estimates the impact on consumers, health services, crime, employers, retailers and government tax revenues. The synthesis of public and commercial data sources to inform the model structure is described. A detailed algebraic description of the model is provided. This involves quantifying baseline levels of alcohol purchasing and consumption by age and gender subgroups, estimating the impact of policies on consumption, for example, using evidence on price elasticities of demand for alcohol, quantification of risk functions relating alcohol consumption to harms including 47 health conditions, crimes, absenteeism and unemployment, and finally monetary valuation of the consequences. The results framework, shown for a minimum price per unit of alcohol, has been used to provide policy appraisals for the UK government policy-makers. In discussion and online appendix, we explore issues around valuation and scope, limitations of evidence/data, how the framework can be adapted to other countries and decisions, and ongoing plans for further development.

10.1002/hec.3105.abstractZh: 这篇方法论论文对谢菲尔德酒精政策模型2.0版本进行了数学描述，该模型用于评估英国在减少酒精危害方面的公共卫生策略。可以评估的政策包括酒精单位的最低价格、对价格折扣的限制以及更广泛的公共卫生措施。该模型估算了对消费者、卫生服务、犯罪、雇主、零售商和政府税收收入的影响。文中描述了如何结合公共和商业数据来源来构建模型结构，并提供了模型的详细代数描述。这包括量化不同年龄和性别群体的酒精购买和消费基线水平，估算政策对消费的影响，例如利用酒精需求的价格弹性数据，量化与酒精消费相关的风险函数，包括47种健康状况、犯罪、缺勤和失业等问题，最后对后果进行货币评估。针对酒精单位最低价格的结果框架已被用于为英国政府决策者提供政策评估。在讨论和在线附录中，我们探讨了估值和范围问题、证据/数据的局限性、该框架如何适用于其他国家和其他决策，以及进一步发展的计划。

abstract.text: Although studies have looked at the effect of physical activity on obesity and other health outcomes, the causal nature of this relationship remains unclear. We fill this gap by investigating the impact of leisure-time physical activity (LTPA) and work-related physical activity (WRPA) on obesity and chronic conditions in Canadians aged 18-75 using instrumental variable and recursive bivariate probit approaches. Average local temperatures surrounding the respondents' interview month are used as a novel instrument to help identify the causal relationship between LTPA and health outcomes. We find that an active level of LTPA (i.e., walking ≥1 h/day) reduces the probability of obesity by five percentage points, which increases to 11 percentage points if also combined with some WRPA. WRPA exhibits a negative effect on the probability of obesity and chronic conditions.

10.1002/hec.3106.abstractZh: 尽管已有研究探讨了体力活动对肥胖及其他健康结果的影响，但这种关系的因果关系仍不明确。我们通过使用工具变量和递归双变量Probit方法，研究休闲时间体力活动与工作相关体力活动对18-75岁加拿大人肥胖及慢性疾病的影响，以填补这一空白。我们采用受访者访谈月份周围的平均当地温度作为新型工具变量，以帮助识别休闲时间体力活动与健康结果之间的因果关系。研究发现，较高的休闲时间体力活动水平（即每天步行≥1小时）可使肥胖的概率降低五个百分点；如果同时结合一些与工作相关的体力活动，这一降低幅度可上升至11个百分点。与工作相关的体力活动对肥胖及慢性疾病的概率具有负面影响。

abstract.text: Recent years have seen considerable interest in examining the impact of food prices on food consumption and subsequent health consequences. Fiscal policies targeting the relative price of unhealthy foods are frequently put forward as ways to address the obesity epidemic. Conversely, various food subsidy interventions are used in attempts to reduce levels of under-nutrition. Information on price elasticities is essential for understanding how such changes in food prices affect food consumption. It is crucial to know not only own-price elasticities but also cross-price elasticities, as food substitution patterns may have significant implications for policy recommendations. While own-price elasticities are common in analyses of the impact of food price changes on health, cross-price effects, even though generally acknowledged, are much less frequently included in analyses, especially in the public health literature. This article systematically reviews the global evidence on cross-price elasticities and provides combined estimates for seven food groups in low-income, middle-income and high-income countries alongside previously estimated own-price elasticities. Changes in food prices had the largest own-price effects in low-income countries. Cross-price effects were more varied and depending on country income level were found to be reinforcing, undermining or alleviating own-price effects.

10.1002/hec.3107.abstractZh: 近年来，人们越来越关注食品价格对食品消费及其后续健康影响的研究。针对不健康食品相对价格的财政政策常被提出作为应对肥胖问题的手段。相反，各种食品补贴措施也被用于减少营养不良现象。了解价格弹性对于理解食品价格变化如何影响食品消费至关重要。不仅了解自身价格弹性，还了解交叉价格弹性同样重要，因为食品替代模式可能对政策建议产生重大影响。虽然自身价格弹性在分析食品价格变化对健康的影响时很常见，但交叉价格效应尽管普遍被认可，但在分析中却很少被考虑，尤其是在公共卫生领域。本文系统回顾了全球关于交叉价格弹性的研究证据，并为低收入、中等收入和高收入国家的七类食品提供了综合估计值，同时包含了之前估计的自身价格弹性。在低收入国家，食品价格变化对自身价格的影响最为显著。交叉价格效应则更为复杂，且取决于国家收入水平，可能强化、削弱或缓解自身价格效应。

abstract.text: In this paper, we exploit the progressive implementation of smoking bans in public venues at the state level in Switzerland to evaluate both the direct effects on smoking and the potential unintended consequences of these legislations on consumer behaviors as measured by visiting restaurants/bars and discos ('going out'). Our results indicate that public venue smoking bans in Switzerland reduce smoking rates, but the findings do not emerge until 1 year following the ban. This pattern of results is consistent with delays in ban enforcement on the part of business owners, difficulties in changing addictive behaviors such as smoking, and/or learning on the part of smokers. We find evidence that smoking bans influence going-out behavior and there is substantial heterogeneity across venue and consumer characteristics.

10.1002/hec.3108.abstractZh: 在本文中，我们利用瑞士各州逐步实施公共场所禁烟令的情况，评估这些立法对吸烟行为的直接影响以及可能对消费者行为产生的潜在意外影响，具体通过访问餐厅、酒吧和迪斯科舞厅（“外出”）来衡量。我们的研究结果表明，瑞士公共场所的禁烟令确实降低了吸烟率，但这一效果在禁令实施一年后才会显现。这一结果模式与以下因素一致：企业主在禁令执行上的延迟、改变如吸烟这样的成瘾行为的困难，以及吸烟者的学习过程。我们发现，禁烟令确实影响了外出行为，并且不同场所和消费者特征之间存在显著的异质性。

abstract.text: I propose an application of the pure-consumption version of the Grossman model of health care demand, where utility depends on consumption and health status and health status on medical care and health technology. I derive the conditions under which an improvement in health care technology leads to an increase/decrease in health care consumption. In particular, I show how the direction of the effect depends on the relationship between the constant elasticity of substitution parameters of the utility and health production functions. I find that, under the constancy assumption, the ratio of the two elasticity of substitution parameters determines the direction of a technological change on health care demand. On the other hand, the technology share parameter in the health production function contributes to the size but not to the direction of the technological effect. I finally explore how the ratio of the elasticity of substitution parameters work in measurement and practice and discuss how future research may use the theoretical insight provided here.

10.1002/hec.3109.abstractZh: 我提出了将Grossman的医疗保健需求模型应用于纯消费版本的方法，其中效用取决于消费和健康状况，而健康状况又取决于医疗护理和健康技术。我推导出了医疗保健技术改进导致医疗保健消费增加或减少的条件。特别地，我展示了这种效应方向如何取决于效用和健康生产函数的替代弹性常数参数之间的关系。我发现，在常数假设下，这两个替代弹性常数参数的比率决定了技术变革对医疗保健需求的影响方向。另一方面，健康生产函数中的技术份额参数只影响技术效应的规模，而不影响其方向。最后，我探讨了替代弹性参数比率在测量和实践中的作用，并讨论了未来研究如何利用这里提供的理论见解。

abstract.text: We estimated lifetime costs of publicly funded social care, covering services such as residential and nursing care homes, domiciliary care and meals. Like previous studies, we constructed microsimulation models. However, our transition probabilities were estimated from longitudinal, linked administrative health and social care datasets, rather than from survey data. Administrative data were obtained from three geographical areas of England, and we estimated transition probabilities in each of these sites flexibly using Bayesian methods. This allowed us to quantify regional variation as well as the impact of structural and parameter uncertainty regarding the transition probabilities. Expected lifetime costs at age 65 were £20,200-27,000 for men and £38,700-49,000 for women, depending on which of the three areas was used to calibrate the model. Thus, patterns of social care spending differed markedly between areas, with mean costs varying by almost £10,000 (25%) across the lifetime for people of the same age and gender. Allowing for structural and parameter uncertainty had little impact on expected lifetime costs, but slightly increased the risk of very high costs, which will have implications for insurance products for social care through increasing requirements for capital reserves.

10.1002/hec.3110.abstractZh: 我们估算了公共资金支持的社会护理的终身成本，涵盖住宅和护理院、家庭护理以及膳食等服务。与以往的研究一样，我们构建了微观模拟模型。然而，我们的转移概率是根据纵向的、相互关联的行政健康和社会护理数据集来估算的，而不是基于调查数据。行政数据来自英格兰的三个地理区域，我们使用贝叶斯方法灵活地估算了这些地区的转移概率。这使我们能够量化地区差异，以及转移概率在结构和参数方面的不确定性所带来的影响。在65岁时，男性的预期终身成本为20,200至27,000英镑，女性为38,700至49,000英镑，具体取决于用于校准模型的三个区域中的哪一个。因此，不同地区的社会护理支出模式存在显著差异，同年龄和性别的人群在终身内的平均成本相差近10,000英镑（25%）。考虑到结构和参数的不确定性对预期终身成本的影响不大，但略微增加了出现极高成本的风险，这将对社会护理的保险产品产生影响，因为需要增加资本储备的要求。

abstract.text: One policy tool that could affect organ donation rates is legislative defaults. In this study, we examine how presumed consent impacts cadaveric donations and kidney transplantations, using a panel dataset from the EU-27 countries plus Croatia in the period 2000-2010. We find that presumed consent countries have 28% to 32% higher cadaveric donation and 27% to 31% higher kidney transplant rates in comparison to informed consent countries, after accounting for potential confounding factors. After studying willingness to donate one's organs and registering preferences for organ donation, we find that presumed consent could increase cadaveric donation rates, because people fail to register their preferences and many have no preference for organ donation.

10.1002/hec.3111.abstractZh: 一种可能影响器官捐赠率的政策工具是立法默认条款。本研究利用欧盟27国及克罗地亚在2000-2010年期间的数据集，探讨了“推定同意”对尸体捐赠和肾脏移植的影响。研究发现，在考虑潜在混杂因素后，“推定同意”国家的尸体捐赠率比“知情同意”国家高出28%至32%，肾脏移植率则高出27%至31%。在研究了人们愿意捐赠器官以及登记器官捐赠意愿之后，我们发现“推定同意”可能会提高尸体捐赠率，因为许多人并未登记自己的意愿，且很多人对器官捐赠没有偏好。

abstract.text: Longitudinal analysis of Wave 5 to 10 of the nationally representative Household, Income and Labour Dynamics in Australia dataset was undertaken to assess whether multidimensional poverty status can predict chronic income poverty. Of those who were multidimensionally poor (low income plus poor health or poor health and insufficient education attainment) in 2007, and those who were in income poverty only (no other forms of disadvantage) in 2007, a greater proportion of those in multidimensional poverty continued to be in income poverty for the subsequent 5 years through to 2012. People who were multidimensionally poor in 2007 had 2.17 times the odds of being in income poverty each year through to 2012 than those who were in income poverty only in 2005 (95% CI: 1.23-3.83). Multidimensional poverty measures are a useful tool for policymakers to identify target populations for policies aiming to improve equity and reduce chronic disadvantage.

10.1002/hec.3112.abstractZh: 对澳大利亚具有全国代表性的“家庭、收入和劳动动态”数据集中的第5至第10波数据进行了纵向分析，以评估多维贫困状况是否能够预测长期收入贫困。在2007年属于多维贫困群体（低收入加上健康状况差或健康状况差且教育水平不足）的人中，以及2007年仅处于收入贫困状态（没有其他形式的劣势）的人中，那些处于多维贫困状态的人在随后的5年直至2012年仍然持续处于收入贫困状态的比例更高。2007年属于多维贫困状态的人在每年直至2012年陷入收入贫困的概率，是2005年仅处于收入贫困状态的人们的2.17倍（95%置信区间：1.23-3.83）。多维贫困指标是政策制定者识别目标人群以制定旨在改善公平和减少长期劣势政策的有效工具。

abstract.text: When analyzing many health-related quality-of-life (HRQoL) outcomes, statistical inference is often based on the summary score formed by combining the individual domains of the HRQoL profile into a single measure. Through a series of Monte Carlo simulations, this paper illustrates that reliance solely on the summary score may lead to biased estimates of incremental effects, and I propose a novel two-stage approach that allows for unbiased estimation of incremental effects. The proposed methodology essentially reverses the order of the analysis, from one of 'aggregate, then estimate' to one of 'estimate, then aggregate'. Compared to relying solely on the summary score, the approach also offers a more patient-centered interpretation of results by estimating regression coefficients and incremental effects in each of the HRQoL domains, while still providing estimated effects in terms of the overall summary score. I provide an application to the estimation of incremental effects of demographic and clinical variables on HRQoL following surgical treatment for adult scoliosis and spinal deformity.

10.1002/hec.3113.abstractZh: 在分析许多与健康相关的生活质量（HRQoL）指标时，统计推断通常基于将HRQoL各领域的得分合并为单一指标的汇总分数。本文通过一系列蒙特卡洛模拟实验表明，仅依赖汇总分数可能导致对增量效应的估计出现偏差。我们提出了一种新颖的两阶段方法，该方法允许对增量效应进行无偏估计。该方法本质上改变了分析的顺序，从“汇总后再估计”转变为“先估计再汇总”。与仅依赖汇总分数相比，该方法通过估计每个HRQoL领域的回归系数和增量效应，为结果提供了更加以患者为中心的诠释，同时仍然提供了整体汇总分数的估计值。本文以成人脊柱侧弯和脊柱畸形手术治疗后人口统计学和临床变量对HRQoL的增量效应估计为例进行了应用说明。

abstract.text: The use of long-term care (LTC) is changing rapidly. In the Netherlands, rates of institutional LTC use are falling, whereas homecare use is growing. Are these changes attributable to declining disability rates, or has LTC use given disability changed? And have institutionalization rates fallen regardless of disability level, or has LTC use become better tailored to needs? We answer these questions by explaining trends in LTC use for the Dutch 65+ population in the period 2000-2008 using a nonlinear variant of the Oaxaca-Blinder decomposition. We find that changes in LTC use are not due to shifts in the disability distribution but can almost entirely be traced back to changes in the way the system treats disability. Elderly with mild disability are more likely to be treated at home than before, whereas severely disabled individuals continue to receive institutional LTC. As a result, LTC use has become better tailored to the needs for such care. This finding suggests that policies that promote LTC in the community rather than in institutions can effectively mitigate the consequences of population aging on LTC spending.

10.1002/hec.3114.abstractZh: 长期护理的使用正在迅速发生变化。在荷兰，机构化长期护理的使用率正在下降，而家庭护理的使用率则在上升。这些变化是由于残疾率下降所致，还是长期护理的使用方式发生了变化？此外，无论残疾程度如何，机构化护理的使用率是否有所下降，还是长期护理的使用方式变得更加符合需求？我们通过使用Oaxaca-Blinder分解的非线性变体，分析了2000-2008年期间荷兰65岁以上人群长期护理使用的趋势。我们发现，长期护理使用方式的变化并非由于残疾分布的变化，而几乎完全可以归因于系统对待残疾方式的变化。轻度残疾的老年人更有可能在家中接受护理，而重度残疾的老年人则继续接受机构化长期护理。因此，长期护理的使用方式已经变得更加符合这些老年人的需求。这一发现表明，鼓励在社区而非机构中提供长期护理的政策，可以有效减轻人口老龄化对长期护理支出的影响。

abstract.text: Consumer dissatisfaction with the quality and limitations of managed health care led to rapid disenrollment from managed care plans and demands for regulation between 1998 and 2003. Managed care organizations, particularly health maintenance organizations (HMOs), now face quality and coverage mandates that restrict them from using their most aggressive strategies for managing costs. This paper examines the effect of this backlash on managed care's ability to contain costs among short-term, non-federal hospitals between 1998 and 2008. The results show that the impact of increased HMO penetration on inpatient costs reversed over the study period, but HMOs were still effective at containing outpatient costs. These findings have important policy implications for understanding the continuing role that HMOs should play in cost containment policy and for understanding how effective the latest wave of cost containment institutions may perform in heavily regulated markets.

10.1002/hec.3115.abstractZh: 在1998年至2003年间，消费者对管理式医疗保健的质量和局限性感到不满，导致人们迅速退出管理式医疗计划，并要求对其进行监管。管理式医疗组织，尤其是健康维护组织（HMO），现在面临着质量和覆盖范围的限制，这限制了他们采用最激进的成本管理策略。本文研究了这一反作用对1998年至2008年间短期非联邦医院管理式医疗成本控制能力的影响。研究结果表明，HMO渗透率的增加对住院成本的影响在研究期间有所逆转，但HMO在控制门诊成本方面仍然有效。这些发现对于理解HMO在成本控制政策中应继续发挥的作用，以及了解最新一波成本控制机构在高度监管市场中的表现具有重要意义。

abstract.text: In this note, we use data from the national and state Youth Risk Behavior Surveys for the period 1999 through 2011 to estimate the relationship between the Meth Project, an anti-methamphetamine advertising campaign, and meth use among high school students. During this period, a total of eight states adopted anti-meth advertising campaigns. After accounting for pre-existing downward trends in meth use, we find little evidence that the campaign curbed meth use in the full sample. We do find, however, some evidence that the Meth Project may have decreased meth use among White high school students.

10.1002/hec.3116.abstractZh: 在这篇论文中，我们使用了1999年至2011年期间全国及各州青少年风险行为调查的数据，来估算“Meth项目”这一反甲基苯丙胺广告活动与高中生甲基苯丙胺使用之间的关系。在此期间，共有八个州开展了反甲基苯丙胺广告活动。在考虑甲基苯丙胺使用量已存在的下降趋势后，我们发现该活动对整体样本中的甲基苯丙胺使用几乎没有抑制作用。不过，我们确实发现了一些证据表明，“Meth项目”可能减少了白人高中学生的甲基苯丙胺使用量。

abstract.text: The present study empirically investigates the effect of consumer health information on the demand for physician visits. Using a direct information measure based on questions from the Swiss Health Survey, we estimate a Poisson hurdle model for office visits. We find that information has a negative effect on health care utilization, contradicting previous findings in the literature. We consider differences in the used information measures to be the most likely explanation for the different findings. However, our results suggest that increasing consumer health information has the potential to reduce health care expenditures.

10.1002/hec.3117.abstractZh: 本研究通过实证分析，探讨了消费者健康信息对就医需求的影响。我们基于瑞士健康调查中的问题，采用直接信息测量方法，对门诊就诊情况建立了泊松障碍模型。研究发现，健康信息对医疗利用具有负面影响，这与以往的研究结果相矛盾。我们认为，所使用的信息测量方式差异可能是导致研究结果不同的主要原因。不过，我们的研究结果表明，增加消费者的健康信息，有可能减少医疗支出。

abstract.text: This work sets out to analyze the motivations adult children may have to provide informal care, considering the monetary transfers they receive from their parents. Traditional motivations, such as altruism and exchange, are matched against more recent social bond theories. Our findings indicate that informal caregivers receive less frequent and less generous transfers than non-caregivers; that is, caregivers are more prone to suppress their self-interested motivations in order to prioritize the well being of another person. Additionally, long-term public care benefits increase both the probability of receiving a transfer and its amount, with this effect being more intense for both the poorest and richest households. Our findings suggest that if long-term care benefits are intended to increase the recipients' welfare and represent a higher fraction of total income for the poorest households, the effectiveness of these long-term care policies may be diluted.

10.1002/hec.3135.abstractZh: 本研究旨在分析成年子女提供非正式照顾的动机，同时考虑他们从父母那里获得的金钱转移。传统的动机，如利他主义和交换行为，与较新的社会纽带理论进行了对比。我们的研究发现表明，非正式照顾者获得的转移频率较低且金额较少；也就是说，照顾者更倾向于抑制自己的利益动机，以优先考虑他人的福祉。此外，长期的公共照顾福利不仅增加了获得转移的概率，还提高了转移金额，这种效应在最贫困和最富裕的家庭中更为明显。我们的研究结果表明，如果长期照顾福利的目的是为了提高受助者的福祉，并且这些福利在最贫困家庭的总收入中占较大比例，那么这些长期照顾政策的有效性可能会受到削弱。

abstract.text: While it has long been assumed that family structure and potential sources of informal care play a large role in the purchase decisions for long-term care insurance (LTCI), current empirical evidence is inconclusive. Our study examines the relationship between family structure and LTCI purchase and addresses several major limitations of the prior literature by using a long panel of data and considering modern family relationships, such as the presence of stepchildren. We find that family structure characteristics from one's own generation, particularly about one's spouse, are associated with purchase, but that few family structure attributes from the younger generation have an influence. Family factors that may indicate future caregiver supply are negatively associated with purchase: having a coresidential child, signaling close proximity, and having a currently working spouse, signaling a healthy and able spouse, that long-term care planning has not occurred yet or that there is less need for asset protection afforded by LTCI. Dynamic factors, such as increasing wealth or turning 65, are associated with higher likelihood of LTCI purchase.

10.1002/hec.3145.abstractZh: 长期以来，人们认为家庭结构和非正式照顾的潜在来源在长期护理保险购买决策中起着重要作用，但目前的实证研究结果并不一致。本研究探讨了家庭结构与长期护理保险购买之间的关系，并通过使用长期数据面板以及考虑现代家庭关系（如继子女的存在）来弥补先前研究的几个主要局限性。我们发现，来自自己这一代的家庭结构特征，尤其是关于配偶的信息，与购买决策有关，而来自年轻一代的家庭结构特征则对购买决策的影响较小。那些可能表明未来有照顾者供应的家庭因素与购买决策呈负相关：拥有同住子女、表明居住距离较近，以及拥有目前在职的配偶，表明配偶健康且有能力照顾，或者长期护理规划尚未进行，或者对资产保护的需求较低。而诸如财富增加或年满65岁等动态因素则与更高的长期护理保险购买可能性相关。

abstract.text: Population forecasters have predicted that the proportion of people in the UK aged 65 years and older will rise significantly in coming decades. This shift in demographics will put increasing pressure on the National Health Service and providers of social care. However, older people do not rely only on care provided by the state; informal care of the elderly is often supplied by family and friends. Therefore, the relationship between formal and informal care and the reaction of informal carers to institutional changes is an important policy issue. This study uses individual level data from the British Household Panel Survey to estimate the effects of the introduction of free personal care for the elderly in Scotland on informal care behaviour. As the change in policy applied only to Scotland, a natural experiment is formed allowing a difference-in-differences approach to be used. This paper finds that the introduction of the policy increased the probability of women supplying informal care by around six percentage points. In addition, for both sexes, it reports evidence of a shift away from the upper and lower tails towards the middle of the hours of care distribution as a result of the change in policy.

10.1002/hec.3146.abstractZh: 人口预测机构预计，未来几十年内，英国65岁及以上人口的比例将显著上升。这种人口结构的变化将对国家卫生服务系统和社会护理提供者造成越来越大的压力。然而，老年人并不只依赖政府的护理服务；他们的非正式护理通常由家人和朋友提供。因此，正式护理与非正式护理之间的关系，以及非正式护理人员对制度变化的反应，是一个重要的政策问题。本研究利用英国家庭面板调查中的个人数据，来估算苏格兰实施免费个人护理政策对非正式护理行为的影响。由于该政策仅适用于苏格兰，因此形成了一个自然实验，可以使用差异-差异方法进行分析。研究发现，该政策的实施使女性提供非正式护理的概率增加了约六个百分点。此外，对于两性而言，该政策还导致护理时间分布从两端向中间偏移。

abstract.text: Home health care expenditures were the fastest growing part of Medicare from 2001-2009, despite the implementation of prospective payment. Prior research has shown that home health agencies adopted two specific strategies to take advantage of Medicare policies: provide at least 10 therapy visits to get an enormous marginal payment and recertify patients for additional episodes. We study whether there is heterogeneity in the adoption of those strategic behaviors between home health agency entrants and incumbents and find that entrants were more likely to adopt strategic practice patterns than were incumbents. We also find that for-profit incumbents mimicked one of the practice patterns following entrants in the same market. Our findings suggest that it is important to understand the heterogeneity in providers' behavior and how firms interact with each other in the same market. These findings help explain the rapid rise in expenditures in the home health care market.

10.1002/hec.3147.abstractZh: 在2001至2009年间，尽管实施了预期支付制度，家庭健康护理支出仍然是医疗保险中增长最快的部分。先前的研究表明，家庭健康服务机构采取了两种特定策略来利用医疗保险政策：至少提供10次治疗访问以获得较高的边际支付，以及重新认证患者以接受更多的治疗。我们研究了新进入者与现有从业者之间在采用这些策略行为上的差异，发现新进入者比现有从业者更有可能采用这些策略性行为。我们还发现，在同一市场中，营利性现有从业者会模仿新进入者所采用的策略性行为之一。我们的研究结果表明，了解供应商行为的差异以及企业在同一市场中如何互动是非常重要的。这些发现有助于解释家庭健康护理市场支出迅速增长的原因。

abstract.text: Long-term care (LTC) is the largest insurable risk that old-age individuals face in most western societies. However, the demand for LTC insurance is still ostensibly small in comparison with the financial risk. One explanation that has received limited support is that expectations of either 'public sector funding' and 'family support' crowd out individual incentives to seek insurance. This paper aims to investigate further the aforementioned motivational crowding-out hypothesis by developing a theoretical model and by drawing on an innovative empirical analysis of representative European survey data containing records on individual expectations of LTC funding sources (including private insurance, social insurance, and the family). The theoretical model predicts that, when informal care is treated as exogenously determined, expectations of both state support and informal care can potentially crowd out LTC insurance expectations, while this is not necessarily the case when informal care is endogenous to insurance, as happens when intra-family moral hazard is integrated in the insurance decision. We find evidence consistent with the presence of family crowding out but no robust evidence of public sector crowding out.

10.1002/hec.3148.abstractZh: 长期护理是大多数西方社会中老年人面临的最大可保险风险。然而，与财务风险相比，对长期护理保险的需求仍然相对较小。有一种解释认为，对“公共部门资助”和“家庭支持”的期望会削弱个人寻求保险的积极性。本文旨在通过构建理论模型并基于对欧洲代表性调查数据的创新性分析来进一步探讨这一动机挤出的假设。该分析包含了关于个人对长期护理资金来源（包括私人保险、社会保险和家庭支持）的期望信息。理论模型预测，当非正式护理被视为外生因素时，对政府支持和非正式护理的期望可能会挤出对长期护理保险的期望；而当非正式护理是保险内生因素时，情况则未必如此，例如当家庭内部的道德风险被纳入保险决策时。我们发现有证据支持家庭挤出的现象，但并没有确凿的证据表明公共部门会挤出保险需求。

abstract.text: This study investigates the causes of full closure of care homes in the English care home/nursing home market. We develop theoretical arguments about two causes for closure that are triggered by errors or external shocks: poor economic sustainability and regulatory action. Homes aiming to operate with lower quality in the market are argued for a number of reasons to be more susceptible to errors/shocks in setting quality, especially negative errors, leading to an empirical hypothesis that observed quality should negatively affect closure chance. In addition, given quality, homes facing relatively high levels of local competition should also have an increased chance of closure. We use a panel of care homes from 2008 and 2010 to examine factors affecting their closure status in subsequent years. We allow for the potential endogeneity of home quality and use multiple imputation to replace missing data. Results suggest that homes with comparatively higher quality and/or lower levels of competition have less chance of closure than other homes. We discuss that the results provide some support for the policy of regulators providing quality information to potential purchasers in the market.

10.1002/hec.3149.abstractZh: 本研究探讨了英国养老院市场中出现养老院完全关闭现象的原因。我们提出了两种可能导致养老院关闭的理论原因：经济可持续性的不足和监管措施。我们认为，那些试图以较低质量运营的老龄院更容易受到质量方面的错误或外部冲击的影响，尤其是负面错误，这导致了一个实证假设：观察到的质量水平应该会对养老院的关闭概率产生负面影响。此外，由于质量水平较高，面临较高本地竞争的老龄院也更容易面临关闭的风险。我们使用了2008年和2010年的养老院数据，来考察影响其关闭状况的因素。我们考虑了养老院质量的可能内生性，并采用多重插补法来填补缺失数据。研究结果表明，那些质量较高和/或竞争程度较低的老龄院，其关闭的可能性比其他养老院要小。我们认为，这些结果为监管机构向市场潜在购买者提供质量信息这一政策提供了一定的支持。

abstract.text: Hospital bed-blocking occurs when hospital patients are ready to be discharged to a nursing home, but no place is available, so that hospital care acts as a more costly substitute for long-term care. We investigate the extent to which greater supply of nursing home beds or lower prices can reduce hospital bed-blocking using a new Local Authority (LA) level administrative data from England on hospital delayed discharges in 2009-2013. The results suggest that delayed discharges respond to the availability of care home beds, but the effect is modest: an increase in care home beds by 10% (250 additional beds per LA) would reduce social care delayed discharges by about 6-9%. We also find strong evidence of spillover effects across LAs: more care home beds or fewer patients aged over 65 years in nearby LAs are associated with fewer delayed discharges.

10.1002/hec.3150.abstractZh: 医院床位占用现象发生在医院患者准备出院前往养老院时，但无床位可供使用，因此医院护理成为长期护理的更昂贵替代方案。我们利用英格兰2009-2013年关于医院延迟出院的新地方当局级行政数据，研究增加养老院床位供应或降低价格在多大程度上可以减少医院床位占用现象。研究结果表明，延迟出院现象受养老院床位供应情况的影响，但效果有限：每增加10%的养老院床位（每个地方当局增加250张床位），社会护理延迟出院的情况将减少约6-9%。我们还发现，地方当局之间存在强烈的溢出效应：附近地方当局中养老院床位增加或65岁以上患者减少，都会减少延迟出院的情况。

abstract.text: In many countries, public responsibility over the funding and provision of long-term care services is held at the local level. In such systems, long-term care provision is often characterised by significant local variability. Using a panel dataset of local authorities over the period 2002-2012, the paper investigates the underlying causes of variation in gross social care expenditure for older people in England. The analysis distinguishes between factors outside the direct control of policy makers, local preferences and local policy spillovers. The results indicate that local demand and supply factors, and to a much lesser extent local political preferences and spatial policy spillovers, explain a large majority of the observed variation in expenditure.

10.1002/hec.3151.abstractZh: 在许多国家，长期护理服务的资金供应和提供责任由地方层面承担。在这种体系中，长期护理服务的提供往往表现出显著的地区差异。本文利用2002至2012年期间的地方当局面板数据集，研究了英格兰老年人社会护理支出差异的根本原因。分析区分了政策制定者无法直接控制的因素、地方偏好以及地方政策溢出效应。研究结果表明，地方的需求和供应因素，以及在较小程度上地方政治偏好和空间政策溢出效应，解释了观察到的支出差异的绝大部分。

abstract.text: This paper attempts to examine the heterogeneity in the public financing of long-term care (LTC) and the wide-ranging instruments in place to finance LTC services. We distinguish and classify the institutional responses to the need for LTC financing as ex ante (occurring prior to when the need arises, such as insurance) and ex post (occurring after the need arises, such as public sector and family financing). Then, we examine country-specific data to ascertain whether the two types of financing are complements or substitutes. Finally, we examine exploratory cross-national data on public expenditure determinants, specifically economic, demographic and social determinants. We show that although both ex ante and ex post mechanisms exist in all countries with advanced industrial economies and despite the fact that instruments are different across countries, ex ante and ex post instruments are largely substitutes for each other. Expenditure estimates to date indicate that the public financing of LTC is highly sensitive to a country's income, ageing of the population and the availability of informal caregiving.

10.1002/hec.3152.abstractZh: 本文试图探讨长期护理公共融资的异质性，以及用于资助长期护理服务的多种手段。我们将对针对长期护理融资需求的制度反应进行分类，分为事前融资（在需求出现之前进行，如保险）和事后融资（在需求出现之后进行，如公共部门和家庭融资）。随后，我们通过具体国家的数据来研究这两种融资方式是否存在互补关系。最后，我们通过对跨国数据的分析，研究公共支出决定因素，特别是经济、人口和社会因素。研究表明，尽管在所有工业化发达国家都存在事前和事后融资机制，且不同国家采用的手段有所不同，但事前和事后融资机制在很大程度上是互补的。迄今为止的支出估算表明，长期护理的公共融资对国家的收入、人口老龄化以及非正式护理服务的可用性具有高度敏感性。

abstract.text: Deductibles in health insurance generate nonlinear budget sets and dynamic incentives. Using detailed individual health expenditure data from a Swiss health insurer, we estimate the response in healthcare demand to the discrete price increase generated by resetting the deductible at the start of each calendar year. We find that for individuals with high deductibles, healthcare demand drops by 27%. The decrease is most pronounced for inpatient care and prescription drugs. By contrast, for individuals with low deductibles, there is no significant change in healthcare demand (except for prescription drugs). Overall our results suggest that healthy individuals respond much stronger to the price change.

10.1002/hec.3154.abstractZh: 健康保险中的免赔额会产生非线性的预算组合和动态激励。利用瑞士一家健康保险公司提供的详细个人健康支出数据，我们研究了每年年初重新设定免赔额对医疗需求的影响。研究发现，对于免赔额较高的个体来说，医疗需求下降了27%。这种下降在住院治疗和处方药方面最为明显。相比之下，免赔额较低的个体在医疗需求上没有显著变化（处方药除外）。总体而言，我们的结果表明，健康个体对价格变化的反应更为强烈。

abstract.text: Limited evidence exists on whether expanding home care saves money overall or how much institutional long-term care can be reduced. This paper estimates the causal effect of Medicaid-financed home care services on the costs and utilization of institutional long-term care using Medicaid claims data. A unique instrumental variable was applied to address the potential bias caused by omitted variables or reverse effect of institutional care use. We find that the use of Medicaid-financed home care services significantly reduced but only partially offset utilization and Medicaid expenditures on nursing facility services. A $1000 increase in Medicaid home care expenditures avoided 2.75 days in nursing facilities and reduced annual Medicaid nursing facility costs by $351 among people over age 65 when selection bias is addressed. Failure to address selection biases would misestimate the substitution and offset effects.

10.1002/hec.3155.abstractZh: 关于扩大家庭护理是否能总体上节省资金，以及能减少多少机构长期护理的需求，目前缺乏足够的证据。本文利用医疗补助报销数据，估算了由医疗补助资助的家庭护理服务对机构长期护理成本和利用率的因果效应。为了应对遗漏变量或机构护理使用产生的反向效应带来的潜在偏差，我们采用了一种独特的工具变量方法。研究发现，使用由医疗补助资助的家庭护理服务显著降低了机构长期护理的利用率和医疗补助支出。在排除选择偏差的情况下，医疗补助家庭护理支出增加1000美元，可以避免2.75天的机构护理需求，并减少65岁以上人群每年351美元的医疗补助支出。如果未能解决选择偏差问题，将会导致对替代效应和抵消效应的误判。

abstract.text: This study compares the impact of sugar-sweetened beverages (SSBs) tax between moderate and high consumers in Australia. The key methodological contribution is that price response heterogeneity is identified while controlling for censoring of consumption at zero and endogeneity of expenditure by using a finite mixture instrumental variable Tobit model. The SSB price elasticity estimates show a decreasing trend across increasing consumption quantiles, from -2.3 at the median to -0.2 at the 95th quantile. Although high consumers of SSBs have a less elastic demand for SSBs, their very high consumption levels imply that a tax would achieve higher reduction in consumption and higher health gains. Our results also suggest that an SSB tax would represent a small fiscal burden for consumers whatever their pre-policy level of consumption, and that an excise tax should be preferred to an ad valorem tax.

10.1002/hec.3157.abstractZh: 本研究比较了在澳大利亚，对含糖饮料征税对中等和高端消费者的影响。该方法论上的主要贡献在于，在控制消费为零的截尾效应以及支出内生性的前提下，识别出价格反应的异质性。含糖饮料的价格弹性估计值显示，随着消费量的增加，弹性呈下降趋势，从中位数处的-2.3降至第95百分位的-0.2。尽管高端含糖饮料消费者对含糖饮料的需求弹性较低，但他们极高的消费水平意味着征税能够带来更大的消费减少和健康收益。我们的研究结果还表明，无论消费者的政策前消费水平如何，对含糖饮料征税对消费者来说都是较小的财政负担，因此应优先选择从量税而非从价税。

abstract.text: The prescription drug user fee program provides additional resources to the U.S. Food and Drug Administration at the expense of regulated firms. Those resources accelerate the review of new drugs. Faster approvals allow firms to realize profits sooner, and the program is supported politically by industry. However, published estimates of the value to firms of reduced regulatory delay vary dramatically. It is shown here that this variation is driven largely by differences in methods that correspond to differences in implicit assumptions about the effects of reduced delay. Theoretical modeling is used to derive an equation describing the relationship between estimates generated using different methods. The method likely to yield the most accurate results is identified. A reconciliation of published estimates yields a value to a firm for a one-year reduction in regulatory delay at the time of approval of about $60 million for a typical drug. Published 2015. This article is a U.S. Government work and is in the public domain in the U.S.A.

10.1002/hec.3166.abstractZh: 处方药用户费用计划为美国食品药品监督管理局提供了额外资源，而这些资源是以监管企业的成本为代价的。这些资源加速了新药的审批过程。更快的审批速度使得企业能够更早实现利润，同时该计划也得到了行业的政治支持。然而，关于该计划对企业减少监管延迟所带来的价值的估计结果差异很大。研究表明，这种差异主要源于不同方法之间的差异，而这些差异又对应于关于减少延迟效果的不同隐含假设。通过理论建模，我们推导出一个描述不同方法得出的估计值之间关系的方程。最终确定了最有可能得出最准确结果的方法。对已发布的估计值进行整合后，我们发现对于典型药物而言，在审批时减少一年的监管延迟，企业可以获得的收益约为6000万美元。本文发表于2015年，属于美国政府的研究成果，在美国属于公共领域。

abstract.text: Understanding the data generating process behind healthcare costs remains a key empirical issue. Although much research to date has focused on the prediction of the conditional mean cost, this can potentially miss important features of the full distribution such as tail probabilities. We conduct a quasi-Monte Carlo experiment using the English National Health Service inpatient data to compare 14 approaches in modelling the distribution of healthcare costs: nine of which are parametric and have commonly been used to fit healthcare costs, and five others are designed specifically to construct a counterfactual distribution. Our results indicate that no one method is clearly dominant and that there is a trade-off between bias and precision of tail probability forecasts. We find that distributional methods demonstrate significant potential, particularly with larger sample sizes where the variability of predictions is reduced. Parametric distributions such as log-normal, generalised gamma and generalised beta of the second kind are found to estimate tail probabilities with high precision but with varying bias depending upon the cost threshold being considered.

10.1002/hec.3178.abstractZh: 理解医疗成本背后的数据生成过程仍然是一个重要的实证问题。尽管迄今为止许多研究都集中在条件平均成本的预测上，但这可能会忽略完整分布中的重要特征，比如尾部概率。我们采用准蒙特卡罗实验，利用英国国家卫生服务的住院数据，比较了14种用于建模医疗成本分布的方法：其中9种是参数化方法，通常用于拟合医疗成本数据；另外5种则是专门设计用来构建反事实分布的方法。我们的研究结果表明，没有任何一种方法明显占据优势，而且在尾部概率预测的偏差与精确度之间存在权衡。我们发现，分布方法具有显著的潜力，尤其是在样本量较大的情况下，预测的变异性会降低。参数化分布，如对数正态分布、广义伽马分布和广义贝塔分布，能够以高精确度估计尾部概率，但偏差程度取决于所考虑的成本阈值。

abstract.text: For a continuous treatment, the generalised propensity score (GPS) is defined as the conditional density of the treatment, given covariates. GPS adjustment may be implemented by including it as a covariate in an outcome regression. Here, the unbiased estimation of the dose-response function assumes correct specification of both the GPS and the outcome-treatment relationship. This paper introduces a machine learning method, the 'Super Learner', to address model selection in this context. In the two-stage estimation approach proposed, the Super Learner selects a GPS and then a dose-response function conditional on the GPS, as the convex combination of candidate prediction algorithms. We compare this approach with parametric implementations of the GPS and to regression methods. We contrast the methods in the Risk Adjustment in Neurocritical care cohort study, in which we estimate the marginal effects of increasing transfer time from emergency departments to specialised neuroscience centres, for patients with acute traumatic brain injury. With parametric models for the outcome, we find that dose-response curves differ according to choice of specification. With the Super Learner approach to both regression and the GPS, we find that transfer time does not have a statistically significant marginal effect on the outcomes.

10.1002/hec.3189.abstractZh: 在连续处理的情况下，广义倾向得分被定义为给定协变量的治疗的条件密度。通过将广义倾向得分作为协变量纳入结果回归中，可以实现广义倾向得分的调整。这里，对剂量-反应函数无偏估计的前提是广义倾向得分与结果-治疗关系的正确设定。本文介绍了一种机器学习方法“超级学习器”，用于解决这一情境下的模型选择问题。在提出的双阶段估计方法中，超级学习器首先选择一个广义倾向得分，然后基于该得分选择一个剂量-反应函数，作为候选预测算法的凸组合。我们将这种方法与广义倾向得分的参数化实现以及回归方法进行了比较。在神经重症监护队列研究中，我们估计了从急诊科到专业神经科学中心转移时间增加对急性创伤性脑损伤患者的边际影响。使用参数的结果模型，我们发现剂量-反应曲线因模型设定方式的不同而有所差异。而采用超级学习器方法进行回归和广义倾向得分分析时，我们发现转移时间对结果并没有统计学上的显著边际影响。

abstract.text: The provision of information, which is a common public health strategy, may be ineffective if recommendations are not privately optimal for message recipients. This paper evaluates the response to a hygiene information campaign in rural Pakistan. In a theoretical model, baseline hygiene and health proxy for preferences, prices, and wealth, which jointly moderate the impact of information. We show that people with good baseline hygiene and health respond differentially to the hygiene message. This result, which does not appear to arise through differential learning, suggests that practical constraints limit the adoption of hygiene recommendations. Information provision may exacerbate health inequality under these conditions.

10.1002/hec.3193.abstractZh: 信息提供是一种常见的公共卫生策略，但如果建议对信息接收者来说并非最优，那么这种策略可能会无效。本文评估了在巴基斯坦农村地区开展的卫生信息宣传活动的效果。在一个理论模型中，基线卫生状况和健康状况作为偏好、价格和财富的代表，共同影响着信息的影响。我们发现，具有良好基线卫生状况和健康状况的人对卫生信息的反应有所不同。这一结果并非由于学习差异所致，表明实际限制因素限制了人们对卫生建议的采纳。在这种情况下，信息提供可能会加剧健康不平等。

abstract.text: In Germany, individuals in need of long-term care receive support through benefits of the long-term care insurance. A central goal of the insurance is to support informal care provided by family members. Care recipients can choose between benefits in kind (formal home care services) and benefits in cash. From a budgetary perspective, family care is often considered a cost-saving alternative to formal home care and to stationary nursing care. However, the opportunity costs resulting from reduced labor supply of the carer are often overlooked. We focus on the labor supply decision of family carers and the incentives set by the long-term care insurance. We estimate a structural model of labor supply and the choice of benefits of family carers. We find that benefits in kind have small positive effects on labor supply. Labor supply elasticities of cash benefits are larger and negative. If both types of benefits increase, negative labor supply effects are offset to a large extent. However, the average effect is significantly negative.

10.1002/hec.3200.abstractZh: 在德国，需要长期护理的民众可以通过长期护理保险获得的福利得到支持。该保险的核心目标是支持家庭成员提供的非正式护理。护理接受者可以在实物福利（如正式的居家护理服务）和现金福利之间选择。从预算角度来看，家庭护理通常被视为比正式居家护理和固定护理更节省成本的替代方案。然而，护理人员的劳动力供应减少所带来的机会成本往往被忽视。我们重点关注家庭护理人员的劳动力供应决策以及长期护理保险所设定的激励措施。我们建立了一个关于家庭护理人员劳动力供应和福利选择的结构模型。研究发现，实物福利对劳动力供应有较小的正面影响，而现金福利的劳动力供应弹性则更大且为负。如果两种类型的福利都增加，劳动力供应的负面影响在很大程度上会被抵消。然而，平均影响仍然显著为负。

abstract.text: In 2010-2012, new outpatient service locations were established in Hungarian micro-regions, which had lacked such capacities before. We exploit this quasi-experiment to estimate the effect of geographical accessibility on outpatient case numbers using both individual-level and semi-aggregate panel data. We find a 24-27 per cent increase of case numbers as a result of the establishments. Our specialty-by-specialty estimates imply that a 1-min reduction of travel time to the nearest outpatient unit increases case numbers for example by 0.9 per cent in internal care and 3.1 per cent in rheumatology. The size of the new outpatient capacities has a separate effect, raising the possibility of the presence of supplier-induced demand. By combining a fixed-effects logit and a fixed-effects truncated Poisson estimator, we decompose the effects into increases in the probability of ever visiting a doctor on the one hand and an increase of the frequency of visits on the other hand. We find that new visits were dominant in the vast majority of specialties, whereas both margins were important for example in rheumatology. Finally, we demonstrate the usefulness of the fixed-effects truncated Poisson estimator in modelling count data by examining its robustness by simulations.

10.1002/hec.3201.abstractZh: 在2010-2012年间，匈牙利的一些微型区域建立了新的门诊服务设施，这些地区此前缺乏这样的服务能力。我们利用这一准实验来估计地理可达性对门诊病例数量的影响，使用了个体水平和半聚合面板数据。研究发现，由于这些新设施的建立，病例数量增加了24-27%。我们的按专科分列的估计结果显示，将前往最近门诊机构的旅行时间减少1分钟，会导致病例数量增加，例如，在内科领域增加0.9%，在风湿病学领域增加3.1%。新门诊设施的建设还带来了其他影响，有可能存在供应商诱导的需求。通过结合固定效应逻辑模型和固定效应截断泊松估计器，我们将这些影响分解为两个方面：一方面增加了就诊的概率，另一方面增加了就诊的频率。我们发现，在绝大多数专科中，新就诊是主导现象，而在某些专科中，这两个方面都非常重要，例如在风湿病学领域。最后，我们通过模拟实验验证了固定效应截断泊松估计器在建模计数数据时的有效性。

abstract.text: This paper investigates the nature and consequences of sample attrition in a unique longitudinal survey of medical doctors. We describe the patterns of non-response and examine if attrition affects the econometric analysis of medical labour market outcomes using the estimation of physician earnings equations as a case study. We compare the econometric gestimates obtained from a number of different modelling strategies, which are as follows: balanced versus unbalanced samples; an attrition model for panel data based on the classic sample selection model; and a recently developed copula-based selection model. Descriptive evidence shows that doctors who work longer hours, have lower years of experience, are overseas trained and have changed their work location are more likely to drop out. Our analysis suggests that the impact of attrition on inference about the earnings of general practitioners is small. For specialists, there appears to be some evidence for an economically significant bias. Finally, we discuss how the top-up samples in the Medicine in Australia: Balancing Employment and Life survey can be used to address the problem of panel attrition.

10.1002/hec.3206.abstractZh: 本文研究了在一项针对医生的独特纵向调查中，样本流失的性质及其后果。我们描述了非响应的模式，并探讨了样本流失是否会影响利用医生收入方程进行的经济计量分析。我们比较了采用不同建模策略所得到的经济计量估计结果，这些策略包括：平衡样本与非平衡样本；基于经典样本选择模型的面板数据流失模型；以及最近开发的基于copula的选择模型。描述性证据表明，工作时间较长、经验年限较短、接受海外培训以及工作地点发生变化的医生更有可能退出研究。我们的分析表明，流失对全科医生收入推断的影响较小。而对于专科医生来说，似乎存在某种经济上显著的偏差。最后，我们讨论了如何利用“澳大利亚医学：平衡就业与生活”调查中的补充样本来解决面板数据流失问题。

abstract.text: The English National Health Service is moving towards providing comprehensive 7-day hospital services in response to higher death rates for emergency weekend admissions. Using Hospital Episode Statistics between 1st April 2010 and 31st March 2011 linked to all-cause mortality within 30 days of admission, we estimate the number of excess deaths and the loss in quality-adjusted life years associated with emergency weekend admissions. The crude 30-day mortality rate was 3.70% for weekday admissions and 4.05% for weekend admissions. The excess weekend death rate equates to 4355 (risk adjusted 5353) additional deaths each year. The health gain of avoiding these deaths would be 29 727-36 539 quality-adjusted life years per year. The estimated cost of implementing 7-day services is £1.07-£1.43 bn, which exceeds by £339-£831 m the maximum spend based on the National Institute for Health and Care Excellence threshold of £595 m-£731 m. There is as yet no clear evidence that 7-day services will reduce weekend deaths or can be achieved without increasing weekday deaths. The planned cost of implementing 7-day services greatly exceeds the maximum amount that the National Health Service should spend on eradicating the weekend effect based on current evidence. Policy makers and service providers should focus on identifying specific service extensions for which cost-effectiveness can be demonstrated.

10.1002/hec.3207.abstractZh: 英国国家健康服务体系正在努力提供全面的7天医院服务，以应对周末急诊入院导致的死亡率上升问题。通过对比2010年4月1日至2011年3月31日之间的医院病例统计数据，并与入院后30天内的全因死亡率进行关联分析，我们估算了因周末急诊入院而导致的额外死亡人数以及相关的质量调整生命年损失。工作日入院的30天死亡率为3.70%，而周末入院的死亡率则高达4.05%。每年因周末急诊入院而导致的额外死亡人数为4355人（风险调整后为5353人）。避免这些死亡所带来的健康收益相当于每年增加29,727至36,539个质量调整生命年。实施7天服务所需的估计成本为10.7亿至14.3亿英镑，这一费用比国家健康与护理卓越研究所设定的最高支出限额5.95亿至7.31亿英镑高出3390万至8310万英镑。目前尚无明确证据表明7天服务能够减少周末死亡人数，或者可以在不增加工作日死亡人数的情况下实现。根据现有证据，实施7天服务所需的计划成本远远超过了国家健康服务体系在消除周末急诊效应方面应花费的最大金额。政策制定者和服务提供者应专注于确定那些能够证明其成本效益的具体服务扩展措施。
