10.1016/j.jhealeco.2015.03.004.abstractZh: 在1976年至2010年期间，总死亡率从强烈顺经济周期变化转变为与宏观经济状况关系不大或无关。当使用较短的分析周期（少于15年）时，这种关联可能会被误判。心血管疾病和交通事故导致的死亡仍然表现出顺经济周期的特征；然而，癌症死亡和外部原因导致的死亡则出现了逆经济周期的模式。在后者中，非交通事故，尤其是意外中毒，起着重要作用。

abstract.text: This paper aims at opening the black box of peer effects in adolescent weight gain. Using Add Health data on secondary schools in the U.S., we investigate whether these effects partly flow through the eating habits channel. Adolescents are assumed to interact through a friendship social network. We propose a two-equation model. The first equation provides a social interaction model of fast food consumption. To estimate this equation we use a quasi maximum likelihood approach that allows us to control for common environment at the network level and to solve the simultaneity (reflection) problem. Our second equation is a panel dynamic weight production function relating an individual's Body Mass Index z-score (zBMI) to his fast food consumption and his lagged zBMI, and allowing for irregular intervals in the data. Results show that there are positive but small peer effects in fast food consumption among adolescents belonging to a same friendship school network. Based on our preferred specification, the estimated social multiplier is 1.15. Our results also suggest that, in the long run, an extra day of weekly fast food restaurant visits increases zBMI by 4.45% when ignoring peer effects and by 5.11%, when they are taken into account.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2015.03.005.abstractZh: 本文旨在揭示青少年体重增长中的同伴效应这一“黑箱”。利用美国中学的Add Health数据，我们研究了这些效应是否部分通过饮食习惯渠道传递。假设青少年通过友谊社交网络进行互动，我们提出了一个双方程模型。第一个方程提供了快餐消费的社会互动模型。为了估计该方程，我们采用了一种准最大似然法，该方法允许我们在网络层面控制共同环境，并解决同时性（反射）问题。第二个方程是一个面板动态体重生成函数，它将个体的体质指数z分数（zBMI）与其快餐消费以及其滞后zBMI联系起来，并允许数据中存在不规则间隔。结果显示，属于同一友谊学校网络的青少年在快餐消费上存在积极但较小的同伴效应。根据我们优选的模型设定，估计的社会乘数效应为1.15。我们的结果还表明，从长期来看，忽略同伴效应时，每周多一天去快餐店会使zBMI增加4.45%；当考虑同伴效应时，这一增加幅度为5.11%。

abstract.text: Today, almost 3 billion people in developing countries rely on biomass as primary cooking fuel, with profound negative implications for their well-being. Improved biomass cooking stoves are alleged to counteract these adverse effects. This paper evaluates take-up and impacts of low-cost improved stoves through a randomized controlled trial. The randomized stove is primarily designed to curb firewood consumption, but not smoke emissions. Nonetheless, we find considerable effects not only on firewood consumption, but also on smoke exposure and, consequently, smoke-related disease symptoms. The reduced smoke exposure results from behavioural changes in terms of increased outside cooking and a reduction in cooking time. We conclude that in order to assess the effectiveness of a technology-oriented intervention, it is critical to not only account for the incidence of technology adoption - the extensive margin - but also for the way the new technology is used - the intensive margin.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2015.03.006.abstractZh: 如今，发展中国家约有30亿人依赖生物质作为主要烹饪燃料，这对他们的福祉产生了严重的负面影响。改进的生物质炉灶被认为能够抵消这些不利影响。本文通过一项随机对照试验，评估了低成本改进炉灶的采用情况及其影响。该随机对照试验设计的炉灶主要旨在减少木柴的消耗，但并未减少烟雾排放。尽管如此，我们发现该炉灶不仅减少了木柴的消耗，还降低了烟雾暴露，从而减少了与烟雾相关的疾病症状。烟雾暴露的减少是由于行为上的改变，比如增加了在户外烹饪的时间以及减少了烹饪时间。我们得出结论，为了评估技术导向性干预措施的有效性，不仅需要考虑技术采用的频率——即广泛边际，还需要考虑新技术使用的方式——即密集边际。

abstract.text: We estimate the effect of medical marijuana laws (MMLs) in ten states between 2004 and 2012 on adolescent and adult use of marijuana, alcohol, and other psychoactive substances. We find increases in the probability of current marijuana use, regular marijuana use and marijuana abuse/dependence among those aged 21 or above. We also find an increase in marijuana use initiation among those aged 12-20. For those aged 21 or above, MMLs further increase the frequency of binge drinking. MMLs have no discernible impact on drinking behavior for those aged 12-20, or the use of other psychoactive substances in either age group.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2015.03.007.abstractZh: 我们估计了2004年至2012年间，十个州中医用大麻法律对青少年和成年人使用大麻、酒精及其他精神活性物质的影响。研究发现，21岁及以上人群当前使用大麻、定期使用大麻以及滥用/依赖大麻的概率有所增加。同时，12-20岁人群开始使用大麻的频率也有所上升。对于21岁及以上人群，医用大麻法律进一步增加了酗酒的频率。而对于12-20岁人群，医用大麻法律对饮酒行为或其他精神活性物质的使用并没有明显影响。

abstract.text: We evaluate the introduction of a reimbursement schedule for self-employed mental health care providers in the Netherlands in 2008. The reimbursement schedule follows a discontinuous discrete step function-once the provider has passed a treatment duration threshold the fee is flat until a next threshold is reached. We use administrative mental health care data of the total Dutch population from 2008 to 2010. We find an "efficiency" effect: on the flat part of the fee schedule providers reduce treatment duration by 2 to 7% compared to a control group. However, we also find unintended effects: providers treat patients longer to reach a next threshold and obtain a higher fee. The data shows gaps and bunches in the distribution function of treatment durations, just before and after a threshold. About 11 to 13% of treatments are shifted over a next threshold, resulting in a cost increase of approximately 7 to 9%.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2015.03.008.abstractZh: 我们评估了2008年在荷兰为自主提供心理健康服务的从业者引入报销制度的尝试。该报销制度采用不连续的阶梯式收费方式——一旦服务者达到某个治疗时长阈值，之后的费用将保持固定，直到达到下一个阈值。我们使用了2008至2010年间荷兰全国范围内的心理健康护理行政数据。研究发现了一个“效率”效应：在费用固定的阶段，与对照组相比，服务者将治疗时长减少了2%到7%。然而，我们也发现了一些意外效果：服务者为了达到下一个阈值而延长治疗时间，从而获得更高的费用。数据显示，在阈值前后，治疗时长的分布存在间隙和聚集现象。大约11%到13%的治疗时间被调整到了下一个阈值，导致费用增加了约7%到9%。

abstract.text: The US health insurance industry is highly concentrated, and health insurance premiums are high and rising rapidly. Policymakers have focused on the possible link between the two, leading to ACA provisions to increase insurer competition. However, while market power may enable insurers to include higher profit margins in their premiums, it may also result in stronger bargaining leverage with hospitals to negotiate lower payment rates to partially offset these higher premiums. We empirically examine the relationship between employer-sponsored fully-insured health insurance premiums and the level of concentration in local insurer and hospital markets using the nationally-representative 2006-2011 KFF/HRET Employer Health Benefits Survey. We exploit a unique feature of employer-sponsored insurance, in which self-insured employers purchase only administrative services from managed care organizations, to disentangle these different effects on insurer concentration by constructing one concentration measure representing fully-insured plans' transactions with employers and the other concentration measure representing insurers' bargaining with hospitals. As expected, we find that premiums are indeed higher for plans sold in markets with higher levels of concentration relevant to insurer transactions with employers, lower for plans in markets with higher levels of insurer concentration relevant to insurer bargaining with hospitals, and higher for plans in markets with higher levels of hospital market concentration.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2015.03.009.abstractZh: 美国的健康保险行业高度集中，保险费用高且呈快速上升趋势。政策制定者关注这两者之间的可能联系，因此《平价医疗法案》规定了增加保险公司竞争的措施。然而，市场力量可能使保险公司能够在保费中纳入更高的利润空间，但这也可能导致保险公司在与医院谈判时拥有更强的议价能力，从而部分抵消这些较高的保费。我们通过使用具有全国代表性的2006-2011年KFF/HRET雇主健康福利调查数据，实证研究了雇主赞助的全保险健康保险保费与当地保险公司和医院市场集中度之间的关系。我们利用雇主赞助保险的一个独特特征，即自保雇主仅从管理式护理组织购买管理服务，以此来区分这些不同因素对保险公司集中度的影响。研究发现，与保险公司与雇主的交易相关的市场集中度较高的地区，保险费率确实较高；而与保险公司与医院谈判相关的市场集中度较高的地区，保险费率较低；而医院市场集中度较高的地区，保险费率较高。

abstract.text: Using Roy's model of sorting behavior, I study welfare implications of learning about medical care quality through the current health care data production infrastructure that relies on solicitation of research subjects. Due to severe adverse-selection issues, I show that such learning could be biased and welfare decreasing. Direct diversification of treatment receipt may solve these issues but is infeasible. Unifying Manski's work on diversified treatment choice under ambiguity and Heckman's work on estimating heterogeneous treatment effects, I propose a new infrastructure based on temporary diversification of access that resolves the prior issues and can identify nuanced effect heterogeneity.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2015.04.001.abstractZh: 利用Roy的排序行为模型，我研究了通过当前依赖研究对象征集的医疗数据生产基础设施来了解医疗质量对福利的影响。由于严重的逆向选择问题，我表明这种学习可能会存在偏差，并降低福利。直接多样化治疗接受方式可能解决这些问题，但不可行。结合Manski关于在不确定性下多样化治疗选择的研究以及Heckman关于估计异质治疗效果的研究，我提出了一种基于临时多样化访问的新基础设施，该基础设施能够解决上述问题，并能够识别细微的效应异质性。

abstract.text: We analyzed a nationwide registry of all pregnancies in Uruguay during 2007-2013 to assess the impact of three types of tobacco control policies: (1) provider-level interventions aimed at the treatment of nicotine dependence, (2) national-level increases in cigarette taxes, and (3) national-level non-price regulation of cigarette packaging and marketing. We estimated models of smoking cessation during pregnancy at the individual, provider and national levels. The rate of smoking cessation during pregnancy increased from 15.4% in 2007 to 42.7% in 2013. National-level non-price policies had the largest estimated impact on cessation. The price response of the tobacco industry attenuated the effects of tax increases. While provider-level interventions had a significant effect, they were adopted by relatively few health centers. Quitting during pregnancy increased birth weight by an estimated 188 g. Tobacco control measures had no effect on the birth weight of newborns of non-smoking women.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2015.04.002.abstractZh: 我们分析了乌拉圭2007年至2013年期间全国范围内的所有妊娠数据，以评估三种烟草控制政策的影响：(1)针对尼古丁依赖治疗的医疗服务提供者层面的干预措施；(2)全国范围内的香烟税提高政策；(3)全国范围内的香烟包装和营销的非价格监管政策。我们在个体、医疗服务提供者和国家层面分别建立了戒烟模型。妊娠期间戒烟的比例从2007年的15.4%上升到2013年的42.7%。全国范围内的非价格政策对戒烟效果的影响最大。烟草行业对价格政策的反应削弱了税收增加的效果。虽然医疗服务提供者层面的干预措施具有显著效果，但只有相对较少的医疗机构采用了这些措施。妊娠期间戒烟可使新生儿的出生体重增加约188克。烟草控制措施对非吸烟妇女所生新生儿的出生体重没有影响。

abstract.text: Health care financing and funding are usually analyzed in isolation. This paper combines the corresponding strands of the literature and thereby advances our understanding of the important interaction between them. We investigate the impact of three modes of health care financing, namely, optimal income taxation, proportional income taxation, and insurance premiums, on optimal provider payment and on the political implementability of optimal policies under majority voting. Considering a standard multi-task agency framework we show that optimal health care policies will generally differ across financing regimes when the health authority has redistributive concerns. We show that health care financing also has a bearing on the political implementability of optimal health care policies. Our results demonstrate that an isolated analysis of (optimal) provider payment rests on very strong assumptions regarding both the financing of health care and the redistributive preferences of the health authority.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2015.04.003.abstractZh: 医疗融资和资金供应通常被单独进行分析。本文将相关文献的各个方面结合起来，从而加深了我们对它们之间重要互动的理解。我们研究了三种医疗融资模式对最优支付者支付以及多数投票下最优政策政治可行性影响的研究，这三种模式分别是最优所得税制、比例所得税制和保险费用。在采用标准的多任务代理框架后，我们发现，当卫生当局存在再分配需求时，不同的融资制度下的最优医疗政策通常会有所不同。我们还指出，医疗融资也影响着最优医疗政策在政治上的可行性。我们的研究结果表明，对最优支付者支付的孤立分析，建立在关于医疗融资和卫生当局再分配偏好的非常强的假设之上。

abstract.text: We evaluate the productivity effects of investment in preventive health technology through a randomized controlled trial in rural Zambia. In the experiment, access to subsidized bed nets was randomly assigned at the community level; 516 farmers were followed over a one-year farming period. We find large positive effects of preventative health investment on productivity: among farmers provided with access to free nets, harvest value increased by US$ 76, corresponding to about 14.7% of the average output value. While only limited information was collected on farming inputs, shifts in the extensive and the intensive margins of labor supply appear to be the most likely mechanism underlying the productivity improvements observed.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2015.04.004.abstractZh: 我们通过在赞比亚农村进行的随机对照试验，评估了投资预防性健康技术对生产力的影响。在实验中，社区层面随机分配了补贴蚊帐的供应；对516名农民进行了为期一年的跟踪研究。我们发现，预防性健康投资对生产力有显著的正面影响：获得免费蚊帐的农民，其收获价值增加了76美元，相当于平均产出价值的约14.7%。虽然关于农业投入的信息收集有限，但劳动供给的广度和集约度变化似乎是最有可能导致生产力提升的机制。

abstract.text: This paper investigates the effects of a large-scale paid maternity leave program on birth outcomes in the United States. In 1978, states with Temporary Disability Insurance (TDI) programs were required to start providing wage replacement benefits to pregnant women, substantially increasing access to antenatal and postnatal paid leave for working mothers. Using natality data, I find that TDI paid maternity leave reduces the share of low birth weight births by 3.2 percent, and the estimated treatment-on-the-treated effect is over 10 percent. It also decreases the likelihood of early term birth by 6.6 percent. Paid maternity leave has particularly large impacts on the children of unmarried and black mothers.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2015.04.005.abstractZh: 本文研究了大规模带薪产假计划对美国出生结果的影响。1978年，拥有临时残疾保险计划的州被要求开始为孕妇提供工资补偿福利，这大大增加了在职母亲获得产前和产后带薪假期的机会。通过人口数据分析，我发现带薪产假使低出生体重婴儿的比例降低了3.2%，而治疗效果的估计值超过10%。此外，带薪产假还使早产的可能性降低了6.6%。对于未婚和黑人母亲的子女来说，带薪产假的影响尤为显著。

abstract.text: This paper investigates the mechanisms behind the health effects of retirement. Using a Regression Discontinuity Design to exploit financial incentives in the German pension system for identification, I find that retirement improves subjective health status and mental health, while also reducing outpatient care utilization. I explore a wide range of health behaviors, time use, and effect heterogeneity as potential mechanisms. Relief from work-related stress and strain, increased sleep duration as well as more frequent physical exercise seem to be key mechanisms through which retirement affects health.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2015.05.001.abstractZh: 本文探讨了退休对健康影响的机制。通过采用回归不连续设计来利用德国养老金系统中的财务激励因素进行识别，我发现退休能够改善主观健康状况和心理健康，同时减少门诊就医的需求。我探讨了多种健康行为、时间利用以及效应异质性作为潜在的机制。减轻工作相关的压力和紧张、增加睡眠时间以及更频繁的体育锻炼似乎是影响退休对健康的关键机制。

abstract.text: We use the introduction of diagnosis related groups (DRGs) in German neonatology to study the determinants of upcoding. Since 2003, reimbursement is based inter alia on birth weight, with substantial discontinuities at eight thresholds. These discontinuities create incentives to upcode preterm infants into classes of lower birth weight. Using data from the German birth statistics 1996-2010 and German hospital data from 2006 to 2011, we show that (1) since the introduction of DRGs, hospitals have upcoded at least 12,000 preterm infants and gained additional reimbursement in excess of 100 million Euro; (2) upcoding rates are systematically higher at thresholds with larger reimbursement hikes and in hospitals that subsequently treat preterm infants, i.e. where the gains accrue; (3) upcoding is systematically linked with newborn health conditional on birth weight. Doctors and midwives respond to financial incentives by not upcoding newborns with low survival probabilities, and by upcoding infants with higher expected treatment costs.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2015.06.001.abstractZh: 我们通过引入德国新生儿科的诊断相关分组（DRGs）来研究过度编码的决定因素。自2003年起，报销标准主要依据出生体重，并在八个阈值处出现显著的不连续性。这些不连续性促使医院将早产儿过度编码到出生体重较低的类别中。利用1996至2010年德国的出生统计数据以及2006至2011年的医院数据，我们发现：(1) 自从引入DRGs以来，医院至少过度编码了12,000名早产儿，并获得了超过1亿欧元的额外报销；(2) 在报销幅度较大的阈值处，以及那些后续治疗早产儿的医院中，过度编码的比例更高，即收益最大的医院；(3) 过度编码与新生儿的健康状况存在系统性关联，这取决于出生体重。医生和助产士在面对财务激励时，会避免对生存概率较低的新生儿进行过度编码，而是对预期治疗成本较高的婴儿进行过度编码。

abstract.text: The public-health community views mandatory Front-of-Pack (FOP) nutrition labels and nutritional taxes as promising tools to control the growth of food-related chronic diseases. This paper uses household scanner data to propose an ex-ante evaluation and comparison of these two policy options for the fromage blanc and dessert yogurt market. In most markets, labelling is voluntary and firms display fat labels only on the FOP of low-fat products to target consumers who do not want to eat fat. We here separately identify consumer preferences for fat and for FOP fat labels by exploiting an exogenous difference in legal labelling requirements between these two product categories. Estimates of demand curves are combined with a supply model of oligopolistic price competition to simulate policies. We find that a feasible ad valorem fat tax dominates a mandatory FOP-label policy from an economic perspective, but both are equally effective in reducing average fat purchases.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2015.06.003.abstractZh: 公共卫生界认为，强制在食品包装正面标注营养成分信息以及实施营养税是控制与食品相关的慢性疾病的有效手段。本文利用家庭调查数据，对法式奶酪和甜酸奶市场的这两种政策选项进行了事前评估与比较。在大多数市场中，标注营养成分信息是一种自愿行为，企业通常只在低脂产品的包装正面标注脂肪含量，以吸引不希望摄入脂肪的消费者。本文通过利用这两种产品类别在法律标注要求上的差异，分别确定了消费者对脂肪含量的偏好以及对于标注脂肪含量的偏好。通过结合需求曲线估计与寡头价格竞争供应模型，我们模拟了这两种政策的实施效果。研究发现，从经济角度来看，征收可实施的按重量计的脂肪税比强制标注脂肪含量的政策更为有效，但两者在减少平均脂肪摄入量方面的作用相当。

abstract.text: This study uses a discrete choice experiment (DCE) to measure patients' preferences for public and private hospital care in New Zealand. A labeled DCE was administered to 583 members of the general public, with the choice between a public and private hospital for a non-urgent surgery. The results suggest that cost of surgery, waiting times for surgery, option to select a surgeon, convenience, and conditions of the hospital ward are important considerations for patients. The most important determinant of hospital choice was whether it was a public or private hospital, with respondents far more likely to choose a public hospital than a private hospital. The results have implications for government policy toward using private hospitals to clear waiting lists in public hospitals, with these results suggesting the public might not be indifferent to policies that treat private hospitals as substitutes for public hospitals.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2015.06.004.abstractZh: 本研究采用离散选择实验（DCE）来测量新西兰民众对公立和私立医院护理的偏好。对583名普通民众进行了标记化的DCE调查，要求他们在非紧急手术的情况下选择公立或私立医院。研究结果表明，手术费用、手术等待时间、选择外科医生的可能性、便利性以及医院设施都是患者重要的考虑因素。医院选择的最重要决定因素是医院是公立还是私立，受访者更倾向于选择公立医院而非私立医院。这些结果对政府政策具有启示意义，即政府可以考虑利用私立医院来缓解公立医院的等待名单压力。这些结果表明，公众可能不会对将私立医院视为公立医院替代品的政策持冷漠态度。

abstract.text: We analyzed the impact of social networks on general practitioners' (GPs) referral behavior based on administrative panel data from 2,684,273 referrals to specialists made between 1998 and 2007. For the definition of social networks, we used information on the doctors' place and time of study and their hospital work history. We found that GPs referred more patients to specialists within their personal networks and that patients referred within a social network had fewer follow-up consultations and less inpatient days thereafter. The effects on patient outcomes (e.g. waiting periods, days in hospital) of referrals within personal networks and affinity-based networks differed. Specifically, whereas empirical evidence showed a concentration on high-quality specialists for referrals within the personal network, suggesting that referrals within personal networks overcome information asymmetry with respect to specialists' abilities, the empirical evidence for affinity-based networks was different and less clear. Same-gender networks tended to refer patients to low-quality specialists.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2015.06.005.abstractZh: 我们基于1998年至2007年间2,684,273例转诊给专科医生的行政面板数据，分析了社交网络对全科医生转诊行为的影响。在定义社交网络时，我们使用了医生的学习地点、时间以及他们在医院的工作经历等信息。研究发现，全科医生更倾向于将患者转诊到其个人网络中的专科医生，而来自同一社交网络的患者后续就诊次数较少，住院天数也较短。个人网络与基于亲缘关系的网络在患者治疗效果方面存在差异：实证数据显示，个人网络中的转诊更倾向于选择高质量专科医生，这表明个人网络中的转诊能够克服关于专科医生能力的信息不对称问题；而基于亲缘关系的网络的实证结果则有所不同，且不够明确。同性别网络则倾向于将患者转诊给质量较低的专科医生。

abstract.text: This paper studies the effects of immigration on health. Specifically, we merge information on individual characteristics from the German Socio-Economic Panel (1984-2009) with detailed local labour market characteristics, and we then exploit the longitudinal component of the data to determine how immigration affects the health of both immigrants and natives over time. We find that immigrants to Germany are healthier than natives upon their arrival (the healthy immigrant effect) but that immigrants' health deteriorates over time. We show that the convergence in health is heterogeneous across immigrants and occurs more rapidly among those working in more physically demanding jobs. Because immigrants are significantly more likely to work in strenuous occupations, we investigate whether changes in the spatial concentration of immigrants affect the health of the native population. Our results suggest that immigration reduces the likelihood that residents will report negative health outcomes. We show that these effects are concentrated in blue-collar occupations and are stronger among low-educated natives. Improvements in natives' average working conditions and workloads help explain the positive effects of immigration on the health of the native population.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2015.06.006.abstractZh: 本文研究了移民对健康的影响。具体而言，我们整合了德国社会经济面板调查（1984-2009年）中的个人特征信息，以及详细的本地劳动力市场特征数据，并利用数据的纵向数据来研究移民如何随时间影响移民和本地人的健康状况。我们发现，移民到德国后，他们的健康状况比本地人更健康（即“健康移民效应”），但随着时间的推移，移民的健康状况会恶化。我们的研究还表明，移民在健康方面的趋同现象在不同移民群体中存在差异，且从事体力劳动强度较高的工作的人群这种趋同现象更为明显。由于移民更有可能从事体力劳动强度高的职业，我们进一步探讨了移民的空间集中程度是否会影响本地人的健康状况。研究结果表明，移民能够降低居民出现不良健康状况的可能性。此外，这些影响主要集中在蓝领职业中，且在教育水平较低的本地人中更为显著。本地人的平均工作条件和工作负荷的改善有助于解释移民对本地人健康的积极影响。

abstract.text: Although many commentators called for increased efforts to incentivize organ donations, theorists and some evidence suggest these efforts will be ineffective. Studies examining the impact of tax incentives generally report zero/negative coefficients, but these studies incorrectly define their tax variables and rely on difference-in-differences despite likely failures of the parallel trends assumption. We identify the causal effect of tax legislation to serve as an organ donor on living kidney donation rates in the U.S. states using more precise tax data and allowing for heterogeneous time-variant causal effects. Employing a synthetic control method, we find that the passage of tax incentive legislation increased living unrelated kidney donation rates by 52 percent in New York relative to a comparable synthetic New York in the absence of legislation. It is possible that New York is unique, but our methodology does not allow us to measure accurately effects in other states.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2015.06.007.abstractZh: 尽管许多评论员呼吁加大激励措施以推动器官捐赠，但理论研究和一些证据表明这些努力可能无效。研究税收激励措施影响的研究通常报告出零或负的系数，但这些研究错误地定义了税收变量，并依赖于差异-差异法，而这种方法可能不符合平行趋势假设。我们利用更精确的税收数据，并考虑异质的时间变化因果效应，来识别税收立法作为器官捐赠者的因果效应对美国各州活体肾脏捐赠率的影响。采用合成控制方法，我们发现，在纽约州，税收激励立法的实施使活体非亲属肾脏捐赠率增加了52%，而在没有该立法的情况下，纽约州的活体非亲属肾脏捐赠率没有变化。虽然纽约州的情况可能具有特殊性，但我们的研究方法无法准确衡量其他州的效果。

abstract.text: Health insurance benefit mandates are believed to have adverse effects on the labor market, but efforts to document such effects for mental health parity mandates have had limited success. I show that one reason for this failure is that the association between parity mandates and labor market outcomes vary with mental distress. Accounting for this heterogeneity, I find adverse labor market effects for non-distressed individuals, but favorable effects for moderately distressed individuals and individuals with a moderately distressed family member. On net, I conclude that the mandates are welfare increasing for moderately distressed workers and their families, but may be welfare decreasing for non-distressed individuals.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2015.06.008.abstractZh: 人们认为，健康保险福利要求会对劳动力市场产生不利影响，但关于心理健康平等要求对劳动力市场影响的实证研究成效有限。我发现，这种研究失败的一个原因是，平等要求与劳动力市场结果之间的关联会随着心理困扰程度的不同而变化。考虑到这种异质性，我发现对于没有心理困扰的个体来说，这些要求会对劳动力市场产生不利影响；而对于有中度心理困扰的个体以及有中度心理困扰家庭成员的个体来说，则会产生积极影响。总体而言，我得出结论：这些要求对于中度心理困扰的工人及其家庭来说确实能提升福利，但对于没有心理困扰的个体来说，则可能降低福利。

abstract.text: A decade ago, the political party of the Italian center-right voted a law restricting immigration. The law became effective in early 2005, when the Italian parliament approved the decree for its application, but one of its articles, granting amnesty for illegal immigrant workers, became immediately effective in July 2002. As a result, 650,000 immigrants were granted the status of foreign nationals in Italy. In this paper, we examine whether the increase in the prevalence of "regular immigrants" has led to an improvement in health outcomes of babies born to migrant women, measured in terms of birth weight. Two hitherto unexploited birth sample surveys published by Italian Institute of Statistics were used for this study. Our estimates show that regularized immigration reduced the probability of low birth weight.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2015.06.009.abstractZh: 十年前，意大利中右翼政党通过了一项限制移民的法律。该法律于2005年初生效，当时意大利议会批准了相关实施法令，但其中一项条款——给予非法移民工人赦免——已于2002年7月立即生效。结果，有65万移民获得了意大利外国公民身份。本文探讨了“正规移民”数量的增加是否改善了移民女性所生婴儿的健康状况，具体体现在出生体重方面。本研究使用了意大利统计研究所发布的两项尚未被充分利用的出生样本调查数据。我们的估计结果显示，正规移民身份的存在降低了婴儿低出生体重的概率。

abstract.text: This paper studies the health effects of one of the world's largest demand-side financial incentive programmes--India's Janani Suraksha Yojana. Our difference-in-difference estimates exploit heterogeneity in the implementation of the financial incentive programme across districts. We find that cash incentives to women were associated with increased uptake of maternity services but there is no strong evidence that the JSY was associated with a reduction in neonatal or early neonatal mortality. The positive effects on utilisation are larger for less educated and poorer women, and in places where the cash payment was most generous. We also find evidence of unintended consequences. The financial incentive programme was associated with a substitution away from private health providers, an increase in breastfeeding and more pregnancies. These findings demonstrate the potential for financial incentives to have unanticipated effects that may, in the case of fertility, undermine the programme's own objective of reducing mortality.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2015.07.001.abstractZh: 本文研究了全球规模最大的需求端金融激励计划之一——印度“Janani Suraksha Yojana”对健康的影响。我们的差异估计方法利用了各地区在实施该金融激励计划时的差异。我们发现，向女性提供现金激励与孕产妇服务的接受度增加有关，但并没有强有力的证据表明该计划能降低新生儿或早期新生儿的死亡率。对利用率的积极影响在受教育程度较低和较贫困的女性中更为显著，尤其是在现金支付最为慷慨的地区。我们还发现了一些意外后果：该金融激励计划导致人们转向私人医疗服务，增加了母乳喂养的比例，并增加了怀孕次数。这些发现表明，金融激励措施可能会产生意想不到的影响，在生育率方面，这些影响可能会削弱该计划降低死亡率的目标。

abstract.text: This paper investigates the average effects of firm-provided workplace health promotion measures on labour market outcomes of the firms' employees. Exploiting linked employer-employee panel data that consist of rich survey-based and administrative information on firms, workers and regions, we apply a flexible propensity score matching approach that controls for selection on observables and time-constant unobserved factors. While the effects of analysing sickness absenteeism appear to be rather limited, our results suggest that health circles/courses increase tenure and job stability across various age groups. A key finding is that health circles/courses strengthen the labour force attachment of elderly employees (51-60), implying potential cost savings for public transfer schemes such as unemployment insurance or early retirement schemes.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2015.07.002.abstractZh: 本文研究了企业提供的职场健康促进措施对员工劳动力市场结果的平均影响。我们利用包含丰富基于调查的和行政信息的雇主-雇员面板数据，采用灵活的倾向得分匹配方法，控制了可观测变量的选择和时间恒定的未观测因素。虽然分析病假缺勤的影响似乎较为有限，但我们的结果表明，健康课程/活动能够增加不同年龄群体的工作年限和就业稳定性。一个关键发现是，健康课程/活动增强了老年员工（51-60岁）对劳动力的依附性，这意味着对于失业保险或提前退休等公共转移计划而言，可能具有节省成本的效果。

abstract.text: Job loss in the United States is associated with reductions in income and long-term increases in mortality rates. This paper examines the short-run changes in health, health care access, and health care utilization after job loss that lead to these long-term effects. Using a sample with more than 10,000 individual job losses and longitudinal data on a wide variety of health-related outcomes, we show that job loss results in worse self-reported health, activity limitations, and worse mental health, but is not associated with statistically significant increases in a variety of specific chronic conditions. Among the full sample of workers, we see reductions in insurance coverage, but little evidence of reductions in health care utilization after job loss. Among the subset of displaced workers with chronic conditions and those for whom the lost job was their primary source of insurance we do see reductions in doctor's visits and prescription drug usage.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2015.07.003.abstractZh: 美国的失业与收入减少和长期死亡率上升有关。本文探讨了失业后短期内健康状况、医疗保健获取情况以及医疗保健利用方面的变化，这些变化导致了这些长期影响。通过一项包含超过10,000例个人失业案例的样本，并结合各种与健康相关的长期数据，我们发现失业会导致自我报告的健康状况恶化、活动能力受限以及心理健康状况下降，但并未导致各种特定慢性疾病的发病率出现统计学意义上的显著增加。在全体工人样本中，我们观察到保险覆盖范围的减少，但失业后医疗保健利用情况的减少幅度很小。在那些患有慢性疾病的失业工人中，以及那些因失业而失去主要保险来源的人群中，我们确实观察到医生就诊次数和处方药使用量的减少。

abstract.text: This paper identifies the effect of health insurance on workers' compensation (WC) filing for young adults by implementing a regression discontinuity design using WC medical claims data from Texas. The results suggest health insurance factors into the decision to have WC pay for discretionary care. The implied instrumental variables estimates suggest a ten-percentage-point decrease in health insurance coverage increases WC bills by 15.3 percent. Despite the large impact of health insurance on the number of WC bills, the additional cost to WC at age 26 appears to be small as most of the increase comes from small bills.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2015.07.004.abstractZh: 本文通过采用回归断点设计，利用德克萨斯州的工伤医疗索赔数据，研究了健康保险对年轻成年人申请工伤赔偿的影响。研究结果表明，健康保险因素会影响他们是否选择由工伤赔偿机构支付自选医疗服务的费用。根据工具变量估计结果，健康保险覆盖率每降低10个百分点，工伤赔偿费用将增加15.3%。尽管健康保险对工伤赔偿费用有显著影响，但26岁时工伤赔偿的额外成本似乎并不大，因为大部分增加都来自小额费用。

abstract.text: This paper analyzes how prices in the retail pharmaceutical market affect health care utilization. Specifically, I study the impact of Walmart's $4 Prescription Drug Program on utilization of antihypertensive drugs and on hospitalizations for conditions amenable to drug therapy. Identification relies on the change in the availability of cheap drugs introduced by Walmart's program, exploiting variation in the distance to the nearest Walmart across ZIP codes in a difference-in-differences framework. I find that living close to a source of cheap drugs increases utilization of antihypertensive medications by 7 percent and decreases the probability of an avoidable hospitalization by 6.2 percent.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2015.07.005.abstractZh: 本文分析了零售药品市场的价格如何影响医疗保健的利用情况。具体而言，我研究了沃尔玛的“4美元处方药计划”对降压药物的使用以及适合药物治疗的疾病住院率的影响。研究基于差异-差异框架，利用沃尔玛计划带来的廉价药物供应变化，并分析了不同邮政编码区距离最近的沃尔玛的距离差异。研究发现，居住在廉价药物供应区附近可使降压药物的利用增加7%，同时可降低6.2%的可避免住院概率。

abstract.text: This paper is the first to apply prospect theory to societal health-related decision making. In particular, we allow for utility curvature, equity weighting, sign-dependence, and loss aversion in choices concerning quality of life of other people. We find substantial inequity aversion, both for gains and losses, which can be attributed to both diminishing marginal utility and differential weighting of better-off and worse-off. There are also clear framing effects, which violate expected utility. Moreover, we observe loss aversion, indicating that subjects give more weight to one group's loss than another group's gain of the same absolute magnitude. We also elicited some information on the effect of the age of the studied group. The amount of inequity aversion is to some extent influenced by the age of the considered patients. In particular, more inequity aversion is observed for gains of older people than gains of younger people.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2015.07.006.abstractZh: 本文首次将前景理论应用于社会健康相关的决策制定。具体而言，我们考虑了效用曲率、公平权重、符号依赖性和损失厌恶等因素，这些因素在涉及他人生活质量的选择中起着重要作用。我们发现，无论是收益还是损失，都存在显著的不公平厌恶现象，这可能是由于边际效用的递减以及不同群体之间的权重差异所导致的。此外，还存在明显的框架效应，这违反了期望效用理论。我们还观察到损失厌恶现象，即受试者更重视某一群体在相同绝对幅度下的损失，而不是另一群体的收益。我们还获得了一些关于研究群体年龄效应的信息。在一定程度上，不公平厌恶的程度受到被研究患者年龄的影响。具体来说，对于老年人而言，他们对收益的厌恶程度高于年轻人。

abstract.text: Many studies link cross-state variation in compulsory schooling laws to early-life educational attainment, thereby providing a plausible way to investigate the causal impact of education on various lifetime outcomes. We use this strategy to estimate the effect of education on older-age mortality of individuals born in the early twentieth century U.S. Our key innovation is to combine U.S. Census data and the complete Vital Statistics records to form precise mortality estimates by sex, birth cohort, and birth state. In turn we find that virtually all of the variation in these mortality rates is captured by cohort effects and state effects alone, making it impossible to reliably tease out any additional impact due to changing educational attainment induced by state-level changes in compulsory schooling.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2015.07.007.abstractZh: 许多研究将各州在义务教育法律上的差异与个体早期教育成就联系起来，这为探究教育对各种终身结果的影响提供了合理的途径。我们采用这一策略来估算20世纪初在美国出生的个体在老年时的死亡率所受的教育影响。我们的关键创新在于结合美国人口普查数据和完整的生命统计记录，以按性别、出生队列和出生州来精确估算死亡率。结果发现，这些死亡率差异几乎全部由队列效应和州效应单独造成，因此无法可靠地识别出由于州级义务教育政策变化而导致的教育成就变化所带来的额外影响。

abstract.text: To reduce the burden of the HIV/AIDS epidemic, international donors recently began providing free antiretroviral therapy (ART) in parts of Sub-Saharan Africa. ART dramatically prolongs life and reduces infectiousness for people with HIV. This paper shows that ART availability increases work time for HIV-negative people without caretaker obligations, who do not directly benefit from the medicine. A difference-in-difference design compares people living near and far from ART, before and after treatment becomes available. Next we explore the possible reasons for this pattern. Although we cannot pinpoint the mechanism, we find that ART availability substantially reduces subjective mortality risk and improves mental health. These results show an undocumented economic consequence of the HIV/AIDS epidemic and an important externality of medical innovation. They also provide the first evidence of a link between the disease environment and mental health.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2015.07.008.abstractZh: 为了减轻HIV/AIDS疫情带来的负担，国际捐助者最近开始在撒哈拉以南非洲的部分地区提供免费的抗逆转录病毒治疗。抗逆转录病毒治疗显著延长了HIV感染者的生命并降低了传染性。本文指出，抗逆转录病毒治疗的普及增加了没有照顾责任的无HIV感染者的工作时间，而这些人并未直接从中受益。通过差异-差异设计，我们比较了在抗逆转录病毒治疗普及前后，生活在治疗附近和远离治疗地区的人群的情况。接下来，我们探讨了这一现象可能的原因。尽管我们无法确定具体机制，但我们发现抗逆转录病毒治疗的普及显著降低了主观死亡风险并改善了心理健康。这些结果揭示了HIV/AIDS疫情带来的未被记录的经济后果，以及医疗创新的重要外部性。它们还首次证明了疾病环境与心理健康之间的联系。

abstract.text: Following devolution in 1999 England and Scotland's National Health Services diverged, resulting in major differences in hospital payment. England introduced a case payment mechanism from 2003/4, while Scotland continued to pay through global budgets. We investigate the impact this change had on activity for Hip Replacement. We examine the financial reimbursement attached to uncemented Hip Replacement in England, which has been more generous than for its cemented counterpart, although clinical guidance from the National Institute for Clinical Excellence recommends the later. In Scotland this financial differential does not exist. We use a difference-in-difference estimator, using Scotland as a control, to test whether the change in reimbursement across the two countries had an influence on treatment. Our results indicate that financial incentives are directly linked to the faster uptake of the more expensive, uncemented Hip Replacement in England, which ran against the clinical guidance.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2015.08.001.abstractZh: 1999年的权力下放导致英格兰和苏格兰的国家医疗服务体系出现分歧，医院支付方式也出现了重大差异。英格兰自2003/4年度开始采用病例支付机制，而苏格兰则继续通过总体预算进行支付。我们研究了这一变化对髋关节置换手术的影响。我们分析了英格兰对未植入骨头的髋关节置换手术的财务补偿情况，该补偿政策比植入骨头的手术更为宽松，尽管国家临床卓越研究所的临床指南建议采用植入骨头的手术。在苏格兰，这种财务差异并不存在。我们使用差异估计方法，以苏格兰作为对照组，来检验两国之间的补偿政策变化是否对治疗产生了影响。我们的研究结果表明，财务激励措施与英格兰对更昂贵的未植入骨头髋关节置换手术的更快采用直接相关，这与临床指南的建议相悖。

abstract.text: This study evaluates the economic consequences of a 1959-1960 malaria eradication campaign in southwestern Uganda. The effort constitutes a rare, large-scale, and well-documented attempt to eliminate malaria in sub-Saharan Africa and produced an immediate disease reduction. We use this quasi-experimental health shock to identify long-term changes in educational and economic outcomes. Comparing the treatment district to a similar synthetic control, we find malaria eradication raised educational attainment by about a half year for both males and females, increased primary school completion among females and generated an almost 40% rise in the likelihood of male wage employment.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2015.08.002.abstractZh: 本研究评估了1959-1960年乌干达西南部疟疾根除运动的经济后果。这一行动是撒哈拉以南非洲地区罕见、大规模且记录详尽的疟疾消除尝试，并取得了立竿见影的疾病减少效果。我们利用这一准实验性的“健康冲击”研究，来识别教育和经济成果的长期变化。通过将实验区与类似的对照区进行比较，我们发现疟疾根除使男性和女性的教育水平提高了约半年，女性小学毕业率有所提升，同时男性从事有偿工作的可能性增加了近40%。

abstract.text: In 1980, Zimbabwe rapidly expanded access to secondary schools, providing a natural experiment to estimate the impact of increased maternal secondary education on child mortality. Exploiting age specific exposure to these reforms, we find that children born to mothers most likely to have benefited from the policies were about 21% less likely to die than children born to slightly older mothers. We also find that increased education leads to delayed age at marriage, sexual debut, and first birth and that increased education leads to better economic opportunities for women. We find little evidence supporting other channels through which increased education might affect child mortality. Expanding access to secondary schools may greatly accelerate declines in child mortality in the developing world today.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2015.08.003.abstractZh: 1980年，津巴布韦迅速扩大了中等教育的普及率，这为评估提高母亲受教育程度对儿童死亡率的影响提供了一个自然实验。通过研究不同年龄段人群受这些政策影响的情况，我们发现，那些母亲受教育程度较高的孩子，其死亡风险比那些母亲受教育程度稍低的孩子的死亡风险低约21%。我们还发现，教育水平的提高会导致结婚年龄、性成熟年龄和首次生育年龄的推迟，同时也会为女性带来更好的经济机会。我们发现，几乎没有证据表明教育水平的提高会通过其他途径影响儿童死亡率。扩大中等教育的普及率，可能会大大加速当今发展中国家儿童死亡率的下降。

abstract.text: This paper examines the impacts of a mandatory, universal prescription drug insurance program on health care utilization and health outcomes in a public health care system with free physician and hospital services. Using the Canadian National Population Health Survey from 1994 to 2003 and implementing a difference-in-differences estimation strategy, we find that the mandatory program substantially increased drug coverage among the general population. The program also increased medication use and general practitioner visits but had little effect on specialist visits and hospitalization. Findings from quantile regressions suggest that there was a large improvement in the health status of less healthy individuals. Further analysis by pre-policy drug insurance status and the presence of chronic conditions reveals a marked increase in the probability of taking medication and visiting a general practitioner among the previously uninsured and those with a chronic condition.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2015.08.004.abstractZh: 本文探讨了强制性、全民处方药保险计划对免费医生和医院服务公共医疗体系中的医疗利用和健康结果的影响。通过利用1994至2003年的加拿大全国人口健康调查数据，并采用差异估计策略，我们发现该计划显著提高了普通人群的药物覆盖率。该计划还增加了药物使用量和全科医生就诊次数，但对专科就诊和住院率的影响较小。分位数回归分析表明，健康状况较差的人群健康状况得到了显著改善。进一步分析显示，对于之前未投保的人群以及患有慢性疾病的人群来说，服药和看全科医生的概率显著增加。

abstract.text: Many families fail to vaccinate their children despite the supply of these services at no cost. This study tests whether personal reminders can increase demand for vaccination. A field experiment was conducted in rural Guatemala in which timely reminders were provided to families whose children were due for a vaccine. The six-month intervention increased the probability of vaccination completion by 2.2 percentage points among all children in treatment communities. Moreover, for children in treatment communities who were due to receive a vaccine, and whose parents were expected to be reminded about that due date, the probability of vaccination completion increased by 4.6 percentage points. The cost of an additional child with complete vaccination due to the intervention is estimated at about $7.50.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2015.08.005.abstractZh: 尽管这些服务可以免费提供，许多家庭仍然不给孩子接种疫苗。本研究旨在探讨个人提醒是否能够增加疫苗接种的需求。在危地马拉的农村地区进行了一项实地实验，为那些孩子即将接种疫苗的家庭提供了及时的提醒。这项为期六个月的干预措施使所有接受干预的家庭中，孩子完成疫苗接种的概率提高了2.2个百分点。此外，对于那些即将接种疫苗且父母被提醒该日期的儿童来说，他们完成疫苗接种的概率提高了4.6个百分点。由于这项干预措施，每个孩子完成疫苗接种的成本估计约为7.50美元。

abstract.text: This paper estimates the trade-off between salary and health insurance costs using data on Illinois school teachers between 1991 and 2008 that allow us to address several common empirical challenges in this literature. Teachers paid about 17 percent of the cost of individual health insurance and about 46 percent of the cost of their family members' plans through premium contributions, but we find no evidence that teachers' salaries respond to changes in insurance costs. Consistent with a higher willingness to pay for insurance, we find that premium contributions are higher in districts that employ a higher-tenured workforce. We find no evidence that school districts respond to higher health insurance costs by reducing the number of teachers.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2015.08.006.abstractZh: 本文利用1991年至2008年间伊利诺伊州教师的数据，估算了薪资与医疗保险费用之间的权衡关系，从而解决了该领域常见的实证挑战。教师个人医疗保险费用约占总费用的17%，而其家庭成员的保险费用则通过保费贡献承担，约占总费用的46%。然而，我们发现教师的薪资并未对保险费用的变化作出反应。与更愿意为保险支付更高费用的情况一致，我们发现，在拥有较高任期较长的教师的学区，保费贡献更高。此外，我们没有发现学区会因医疗保险费用的增加而减少教师数量。

abstract.text: We test whether the generosity of employer-sponsored health insurance facilitates the exercise of market power by hospitals. We construct indices of health plan generosity and the price and volume of hospital services using data from Truven MarketScan for 601 counties from 2001 to 2007. We use variation in the industry and union status of covered workers within a county over time to identify the causal effects of generosity. Although OLS estimates fail to reject the hypothesis that generosity facilitates the exercise of hospital market power, IV estimates show a statistically significant and economically important positive effect of plan generosity on hospital prices in uncompetitive markets, but not in competitive markets. Our results suggest that most of the aggregate effect of hospital market structure on prices found in previous work may be coming from areas with generous plans.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2015.08.007.abstractZh: 我们测试了雇主赞助的医疗保险的慷慨程度是否有助于医院行使市场权力。我们使用Truven MarketScan的数据，针对2001至2007年间601个县的医疗计划慷慨程度、医院服务的价格及数量等指标进行了分析。通过考察各县内受覆盖工人的行业及工会状态随时间的变化，我们试图确定慷慨程度对医院市场权力的影响。尽管普通最小二乘法估计未能否定慷慨程度有助于医院行使市场权力的假设，但工具变量估计显示，在非竞争市场中，医疗计划的慷慨程度对医院价格有显著且重要的正面影响，但在竞争市场中则没有这种效应。我们的研究结果表明，先前关于医院市场结构对价格影响的研究中发现的整体效应，可能主要来自于那些医疗计划较为慷慨的地区。

abstract.text: This paper evaluates the impact of state-level Medicaid reimbursement rates for obstetric care on prenatal care utilization across demographic groups. It also uses these rates as an instrumental variable to assess the importance of prenatal care on birth weight. The analysis is conducted using a unique dataset of Medicaid reimbursement rates and 2001-2010 Vital Statistics Natality data. Conditional on county fixed effects, the study finds a modest, but statistically significant positive relationship between Medicaid reimbursement rates and the number of prenatal visits obtained by pregnant women. Additionally, higher rates are associated with an increase in the probability of obtaining adequate care, as well as a reduction in the incidence of going without any prenatal care. However, the effect of an additional prenatal visit on birth weight is virtually zero for black disadvantaged mothers, while an additional visit yields a substantial increase in birth weight of over 20 g for white disadvantaged mothers.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2015.08.008.abstractZh: 本文评估了州级医疗补助报销率对不同人口群体产前护理使用情况的影响。同时，利用这些报销率作为工具变量，来评估产前护理对出生体重的重要性。分析采用了独特的医疗补助报销率数据以及2001-2010年的生命统计数据。在考虑县固定效应的基础上，研究发现医疗补助报销率与孕妇接受产前检查次数之间存在适度但统计上显著的正相关关系。此外，较高的报销率与获得充分护理的概率增加有关，同时也减少了未接受任何产前护理的情况。然而，对于黑人弱势母亲来说，额外一次产前检查对出生体重的影响几乎为零；而对于白人弱势母亲而言，额外一次产前检查可使出生体重增加超过20克。

abstract.text: This article examines the effect of Medicaid adult dental coverage on use of dental care and dental health outcomes using state-level variation in dental coverage during 2000-2012. Our findings imply that dental coverage is associated with an increase in the likelihood of a recent dental visit, with the size of the effect increasing with Medicaid payment rates to dentists, and a reduction in the likelihood of untreated dental caries. We are among the first to detect an effect of Medicaid coverage on a clinical health outcome other than mortality. These findings may have implications for states expanding Medicaid coverage to adults with incomes of up to 138% of the federal poverty threshold under the Affordable Care Act as most of these states offer an adult dental benefit.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2015.08.009.abstractZh: 本文通过考察2000至2012年间各州在牙科覆盖方面的差异，研究了Medicaid成人牙科保险对牙科护理使用率和口腔健康结果的影响。研究发现，牙科覆盖与近期进行牙科就诊的可能性增加有关，且这种影响随着Medicaid支付给牙医的额度增加而增强；同时，未治疗龋齿的可能性则有所降低。我们首次发现Medicaid覆盖对除死亡率之外的临床健康结果也产生了影响。这些发现对于根据《平价医疗法案》将Medicaid覆盖范围扩展到收入不超过联邦贫困线138%的成年人的各州具有参考价值，因为大多数这些州都提供成人牙科保险服务。

abstract.text: This paper empirically examines the consumer welfare implications of changes in government policies related to patent protection and compulsory licensing in the Indian market for oral anti-diabetic (OAD) medicines. In contrast to previous studies on the impact of pharmaceutical patents in India, we observe, and estimate the welfare effects accruing from differential pricing and voluntary licensing strategies of patent-holding innovator firms. Three novel molecules belonging to the dipeptidyl peptidase-4 (DPP-4) inhibitor class of OADs have been launched in India by the patent holders, at lower prices than those prevailing in the developed countries. Using aggregate market transaction data, we structurally estimate demand and supply and use the parameter estimates in our model to simulate consumer welfare under various counterfactual scenarios. Our results suggest that the introduction of DPP-4 inhibitors generated a consumer surplus gain of around 7.6 cents per day for a typical DPP-4 inhibitor user under the existing differential pricing and voluntary licensing strategies. If the innovators decide to price at developed-country levels, this surplus is eliminated almost entirely. The issuance of compulsory licensing does not always improve consumer welfare because if innovators defer or delay the introduction of new drugs in response, the loss in consumer welfare could be substantial.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2015.09.001.abstractZh: 本文通过实证研究，探讨了与印度市场中的专利保护和强制许可政策相关的变化对口服抗糖尿病药物消费者福利的影响。与以往关于印度制药专利影响的研究不同，我们观察到并估算了专利持有创新企业采用差异定价和自愿许可策略所带来的福利效应。印度专利持有者以低于发达国家水平的价格推出了三种新型二肽肽酶-4（DPP-4）抑制剂类口服抗糖尿病药物。利用整体市场交易数据，我们构建了需求与供给模型，并利用模型参数估计结果，模拟了在不同假设情景下的消费者福利状况。研究结果表明，在现有的差异定价和自愿许可策略下，DPP-4抑制剂的引入为典型用户每天带来了约7.6美分的消费者剩余收益。如果创新企业决定按照发达国家水平定价，这种剩余收益将几乎完全消失。强制许可的颁发并不总是能改善消费者福利，因为如果创新企业推迟或延迟新药的推出，消费者福利的损失可能会相当严重。

abstract.text: We study the effect of state-level merit aid programs (such as Georgia's HOPE scholarship) on alcohol consumption among college students. Such programs have the potential to affect drinking through a combination of channels--such as raising students' disposable income and increasing the incentive to maintain a high GPA--that could theoretically raise or lower alcohol use. We find that the presence of a merit-aid program in one's state generally leads to an overall increase in (heavy) drinking. This effect is concentrated among men, students with lower parental education, older students, and students with high college GPA's. Our findings are robust to several alternative empirical specifications including event-study analyses by year of program adoption. Furthermore, no difference in high-school drinking is observed for students attending college in states with merit-aid programs.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2015.09.002.abstractZh: 我们研究了州级奖励性援助计划（如乔治亚州的HOPE奖学金）对大学生饮酒行为的影响。这类计划通过多种途径影响饮酒行为——例如增加学生的可支配收入以及提高保持高GPA的动机——这些途径理论上可能会增加或减少酒精使用。我们发现，在一个州存在奖励性援助计划时，整体饮酒量通常会增加。这种效应主要集中在男性、父母教育水平较低的学生、年龄较大的学生以及大学GPA较高的学生身上。我们的研究结果在采用多种替代性实证分析模型时依然成立，包括按计划实施年份进行的事件研究分析。此外，在设有奖励性援助计划的州，就读于该州的大学生中，高中时期的饮酒行为并没有显著差异。

abstract.text: Complementing the commonly used concepts of evaluative wellbeing and decision utility, emotional wellbeing and experienced utility are important welfare criteria to assess individuals' subjective wellbeing, especially for valuing health and disability. Yet, almost all empirical evidences on the link between disability and experienced wellbeing come from developed countries. This paper studies the relationship between old-age disability and experienced utility in five low- and middle-income countries. Using data on individual time use and activity-specific affective experiences from an abbreviated version of the Day Reconstruction Method, we document a strong negative association between disability and experienced utility. These differences in experienced utility by disability status are exclusively due to worse activity-specific affective experiences among persons with disabilities. By contrast, disability-related differences in time use provide small compensating effects. Interventions or technologies that facilitate daily life hold most promise to improve experienced utility among persons with disabilities in the developing world.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2015.09.003.abstractZh: 在常用的评估幸福感与决策效用概念之外，情感幸福感和体验效用也是评估个体主观幸福感的重要标准，尤其是在评估健康与残疾的价值方面。然而，几乎所有关于残疾与体验幸福感之间关系的实证证据都来自发达国家。本文研究了五个低收入和中等收入国家中老年残疾与体验效用之间的关系。通过采用简化版日重建法对个体时间使用及特定活动情感体验的数据进行分析，我们发现残疾与体验效用之间存在强烈的负相关关系。这种因残疾状态导致的体验效用差异，完全是由于残疾人士在特定活动中的情感体验较差所致。相比之下，与残疾相关的时间使用差异则提供了较小的补偿效应。对于发展中国家残疾人士来说，能够改善其体验效用的干预措施或技术具有最大的潜力。

abstract.text: This paper examines the impact of parental illness on children's education. We find that only father's illness decreases children's school attendance. Father's illness also has long-term impacts on child education, as it decreases children's likelihood of completing primary school and leads to fewer years of schooling. However, we find no evidence that father's illness affects schooling through increased child labor. Instead, father's illness decreases household's income and reduces school attendance possibly because of the reduced ability of the family to afford education. In contrast, mother's illness and illness of other household members have no effect on children's schooling.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2015.09.004.abstractZh: 本文探讨了父母疾病对儿童教育的影响。我们发现，只有父亲的疾病会减少儿童的出勤率。父亲的疾病还会对儿童教育产生长期影响，因为它会降低儿童完成小学教育的可能性，并导致受教育年限减少。然而，我们没有发现父亲的疾病会通过增加儿童劳动来影响教育。相反，父亲的疾病会降低家庭收入，并可能导致儿童出勤率下降，可能是因为家庭无力承担教育费用。相比之下，母亲的疾病以及其他家庭成员的疾病对儿童教育没有影响。

abstract.text: This paper studies empirically the consequences on health of an early retirement offer. To this end we use a targeted retirement offer to military officers 55 years of age or older. Before the offer was implemented, the normal retirement age in the Swedish defense was 60 years of age. Estimating the effect of the offer on individuals' health within the age range 56-70, we find support for a reduction in both mortality and in inpatient care as a consequence of the early retirement offer. Increasing the mandatory retirement age may thus not only have positive government income effects but also negative effects on increasing government health care expenditures.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2015.09.006.abstractZh: 本文通过实证研究探讨了提前退休政策对健康的影響。我们选取了55岁及以上的军官作为研究对象。在政策实施之前，瑞典国防部门的正常退休年龄为60岁。通过评估该政策在56至70岁年龄段的个体健康影响，我们发现提前退休政策有助于降低死亡率和住院率。因此，提高强制退休年龄不仅可能带来政府的收入增加，也可能导致政府医疗保健支出的增加。

abstract.text: This study examines the impact of individually oriented, purely altruistic, and a hybrid of competitive and cooperative monetary reward incentives on older adults' completion of cognitive exercises and cognitive function. We find that all three incentive structures approximately double the number of exercises completed during the six-week active experimental period relative to a no incentive control condition. However, the altruistic and cooperative/competitive incentives led to different patterns of participation, with significantly higher inter-partner correlations in utilization of the software, as well as greater persistence once incentives were removed. Provision of all incentives significantly improved performance on the incentivized exercises. However, results of an independent cognitive testing battery suggest no generalizable gains in cognitive function resulted from the training.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2015.09.007.abstractZh: 本研究探讨了以个人为导向、纯粹利他主义以及结合竞争与合作的货币奖励激励方式对老年人完成认知练习和认知功能的影响。研究发现，在为期六周的实验期间，这三种激励方式使完成的练习数量大约增加了两倍，相比之下，无激励控制组的情况则没有如此显著的变化。然而，利他主义和合作/竞争激励方式导致了不同的参与模式，软件使用的相互关联性显著增强，且一旦移除激励措施后，参与者的持续性也更高。同时，提供所有激励方式显著提升了在激励下完成的练习的表现。不过，独立的认知测试结果显示，这种训练并未带来认知功能的普遍性提升。

abstract.text: This paper presents new empirical evidence on the impact of tax subsidies for Health Savings Accounts (HSAs) on group insurance coverage. HSAs are tax-free health care expenditure savings accounts. Coupled with high deductible health insurance plans (HDHPs), they together represent new health insurance options. The tax advantage of HSAs expands the group health insurance market by making health care more affordable. Using individual level data from the Current Population Survey and exploiting policy variation by state and year from 2004 to 2012, I find that HSA tax subsidies increase small-group coverage by a statistically significant 2.5 percentage points, although not coverage in larger firms. Moreover, if the tax price of HSA contribution decreases by 10 cents, small-group insurance coverage increases by almost 2 percentage points. I also find that for older workers or less-educated workers, HSA subsidies are associated with 2-3 percentage point increase in their group insurance coverage.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2015.09.009.abstractZh: 本文提出了关于税收补贴对健康储蓄账户对团体保险覆盖影响的新的实证证据。健康储蓄账户是一种免税的医疗保健支出储蓄账户。与高免赔额健康保险计划相结合，它们共同构成了新的健康保险选择。健康储蓄账户的税收优惠通过使医疗保健更加可负担，扩大了团体健康保险市场。利用《当前人口调查》中的个人数据，并分析2004年至2012年间各州的政策变化，我发现健康储蓄账户的税收补贴使小团体的保险覆盖增加了2.5个百分点，尽管并未增加大企业的保险覆盖。此外，如果健康储蓄账户的贡献税收成本降低10美分，小团体的保险覆盖将增加近2个百分点。我还发现，对于年龄较大或教育程度较低的工人来说，健康储蓄账户的补贴会使他们的团体保险覆盖增加2-3个百分点。

abstract.text: The consequences of tobacco control policies for individual welfare are difficult to assess, even more so when related consumption choices challenge people's willpower. We therefore evaluate the impact of smoking bans and cigarette prices on subjective well-being by analyzing data for 40 European countries and regions between 1990 and 2011. We exploit the staggered introduction of bans and apply an imputation strategy to study the effect of anti-smoking policies on people with different propensities to smoke. We find that higher cigarette prices reduce the life satisfaction of likely smokers. Overall, smoking bans are barely related to subjective well-being, but increase the life satisfaction of smokers who would like to quit smoking. The latter finding is consistent with cue-triggered models of addiction and the idea of bans as self-control devices.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2015.09.010.abstractZh: 烟草控制政策对个人福祉的影响难以评估，尤其是当相关消费选择挑战人们的意志力时。因此，我们通过分析1990年至2011年间40个欧洲国家和地区的数据，来评估禁烟令和香烟价格对主观幸福感的影响。我们利用了分阶段实施禁烟令的做法，并采用插补策略来研究反吸烟政策对不同吸烟倾向人群的影响。研究发现，较高的香烟价格会降低潜在吸烟者的生活满意度。总体而言，禁烟令与主观幸福感几乎没有关联，但会增加那些希望戒烟的吸烟者的生活满意度。这一发现与成瘾的线索触发模型以及将禁烟令视为自我控制手段的观点一致。

abstract.text: In February 2009 the U.S. Congress unexpectedly passed the Health Information Technology for Economic and Clinical Health Act (HITECH). HITECH provides up to $27 billion to promote adoption and appropriate use of Electronic Medical Records (EMR) by hospitals. We measure the extent to which HITECH incentive payments spurred EMR adoption by independent hospitals. Adoption rates for all independent hospitals grew from 48 percent in 2008 to 77 percent by 2011. Absent HITECH incentives, we estimate that the adoption rate would have instead been 67 percent in 2011. When we consider that HITECH funds were available for all hospitals and not just marginal adopters, we estimate that the cost of generating an additional adoption was $48 million. We also estimate that in the absence of HITECH incentives, the 77 percent adoption rate would have been realized by 2013, just 2 years after the date achieved due to HITECH.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2015.10.001.abstractZh: 2009年2月，美国国会意外通过了《经济与临床健康信息技术法案》（HITECH）。该法案提供了高达270亿美元的资金，以促进医院采用并合理使用电子病历系统。我们研究了HITECH激励措施对独立医院采用电子病历的推动作用。所有独立医院的使用率从2008年的48%上升至2011年的77%。如果没有HITECH激励措施，我们预计2011年的使用率仅为67%。考虑到HITECH资金适用于所有医院，而不仅仅是那些采用电子病历的少数医院，我们估计额外增加一项激励措施的成本为4800万美元。此外，我们估计如果没有HITECH激励措施，到2013年，独立医院的使用率才能达到77%，而由于HITECH激励措施，这一目标仅在两年后就能实现。

abstract.text: Understanding electronic cigarettes' effect on tobacco smoking is a central economic and policy issue. This paper examines the causal impact of e-cigarette access on conventional cigarette use by adolescents. Regression analyses consider how state bans on e-cigarette sales to minors influence smoking rates among 12 to 17 year olds. Such bans yield a statistically significant 0.9 percentage point increase in recent smoking in this age group, relative to states without such bans. Results are robust to multiple specifications as well as several falsification and placebo checks. This effect is both consistent with e-cigarette access reducing smoking among minors, and large: banning electronic cigarette sales to minors counteracts 70 percent of the downward pre-trend in teen cigarette smoking for a given two-year period.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2015.10.003.abstractZh: 了解电子香烟对烟草吸烟的影响是一个重要的经济和政策问题。本文探讨了电子香烟的获取对青少年传统香烟使用的影响。回归分析考察了各州对未成年人销售电子香烟的禁令对12至17岁青少年吸烟率的影响。结果显示，与没有此类禁令的州相比，禁令的实施使该年龄段的吸烟率增加了0.9个百分点。研究结果在多次参数调整以及多次虚假测试和安慰剂检验中依然保持稳定。这一效应不仅与电子香烟的获取有助于减少未成年人的吸烟行为相一致，其影响幅度也相当显著：禁止向未成年人销售电子香烟能够在给定的两年时间内抵消青少年吸烟率下降的70%。

abstract.text: Increasing the proportion of adults that have regular, comprehensive eye exams and reducing visual impairment due to uncorrected refractive error and other common eye health problems are federal health objectives. We examine the effect of vision insurance on eye care utilization and vision health outcomes by taking advantage of quasi-experimental variation in Medicaid coverage of adult vision care. Using a difference-in-difference-in-difference approach, we find that Medicaid beneficiaries with vision coverage are 4.4 percentage points (p<0.01) more likely to have seen an eye doctor in the past year, 5.3 percentage points (p<0.01) less likely to report needing but not purchasing eyeglasses or contacts due to cost, 2.0 percentage points (p<0.05) less likely to report difficulty seeing with usual vision correction, and 1.2 percentage points (p<0.01) less likely to have a functional limitation due to vision.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2015.10.006.abstractZh: 增加定期进行全面眼科检查的成年人比例，减少因未矫正的屈光不正和其他常见眼部健康问题导致的视力障碍，是联邦政府的健康目标。我们利用医疗补助对成人眼科护理的覆盖差异，研究视力保险对眼科护理利用和视力健康结果的影响。通过差异-差异-差异的方法分析，我们发现拥有视力保险的医疗补助受益人，在过去一年中看眼科医生的可能性高出4.4个百分点（p<0.01），因费用原因而不需要或购买眼镜或隐形眼镜的可能性降低5.3个百分点（p<0.01），使用常规视力矫正方法时视力困难的可能性降低2.0个百分点（p<0.05），因视力问题而出现功能限制的可能性降低1.2个百分点（p<0.01）。

abstract.text: This paper evaluates the impact of three different performance incentive schemes using data from a social experiment that randomized 88 Mexican high schools with over 40,000 students into three treatment groups and a control group. Treatment 1 provides individual incentives for performance on curriculum-based mathematics tests to students only, treatment 2 to teachers only, and treatment 3 gives both individual and group incentives to students, teachers, and school administrators. Program impact estimates reveal the largest average effects for treatment 3, smaller impacts for treatment 1, and no impact for treatment 2.

10.1086/675910.abstractZh: 本文通过一项社会实验的数据来评估三种不同的绩效激励方案的影响。该实验将88所墨西哥高中（共有超过40,000名学生）随机分为三个实验组和一个对照组。实验组1仅为学生提供基于课程的数学测试表现的个体激励；实验组2仅为教师提供激励；实验组3则为学生、教师和学校管理人员提供个体和群体激励。程序影响估计显示，实验组3的平均效果最大，实验组1的效果较小，而实验组2则没有效果。

abstract.text: How much of the foreclosure crisis can be explained by the large number of high-leverage mortgages originated during the housing boom? In our model, heterogeneous households select from mortgages with different down payments and choose whether to default given income and housing shocks. The use of low-down payment loans is initially limited by payment-to-income requirements but becomes unrestricted during the boom. The model approximates key housing and mortgage market facts before and after the crisis. A counterfactual experiment suggests that the increased number of high-leverage loans originated prior to the crisis can explain over 60 percent of the rise in foreclosure rates.

10.1086/677349.abstractZh: 在房地产繁荣期间，大量高杠杆抵押贷款的出现，能在多大程度上解释止赎危机？在我们的模型中，不同家庭会根据不同的首付比例选择抵押贷款，并会根据收入和住房状况决定是否违约。最初，使用低首付贷款受到支付能力限制，但在房地产繁荣期间这种限制被解除。该模型模拟了危机前后住房市场和抵押贷款市场的关键情况。一项反事实实验表明，在危机之前增加的高杠杆贷款数量，可以解释超过60%的止赎率上升现象。

abstract.text: We model demand for noninstrumental information, drawing on the idea that people derive entertainment utility from suspense and surprise. A period has more suspense if the variance of the next period's beliefs is greater. A period has more surprise if the current belief is further from the last period's belief. Under these definitions, we analyze the optimal way to reveal information over time so as to maximize expected suspense or surprise experienced by a Bayesian audience. We apply our results to the design of mystery novels, political primaries, casinos, game shows, auctions, and sports.

10.1086/677350.abstractZh: 我们基于这样一个观点来建模对非工具性信息的需求：人们从悬念和惊喜中获得娱乐效用。如果一个时期下一时期信念的变异性更大，那么这个时期就具有更多的悬念；如果当前信念与上一时期信念的差距更大，那么这个时期就具有更多的惊喜。根据这些定义，我们分析了随时间揭示信息的最佳方式，以最大化贝叶斯受众所经历的预期悬念或惊喜。我们将这些结果应用于悬疑小说、政治初选、赌场、游戏节目、拍卖以及体育赛事的设计中。

abstract.text: Medicare spending exceeds 4% of GDP in the US each year, and there are concerns that moral hazard problems have led to overspending. This paper considers whether hospitals that treat patients more aggressively and receive higher payments from Medicare improve health outcomes for their patients. An innovation is a new lens to compare hospital performance for emergency patients: plausibly exogenous variation in ambulance-company assignment among patients who live near one another. Using Medicare data from 2002-2010, we show that ambulance company assignment importantly affects hospital choice for patients in the same ZIP code. Using data for New York State from 2000-2006 that matches exact patient addresses to hospital discharge records, we show that patients who live very near each other but on either side of ambulance service area boundaries go to different types of hospitals. Both identification strategies show that higher-cost hospitals achieve better patient outcomes for a variety of emergency conditions. Using our Medicare sample, the estimates imply that a one standard deviation increase in Medicare reimbursement leads to a 4 percentage point reduction in mortality (10% compared to the mean). Taking into account one-year spending after the health shock, the implied cost per at least one year of life saved is approximately $80,000. These results are found across different types of hospitals and patients, as well across both identification strategies.

10.1086/677756.abstractZh: 在美国，Medicare的支出每年占GDP的4%以上，人们担心道德风险问题导致了过度支出。本文探讨了那些对病人治疗更为积极且从Medicare获得更高补偿的医院是否能改善病人的健康结果。一种创新的方法是通过救护车公司分配的差异来评估医院对急诊病人的服务表现——这些差异可能是由于救护车公司在病人之间的分配是偶然的。利用2002-2010年的Medicare数据，我们发现救护车公司的分配对同个邮政编码区内的病人选择医院有重要影响。通过2000-2006年纽约州的数据，这些数据将病人的实际地址与医院出院记录进行匹配，我们发现即使住在非常近的地方，但位于救护车服务区域边界两侧的病人会去不同类型的医院。这两种识别策略都表明，成本较高的医院在多种急诊情况下能带来更好的病人结果。根据我们的Medicare样本数据，估计每增加一个标准差的Medicare补偿，死亡率就会降低4个百分点（与平均水平相比）。考虑到健康冲击后的一年支出，每挽救至少一年的生命所节省的成本约为80,000美元。这些结果在不同类型的医院和病人中均得到验证，且两种识别策略都适用。

abstract.text: We present a theory and experimental evidence on pricing and portfolio choices under asymmetric reasoning. We show that under asymmetric reasoning, prices do not reflect all (types of) reasoning. Some agents who observe prices that cannot be reconciled with their reasoning switch from perceiving the environment as risky to perceiving it as ambiguous. If they are ambiguity-averse, these agents become price-insensitive. Results from an experiment show that, consistent with the theory, (i) without aggregate risk, mispricing decreases as the fraction of price-sensitive agents increases; and (ii) with aggregate risk, price-insensitive agents trade to more balanced portfolios.

10.1086/679283.abstractZh: 我们提出了一种关于在不对称推理下定价和投资组合选择的理论和实验证据。研究表明，在不对称推理下，价格并不反映所有类型的推理。一些观察到与自身推理不符的价格的代理人，会从认为环境具有风险转变为认为环境具有模糊性。如果这些代理人厌恶模糊性，他们就会变得对价格不敏感。实验结果表明，与理论一致的是：(i)在没有整体风险的情况下，随着对价格敏感的代理人比例的增加，定价偏差会减小；(ii)在存在整体风险的情况下，对价格不敏感的代理人会转向更均衡的投资组合。

abstract.text: Analyzing the savings behavior of a large sample of identical and fraternal twins, we find that genetic differences explain about 33 percent of the variation in savings propensities across individuals. Individuals are born with a persistent genetic predisposition to a specific savings behavior. Parenting contributes to the variation in savings rates among younger individuals, but its effect decays over time. The environment when growing up (e.g., parents' wealth) moderates genetic effects. Finally, savings behavior is genetically correlated with income growth, smoking, and obesity, suggesting that the genetic component of savings behavior reflects genetic variation in time preferences or self-control.

10.1086/679284.abstractZh: 通过对大量同卵和异卵双胞胎的储蓄行为进行分析，我们发现遗传差异解释了个体储蓄倾向变化中的约33%。个体天生就具有某种特定的储蓄行为的遗传倾向。父母教养方式对年轻个体的储蓄率差异有一定影响，但这种影响随时间逐渐减弱。成长环境（如父母的财富状况）能够调节遗传因素的影响。最后，储蓄行为与收入增长、吸烟和肥胖状况存在遗传相关性，这表明储蓄行为的遗传成分反映了时间偏好或自我控制的遗传变异。

abstract.text: This paper provides a systematic analysis of identification in linear social interactions models. This is a theoretical and econometric exercise as the analysis is linked to a rigorously delineated model of interdependent decisions. We develop an incomplete information game for individual choice under social influences that nests standard models as special cases. We consider identification of both endogenous and contextual social effects under alternative assumptions regarding an analyst's a priori knowledge of social structure or access to individual-level or aggregate data. Finally, we discuss potential ramifications for identification of endogenous formation of social structure.

10.1086/679496.abstractZh: 本文对线性社会互动模型中的识别问题进行了系统分析。这是一项理论性和计量经济学的研究，因为分析与一个严格定义的相互依赖决策模型相关联。我们开发了一个不完全信息博弈模型，用于描述在社会影响下的个体选择行为，并将标准模型作为该模型的特例。我们考虑了在分析师对社会结构的先验知识或能否获取个体层面或总体数据不同的假设下，内生性社会效应和情境性社会效应的识别问题。最后，我们讨论了内生性社会结构形成对识别问题可能带来的影响。

abstract.text: We derive a formula to determine the degree to which a school choice program may harm public school stayers by luring the best students to other schools. The "cream skimming" effect is increasing in the degree of heterogeneity within schools, the school choice take-up rate of strong students relative to weak students, and the dependence of school outcomes on student body quality. We use the formula to investigate the cream skimming effect of hypothetical voucher programs on the high school graduation rate and other outcomes of the students who would remain in public school. We find small effects across a wide variety of model specifications and types of modest voucher programs.

10.1086/679497.abstractZh: 我们推导出一个公式，用于确定学校选择计划通过吸引最优秀的学生到其他学校而对公立学校留校学生造成的损害程度。这种“精华抽取”效应随着学校内部异质性的增加、优秀学生相对于薄弱学生的选择率上升，以及学校成果对学生群体质量的依赖性增强而加剧。我们利用该公式来研究假设性奖学金计划对公立学校留校学生的高中毕业率及其他成果的影响。研究发现，在多种模型参数设置和不同类型的奖学金计划下，这种效应都较为微小。

abstract.text: The literature on treatment effects focuses on gross benefits from program participation. We extend this literature by developing conditions under which it is possible to identify parameters measuring the cost and net surplus from program participation. Using the generalized Roy model, we nonparametrically identify the cost, benefit, and net surplus of selection into treatment without requiring the analyst to have direct information on the cost. We apply our methodology to estimate the gross benefit and net surplus of attending college.

10.1086/679498.abstractZh: 关于治疗效果的文献主要关注项目参与所带来的总体收益。我们在此基础上进一步研究，探讨能够确定衡量项目参与成本及净收益参数的条件。利用广义Roy模型，我们非参数地确定了选择接受治疗所带来的成本、收益和净收益，而无需分析师直接了解成本信息。我们将这一方法应用于估算上大学所带来的总体收益和净收益。

abstract.text: This study investigates the antipoverty efficacy of minimum wage policies. Proponents of these policies contend that employment impacts are negligible and suggest that consumers pay for higher labor costs through imperceptible increases in goods prices. Adopting this empirical scenario, the analysis demonstrates that an increase in the national minimum wage produces a value-added tax effect on consumer prices that is more regressive than a typical state sales tax and allocates benefits as higher earnings nearly evenly across the income distribution. These income-transfer outcomes sharply contradict portraying an increase in the minimum wage as an antipoverty initiative.

10.1086/679626.abstractZh: 本研究探讨了最低工资政策在减贫方面的效果。该政策支持者认为，其就业影响微乎其微，并指出消费者通过商品价格的微小上涨来承担更高的劳动力成本。基于这一假设的分析表明，提高国家最低工资会对消费品价格产生比普通州销售税更为显著的增值税效应，并且这种福利分配几乎均匀分布在整个收入分布中。这些收入转移的结果与将最低工资提高视为减贫措施的观点形成了鲜明对比。

abstract.text: We study a change in maternity leave entitlements in Norway. Mothers giving birth before July 1, 1977, were eligible for 12 weeks of unpaid leave, while those giving birth after that date were entitled to 4 months of paid leave and 12 months of unpaid leave. The increased time spent with the child led to a 2 percentage point decline in high school dropout rates and a 5 percent increase in wages at age 30. These effects were larger for the children of mothers who, in the absence of the reform, would have taken very low levels of unpaid leave.

10.1086/679627.abstractZh: 我们研究了挪威产假福利的变化。1977年7月1日之前分娩的母亲可以享受12周的无薪休假，而该日期之后分娩的母亲则有权享受4个月的带薪休假和12个月的无薪休假。增加与孩子的相处时间使得高中辍学率下降了2个百分点，30岁时的工资水平也提高了5%。对于那些在没有这项改革的情况下只能享受极低无薪休假的母亲所生的孩子来说，这些影响更为显著。

abstract.text: We consider infinite-horizon economies populated by a continuum of agents subject to idiosyncratic shocks. This framework contains models of saving and capital accumulation with incomplete markets in the spirit of works by Bewley, Aiyagari, and Huggett; models of entry, exit, and industry dynamics in the spirit of Hopenhayn's work; and dynamic models of occupational choice and search models as special cases. Robust and easy-to-apply comparative statics results are established with respect to exogenous parameters as well as various kinds of changes in the Markov processes governing the law of motion of the idiosyncratic shocks.

10.1086/680685.abstractZh: 我们考虑了由一系列受特异性冲击影响的代理人构成的无限时域经济模型。该框架包含了遵循Bewley、Aiyagari和Huggett研究成果的储蓄与资本积累模型；遵循Hopenhayn研究成果的进入、退出及行业动态模型；以及作为特例的职业选择动态模型和搜索模型。针对外生参数以及控制特异性冲击运动规律的马尔可夫过程的各种变化，我们建立了稳健且易于应用的比较静态结果。

abstract.text: We use Spain's Equality Law to test for the existence of agency problems between party leaders and their constituents. The law mandates a 40 percent female quota on electoral lists in towns with populations above 5,000. Using pre- and postquota data by party and municipality, we implement a triple-difference design. We find that female quotas resulted in slightly better electoral results for the parties that were most affected by the quota. Our evidence shows that party leaders were not maximizing electoral results prior to the quota, suggesting the existence of agency problems that hinder female representation in political institutions.

10.1086/680686.abstractZh: 我们运用西班牙的平等法来检验政党领袖与其选民之间是否存在代理问题。该法律要求在人口超过5,000的城镇的选举名单中必须包含40%的女性候选人。通过对比实施配额前后的政党及市镇数据，我们采用了三重差分设计。研究发现，女性配额对受配额影响最大的政党而言，确实带来了略微更好的选举结果。我们的证据表明，在配额实施之前，政党领袖并未尽力最大化选举结果，这表明存在阻碍女性在政治机构中代表的代理问题。

abstract.text: Emission regulations become more prevalent in developing countries, but they may be compromised by corruption. This paper documents the prevalence of corruption and the effectiveness of vehicle emission regulations in Mexico City. I develop a statistical test for identifying a specific type of cheating that involves bribing center technicians. I also estimate a structural model of car owner retesting and cheating decisions. Results suggest that 9.6 percent of car owners paid US$20 to circumvent the regulation. Eliminating cheating and increasing the cost of retests would reduce emissions by 3,708 tons at a high cost for vehicle owners.

10.1086/680936.abstractZh: 在发展中国家，排放法规变得越来越普遍，但这些法规可能会受到腐败的破坏。本文记录了墨西哥城腐败现象的普遍性以及车辆排放法规的有效性。我开发了一种统计测试，用于识别一种涉及贿赂中心技术人员的作弊行为。我还建立了一个结构模型，用于分析车主重新测试和作弊的决策。研究结果表明，有9.6%的车主支付20美元来规避法规。消除作弊行为并增加重新测试的成本，虽然能减少3,708吨的排放，但会给车主带来高昂的成本。

abstract.text: A major policy issue in standard setting is that patents that are ex ante not that important, by being included into a standard, may become standard-essential patents. In an attempt to curb the monopoly power that they create, most standard-setting organizations require the owners of patents covered by the standard to make a loose commitment to grant licenses on reasonable terms. Such commitments unsurprisingly are conducive to litigation. This paper builds a framework for the analysis of these patents, identifies several types of inefficiencies attached to the lack of price commitments, and shows how structured price commitments restore competition and why such commitments may not arise spontaneously in the marketplace.

10.1086/680995.abstractZh: 在标准制定中，一个重要的政策问题是，那些在事前并不重要的专利，通过被纳入标准后，可能会成为标准必要专利。为了遏制这些专利所创造的垄断力量，大多数标准制定组织要求被纳入标准的专利所有者做出宽松的承诺，以合理条件授予许可。不出所料，这样的承诺容易引发诉讼。本文构建了一个分析这些专利的框架，指出了缺乏价格承诺所带来的几种低效现象，并说明了结构化价格承诺如何恢复竞争，以及为什么这种承诺不会在市场中自发产生。

abstract.text: We study the implications of preference heterogeneity for asset pricing. We use recursive preferences in order to separate heterogeneity in risk aversion from heterogeneity in the intertemporal elasticity of substitution and an overlapping-generations framework to obtain a nondegenerate stationary equilibrium. We solve the model explicitly up to the solutions of ordinary differential equations and highlight the effects of overlapping generations and each dimension of preference heterogeneity on the market price of risk, interest rates, and the volatility of stock returns. We find that separating intertemporal elasticity of substitution and risk aversion heterogeneity can have a substantive impact on the model's (qualitative and quantitative) ability to address some key asset-pricing issues.

10.1086/680996.abstractZh: 我们研究了偏好异质性对资产定价的影响。我们采用递归偏好模型，将风险厌恶的异质性与跨期替代弹性的异质性分离开来，并利用重叠世代框架得到一个非退化的稳定均衡。我们明确求解了模型中的常微分方程，并重点分析了重叠世代以及各偏好维度异质性对市场风险价格、利率以及股票回报波动性的影响。研究发现，将跨期替代弹性与风险厌恶的异质性分离开来，对模型解决某些关键资产定价问题的能力和质量有着实质性的影响。

abstract.text: How and by how much do supervisors enhance worker productivity? Using a company-based data set on the productivity of technology-based services workers, we estimate supervisor effects and find them to be large. Replacing a boss who is in the lower 10% of boss quality with one who is in the upper 10% of boss quality increases a team’s total output by more than adding one worker to a nine-member team would. Workers assigned to better bosses are less likely to leave the firm. A separate normalization implies that the average boss is about 1.75 times as productive as the average worker.

10.1086/681097.abstractZh: 主管如何以及多大幅度地提升员工的生产力？通过基于公司层面的技术型服务员工生产率数据集，我们估算了主管效应，并发现其影响相当显著。用一位属于优秀主管类别的老板替换一位属于较差主管类别的老板，能够增加团队的总产出，其效果甚至超过在九人团队中增加一名员工的效应。被分配到优秀主管手中的员工更不容易离开公司。另外，通过标准化处理可以发现，平均而言，优秀主管的生产力大约是普通员工生产力的1.75倍。

abstract.text: Leading equilibrium concepts require agents' beliefs to coincide with the model's true probabilities and thus be free of systematic errors. This implicitly assumes a criterion that tests beliefs against the observed outcomes generated by the model. We formalize this requirement in stationary environments. We show that there is a tension between requiring that beliefs can be tested against systematic errors and allowing agents to disagree or be uncertain about the long-run fundamentals. We discuss the application of our analysis to asset pricing, Markov perfect equilibria, and dynamic games.

10.1086/681241.abstractZh: 领先均衡概念要求代理人的信念与模型中的真实概率一致，从而避免系统性错误。这隐含了一个标准，即检验信念是否与模型生成的观测结果相符。我们在静态环境中对这一要求进行了形式化。我们发现，要求信念能够针对系统性错误进行测试，与允许代理人对长期基本因素持有不同意见或不确定之间存在矛盾。我们讨论了将这一分析应用于资产定价、马尔可夫完美均衡和动态博弈的情况。

abstract.text: We study the effects of a contraction in financial intermediation on nonfinancial firms. The Panic of 1907 originated in the shadow banks of the time, New York's trust companies. The runs were caused by a shock unrelated to the trust companies' nonfinancial corporate clients. In the years following the panic, corporations affiliated with the worst-affected trusts made fewer capital investments, paid lower dividends, and suffered lower profitability and higher borrowing costs relative to firms without such connections. The shock to New York's trust companies accounted for at least 18.4 percent of the decline in corporate investment in the United States in 1908.

10.1086/681575.abstractZh: 我们研究了金融中介收缩对非金融企业的影响。1907年的恐慌起源于当时的影子银行——纽约的信托公司。这些危机是由与信托公司的非金融企业客户无关的突发事件引发的。在恐慌之后的几年里，与受影响最严重的信托公司相关的企业进行了更少的资本投资，支付了更低的股息，其盈利能力下降，借款成本也高于没有这种关联的企业。对纽约信托公司的冲击至少占1908年美国企业投资下降的18.4%。

abstract.text: This paper theoretically and empirically analyzes the financing terms that support international trade. The choice of trade finance terms balances the risk that an importer defaults on an exporter and the possibility that an exporter does not deliver goods as specified. Analysis of transaction-level data from a US exporter reveals that importers located in countries with weak enforcement of contracts typically finance transactions, but these firms are able to overcome the constraints of such environments if they can establish a relationship with the exporter. Furthermore, the manner in which trade is financed shapes the impact of crises.

10.1086/681592.abstractZh: 本文从理论和实证角度分析了支持国际贸易的融资条款。贸易融资条款的选择需要平衡进口商违约的风险以及出口商未能按约定交付商品的可能性。对一家美国出口商的交易数据进行分析后发现，位于合同执行力度较弱国家的进口商通常会为交易提供融资，但这些企业如果能够与出口商建立良好关系，就能克服这种环境的限制。此外，贸易融资的方式还会影响危机的影响程度。

abstract.text: I study the role of social security in providing insurance when there is adverse selection in the annuity market. I calculate welfare gain from mandatory annuitization in the social security system relative to a laissez-faire benchmark, using a model in which individuals have private information about their mortality. I estimate large heterogeneity in mortality using the Health and Retirement Study. Despite that, I find small welfare gain from mandatory annuitization. Social security has a large effect on annuity prices because it crowds out demand by high-mortality individuals. Welfare gain would have been significantly larger in the absence of this effect.

10.1086/681593.abstractZh: 我研究了在年金市场存在逆向选择的情况下，社会保障在提供保险方面的作用。我使用了一个模型来计算社会保障体系中强制年金制度相对于自由市场基准的福利收益，该模型考虑了个人对其死亡率的私人信息。我利用“健康与退休研究”数据估计了死亡率的较大异质性。尽管如此，我发现强制年金制度的福利收益很小。社会保障对年金价格有较大的影响，因为它排挤了高死亡率个体的需求。如果没有这种影响，福利收益将会显著更大。

abstract.text: We study the internal organization of French manufacturing firms. We divide the employees of each firm into "layers" using occupational categories. Layers are hierarchical in that the typical worker in a higher layer earns more, and the typical firm occupies less of them. The probability of adding/dropping a layer is positively/negatively correlated with value added. Reorganization, through changes in layers, is essential to understanding how firms grow. Firms that expand substantially add layers and pay lower average wages in all preexisting layers. In contrast, firms that expand little and do not reorganize pay higher average wages in all preexisting layers.

10.1086/681641.abstractZh: 我们研究了法国制造企业的内部组织结构。我们将每家企业的员工按照职业类别划分为不同的“层级”。这些层级具有层级性，即处于较高层级的员工收入更高，而企业所占据的层级数量则较少。增加或减少一个层级的概率与附加值呈正相关或负相关。通过调整层级结构，可以更好地理解企业的成长过程。那些实现大规模扩张的企业会增加层级数量，并且所有层级的平均工资都会降低。相反，那些扩张幅度较小且不进行重组的企业，则会在所有层级上支付更高的平均工资。

abstract.text: Thomas Piketty’s recent book Capital in the Twenty-First Century is a timely and important contribution that turns our attention to striking long-run trends in economic inequality. A large part of the book is thus a documentation of historical data, going further back in time, and focusing more on the very richest in society, than have most existing economic

10.1086/682574.abstractZh: 托马斯·皮凯蒂的新书《二十一世纪资本》是一项及时且重要的贡献，它让我们关注经济不平等的长期趋势。因此，这本书的很大一部分内容是对历史数据的记录，时间跨度更长，并且更多地关注社会中最富有的群体，这比大多数现有的经济学著作更为深入。

abstract.text: We provide a model of conflict and mass killing decisions to identify the key variables and situations that make mass killings more likely to occur. We predict that mass killings are most likely in countries with large amounts of natural resource rents, polarization, institutional constraints regarding rent sharing, and low productivity of labor.
