The role of resources such as oil, gas, and diamonds and other key determinants of mass killings is confirmed by our empirical results based on country-level as well as ethnic group-level analysis.

10.1086/682584.abstractZh: 我们提出了一个关于冲突与大规模杀戮决策的模型，以识别那些使大规模杀戮更有可能发生的关键变量和情境。我们预测，大规模杀戮最有可能发生在拥有大量自然资源租金、社会两极分化、关于租金分配的制度限制以及劳动生产率低下等国家。基于国家层面以及民族群体层面的分析，我们的实证结果证实了石油、天然气、钻石等资源的角色，以及这些资源作为大规模杀戮关键决定因素的重要性。

abstract.text: How do entrepreneurs vary firm size, capital structure, and default to manage risk? We show that more risk-averse entrepreneurs run smaller, more highly leveraged firms and default less, because running a smaller firm with higher debt reduces personal funds at risk in the firm. Optimal default depends on ex ante debt, consumption forgone from firm liquidation, and owner capacity to inject funds. We show that entrepreneurs sacrifice current consumption in the hope of future success that never materializes for the bottom 25 percent, but entrepreneurship is a path toward great wealth and high consumption for the top quartile.

10.1086/682678.abstractZh: 企业家如何调整企业规模、资本结构以及违约行为以管理风险？我们发现，更厌恶风险的企业家会经营规模较小、杠杆率较高的企业，并且违约次数较少，因为经营规模较小且债务较高的企业会减少个人面临的风险资金。最优违约行为取决于事前债务、企业清算时放弃的消费以及企业主注入资金的能力。我们发现，对于最底层25%的人群来说，企业家为了未来成功的希望而牺牲当前的消费，但对于最顶尖的25%人群而言，创业是一条通往巨大财富和较高消费水平的道路。

abstract.text: We provide a general framework for the analysis of institutional dynamics in an environment in which payoffs and political powers change stochastically. Assuming that economic and political institutions as well as individual types can be ordered, and preferences and the distribution of political power satisfy natural "single-crossing" (increasing differences) conditions, we prove existence of a pure-strategy Markov voting equilibrium, provide conditions for its uniqueness, and present a number of comparative static results. We then use this framework to study the dynamics of political rights and repression in the presence of threats from extremist groups and the dynamics of collective experimentation.

10.1086/682679.abstractZh: 我们提供了一个通用框架，用于分析在收益和政治权力随机变化的环境中的制度动态。假设经济和政治制度以及个体类型可以被排序，并且偏好和政治权力的分配满足自然的“单交叉”条件（即差异逐渐增大），我们证明了纯策略马尔可夫投票均衡的存在性，给出了其唯一性的条件，并提出了一些比较静态的结果。随后，我们利用这一框架来研究在极端主义团体威胁以及集体实验动态影响下的政治权利与镇压的动态变化。

abstract.text: Using survey data from the Promise Academy in the Harlem Children's Zone, we estimate the effects of high-performing charter schools on human capital, risky behaviors, and health outcomes. Six years after the random admissions lottery, youths offered admission to the Promise Academy middle school score 0.279 (0.073) standard deviations higher on academic achievement outcomes, 0.067 (0.076) standard deviations higher on an index of academic attainment, and 0.313 (0.091) standard deviations higher on a measure of on-time benchmarks. Females are 10.1 percentage points less likely to be pregnant as teenagers, and males are 4.4 percentage points less likely to be incarcerated.

10.1086/682718.abstractZh: 通过 Harlem 儿童区 Promise 学院的调查数据，我们评估了表现优异的特许学校对人类资本、风险行为以及健康结果的影响。在随机录取抽签制度实施六年后，被 Promise 学院中学录取的青少年在学业成绩上高出0.279（0.073）个标准差，在学术成就指数上高出0.067（0.076）个标准差，在按时完成学业的标准上高出0.313（0.091）个标准差。女性在青少年时期怀孕的可能性低10.1个百分点，而男性被监禁的可能性则低4.4个百分点。

abstract.text: We provide evidence suggesting that the cross-sectional distributions of US consumption and its growth rate obey the power law in both the upper and lower tails, with exponents approximately equal to four. Consequently, high-order moments are unlikely to exist, and the generalized method of moments estimation of Euler equations that employs cross-sectional moments may be inconsistent. Through bootstrap studies, we find that the power law appears to generate spurious nonrejection of heterogeneous-agent asset pricing models in explaining the equity premium. Dividing households into age groups, we propose an estimation approach that appears less susceptible to fat tail issues.

10.1086/682729.abstractZh: 我们提供了证据，表明美国消费的截面分布及其增长率在上下尾部都遵循幂律分布，指数值约为四。因此，高阶矩不太可能存在，而使用截面矩来估计欧拉方程的广义矩估计方法可能会不一致。通过自助法研究，我们发现幂律分布似乎在解释股权溢价时产生了虚假的非拒绝结果，即 heterogeneous-agent资产定价模型在解释股权溢价时出现了错误。通过将家庭划分为不同年龄组，我们提出了一种对肥尾问题不太敏感的估计方法。

abstract.text: Self-control problems change the logic of agency theory by partly aligning the interests of the firm and worker: both now value contracts that elicit future effort. Findings from a year-long field experiment with full-time data entry workers support this idea. First, workers increase output by voluntarily choosing dominated contracts (which penalize low output but give no additional rewards for high output). Second, effort increases closer to (randomly assigned) paydays. Third, the contract and payday effects are strongly correlated within workers, and this correlation grows with experience. We suggest that workplace features such as high-powered incentives or effort monitoring may provide self-control benefits.

10.1086/683822.abstractZh: 自我控制问题通过改变代理理论的逻辑来影响双方的利益：现在，企业和员工都更重视能够激发未来努力的契约。一项为期一年的实地实验发现，全职数据录入工人确实表现出这种倾向。首先，工人通过自愿选择那些对低产出有惩罚、但对高产出没有额外奖励的契约来提高产出。其次，努力程度在接近（随机分配的）发薪日时会增加。第三，契约效应和发薪日效应在工人之间具有高度相关性，且这种相关性随着经验的增加而增强。我们认为，诸如高动力激励或努力监控这样的工作场所特征可能会带来自我控制的好处。

abstract.text: Recent models of reference-dependent preferences indicate that expectations may play a prominent role in the presence of behavioral anomalies. A subset of such expectations-based models predicts an "endowment effect for risk": that risk attitudes differ when reference points change from certain to stochastic. In two purposefully simple risk preference experiments, eliminating often-discussed confounds, I demonstrate both between and within subjects such an endowment effect for risk. These results provide needed separation between expectations-based reference-dependent models, allow for evaluation of recent theoretical extensions, and may help to close a long-standing debate in decision science on inconsistency between utility elicitation methodologies.

10.1086/683836.abstractZh: 最近的参考依赖偏好模型表明，在行为异常的情况下，预期可能起着重要作用。其中一些基于预期的模型预测了“风险禀赋效应”：当参考点从确定性的变为随机性的时候，风险态度会有所不同。在两项旨在简化风险偏好实验的研究中，通过消除常见的混淆因素，我证明了在受试者之间以及受试者内部都存在这种风险禀赋效应。这些结果为基于预期的参考依赖模型提供了必要的区分，有助于评估最近的理论扩展，并可能有助于解决决策科学中关于效用提取方法不一致性的长期争议。

abstract.text: Evidence showing that individual behavior often deviates from the classical principle of preference maximization has raised at least two important questions: (1) How serious are the deviations? (2) What is the best way to analyze choice behavior in order to extract information for the purpose of welfare analysis? This paper addresses these questions by proposing a new way to identify the preference relation that is closest, in terms of welfare loss, to the revealed choice.

10.1086/683838.abstractZh: 有证据表明，个体行为常常偏离经典的偏好最大化原则，这引发了至少两个重要问题：(1)这种偏离的严重程度如何？(2)为了进行福利分析，分析选择行为的最佳方式是什么？本文通过提出一种新的方法来识别在福利损失方面最接近于实际选择的偏好关系，从而解决了这些问题。

abstract.text: This paper studies how private information is incorporated into prices, using a unique setting from the eighteenth century that is closer to stylized models of price discovery than modern-day markets. Specifically, the paper looks at English securities traded in both London and Amsterdam. Private information reached Amsterdam through sailing boats that sailed only twice a week and in adverse weather could not sail at all. Results are consistent with a Kyle model in which informed agents trade strategically. Most importantly, the speed of information revelation in Amsterdam depended on the expected time until the private signal would become public.

10.1086/683839.abstractZh: 本文研究了私人信息如何被纳入价格之中，采用了一种源自18世纪的独特设定，这种设定更接近于价格发现的风格化模型，而非现代市场。具体而言，本文研究了在伦敦和阿姆斯特丹交易的英国证券。私人信息通过每周仅航行两次且天气恶劣时无法航行的帆船传送到阿姆斯特丹。研究结果与凯尔模型相符，该模型认为知情交易者会进行策略性交易。最重要的是，阿姆斯特丹的信息披露速度取决于私人信号公开的预期时间。

abstract.text: To fight evasion, many developing countries use production-inefficient tax policies. This includes minimum tax schemes whereby firms are taxed on either profits or turnover, depending on which tax liability is larger. Such schemes create nonstandard kink points, which allow for eliciting evasion responses to switches between profit and turnover taxes using a bunching approach. Using administrative data on corporations in Pakistan, we estimate that turnover taxes reduce evasion by up to 60-70 percent of corporate income. Incorporating this in a calibrated optimal tax model, we find that switching from profit to turnover taxation increases revenue by 74 percent without reducing aggregate profits.

10.1086/683849.abstractZh: 为了打击逃税行为，许多发展中国家采用生产效率低的税收政策。这包括最低税方案，即企业根据利润或营业额 whichever 的税收责任更大来纳税。这种方案会创造出非标准的临界点，使得企业可以通过切换利润税和营业额税来逃避税收。利用巴基斯坦企业的行政数据，我们估计营业额税可以将企业收入的逃税行为减少60-70%。在调整过的最优税收模型中，我们发现从利润税转换为营业额税可以增加74%的税收收入，同时不会减少总利润。

abstract.text: We derive a tractable nonlinear earnings function that we estimate separately individual by individual using NLSY79 data. We obtain three ability measures, a rate of skill depreciation, a time discount rate, and a population-wide estimate of the human capital rental rate. We utilize these parameters to verify a number of heretofore untested theorems based on the life cycle model. We show how these human capital production function parameters relate to cognitive ability, personality traits, and family background. Finally, we show that accounting for individual-specific heterogeneity dramatically reduces estimates of population-wide persistence of permanent and transitory shocks by over 50 percent.

10.1086/683989.abstractZh: 我们推导出一个易于处理的非线性收益函数，并使用NLSY79数据逐个体进行估计。我们获得了三个能力指标：技能折旧率、时间折现率，以及整个人群范围内的人力资本租金率估计值。我们利用这些参数来验证一些基于生命周期模型的、此前未经过检验的定理。我们展示了这些人力资本生产函数参数与认知能力、人格特质和家庭背景之间的关系。最后，我们发现，考虑到个体特定的异质性后，永久性和暂时性冲击在整个人群中的持续性估计值可以减少超过50%。

abstract.text: Cumulative innovation is central to economic growth. Do patent rights facilitate or impede follow-on innovation? We study the causal effect of removing patent rights by court invalidation on subsequent research related to the focal patent, as measured by later citations. We exploit random allocation of judges at the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Federal Circuit to control for endogeneity of patent invalidation. Patent invalidation leads to a 50% increase in citations to the focal patent, on average, but the impact is heterogeneous and depends on characteristics of the bargaining environment. Patent rights block downstream innovation in computers, electronics, and medical instruments, but not in drugs, chemicals, or mechanical technologies. Moreover, the effect is entirely driven by invalidation of patents owned by large patentees that triggers more follow-on innovation by small firms.

10.1093/qje/qju029.abstractZh: 累积创新是经济增长的核心。专利权是促进还是阻碍后续创新？我们研究了通过法院宣告专利无效来消除专利权的因果效应，以及这对后续与焦点专利相关的研究的影响，具体通过后来的引用次数来衡量。我们利用美国联邦巡回上诉法院法官的随机分配，来控制专利无效的内生性。专利无效平均会导致焦点专利的引用次数增加50%，但这种影响是异质的，并取决于谈判环境的特征。专利权在计算机、电子设备和医疗仪器领域阻碍了下游创新，但在药品、化学品或机械技术领域则没有这种影响。此外，这种效应完全是由大型专利持有人的专利被宣告无效所引发的，这反过来又促进了小型企业的后续创新。

abstract.text: One long-standing motivation for low-income housing programs is the possibility that housing affordability and housing conditions generate externalities, including on children’s behavior and long-term life outcomes. We take advantage of a randomized housing voucher lottery in Chicago in 1997 to examine the long-term impact of housing assistance on a wide variety of child outcomes, including schooling, health, and criminal involvement. In contrast to most prior work focusing on families in public housing, we focus on families living in unsubsidized private housing at baseline, for whom voucher receipt generates large changes in both housing and nonhousing consumption. We find that the receipt of housing assistance has little, if any, impact on neighborhood or school quality or on a wide range of important child outcomes.

10.1093/qje/qju030.abstractZh: 低收入住房计划的一个长期动机在于，住房的可负担性和住房条件可能会产生外部影响，包括对儿童行为和长期生活结果的影响。我们利用了1997年芝加哥的一项随机住房券抽奖活动，来研究住房援助对多种儿童结果的长期影响，包括教育、健康和犯罪参与等方面。与大多数关注公共住房中家庭的研究不同，我们关注的是那些在基线时居住在未获得补贴的私人住房中的家庭，这些家庭在收到住房券后，住房和非住房消费都发生了显著变化。我们发现，获得住房援助对社区或学校质量，以及一系列重要的儿童结果几乎没有影响。

abstract.text: This article studies socially responsible behavior in markets. We develop a laboratory product market in which low-cost production creates a negative externality for third parties, but where alternative production with higher costs mitigates the externality. Our first study, conducted in Switzerland, reveals a persistent preference among many consumers and firms for avoiding negative social impact in the market, reflected both in the composition of product types and in a price premium for socially responsible products. Socially responsible behavior is generally robust to varying market characteristics, such as increased seller competition and limited consumer information, and it responds to prices in a manner consistent with a model in which positive social impact is a utility-enhancing feature of a consumer product. In a second study, we investigate whether market social responsibility varies across societies by comparing market behavior in Switzerland and China. While subjects in Switzerland and China do not differ in their degree of social concern in nonmarket contexts, we find that low-cost production that creates negative externalities is significantly more prevalent in markets in China. Across both studies, consumers in markets exhibit less social concern than subjects in a comparable individual choice context.

10.1093/qje/qju031.abstractZh: 本文研究了市场中的社会责任行为。我们构建了一个实验室产品市场模型，在该模型中，低成本生产会对第三方产生负面外部性，而高成本的生产方式则能够缓解这种外部性。我们在瑞士进行的研究发现，许多消费者和企业仍然倾向于避免市场中的负面社会影响，这一倾向不仅体现在产品类型的构成上，还体现在社会责任产品所享有的价格优势上。社会责任行为通常能够适应不同的市场特征，例如卖方竞争加剧或消费者信息有限的情况，并且其反应方式与一种模型相符，即正面的社会影响是消费产品的一种效用增强特征。在第二项研究中，我们通过比较瑞士和中国市场的市场行为，探讨了市场中的社会责任是否存在差异。虽然瑞士和中国消费者的非市场情境中的社会关注程度并无差异，但我们发现，在中国市场中，产生负面外部性的低成本生产现象更为普遍。这两项研究都表明，市场中的消费者比在类似个人选择情境下的消费者表现出更少的社会责任意识。

abstract.text: A rising share of employees now regularly engage in working from home (WFH), but there are concerns this can lead to “shirking from home.” We report the results of a WFH experiment at Ctrip, a 16,000-employee, NASDAQ-listed Chinese travel agency. Call center employees who volunteered to WFH were randomly assigned either to work from home or in the office for nine months. Home working led to a 13% performance increase, of which 9% was from working more minutes per shift (fewer breaks and sick days) and 4% from more calls per minute (attributed to a quieter and more convenient working environment). Home workers also reported improved work satisfaction, and their attrition rate halved, but their promotion rate conditional on performance fell. Due to the success of the experiment, Ctrip rolled out the option to WFH to the whole firm and allowed the experimental employees to reselect between the home and office. Interestingly, over half of them switched, which led to the gains from WFH almost doubling to 22%. This highlights the benefits of learning and selection effects when adopting modern management practices like WFH.

10.1093/qje/qju032.abstractZh: 目前，越来越多的员工选择在家工作，但有人担心这会导致员工“逃避工作”。我们报道了在Ctrip进行的一项在家工作实验的结果。Ctrip是一家拥有16,000名员工、在纳斯达克上市的中国旅游公司。自愿在家工作的客服人员被随机分配在九个月内在家工作或办公室工作。在家工作使员工的表现提高了13%，其中9%是由于每班工作时间增加（减少了休息时间和病假天数），4%是由于每分钟通话次数增加（得益于更安静、更便利的工作环境）。在家工作的员工还报告称工作满意度有所提高，流失率减半，但基于绩效的晋升机会却减少了。由于实验的成功，Ctrip将在家工作的选项推广到整个公司，并允许实验中的员工在家庭和办公室之间重新选择。有趣的是，超过一半的员工改变了选择，这使得在家工作的收益几乎翻倍至22%。这凸显了在采用现代管理实践如在家工作时，学习和选择效应所带来的好处。

abstract.text: When buying durable goods, consumers must forecast how much utility they will derive from future consumption, including consumption in different states of the world. This can be complicated for consumers because making intertemporal evaluations may expose them to a variety of psychological biases such as present bias, projection bias, and salience effects. We investigate whether consumers are affected by such intertemporal biases when they purchase automobiles. Using data for more than 40 million vehicle transactions, we explore the impact of weather on purchasing decisions. We find that the choice to purchase a convertible or a four-wheel-drive is highly dependent on the weather at the time of purchase in a way that is inconsistent with classical utility theory. We consider a range of rational explanations for the empirical effects we find, but none can explain fully the effects we estimate. We then discuss and explore projection bias and salience as two primary psychological mechanisms that are consistent with our results.

10.1093/qje/qju033.abstractZh: 在购买耐用商品时，消费者必须预测未来消费所能获得的效用，包括在不同状态下的消费。这对消费者来说可能相当复杂，因为进行跨时间评估可能会使他们受到各种心理偏差的影响，例如当前偏差、预测偏差和显著性效应。我们研究了消费者在购买汽车时是否受到这些跨时间偏差的影响。通过超过4000万笔车辆交易的数据，我们探讨了天气对购买决策的影响。我们发现，购买敞篷车或四轮驱动车的选择在很大程度上取决于购买时的天气状况，这与经典效用理论不符。我们考虑了多种合理的解释来说明我们发现的实证效应，但没有一种能够完全解释我们估计的效应。随后，我们讨论了预测偏差和显著性效应作为与我们的结果一致的两个主要心理机制。

abstract.text: In all markets, firms go through a process of creative destruction: entry, random growth, and exit. In many of these markets there are also regulations that restrict entry, possibly distorting this process. We study the public interest rationale for entry taxes in a general equilibrium model with free entry and exit of firms in which firm dynamics are driven by reputation concerns. In our model firms can produce high-quality output by making a costly but efficient initial unobservable investment. If buyers never learn about this investment, an extreme “lemons problem” develops, no firm invests, and the market shuts down. Learning introduces reputation incentives such that a fraction of entrants do invest. We show that if the market operates with spot prices, entry taxes always enhance the role of reputation to induce investment, improving welfare despite the impact of these taxes on equilibrium prices and total production.

10.1093/qje/qju034.abstractZh: 在所有市场中，企业都会经历一个创造性破坏的过程：进入、随机增长和退出。在许多市场中，还存在限制进入的法规，这可能会扭曲这一过程。我们在一个允许企业自由进入和退出的一般均衡模型中研究了对进入征税的公共利益理由。在该模型中，企业动态由声誉因素驱动。我们的模型表明，企业通过进行成本高但效率高的初始不可观测投资可以生产高质量的产品。如果买家永远不知道这一投资的存在，就会出现“柠檬问题”，即没有企业愿意投资，市场因此关闭。通过引入声誉激励机制，一部分进入者会进行投资。我们指出，如果市场采用即时价格机制，进入税总是能够增强声誉的作用，从而促使企业投资，尽管这些税收会对均衡价格和总产量产生影响，但总体上会改善福利。

abstract.text: We study the link between investment boom and bust cycles and returns on capital in the dry bulk shipping industry. We show that high current ship earnings are associated with high used ship prices and heightened industry investment in new ships, but forecast low future returns. We propose and estimate a behavioral model of industry cycles that can account for the evidence. In our model, firms overextrapolate exogenous demand shocks and partially neglect the endogenous investment response of their competitors. As a result, firms overpay for ships and overinvest in booms and are disappointed by the subsequent low returns. Formal estimation of the model suggests that modest expectational errors can result in dramatic excess volatility in prices and investment.

10.1093/qje/qju035.abstractZh: 我们研究了投资繁荣与萧条周期与干散货运输行业资本回报之间的关系。我们发现，当前船舶的收益较高与二手船舶价格较高以及行业对新船舶的投资增加有关，但未来回报预计较低。我们提出并估计了一个能够解释这些现象的行业周期行为模型。在我们的模型中，企业过度放大了外部需求冲击的影响，并部分忽略了竞争对手的内生投资反应。因此，企业为船舶支付过高的价格，并在投资高峰期过度投资，随后又因低回报而失望。对该模型的正式估计表明，适度的预期误差可能导致价格和投资的剧烈波动。

abstract.text: We estimate how households trade off immediate costs and uncertain future benefits that occur in the very long run, 100 or more years away. We exploit a unique feature of housing markets in the United Kingdom and Singapore, where residential property ownership takes the form of either leaseholds or freeholds. Leaseholds are temporary, prepaid, and tradable ownership contracts with maturities between 99 and 999 years, while freeholds are perpetual ownership contracts. The price difference between leaseholds and freeholds reflects the present value of perpetual rental income starting at leasehold expiration, and is thus informative about very long-run discount rates. We estimate the price discounts for varying leasehold maturities compared to freeholds and extremely long-run leaseholds via hedonic regressions using proprietary data sets of the universe of transactions in each country. Households discount very long-run cash flows at low rates, assigning high present value to cash flows hundreds of years in the future. For example, 100-year leaseholds are valued at more than 10% less than otherwise identical freeholds, implying discount rates below 2.6% for 100-year claims.

10.1093/qje/qju036.abstractZh: 我们估算了家庭如何在100年或更长的时期内，权衡即时成本与不确定的未来收益。我们利用了英国和新加坡住房市场的独特特征，即住宅财产所有权分为租赁权和永久产权两种形式。租赁权是临时性的、预付的、可转让的所有权合同，期限在99年到999年之间；而永久产权则是永久性的所有权合同。租赁权与永久产权之间的价格差异反映了从租赁权到期开始，永久租金收入的现值，因此能够反映非常长期的折现率。我们通过使用各自国家交易数据的专有数据集，利用享乐回归法，估算了不同租赁权期限与永久产权相比的定价折扣。家庭对非常长期的现金流以较低的折现率进行估值，将未来数百年的现金流赋予较高的现值。例如，100年的租赁权价值比完全相同的永久产权低10%以上，这意味着100年期限的权利的折现率低于2.6%。

abstract.text: We analyze the effectiveness of consumer financial regulation by considering the 2009 Credit Card Accountability Responsibility and Disclosure (CARD) Act. We use a panel data set covering 160 million credit card accounts and a difference-in-differences research design that compares changes in outcomes over time for consumer credit cards, which were subject to the regulations, to changes for small business credit cards, which the law did not cover. We estimate that regulatory limits on credit card fees reduced overall borrowing costs by an annualized 1.6% of average daily balances, with a decline of more than 5.3% for consumers with FICO scores below 660. We find no evidence of an offsetting increase in interest charges or a reduction in the volume of credit. Taken together, we estimate that the CARD Act saved consumers $11.9 billion a year. We also analyze a nudge that disclosed the interest savings from paying off balances in 36 months rather than making minimum payments. We detect a small increase in the share of accounts making the 36-month payment value but no evidence of a change in overall payments.

10.1093/qje/qju037.abstractZh: 我们通过分析2009年《信用卡责任与披露法案》对消费者金融监管的有效性进行了研究。我们使用了涵盖1.6亿信用卡账户的面板数据集，并采用了差异-差异研究设计，比较了受该法规约束的消费者信用卡与未受该法规约束的小微企业信用卡在一段时间内的变化。我们的估计表明，对信用卡费用的限制使整体借款成本降低了每年平均每日余额的1.6%，对于FICO评分低于660的消费者来说，这一降幅超过了5.3%。我们没有发现利息费用增加或信用额度减少的抵消效应。综合来看，我们估计《信用卡责任与披露法案》每年为消费者节省了119亿美元。我们还分析了关于披露36个月内还清欠款可节省的利息信息的激励效应。我们发现，选择36个月还款方式的账户比例略有增加，但整体支付金额没有变化。

abstract.text: We establish a theoretical and empirical framework to assess the role of resource endowments and their geographic location in interstate conflict. The main predictions of the theory are that conflict is more likely when at least one country has natural resources, when the resources in the resource-endowed country are closer to the border, and, in the case where both countries have natural resources, when the resources are located asymmetrically vis-à-vis the border. We test these predictions on a novel data set featuring oilfield distances from bilateral borders. The empirical analysis shows that the presence and location of oil are significant and quantitatively important predictors of interstate conflicts after World War II.

10.1093/qje/qju038.abstractZh: 我们建立了一个理论和实证框架，以评估资源禀赋及其地理位置在州际冲突中的作用。该理论的主要预测是：当至少有一个国家拥有自然资源时，冲突的可能性会增加；当资源禀赋国的资源靠近边界时，冲突的可能性也会增加；而在两国都拥有自然资源的情况下，如果资源的位置相对于边界不对称，冲突的可能性也会增加。我们基于一个包含油田距离双边边界的新数据集来检验这些预测。实证分析表明，石油的存在和位置在二战后成为州际冲突的重要且具有定量意义的预测因素。

abstract.text: We examine causes and consequences of relative income within households. We show that the distribution of the share of income earned by the wife exhibits a sharp drop to the right of 12 , where the wife’s income exceeds the husband’s income. We argue that this pattern is best explained by gender identity norms, which induce an aversion to a situation where the wife earns more than her husband. We present evidence that this aversion also impacts marriage formation, the wife’s labor force participation, the wife’s income conditional on working, marriage satisfaction, likelihood of divorce, and the division of home production. Within marriage markets, when a randomly chosen woman becomes more likely to earn more than a randomly chosen man, marriage rates decline. In couples where the wife’s potential income is likely to exceed the husband’s, the wife is less likely to be in the labor force and earns less than her potential if she does work. In couples where the wife earns more than the husband, the wife spends more time on household chores; moreover, those couples are less satisfied with their marriage and are more likely to divorce. These patterns hold both cross-sectionally and within couples over time.

10.1093/qje/qjv001.abstractZh: 我们研究了家庭内部相对收入的原因和后果。我们发现，妻子收入占比在12%左右出现显著下降，此时妻子的收入超过了丈夫的收入。我们认为，这种模式最好用性别身份规范来解释，这些规范使得人们厌恶妻子收入超过丈夫的情况。我们有证据表明，这种厌恶也会影响婚姻形成、妻子的劳动力参与率、工作条件下的收入、婚姻满意度、离婚的可能性以及家庭生产的分配。在婚姻市场中，当随机选择的女性比随机选择的男性更有可能获得更高的收入时，婚姻率会下降。在妻子潜在收入可能超过丈夫的夫妻关系中，妻子不太可能参与劳动力市场，即使工作，其收入也低于潜在水平。而在妻子收入超过丈夫的夫妻关系中，妻子会花费更多时间从事家务劳动；此外，这些夫妻对婚姻的满意度较低，离婚的可能性也更高。这些模式在横截面和夫妻关系随时间变化的过程中都普遍存在。

abstract.text: We study the economic effects of religious practices in the context of the observance of Ramadan fasting, one of the central tenets of Islam. To establish causality, we exploit variation in the length of daily fasting due to the interaction between the rotating Islamic calendar and a country’s latitude. We report two key, quantitatively meaningful results: (i) longer Ramadan fasting has a negative effect on output growth in Muslim countries, and (ii) it increases subjective well-being among Muslims. We find evidence that these patterns are consistent with a standard club good explanation for the emergence of costly religious practices: increased strictness of fasting screens out the less committed members, while the more committed respond with an increase in their relative levels of participation. Together, our results underscore that religious practices can affect individual behavior and beliefs in ways that have negative implications for economic performance, but that nevertheless increase subjective well-being among followers.

10.1093/qje/qjv002.abstractZh: 我们研究了宗教实践在斋月禁食这一伊斯兰教核心教义背景下的经济效应。为了确立因果关系，我们利用了伊斯兰历法与一个国家纬度之间的相互作用导致每日禁食时长变化的现象。我们得出了两个具有定量意义的关键结果：(i) 更长的斋月禁食对穆斯林国家的产出增长有负面影响；(ii) 它提升了穆斯林的主观幸福感。我们发现，这些模式与一种标准的“俱乐部物品”解释相符，即昂贵的宗教实践的出现是由于更严格的禁食行为淘汰了那些参与程度较低的成员，而更投入的成员则会增加他们的参与程度。总的来说，我们的研究结果表明，宗教实践可以通过影响个人行为和信仰来对经济表现产生负面影响，但同时也能提升信徒的主观幸福感。

abstract.text: Over 130,000 juveniles are detained in the United States each year with 70,000 in detention on any given day, yet little is known about whether such a penalty deters future crime or interrupts social and human capital formation in a way that increases the likelihood of later criminal behavior. This article uses the incarceration tendency of randomly assigned judges as an instrumental variable to estimate causal effects of juvenile incarceration on high school completion and adult recidivism. Estimates based on over 35,000 juvenile offenders over a 10-year period from a large urban county in the United States suggest that juvenile incarceration results in substantially lower high school completion rates and higher adult incarceration rates, including for violent crimes. In an attempt to understand the large effects, we found that incarceration for this population could be very disruptive, greatly reducing the likelihood of ever returning to school and, for those who do return, significantly increasing the likelihood of being classified as having an emotional or behavioral disorder.

10.1093/qje/qjv003.abstractZh: 在美国，每年有超过13万名青少年被拘留，其中每天有7万名青少年处于拘留状态。然而，关于这种惩罚是否能阻止未来的犯罪行为，或者是否以某种方式中断了社会和人力资本的形成，从而增加日后犯罪行为的可能性，目前知之甚少。本文采用随机分配的法官的监禁倾向作为工具变量，来估计青少年监禁对高中毕业率和成年后再犯率的因果效应。基于美国一个大城市县超过35,000名青少年犯罪者的10年数据，研究结果表明，青少年监禁导致高中毕业率显著降低，而成年后监禁率却有所上升，包括暴力犯罪的监禁率也是如此。为了理解这些巨大影响，我们发现，对这类人群实施监禁可能会带来极大的破坏性影响，大大降低他们重返学校的可能性，而对于那些重返学校的人，则更有可能被归类为具有情绪或行为障碍。

abstract.text: Using a unique data set on students from the first regional schools in colonial Benin, we investigate the effect of education on living standards, occupation, and political participation. Since both school locations and student cohorts were selected with very little information, treatment and control groups are balanced on observables. We can therefore estimate the effect of education by comparing the treated to the untreated living in the same village, as well as those living in villages where no schools were set up. We find a significant positive treatment effect of education for the first generation of students, as well as their descendants: they have higher living standards, are less likely to be farmers, and are more likely to be politically active. We find large village-level externalities—descendants of the uneducated in villages with schools do better than those in control villages. We also find extended family externalities—nephews and nieces directly benefit from their uncle’s education—and show that this represents a “family tax,” as educated uncles transfer resources to the extended family.

10.1093/qje/qjv004.abstractZh: 我们利用关于殖民时期贝宁首批地区学校学生的独特数据集，研究教育对生活水平、职业和政治参与的影响。由于学校地点和学生群体的选择信息非常有限，实验组和对照组在可观测变量上进行了平衡处理。因此，我们可以通过比较接受教育的学生与未接受教育的学生在同一村庄中的生活状况，以及那些没有学校设立的村庄中的学生，来估计教育的效果。我们发现，对于第一代学生及其后代来说，教育具有显著的积极效果：他们的生活水平更高，成为农民的可能性更低，且更有可能参与政治活动。我们还发现，村庄层面的外部性非常明显——在有学校的村庄中，未受教育者的后代比在对照村庄中的后代表现更好。此外，我们还发现了扩展家庭的外部性——侄子侄女直接受益于叔叔的教育，这表明受过教育的叔叔将资源转移给了扩展家庭。

abstract.text: We study the demand response to non-linear price schedules using data on insurance contracts and prescription drug purchases in Medicare Part D. We exploit the kink in individuals' budget set created by the famous "donut hole," where insurance becomes discontinuously much less generous on the margin, to provide descriptive evidence of the drug purchase response to a price increase. We then specify and estimate a simple dynamic model of drug use that allows us to quantify the spending response along the entire non-linear budget set. We use the model for counterfactual analysis of the increase in spending from "filling" the donut hole, as will be required by 2020 under the Affordable Care Act. In our baseline model, which considers spending decisions within a single year, we estimate that "filling" the donut hole will increase annual drug spending by about $150, or about 8 percent. About one-quarter of this spending increase reflects "anticipatory" behavior, coming from beneficiaries whose spending prior to the policy change would leave them short of reaching the donut hole. We also present descriptive evidence of cross-year substitution of spending by individuals who reach the kink, which motivates a simple extension to our baseline model that allows - in a highly stylized way - for individuals to engage in such cross year substitution. Our estimates from this extension suggest that a large share of the $150 drug spending increase could be attributed to cross-year substitution, and the net increase could be as little as $45 per year.

10.1093/qje/qjv005.abstractZh: 我们研究了消费者对非线性价格安排的需求反应，使用了医疗保险D部分中的保险合同和处方药购买数据。我们利用著名的“甜甜圈洞”现象所引发的个人预算设置的转折点，即保险福利在边际上急剧下降，来提供关于药品购买反应对价格上涨的描述性证据。随后，我们构建并估计了一个简单的药品使用动态模型，该模型使我们能够量化整个非线性预算设置下的支出反应。我们使用该模型对“填补甜甜圈洞”所导致的支出增加进行反事实分析，因为根据《平价医疗法案》的要求，到2020年这种情况将会发生。在我们的基线模型中，我们考虑了单一年度内的支出决策，估计“填补甜甜圈洞”将使年度药品支出增加约150美元，或约8%。这一支出增加中约有四分之一是“预期性”行为，这些支出来自那些在政策变更前支出不足、无法达到甜甜圈洞边缘的受益人。我们还提供了关于个人在年度内如何替代支出的描述性证据，这促使我们对基线模型进行简单的扩展，以在高度简化的方式允许个人进行这种跨年度替代。我们的估计表明，这150美元的药品支出增加中，很大一部分可能归因于跨年度替代行为，而净增加可能每年仅为45美元。

abstract.text: This article develops a model of unemployment fluctuations. The model keeps the architecture of the general-disequilibrium model of Barro and Grossman (1971) but takes a matching approach to the labor and product markets instead of a disequilibrium approach. On the product and labor markets, both price and tightness adjust to equalize supply and demand. Since there are two equilibrium variables but only one equilibrium condition on each market, a price mechanism is needed to select an equilibrium. We focus on two polar mechanisms: fixed prices and competitive prices. When prices are fixed, aggregate demand affects unemployment as follows. An increase in aggregate demand leads firms to find more customers. This reduces the idle time of their employees and thus increases their labor demand. This in turn reduces unemployment. We combine the predictions of the model and empirical measures of product market tightness, labor market tightness, output, and employment to assess the sources of labor market fluctuations in the United States. First, we find that product market tightness and labor market tightness fluctuate a lot, which implies that the fixed-price equilibrium describes the data better than the competitive-price equilibrium. Next, we find that labor market tightness and employment are positively correlated, which suggests that the labor market fluctuations are mostly due to labor demand shocks and not to labor supply or mismatch shocks. Last, we find that product market tightness and output are positively correlated, which suggests that the labor demand shocks mostly reflect aggregate demand shocks and not technology shocks.

10.1093/qje/qjv006.abstractZh: 本文提出了一个失业波动的模型。该模型保留了Barro和Grossman（1971年）提出的非均衡模型的结构，但采用匹配方法来处理劳动市场和产品市场，而非非均衡方法。在产品市场和劳动市场，价格和紧密度都会进行调整以平衡供需。由于每个市场都有两个均衡变量，但只有一个均衡条件，因此需要一种价格机制来选择均衡状态。我们重点关注两种极端的机制：固定价格和竞争价格。当价格固定时，总需求会影响失业情况。总需求的增加促使企业寻找更多的客户，这减少了员工的闲置时间，从而增加了劳动力需求，进而降低失业率。我们结合模型的预测以及产品市场紧密度、劳动力市场紧密度、产出和就业方面的实证数据，来评估美国劳动力市场波动的原因。首先，我们发现产品市场紧密度和劳动力市场紧密度波动较大，这表明固定价格均衡比竞争价格均衡更能描述实际情况。其次，我们发现劳动力市场紧密度和就业之间存在正相关关系，这表明劳动力市场波动主要是由劳动力需求冲击引起的，而非劳动力供给或不匹配的冲击。最后，我们发现产品市场紧密度和产出之间存在正相关关系，这表明劳动力需求冲击主要反映了总需求冲击，而非技术冲击。

abstract.text: The theory of comparative advantage is at the core of neoclassical trade theory. Yet we know little about its implications for how nations should conduct their trade policy. For example, should import sectors with weaker comparative advantage be protected more? Conversely, should export sectors with stronger comparative advantage be subsidized less? In this article we take a first stab at exploring these issues. Our main results imply that in the context of a canonical Ricardian model, optimal import tariffs should be uniform, whereas optimal export subsidies should be weakly decreasing with respect to comparative advantage, reflecting the fact that countries have more room to manipulate prices in their comparative-advantage sectors. Quantitative exercises suggest substantial gains from such policies relative to simpler tax schedules.

10.1093/qje/qjv007.abstractZh: 比较优势理论是新古典贸易理论的核心。然而，我们对这一理论对各国贸易政策的影响知之甚少。例如，是否应该对比较优势较弱的进口部门给予更多保护？相反，是否应该减少对比较优势较强的出口部门的补贴？在本文中，我们首次尝试探讨这些问题。我们的主要结果表明，在典型的李嘉图模型框架下，最优进口关税应该是统一的，而最优出口补贴则应该随着比较优势的减弱而减少，这反映了各国在比较优势较强的部门中有更大的空间来操纵价格。定量分析表明，与更简单的税收制度相比，这种政策能够带来显著的好处。

abstract.text: We develop a model of policy experimentation in federal systems in which heterogeneous districts choose both whether to experiment and the policies to experiment with. The prospect of informational spillovers implies that in the first best the districts converge in their policy choice. Strikingly, when authority is decentralized, the equilibrium predicts the opposite. The districts use their policy choice to discourage other districts from free-riding on them, thereby inefficiently minimizing informational spillovers. To address this failure, we introduce a dynamic form of federalism in which the central government harmonizes policy choices only after the districts have experimented. This progressive concentration of power induces a policy tournament that can increase the incentive to experiment and encourage policy convergence. We compare outcomes under the different systems and derive the optimal levels of district heterogeneity.

10.1093/qje/qjv008.abstractZh: 我们开发了一个关于联邦体系中政策实验的模型，其中不同地区的决策者同时决定是否进行实验以及实验的具体政策。信息溢出效应的存在意味着在最优情况下，各地区的政策选择会趋于一致。然而，当权力分散时，均衡结果却相反。各地区通过选择政策来阻止其他地区利用它们的政策，从而低效地减少了信息溢出效应。为了解决这一问题，我们引入了一种动态形式的联邦制，即中央政府仅在各地区进行实验后才会协调政策选择。这种渐进式的权力集中可以激发实验的积极性，并促进政策趋同。我们比较了不同体系下的结果，并推导出各地区异质性的最优水平。

abstract.text: Using personnel data from nine large firms in three industries (call centers, trucking, and high-tech), we empirically assess the benefit to firms of hiring through employee referrals. Compared to nonreferred applicants, referred applicants are more likely to be hired and more likely to accept offers, even though referrals and nonreferrals have similar skill characteristics. Referred workers tend to have similar productivity compared to nonreferred workers on most measures, but referred workers have lower accident rates in trucking and produce more patents in high-tech. Referred workers are substantially less likely to quit and earn slightly higher wages than nonreferred workers. In call centers and trucking, the two industries for which we can calculate worker-level profits, referred workers yield substantially higher profits per worker than nonreferred workers. These profit differences are driven by lower turnover and lower recruiting costs for referrals.

10.1093/qje/qjv010.abstractZh: 我们基于三家行业（呼叫中心、卡车运输和高科技）的九家大型企业的人员数据，实证评估了通过员工推荐来招聘对企业带来的好处。与非推荐申请者相比，推荐申请者更有可能被录用，并且更有可能接受录用通知，尽管推荐申请者和非推荐申请者在技能特征上并无差异。在大多数指标上，推荐申请者与非推荐申请者具有相似的生产力水平，但在卡车运输行业中，推荐申请者的事故率较低，在高科技领域则创造了更多的专利。推荐申请者离职的可能性显著降低，且工资水平略高于非推荐申请者。在呼叫中心和卡车运输这两个我们能够计算工人层面利润的行业，推荐申请者每工人的利润显著高于非推荐申请者。这些利润差异主要源于推荐方式的员工流动率较低以及招聘成本较低。

abstract.text: We study legislators who have a present bias for spending: they want to increase current spending and procrastinate spending cuts. We show that disagreement in legislatures can lead to policy persistence that attenuates the temptation to overspend. Depending on the environment, legislators’ decisions to be fiscally responsible may either complement or substitute other legislators’ decisions. When legislators have low discount factors, their actions are strategic complements. Thus, changes of the political environment that induce fiscal responsibility are desirable as they generate a positive responsibility multiplier and reduce spending. However, when the discount factor is high, the same changes induce some legislators to free ride on others’ responsibility which may lead to higher spending.

10.1093/qje/qjv011.abstractZh: 我们研究了具有当前偏好的支出决策者的行为：他们希望增加当前支出，并推迟削减支出。我们发现，立法机构内部的不同意见可能导致政策的持续性，从而减弱过度支出的诱惑。根据环境的不同，立法者选择承担财政责任的行为可能会补充或替代其他立法者的决策。当立法者的折现率较低时，他们的行为属于战略性的补充。因此，促使立法者承担财政责任的政治环境变化是值得欢迎的，因为这些变化能够产生积极的责任乘数效应，并减少支出。然而，当折现率较高时，同样的改变可能会促使一些立法者依赖其他立法者的责任来减轻自己的负担，这可能导致更高的支出。

abstract.text: Preventives are sold ex ante, before disease status is realized, while treatments are sold ex post. Even if the mean of the ex ante distribution of consumer values is the same as that ex post, the shape of the distributions may differ, generating a difference between the surplus each product can extract. If, for example, consumers differ only in ex ante disease risk, then a monopolist would have more difficulty extracting surplus with a preventive than with a treatment because treatment consumers, having contracted the disease, no longer differ in disease risk. We show that the ratio of preventive to treatment producer surplus can be arbitrarily small, in particular when the distribution of consumer values has a Zipf shape and the disease is rare. The firm’s bias toward treatments can be reversed, for example, if the source of private information is disease severity learned ex post. The difference between the producer surplus earned from the products can result in distorted R&D incentives; the deadweight loss from this distortion can be as large as the entire producer-surplus difference. Calibrations for HIV and heart attacks based on risk factors in the U.S. population suggest that the distribution of disease risk is sufficiently Zipf-similar to generate substantial differences between producer surplus from preventives and treatments. Empirically, we find that proxies for the Zipf-similarity of the disease-risk distribution are associated a significantly lower likelihood of vaccine development but not drug development.

10.1093/qje/qjv012.abstractZh: 预防措施是在疾病状况出现之前就进行销售的，而治疗措施则是在疾病发生后才进行销售的。即使消费者在预防措施和治疗措施上的价值分布的平均值相同，分布的形状仍可能有所不同，从而导致每种产品所能获取的剩余收益存在差异。例如，如果消费者仅在预防措施和治疗措施的风险上存在差异，那么垄断者通过预防措施获取剩余收益的难度将大于通过治疗措施，因为已经患病的患者在疾病风险上不再存在差异。我们指出，预防措施与治疗方法之间的生产者剩余比率可以非常小，尤其是在消费者价值分布具有Zipf形状且疾病较为罕见的情况下。如果私人信息的来源是事后得知的疾病严重程度，那么企业倾向于治疗措施的偏差可以被逆转。由此产生的生产者剩余差异可能导致研发激励的扭曲，而这种扭曲造成的无谓损失可能与生产者剩余差异本身一样大。基于美国人口中的风险因素对HIV和心脏病发作的校准表明，疾病风险分布与Zipf分布足够相似，足以使预防措施和治疗措施的生产者剩余产生显著差异。从经验上看，我们发现，疾病风险分布的Zipf相似性越低，疫苗开发的可能性就越低，而药物开发的可能性则不会降低。

abstract.text: We present experimental evidence on the impact of a school choice program in the Indian state of Andhra Pradesh that provided students with a voucher to finance attending a private school of their choice. The study design featured a unique two-stage lottery-based allocation of vouchers that created both student-level and market-level experiments, which allows us to study the individual and the aggregate effects of school choice (including spillovers). After two and four years of the program, we find no difference between test scores of lottery winners and losers on Telugu (native language), math, English, and science/social studies, suggesting that the large cross-sectional differences in test scores across public and private schools mostly reflect omitted variables. However, private schools also teach Hindi, which is not taught by the public schools, and lottery winners have much higher test scores in Hindi. Furthermore, the mean cost per student in the private schools in our sample was less than a third of the cost in public schools. Thus, private schools in this setting deliver slightly better test score gains than their public counterparts (better on Hindi and same in other subjects), and do so at a substantially lower cost per student. Finally, we find no evidence of spillovers on public school students who do not apply for the voucher, or on private school students, suggesting that the positive effects on voucher winners did not come at the expense of other students.

10.1093/qje/qjv013.abstractZh: 我们提供了关于印度安得拉邦一项学校选择计划的实验证据。该计划向学生提供代金券，用于资助他们选择私立学校就读。研究设计采用了独特的双阶段抽签分配代金券的方式，从而实现了学生层面和市场层面的实验，使我们能够研究学校选择的个体效应和整体效应（包括溢出效应）。在计划实施两年和四年之后，我们发现抽签获胜者和失败者在泰卢固语（母语）、数学、英语以及科学/社会研究方面的测试成绩没有差异，这表明公立学校和私立学校之间在测试成绩上的巨大差异主要反映了被忽略的变量。然而，私立学校也教授印地语，而公立学校不教授这一科目，因此抽签获胜者在印地语方面的测试成绩要高出许多。此外，我们样本中的私立学校每名学生的平均成本不到公立学校成本的三分之一。因此，在这种环境下，私立学校在测试成绩上的提升略优于公立学校（在印地语方面表现更好，在其他科目方面则相当），并且每名学生的成本也明显更低。最后，我们没有发现对未申请代金券的公立学校学生或私立学校学生产生溢出效应的证据，这表明对抽签获胜者的积极影响并没有以牺牲其他学生为代价。

abstract.text: In developing countries, the extent to which women possess property rights is shaped in large part by transfers received at the time of marriage. Focusing on dowry, we develop a simple model of the marriage market with intrahousehold bargaining to understand the incentives for brides’ parents to allocate the rights over the dowry between their daughter and her groom. In doing so, we clarify and formalize the “dual role” of dowry—as a premortem bequest and as a market clearing price—identified in the literature. We use the model to shed light on the intriguing observation that in contrast to other rights, women’s rights over the dowry tend to deteriorate with development. We show how marriage payments are utilized even when they are inefficient, and how the marriage market mitigates changes in other dimensions of women’s rights even to the point where women are worse off following a strengthening of such rights. We also generate predictions for when marital transfers will disappear and highlight the importance of female human capital for the welfare of women.

10.1093/qje/qjv014.abstractZh: 在发展中国家，女性拥有财产权的程度在很大程度上受到婚姻时获得的财产转移的影响。我们重点关注嫁妆这一因素，构建了一个简单的婚姻市场模型，并考虑家庭内部的讨价还价行为，以理解新娘父母在女儿与新郎之间分配嫁妆权利的动机。通过这一模型，我们明确了嫁妆的“双重角色”——既是一种婚前遗产，又是一种市场清算价格。该模型还揭示了另一个有趣的现象：与其他财产权相比，女性对嫁妆的掌控权往往随着经济的发展而下降。我们展示了即使嫁妆的分配效率低下，婚姻支付仍然会被利用；同时，婚姻市场能够缓解女性其他权利方面的变化，甚至在某些情况下，女性在这些权利得到加强后反而处境更糟。此外，我们还对婚姻财产转移何时会消失进行了预测，并强调了女性人力资本对女性福利的重要性。

abstract.text: “Site selection bias” can occur when the probability that a program is adopted or evaluated is correlated with its impacts. I test for site selection bias in the context of the Opower energy conservation programs, using 111 randomized control trials involving 8.6 million households across the United States. Predictions based on rich microdata from the first 10 replications substantially overstate efficacy in the next 101 sites. Several mechanisms caused this positive selection. For example, utilities in more environmentalist areas are more likely to adopt the program, and their customers are more responsive to the treatment. Also, because utilities initially target treatment at higher-usage consumer subpopulations, efficacy drops as the program is later expanded. The results illustrate how program evaluations can still give systematically biased out-of-sample predictions, even after many replications.

10.1093/qje/qjv015.abstractZh: “选址偏差”可能发生在某个项目被采纳或评估的概率与其影响之间存在关联的情况下。我在Opower节能项目的背景下进行了选址偏差的测试，使用了涉及美国860万户家庭的111项随机对照试验。基于前10次重复试验获得的丰富微观数据，预测结果显示在接下来的101个地点，项目的有效性被严重高估了。造成这种正面选择效应的机制有多种。例如，在更注重环保的地区，公用事业公司更有可能采纳该项目，而他们的客户对项目的响应也更为积极。此外，由于公用事业公司最初将重点放在使用量较高的消费者群体上，随着项目范围的扩大，项目的有效性会下降。这些结果表明，即使经过多次重复试验，项目评估仍然可能给出系统性偏差的抽样外预测。

abstract.text: We provide a theory of the determination of exchange rates based on capital flows in imperfect financial markets. Capital flows drive exchange rates by altering the balance sheets of financiers that bear the risks resulting from international imbalances in the demand for financial assets. Such alterations to their balance sheets cause financiers to change their required compensation for holding currency risk, thus affecting both the level and volatility of exchange rates. Our theory of exchange rate determination in imperfect financial markets not only helps rationalize the empirical disconnect between exchange rates and traditional macroeconomic fundamentals, it also has real consequences for output and risk sharing. Exchange rates are sensitive to imbalances in financial markets and seldom perform the shock absorption role that is central to traditional theoretical macroeconomic analysis. Our framework is flexible; it accommodates a number of important modeling features within an imperfect financial market model, such as nontradables, production, money, sticky prices or wages, various forms of international pricing-to-market, and unemployment.

10.1093/qje/qjv016.abstractZh: 我们提出了一种基于资本流动在不完善金融市场中确定汇率的理论。资本流动通过改变承担国际金融资产需求失衡所带来的风险的金融家的资产负债表，从而驱动汇率变动。这种对资产负债表的影响使得金融家需要改变持有货币风险所需的补偿方式，进而影响到汇率的水平与波动性。我们关于不完善金融市场中汇率确定的理论不仅有助于解释汇率与传统宏观经济基本面之间的实证差异，还对产出和风险分担产生了实际影响。汇率对金融市场的失衡非常敏感，很少能发挥传统理论宏观经济分析中所强调的减震作用。我们的框架具有灵活性，能够在不完善金融市场模型中容纳许多重要的建模要素，例如非贸易品、生产、货币、价格或工资的粘性、各种形式的国际定价机制以及失业问题。

abstract.text: A large share of dollar-denominated lending is done by non-U.S. banks, particularly European banks. We present a model in which such banks cut dollar lending more than euro lending in response to a shock to their credit quality. Because these banks rely on wholesale dollar funding, while raising more of their euro funding through insured retail deposits, the shock leads to a greater withdrawal of dollar funding. Banks can borrow in euros and swap into dollars to make up for the dollar shortfall, but this may lead to violations of covered interest parity when there is limited capital to take the other side of the swap trade. In this case, synthetic dollar borrowing also becomes expensive, which causes cuts in dollar lending. We test the model in the context of the Eurozone sovereign crisis, which escalated in the second half of 2011 and resulted in U.S. money market funds sharply reducing their exposure to European banks in the year that followed. During this period dollar lending by Eurozone banks fell relative to their euro lending, and firms who were more reliant on Eurozone banks before the Eurozone crisis had a more difficult time borrowing.

10.1093/qje/qjv017.abstractZh: 大部分以美元计价的贷款是由非美国银行提供的，尤其是欧洲银行。我们提出了一个模型，该模型表明，在信用质量受到冲击时，这些银行会减少美元贷款，而非欧元贷款。由于这些银行依赖批发美元融资，同时通过有保险的零售存款获得更多的欧元融资，因此冲击会导致美元融资的更大减少。银行可以借入欧元并兑换成美元来弥补美元资金的不足，但这可能会导致在资本有限的情况下违反覆盖利息平价。在这种情况下，合成美元借款也会变得昂贵，从而导致美元贷款的减少。我们在欧元区主权危机的背景下测试了这个模型，该危机在2011年下半年加剧，导致美国货币市场基金在随后的一年里大幅减少了对欧洲银行的依赖。在此期间，欧元区银行的美元贷款相对于欧元贷款有所减少，而那些在欧元区危机之前更依赖欧洲银行的公司则更难借款。

abstract.text: Suppose an intermediary provides a benefit to buyers when they purchase from sellers using the intermediary’s technology. We develop a model to show that the intermediary would want to restrict sellers from charging buyers more for transactions it intermediates. With this restriction an intermediary can profitably raise demand for its services by eliminating any extra price buyers face for purchasing through the intermediary. We show that this leads to inflated retail prices, excessive adoption of the intermediaries’ services, over-investment in benefits to buyers, and a reduction in consumer surplus and sometimes welfare. Competition among intermediaries intensifies these problems by increasing the magnitude of their effects and broadening the circumstances in which they arise. We discuss applications to payment card systems, travel reservation systems, rebate services, and various other intermediaries.

10.1093/qje/qjv018.abstractZh: 假设一个中介机构在买家通过中介的技术与卖家进行交易时，为买家提供某种利益。我们建立了一个模型，表明中介机构会希望限制卖家在中介交易中向买家收取更高的费用。通过这种限制，中介机构可以通过消除买家通过中介购买商品时面临的额外价格，从而盈利性地增加其服务的需求。我们发现，这会导致零售价格虚高、中介机构服务过度采用、对买家利益的过度投资，以及消费者剩余和福利的减少。中介机构之间的竞争会加剧这些问题，因为它们的影响范围更广，出现问题的情境也更多。我们讨论了这一模型在支付卡系统、旅游预订系统、返利服务以及各种其他中介机构中的应用。

abstract.text: The English Parliament’s struggle for supremacy against monarchical dictatorship during the Civil War (1642–1648) was crucial for the establishment of representative government, yet its lessons continue to be debated. I exploit novel data on individual MPs drawn from 1,842 biographies to show that the conflict was over overseas interests and other factors over which the executive enjoyed broad constitutional discretion, rather than over domestic property rights. I further exploit the coincidence of individual MPs’ ability to sign legally binding share contracts with novel share offerings by overseas companies to measure the effect of overseas share investment on their political attitudes. I show that overseas shareholding pushed moderates lacking prior mercantile interests to support reform. I interpret the effect of financial assetholding as allowing new investors to exploit emerging economic opportunities overseas, aligning their interests with traders. By consolidating a broad parliamentary majority that favored reform, the introduction of financial assets also broadened support for the institutionalization of parliamentary supremacy over dictatorial rule.

10.1093/qje/qjv019.abstractZh: 英国议会在内战期间（1642–1648年）为争夺至高无上的权力而进行的斗争，对于建立代议制政府至关重要。然而，这一斗争的教训至今仍备受争议。我利用来自1,842份传记中的新数据，发现这场冲突实际上是关于海外利益及其他因素的，而行政部门在这些问题上享有广泛的宪法自由裁量权，而非关于国内财产权的问题。此外，我还利用个别议员能够签署具有法律约束力的股份合同这一事实，来衡量海外股份投资对其政治态度的影响。结果表明，海外股份持有促使那些没有商业利益的温和派人士支持改革。我将持有金融资产的效应解释为让新投资者能够利用海外新兴的经济机会，从而使其利益与商人保持一致。通过巩固支持改革的议会多数派，金融资产的引入也扩大了人们对议会至高无上权相对于独裁统治的支持。

abstract.text: Experimental tests of dynamically inconsistent time preferences have largely relied on choices over time-dated monetary rewards. Several recent studies have failed to find the standard patterns of present bias. However, such monetary studies contain often-discussed confounds. In this article, we sidestep these confounds and investigate choices over consumption (real effort) in a longitudinal experiment. We pair this effort study with a companion monetary discounting study. We confirm very limited time inconsistency in monetary choices. However, subjects show considerably more present bias in effort. Furthermore, present bias in the allocation of work has predictive power for demand of a meaningfully binding commitment device. Therefore our findings validate a key implication of models of dynamic inconsistency, with corresponding policy implications.

10.1093/qje/qjv020.abstractZh: 关于动态不一致时间偏好的实验研究，大多依赖于对时间定时的货币奖励的选择。然而，一些近期的研究未能发现典型的当前偏好模式。不过，这类货币相关研究往往存在混淆因素。在本文中，我们避开了这些混淆因素，通过一项纵向实验来研究消费选择（实际努力）。我们将这项努力研究与相关的货币贴现研究相结合。我们发现，在货币选择方面，时间不一致性非常有限。然而，受试者在努力方面表现出更为明显的当前偏好。此外，工作分配中的当前偏好对于需求具有预测作用，这表明需要一种具有实际约束力的承诺机制。因此，我们的研究结果验证了动态不一致性模型的一个关键推论，并带来了相应的政策启示。

abstract.text: When effort is observable to peers, students may try to avoid social penalties by conforming to prevailing norms. To test this hypothesis, we first consider a natural experiment that introduced a performance leaderboard into computer-based high school courses. The result was a 24 percent performance decline. The decline appears to be driven by a desire to avoid the leaderboard; top performing students prior to the change, those most at risk of appearing on the leaderboard, had a 40 percent performance decline, while poor performing students improved slightly. We next consider a field experiment that offered students complimentary access to an online SAT preparatory course. Sign-up forms differed randomly across students only in whether they said the decision would be kept private from classmates. In nonhonors classes, sign-up was 11 percentage points lower when decisions were public rather than private. Honors class sign-up was unaffected. For students taking honors and nonhonors classes, the response depended on which peers they were with at the time of the offer, and thus to whom their decision would be revealed. When offered the course in a nonhonors class (where peer sign-up rates are low), they were 15 percentage points less likely to sign up if the decision was public. But when offered the course in an honors class (where peer sign-up rates are high), they were 8 percentage points more likely to sign up if the decision was public. Thus, students are highly responsive to their peers are the prevailing norm when they make decisions.

10.1093/qje/qjv021.abstractZh: 当努力可以被同伴观察到时，学生可能会通过遵循普遍接受的规范来避免社会惩罚。为了验证这一假设，我们首先进行了一项自然实验，在基于计算机的高中课程中引入了一个成绩排行榜。结果显示，学生的成绩下降了24%。这种下降似乎是由于避免上榜的意愿所驱动的；在变化之前表现最好的学生，那些最有可能出现在排行榜上的学生，他们的成绩下降了40%，而表现较差的学生则有所改善。接下来，我们进行了一次实地实验，向学生提供免费的在线SAT备考课程。报名表格在是否将决定保密给同学这一方面有所不同。在非荣誉课程中，当决定公开而非保密时，报名率降低了11个百分点。而荣誉课程的报名率则没有受到影响。对于参加荣誉课程和非荣誉课程的学生来说，他们的反应取决于他们在接受课程邀请时的同伴情况，也就是他们的决定会透露给谁。当在非荣誉课程中提供该课程时（此时同伴的报名率较低），如果决定公开，他们报名的可能性会降低15个百分点。而当在荣誉课程中提供该课程时（此时同伴的报名率较高），如果决定公开，他们报名的可能性则会增加8个百分点。因此，学生在做出决定时，非常容易受到同伴普遍接受的标准的影响。

abstract.text: We study fiscal and monetary policy in a monetary union with the potential for rollover crises in sovereign debt markets. Member-country fiscal authorities lack commitment to repay their debt and choose fiscal policy independently. A common monetary authority chooses inflation for the union, also without commitment. We first describe the existence of a fiscal externality that arises in the presence of limited commitment and leads countries to overborrow; this externality rationalizes the imposition of debt ceilings in a monetary union. We then investigate the impact of the composition of debt in a monetary union, that is the fraction of high-debt versus low-debt members, on the occurrence of self-fulfilling debt crises. We demonstrate that a high-debt country may be less vulnerable to crises and have higher welfare when it belongs to a union with an intermediate mix of high- and low-debt members, than one where all other members are low-debt. This contrasts with the conventional wisdom that all countries should prefer a union with low-debt members, as such a union can credibly deliver low inflation. These findings shed new light on the criteria for an optimal currency area in the presence of rollover crises.

10.1093/qje/qjv022.abstractZh: 我们研究了在存在主权债务市场滚动危机风险的货币联盟中的财政和货币政策。成员国财政当局缺乏偿还债务的承诺，因此会独立选择财政政策。共同的货币当局则负责为联盟制定通货膨胀目标，同样没有偿还承诺。我们首先描述了在有限承诺的情况下出现的财政外部性，这种外部性导致各国过度借贷；这种外部性解释了在货币联盟中实施债务上限的合理性。接着，我们研究了货币联盟中债务构成对自我实现债务危机发生的影响，即高债务成员与低债务成员的比例。我们发现，当高债务国家属于一个高债务与低债务成员比例适中的联盟时，其面临危机的风险较低，福利也更高。这与传统观点相反，传统观点认为所有国家都应倾向于拥有低债务成员的联盟，因为这样的联盟能够可信地实现低通货膨胀。这些发现为在滚动危机存在的情况下确定最优货币区域的标准提供了新的视角。

abstract.text: Twenty-five large field experiments with major U.S. retailers and brokerages, most reaching millions of customers and collectively representing $2.8 million in digital advertising expenditure, reveal that measuring the returns to advertising is difficult. The median confidence interval on return on investment is over 100 percentage points wide. Detailed sales data show that relative to the per capita cost of the advertising, individual-level sales are very volatile; a coefficient of variation of 10 is common. Hence, informative advertising experiments can easily require more than 10 million person-weeks, making experiments costly and potentially infeasible for many firms. Despite these unfavorable economics, randomized control trials represent progress by injecting new, unbiased information into the market. The inference challenges revealed in the field experiments also show that selection bias, due to the targeted nature of advertising, is a crippling concern for widely employed observational methods.

10.1093/qje/qjv023.abstractZh: 针对美国25家大型零售商和经纪公司的大规模实地实验表明，衡量广告效果的难度很大。投资回报的中值置信区间超过100个百分点。详细的销售数据显示，与人均广告成本相比，个体层面的销售额波动极大，变异系数通常达到10。因此，信息丰富的广告实验可能需要超过1000万个人工作周的时间，这使得实验成本高昂，对许多公司来说可能难以实施。尽管存在这些不利的经济因素，随机对照试验仍然代表了向市场注入新信息的进步。实地实验揭示的推理挑战也表明，由于广告的针对性特点，选择偏差是广泛使用的观察方法面临的一个严重问题。

abstract.text: We estimate the effect of information and expertise on consumers’ willingness to pay for national brands in physically homogeneous product categories. In a detailed case study of headache remedies, we find that more informed or expert consumers are less likely to pay extra to buy national brands, with pharmacists choosing them over store brands only 9 percent of the time, compared to 26 percent of the time for the average consumer. In a similar case study of pantry staples such as salt and sugar, we show that chefs devote 12 percentage points less of their purchases to national brands than demographically similar nonchefs. We extend our analysis to cover 50 retail health categories and 241 food and drink categories. The results suggest that misinformation and related consumer mistakes explain a sizable share of the brand premium for health products, and a much smaller share for most food and drink products. We tie our estimates together using a stylized model of demand and pricing.

10.1093/qje/qjv024.abstractZh: 我们研究了信息和专业知识对消费者购买国产品牌意愿的影响，这些产品属于物理上同质的产品类别。在对头痛治疗产品的详细案例研究中，我们发现，信息更丰富或具有专业知识的消费者不太愿意额外支付费用来购买国产品牌，只有9%的情况下，消费者会选择国产品牌，而普通消费者这一比例高达26%。在另一项关于盐、糖等日常用品的案例研究中，我们发现，厨师在购买这些产品时，选择国产品牌的比例比类似人口统计特征的普通消费者低12个百分点。我们将分析范围扩展到50个零售健康产品和241个食品饮料产品类别。研究结果表明，错误信息及相关消费误区解释了健康产品品牌溢价的大部分原因，而大多数食品饮料产品的品牌溢价则较少受到这些因素的影响。我们通过一个简化的需求与定价模型来整合我们的研究结果。

abstract.text: While human capital is a strong predictor of economic development today, its importance for the Industrial Revolution has typically been assessed as minor. To resolve this puzzling contrast, we differentiate average human capital (literacy) from upper-tail knowledge. As a proxy for the historical presence of knowledge elites, we use city-level subscriptions to the famous Encyclopédie in mid-18th century France. We show that subscriber density is a strong predictor of city growth after the onset of French industrialization. Alternative measures of development such as soldier height, disposable income, and industrial activity confirm this pattern. Initial literacy levels, on the other hand, are associated with development in the cross-section, but they do not predict growth. Finally, by joining data on British patents with a large French firm survey from the 1840s, we shed light on the mechanism: upper-tail knowledge raised productivity in innovative industrial technology.

10.1093/qje/qjv025.abstractZh: 虽然人力资本是当今经济发展的重要预测因素，但其在工业革命中的重要性通常被认为并不显著。为了解释这一矛盾现象，我们将平均人力资本（即识字率）与高端知识区分开来。作为知识精英历史存在的指标，我们采用了18世纪中叶法国城市对《百科全书》的订阅数据。研究表明，订阅密度是法国工业化开始后城市增长的重要预测因素。其他发展指标，如士兵身高、可支配收入以及工业活动，也证实了这一规律。然而，初始识字水平虽然与截面数据中的发展相关，但并不能预测城市的增长。最后，通过将英国专利数据与19世纪40年代法国大型企业的调查数据相结合，我们揭示了这一机制：高端知识提升了创新工业技术的生产力。

abstract.text: I replicate and extend the seminal work of Camerer et al. (“Labor Supply of New York City Cabdrivers: One Day at a Time,” Quarterly Journal of Economics, 112 [1997], 407–441), who find that the wage elasticity of daily hours of work for New York City taxi drivers is negative and conclude that their labor supply behavior is consistent with reference dependence. In contrast, my analysis of the complete record of all trips taken in NYC taxi cabs from 2009 to 2013 shows that drivers tend to respond positively to unanticipated as well as anticipated increases in earnings opportunities. Additionally, using a discrete choice stopping model, the probability of a shift ending is strongly positively related to hours worked but at best weakly related to income earned. I find substantial heterogeneity across drivers in their elasticities, but the estimated elasticities are generally positive and rarely substantially negative. I find that new drivers with smaller elasticities are more likely to exit the industry, whereas drivers who remain quickly learn to be better optimizers (have positive labor supply elasticities that grow with experience). These results are consistent with the neoclassical optimizing model of labor supply and suggest that consideration of gain-loss utility and income reference dependence is not an important factor in the daily labor supply decisions of taxi drivers.

10.1093/qje/qjv026.abstractZh: 我复制并扩展了Camerer等人开创性的研究（“纽约市出租车司机的劳动力供给：日复一日”，《经济学季刊》，112卷[1997年]，407-441页）。他们发现纽约市出租车司机的每日工作小时数对工资的变化呈负弹性，并得出结论认为他们的劳动力供给行为符合参照依赖性的特征。相比之下，我对2009年至2013年间纽约市出租车所有行程的完整记录进行分析后发现，司机对未预料到的以及预期中的收入增长反应积极。此外，通过离散选择停止模型分析，发现工作时间的变动与离职概率呈强烈的正相关关系，但与收入的关系则较为微弱。我发现不同司机在劳动力供给弹性上存在显著差异，但总体弹性均为正值，很少出现显著负值。我还发现，弹性较小的新司机更有可能退出该行业，而那些持续工作的司机则很快学会了如何成为更优的经营者（即劳动力供给弹性随着经验的增加而上升）。这些结果与新古典优化模型中的劳动力供给理论一致，表明在出租车司机的日常劳动力供给决策中，收益-损失效用和收入参照依赖性并非重要因素。

abstract.text: The high-frequency trading arms race is a symptom of flawed market design. Instead of the continuous limit order book market design that is currently predominant, we argue that financial exchanges should use frequent batch auctions: uniform price double auctions conducted, for example, every tenth of a second. That is, time should be treated as discrete instead of continuous, and orders should be processed in a batch auction instead of serially. Our argument has three parts. First, we use millisecond-level direct-feed data from exchanges to document a series of stylized facts about how the continuous market works at high-frequency time horizons: (i) correlations completely break down; which (ii) leads to obvious mechanical arbitrage opportunities; and (iii) competition has not affected the size or frequency of the arbitrage opportunities, it has only raised the bar for how fast one has to be to capture them. Second, we introduce a simple theory model which is motivated by and helps explain the empirical facts. The key insight is that obvious mechanical arbitrage opportunities, like those observed in the data, are built into the market design—continuous-time serial-processing implies that even symmetrically observed public information creates arbitrage rents. These rents harm liquidity provision and induce a never-ending socially wasteful arms race for speed. Last, we show that frequent batch auctions directly address the flaws of the continuous limit order book. Discrete time reduces the value of tiny speed advantages, and the auction transforms competition on speed into competition on price. Consequently, frequent batch auctions eliminate the mechanical arbitrage rents, enhance liquidity for investors, and stop the high-frequency trading arms race.

10.1093/qje/qjv027.abstractZh: 高频交易竞赛是市场设计缺陷的一个表现。我们认为，金融交易所应采用频繁批量拍卖机制，例如每十分之一秒进行一次统一价格双拍卖。也就是说，时间应被视为离散的，而非连续的，订单应以批量拍卖的方式处理，而非串行处理。我们的论点分为三个部分。首先，我们利用交易所提供的毫秒级直接数据，记录了一系列关于高频市场运作的实证事实：(i)相关性完全消失；(ii)这导致了明显的机械性套利机会；(iii)竞争并未影响套利机会的大小或频率，只是提高了捕捉这些机会的速度要求。其次，我们提出了一个简单的理论模型，以解释这些实证事实。关键观点是，像数据中观察到的那样，明显的机械性套利机会是市场设计的一部分——连续时间的串行处理意味着，即使是对称性的公开信息也能产生套利收益。这些收益会损害流动性供应，并引发无止境的、浪费资源的速度竞赛。最后，我们表明频繁批量拍卖直接解决了连续限价单簿的缺陷。离散时间降低了微小速度优势的价值，拍卖将速度竞争转化为价格竞争。因此，频繁批量拍卖消除了机械性套利收益，提升了投资者的流动性，并终止了高频交易竞赛。

abstract.text: Does adoption of broadband internet in firms enhance labor productivity and increase wages? Is this technological change skill biased or factor neutral? We combine several Norwegian data sets to answer these questions. A public program with limited funding rolled out broadband access points and provides plausibly exogenous variation in the availability and adoption of broadband internet in firms. Our results suggest that broadband internet improves (worsens) the labor market outcomes and productivity of skilled (unskilled) workers. We explore several possible explanations for the skill complementarity of broadband internet. We find suggestive evidence that broadband adoption in firms complements skilled workers in executing nonroutine abstract tasks, and substitutes for unskilled workers in performing routine tasks. Taken together, our findings have important implications for the ongoing policy debate over government investment in broadband infrastructure to encourage productivity and wage growth.

10.1093/qje/qjv028.abstractZh: 企业采用宽带互联网是否能够提高劳动生产率并增加工资？这种技术变革是技能偏向性的还是因素中性的？我们结合了几组挪威的数据来回答这些问题。一项资金有限的公共计划推出了宽带接入点，从而提供了宽带互联网在企业中可用性和采用情况的合理外生变化。我们的研究结果表明，宽带互联网改善了（恶化了）熟练与非熟练工人的劳动力市场结果和生产力。我们探讨了宽带互联网在技能互补性方面的几种可能解释。我们发现有证据表明，企业采用宽带互联网可以补充熟练工人执行非例行抽象任务的能力，并替代非熟练工人执行例行任务。总的来说，我们的发现对关于政府投资宽带基础设施以促进生产力和工资增长的持续政策讨论具有重要意义。

abstract.text: A fundamental implication of standard moral hazard models is overuse of low-value medical care because copays are lower than costs. In these models, the demand curve alone can be used to make welfare statements, a fact relied on by much empirical work. There is ample evidence, though, that people misuse care for a different reason: mistakes, or "behavioral hazard." Much high-value care is underused even when patient costs are low, and some useless care is bought even when patients face the full cost. In the presence of behavioral hazard, welfare calculations using only the demand curve can be off by orders of magnitude or even be the wrong sign. We derive optimal copay formulas that incorporate both moral and behavioral hazard, providing a theoretical foundation for value-based insurance design and a way to interpret behavioral "nudges." Once behavioral hazard is taken into account, health insurance can do more than just provide financial protection - it can also improve health care efficiency.

10.1093/qje/qjv029.abstractZh: 标准道德风险模型的一个基本问题在于，由于自付费用低于实际成本，低价值的医疗服务被过度使用。在这些模型中，仅使用需求曲线就可以进行福利分析，这一点在许多实证研究中被广泛采用。然而，有大量证据表明，人们滥用医疗服务的原因并非出于经济考虑，而是由于失误或“行为风险”。即使患者的医疗费用较低，许多高价值的医疗服务仍被闲置；而一些无用的医疗服务则会被购买，即使患者面临全部成本。在存在行为风险的情况下，仅使用需求曲线进行的福利计算可能会出现巨大的误差，甚至会导致错误的分析结果。我们提出了一种最优自付费用公式，该公式同时考虑了道德风险和行为风险，为基于价值的保险设计提供了理论基础，并提供了一种解释行为“诱因”的方法。一旦考虑到行为风险，健康保险不仅可以提供财务保护，还可以提高医疗服务的效率。

abstract.text: How do the media affect public support for democratic institutions in a fragile democracy? What role do they play in a dictatorial regime? We study these questions in the context of Germany of the 1920s and 1930s. During the democratic period, when the Weimar government introduced progovernment political news, the growth of Nazi popularity slowed down in areas with access to radio. This effect was reversed during the campaign for the last competitive election as a result of the pro-Nazi radio broadcast following Hitler’s appointment as chancellor. During the consolidation of dictatorship, radio propaganda helped the Nazis enroll new party members. After the Nazis established their rule, radio propaganda incited anti-Semitic acts and denunciations of Jews to authorities by ordinary citizens. The effect of anti-Semitic propaganda varied depending on the listeners’ predispositions toward the message. Nazi radio was most effective in places where anti-Semitism was historically high and had a negative effect in places with historically low anti-Semitism.

10.1093/qje/qjv030.abstractZh: 媒体在脆弱的民主国家中如何影响公众对民主制度的支持？在独裁政权中，媒体扮演了怎样的角色？我们在20世纪20年代和30年代的德国背景下研究这些问题。在民主时期，当魏玛政府推出支持政府的政治新闻时，在能够收听广播的地区，纳粹党的受欢迎程度有所放缓。然而，在最后一次竞争性选举期间，由于希特勒被任命为总理后出现了支持纳粹的广播节目，这一效应发生了逆转。在独裁政权巩固期间，广播宣传帮助纳粹党招募了新的党员。在纳粹党建立统治后，广播宣传煽动普通公民对犹太人的反犹太行为，并向当局举报犹太人。反犹太宣传的效果因听众对信息的态度而异。在历史上反犹太主义较为严重的地区，纳粹广播最为有效；而在历史上反犹太主义较低的地区，这种宣传则产生了负面影响。

abstract.text: This article starts by unveiling a strong empirical regularity: multinational corporations exhibit higher stock market returns and earning yields than nonmultinational firms. Within nonmultinationals, exporters exhibit higher earning yields and returns than firms selling only in their domestic market. To explain this pattern, we develop a real option value model where firms are heterogeneous in productivity and have to decide whether and how to sell in a foreign market where demand is risky. Selling abroad is a source of risk exposure to firms: following a negative shock, they are reluctant to exit the foreign market because they would forgo the sunk cost they paid to enter. Multinational firms are the most exposed because of the higher costs they have to pay to invest. The calibrated model is able to match both aggregate U.S. export and foreign direct investment data, and the observed cross-sectional differences in earning yields and returns.

10.1093/qje/qjv031.abstractZh: 本文首先揭示了一个显著的实证规律：跨国公司在股市中的回报和收益水平高于非跨国企业。在非跨国企业中，出口企业比仅在国内市场销售的企业具有更高的收益和回报。为了解释这一现象，我们开发了一个实物期权价值模型，该模型认为企业在生产率上存在差异，并且必须决定是否以及在何种条件下在需求不确定的国外市场进行销售。在国外市场销售会增加企业的风险敞口：面对负面冲击时，企业往往不愿退出国外市场，因为这将导致他们不得不放弃进入该市场的成本。由于需要支付更高的投资成本，跨国企业面临的风险最大。经过校准的模型能够很好地匹配美国出口和外国直接投资的统计数据，以及观察到的收益和回报的横向差异。

abstract.text: This article studies belief heterogeneity in a benchmark competitive asset market: a market for Arrow–Debreu securities. We show that differences in agents' beliefs lead to a systematic pricing pattern, the favourite–longshot bias (FLB): securities with a low-pay-out probability are overpriced, whereas securities with high probability pay-out are underpriced. We apply demand estimation techniques to betting market data, and find that the observed FLB is explained by a two-type population consisting of canonical traders, who hold virtually correct beliefs and are the majority type in the population (70%); and noise traders exhibiting significant belief dispersion. Furthermore, exploiting variation in public information across markets in our data set, we show that our belief heterogeneity model empirically outperforms existing preference-based explanations of the FLB.

10.1093/restud/rdu017.abstractZh: 本文研究了一个基准竞争资产市场中的信念异质性现象：该市场为Arrow-Debreu证券市场。我们发现，不同投资者信念的差异会导致一种系统性的定价模式，即“偏好-长投偏见”（FLB）：支付概率较低的证券会被高估，而支付概率较高的证券则被低估。我们采用需求估计技术对赌市数据进行分析，发现观察到的FLB现象可以通过两种类型的人群来解释：一种是持有几乎正确信念的典型交易者，他们构成了人群中的大多数（70%）；另一种是表现出显著信念分散的噪声交易者。此外，通过利用数据集中不同市场之间的公共信息差异，我们发现我们的信念异质性模型在实证上优于现有的基于偏好的FLB解释方法。

abstract.text: This article analyses contractual situations between many principals and many agents. The agents have private information, and the principals take actions. Principals have the ability to contract not only on the reports of the agents but also on the contracts offered by other principals. Contracts are required to be representable in a formal language. The main result of the article is a characterization of the allocations that can be implemented as equilibria in our contracting game. We then restrict attention to exclusive-contracting environments, in which the agent may select the contract of at most one principal. In this setting, our characterization result implies that principals can collude to implement the monopolist outcome. Finally, in general, equilibrium contracts turn out to be incomplete. That is, a contract will restrict the action space of a principal but will not necessarily determine a single action.

10.1093/restud/rdu025.abstractZh: 本文分析了多个主体与多个代理人之间的契约关系。代理人拥有私人信息，而主体则采取相应行动。主体不仅可以根据代理人的报告进行契约安排，还可以根据其他主体的提议来签订契约。契约需要能用一种形式化语言来表示。文章的主要成果是对那些可以作为我们契约游戏中的均衡状态的分配方式的描述。随后，我们将注意力集中在独占契约的环境中，在这种环境下，代理人最多只能选择一个主体的契约。在这种情况下，我们的描述结果表明，主体可以合谋以实现垄断结果。最后，一般来说，均衡契约是不完整的。也就是说，契约会限制主体的行动空间，但未必能确定唯一的行动选择。

abstract.text: This paper studies adaptive learning with multiple models. An agent operating in a self-referential environment is aware of potential model misspecification, and tries to detect it, in real-time, using an econometric specification test. If the current model passes the test, it is used to construct an optimal policy. If it fails the test, a new model is selected. As the rate of coefficient updating decreases, one model becomes dominant, and is used “almost always”. Dominant models can be characterized using the tools of large deviations theory. The analysis is used to address two questions posed by Sargent's Phillips Curve model.

10.1093/restud/rdu026.abstractZh: 本文研究了具有多个模型的自适应学习机制。在一个自我参照的环境中运行的智能体能够意识到潜在模型的不准确性，并试图通过经济计量规范测试来实时检测这一情况。如果当前模型通过测试，则将其用于构建最优策略；如果测试未通过，则选择一个新的模型。随着系数更新频率的降低，一个模型将占据主导地位，并几乎“始终”被使用。可以利用大偏差理论的工具来描述这些主导模型。该分析用于解决Sargent的菲利普斯曲线模型所提出的两个问题。

abstract.text: We study patterns of foreign direct investment (FDI) in a multi-country world economy. We develop a model featuring non-homothetic preferences for quality and monopolistic competition in which specialization is purely demand-driven and the decision to serve foreign countries via exports or FDI depends on a proximity-concentration trade-off. We characterize the joint patterns of trade and FDI when countries differ in income distribution and size and show that FDI is more likely to occur between countries with similar per capita income levels. The model predicts a Linder Hypothesis for horizontal FDI, which is consistent with some patterns we find using establishment-level data on multinational activity.

10.1093/restud/rdu027.abstractZh: 我们研究多国世界经济中的外国直接投资（FDI）模式。我们建立了一个模型，该模型考虑了质量和垄断竞争的非同态偏好，其中专业化完全由需求驱动，而通过出口还是直接投资服务外国国家的决策则取决于接近性与集中度的权衡。我们描述了在各国收入分配和规模存在差异时，贸易和外国直接投资的联合模式，并发现外国直接投资更可能发生在人均收入水平相似的国家之间。该模型预测了水平外国直接投资的Linder假设，这与我们使用跨国企业数据发现的一些模式是一致的。

abstract.text: We estimate the elasticity of exports to credit using matched customs and firm-level bank credit data from Peru. To account for non-credit determinants of exports, we compare changes in exports of the same product and to the same destination by firms borrowing from banks differentially affected by capital-flow reversals during the 2008 financial crisis. We find that credit shocks affect the intensive margin of exports, but have no significant impact on entry or exit of firms to new product and destination markets. Our results suggest that credit shortages reduce exports through raising the variable cost of production, rather than the cost of financing sunk entry investments.

10.1093/restud/rdu028.abstractZh: 我们利用秘鲁的匹配海关数据和企业级银行信贷数据，估算了出口对信贷的弹性。为了考虑非信贷因素对出口的影响，我们比较了在2008年金融危机期间，从银行借款的不同企业，同一产品和同一目的地的出口变化。我们发现，信贷冲击影响了出口的集约边际，但对企业进入或退出新的产品和目的地市场没有显著影响。我们的结果表明，信贷短缺通过增加生产可变成本来减少出口，而不是通过增加沉没性进入投资的融资成本来实现。

abstract.text: We conduct a series of laboratory experiments to understand what role commitment and reputation play in bargaining. The experiments implement the Abreu and Gul (2000) bargaining model that demonstrates how introducing behavioral types, which are obstinate in their demands, creates incentives for all players to build reputations for being hard bargainers. The data are qualitatively consistent with the theory, as subjects mimic induced types. Furthermore, we find evidence for the presence of complementary types, whose initial demands acquiesce to induced behavioural demands. However, there are quantitative deviations from the theory: subjects make aggressive demands too often and participate in longer conflicts before reaching agreements. Overall, the results suggest that the Abreu and Gul (2000) model can be used to gain insights to bargaining behavior, particularly in environments where the process underlying obstinate play is well established.

10.1093/restud/rdu029.abstractZh: 我们进行了一系列实验室实验，以了解承诺和声誉在讨价还价中的作用。这些实验采用了Abreu和Gul在2000年提出的讨价还价模型，该模型表明，引入那些在要求上固执的行为类型，会促使所有参与者建立作为强硬讨价还价者的声誉。数据在定性上与理论一致，因为实验对象模仿了诱导出的行为类型。此外，我们发现存在互补类型的行为，其初始要求会顺应诱导出的行为要求。然而，从定量角度来看，实验结果与理论存在偏差：实验对象过于频繁地提出激进的要求，并且在达成协议之前会陷入更长时间的冲突。总体而言，这些结果表明，Abreu和Gul的模型可以用来深入了解讨价还价行为，尤其是在那些固执行为模式已经根深蒂固的环境中。

abstract.text: An important line of research using laboratory experiments has provided a new potential reason for gender imbalances in labour markets: men are more competitively inclined than women. Whether, and to what extent, gender differences in attitudes toward competition lead to differences in naturally occurring labour markets remains an open question. To examine this, we run a natural field experiment on job-entry decisions where we randomize almost 9000 job-seekers into different compensation regimes. By varying the role that individual competition plays in setting the wage and the gender composition, we examine whether a competitive compensation regime, by itself, can cause differential job entry. The data highlight the power of the compensation regime in that women disproportionately shy away from competitive work settings. Yet, there are important factors that attenuate the gender differences, including whether the job is performed in teams, whether the position has overt gender associations, and the age of the job-seekers. We also find that the effect is most pronounced in labour markets with attractive alternative employment options. Furthermore, our results suggest that preferences over uncertainty can be just as important as preferences over competition per se in driving job-entry choices.

10.1093/restud/rdu030.abstractZh: 一项重要的研究利用实验室实验提供了关于劳动力市场性别失衡的新潜在原因：男性比女性更具竞争力。性别在竞争态度上的差异是否以及在多大程度上导致了自然存在的劳动力市场中的差异，仍然是一个未解之谜。为了研究这一点，我们开展了一项关于求职决策的自然实地实验，将近9000名求职者随机分配到不同的薪酬制度中。通过改变个体竞争在设定工资和性别构成中的作用，我们考察了竞争性薪酬制度本身是否会导致不同的求职选择。数据表明，薪酬制度的影响力非常显著，女性明显不愿从事竞争性的工作。然而，有一些重要因素可以减弱这种性别差异，包括工作是否以团队形式进行、职位是否有明显的性别关联，以及求职者的年龄。我们还发现，这种效应在具有吸引力的替代就业选择的市场中最为明显。此外，我们的研究结果表明，对不确定性的偏好可能与对竞争本身的偏好一样重要，它们共同影响着求职决策。

abstract.text: We study the pricing behaviour of a multiproduct firm, when consumers must pay a search cost to learn its prices. Equilibrium prices are high, because consumers understand that visiting a store exposes them to a hold-up problem. However, a firm with more products charges lower prices, because it attracts consumers who are more price sensitive. Similarly, when a firm advertises a low price on one product, consumers rationally expect it to charge somewhat lower prices on its other products as well. We therefore find that having a large product range, and advertising a low price on one product, are substitute ways of building a “low-price image”. Finally, we show that in a competitive setting each product has a high regular price, with firms occasionally giving random discounts that are positively correlated across products.

10.1093/restud/rdu032.abstractZh: 我们研究了多产品企业的定价行为，在这种情况下，消费者必须支付搜索成本来了解企业的价格。由于消费者意识到光顾商店会面临价格操纵的风险，因此均衡价格较高。然而，拥有更多产品的企业会收取较低的价格，因为这类企业能够吸引对价格更为敏感的消费者。同样，当一家企业在一个产品上宣传低价时，消费者会理性地预期它在其他产品上也会收取较低的价格。因此，我们发现，拥有丰富的产品系列并在一个产品上宣传低价，是建立“低价形象”的替代方式。最后，我们表明，在竞争环境中，每种产品的常规价格都较高，但企业偶尔会提供随机折扣，这些折扣在不同产品之间呈正相关。

abstract.text: This article uses detailed barcode data on purchase transactions by households in 49 U.S. cities to calculate the first theoretically founded urban price index. In doing so, we overcome a large number of problems that have plagued spatial price index measurement. We identify two important sources of bias. Heterogeneity bias arises from comparing different goods in different locations, and variety bias arises from not correcting for the fact that some goods are unavailable in some locations. Eliminating heterogeneity bias causes 97% of the variance in the price level of food products across cities to disappear relative to a conventional index. Eliminating both biases reverses the common finding that prices tend to be higher in larger cities. Instead, we find that price level for food products falls with city size.

10.1093/restud/rdu033.abstractZh: 本文利用美国49个城市家庭购买交易的详细条形码数据，计算出了首个理论上的城市价格指数。通过这一方法，我们克服了空间价格指数测量中存在的诸多问题。我们发现了两个主要的偏差来源：异质性偏差源于在不同地点比较不同商品，而多样性偏差则源于没有纠正某些商品在某些地点无法获得的事实。消除异质性偏差后，城市间食品价格水平的97%的变异都消失了，这与传统指数相比更为理想。同时消除这两种偏差后，我们发现食品价格水平实际上随着城市规模的增加而下降。

abstract.text: We propose a theory of inefficient renegotiation that is based on loss aversion.
