When two parties write a long-term contract that has to be renegotiated after the realization of the state of the world, they take the initial contract as a reference point to which they compare gains and losses of the renegotiated transaction. We show that loss aversion makes the renegotiated outcome sticky and materially inefficient. The theory has important implications for the optimal design of long-term contracts. First, it explains why parties often abstain from writing a beneficial long-term contract or why some contracts specify transactions that are never ex post efficient. Secondly, it shows under what conditions parties should rely on the allocation of ownership rights to protect relationship-specific investments rather than writing a specific performance contract. Thirdly, it shows that employment contracts can be strictly optimal even if parties are free to renegotiate.

10.1093/restud/rdu034.abstractZh: 我们提出了一种基于损失厌恶的无效重新谈判理论。当双方签订一份需要在实际情况实现后重新谈判的长期合同时，他们会以初始合同为参考点，来比较重新谈判交易中的收益与损失。研究表明，损失厌恶使得重新谈判的结果具有粘性，从而导致实际效率低下。该理论对长期合同的最优设计具有重要意义。首先，它解释了为什么各方往往不愿签订有益的长期合同，或者为什么有些合同规定的交易实际上从未达到最优效率。其次，它说明了在何种情况下，各方应该依靠所有权分配来保护特定关系中的投资，而不是签订具体的履行合同。第三，它表明，即使各方可以自由重新谈判，雇佣合同仍然可以是严格最优的。

abstract.text: We build into a Ricardian model sectoral linkages, trade in intermediate goods, and sectoral heterogeneity in production to quantify the trade and welfare effects from tariff changes. We also propose a new method to estimate sectoral trade elasticities consistent with any trade model that delivers a multiplicative gravity equation. We apply our model and use our estimated elasticities to identify the impact of NAFTA's tariff reductions. We find that Mexico's welfare increases by 1.31%, U.S.'s welfare increases by 0.08%, and Canada's welfare declines by 0.06%. We find that intra-bloc trade increases by 118% for Mexico, 11% for Canada, and 41% for the U.S. We show that welfare effects from tariff reductions are reduced when the structure of production does not take into account intermediate goods or input–output linkages. Our results highlight the importance of sectoral heterogeneity, intermediate goods, and sectoral linkages for the quantification of the welfare gains from tariffs reductions.

10.1093/restud/rdu035.abstractZh: 我们在里卡德模型中加入了部门联系、中间商品的贸易以及部门间的生产异质性，以量化关税变化对贸易和福利的影响。我们还提出了一种新方法，用于估计与任何贸易模型一致的部门贸易弹性，该模型采用乘法引力方程。我们应用了模型，并利用估计出的弹性来识别北美自由贸易协定关税减让的影响。研究发现，墨西哥的福利增加了1.31%，美国的福利增加了0.08%，加拿大的福利则减少了0.06%。此外，墨西哥的区内贸易增加了118%，加拿大增加了11%，美国增加了41%。我们指出，当生产结构未考虑中间商品或投入产出联系时，关税减让带来的福利效应会减弱。我们的研究结果强调了部门异质性、中间商品以及部门联系在量化关税减让带来的福利收益方面的重要性。

abstract.text: We analyze a large, anonymous labour market in which firms motivate their workers via relational contracts. The market is frictionless and features on-the-job search, in that all acceptable vacancies are immediately filled and the employed compete with the unemployed for vacancies. While firms and workers are ex ante identical, the unique equilibrium exhibits a continuous distribution of contracts in which high wage firms have higher retention rates, more motivated workers and higher productivity. The model thus generates dispersion in wages, productivity and human resource strategies, and gives rise to endogenous job ladders. An exogenous increase in on-the-job search increases the quantity of jobs but decreases their quality; with sufficient on-the-job search there is full employment, and wage dispersion rather than unemployment motivates workers.

10.1093/restud/rdu036.abstractZh: 我们研究了一个大型的匿名劳动力市场，在该市场中，企业通过关系合同来激励员工。这个市场没有摩擦，存在在职搜寻机制，所有可接受的职位空缺都会立即被填补，雇员会与失业者竞争这些职位。虽然企业和员工在事前是相同的，但独特的均衡状态表现为合同的连续分布，其中高工资的企业的保留率更高，员工更有动力，生产率也更高。因此，该模型导致了工资、生产率和人力资源策略的分散，并产生了内生性的职位阶梯。在职搜寻的外生增加会增加职位数，但会降低职位质量；在足够的在职搜寻下，可以实现充分就业，而工资分散而非失业成为激励员工的主要因素。

abstract.text: Using administrative panel data on the entire Danish population we document a new set of facts characterizing occupational mobility. For most occupations, mobility is U-shaped and directional: not only low but also high wage earners within an occupation have a particularly large probability of leaving their occupation, and the low (high) earners tend to switch to new occupations with lower (higher) average wages. Exceptions to this pattern of two-sided selection are occupations with steeply rising (declining) productivity, where mainly the lower (higher) paid workers within this occupation tend to leave. The facts conflict with several existing theories that are used to account for endogeneity in occupational choice, but it is shown analytically that the patterns are explained consistently within a theory of vertical sorting under absolute advantage that includes learning about workers' abilities.

10.1093/restud/rdu037.abstractZh: 我们利用丹麦全体人口的行政面板数据，记录了一组新的职业流动性特征。对于大多数职业而言，职业流动性呈现U形且具有方向性：不仅低收入的从业者，高收入的从业者也有较大的离职可能性，而低收入（高收入）从业者则倾向于转向平均收入较低（较高）的新职业。这一双向选择模式的例外情况出现在生产率急剧上升（下降）的职业中，这些职业中的低收入（高收入）从业者更有可能离职。这些事实与几种用于解释职业选择内生性的现有理论相矛盾，但分析表明，这些模式可以在一个包含对劳动者能力学习的绝对优势垂直排序理论中得到一致解释。

abstract.text: We study the evolution of a social norm of “cooperation” in a dynamic environment. Each agent lives for two periods and interacts with agents from the previous and next generations via a coordination game. Social norms emerge as patterns of behaviour that are stable in part due to agents' interpretations of private information about the past, influenced by occasional commonly observed past behaviours. For sufficiently backward-looking societies, history completely drives equilibrium play, leading to a social norm of high or low cooperation. In more forward-looking societies, there is a pattern of “reversion” whereby play starting with high (low) cooperation reverts towards lower (higher) cooperation. The impact of history can be countered by occasional “prominent” agents, whose actions are visible by all future agents and who can leverage their greater visibility to influence expectations of future agents and overturn social norms of low cooperation.

10.1093/restud/rdu039.abstractZh: 我们研究了在动态环境中“合作”社会规范的演变。每个个体存活两个时期，并通过协调游戏与前后几代的个体进行互动。社会规范作为行为模式出现，部分原因在于个体对过去私人信息的解读，这些解读受到偶尔观察到的过去行为的影响。对于足够具有回顾能力的社会来说，历史完全决定了均衡行为，从而形成高或低合作的社会规范。在更具前瞻性的社会中，存在一种“回归”模式，即始于高（低）合作的行为会重新趋向于较低（较高）的合作。历史的影响可以被偶尔出现的“杰出”个体所抵消，这些个体的行为对所有未来的个体都是可见的，他们可以利用自己的更大影响力来影响未来个体的预期，并打破低合作的社会规范。

abstract.text: When is it best for the Principal to commit to not disclosing all that he/she knows in moral hazard interactions? I show that whenever the Agent would choose the same action under complete information at several distinct states, then full transparency can generically be improved upon. This implies that full transparency is generically suboptimal whenever the dimension of the information held by the Principal exceeds the dimension of the Agent's action. In a simple class of problems, I make further progress on the best disclosure policy assuming the Principal can either disclose fully the state or remain silent.

10.1093/restud/rdu040.abstractZh: 在道德风险互动中， Principal 何时最好选择不披露他所知道的所有信息？我表明，每当代理人能够在完全信息下在几个不同的状态下选择相同的行动时，完全透明性通常可以被改进。这意味着，当 Principal 所持有的信息维度超过代理人行动的维度时，完全透明性通常是不优的。在一个简单的问题类别中，我进一步探讨了在 Principal 能够完全披露状态或保持沉默的情况下，最佳披露政策。

abstract.text: We propose a new methodology for measuring intergenerational mobility in economic well-being. Our method is based on the joint distribution of surnames and economic outcomes. It circumvents the need for intergenerational panel data, a long-standing stumbling block for understanding mobility. It does so by using cross-sectional data alongside a calibrated structural model to recover the traditional intergenerational elasticity measures. Our main idea is simple. If “inheritance” is important for economic outcomes, then rare surnames should predict economic outcomes in the cross-section. This is because rare surnames are indicative of familial linkages. If the number of rare surnames is small this approach will not work. However, rare surnames are abundant in the highly skewed nature of surname distributions from most Western societies. We develop a model that articulates this idea and shows that the more important is inheritance, the more informative will be surnames. This result is robust to a variety of different assumptions about fertility and mating. We apply our method using the 2001 census from Catalonia, a large region of Spain. We use educational attainment as a proxy for overall economic well-being. A calibration exercise results in an estimate of the intergenerational correlation of educational attainment of 0.60. We also find evidence suggesting that mobility has decreased among the different generations of the 20th century. A complementary analysis based on sibling correlations confirms our results and provides a robustness check on our method. Our model and our data allow us to examine one possible explanation for the observed decrease in mobility. We find that the degree of assortative mating has increased over time. Overall, we argue that our method has promise because it can tap the vast mines of census data that are available in a heretofore unexploited manner.

10.1093/restud/rdu041.abstractZh: 我们提出了一种衡量经济福祉代际流动性的新方法。我们的方法基于姓氏与经济结果之间的联合分布，从而绕过了需要代际面板数据这一长期存在的障碍。我们通过使用横截面数据以及经过校准的结构模型来恢复传统的代际弹性指标。我们的主要思想很简单：如果“遗传”对经济结果很重要，那么稀有姓氏应该能在横截面中预测经济结果。这是因为稀有姓氏反映了家族联系。然而，如果稀有姓氏的数量很少，这种方法将不起作用。然而，在大多数西方社会姓氏分布的严重偏态中，稀有姓氏是普遍存在的。我们开发了一个模型来阐述这一思想，并表明遗传的重要性越高，姓氏的信息量就越大。这一结果在关于生育和婚姻的各种假设下都是稳健的。我们使用西班牙加泰罗尼亚地区2001年的人口普查数据来应用我们的方法。我们将教育水平作为整体经济福祉的代理变量。通过校准练习，我们得出了教育水平的代际相关性为0.60的估计值。我们还发现了一些证据，表明在20世纪的不同世代中，流动性有所减少。基于兄弟姐妹相关性的补充分析证实了我们的结果，并对我们的方法进行了稳健性检验。我们的模型和数据使我们能够探讨流动性下降的一个可能解释。我们发现，随着时间的推移，选择性交配的程度有所增加。总体而言，我们认为我们的方法具有潜力，因为它能够以一种尚未被充分利用的方式挖掘丰富的普查数据资源。

abstract.text: We investigate global factors associated with bank capital flows. We formulate a model of the international banking system where global banks interact with local banks. The solution highlights the bank leverage cycle as the determinant of the transmission of financial conditions across borders through banking sector capital flows. A distinctive prediction of the model is that local currency appreciation is associated with higher leverage of the banking sector, thereby providing a conceptual bridge between exchange rates and financial stability. In a panel study of 46 countries, we find support for the key predictions of our model.

10.1093/restud/rdu042.abstractZh: 我们研究了与银行资本流动相关的全球因素。我们构建了一个国际银行系统的模型，其中全球银行与本地银行进行互动。模型的结果表明，银行杠杆周期是决定金融状况通过银行部门资本流动跨境传递的关键因素。该模型的一个独特预测是，本地货币升值与银行部门的更高杠杆率相关，从而为汇率与金融稳定之间建立了概念上的联系。通过对46个国家的面板研究，我们发现了该模型关键预测的支持。

abstract.text: We study contractual arrangements that support an efficient use of time in a knowledge-intensive economy in which agents endogenously specialize in either production or consulting. The resulting market for advice is plagued by informational problems, since both the difficulty of the questions posed to consultants and the knowledge of those consultants are hard to assess. We show that spot contracting is not efficient because lemons (in this case, self-employed producers with intermediate knowledge) cannot be appropriately excluded from the market. However, an ex ante, firm-like contractual arrangement uniquely delivers the first best. This arrangement involves hierarchies in which consultants are full residual claimants of output and compensate producers via incentive contracts. This simple characterization of the optimal ex ante arrangement suggests a rationale for the organization of firms and the structure of compensation in knowledge-intensive sectors. Our findings correspond empirically to observed arrangements inside professional service firms and between venture capitalists and entrepreneurs.

10.1093/restud/rdu043.abstractZh: 我们研究了在知识密集型经济中支持时间高效利用的合同安排，在这种经济环境中，参与者会内生性地专注于生产或咨询领域。由此产生的咨询市场存在信息问题，因为咨询对象所提出的问题的复杂程度以及咨询者的知识水平都难以评估。我们发现，即时合同安排并不高效，因为无法适当排除那些具有中间知识的“柠檬”参与者（即自雇生产者）。然而，一种事前性的、类似企业的合同安排能够实现最优结果。这种安排涉及层级结构，其中咨询者成为产出的完全剩余索取者，并通过激励合同对生产者进行补偿。这种对最优事前安排的简单描述，为知识密集型行业中的企业组织结构和补偿机制提供了理论依据。我们的发现与专业服务企业内部以及风险投资家与企业家之间的实际安排相符。

abstract.text: This article studies the determinants of college major choice using an experimentally generated panel of beliefs, obtained by providing students with information on the true population distribution of various major-specific characteristics. Students logically revise their beliefs in response to the information, and their subjective beliefs about future major choice are associated with beliefs about their own earnings and ability. We estimate a rich model of college major choice using the panel of beliefs data. While expected earnings and perceived ability are a significant determinant of major choice, heterogeneous tastes are the dominant factor in the choice of major. Analyses that ignore the correlation in tastes with earnings expectations inflate the role of earnings in college major choices. We conclude by computing the welfare gains from the information experiment and find positive average welfare gains.

10.1093/restud/rdu044.abstractZh: 本文通过实验生成的信念面板数据，研究了大学生专业选择的决定因素。实验中向学生提供了关于各种专业特征的真实分布信息，学生会根据这些信息调整自己的信念。他们对未来专业选择的看法与对自己收入和能力的主观认知相关联。我们利用这些信念面板数据构建了一个关于大学专业选择的复杂模型。虽然预期收入和个人能力是专业选择的重要决定因素，但异质性的偏好才是专业选择的主要驱动因素。忽略偏好与收入预期之间的相关性会导致对收入在专业选择中作用的过度估计。最后，我们计算了信息实验带来的福利收益，发现平均福利收益是积极的。

abstract.text: We analyse the causal impact of competition on managerial quality and hospital performance. To address the endogeneity of market structure we analyse the English public hospital sector where entry and exit are controlled by the central government. Because closing hospitals in areas where the governing party is expecting a tight election race (“marginals”) is rare due to the fear of electoral defeat, we can use political marginality as an instrumental variable for the number of hospitals in a geographical area. We find that higher competition results in higher management quality, measured using a new survey tool, and improved hospital performance. Adding a rival hospital increases management quality by 0.4 standard deviations and increases survival rates from emergency heart attacks by 9.7%. We confirm the robustness of our IV strategy to “hidden policies” that could be used in marginal districts to improve hospital management and to changes in capacity that may follow from hospital closure.

10.1093/restud/rdu045.abstractZh: 我们分析了竞争对管理质量和医院绩效的因果影响。为了解决市场结构的内生性问题，我们选择了英国公立医院部门作为研究对象，该部门的进入和退出由中央政府控制。由于执政党担心选举失利，在选举竞争激烈的地区关闭医院的情况较为罕见，因此我们可以将政治边缘性作为地理区域内医院数量的工具变量。研究发现，竞争程度越高，管理质量越高，且医院绩效也有所改善。新增一家竞争对手医院可使管理质量提高0.4个标准差，同时使紧急心脏病发作的存活率提高9.7%。我们进一步确认了我们的工具变量策略对“隐性政策”的稳健性，这些政策可能用于边缘地区以改善医院管理，同时也会因医院关闭而导致医院容量发生变化。

abstract.text: Marriage institutions have changed over time, evolving from polygyny to monogamy, and then to serial monogamy (as defined by divorce and remarriage). We propose a unified theory of such institutional changes, where the dynamics of income distribution are the driving force. We characterize the marriage-market equilibrium in each of the three alternative regimes, and determine which one emerges as a political equilibrium, depending on the state of the economy. In a two-class society, a rise in the share of rich males drives the change from polygyny to monogamy. The introduction of serial monogamy follows from a further rise in the proportion of either rich females or rich males. Monogamy eases the transition to serial monogamy, since it promotes social mobility.

10.1093/restud/rdv001.abstractZh: 婚姻制度随着时间的推移而发生变化，从一夫多妻制发展到一夫一妻制，然后又发展为通过离婚和再婚实现的序列一夫一妻制。我们提出了一种关于这种制度变化的统一理论，其中收入分配的动态变化是驱动因素。我们描述了三种不同制度下的婚姻市场均衡，并确定了哪种制度会在经济状态下成为政治均衡。在双阶级社会中，富裕男性比例的上升推动了从一夫多妻制到一夫一妻制的转变。而序列一夫一妻制的出现则源于富裕女性或富裕男性比例的进一步上升。一夫一妻制有助于促进向序列一夫一妻制的过渡，因为它促进了社会流动性。

abstract.text: In this article we examine the competitive equilibria of a dynamic stochastic economy with complete markets and collateral constraints. We show that, provided the sets of asset pay-offs and of collateral levels are sufficiently rich, the equilibrium allocations with sequential trades and collateral constraints are equivalent to those obtained in Arrow–Debreu markets subject to a series of limited pledgeability constraints. We provide both necessary and sufficient conditions for equilibria to be Pareto efficient and show that when collateral is scarce equilibria are not only Pareto inefficient but also often constrained inefficient, in the sense that imposing tighter borrowing restrictions can make everybody in the economy better off. We derive sufficient conditions for the existence of Markov equilibria and, for the case of two agents, for the existence of equilibria that have finite support. These equilibria can be computed with arbitrary accuracy and the model is very tractable.

10.1093/restud/rdv002.abstractZh: 在本文中，我们研究了一个具有完全市场与抵押约束的动态随机经济体的竞争均衡。我们表明，只要资产收益集合和抵押水平足够丰富，带有顺序交易和抵押约束的均衡分配就等同于在受一系列有限抵押限制条件的Arrow-Debreu市场中获得的均衡分配。我们提出了均衡为帕累托有效所需的充分条件，并证明当抵押品稀缺时，均衡不仅为帕累托无效，而且常常处于约束性无效状态，即实施更严格的借贷限制可以使经济中的每个人受益。我们还推导出了存在马尔可夫均衡的充分条件，对于两个代理人的情况，还推导出了存在具有有限支持的均衡的条件。这些均衡可以以任意精度进行计算，且模型非常易于处理。

abstract.text: We introduce ex post participation constraints in the standard sequential screening model. This captures the presence of consumer withdrawal rights as, for instance, mandated by European Union regulation of “distance sales contracts”. With such additional constraints, the optimal contract is static and, unlike with only ex ante participation constraints, does not elicit the agent's information sequentially. This holds whenever differences in ex ante and ex post outside options are below a positive upper bound. Welfare effects of mandatory withdrawal rights are ambiguous. Since it is insufficient in our setting to consider only local incentive constraints, we develop a novel technique to identify the relevant global constraints.

10.1093/restud/rdv003.abstractZh: 我们在标准的顺序筛选模型中引入了事后参与约束。这反映了消费者撤销权的存在，例如，根据欧盟对“远程销售合同”的法规要求。有了这样的额外约束，最优合同是静态的，并且与仅有事前参与约束的情况不同，不会依次引导代理人的信息决策。只要事前和事后选择之间的差异低于一个正的上限，这一结论仍然成立。强制撤销权的福利效应是模糊的。由于在我们的设定中仅考虑局部激励约束是不够的，我们开发了一种新的技术来识别相关的全局约束。

abstract.text: This article analyses the identification and empirical content of the pure moral hazard (PMH) and the hybrid moral hazard (HMH) principal–agent models. The PMH model has hidden actions, while the HMH model has hidden information in addition to hidden actions. In both models, agents are risk averse and principals are risk neutral. The article derives the equilibrium restrictions from the optimal contract and uses the restrictions to show that the models have empirical content. For any given risk-aversion parameter, the models' other parameters are non-parametrically point identified. The risk-aversion parameter—and hence the model—are, however, only partially identified. Management's ability to manipulate accounting reports arises endogenously within HMH models, but not in all versions of PMH models. We use our framework to investigate whether shareholders contract with management recognizing that accounting reports are susceptible to manipulation and, therefore, endogenous to the incentives offered to management. The data reject all models in which accounting reports are verifiable. Furthermore, the version of the PMH in which accounting reports can be manipulated is rejected if expected compensation is restricted to be positive.

10.1093/restud/rdv004.abstractZh: 本文分析了纯粹的道德风险（PMH）和混合道德风险（HMH）的委托-代理模型的识别与实证内容。PMH模型存在隐藏行为，而HMH模型除了隐藏行为外还包含隐藏信息。在两种模型中，代理人都是风险厌恶的，而委托人则是风险中性的。文章从最优契约中推导出均衡约束，并利用这些约束证明了这些模型具有实证意义。对于任何给定的风险厌恶参数，这些模型的其他参数都是非参数点识别的。然而，风险厌恶参数以及模型本身只是部分识别的。在HMH模型中，管理层操纵会计报告的能力是内生产生的，而在所有版本的PMH模型中并非如此。我们利用我们的框架来研究股东是否与管理层签订契约时意识到会计报告容易被操纵，因此会计报告是受管理层激励所影响的。数据否定了所有会计报告可验证的模型。此外，如果预期补偿被限制为正值，那么会计报告可以被操纵的PMH模型也被否定。

abstract.text: This article analyses how outsiders, such as bidders or activist investors, overcome the lack of coordination and information among dispersed shareholders. We identify the two basic means to achieve this goal. First, the outsider must relinquish private benefits in a manner that is informative about security benefits. We show under which conditions this is feasible and which acquisition strategies used in practice meet these conditions. Second, the outsider can alternatively use derivatives to drive a wedge between her voting power and her economic interest in the firm. Such unbundling of ownership and control, while typically considered a source of corporate governance problems, is an efficient response to the frictions dispersed ownership causes for control contestability. We also show that unbundling comes with costs and benefits for the bidder's incentives to improve firm value.

10.1093/restud/rdv005.abstractZh: 本文分析了外部参与者，如投标者或激进投资者，如何克服分散股东之间缺乏协调和信息的问题。我们确定了实现这一目标的两个基本手段。首先，外部参与者必须以能够反映公司安全利益的方式放弃私人利益。我们展示了在何种条件下这是可行的，以及实践中使用的哪些收购策略符合这些条件。其次，外部参与者还可以利用衍生品来削弱其投票权与公司在经济上的利益之间的关联。这种所有权与控制权的分离虽然通常被认为是公司治理问题的来源，但实际上是对分散所有权导致的控制权争夺问题的有效应对。我们还指出，这种分离对投标者提升公司价值的动机既有成本也有收益。

abstract.text: A dynamic model with credit under limited commitment is constructed, in which limited memory can weaken the effects of punishment for default. This creates an endogenous role for government debt in credit markets, and the economy can be non-Ricardian. Default can occur in equilibrium, and government debt essentially plays a role as collateral and thus improves borrowers' incentives. The provision of government debt acts to discourage default, whether default occurs in equilibrium or not.

10.1093/restud/rdv006.abstractZh: 构建了一个具有有限承诺的信用动态模型，在该模型中，有限的记忆能力会削弱违约惩罚的效果。这使得政府债务在信用市场中扮演了内生性的角色，并且经济可能不属于李嘉图模型所描述的范畴。违约可能在均衡状态下发生，而政府债务本质上起到了抵押品的作用，从而提升了借款人的积极性。无论违约是否发生在均衡状态下，提供政府债务都能起到抑制违约的作用。

abstract.text: Maximum-likelihood estimation of nonlinear models with fixed effects is subject to the incidental-parameter problem. This typically implies that point estimates suffer from large bias and confidence intervals have poor coverage. This article presents a jackknife method to reduce this bias and to obtain confidence intervals that are correctly centred under rectangular-array asymptotics. The method is explicitly designed to handle dynamics in the data, and yields estimators that are straightforward to implement and can be readily applied to a range of models and estimands. We provide distribution theory for estimators of model parameters and average effects, present validity tests for the jackknife, and consider extensions to higher-order bias correction and to two-step estimation problems. An empirical illustration relating to female labour-force participation is also provided.

10.1093/restud/rdv007.abstractZh: 固定效应的非线性模型的最大似然估计会面临偶然参数问题。这通常意味着点估计存在较大偏差，置信区间的覆盖范围也较差。本文提出了一种杰克刀法来减少这种偏差，并在矩形阵列渐近条件下获得正确居中的置信区间。该方法专门设计用于处理数据中的动态变化，所得到的估计量易于实施，可以广泛应用于各种模型和估计量。我们为模型参数和平均效应的估计量提供了分布理论，对杰克刀法进行了有效性检验，并考虑了高阶偏差校正和两步估计问题的扩展。此外，还提供了关于女性劳动力参与率的实证案例。

abstract.text: By the 1970s, quid pro quo policy, which requires multinational firms to transfer technology in return for market access, had become a common practice in many developing countries. While many countries have subsequently liberalized quid pro quo requirements, China continues to follow the policy. In this article, we incorporate quid pro quo policy into a multicountry dynamic general equilibrium model, using microevidence from Chinese patents to motivate key assumptions about the terms of the technology transfer deals and macroevidence on China's inward foreign direct investment (FDI) to estimate key model parameters. We then use the model to quantify the impact of China's quid pro quo policy and show that it has had a significant impact on global innovation and welfare.

10.1093/restud/rdv008.abstractZh: 到了20世纪70年代，以技术转让换取市场准入的“交换政策”在许多发展中国家已成为常见做法。虽然许多国家随后放宽了这种交换政策，但中国仍然坚持这一政策。在本文中，我们将这种交换政策纳入一个多国动态一般均衡模型中，利用中国专利的微观数据来推导技术转让协议的相关假设，并利用中国对外直接投资的数据来估计模型参数。随后，我们利用该模型量化了中国这种交换政策的影响，并表明它对全球创新和福利产生了显著的影响。

abstract.text: Committee voting has mostly been investigated from the perspective of the standard Baron–Ferejohn model of bargaining over the division of a pie, in which bargaining ends as soon as the committee reaches an agreement. In standing committees, however, existing agreements can be amended. This article studies an extension of the Baron–Ferejohn framework to a model with an evolving default that reflects this important feature of policymaking in standing committees: In each of an infinite number of periods, the ongoing default can be amended to a new policy (which is, in turn, the default for the next period). The model provides a number of quite different predictions. (i) From a positive perspective, the key distinction turns on whether the quota is less than unanimity. In that case, patient enough players waste substantial shares of the pie each period and the size principle fails in some pure strategy Markov perfect equilibria. In contrast, the unique Markov perfect equilibrium payoffs in a unanimity committee coincide with those in the corresponding Baron–Ferejohn framework. (ii) If players have heterogeneous discount factors then a large class of subgame perfect equilibria (including all Markov perfect equilibria) are inefficient.

10.1093/restud/rdv009.abstractZh: 委员会投票的研究大多从标准的Baron–Ferejohn讨价还价模型出发，该模型假设委员会在达成一致后便结束讨价还价过程。然而，在常设委员会中，现有的协议可以被修改。本文研究了Baron–Ferejohn框架的扩展模型，该模型包含了一个不断变化的默认状态，这反映了常设委员会政策制定中的一个重要特征：在无限多个周期内，当前的默认状态可以被修改为新的政策，而这一新政策又成为下一个周期的新默认状态。该模型提出了一些不同的预测。(i) 从积极的角度来看，关键的区别在于配额是否低于一致同意的标准。在这种情况下，耐心等待的玩家会在每个周期中浪费大量的资源，而规模原则在某些纯策略马尔可夫完美均衡中无法得到体现。相反，一致同意委员会的独特马尔可夫完美均衡结果与相应的Baron–Ferejohn框架中的结果一致。(ii) 如果玩家的折现因子不同，那么许多子博弈完美均衡（包括所有马尔可夫完美均衡）都是低效的。

abstract.text: We argue that one major cause of the U.S. post-war baby boom was the rise in female labour supply during World War II. We develop a quantitative dynamic general equilibrium model with endogenous fertility and female labour force participation decisions. We use the model to assess the impact of the war on female labour supply and fertility in the decades following the war. For the war generation of women, the high demand for female labour brought about by mobilization leads to an increase in labour supply that persists after the war. As a result, younger women who reach adulthood in the 1950s face increased labour market competition, which impels them to exit the labour market and start having children earlier. The effect is amplified by the rise in taxes necessary to pay down wartime government debt. In our calibrated model, the war generates a substantial baby boom followed by a baby bust.

10.1093/restud/rdv010.abstractZh: 我们认为，美国战后婴儿潮的一个主要原因是第二次世界大战期间女性劳动力供应的增加。我们建立了一个包含内生生育率和女性劳动力参与决策的定量动态一般均衡模型。利用该模型评估战争对战后几十年女性劳动力供应和生育率的影响。对于战争期间出生的女性来说，由于动员需要，对女性劳动力的高需求导致劳动力供应在战后持续增加。因此，在20世纪50年代成年后的年轻女性面临着更大的劳动力市场竞争，这促使她们更早退出劳动力市场并开始生育子女。这一效应因支付战争期间政府债务而增加的税收进一步加剧。在我们的校准模型中，战争引发了显著的婴儿潮，随后又出现了婴儿潮的衰退。

abstract.text: Episodes of large capital inflows in small open economies are often associated with a shift of resources from the tradable to the non-tradable sector and sometimes lead to balance-of-payments crises. This article builds a two-sector dynamic model to study the evolution of the sectoral structure and its impact on financial fragility. The model embeds a static mechanism of balance-of-payments crisis which produces multiple equilibria within a single time period when the non-tradable sector is large enough compared to the tradable sector. The article studies the dynamics induced by an increase in financial openness. It shows that the relative size of the non-tradable sector overshoots, which makes the economy more likely to be financially fragile during the transitory dynamics. Using an extended version of the model, the article conducts a quantitative analysis and shows that this mechanism accounts well for several episodes of large capital inflows that led to financial crises.

10.1093/restud/rdv011.abstractZh: 在小型开放经济体中，大规模资本流入的事件往往伴随着资源从可交易部门向不可交易部门的转移，有时会导致国际收支危机。本文构建了一个双部门动态模型，研究部门结构的演变及其对金融脆弱性的影响。该模型包含了一个静态的国际收支危机机制，当不可交易部门相对于可交易部门足够大时，该机制会在单一时间周期内产生多种均衡状态。文章研究了金融开放程度增加所引发的动态变化，结果表明不可交易部门的相对规模过大，使得经济在过渡阶段更容易出现金融脆弱性。通过对该模型进行扩展分析，文章进行了定量研究，并表明这一机制能够很好地解释几起导致金融危机的大规模资本流入事件。

abstract.text: I study a general class of noisy rational expectations models that nests the standard Grossman and Stiglitz (1980) and Hellwig (1980) models, but relaxes the usual assumption of joint normality of asset pay-offs and supply, and allows for more general signal structures. I provide a constructive proof of existence of equilibrium, characterize the price function, and provide sufficient conditions for uniqueness within the class of equilibria with continuous price functions, which are met by both the Grossman and Stiglitz (1980) models and the Hellwig (1980) models with a continuum of investors. My solution approach does not rely on the typical “conjecture and verify” method, and I exhibit a number of non-normal examples in which asset prices can be characterized explicitly and in a closed form. The results presented here open up a broad class of models for applied work. To illustrate the usefulness of generalizing the standard model, I show that in settings with non-normally distributed pay-offs, shocks to fundamentals may be amplified purely due to learning effects, price drifts can arise naturally, and the disagreement–return relation depends in a novel way on return skewness.

10.1093/restud/rdv012.abstractZh: 我研究了一类带有噪声的理性预期模型，这类模型包含了标准的Grossman和Stiglitz（1980年）模型以及Hellwig（1980年）模型，但放宽了资产收益与供给共同服从正态分布的假设，并允许更一般的信号结构。我提供了均衡存在的构造性证明，描述了价格函数，并为具有连续价格函数的均衡类提供了唯一性的充分条件，这些条件既适用于Grossman和Stiglitz（1980年）模型，也适用于具有连续投资者的Hellwig（1980年）模型。我的解决方法不依赖于典型的“猜想并验证”方法，并且我展示了一些非正态分布情况下的资产价格，这些价格可以明确地用封闭形式来表示。这里呈现的结果为应用研究开辟了一类广泛的模型。为了说明推广标准模型的实用性，我展示了在收益分布非正态的情况下，基本面的冲击可能会因学习效应而得到放大，价格波动会自然出现，而且分歧与收益关系会以一种新的方式依赖于收益的偏度。

abstract.text: We study the effects of securitization on interbank lending competition. An applicant's observable features are seen by a remote bank, while her true credit quality is known only to a local bank. Without securitization, the remote bank does not compete because of a winner's curse. With securitization, in contrast, ignorance is bliss: the less a bank knows about its loans, the less of a lemons problem it faces in selling them. This enables the remote bank to compete successfully in the lending market. Consistent with the empirical evidence, remote and securitized loans default more than observationally equivalent local and unsecuritized loans, respectively.

10.1093/restud/rdv013.abstractZh: 我们研究了证券化对银行间借贷竞争的影响。远程银行可以观察到借款人的可观测特征，而借款人的真实信用质量只有本地银行知晓。在没有证券化的情况下，远程银行由于“赢者诅咒”而无法参与竞争。而有了证券化，无知反而带来好处：银行对其贷款的了解越少，在出售贷款时面临的“柠檬问题”就越少。这使得远程银行在借贷市场中能够成功竞争。与实证数据一致的是，与本地银行及未证券化贷款相比，远程贷款和证券化贷款违约率更高。

abstract.text: Despite the popularity of prediction, markets among economists, businesses, and policymakers have been slow to adopt them in decision-making. Most studies of prediction markets outside the lab are from public markets with large trading populations. Corporate prediction markets face additional issues, such as thinness, weak incentives, limited entry, and the potential for traders with biases or ulterior motives—raising questions about how well these markets will perform. We examine data from prediction markets run by Google, Ford Motor Company, and an anonymous basic materials conglomerate (Firm X). Despite theoretically adverse conditions, we find these markets are relatively efficient, and improve upon the forecasts of experts at all three firms by as much as a 25% reduction in mean-squared error. The most notable inefficiency is an optimism bias in the markets at Google. The inefficiencies that do exist generally become smaller over time. More experienced traders and those with higher past performance trade against the identified inefficiencies, suggesting that the markets' efficiency improves because traders gain experience and less skilled traders exit the market.

10.1093/restud/rdv014.abstractZh: 尽管预测在经济学界、商业界和政策制定者中颇受欢迎，但市场在决策中采用预测的方式却进展缓慢。大多数关于预测市场的研究都来自拥有大量交易参与者的公共市场。企业级预测市场还面临其他问题，如市场参与者较少、激励不足、进入门槛高，以及可能存在有偏见或别有用心的交易者——这些问题使得人们对这些市场的表现持怀疑态度。我们研究了由谷歌、福特汽车公司和一家匿名的基础材料集团（公司X）运营的预测市场的数据。尽管理论上存在不利条件，我们发现这些市场相对高效，并且能够将三家公司的专家预测结果的平均平方误差降低25%。最显著的不效率现象是谷歌市场中的乐观偏差。这些存在的不效率通常会随着时间逐渐减小。更有经验的交易者和过去表现较好的交易者会利用这些不效率进行交易，这表明市场的效率得到了提升，因为交易者积累了经验，而技术较差的交易者则逐渐退出市场。

abstract.text: I study the positive relationship between prices of tradable goods and per capita income. I develop a highly tractable general equilibrium model of international trade with heterogeneous firms and non-homothetic consumer preferences that positively links prices of tradables to consumer income. Guided by the model's testable prediction, I estimate the elasticity of price with respect to per capita income from a unique data set that I construct, which features prices of 245 identical goods sold in 29 European, Asian, and North American markets via the Internet by Spain's second largest apparel manufacturer—Mango. I find that doubling a destination's per capita income results in an 18% increase in the price of identical items sold there. Per capita income differences account for a third, whereas shipping cost differences can explain up to a third of the cross-country price variations of identical items purchased via the Internet by consumers who do not take advantage of quantity discounts. The price elasticity estimates compare favourably to estimates that I obtain from a standard data set that features prices across retail locations around the world, suggesting that variable mark-ups play a key role in accounting for observed cross-country differences in prices of tradables.

10.1093/restud/rdv015.abstractZh: 我研究了可交易商品的价格与人均收入之间的正相关关系。我开发了一个高度可操作的国际贸易一般均衡模型，该模型包含异质企业和非同质消费者偏好，能够将可交易商品的价格与消费者收入联系起来。根据模型的可测试预测，我利用我构建的独特数据集来估计价格对人均收入的弹性。该数据集包含了西班牙第二大服装制造商Mango通过29个欧洲、亚洲和北美市场在线销售的245种同质商品的价格。我发现，当一个地区的人均收入翻倍时，该地区销售的同质商品价格会上涨18%。人均收入差异解释了三分之一的价格变化，而运输成本差异则能解释高达三分之一的跨国价格差异。与我从全球零售地点价格数据集中获得的估计结果相比，价格弹性的估计结果更为合理，这表明不同的加价策略在解释可交易商品跨国价格差异中起着关键作用。

abstract.text: This article studies the causes of China's Great Famine, during which 16.5 to 45 million individuals perished in rural areas. We document that average rural food retention during the famine was too high to generate a severe famine without rural inequality in food availability; that there was significant variance in famine mortality rates across rural regions; and that rural mortality rates were positively correlated with per capita food production, a surprising pattern that is unique to the famine years. We provide evidence that an inflexible and progressive government procurement policy (where procurement could not adjust to contemporaneous production and larger shares of expected production were procured from more productive regions) was necessary for generating this pattern and that this policy was a quantitatively important contributor to overall famine mortality.

10.1093/restud/rdv016.abstractZh: 本文研究了中国大饥荒的原因，期间有1650万至4500万人在农村地区丧生。我们发现，在饥荒期间，农村地区的平均粮食储备量过高，如果没有农村地区在粮食供应上的不平等现象，就不会出现严重的饥荒；不同农村地区的饥荒死亡率存在显著差异；农村地区的死亡率与人均粮食产量呈正相关，这一令人惊讶的现象在饥荒期间尤为突出。我们有证据表明，一种僵化且过度的政府采购政策（即采购无法适应同期生产情况，且预期生产中的更大份额从生产力更高的地区采购）是造成这种现象的必要条件，并且这一政策对整体饥荒死亡率起到了重要的推动作用。

abstract.text: This article analyses costly information acquisition in asset markets with Knightian uncertainty about the asset fundamentals. In these markets, acquiring information not only reduces the expected variability of the fundamentals for a given distribution ( i.e . risk). It also mitigates the uncertainty about the true distribution of the fundamentals. Agents who lack knowledge of this distribution cannot correctly interpret the information other investors impound into the price. We show that, due to uncertainty aversion, the incentives to reduce uncertainty by acquiring information increase as more investors acquire information. When uncertainty is high enough, information acquisition decisions become strategic complements and lead to multiple equilibria. Swift changes in information demand can drive large price swings even after small changes in Knightian uncertainty.

10.1093/restud/rdv017.abstractZh: 本文分析了在存在奈特式不确定性下的资产市场中昂贵的信息获取问题。在这些市场中，获取信息不仅可以减少给定分布下资产基本面的预期变异（即风险），还能减轻对资产基本面真实分布的不确定性。缺乏这种分布知识的代理人无法正确解读其他投资者所提供的信息对价格的影响。研究表明，由于不确定性厌恶，随着更多投资者获取信息，减少不确定性的动机会增强。当不确定性足够高时，信息获取决策会成为战略性的补充，并导致多个均衡的出现。即使奈特式不确定性发生微小变化，信息需求的快速变化仍可能导致价格大幅波动。

abstract.text: We study the mechanism-design problem of guaranteeing desirable performances whenever agents are rational in the sense of not playing weakly dominated strategies. We first provide an upper bound for the best performance we can guarantee among all feasible mechanisms. We then prove the bound to be tight under certain conditions in auction and bilateral-trade applications. In particular, we find that a second-price auction is optimal in revenue with interdependent values, which is neither dominant-strategy nor ex post incentive compatible, but satisfies the novel incentive compatibility introduced in this analysis.

10.1093/restud/rdv018.abstractZh: 我们研究了在代理人遵循非弱占优策略这一理性条件下，如何保证理想性能的机制设计问题。首先，我们为所有可行机制中能够保证的最佳性能提供了一个上界。随后，我们在拍卖和双边交易应用中证明了该上界在某些条件下是紧的。特别地，我们发现对于具有相互依赖价值的情形，第二价格拍卖在收益方面是最优的，它既不是占优策略，也不满足事后激励相容性，但却满足了本分析中引入的新颖激励相容性标准。

abstract.text: Powerful, centralized states controlling a large share of national income only begin to appear in Europe after 1500. We build a model that explains their emergence in response to the increasing importance of money for military success. When fiscal resources are not crucial for winning wars, the threat of external conflict stifles state-building. As finance becomes critical, internally cohesive states invest in state capacity while divided states rationally drop out of the competition, causing divergence. We emphasize the role of the “Military Revolution”, a sequence of technological innovations that transformed armed conflict. Using data from 374 battles, we investigate empirically both the importance of money for military success and patterns of state-building in early modern Europe. The evidence is consistent with the predictions of our model.

10.1093/restud/rdv019.abstractZh: 在1500年之后，那些能够控制大量国民收入的强大、集中的国家才出现在欧洲。我们建立了一个模型，来解释这些国家的出现是由于货币对军事胜利的重要性日益增加。当财政资源对赢得战争并不至关重要时，外部冲突的威胁会抑制国家的建设。随着金融变得至关重要，内部团结的国家会投资于国家能力，而分裂的国家则会理性地退出竞争，导致分化。我们强调了“军事革命”的作用，这是一系列技术革新，它们改变了武装冲突的形式。通过研究374场战役的数据，我们实证地探讨了货币对军事胜利的重要性以及早期现代欧洲国家建设的模式。这些证据与我们的模型预测一致。

abstract.text: We study the relationship between the political connections of Chinese firms and workplace fatalities. In our preferred specification we find that the worker death rate for connected companies is two to three times that of unconnected firms (depending on the sample employed), a pattern that holds for within-firm estimations. The connections-mortality relationship is attenuated in provinces where safety regulators' promotion is contingent on meeting safety targets. In the absence of fatalities, connected firms receive fewer reports of major violations for safety compliance, whereas in years of fatal accidents the rate of reported violations is identical. Moreover, fatal accidents produce negative returns at connected companies and are associated with the subsequent departure of well-connected executives. These results provide suggestive evidence that connections enable firms to avoid (potentially costly) compliance measures, rather than using connections to avoid regulatory response after accidents occur. Our findings emphasize the social costs of political connections, and suggest that appropriate regulatory incentives may be useful in mitigating these costs.

10.1093/restud/rdv020.abstractZh: 我们研究了中国企业政治关系与工作场所死亡事件之间的关系。根据我们的研究，与政治关系紧密的企业，其工人死亡率是那些没有这种关系的企业的两到三倍（具体数值取决于所采用的样本）。这一趋势在企业内部评估中同样成立。在那些安全监管机构以达成安全目标为条件的省份，政治关系与死亡事件之间的关系有所减弱。在没有发生死亡事件的情况下，与政治关系紧密的企业在安全合规方面的重大违规行为报告较少；而在发生致命事故的情况下，违规行为的报告频率却保持不变。此外，致命事故会导致与政治关系紧密的企业出现负面后果，并且往往伴随着相关高管离职的情况。这些结果表明，政治关系使得企业能够避免那些可能成本高昂的合规措施，而不是在事故发生后利用政治关系来规避监管措施。我们的研究结果强调了政治关系带来的社会成本，并表明适当的监管激励措施可能有助于降低这些成本。

abstract.text: We examine the asset pricing implications of a neoclassical model of repeated investment and disinvestment. Prior research has emphasized a negative relation between productivity and equity risk that results from operating leverage when capital adjustment is costly. In general, however, expansion and contraction options affect risk in the opposite direction: they lower equity risk as profitability declines. The general prediction is a non-monotonic overlay of opposing real option and operating leverage effects. For parameters chosen to match empirical firm characteristics, the predicted non-monotonicities are quantitatively important, and are detectable in the data. The calibrated model implies that real option effects dominate operating leverage effects, and the average firm is best described by an increasing risk profile, a conclusion supported by conditional beta estimates. The baseline calibration helps explain the profitability premium in the cross-section, but makes the value puzzle worse. Panels with heterogeneous firms can deliver simultaneous profitability and value effects that match empirical levels.

10.1093/restud/rdv021.abstractZh: 我们研究了新古典重复投资与退出模型对资产定价的影响。先前的研究强调了生产率与股权风险之间的负相关关系，这种关系源于资本调整成本较高时的运营杠杆效应。然而，通常情况下，扩张和收缩选择对风险的影响方向相反：随着盈利能力下降，股权风险会降低。这一总体预测表明，实际期权效应与运营杠杆效应之间存在非单调关系。对于符合实证企业特征的参数选择，这种非单调性在数量上具有重要意义，并且在数据中可以被检测到。经过校准的模型表明，实际期权效应优于运营杠杆效应，平均企业的最佳描述特征为风险随规模增加而上升，这一结论得到了条件贝塔估计的支持。基线校准有助于解释截面数据中的盈利能力溢价，但使得价值之谜更加复杂。包含异质企业的面板数据能够同时呈现与实证数据一致的盈利能力和价值效应。

abstract.text: This article applies mechanism design to the study of international conflict resolution. Standard mechanisms in which an arbitrator can enforce her decisions are usually not feasible because disputants are sovereign entities. Nevertheless, we find that this limitation is inconsequential. Despite only being capable of making unenforceable recommendations, mediators can be equally effective as arbitrators. By using recommendation strategies that do not reveal that one player is weak to a strong opponent, a mediator can effectively circumvent the unenforceability constraint. This is because these strategies make the strong player agree to recommendations that yield the same payoff as arbitration in expectation. This result relies on the capability of mediators to collect confidential information from the disputants, before making their recommendations. Simple protocols of unmediated communication cannot achieve the same level of ex ante welfare, as they preclude confidentiality.

10.1093/restud/rdv022.abstractZh: 本文将机制设计应用于国际冲突解决的研究。通常情况下，由仲裁员来执行裁决的机制并不可行，因为争端各方都是主权实体。然而，我们发现这一限制并不重要。尽管调解员只能提出无法执行的建议，但它们同样能够像仲裁员一样有效。通过使用那些不会让弱方玩家显得比强方玩家弱的策略，调解员可以有效地规避无法执行的限制。因为这些策略使得强方玩家同意那些在预期中能够获得与仲裁相同的收益的提议。这一结果依赖于调解员在提出建议之前能够从争端各方收集机密信息的能力。简单的非调解沟通协议无法达到同样的预期福利水平，因为它们会剥夺保密性。

abstract.text: Many countries use college-major-specific admissions policies that require a student to choose a college-major pair jointly. Given the potential of student-major mismatches, we explore the equilibrium effects of postponing student choice of major. We develop a sorting equilibrium model under the college-major-specific admissions regime, allowing for match uncertainty and peer effects. We estimate the model using Chilean data. We introduce the counterfactual regime as a Stackelberg game in which a social planner chooses college-specific admissions policies and students make enrollment decisions, learn about their fits to various majors before choosing one. Our estimates indicate that switching from the baseline to the counterfactual regime leads to a 1% increase in average student welfare and that it is more likely to benefit female, low-income and/or low-ability students.

10.1093/restud/rdv023.abstractZh: 许多国家采用针对特定大学专业的招生政策，要求学生共同选择一对大学专业。考虑到学生专业不匹配的可能性，我们探讨了推迟学生专业选择的均衡效应。我们在这种针对特定大学专业的招生制度下，建立了一个排序均衡模型，该模型考虑了匹配不确定性和同伴效应。我们使用智利数据对模型进行了估计。我们将反事实制度引入模型，将其视为一个斯塔克伯格博弈，其中社会规划者负责选择大学特定的招生政策，而学生则在选择专业之前先了解自己与不同专业的匹配程度。我们的估计结果显示，从基准制度转变为反事实制度会使平均学生福利增加1%，并且这种改变更有可能使女性、低收入和/或能力较低的学生受益。

abstract.text: We conducted an experiment with 182 inmates from a maximum security prison to analyze the impact of criminal identity salience on cheating. The results show that inmates cheat more when we exogenously render their criminal identity more salient. This effect is specific to individuals who have a criminal identity, because an additional placebo experiment shows that regular citizens do not become more dishonest in response to crime-related reminders. Moreover, our experimental measure of cheating correlates with inmates' offences against in-prison regulation. Together, these findings suggest that criminal identity salience plays a crucial role in rule violating behaviour.

10.1093/restud/rdv025.abstractZh: 我们针对一所最高安全级别的监狱中的182名囚犯进行了一项实验，以分析犯罪身份显著性对作弊行为的影响。实验结果表明，当我们人为地使囚犯的犯罪身份更加显著时，他们更有可能进行作弊行为。这种效应仅适用于拥有犯罪身份的个体，因为另一项安慰剂实验表明，普通公民在受到与犯罪相关的提醒时并不会变得更加不诚实。此外，我们实验中所测量的作弊行为与囚犯违反监狱规定的行为存在相关性。综上所述，这些发现表明，犯罪身份的显著性在违反规则的行为中起着至关重要的作用。

abstract.text: We develop a dynamic stochastic general equilibrium (DSGE) model with rational inattention and compare its predictions to data. Households and decision-makers in firms have limited attention and optimally allocate their attention. Rational inattention is the only source of slow adjustment. The model matches the empirical impulse responses to monetary policy shocks and aggregate technology shocks. At the same time, profit losses and utility losses from inattention are very small. Furthermore, it matters whether one uses this model or a conventional DSGE model for policy analysis.

10.1093/restud/rdv027.abstractZh: 我们开发了一个动态随机一般均衡模型，该模型考虑了理性忽视现象，并将其预测结果与数据进行了比较。家庭和企业决策者都拥有有限的注意力，并会进行最优的注意力分配。理性忽视是缓慢调整的唯一原因。该模型能够很好地匹配实证研究中货币政策冲击和总体技术冲击引起的脉冲响应。同时，由于忽视而导致的利润损失和效用损失非常小。此外，使用该模型还是传统的DSGE模型进行政策分析，这一点也很重要。

abstract.text: Research on differentiated products markets often uses structural demand/supply models to identify firms' marginal costs as product‐level cost data are unavailable. Using unique demand and cost data from cable TV, I evaluate a differentiated products model's ability to identify marginal costs. I find firms systematically price below profit‐maximizing levels, leading to biases in the model's marginal cost estimates. I study the implications for merger simulations and find that these biases compromise estimates of merger‐related cost efficiencies, yet do not prevent these models from generating useful predictions of the price and nonprice effects of mergers.

10.1111/iere.12123.abstractZh: 关于差异化产品市场的研究通常会使用结构性的需求/供应模型来识别企业的边际成本，因为无法获得产品层面的成本数据。我利用有线电视行业的独特需求和成本数据，评估了差异化产品模型识别边际成本的能力。我发现，企业通常会以低于利润最大化的价格出售产品，这导致模型对边际成本的估计存在偏差。我对合并模拟的影响进行了研究，发现这些偏差会损害对合并相关成本效率的估计，但并不会阻止这些模型对合并的价格和非价格影响做出有用的预测。

abstract.text: This article develops a dynamic model of entry and exit to analyze quality choice and oligopoly market structure in the nursing home industry. I find significant heterogeneity in the competitive effects across market structures: Firms of similar quality levels compete more strongly than dissimilar firms. Sunken entry costs are extremely large, and quality adjustment behavior is governed by significant fixed adjustment costs. A proposal to eliminate low‐quality nursing homes is found to cause a large supply‐side shortage, and another proposal to lower entry costs has offered a perverse incentive to provide low quality of care.

10.1111/iere.12137.abstractZh: 本文构建了一个动态模型，用于分析养老院行业的质量选择与寡头市场结构。研究发现，不同市场结构下企业的竞争效应存在显著差异：质量水平相近的企业之间的竞争更为激烈，而质量差异较大的企业则面临更大的竞争压力。进入成本在寡头市场中非常高，质量调整行为则受到显著的固定调整成本的制约。提出淘汰低质量养老院的建议会导致供应端的严重短缺，而降低进入成本的建议则会产生提供低质量护理服务的逆向激励。

abstract.text: This article develops a new estimation method that accounts for excess demand and the unobserved component of product quality. We apply our method to study the Wisconsin nursing home market in 1999 and find that nearly 20% of elderly qualified for Medicaid were rationed out. However, our counterfactual experiment shows that the net welfare gain of fulfilling all nursing home demands may be small, because the welfare gain could be largely offset by the increase in Medicaid expenditures. We also find that a 1% increase in quality would crowd out 3.2% Medicaid patients in binding nursing homes.

10.1111/iere.12138.abstractZh: 本文提出了一种新的估计方法，该方法考虑了超额需求以及产品质量的未观测成分。我们将该方法应用于1999年的威斯康星州养老院市场的研究，发现近20%符合Medicaid条件的老年人被进行了需求分配。然而，我们的反事实实验表明，满足所有养老院需求所带来的净福利增益可能很小，因为这一增益可能会被Medicaid支出的增加所抵消。我们还发现，产品质量提高1%会导致3.2%的Medicaid患者被迫离开养老院。

abstract.text: Evidence Review and Guidelines Development ProcessThe process used to generate the 2015 AHA Guidelines Update for CPR and ECC was significantly different from the process used in prior releases of the Guidelines, and marks the planned transition from a 5-year cycle of evidence review to a continuous evidence evaluation process.The AHA continues to partner with the International Liaison Committee on Resuscitation (ILCOR) in the evidence review process.However, for 2015, ILCOR prioritized topics for systematic review based on clinical significance and availability of new

10.1161/cir.0000000000000252.abstractZh:
证据审查与指南制定流程  
2015年AHA心肺复苏术和紧急心脏通气管使用指南的编制过程与以往发布的指南相比有显著不同，标志着从每五年一次的循证审查周期向持续性的证据评估流程的转变。AHA在证据审查过程中继续与国际复苏联络委员会合作。不过，2015年ILCOR根据临床重要性和新证据的可用性，优先选择了需要系统审查的主题。

abstract.text: The health economics literature contains two models of selection, one with endogenous plan characteristics to attract good risks and one with fixed plan characteristics; neither model contains a regulator. Medicare Advantage, a principal example of selection in the literature, is, however, subject to anti-selection regulations. Because selection causes economic inefficiency and because the historically favorable selection into Medicare Advantage plans increased government cost, the effectiveness of the anti-selection regulations is an important policy question, especially since the Medicare Advantage program has grown to comprise 30 percent of Medicare beneficiaries. Moreover, similar anti-selection regulations are being used in health insurance exchanges for those under 65. Contrary to earlier work, we show that the strengthened anti-selection regulations that Medicare introduced starting in 2004 markedly reduced government overpayment attributable to favorable selection in Medicare Advantage. At least some of the remaining selection is plausibly related to fixed plan characteristics of Traditional Medicare versus Medicare Advantage rather than changed selection strategies by Medicare Advantage plans.

10.1162/ajhe_a_00001.abstractZh: 健康经济学文献中包含了两种选择模型，一种具有内生计划特征以吸引优质风险，另一种则具有固定的计划特征；这两种模型都没有包含监管机制。Medicare Advantage是文献中主要的例子，但它也受到反选择法规的约束。由于选择会导致经济效率低下，而且历史上选择进入Medicare Advantage计划的行为增加了政府成本，因此反选择法规的有效性是一个重要的政策问题，尤其是考虑到Medicare Advantage计划已经占到了Medicare受益人的30%。此外，类似的反选择法规也被用于65岁以下人群的医疗保险市场。与早期的研究不同，我们发现自2004年起Medicare引入的加强反选择法规显著减少了因Medicare Advantage中的有利选择而导致的政府过度支付。至少部分剩余的选择与Traditional Medicare和Medicare Advantage的固定计划特征有关，而不是由于Medicare Advantage计划的选择策略发生变化所致。

abstract.text: We analyze insurance-pricing regulation under imperfect competition on the Massachusetts health insurance exchange. Differential markups lead to price variation apart from cost variation. Coarse insurer pricing strategies identify consumer demand. Younger consumers are twice as price sensitive as older consumers. Older consumers thus face higher markups over costs. Modified community rating links prices for consumers differing in both costs and preferences, and changes the marginal consumer firms face. Stricter regulations transfer resources from low-cost to high-cost consumers, reduce firm profits, and increase overall consumer surplus.

10.1162/rest_a_00514.abstractZh: 我们分析了在马萨诸塞州健康保险交易所中，不完美竞争条件下的保险定价监管。不同的价格加成导致价格变化独立于成本变化。粗略的保险公司定价策略能够识别消费者需求。年轻消费者的价格敏感度是老年消费者的两倍。因此，老年消费者面临高于成本的更高价格加成。修改后的社区评级机制将价格与成本和偏好不同的消费者联系起来，并改变了边际消费者企业所面临的状况。更严格的监管政策会将资源从低成本消费者转移到高成本消费者，从而降低企业利润，并增加整体消费者剩余。

abstract.text: We draw on macroeconomic models of diffusion and productivity to explain empirical patterns of survival gains in heart attacks. Using Medicare data for 2.8 million patients during 1986-2004, we find that hospitals rapidly adopting cost-effective innovations such as beta blockers, aspirin, and reperfusion, had substantially better outcomes for their patients. Holding technology adoption constant, the marginal returns to spending were relatively modest. Hospitals increasing the pace of technology diffusion ("tigers") experienced triple the survival gains compared to those with diminished rates ("tortoises"). In sum, small differences in the propensity to adopt effective technology lead to wide productivity differences across hospitals.

10.1162/rest_a_00535.abstractZh: 我们借助宏观经济模型中的扩散和生产率理论，来解释心脏病发作患者生存获益的实证模式。通过1986至2004年间280万患者的Medicare数据，我们发现，那些迅速采用如β阻滞剂、阿司匹林和再灌注等成本效益高的创新技术的医院，其患者的治疗效果明显更好。在技术采用保持不变的情况下，支出的边际回报相对较为温和。而那些加快技术扩散速度的医院（“老虎”）与那些扩散速度较慢的医院（“乌龟”）相比，其生存获益增加了三倍。总之，在采用有效技术的倾向上微小的差异，会导致医院之间在生产力上的巨大差异。

abstract.text: Notwithstanding great progress in scientific and economic understanding of climate change, it has proven difficult to forge international agreements because of free-riding, as seen in the defunct Kyoto Protocol. This study examines the club as a model for international climate policy. Based on economic theory and empirical modeling, it finds that without sanctions against non-participants there are no stable coalitions other than those with minimal abatement. By contrast, a regime with small trade penalties on non-participants, a Climate Club, can induce a large stable coalition with high levels of abatement. (JEL Q54, Q58, K32, K33)

10.1257/aer.15000001.abstractZh: 尽管在气候变化的科学和经济理解方面取得了巨大进展，但由于搭便车行为，国际协议的达成仍然困难重重，这一点在已失效的《京都议定书》中得到了体现。本研究将“俱乐部”作为国际气候政策的模型进行探讨。基于经济理论和实证建模分析，研究发现，如果不对未参与国家实施制裁，除了那些采取最低减排措施的国家之外，其他国家很难形成稳定的联盟。相比之下，一个对未参与国家实施轻微贸易处罚的气候俱乐部，能够引导形成具有较高减排水平的稳定联盟。（JEL Q54, Q58, K32, K33）

abstract.text: Industrial organization studies the exercise and control of market power. To this purpose, it builds models that capture the essence of the situation. The predictions of the model can then be tested econometrically and possibly in the lab or the field. In the end, the reasonableness of, and robustness to modeling assumptions and the quality of empirical fit determine how confident economists are in making recommendations to public decision-makers for intervention, and to companies for the design of their business model. Industrial organization has a long tradition: first theoretical, with the work of French “engineer-economists” Antoine Augustin Cournot (1838) and Jules Dupuit (1844); then policy-oriented with the enactment of the Sherman Act (1890) and subsequent legislation; then descriptive with the studies of the Harvard school (“Structure-Conduct-Performance”) comforting and refining the antitrust drive; and finally skeptical with the Chicago school. The Chicago school correctly pointed out the lack of underlying theoretical doctrine and went on to cast doubt on the whole edifice. It however did not develop an alternative antitrust doctrine, perhaps because

10.1257/aer.15000024.abstractZh: 产业组织研究市场力量的行使与控制。为此，它构建了能够捕捉 상황本质的模型。模型的预测可以通过计量经济学方法进行检验，也可能在实验室或实地进行验证。最终，模型假设的合理性、对建模假设的稳健性以及实证拟合的质量决定了经济学家在向公共决策者提出干预建议以及为公司设计商业模式时所能提供的信心程度。产业组织有着悠久的传统：首先是理论层面的研究，以法国“工程师经济学家”安托万·奥古斯丁·库尔诺（1838年）和朱尔·杜普伊特（1844年）的工作为代表；然后是政策导向的研究，如《谢尔曼法案》的颁布及后续立法；接着是描述性研究，哈佛学派的“结构-行为-绩效”理论为反垄断运动提供了支持与完善；最后是以芝加哥学派为代表的批判性研究。芝加哥学派正确地指出了缺乏基础理论体系的缺陷，并进一步对整个体系提出了质疑。然而，它并没有发展出替代性的反垄断理论，这或许是因为……

abstract.text: We identify a key role of factor supply, driven by demographic changes, in shaping several empirical regularities that are a focus of active research in macro and labor economics. In particular, demographic changes alone can account for the large movements of the return to experience over the last four decades, for the differential dynamics of the age premium across education groups emphasized by Katz and Murphy (1992), for the differential dynamics of the college premium across age groups emphasized by Card and Lemieux (2001), and for the changes in cross-sectional and cohort-based life-cycle profiles emphasized by Kambourov and Manovskii (2005). (JEL D91, E24, I23, J11, J24, J31)

10.1257/aer.20080841.abstractZh: 我们发现，由人口变化驱动的因素供给在塑造一些实证规律中起着关键作用，这些规律是宏观经济学和劳动经济学领域研究的重点。特别是，仅人口变化就能解释过去四十年中经验回报的巨大波动、Katz和Murphy（1992）所强调的不同教育群体之间的年龄溢价差异、Card和Lemieux（2001）所强调的不同年龄群体之间的大学溢价差异，以及Kambourov和Manovskii（2005）所强调的跨截面和队列生命周期特征的变化。（JEL D91, E24, I23, J11, J24, J31）

abstract.text: Many real matching markets are subject to distributional constraints. These constraints often take the form of restrictions on the numbers of agents on one side of the market matched to certain subsets on the other side. Real-life examples include restrictions on regions in medical matching, academic master's programs in graduate admission, and state-financed seats for college admission. Motivated by these markets, we study design of matching mechanisms under distributional constraints. We show that existing matching mechanisms suffer from inefficiency and instability, and propose a mechanism that is better in terms of efficiency, stability, and incentives while respecting the distributional constraints. (JEL C70, D61, D63)

10.1257/aer.20101552.abstractZh: 许多现实中的匹配市场都受到分配约束的制约。这些约束通常表现为对市场上一方代理人数量的限制，以及另一方特定子集的限制。现实中的例子包括医疗匹配中对地区的限制、研究生录取中的学术硕士项目，以及大学录取中由州政府资助的席位。基于这些市场，我们研究了在分配约束下匹配机制的设计。我们发现现有的匹配机制存在效率低下和不稳定的问题，并提出了一种在效率、稳定性和激励方面都更优的机制，同时还能满足分配约束的要求。（JEL C70, D61, D63）

abstract.text: I study an economy where asymmetric information about the quality of capital endogenously determines liquidity. Liquid funds are key to relaxing financial constraints on investment and employment. These funds are obtained by selling capital or using it as collateral. Liquidity is determined by balancing the costs of obtaining liquidity under asymmetric information against the benefits of relaxing financial constraints. Aggregate fluctuations follow increases in the dispersion of capital quality, which raise the cost of obtaining liquidity. An estimated version of the model can generate patterns for quantities and credit conditions similar to the Great Recession. (JEL D82, E22, E24, E32, E44, G01)

10.1257/aer.20110035.abstractZh: 我研究的是一个经济体系，其中关于资本质量的非对称信息会内生性地决定流动性。流动性资金对于缓解投资和就业的金融约束至关重要。这些资金是通过出售资本或将其作为抵押品获得的。流动性的决定取决于在非对称信息下获取流动性的成本与缓解金融约束所带来的收益之间的平衡。资本质量的分散程度增加会导致总体波动，这会增加获取流动性的成本。该模型的估计版本能够生成与大衰退时期类似的货币量和信贷状况模式。（JEL D82, E22, E24, E32, E44, G01）

abstract.text: We provide a life-cycle framework for comparing insurance and disincentive effects of disability benefits. The risks that individuals face and the parameters of the Disability Insurance (DI ) program are estimated from consumption, health, disability insurance, and wage data. We characterize the effects of disability insurance and study how policy reforms impact behavior and welfare. DI features high rejection rates of disabled applicants and some acceptance of healthy applicants. Despite worse incentives, welfare increases as programs become less strict or generosity increases. Disability insurance interacts with welfare programs: making unconditional means-tested programs more generous improves disability insurance targeting and increases welfare.

10.1257/aer.20110108.abstractZh: 我们提供了一个生命周期框架，用于比较残疾福利的保险效应和抑制效应。通过消费、健康、残疾保险和工资数据，估算了个人面临的风险以及残疾保险（DI）计划的参数。我们描述了残疾保险的效果，并研究了政策改革对行为和福利的影响。残疾保险对残疾申请者的拒绝率较高，而对健康申请者则有一定的接受率。尽管激励措施较差，但随着计划变得不那么严格或提高福利程度，福利反而会增加。残疾保险与福利计划之间存在相互作用：使无条件的按需测试计划变得更加慷慨，可以提高残疾保险的目标定位，并增加福利。

abstract.text: We propose a new approach to test the full-information rational expectations hypothesis which can identify whether rejections of the null arise from information rigidities. This approach quantifies the economic significance of departures from the null and the underlying degree of information rigidity. Applying this approach to US and international data of professional forecasters and other agents yields pervasive evidence consistent with the presence of information rigidities. These results therefore provide a set of stylized facts which can be used to calibrate imperfect information models. Finally, we document evidence of state-dependence in the expectations formation process. (JEL C53, D83, D84, E13, E31, E37)

10.1257/aer.20110306.abstractZh: 我们提出了一种新的方法来检验完全信息理性预期假设，该方法能够确定拒绝零假设是否源于信息刚性。这种方法量化了偏离零假设的经济意义以及信息刚性的程度。将这种方法应用于美国和国际上的专业预测者及其他代理人的数据，得到了与信息刚性存在相一致的普遍证据。因此，这些结果提供了一组可以用于校准不完全信息模型的结构化事实。最后，我们发现了预期形成过程中存在状态依赖性的证据。（JEL C53, D83, D84, E13, E31, E37）

abstract.text: Electricity and water are often subsidized in developing countries to increase their affordability for low-income households. Ideally, such subsidies would create sufficient demand in poor neighborhoods to encourage private investment in their infrastructure. Instead, many regions receiving large subsidies have precarious distribution networks supplying users who never pay. Using a structural model of household electricity demand in Colombia, I predict the change in consumption and profits from upgrading low-quality electricity connections. I show that the existing subsidies, which provide greater transfers to areas with unreliable supply, deter investment to modernize infrastructure. Finally, I analyze alternative programs with stronger investment incentives. (JEL H23, H54, L94, L98, O12, O13)

10.1257/aer.20110572.abstractZh: 在发展中国家，电力和水资源常常被提供补贴，以提高低收入家庭的可负担性。理想情况下，这种补贴能够在贫困社区创造足够的需求，从而鼓励私人投资基础设施。然而，许多获得大量补贴的地区，其供电网络不稳定，导致用户无法支付费用。通过构建哥伦比亚家庭电力需求的结构模型，我预测了升级低质量电力连接所带来的消费和利润变化。研究表明，现有的补贴更倾向于向供应不稳定的地区转移资金，从而阻碍了基础设施现代化的投资。最后，我分析了具有更强投资激励措施的替代方案。（JEL H23, H54, L94, L98, O12, O13）

abstract.text: We consider an economy where individuals face uninsurable risks to their human capital accumulation and analyze the optimal level of linear taxes on capital and labor income together with the optimal path of government debt. We show that in the presence of such risks, it is beneficial to tax both labor and capital and to issue public debt. We also assess the quantitative importance of these findings, and show that the benefits of government debt and capital taxes both increase with the magnitude of idiosyncratic risks and the degree of relative risk aversion. (JEL D52, H21, H24, H25, H63, J24)

10.1257/aer.20110576.abstractZh: 我们考虑一个经济环境，其中个体面临无法投保的人力资本积累风险，并分析对资本和劳动收入征收线性税的最优水平以及政府债务的最优路径。我们表明，在存在此类风险的情况下，对劳动和资本征税并发行公共债务是有益的。我们还评估了这些发现的定量重要性，并表明政府债务和资本税的好处随着特殊风险的大小以及相对风险厌恶程度的增加而增加。（JEL D52, H21, H24, H25, H63, J24）

abstract.text: The paper studies how high household leverage and crises can be caused by changes in the income distribution. Empirically, the periods 1920–1929 and 1983–2008 both exhibited a large increase in the income share of high-income households, a large increase in debt leverage of low- and middle-income households, and an eventual financial and real crisis. The paper presents a theoretical model where higher leverage and crises are the endogenous result of a growing income share of high-income households. The model matches the profiles of the income distribution, the debt-to-income ratio and crisis risk for the three decades preceding the Great Recession. (JEL D14, D31, D33, E32, E44, G01, N22)

10.1257/aer.20110683.abstractZh: 本文研究了收入分配变化如何导致家庭杠杆率上升及危机的发生。实证研究表明，1920至1929年和1983至2008年期间，高收入家庭的收入份额均出现大幅增长，而低收入和中等收入家庭的家庭杠杆率也大幅上升，最终引发了金融和实体经济危机。本文提出了一个理论模型，该模型认为较高的杠杆率和危机是高收入家庭收入份额增长的内生结果。该模型与大衰退前三十年的收入分配、债务与收入比率以及危机风险特征相吻合。（JEL D14, D31, D33, E32, E44, G01, N22）

abstract.text: This paper empirically studies firm's strategic exit decisions in an environment where demand is declining. Specifically, I quantify the extent to which the exit process generated by firms' strategic interactions deviates from the outcome that maximizes industry profits. I develop and estimate a dynamic exit game using data from the US movie theater industry in the 1950s, when the industry faced demand declines. Using the estimated model, I quantify the magnitude of strategic delays and find that strategic interactions cause an average delay of exit of 2.7 years. I calculate the relative importance of several components of these strategic delays. (JEL D92, L11, L82, N72)

10.1257/aer.20110701.abstractZh: 本文通过实证研究，探讨了在需求下降环境下企业的战略退出决策。具体而言，本文量化了企业战略互动导致的退出过程与最大化行业利润结果之间的偏差程度。我们基于20世纪50年代美国电影行业的数据，开发并估计了一个动态退出模型。利用该模型，我们量化了战略延迟的幅度，发现战略互动导致企业平均退出延迟2.7年。我们还计算了这些战略延迟中各个组成部分的相对重要性。（JEL D92, L11, L82, N72）

abstract.text: Market outcomes depend on the quality of information available to its participants. We measure the effect of information disclosure on market outcomes using a large-scale field experiment that randomly discloses quality information in wholesale automobile auctions. We argue that buyers in this market are horizontally differentiated across cars that are vertically ranked by quality. This implies that information disclosure helps match heterogeneous buyers to cars of varying quality, causing both good and bad news to increase competition and revenues. The data confirm these hypotheses. These findings have implications for the design of other markets, including e-commerce, procurement auctions, and labor markets. (JEL C93, D44, D82, L15)

10.1257/aer.20110753.abstractZh: 市场结果取决于参与者可获得的信息质量。我们通过一项大规模实地实验来衡量信息披露对市场结果的影响，该实验在批发汽车拍卖中随机披露了高质量信息。我们认为，该市场的买家在汽车质量上存在横向差异，而汽车质量则存在纵向排序。这意味着信息披露有助于将不同质量的汽车与不同的买家匹配起来，从而促使竞争和收入的增加，无论好坏。数据证实了这些假设。这些发现对其他市场设计具有启示意义，包括电子商务、采购拍卖和劳动力市场。（JEL C93, D44, D82, L15）

abstract.text: This paper develops axiomatically a revealed preference theory of reference-dependent choice behavior. Instead of taking the reference for an agent as exogenously given in the description of a choice problem, we suitably relax the Weak Axiom of Revealed Preference to obtain, endogenously, the existence of reference alternatives as well as the structure of choice behavior conditional on those alternatives. We show how this model captures some well-known choice patterns such as the attraction effect. (JEL D11, D81)

10.1257/aer.20111046.abstractZh: 本文公理性地发展了一种揭示偏好理论，用于描述依赖参考的选择行为。我们不再将代理人的参考设定为选择问题描述中外部给定的信息，而是适当放宽揭示偏好的弱公理，从而内生地获得参考选项的存在性以及在这些选项条件下的选择行为结构。我们展示了该模型如何捕捉一些常见的选择模式，例如吸引效应。（JEL D11, D81）

abstract.text: We argue that US welfare would rise if unemployment insurance were increased for younger and decreased for older workers. This is because the young tend to lack the means to smooth consumption during unemployment and want jobs to accumulate high-return human capital. So unemployment insurance is most valuable to them, while moral hazard is mild. By calibrating a life cycle model with unemployment risk and endogenous search effort, we find that allowing unemployment replacement rates to decline with age yields sizeable welfare gains to US workers. (JEL D91, E24, J13, J64, J65)

10.1257/aer.20111559.abstractZh: 我们认为，如果为年轻工人增加失业保险，而为年长工人减少失业保险，美国的福利将会提高。这是因为年轻人在失业期间往往缺乏平滑消费的手段，他们希望工作能够积累高回报的人力资本。因此，失业保险对他们来说最为重要，而道德风险相对较低。通过校准一个包含失业风险和内生搜索努力的生命周期模型，我们发现允许失业保险替代率随年龄下降，可以为美国工人带来显著的福利收益。（JEL D91, E24, J13, J64, J65）

abstract.text: This paper uses an assignment model to understand the cross section of house prices within a metro area. Movers’ demand for housing is derived from a life-cycle problem with credit market frictions. Equilibrium house prices adjust to assign houses that differ by quality to movers who differ by age, income, and wealth. To quantify the model, we measure distributions of house prices, house qualities, and mover characteristics from micro-data on San Diego County during the 2000s boom. The main result is that cheaper credit for poor households was a major driver of prices, especially at the low end of the market. (JEL D14, D91, R21, R31)

10.1257/aer.20111662.abstractZh: 本文采用分配模型来理解一个都市区域内房价的横截面特征。购房者对住房的需求源于生命周期问题，同时伴随着信贷市场的摩擦。均衡房价会调整，将不同质量的房屋分配给不同年龄、收入和财富水平的购房者。为了量化该模型，我们基于2000年代圣地亚哥县经济繁荣时期的微观数据，对房价分布、房屋质量以及购房者特征进行了分析。主要结论是，对贫困家庭提供更低的信贷条件是推动房价上涨的主要因素，尤其是在市场的低端区域。（JEL D14, D91, R21, R31）

abstract.text: We use microdata to show that young households with children are underinsured against the risk that an adult member of the household dies. This empirical finding can be explained by a macroeconomic model with human capital risk, age-dependent returns to human capital investment, and endogenous borrowing constraints due to limited contract enforcement. When calibrated, the model quantitatively accounts for the observed life-cycle variation in life insurance holdings, financial wealth, earnings, and consumption inequality. The model also predicts that reforms making consumer bankruptcy more costly will substantially increase the volume of both credit and insurance. (JEL D14, D91, G22, J13, J24)

10.1257/aer.20111681.abstractZh: 我们使用微观数据表明，有孩子的年轻家庭在面临家庭主要成员死亡风险时，其保险覆盖不足。这一实证发现可以通过一个包含人力资本风险、年龄依赖的人力资本投资回报以及由于合同执行限制导致的内生性借贷约束的宏观经济模型来解释。经过校准后，该模型能够定量解释生命周期中人寿保险持有量、金融财富、收入以及消费不平等的变化。该模型还预测，使消费者破产成本增加的改革措施将显著增加信贷和保险的规模。（JEL D14, D91, G22, J13, J24）

abstract.text: This paper uses the rollout of the first Community Health Centers (CHCs) to study the longer-term health effects of increasing access to primary care. Within ten years, CHCs are associated with a reduction in age-adjusted mortality rates of 2 percent among those 50 and older. The implied 7 to 13 percent decrease in one-year mortality risk among beneficiaries amounts to 20 to 40 percent of the 1966 poor/non-poor mortality gap for this age group. Large effects for those 65 and older suggest that increased access to primary care has longer-term benefits, even for populations with near universal health insurance. (JEL H75, I12, I13, I18, I32, I38, J14).

10.1257/aer.20120070.abstractZh: 本文以首批社区健康中心的建设为研究对象，探讨增加初级医疗服务可及性对长期健康影响的效应。在十年内，社区健康中心与50岁及以上人群的年龄调整死亡率降低了2%。受益者一年的死亡风险降低了7%至13%，这一降幅相当于1966年该年龄组贫富人群死亡差距的20%至40%。对于65岁及以上的人群而言，增加初级医疗服务可及性的长期效益更为显著，即使是在医疗保险几乎普及的人群中也是如此。（JEL H75, I12, I13, I18, I32, I38, J14）

abstract.text: This paper provides evidence on the importance of reputation in the context of the Kenyan rose export sector. A model of reputation and relational contracting is developed and tested. A seller's reputation is defined by buyer's beliefs about seller's reliability. We show that (i) due to lack of enforcement, the volume of trade is constrained by the value of the relationship; (ii) the value of the relationship increases with the age of the relationship; and (iii) during an exogenous negative supply shock deliveries are an inverted-U shaped function of relationship's age. Models exclusively focusing on enforcement or insurance considerations cannot account for the evidence. (JEL D86, F14, L14, O13, O19, Q17)

10.1257/aer.20120141.abstractZh: 本文提供了关于声誉在肯尼亚玫瑰出口领域重要性的证据。文中构建并测试了一个关于声誉与关系契约的模型。卖方声誉由买方对卖方可靠性的信念决定。我们发现：(i)由于缺乏执行机制，贸易量受到关系价值的约束；(ii)关系价值随着关系的持续时间而增加；(iii)在外部负面供应冲击期间，交货量呈现倒U形关系。仅关注执行机制或保险因素的模型无法解释这些现象。(JEL D86, F14, L14, O13, O19, Q17)

abstract.text: This paper examines how divorce laws affect couples' intertemporal choices and well-being. Exploiting panel variation in US laws, I estimate the parameters of a model of household decision-making. Household survey data indicate that the introduction of unilateral divorce in states that imposed an equal division of property is associated with higher household savings and lower female employment, implying a distortion in household assets accumulation and a transfer toward wives whose share in household resources is smaller than the one of their husband. When spouses share consumption equally, separate property or prenuptial agreements can reduce distortions and increase equity. (JEL D13, D14, D91, J12, J16, K36)

10.1257/aer.20120234.abstractZh: 本文探讨了离婚法律如何影响夫妻之间的跨时期选择与福祉。通过利用美国法律的变化趋势，我估算了一个家庭决策模型的参数。家庭调查数据表明，在实行财产平等分割的州中，单方面离婚政策的实施与更高的家庭储蓄和较低的女性就业率相关，这表明家庭资产积累出现了扭曲，且资源分配更多地偏向妻子，其份额小于丈夫的份额。当夫妻平等分担消费时，分开财产或婚前协议可以减少这种扭曲，并增强公平性。（JEL D13, D14, D91, J12, J16, K36）

abstract.text: Following FCC pressure to end bill shock, cellular carriers now alert customers when they exceed usage allowances. We estimate a model of plan choice, usage, and learning using a 2002–2004 panel of cellular bills. Accounting for firm price adjustment, we predict that implementing alerts in 2002–2004 would have lowered average annual consumer welfare by $33. We show that consumers are inattentive to past usage, meaning that bill-shock alerts are informative. Additionally, our estimates imply that consumers are overconfident, underestimating the variance of future calling. Overconfidence costs consumers $76 annually at 2002–2004 prices. Absent overconfidence, alerts would have little to no effect. (JEL D12, D18, L11, L96, L98)

10.1257/aer.20120283.abstractZh: 在FCC要求结束账单冲击后，移动运营商现在会在用户超出使用额度时向用户发出提醒。我们通过2002-2004年的手机账单数据，建立了一个关于计划选择、使用情况和学习过程的模型。考虑到企业价格调整的因素，我们预测在2002-2004年期间实施提醒机制，将使消费者平均每年获得的福利减少33美元。我们的研究表明，消费者对过去的使用情况不够关注，这意味着账单冲击提醒具有信息价值。此外，我们的估计还表明，消费者过于自信，低估了未来通话的波动。如果不存在这种过度自信，提醒机制几乎不会产生任何效果。（JEL D12, D18, L11, L96, L98）

abstract.text: We investigate the relationship between political networks, weak institutions, and election fraud during the 2010 parliamentary election in Afghanistan combining: (i) data on political connections between candidates and election officials; (ii) a nationwide controlled evaluation of a novel monitoring technology; and (iii) direct measurements of aggregation fraud. We find considerable evidence of aggregation fraud in favor of connected candidates and that the announcement of a new monitoring technology reduced theft of election materials by about 60 percent and vote counts for connected candidates by about 25 percent. The results have implications for electoral competition and are potentially actionable for policymakers. (JEL C93, D02, D72, K42, O17)

10.1257/aer.20120427.abstractZh: 我们研究了2010年阿富汗议会选举期间政治网络、薄弱制度与选举舞弊之间的关系，结合了以下三个方面的数据：(i) 候选人与选举官员之间的政治联系数据；(ii) 对一种新型监控技术的全国范围控制性评估；以及(iii) 对聚合舞弊的直接测量。我们发现，存在大量支持有联系候选人的聚合舞弊现象，并且新监控技术的宣布使选举材料的盗窃减少了约60%，同时使有联系候选人的计票结果增加了约25%。这些结果对选举竞争具有启示意义，并可能对政策制定者产生实际影响。(JEL C93, D02, D72, K42, O17)

abstract.text: Does credit availability exacerbate asset price inflation? Are there long-run consequences? During the farm land price boom and bust before the Great Depression, we find that credit availability directly inflated land prices. Credit also amplified the relationship between positive fundamentals and land prices, leading to greater indebtedness. When fundamentals soured, areas with higher credit availability suffered a greater fall in land prices and had more bank failures. Land prices and credit availability also remained disproportionately low for decades in these areas, suggesting that leverage might render temporary credit-induced booms and busts persistent. We draw lessons for regulatory policy. (JEL E31, G21, G28, N22, N52, Q12, Q14)

10.1257/aer.20120525.abstractZh: 信贷供应是否加剧了资产价格通胀？是否存在长期后果？在大萧条之前的农业土地价格繁荣与萧条期间，我们发现信贷供应直接推高了土地价格。信贷还放大了基本面良好与土地价格之间的关系，导致债务负担加重。当基本面恶化时，信贷供应较高的地区土地价格跌幅更大，银行倒闭的情况也更频繁。这些地区的土地价格和信贷供应在数十年间仍然处于极低水平，这表明杠杆效应可能会使临时性的信贷引发的繁荣与萧条变得持久。我们为监管政策提供了一些启示。（JEL E31, G21, G28, N22, N52, Q12, Q14）

abstract.text: We study the procompetitive gains from international trade in a quantitative model with endogenously variable markups. We find that trade can significantly reduce markup distortions if two conditions are satisfied: (i) there is extensive misallocation, and (ii) opening to trade exposes hitherto dominant producers to greater competitive pressure. We measure the extent to which these two conditions are satisfied in Taiwanese producer-level data. Versions of our model consistent with the Taiwanese data predict that opening up to trade strongly increases competition and reduces markup distortions by up to one-half, thus significantly reducing productivity losses due to misallocation. (JEL D43, F12, F14, L13, L60, O47)

10.1257/aer.20120549.abstractZh: 我们在一个具有内生可变加价的定量模型中研究了国际贸易对促进竞争的好处。我们发现，如果满足以下两个条件，贸易可以显著减少加价扭曲：（i）存在广泛的资源错配，以及（ii）开放贸易使迄今为止占据主导地位的生产者面临更大的竞争压力。我们通过台湾生产者层面的数据来衡量这两个条件满足的程度。与台湾数据一致的模型版本预测，开放贸易会显著增强竞争，并将加价扭曲减少一半，从而大幅减少因资源错配导致的生产力损失。（JEL D43, F12, F14, L13, L60, O47）

abstract.text: A quantitative investigation of financial intermediation in the United States over the past 130 years yields the following results: (i) the finance industry's share of gross domestic product (GDP) is high in the 1920s, low in the 1960s, and high again after 1980; (ii) most of these variations can be explained by corresponding changes in the quantity of intermediated assets (equity, household and corporate debt, liquidity); (iii) intermediation has constant returns to scale and an annual cost of 1.5–2 percent of intermediated assets; (iv) secular changes in the characteristics of firms and households are quantitatively important. (JEL D24, E44, G21, G32, N22)

10.1257/aer.20120578.abstractZh: 对过去130年美国金融中介活动的定量研究得出以下结果：(i) 20世纪20年代，金融行业的国内生产总值占比较高，20世纪60年代较低，而1980年后又再次上升；(ii) 这些变化大多可以通过中介资产数量的变化来解释，包括股票、家庭债务、企业债务以及流动性等；(iii) 金融中介活动具有规模报酬不变的特性，其年度成本约为中介资产金额的1.5%至2%；(iv) 企业和家庭特征的长期变化在定量上具有重要意义。(JEL D24, E44, G21, G32, N22)

abstract.text: We revisit to what extent the increase in income inequality since 1980 was mirrored by consumption inequality. We do so by constructing an alternative measure of consumption expenditure using a demand system to correct for systematic measurement error in the Consumer Expenditure Survey. Our estimation exploits the relative expenditure of high- and low-income households on luxuries versus necessities. This double differencing corrects for measurement error that can vary over time by good and income. We find consumption inequality tracked income inequality much more closely than estimated by direct responses on expenditures. (JEL D31, D63, E21)

10.1257/aer.20120599.abstractZh: 我们重新审视了自1980年以来收入不平等的增加在消费不平等中的体现程度。我们通过构建一个替代性的消费支出衡量指标来实现这一点，该指标利用需求系统来纠正消费者支出调查中的系统性测量误差。我们的估计利用了高收入家庭和低收入家庭在奢侈品与必需品上的相对支出差异。这种双重差分方法能够纠正因商品类型和收入差异而导致的测量误差。我们发现，消费不平等的追踪效果比直接基于支出估计的结果更为准确。（JEL D31, D63, E21）

abstract.text: The Great Migration-the massive migration of African Americans out of the rural South to largely urban locations in the North, Midwest, and West-was a landmark event in U.S. History Our paper shows that this migration increased mortality of African Americans born in the early twentieth century South. This inference comes from an analysis that uses proximity of birthplace to railroad lines as an instrument for migration.

10.1257/aer.20120642.abstractZh: 大规模的非裔美国人从美国南部农村迁移到北部、中西部和西部的大城市，这一“大迁移”是美国历史上的一个标志性事件。我们的论文表明，这种迁移加剧了20世纪初出生于美国南部地区的非裔美国人的死亡率。这一推论是基于一项分析得出的，该分析以出生地与铁路线的距离作为迁移的指标。

abstract.text: We study whether people became less likely to switch Medicare prescription drug plans (PDPs) due to more options and more time in Part D. Panel data for a random 20 percent sample of enrollees from 2006--2010 show that 50 percent were not in their original PDPs by 2010. Individuals switched PDPs in response to higher costs of their status quo plans, saving them money. Contrary to choice overload, larger choice sets increased switching unless the additional plans were relatively expensive. Neither switching overall nor responsiveness to costs declined over time, and above-minimum spending in 2010 remained below the 2006 and 2007 levels.

10.1257/aer.20120651.abstractZh: 我们研究了人们是否因为选择更多且D阶段的时间更长而减少了更换医疗保险处方药物计划（PDPs）的意愿。对2006年至2010年间随机抽取的20%参保人的面板数据进行分析发现，到2010年，有50%的人不再使用原来的PDPs。个体之所以更换PDPs，是因为现状计划的成本更高，从而节省了资金。与选择过载的情况相反，除非额外的计划相对昂贵，否则更大的选择范围反而增加了更换的可能性。无论是整体更换频率还是对成本的响应能力，随着时间的推移都没有下降，而且2010年的最低支出仍然低于2006年和2007年的水平。

abstract.text: We conduct a social dilemma experiment in which real-world leaders can punish group members as a third party. Despite facing an identical environment, leaders are found to take remarkably different punishment approaches. The different leader types revealed experimentally explain the relative success of groups in managing their forest commons. Leaders who emphasize equality and efficiency see positive forest outcomes. Antisocial leaders, who punish indiscriminately, see relatively negative forest outcomes. Our results highlight the importance of leaders in collective action, and more generally the idiosyncratic but powerful roles that leaders may play, leading to substantial variation in group cooperation outcomes. (JEL C93, D03, O13, Q23)
