10.1257/aer.20120700.abstractZh: 我们开展了一项社会困境实验，实验中现实世界中的领导者可以作为第三方对小组成员进行惩罚。尽管面临相同的环境，领导者们采取的惩罚方式却存在显著差异。实验揭示的不同类型领导者解释了各群体在管理森林公共资源方面的相对成功。强调平等和效率的领导者认为森林管理会取得积极成果，而不分青红皂白进行惩罚的反社会型领导者则认为森林管理结果相对消极。我们的研究结果强调了领导者在集体行动中的重要性，以及领导者可能扮演的独特而强大的角色，这些因素导致了群体合作结果的巨大差异。（JEL C93, D03, O13, Q23）

abstract.text: We use data from a housing-assistance experiment to estimate a model of neighborhood choice. The experimental variation effectively randomizes the rents which households face and helps identify a key structural parameter. Access to two randomly selected treatment groups and a control group allows for out-of-sample validation of the model. We simulate the effects of changing the subsidy-use constraints implemented in the actual experiment. We find that restricting subsidies to even lower poverty neighborhoods would substantially reduce take-up and actually increase average exposure to poverty. Furthermore, adding restrictions based on neighborhood racial composition would not change average exposure to either race or poverty. (JEL I32, I38, R23, R38)

10.1257/aer.20120737.abstractZh: 我们利用一项住房援助实验的数据来估算一个关于社区选择的模型。实验中的随机变化有效地使家庭面临的租金产生随机性，这有助于识别一个关键的结构性参数。通过访问两个随机选定的实验组和一个对照组，我们可以对模型进行样本外验证。我们模拟了在实际实验中实施的补贴使用限制变化所带来的影响。我们发现，将补贴限制在更贫困的社区，会显著减少补贴的接受率，反而会增加社区面临贫困的风险。此外，基于社区种族构成施加的限制并不会改变社区面临任何种族或贫困的风险。（JEL I32, I38, R23, R38）

abstract.text: This paper analyzes how asset prices in a binary market react to information when traders have heterogeneous prior beliefs. We show that the competitive equilibrium price underreacts to information when there is a bound to the amount of money traders are allowed to invest. Underreaction is more pronounced when prior beliefs are more heterogeneous. Even in the absence of exogenous bounds on the amount that traders can invest, prices underreact to information provided that traders become less risk averse as their wealth increases. In a dynamic setting, underreaction results in initial momentum and then reversal in the long run. (JEL D83, D84, G11, G12, G14)

10.1257/aer.20120881.abstractZh: 本文分析了在交易者持有异质先验信念的情况下，二元市场中的资产价格如何对信息作出反应。我们指出，在交易者可投资资金量存在限制的情况下，竞争均衡价格对信息的反应不足。当先验信念更加异质时，这种反应不足更为明显。即使没有外部限制交易者可投资资金量的限制，只要交易者随着财富的增加而变得不那么厌恶风险，价格对信息的反应也会不足。在动态环境中，这种反应不足会导致初始的动量，随后在长期内出现反转。（JEL D83, D84, G11, G12, G14）

abstract.text: We develop a theory of fertility, distinguishing its intensive margin from its extensive margin. The deep parameters are identified using facts from the 1990 US Census: (i) fertility of mothers decreases with education; (ii) childlessness exhibits a U-shaped relationship with education; (iii) the relationship between marriage rates and education is hump-shaped for women and increasing for men. We estimate that 2.5 percent of women were childless because of poverty and 8.1 percent because of high opportunity cost of childrearing. Over time, historical trends in total factor productivity and in education led to a U-shaped response in childlessness rates while fertility of mothers decreased.

10.1257/aer.20120926.abstractZh: 我们提出了一种生育率的理论模型，区分了生育率的集约边际与广延边际。通过1990年美国人口普查的数据确定了相关参数：(i) 母亲的生育率随教育水平的提高而下降；(ii) 无子女现象与教育水平呈U形关系；(iii) 婚姻率与教育水平之间的关系在女性中呈驼峰形，而在男性中则呈上升趋势。我们估计，有2.5%的女性因贫困而无子女，8.1%的女性因抚养子女的机会成本过高而无子女。随着时间的推移，全要素生产力和教育水平的历史趋势导致无子女率呈现U形反应，同时母亲的生育率也有所下降。

abstract.text: During the financial crisis, life insurers sold long-term policies at deep discounts relative to actuarial value. The average markup was as low as −19 percent for annuities and −57 percent for life insurance. This extraordinary pricing behavior was due to financial and product market frictions, interacting with statutory reserve regulation that allowed life insurers to record far less than a dollar of reserve per dollar of future insurance liability. We identify the shadow cost of capital through exogenous variation in required reserves across different types of policies. The shadow cost was $0.96 per dollar of statutory capital for the average company in November 2008. (JEL G01, G22, G28, G32)

10.1257/aer.20121036.abstractZh: 在金融危机期间，人寿保险公司以远低于精算价值的折扣价出售长期保险保单。年金的平均加价低至-19%，而人寿保险的加价则低至-57%。这种异常定价行为是由于金融和市场产品方面的摩擦，以及法定储备监管的规定，导致人寿保险公司每承担一美元的未来保险责任，所记录的储备资金远低于一美元。我们通过不同类型保单所需储备金的外生变化，识别出资本的影子成本。2008年11月，平均公司的影子成本为每美元法定资本0.96美元。（JEL G01, G22, G28, G32）

abstract.text: We develop an equilibrium wage-posting model with heterogeneous firms that decide to locate in the formal or the informal sector and workers who search randomly on and off the job. We estimate the model on Brazilian labor force survey data. In equilibrium, firms of equal productivity locate in different sectors, a fact observed in the data. Wages are characterized by compensating differentials. We show that tightening enforcement does not increase unemployment and increases wages, total output, and welfare by enabling better allocation of workers to higher productivity jobs and improving competition in the formal labor market. (JEL E26, J24, J31, J46, O15, O17)

10.1257/aer.20121110.abstractZh: 我们开发了一个具有异质企业的均衡工资发布模型，这些企业决定在正规或非正规部门经营，而工人则在工作内外进行随机搜索。我们在巴西劳动力调查数据上对该模型进行了估计。在均衡状态下，同等生产力的企业会分布在不同的部门，这一事实在数据中得到了验证。工资具有补偿性差异的特点。我们表明，加强执法并不会增加失业率，反而会通过让工人更好地分配到高生产力的工作岗位以及改善正规劳动力市场的竞争，从而提高工资、总产出和福利水平。（JEL E26, J24, J31, J46, O15, O17）

abstract.text: We study how unexpected changes in uncertainty about fiscal policy affect economic activity. First, we estimate tax and spending processes for the United States with time-varying volatility to uncover evidence of time-varying volatility. Second, we estimate a VAR for the US economy using the time-varying volatility found in the previous step. Third, we feed the tax and spending processes into an otherwise standard New Keynesian model. Both in the VAR and in the model, we find that unexpected changes in fiscal volatility shocks can have a sizable adverse effect on economic activity. An endogenous increase in markups is a key mechanism. (JEL E12, E23, E32, E52, E62)

10.1257/aer.20121236.abstractZh: 我们研究了财政政策不确定性发生的意外变化如何影响经济活动。首先，我们估算了美国税收和支出过程，并考虑了时间变化的波动性，以发现时间变化波动性的证据。其次，我们使用前一步骤中发现的时间变化波动性，估算了美国经济的向量自回归模型。第三，我们将税收和支出过程输入到一个标准的新凯恩斯模型中。无论是在向量自回归模型中，还是在模型中，我们都发现财政波动性的意外变化会对经济活动产生显著的负面影响。内生性的价格加成增加是其中一个关键机制。（JEL E12, E23, E32, E52, E62）

abstract.text: Teacher contracts that condition pay and retention on demonstrated performance can improve selection into and out of teaching. I study alternative contracts in a simulated teacher labor market that incorporates dynamic self-selection and Bayesian learning. Bonus policies create only modest incentives and thus have small effects on selection. Reductions in tenure rates can have larger effects, but must be accompanied by substantial salary increases; elimination of tenure confers little additional benefit unless firing rates are extremely high. Benefits of both bonus and tenure policies exceed costs, though optimal policies are sensitive to labor market parameters about which little is known. (JEL I21, J22, J23, J24, J31, J41, J45)

10.1257/aer.20121242.abstractZh: 教师合同规定基于表现来支付薪酬和保留教师职位，这一做法可以提高教师的选择率。我在一个模拟的教师劳动力市场中进行研究，该市场包含动态自我选择机制和贝叶斯学习过程。奖金政策只能提供适度的激励，因此对选择的影响较小。减少终身教职的幅度可能会产生更大的影响，但必须伴随大幅的薪资增长；取消终身教职除了在解雇率极高的情况下，不会带来额外的好处。无论是奖金政策还是终身教职政策，其带来的好处都超过了成本，不过最优政策会受到劳动力市场参数的影响，而这些参数目前还知之甚少。（JEL I21, J22, J23, J24, J31, J41, J45）

abstract.text: When will solidarity, which emerges spontaneously from the fear of spillovers, be reinforced through contracting? The optimal pact between countries that differ substantially in their probability of distress is a simple debt contract with market financing, a borrowing cap, but no joint liability. While joint liability augments total surplus, the borrowing country cannot compensate the deep-pocket guarantor. By contrast, the optimal pact between two countries symmetrically exposed to shocks with an arbitrary correlation is a simple debt contract with joint liability, provided that shocks are sufficiently independent, spillovers sufficiently large, liquidity needs moderate, and available sanctions sufficiently tough. (JEL D86, F34, H63)

10.1257/aer.20121248.abstractZh: 当出于对溢出效应的担忧而自发产生的团结性，如何通过契约来加强呢？在两国在面临困境的概率上存在显著差异的情况下，最优的契约是一种简单的债务契约，采用市场融资方式，设定借款上限，但不承担共同责任。虽然共同责任能够增加总剩余，但借款国无法补偿资金雄厚的担保人。相比之下，当两国对称地暴露于冲击中，且冲击具有任意相关性时，最优的契约是一种带有共同责任的简单债务契约，前提是冲击足够独立，溢出效应足够大，流动性需求适中，且可用制裁足够严厉。（JEL D86, F34, H63）

abstract.text: In many economic, political, and social situations, circumstances change at random points in time, reacting is costly, and reactions appropriate to present circumstances may become inappropriate upon future changes, requiring further costly reaction. Waiting is informative if arrival of the next change has non-constant hazard rate. We identify two classes of situations: in the first, delayed reaction is optimal only when the hazard rate of further changes is decreasing; in the second, it is optimal only when the hazard rate of further changes is increasing. These results in semi-Markovian decision theory provide motivations for building delay into decision systems. (JEL C61, D72, D82, D83, K10, M11)

10.1257/aer.20121282.abstractZh: 在许多经济、政治和社会情境中，情况会在随机的时间点发生变化，做出反应的成本很高，而针对当前情况的适当反应在将来发生变化时可能会变得不再适用，从而需要进一步的昂贵反应。如果下一次变化的出现具有非恒定的风险率，那么等待则具有信息价值。我们将这种情况分为两类：在第一类中，延迟反应只有在进一步变化的风险率下降时才是最优的；在第二类中，延迟反应只有在进一步变化的风险率上升时才是最优的。这些在半马尔可夫决策理论中的结果为在决策系统中引入延迟提供了依据。（JEL C61, D72, D82, D83, K10, M11）

abstract.text: The well-known double marginalization problem understates the inefficiencies arising from vertical relations in consumer search markets where consumers are uninformed about the wholesale prices charged by manufacturers to retailers. Consumer search provides a monopoly manufacturer with an additional incentive to increase its price, worsening the double marginalization problem and lowering the manufacturer's profits. Nevertheless, manufacturers in more competitive wholesale markets may not have an incentive to reveal their prices to consumers. We show that retail prices decrease in search cost, and so both industry profits and consumer surplus increase in search cost. (JEL D11, D42, D83, L12, L25, L60, L81)

10.1257/aer.20121317.abstractZh: 众所周知的双重边际化问题低估了消费者搜索市场中由于消费者无法了解制造商向零售商收取的总价而产生的效率低下问题。消费者搜索行为使得垄断制造商有额外的动机提高价格，从而加剧双重边际化问题并降低制造商的利润。然而，在竞争更激烈的批发市场中，制造商可能没有动机向消费者透露其价格。我们表明，搜索成本降低会导致零售价格下降，因此搜索成本的增加会同时提升行业利润和消费者剩余。（JEL D11, D42, D83, L12, L25, L60, L81）

abstract.text: An exogenous expansion in mortgage credit has significant effects on house prices. This finding is established using US branching deregulations between 1994 and 2005 as instruments for credit. Credit increases for deregulated banks, but not in placebo samples. Such differential responses rule out demand-based explanations, and identify an exogenous credit supply shock. Because of geographic diver-sification, treated banks expand credit: housing demand increases, house prices rise, but to a lesser extent in areas with elastic housing supply, where the housing stock increases instead. In an instrumental variable sense, house prices are well explained by the credit expansion induced by deregulation. (JEL G21, G28, R21, R31)

10.1257/aer.20121416.abstractZh: 抵押贷款信贷的外生扩张对房价有显著影响。这一发现是通过使用1994年至2005年间美国的银行分支机构放松管制作为信贷的代理变量来建立的。放松管制的银行的信贷增加了，但安慰剂样本中的信贷并未增加。这种不同的反应排除了基于需求的解释，并表明存在外生的信贷供应冲击。由于地理上的差异，受影响的银行扩大了信贷：住房需求增加，房价上升，但在住房供应弹性较大的地区，房价上升的幅度较小，因为此时住房存量增加了。从代理变量的角度来看，房价可以通过放松管制引发的信贷扩张很好地解释。（JEL G21, G28, R21, R31）

abstract.text: We consider a multi-battle team contest in which players from two rival teams form pairwise matches to fight in distinct component battles, which are carried out sequentially or (partially) simultaneously. A team wins if and only if its players win a majority of battles. Each player benefits from his team's win, while he can also receive a private reward for winning his own battle. We find that the outcomes of past battles do not distort the outcomes of future battles. Neither the total expected effort nor the overall outcome of the contest depends on the contest's temporal structure or its feedback policy. (JEL C72, D72, D74, D82)

10.1257/aer.20121469.abstractZh: 我们考虑了一种多队伍比赛，其中来自两个敌对队伍的选手会进行两两对战，在各自的战斗中进行较量，这些战斗可以依次进行，也可以部分同时进行。一个队伍获胜的条件是其选手在多数战斗中获胜。每个选手都会从队伍的获胜中获益，同时他还可以因自己赢得的战斗而获得个人奖励。我们发现，过去战斗的结果并不会影响未来战斗的结果。无论是总预期努力量还是比赛的整体结果，都不依赖于比赛的时间结构或反馈策略。（JEL C72, D72, D74, D82）

abstract.text: We address the role of “psychological frictions” in the incomplete take-up of EITC benefits with an IRS field experiment. We specifically assess the influence of program confusion, informational complexity, and stigma by evaluating response to experimental mailings distributed to 35,050 tax filers who failed to claim $26 million despite an initial notice. While the mere receipt of the mailing, simplification, and the heightened salience of benefits led to substantial additional claiming, attempts to reduce perceived costs of stigma, application, and audits did not. The study, and accompanying surveys, suggests that low program awareness/understanding and informational complexity contribute to the puzzle of low take-up. (JEL C93, D03, H24, M38)

10.1257/aer.20121493.abstractZh: 我们通过一项IRS实地实验，探讨了“心理摩擦”在EITC福利不完全领取中的作用。我们具体评估了项目混淆、信息复杂性和污名化对领取行为的影响，通过向35,050名未能领取2600万美元福利的纳税人分发实验邮件来进行研究。虽然仅仅收到邮件、信息的简化以及福利的显著性提升都导致了显著的额外领取行为，但试图降低污名化、申请程序和审计成本的努力并未取得效果。该研究及相关的调查表明，项目认知度低和信息复杂性高是导致领取率低的因素之一。（JEL C93, D03, H24, M38）

abstract.text: This paper studies the impact of an R&D cost shock on R&D investments, imported inputs, and their joint impact on firm performance. We introduce imported inputs into a model of R&D and endogenous productivity, and show that R&D and international sourcing are complementary activities. Exploiting the introduction of an R&D tax credit in Norway in 2002, we find that cheaper R&D stimulated not only R&D investments but also imports of intermediates, quantitatively consistent with the model. An implication of our work is that improved access to imported inputs promotes R&D investments and, ultimately, technological change. (JEL D92, F14, G31, H25, L25, O32, O33)

10.1257/aer.20121530.abstractZh: 本文研究了研发成本冲击对研发投资、进口投入及其对企业绩效的联合影响。我们将进口投入引入一个研发与内生生产率模型，并表明研发与国际采购是互补的活动。通过利用挪威在2002年实施的研发税收抵免政策，我们发现更低的研发成本不仅刺激了研发投资，还促进了中间品的进口，这与模型结果一致。我们的研究表明，改善对进口投入的获取有助于促进研发投资，最终推动技术变革。（JEL D92, F14, G31, H25, L25, O32, O33）

abstract.text: We study the cyclical properties of sales, regular price changes, and average prices paid by consumers (“effective” prices) using data on prices and quantities sold for numerous retailers across many US metropolitan areas. Inflation in the effective prices paid by consumers declines significantly with higher unemployment while little change occurs in the inflation rate of prices posted by retailers. This difference reflects the reallocation of household expenditures across retailers, a feature of the data which we document and quantify, rather than sales. We propose a simple model with household store-switching and assess its implications for business cycles and policymakers. (JEL D12, E31, E32, L25, L81)

10.1257/aer.20121546.abstractZh: 我们研究了销售、定期价格变动以及消费者支付的平均价格（“实际”价格）的周期性特征，使用了多个美国大都市地区众多零售商的物价和销售数量数据。结果显示，随着失业率上升，消费者实际支付的价格通胀显著下降，而零售商标价的价格通胀变化则很小。这种差异反映了家庭支出在零售商之间的重新分配，这是数据中的一个特征，我们对其进行了记录和量化，而非仅仅关注销售情况。我们提出了一个简单的模型，涉及家庭对商店的切换行为，并评估了这一模型对商业周期和政策制定者的影响。（JEL D12, E31, E32, L25, L81）

abstract.text: A seven-year randomized evaluation suggests education subsidies reduce adolescent girls' dropout, pregnancy, and marriage but not sexually transmitted infection (STI). The government's HIV curriculum, which stresses abstinence until marriage, does not reduce pregnancy or STI. Both programs combined reduce STI more, but cut dropout and pregnancy less, than education subsidies alone. These results are inconsistent with a model of schooling and sexual behavior in which both pregnancy and STI are determined by one factor (unprotected sex), but consistent with a two-factor model in which choices between committed and casual relationships also affect these outcomes.

10.1257/aer.20121607.abstractZh: 一项为期七年的随机评估表明，教育补贴能够减少少女的辍学、怀孕和结婚现象，但并不能减少性传播感染。政府的艾滋病课程强调婚前禁欲，但并未减少怀孕和性传播感染。这两种措施联合使用能更有效地减少性传播感染，但减少辍学和怀孕的效果则不如单独使用教育补贴。这些结果与一种认为怀孕和性传播感染仅由单一因素（无保护性行为）决定的模型不符，但与一种认为在选择正式关系与随意关系时也会影响这些结果的双因素模型相符。

abstract.text: Drug trade-related violence has escalated dramatically in Mexico since 2007, and recent years have also witnessed large-scale efforts to combat trafficking, spearheaded by Mexico's conservative PAN party. This study examines the direct and spillover effects of Mexican policy toward the drug trade. Regression discontinuity estimates show that drug-related violence increases substantially after close elections of PAN mayors. Empirical evidence suggests that the violence reflects rival traffickers' attempts to usurp territories after crackdowns have weakened incumbent criminals. Moreover, the study uses a network model of trafficking routes to show that PAN victories divert drug traffic, increasing violence along alternative drug routes. (JEL D72, D85, K42, O17, Z13)

10.1257/aer.20121637.abstractZh: 自2007年以来，墨西哥与毒品贸易相关的暴力事件急剧增加，近年来墨西哥保守派PAN政党也采取了大规模措施来打击毒品贸易。本研究探讨了墨西哥政策对毒品贸易的直接和间接影响。回归断点估计显示，在PAN党市长选举结果明朗后，与毒品相关的暴力事件显著增加。实证证据表明，这种暴力行为反映了敌对贩毒分子在打击行动削弱现有犯罪分子后试图夺取地盘的行为。此外，该研究还利用网络模型分析了毒品贸易路线，发现PAN党的胜利会转移毒品贸易，从而增加替代毒品路线的暴力事件。（JEL D72, D85, K42, O17, Z13）

abstract.text: We consider vertical contracting arrangements between a manufacturer and a retailing network when retailers have private information and the organization is run through bilateral contracts. We highlight a new form of informational opportunism arising when the manufacturer manipulates information learned separately in each relationship. We characterize the set of allocations robust to such opportunism by means of simple ex post incentive compatibility constraints. Those constraints limit the manufacturer's ability to use yardstick competition among retailers. They simplify contracts and restore a rent/efficiency trade-off even with correlated information. We show that sell-out contracts are optimal under a wide range of circumstances. (JEL D21, D86, L14, L60, L81)

10.1257/aer.20121640.abstractZh: 我们研究了制造商与零售网络之间的纵向契约安排，其中零售商拥有私人信息，且组织通过双边契约运作。我们指出，当制造商在每笔交易中操纵单独获取的信息时，会出现一种新的信息机会主义行为。我们通过简单的事后激励相容性约束来描述对这种机会主义行为具有抵抗力的分配方案。这些约束限制了制造商利用零售商之间的竞争来制定契约的能力。它们简化了契约内容，并在信息相关的情况下恢复了租金与效率之间的权衡。我们证明，在多种情况下，销售完成契约是最优的选择。（JEL D21, D86, L14, L60, L81）

abstract.text: Regulatory oversight of toxic emissions from industrial plants and understanding about these emissions' impacts are in their infancy. Applying a research design based on the openings and closings of 1,600 industrial plants to rich data on housing markets and infant health, we find that: toxic air emissions affect air quality only within 1 mile of the plant; plant openings lead to 11 percent declines in housing values within 0.5 mile or a loss of about $4.25 million for these households; and a plant's operation is associated with a roughly 3 percent increase in the probability of low birthweight within 1 mile.

10.1257/aer.20121656.abstractZh: 对工业工厂有毒排放物的监管以及对其影响的了解仍处于初级阶段。通过利用1600家工业工厂的开设与关闭数据，并结合住房市场和婴儿健康的相关数据，我们发现：有毒空气排放物仅对距离工厂1英里范围内的空气质量产生影响；工厂的开设会导致0.5英里范围内的住房价值下降11%，或这些家庭损失约425万美元；此外，工厂的运营与1英里范围内低出生体重婴儿的概率增加约3%有关。

abstract.text: Individuals must often choose among discrete actions with imperfect information about their payoffs. Before choosing, they have an opportunity to study the payoffs, but doing so is costly. This creates new choices such as the number of and types of questions to ask. We model these situations using the rational inattention approach to information frictions. We find that the decision maker's optimal strategy results in choosing probabilistically in line with a generalized multinomial logit model, which depends both on the actions' true payoffs as well as on prior beliefs. (JEL D11, D81, D83)

10.1257/aer.20130047.abstractZh: 个体在面临信息不完全的情况下，常常需要在多种离散的行动中做出选择。在做出选择之前，他们有机会研究各种行动的收益，但这一过程成本较高。这就产生了新的选择，比如要提出多少问题和涉及哪些类型的问题。我们使用理性忽视方法来模拟这些信息摩擦现象。研究发现，决策者的最优策略实际上是基于广义多项逻辑模型来概率性地做出选择的，该模型既取决于行动的真实收益，也取决于先前的信念。（JEL D11, D81, D83）

abstract.text: We measure the impact of a drastic new technology for producing steel—the minimill—on industry-wide productivity in the US steel industry, using unique plant-level data between 1963 and 2002. The sharp increase in the industry's productivity is linked to this new technology through two distinct mechanisms: (i ) the mere displacement of the older technology (vertically integrated producers) was responsible for a third of the increase in the industry's productivity, and (ii ) increased competition, due the minimill expansion, drove a productivity resurgence at the surviving vertical integrated producers and, consequently, the productivity of the industry as a whole. (JEL D24, L13, L23, L61, M11, O31, O33)

10.1257/aer.20130090.abstractZh: 我们利用1963年至2002年间独特的工厂级数据，研究了一种新型钢铁生产技术——迷你钢厂——对美国钢铁行业整体生产率的影响。该行业生产率的显著提升与这一新技术通过两种不同机制相关联：(i) 仅仅取代旧的技术（垂直整合的制造商）就贡献了行业生产率提升的三分之一；(ii) 由于迷你钢厂的发展，竞争加剧，使得存活下来的垂直整合制造商的生产率再次提升，从而也提升了整个行业的生产率。(JEL D24, L13, L23, L61, M11, O31, O33)

abstract.text: This paper tests whether the 2003 dividend tax cut—one of the largest reforms ever to a US capital tax rate—stimulated corporate investment and increased labor earnings, using a quasi-experimental design and US corporate tax returns from years 1996–2008. I estimate that the tax cut caused zero change in corporate investment and employee compensation. Economically, the statistical precision challenges leading estimates of the cost-of-capital elasticity of investment, or undermines models in which dividend tax reforms affect the cost of capital. Either way, it may be difficult to implement an alternative dividend tax cut that has substantially larger near-term effects. (JEL C72, C78, C91)

10.1257/aer.20130098.abstractZh: 本文通过1996至2008年的美国企业税务申报数据，采用准实验设计方法，检验2003年的股息税减让——美国资本税率史上最大规模的改革之一——是否刺激了企业投资并增加了劳动者收入。研究结果表明，该税减让并未导致企业投资或员工薪酬发生显著变化。从经济学角度来看，这一结果对投资与资本成本弹性的统计估计提出了挑战，甚至削弱了那些认为股息税改革会影响资本成本的模型。无论如何，要实施一个具有更大短期影响的替代性股息税减让方案可能较为困难。（JEL C72, C78, C91）

abstract.text: I test the effect of harsher punishments and sanctions on driving under the influence (DUI). In this setting, punishments are determined by strict rules on blood alcohol content (BAC) and previous offenses. Regression discontinuity derived estimates suggest that having a BAC above the DUI threshold reduces recidivism by up to 2 percentage points (17 percent). Likewise having a BAC over the aggravated DUI threshold reduces recidivism by an additional percentage point (9 percent). The results suggest that the additional sanctions experienced by drunk drivers at BAC thresholds are effective in reducing repeat drunk driving. (JEL I12, K42, R41)

10.1257/aer.20130189.abstractZh: 我研究了更严厉的惩罚和制裁对酒后驾车行为的影响。在这种情境下，惩罚依据严格的血液酒精含量规定以及之前的犯罪记录来确定。回归连续法得出的估计结果显示，血液酒精含量超过酒后驾车警戒线时，再犯率可降低高达2个百分点（17%）。同样，当血液酒精含量超过严重酒后驾车警戒线时，再犯率还会再降低1个百分点（9%）。这些结果表明，对于血液酒精含量达到警戒线的酒驾者来说，额外的制裁措施确实能够有效减少再次酒驾的行为。（JEL I12, K42, R41）

abstract.text: We estimate a bargaining model of competition between hospitals and managed care organizations (MCOs) and use the estimates to evaluate the effects of hospital mergers. We find that MCO bargaining restrains hospital prices significantly. The model demonstrates the potential impact of coinsurance rates, which allow MCOs to partly steer patients toward cheaper hospitals. We show that increasing patient coinsurance tenfold would reduce prices by 16 percent. We find that a proposed hospital acquisition in Northern Virginia that was challenged by the Federal Trade Commission would have significantly raised hospital prices. Remedies based on separate bargaining do not alleviate the price increases. (JEL C78, G34, I11, I13, L13)

10.1257/aer.20130223.abstractZh: 我们构建了一个医院与管理式护理组织之间竞争的讨价还价模型，并利用这些估计结果来评估医院合并的影响。研究发现，管理式护理组织的讨价还价行为显著限制了医院的价格。该模型还展示了共保率的潜在影响，这种机制使得管理式护理组织能够部分引导患者选择价格更低的医院。研究表明，将患者的共保率提高十倍可以将价格降低16%。我们发现，联邦贸易委员会对北弗吉尼亚地区一项拟议的医院收购案提出了质疑，该收购案可能会导致医院价格显著上涨。基于单独讨价还价行为的解决方案并不能缓解价格上升的问题。（JEL C78, G34, I11, I13, L13）

abstract.text: We present a model of policy development in which competing factions have different ideologies, yet agree on certain common objectives. Policy developers can appeal to a decision maker by making productive investments to improve the quality of their proposals. These investments are specific to a given proposal, which means that policy developers can potentially obtain informal agenda power. Competition undermines this agenda power, forcing policy developers to craft policies that are better for the decision maker. This beneficial effect is strongest if policy developers have divergent ideological preferences, because their intense desire to affect policy motivates them to develop higher quality proposals. (JEL D72, D73, D78, E61)

10.1257/aer.20130250.abstractZh: 我们提出了一个政策制定的模型，其中不同的派别持有不同的意识形态，但在某些共同目标上达成一致。政策制定者可以通过进行富有成效的投资来提高其提案的质量，从而吸引决策者的关注。这些投资是特定于某个提案的，这意味着政策制定者有可能获得非正式的议程权力。竞争会削弱这种议程权力，迫使政策制定者制定对决策者更有利的政策。如果政策制定者持有不同的意识形态偏好，这种有益效果会更为显著，因为他们强烈希望影响政策，这会促使他们提出更高质量的提案。（JEL D72, D73, D78, E61）

abstract.text: Both under- and over-treatment of communicable diseases are public bads. But efforts to decrease one run the risk of increasing the other. Using rich experimental data on household treatment-seeking behavior in Kenya, we study the implications of this trade-off for subsidizing life-saving antimalarials sold over-the-counter at retail drug outlets. We show that a very high subsidy (such as the one under consideration by the international community) dramatically increases access, but nearly one-half of subsidized pills go to patients without malaria. We study two ways to better target subsidized drugs: reducing the subsidy level, and introducing rapid malaria tests over-the-counter. (JEL D12, D82, I12, O12, O15)

10.1257/aer.20130267.abstractZh: 无论是低估还是高估传染病的治疗需求，都是公共健康问题。但减少其中一种治疗需求的做法可能会增加另一种需求。利用肯尼亚关于家庭寻求治疗行为的丰富实验数据，我们研究了这种权衡对补贴在零售药店非处方销售的救命抗疟药的影响。我们发现，极高的补贴（如国际社会正在考虑的这种补贴）会显著增加获取机会，但近一半的补贴药品被无疟疾的患者使用。我们研究了两种更好地定向补贴药物的方法：降低补贴水平，以及引入快速抗疟检测服务。（JEL D12, D82, I12, O12, O15）

abstract.text: Stratification is a distinctive feature of competitive education markets that can be explained by a preference for good peers. Learning externalities can lead students to care about the ability of their peers, resulting in across-school sorting by ability. This paper shows that a preference for good peers, and therefore stratification, can also emerge endogenously from reputational concerns that arise when graduates use their college of origin to signal their ability. Reputational concerns can also explain puzzling observed trends including the increase in student investment into admissions exam preparation, and the decline in study time at college. (JEL I21, I23, I26, J24)

10.1257/aer.20130332.abstractZh: 分层是竞争性教育市场的独特特征，这一特征可以通过对优秀同龄人的偏好来解释。学习外部性使得学生会关注同龄人的能力，从而导致学校之间的能力排序。本文表明，对优秀同龄人的偏好，以及由此产生的分层现象，也可能由毕业生利用原大学来展示自身能力时所产生的声誉问题内生性地产生。声誉问题还可以解释一些令人困惑的现象，包括学生投入招生考试准备的时间增加，以及大学学习时间的减少。（JEL I21, I23, I26, J24）

abstract.text: We show that endogenous firm selection provides a new welfare margin for heterogeneous firm models of trade (relative to homo geneous firm models). Under some parameter restrictions, the trade elasticity is constant and is a sufficient statistic for welfare, along with the domestic trade share. However, even small deviations from these restrictions imply that trade elasticities are variable and differ across markets and levels of trade costs. In this more general setting, the domestic trade share and endogenous trade elasticity are no longer sufficient statistics for welfare. Additional empirically observable moments of the micro structure also matter for welfare. (JEL F12, F13, F41)

10.1257/aer.20130351.abstractZh: 我们表明，内生企业选择为异质企业模型提供了新的福利空间（相对于同质企业模型）。在某些参数限制下，贸易弹性是恒定的，并且与国内贸易份额一起，是福利的充分统计量。然而，即使这些限制有微小的偏差，也会导致贸易弹性发生变化，并且在不同市场和贸易成本水平下有所不同。在这种更一般的情境下，国内贸易份额和内生贸易弹性已不再是福利的充分统计量。微观结构的其他可观测的统计量也对福利有重要影响。（JEL F12, F13, F41）

abstract.text: We analyze randomized online survey experiments providing interactive, customized information on US income inequality, the link between top income tax rates and economic growth, and the estate tax. The treatment has large effects on views about inequality but only slightly moves tax and transfer policy preferences. An exception is the estate tax—informing respondents of the small share of decedents who pay it doubles support for it. The small effects for all other policies can be partially explained by respondents' low trust in government and a disconnect between concerns about social issues and the public policies meant to address them. (JEL D31, D72, H23, H24)

10.1257/aer.20130360.abstractZh: 我们分析了随机在线调查实验，这些实验提供了关于美国收入不平等、最高所得税率与经济增长之间的联系以及遗产税的交互式、个性化信息。这一措施对人们对不平等的看法产生了较大影响，但仅略微改变了税收和转移支付政策的偏好。例外的是遗产税——向受访者通报有少数逝者缴纳遗产税的情况后，支持遗产税的比例翻倍。其他所有政策的效应较小，这部分可以归因于受访者对政府的信任度较低，以及对社会问题的担忧与旨在解决这些问题的公共政策之间的脱节。（JEL D31, D72, H23, H24）

abstract.text: Claims that the VAT facilitates tax enforcement by generating paper trails on transactions between firms contributed to widespread VAT adoption worldwide, but there is surprisingly little evidence. This paper analyzes the role of third-party information for VAT enforcement through two randomized experiments among over 400,000 Chilean firms. Announcing additional monitoring has less impact on transactions that are subject to a paper trail, indicating the paper trail's preventive deterrence effect. This leads to strong enforcement spillovers up the VAT chain. These findings confirm that when taking evasion into account, significant differences emerge between otherwise equivalent forms of taxation. (JEL D83, H25, H26, K34, O17)

10.1257/aer.20130393.abstractZh: 有观点认为，增值税通过产生企业间交易的纸质记录来促进税收征管，这促进了全球范围内增值税的广泛采用，但实际上相关的证据却很少。本文通过针对超过40万智利企业的两项随机实验，分析了第三方信息在增值税征管中的作用。结果显示，对已有纸质记录的交易进行额外监控的影响较小，这表明纸质记录具有预防性的威慑作用。这一发现表明，在考虑逃税行为的情况下，不同形式的税收之间存在显著差异。（JEL D83, H25, H26, K34, O17）

abstract.text: Many lament that weak accountability and poor governance impede economic development in Africa. Politicians rely on ethnic allegiances that deliver the vote irrespective of performance, dampening electoral incentives. Giving voters information about candidate competence counters ethnic loyalty and strengthens accountability. I extend a canonical electoral model to show how information provision flows through voter behavior and ultimately impacts the distribution of political spending. I test the theory on data from Sierra Leone using decentralization and differential radio coverage to identify information's effects. Estimates suggest that information increases voting across ethnic-party lines and induces a more equitable allocation of campaign spending. (JEL D72, D83, J15, O17, Z13).

10.1257/aer.20130397.abstractZh: 许多人抱怨，薄弱的问责制和糟糕的治理阻碍了非洲的经济发展。政客们依赖种族忠诚来获得选票，而忽视了绩效，这削弱了选举激励。向选民提供有关候选人能力的信息可以对抗种族忠诚，并增强问责制。我运用一个典型的选举模型来展示信息提供如何通过选民行为传递，并最终影响政治支出的分配。我使用塞拉利昂的数据来测试这一理论，通过分散权力和差异化的广播覆盖来识别信息的影响。估计结果表明，信息能够跨越种族和政党界限增加投票率，并促使竞选资金的分配更加公平。（JEL D72, D83, J15, O17, Z13）

abstract.text: This paper argues that the extent of financial contagion exhibits a form of phase transition: as long as the magnitude of negative shocks affecting financial institutions are sufficiently small, a more densely connected financial network (corresponding to a more diversified pattern of interbank liabilities) enhances financial stability. However, beyond a certain point, dense interconnections serve as a mechanism for the propagation of shocks, leading to a more fragile financial system. Our results thus highlight that the same factors that contribute to resilience under certain conditions may function as significant sources of systemic risk under others. (JEL D85, E44, G21, G28, L14)

10.1257/aer.20130456.abstractZh: 本文认为，金融传染的程度呈现出一种相变现象：只要影响金融机构的负面冲击幅度足够小，一个更加紧密连接的金融网络（对应于更加多样化的银行间负债结构）能够增强金融稳定性。然而，一旦超过某个临界点，紧密的互联关系反而会成为冲击传播的机制，导致金融系统变得更加脆弱。我们的研究结果表明，在某些条件下有助于增强韧性的相同因素，在其他情况下则可能成为系统性风险的重大来源。（JEL D85, E44, G21, G28, L14）

abstract.text: We show that in an open-economy OLG model, the interaction between growth differentials and household credit constraints—more severe in fast-growing countries—can explain three prominent global trends: a divergence in private saving rates between advanced and emerging economies, large net capital outflows from the latter, and a sustained decline in the world interest rate. Micro-level evidence on the evolution of age-saving profiles in the US and China corroborates our mechanism. Quantitatively, our model explains about a third of the divergence in aggregate saving rates, and a significant portion of the variations in age-saving profiles across countries and over time. (JEL E21, E22, F21, F32, F41, O16, P24)

10.1257/aer.20130549.abstractZh: 我们指出，在一个开放经济的一般均衡模型中，增长差异与家庭信贷约束之间的相互作用——在快速增长的国家中更为显著——可以解释三个显著的全球趋势：发达国家与新兴经济体之间的私人储蓄率差异、后者大量的资本净流出，以及世界利率的持续下降。关于美国和中国年龄储蓄模式演变的微观层面证据支持了我们的机制。从数量上看，我们的模型解释了总储蓄率差异的约三分之一，以及各国之间及随时间变化的年龄储蓄模式差异的相当一部分。（JEL E21, E22, F21, F32, F41, O16, P24）

abstract.text: The TseTse fly is unique to Africa and transmits a parasite harmful to humans and lethal to livestock. This paper tests the hypothesis that the TseTse reduced the ability of Africans to generate an agricultural surplus historically. Ethnic groups inhabiting TseTse-suitable areas were less likely to use domesticated animals and the plow, less likely to be politically centralized, and had a lower population density. These correlations are not found in the tropics outside of Africa, where the fly does not exist. The evidence suggests current economic performance is affected by the TseTse through the channel of pre colonial political centralization. (JEL I12, N57, O13, O17, Q12, Q16, Q18)

10.1257/aer.20130604.abstractZh: TseTse蝇仅存在于非洲，会传播对人类有害且对牲畜致命的寄生虫。本文验证了一个假设：TseTse蝇可能降低了非洲人在历史上产生农业盈余的能力。居住在TseTse蝇适宜地区的族群，使用驯养动物和犁耕的可能性较低，政治上的中央集权程度也较低，人口密度也较低。这些关联在非洲以外的热带地区并不存在。证据表明，当前的经济表现受到TseTse蝇的影响，这种影响是通过殖民前政治中央集权这一渠道实现的。（JEL I12, N57, O13, O17, Q12, Q16, Q18）

abstract.text: Consumer bankruptcy is one of the largest social insurance programs in the United States, but little is known about its impact on debtors. We use 500,000 bankruptcy filings matched to administrative tax and foreclosure data to estimate the impact of Chapter 13 bankruptcy protection on subsequent outcomes. Exploiting the random assignment of bankruptcy filings to judges, we find that Chapter 13 protection increases annual earnings by $5,562, decreases five-year mortality by 1.2 percentage points, and decreases five-year foreclo-sure rates by 19.1 percentage points. These results come primarily from the deterioration of outcomes among dismissed filers, not gains by granted filers. (JEL D14, I12, J22, J31, K35)

10.1257/aer.20130612.abstractZh: 消费者破产是美国最大的社会保障计划之一，但对其对债务人的影响知之甚少。我们利用50万份与行政税务和止赎数据匹配的破产申请数据，来估算第13章破产保护对后续结果的影响。通过利用破产申请随机分配给法官的方式，我们发现第13章破产保护使年收入增加5,562美元，五年死亡率降低1.2个百分点，五年止赎率降低19.1个百分点。这些结果主要来自于被驳回的破产申请者的结果恶化，而非获得批准的破产申请者的收益增加。（JEL D14, I12, J22, J31, K35）

abstract.text: We study the operation of local governments (Panchayats) in rural Maharashtra, India, using a survey that we designed for this end. Elections are freely contested, fairly tallied, highly participatory, non-coerced, and lead to appointment of representative politicians. However, beneath this veneer of ideal democracy we find evidence of deeply ingrained clientelist vote-trading structures maintained through extra-political means. Elite minorities undermine policies that would redistribute income toward the majority poor. We explore the means by which elites use their dominance of land ownership and traditional social superiority to achieve political control in light of successful majoritarian institutional reforms. (JEL D72, H23, I38, J15, O15, O17, O18)

10.1257/aer.20130623.abstractZh: 我们研究了印度马哈拉施特拉邦农村地区的地方政府（潘查亚特）的运作情况，使用了为此目的专门设计的调查方法。选举是自由进行的，统计结果公正，参与度高，没有强制手段，并且最终会选出有代表性的政治家。然而，在这看似理想的民主表面之下，我们发现存在着根深蒂固的裙带关系投票交易结构，这些结构通过非政治手段得以维持。精英少数群体会破坏那些旨在将收入重新分配给大多数贫困群体的政策。我们探讨了精英如何利用他们对土地所有权的控制和传统社会优势，在成功的多数制度改革背景下实现政治控制的方式。（JEL D72, H23, I38, J15, O15, O17, O18）

abstract.text: We develop an infinite horizon macroeconomic model of banking that allows for liquidity mismatch and bank runs. Whether a bank run equilibrium exists depends on bank balance sheets and an endogenous liquidation price for bank assets. While in normal times a bank run equilibrium may not exist, the possibility can arise in recessions. A run leads to a significant contraction in intermediation and aggregate economic activity. Anticipations of a run have harmful effects on the economy even if the run does not occur. We illustrate how the model can shed light on some key aspects of the recent financial crisis. (JEL E23, E32, E44, G01, G21, G33)

10.1257/aer.20130665.abstractZh: 我们开发了一个无限时域的银行宏观经济模型，该模型能够模拟流动性不匹配和银行挤兑的情况。银行挤兑均衡是否存在取决于银行的资产负债表以及银行资产的内生清算价格。在正常情况下，银行挤兑均衡可能不存在，但在经济衰退时期可能会出现这种情况。挤兑会导致中介活动和整体经济活动的显著收缩。即使挤兑没有发生，人们对挤兑的预期也会对经济产生负面影响。我们通过该模型展示了如何揭示最近金融危机的一些关键特征。（JEL E23, E32, E44, G01, G21, G33）

abstract.text: In the repeated prisoner's dilemma, predictions are notoriously difficult. Recently, however, Blonski, Ockenfels, and Spagnolo (2011)—henceforth, BOS—showed that experimental subjects predictably cooperate when the discount factor exceeds a particular threshold. I analyze individual strategies in four recent experiments to examine whether strategies are predictable, too. Behavior is well summarized by “Semi-Grim” strategies: cooperate after mutual cooperation, defect after mutual defection, randomize otherwise. This holds both in aggregate and individually, and it explains the BOS-threshold: Semi-Grim equilibria appear as the discount factor crosses this threshold, and then, subjects start cooperating in round 1 and switch to Semi-Grim in continuation play. (JEL C72, C73, C92, D12)

10.1257/aer.20130675.abstractZh: 在重复的囚徒困境中，预测往往非常困难。然而，Blonski、Ockenfels和Spagnolo（2011年）的研究表明，当折扣因子超过某个特定阈值时，实验对象会表现出可预测的合作行为。我分析了四项最新实验中的个体策略，以探讨这些策略是否也具有可预测性。行为可以被描述为“半贪婪”策略：在双方都合作后继续合作，在双方都背叛后选择背叛，否则则随机选择。这一策略在整体和个体层面都成立，并且可以解释BOS阈值现象：当折扣因子超过这个阈值时，半贪婪均衡就会出现，此时实验对象在第一轮开始合作，并在后续游戏中继续采用半贪婪策略。（JEL C72, C73, C92, D12）

abstract.text: Do women and men behave differently in financial asset markets? Our results from an asset market experiment show a marked gender difference in producing speculative price bubbles. Mixed markets show intermediate values, and a meta-analysis of 35 markets from different studies confirms the inverse relationship between the magnitude of price bubbles and the frequency of female traders in the market. Women's price forecasts also are significantly lower, even in the first period. Implications for financial markets and experimental methodology are discussed. (JEL D14, D81, G01, G11, J16)

10.1257/aer.20130683.abstractZh: 女性和男性在金融资产市场中是否表现出不同的行为？我们通过对一个资产市场实验的研究发现，女性在制造投机性价格泡沫方面存在显著的性别差异。混合市场显示出中间值，而对35个不同研究市场进行的元分析也证实了价格泡沫的严重程度与女性交易者在该市场中的频率之间存在反比关系。即使在初期阶段，女性的价格预测也明显较低。本文还讨论了这对金融市场和实验方法学的影响。（JEL D14, D81, G01, G11, J16）

abstract.text: The optimal allocation of resources in complex environments—like allocation of dynamic wireless spectrum, cloud computing services, and Internet advertising—is computationally challenging even given the true preferences of the participants. In the theory and practice of optimization in complex environments, a wide variety of special and general purpose algorithms have been developed; these algorithms produce outcomes that are satisfactory but not generally optimal or incentive compatible. This paper develops a very simple approach for converting any, potentially non-optimal, algorithm for optimization given the true participant preferences, into a Bayesian incentive compatible mechanism that weakly improves social welfare and revenue. (JEL D82, H82, L82)

10.1257/aer.20130712.abstractZh: 在复杂环境中优化资源分配——例如动态无线频谱、云计算服务和互联网广告的分配——即使考虑到参与者的真实偏好，也面临着计算上的挑战。在复杂环境下的优化理论与实践中，已经开发出了多种专用和通用算法；这些算法产生的结果虽然令人满意，但通常并不是最优的，也不符合激励原则。本文提出了一种非常简单的方法，可以将任何可能非最优的优化算法，在考虑到参与者的真实偏好后，转化为一种贝叶斯激励兼容机制，从而在保持社会福利和收入稳步提升的同时，实现优化。 (JEL D82, H82, L82)

abstract.text: We develop a model of selection that incorporates a key element of recent health reforms: an individual mandate. Using data from Massachusetts, we estimate the parameters of the model. In the individual market for health insurance, we find that premiums and average costs decreased significantly in response to the individual mandate. We find an annual welfare gain of 4.1% per person or $51.1 million annually in Massachusetts as a result of the reduction in adverse selection. We also find smaller post-reform markups.

10.1257/aer.20130758.abstractZh: 我们开发了一个选择模型，该模型包含了近期健康改革中的一个关键要素：个人强制保险。利用马萨诸塞州的数据，我们估算了该模型的参数。在健康保险的个人市场中，我们发现由于个人强制保险的实施，保费和平均成本显著下降。我们发现在马萨诸塞州，由于逆向选择的减少，每人每年获得的福利增益为4.1%，即每年增加5110万美元。我们还发现，改革后的价格溢价有所降低。

abstract.text: This paper estimates historical intergenerational elasticities between fathers and children of both sexes in the United States using a novel empirical strategy. The key insight of our approach is that the information about socioeconomic status conveyed by first names can be used to create pseudo-links across generations. We find that both father-son and father-daughter elasticities were flat during the nineteenth century, increased sharply between 1900 and 1920, and declined slightly thereafter. We discuss the role of regional disparities in economic development, trends in inequality and returns to human capital, and the marriage market in explaining these patterns. (JEL D63, J12, J16, J24, J62, N31, N32)

10.1257/aer.20130821.abstractZh: 本文采用一种新颖的实证策略，估算了美国父与子女之间不同性别代际间的弹性关系。我们的关键发现是，通过名字所传递的社会经济信息可以用来建立代际间的“伪联系”。研究发现，在19世纪期间，父与子以及父与女之间的弹性关系基本保持不变；1900年至1920年间，这些弹性关系急剧上升；此后则略有下降。我们探讨了地区经济发展差异、不平等趋势、人力资本回报以及婚姻市场等因素对这些关系的影响。（JEL D63, J12, J16, J24, J62, N31, N32）

abstract.text: We analyze the welfare consequences of a monopolist having additional information about consumers' tastes, beyond the prior distribution; the additional information can be used to charge different prices to different segments of the market, i.e., carry out “third degree price discrimination.” We show that the segmentation and pricing induced by the additional information can achieve every combination of consumer and producer surplus such that: (i) consumer sur plus is nonnegative, (ii) producer surplus is at least as high as profits under the uniform monopoly price, and (iii) total surplus does not exceed the surplus generated by efficient trade. (JEL D42, D83, L12)

10.1257/aer.20130848.abstractZh: 我们分析了垄断者拥有超出先前分配信息的消费者偏好额外信息所带来的福利后果；这些额外信息可以用来对市场的不同细分市场收取不同的价格，即实施“三级价格歧视”。我们表明，由额外信息引发的细分和定价可以实现消费者剩余和生产者剩余的任意组合，满足以下条件：(i) 消费者剩余为正；(ii) 在统一垄断价格下，生产者剩余至少与利润相当；(iii) 总剩余不超过有效交易产生的剩余。(JEL D42, D83, L12)

abstract.text: In many developing countries property rights over rural land are maintained through continuous personal use instead of by land titles. We show that removing the link between land use and land rights through the issuance of ownership certificates can result in large-scale adjustments to labor and land allocations. Using the rollout of the Mexican land certification program from 1993 to 2006, we find that households obtaining certificates were subsequently 28 percent more likely to have a migrant member. We also show that even though land certification induced migration, it had little effect on cultivated area due to consolidation of farm units. (JEL O13, O17, P14, Q15, Q18, Q24, Q28)

10.1257/aer.20130853.abstractZh: 在许多发展中国家，农村土地的产权是通过持续的个人使用来维护的，而不是通过土地所有权证书来确立。我们发现，通过颁发所有权证书来消除土地使用与土地产权之间的联系，可以引发劳动力和土地分配的大规模调整。以1993年至2006年间墨西哥土地认证计划的实施为例，我们发现获得证书的家庭随后拥有移民成员的可能性增加了28%。我们还发现，尽管土地认证促进了迁移，但由于农场单位的整合，它对耕种面积的影响很小。（JEL O13, O17, P14, Q15, Q18, Q24, Q28）

abstract.text: We provide a result on prospect theory decision makers who are naïve about the time inconsistency induced by probability weighting. If a market offers a sufficiently rich set of investment strategies, investors postpone their trading decisions indefinitely due to a strong preference for skewness. We conclude that probability weighting in combination with naïveté leads to unrealistic predictions for a wide range of dynamic setups. (JEL D81, G02, G11)

10.1257/aer.20130896.abstractZh: 我们提出了一个关于前景理论决策者的结果，这些决策者对概率加权所引发的时机不一致性问题缺乏认识。如果市场提供足够丰富的一系列投资策略，投资者会因为强烈偏好偏态而无限期地推迟交易决策。我们得出结论，概率加权与认知不足相结合，会导致在多种动态环境下做出不现实的预测。（JEL D81, G02, G11）

abstract.text: This paper shows how in Medicare Part D insurers' gaming of the subsidy paid to low-income enrollees distorts premiums and raises the program cost. Using plan-level data from the first five years of the program, I find multiple instances of pricing strategy distortions for the largest insurers. Instrumental variable estimates indicate that the changes in a concentration index measuring the manipulability of the subsidy can explain a large share of the premium growth observed between 2006 and 2011. Removing this distortion could reduce the cost of the program without worsening consumer welfare.

10.1257/aer.20130903.abstractZh: 本文揭示了在Medicare Part D计划中，保险公司对低收入参保者所支付的补贴进行操纵，从而扭曲了保费价格并增加了项目的成本。通过利用该计划实施头五年的计划级数据，我发现最大的保险公司存在多种定价策略扭曲现象。工具变量估计表明，衡量补贴可操纵性的浓度指数的变化可以解释2006年至2011年间观察到的保费增长的大部分原因。消除这种扭曲可以降低项目成本，同时不会恶化消费者的福利。

abstract.text: Default contribution rates for 401(k) pension plans powerfully influence choices. Potential causes include opt-out costs, procrastination, inattention, and psychological anchoring. Using realistically parameterized models, we show how the optimal default, the magnitude of the welfare effects, and the degree of normative ambiguity depend on the behavioral model, the scope of the choice domain deemed welfare-relevant, the use of penalties for passive choice, and other 401(k) plan features. While results are theory-specific, our analysis provides reasonably robust justifications for setting the default either at the highest contribution rate matched by the employer or—contrary to common wisdom—at zero. (JEL D14, D91, J26, J32)

10.1257/aer.20130907.abstractZh: 401(k)养老金计划的默认缴费率对决策有着显著的影响。潜在的原因包括选择退出成本、拖延行为、疏忽以及心理锚定效应。通过实际参数化的模型，我们展示了最优默认缴费率、福利效应的大小以及规范模糊性的程度如何取决于行为模型、被视为福利相关选择领域的范围、对被动选择的惩罚措施，以及其他401(k)计划特性。虽然研究结果具有理论特殊性，但我们的分析为设定默认缴费率提供了相当稳健的依据：要么采用与雇主相匹配的最高缴费率，要么按照普遍观点相反的做法，将默认缴费率设定为零。 (JEL D14, D91, J26, J32)

abstract.text: This paper studies, theoretically and empirically, the role of overconfidence in political behavior. Our model of overconfidence in beliefs predicts that overconfidence leads to ideological extremeness, increased voter turnout, and stronger partisan identification. The model also makes nuanced predictions about the patterns of ideology in society. These predictions are tested using unique data that measure the overconfidence and standard political characteristics of a nationwide sample of over 3,000 adults. Our numerous predictions find strong support in these data. In particular, we document that overconfidence is a substantively and statistically important predictor of ideological extremeness, voter turnout, and partisan identification. (JEL C83, D03, D72, D83)

10.1257/aer.20130921.abstractZh: 本文从理论和实证角度研究了过度自信在政治行为中的作用。我们的关于信念中过度自信的模型预测，过度自信会导致意识形态的极端化、选民投票率的上升以及党派认同的增强。该模型还对社会中的意识形态模式做出了细致的预测。这些预测通过测量全国3000多名成年人的过度自信和标准政治特征的数据进行了验证。我们的众多预测在这些数据中得到了强有力的支持。特别是，我们发现过度自信是意识形态极端化、选民投票率和党派认同的重要预测因素。（JEL C83, D03, D72, D83）

abstract.text: We characterize choice rules for schools that regard students as substitutes while expressing preferences for a diverse student body. The stable (or fair) assignment of students to schools requires the latter to regard the former as substitutes. Such a requirement is in conflict with the reality of schools’ preferences for diversity. We show that the conflict can be useful, in the sense that certain unique rules emerge from imposing both considerations. We also provide welfare comparisons for students when different choice rules are employed. (JEL D47, H75, I21, I28)

10.1257/aer.20130929.abstractZh: 我们描述了一种学校选择规则，该规则将学生视为替代品，同时表达对多样化学生群体的偏好。学生被稳定地（或公平地）分配到各个学校，这一要求学校必须将学生视为替代品。然而，这一要求与学校对多样性的偏好现实相冲突。我们表明，这种冲突其实是有益的，因为通过同时考虑这两种因素，可以衍生出一些独特的规则。我们还提供了在不同选择规则下学生的福利比较数据。（JEL D47, H75, I21, I28）

abstract.text: We analyze a notion of self-confirming equilibrium with non-neutral ambiguity attitudes that generalizes the traditional concept. We show that the set of equilibria expands as ambiguity aversion increases. The intuition is quite simple: by playing the same strategy in a stationary environment, an agent learns the implied distribution of payoffs, but alternative strategies yield payoffs with unknown distributions; increased aversion to ambiguity makes such strategies less appealing. In sum, a kind of “status quo bias” emerges; in the long run, the uncertainty related to tested strategies disappears, but the uncertainty implied by the untested ones does not. (JEL C72, C73, D81, D83)

10.1257/aer.20130930.abstractZh: 我们分析了一种具有非中性模糊态度的自我确认均衡概念，该概念对传统概念进行了扩展。我们发现，随着模糊厌恶程度的增加，均衡集合会扩大。其直觉非常简单：在静态环境中采用相同的策略，代理人会了解隐含的收益分布，但其他策略带来的收益分布是未知的；对模糊性的厌恶增加使得这些策略变得不那么吸引人。总之，一种“现状偏见”出现了；从长远来看，与已测试策略相关的不确定性会消失，但未被测试策略所隐含的不确定性仍然存在。（JEL C72, C73, D81, D83）

abstract.text: A sovereign’s inability to commit to a course of action regarding future borrowing and default behavior makes long-term debt costly (the problem of debt dilution). One mechanism to mitigate this problem is the inclusion of a seniority clause in debt contracts. In the event of default, creditors are to be paid off in the order in which they lent (the “absolute priority” or “first-in-time” rule). In this paper, we propose a modification of the absolute priority rule suited to sovereign debts contracts and analyze its positive and normative implications within a quantitatively realistic model of sovereign debt and default. (JEL E32, E44, F34, G15, H63, O16, O19)

10.1257/aer.20130932.abstractZh: 一个主权国家无法承诺在未来借款和违约行为方面的行动，这使得长期债务成本增加（债务稀释问题）。一种缓解这一问题的机制是在债务合同中加入优先顺序条款。在违约情况下，债权人应按照他们提供贷款的先后顺序获得偿还（“绝对优先”或“时间优先”原则）。在本文中，我们提出了一种适用于主权债务合同的绝对优先顺序规则的修改方案，并分析了该规则在主权债务和违约定量现实模型中的积极性和规范性影响。（JEL E32, E44, F34, G15, H63, O16, O19）

abstract.text: We estimate the sensitivity of scrap decisions to changes in used car values and show how this “scrap elasticity” produces emissions leakage under fuel efficiency standards, a process known as the Gruenspecht effect. We first estimate the effect of gasoline prices on used vehicle values and scrappage of vehicles with different fuel economies. We then estimate the scrap elasticity itself, which we find to be −0.7. When applied in a model of fuel economy standards, 13–16 percent of the expected fuel savings leak away through the used vehicle market. This effect rivals or exceeds the importance of the often-cited mileage rebound effect. (JEL H23, L62, L78, Q35, Q38, Q48, Q58)

10.1257/aer.20130935.abstractZh: 我们估计了报废决策对二手车价值变化的敏感性，并展示了这种“报废弹性”如何在燃油效率标准下导致排放泄漏，这一过程被称为Gruenspecht效应。我们首先估计了汽油价格对二手车价值的影响，以及不同燃油经济性车辆的报废情况。然后，我们估计了报废弹性本身，发现其值为-0.7。在燃油效率标准的模型中应用这一效应后，预计的燃油节省量的13%到16%会通过二手车市场流失。这种效应与通常提到的里程反弹效应相当，甚至更为重要。（JEL H23, L62, L78, Q35, Q38, Q48, Q58）

abstract.text: We describe the theory and practice of real GDP comparisons across countries and over time. Version 8 of the Penn World Table expands on previous versions in three respects. First, in addition to comparisons of living standards using components of real GDP on the expenditure side, we provide a measure of productive capacity, called real GDP on the output side. Second, growth rates are benchmarked to multiple years of cross-country price data so they are less sensitive to new benchmark data. Third, data on capital stocks and productivity are (re)introduced. Applications including the Balassa-Samuelson effect and development accounting are discussed. (JEL C43, C82, E01, E23, I31, O47)

10.1257/aer.20130954.abstractZh: 我们描述了跨国及不同时期实际GDP比较的理论与实践。Penn世界表格的第八版在三个方面对前几版进行了扩展。首先，除了使用实际GDP的支出方面各项指标来比较生活水平外，我们还提供了一种称为实际GDP的生产能力衡量指标，该指标基于产出方面。其次，增长率是根据多年的跨国价格数据来设定的，因此它们对新基准数据的敏感度较低。第三，资本存量和生产率数据被重新引入。文章还讨论了包括巴拉萨-萨缪尔森效应和发展会计学在内的应用案例。（JEL C43, C82, E01, E23, I31, O47）

abstract.text: This paper develops a framework for estimating preferences in a many-to-one matching market using only observed matches. I use pairwise stability and a vertical preference restriction on one side to identify preferences on both sides of the market. Counterfactual simulations are used to analyze the antitrust allegation that the centralized medical residency match is responsible for salary depression. Due to residents' willingness to pay for desirable programs and capacity constraints, salaries in any competitive equilibrium would remain, on average, at least $23,000 below the marginal product of labor. Therefore, the match is not the likely cause of low salaries.

10.1257/aer.20131006.abstractZh: 本文提出了一个框架，用于仅基于已观察到的匹配情况，估算多对一匹配市场中的偏好。我们通过双边稳定性以及一方的垂直偏好限制，来识别市场双方的偏好。通过反事实模拟分析，针对“集中式医学住院医师匹配制度导致薪资下降”这一反垄断指控，研究发现：由于住院医师愿意为优质项目支付较高费用，且存在能力限制，任何竞争均衡下的薪资水平平均至少比劳动力的边际产出低23,000美元。因此，这种匹配制度并非导致薪资水平较低的原因。

abstract.text: An uncertainty-averse agent prefers betting on an event whose probability is known, to betting on an event whose probability is unknown. Such an agent may randomize his choices to eliminate the effects of uncertainty. For what sort of preferences does a randomization eliminate the effects of uncertainty? To answer this question, we investigate an agent's preferences over sets of acts. We axiomatize a utility function, through which we can identify the agent's subjective belief that a randomization eliminates the effects of uncertainty. (JEL D11, D81)

10.1257/aer.20131030.abstractZh: 一个厌恶不确定性的代理人更倾向于对概率已知的事件进行投注，而不是对概率未知的事件进行投注。这样的代理人可能会通过随机化选择来消除不确定性的影响。那么，什么样的偏好会导致随机化消除不确定性的影响呢？为了回答这个问题，我们研究了一个代理人对一系列行为的偏好。我们通过一个效用函数来公理化这个问题，从而能够确定代理人对于随机化是否消除不确定性影响的主观信念。（JEL D11, D81）

abstract.text: Ethnic favoritism is seen as antithetical to development. This paper provides credible quantification of the extent of ethnic favoritism using data on road building in Kenyan districts across the 1963–2011 period. Guided by a model, it then examines whether the transition in and out of democracy under the same president constrains or exacerbates ethnic favoritism. Across the post-independence period, we find strong evidence of ethnic favoritism: districts that share the ethnicity of the president receive twice as much expenditure on roads and have five times the length of paved roads built. This favoritism disappears during periods of democracy. (JEL D72, H54, J15, O15, O17, O22, R42)

10.1257/aer.20131031.abstractZh: 种族偏袒被视为与发展背道而驰的现象。本文利用1963年至2011年间肯尼亚各地区的道路建设数据，对种族偏袒的严重程度进行了可信的量化分析。基于某一模型，本文进一步探讨了同一总统领导下民主制度的转变是否会对种族偏袒产生限制或加剧作用。研究发现，在独立后的时期，种族偏袒现象十分明显：与总统具有相同种族背景的地区，道路建设投入是其其他地区的两倍，铺设的道路长度也是其其他地区的五倍。这种偏袒现象在民主制度实施期间消失了。（JEL D72, H54, J15, O15, O17, O22, R42）

abstract.text: In a large-scale controlled trial in collaboration with the reelection campaign of an Italian incumbent mayor, we administered (randomized) messages about the candidate's valence or ideology. Informational treatments affected both actual votes in the precincts and individual vote declarations. Campaigning on valence brought more votes to the incumbent, but both messages affected voters' beliefs. Cross-learning occurred, as voters who received information about the incumbent also updated their beliefs on the opponent. With a novel protocol of beliefs elicitation and structural estimation, we assess the weights voters place upon politicians' valence and ideology, and simulate counterfactual campaigns. (JEL D12, D72, D83)

10.1257/aer.20131063.abstractZh: 在一项与一位意大利现任市长竞选团队合作的大规模对照试验中，我们随机向选民传递了关于候选人价值观或意识形态的信息。这些信息影响了选民在选区内的实际投票行为以及个人投票声明。围绕价值观的竞选活动使现任市长获得了更多选票，但两种信息都影响了选民的信念。同时发生了交叉学习现象，即收到有关现任市长信息的选民也更新了他们对对手的信念。通过一种新颖的信念引述和结构估计方法，我们评估了选民对政治家价值观和意识形态的重视程度，并模拟了反事实竞选活动。（JEL D12, D72, D83）

abstract.text: We propose a unified model of limited market integration, asset-price determination, leveraging, and contagion. Investors and firms are located on a circle, and access to markets involves participation costs that increase with distance. Due to a complementarity between participation and leverage decisions, the equilibrium may exhibit diverse leverage and participation choices across investors, although investors are ex ante identical. Small changes in market-access costs can cause a change in the type of equilibrium, leading to discontinuous price changes, deleveraging, and portfolio-flow reversals. Moreover, the market is subject to contagion—an adverse shock to investors in some locations affects prices everywhere. (JEL D83, G11, G12, G32, G35)

10.1257/aer.20131076.abstractZh: 我们提出了一个关于有限市场整合、资产价格确定、杠杆使用和传染效应的统一模型。投资者和企业位于一个圆上，进入市场的机会伴随着随距离增加的参与成本。由于参与决策与杠杆决策之间的互补性，均衡状态下投资者的杠杆使用和参与选择可能会有所不同，尽管这些投资者在事前是相同的。市场进入成本的小幅变化可能导致均衡类型的改变，进而引发价格的不连续变化、去杠杆化以及投资组合流向的逆转。此外，市场还受到传染效应的影响——某些地区的投资者受到的负面冲击会波及整个市场。（JEL D83, G11, G12, G32, G35）

abstract.text: Traditional models of insurance choice are predicated on fully informed and rational consumers protecting themselves from exposure to financial risk. In practice, choosing an insurance plan is a complicated decision often made without full information. In this paper we combine new administrative data on health plan choices and claims with unique survey data on consumer information to identify risk preferences, information frictions, and hassle costs. Our additional friction measures are important predictors of choices and meaningfully impact risk preference estimates. We study the implications of counterfactual insurance allocations to illustrate the importance of distinguishing between these micro-foundations for welfare analysis.

10.1257/aer.20131126.abstractZh: 传统的保险选择模型假设消费者是完全知情且理性的，能够保护自己免受财务风险的影响。但实际上，选择保险计划往往是在缺乏完整信息的情况下做出的复杂决策。本文结合了新的关于健康计划选择和索赔的行政数据，以及关于消费者信息的独特调查数据，来识别风险偏好、信息摩擦和麻烦成本。我们额外测量的摩擦因素是对选择的重要预测因子，并且对风险偏好估计有显著影响。我们通过研究反事实保险分配的影响，来说明区分这些微观基础对福利分析的重要性。

abstract.text: We consider a moral hazard problem where the principal is uncertain as to what the agent can and cannot do: she knows some actions available to the agent, but other, unknown actions may also exist. The principal demands robustness, evaluating possible contracts by their worst-case performance, over unknown actions the agent might potentially take. The model assumes risk-neutrality and limited liability, and no other functional form assumptions. Very generally, the optimal contract is linear. The model thus offers a new explanation for linear contracts in practice. It also introduces a flexible modeling approach for moral hazard under nonquantifiable uncertainty. (JEL D81, D82, D86)

10.1257/aer.20131159.abstractZh: 我们考虑一个道德风险问题，其中委托人不确定代理人能够或不能做什么：代理人知道一些可以执行的行动，但也可能存在其他未知的行动。委托人要求合同具有鲁棒性，通过最坏情况下的表现来评估可能的合同，以应对代理人可能采取的未知行动。该模型假设风险中立性和有限责任，不假设其他功能形式。一般来说，最优合同是线性的。因此，该模型为实践中线性合同的存在提供了新的解释。它还引入了一种灵活的方法，用于在非可量化不确定性的情况下处理道德风险问题。（JEL D81, D82, D86）

abstract.text: We investigate whether private research investments are distorted away from long-term projects. Our theoretical model highlights two potential sources of this distortion: short-termism and the fixed patent term. Our empirical context is cancer research, where clinical trials - and hence, project durations - are shorter for late-stage cancer treatments relative to early-stage treatments or cancer prevention. Using newly constructed data, we document several sources of evidence that together show private research investments are distorted away from long-term projects. The value of life-years at stake appears large. We analyze three potential policy responses: surrogate (non-mortality) clinicaltrial endpoints, targeted R&D subsidies, and patent design.

10.1257/aer.20131176.abstractZh: 我们研究了私人研究投资是否会被扭曲，偏离长期项目。我们的理论模型指出了两种可能导致这种扭曲的因素：短期主义以及固定的专利期限。我们的实证研究对象是癌症研究，其中晚期癌症治疗的临床试验周期较短，相对于早期治疗或癌症预防而言。通过新构建的数据，我们发现有若干证据表明私人研究投资确实被扭曲，偏离了长期项目。所涉及的生命年价值相当巨大。我们分析了三种可能的政策应对方案：使用替代性（非死亡率）临床试验终点、定向研发补贴以及专利设计。

abstract.text: This paper exploits a data rich environment to provide direct econometric estimates of time-varying macroeconomic uncertainty. Our estimates display significant independent variations from popular uncertainty proxies, suggesting that much of the variation in the proxies is not driven by uncertainty. Quantitatively important uncertainty episodes appear far more infrequently than indicated by popular uncertainty proxies, but when they do occur, they are larger, more persistent, and are more correlated with real activity. Our estimates provide a benchmark to evaluate theories for which uncertainty shocks play a role in business cycles. (JEL C53, D81, E32, G12, G35, L25)

10.1257/aer.20131193.abstractZh: 本文利用数据丰富的环境，直接进行宏观经济不确定性随时间变化的计量经济学估计。我们的估计结果显示，与常见的不确定性代理指标相比，存在显著的独立变化，这表明这些代理指标中的变异并非由不确定性驱动。在定量上重要的不确定性事件出现的频率远低于常见的不确定性代理指标所显示的频率，但一旦发生，这些事件会更为严重、持续时间更长，并且与实际经济活动更为相关。我们的估计结果为评估那些不确定性冲击在商业周期中起作用的理论提供了基准。（JEL C53, D81, E32, G12, G35, L25）

abstract.text: We provide evidence that unemployment insurance affects equilibrium conditions in the labor market, which creates significant “market externalities.” We provide a framework for identification of such equilibrium effects and implement it using the Regional Extension Benefit Program (REBP) in Austria which extended the duration of UI benefits for a large group of eligible workers in selected regions of Austria. We show that non-eligible workers in REBP regions have higher job finding rates, lower unemployment durations, and a lower risk of long-term unemployment. We discuss the implications of our results for optimal UI policy. (JEL E24, J64, J65, R23)

10.1257/aer.20131273.abstractZh: 我们提供了证据，证明失业保险会影响劳动力市场的均衡状况，从而产生显著的“市场外部性”。我们提供了一个识别此类均衡效应的框架，并采用奥地利的区域扩展福利计划（REBP）来实施这一框架。该计划为奥地利某些地区的许多符合条件的工人延长了失业保险福利的持续时间。我们发现，REBP地区的非符合条件工人有更高的就业率、更短的失业时间，以及更低的长期失业风险。我们讨论了这些结果对最优失业保险政策的影响。（JEL E24, J64, J65, R23）

abstract.text: Behavioral economics presents a “paternalistic” rationale for benevolent government intervention. This paper presents a model of public debt where voters have self-control problems and attempt to commit using illiquid assets. In equilibrium, government accumulates debt to respond to individuals' desire to undo their commitments, which leads individuals to rebalance their portfolio, in turn feeding into a demand for further debt accumulation. As a consequence, (i) large (and distortionary) government debt accumulation occurs, and (ii) banning illiquid assets could improve individuals' welfare. These results offer a new rationale for balanced budget rules in constitutions to restrain governments' responses to voters' self-control problems.(JEL D2, D72, D78, H62, H63)

10.1257/aer.20131306.abstractZh: 行为经济学为仁慈的政府干预提供了一种“家长式”的合理性解释。本文提出了一个公共债务模型，其中选民存在自我控制问题，并试图使用流动性较低的资产来履行承诺。在均衡状态下，政府通过积累债务来回应个体想要撤销承诺的意愿，这导致个体重新调整其投资组合，进而进一步推动债务积累的需求。因此，(i) 政府会积累大量（且具有扭曲性的）债务，而(ii) 禁止使用流动性较低的资产可能会改善个体的福利。这些结果为宪法中的平衡预算规则提供了新的合理性依据，以限制政府因选民自我控制问题而产生的干预行为。(JEL D2, D72, D78, H62, H63)

abstract.text: Countercyclical risk aversion can explain major puzzles such as the high volatility of asset prices. Evidence for its existence is, however, scarce because of the host of factors that simultaneously change during financial cycles. We circumvent these problems by priming financial professionals with either a boom or a bust scenario. Subjects primed with a financial bust were substantially more fearful and risk averse than those primed with a boom, suggesting that fear may play an important role in countercyclical risk aversion. The mechanism described here is relevant for theory and may explain self-reinforcing processes that amplify market dynamics. (JEL E32, E44, G01, G11, G12)

10.1257/aer.20131314.abstractZh: 逆周期风险厌恶可以解释诸如资产价格高波动性这样的重大谜题。然而，由于金融周期中同时发生的一系列因素，证明其存在的证据却非常有限。我们通过向金融专业人士提供经济繁荣或衰退的情景来规避这些问题。被描述为经济衰退的情景的受试者比那些被描述为经济繁荣的情景的受试者表现得更加恐惧和规避风险，这表明恐惧可能在逆周期风险厌恶中起着重要作用。这里描述的机制对于理论具有重要意义，并且可以解释那些能够放大市场动态的自我强化过程。（JEL E32, E44, G01, G11, G12）

abstract.text: This paper evaluates changes in fuel procurement practices by coal-and gas-fired power plants in the United States following state-level legislation that ended cost-of-service regulation of electricity generation. I find that deregulated plants substantially reduce the price paid for coal (but not gas) and tend to employ less capital-intensive sulfur abatement techniques relative to matched plants that were not subject to any regulatory change. Deregulation also led to a shift toward more productive coal mines. I show how these results lend support to theories of asymmetric information, capital bias, and regulatory capture as important sources of regulatory distortion. (JEL L51, L71, L94, L98, Q35, Q41, Q48)

10.1257/aer.20131377.abstractZh: 本文评估了美国燃煤和燃气发电厂在州级立法结束对发电成本服务监管后，在燃料采购实践方面的变化。研究发现，未受监管的发电厂大幅降低了煤炭的采购价格（但天然气价格未发生变化），并且相对于未受任何监管变化的同类发电厂，这些发电厂倾向于采用较少的资本密集型硫减排技术。此外，监管放开还导致发电厂转向使用更高效的煤矿。本文表明，这些结果支持了信息不对称、资本偏见和监管俘获作为监管扭曲重要来源的理论。（JEL L51, L71, L94, L98, Q35, Q41, Q48）

abstract.text: This paper examines the implicit health insurance that households receive from the ability to declare bankruptcy. Exploiting multiple sources of variation in asset exemption law, I show that uninsured households with a greater financial cost of bankruptcy make higher out-of-pocket medical payments, conditional on the amount of care received. In turn, I find that households with greater wealth at risk are more likely to hold health insurance. The implicit insurance from bankruptcy distorts the insurance coverage decision. Using a microsimulation model, I calculate that the optimal Pigovian penalties are three-quarters as large as the average penalties under the Affordable Care Act.

10.1257/aer.20131408.abstractZh: 本文探讨了家庭因具备破产能力而获得的隐性健康保险效应。通过分析资产豁免法律的多重差异，我发现，未投保且面临较高破产财务成本的家庭，在获得医疗服务时会有更高的自付医疗费用。此外，我发现，面临更大财富风险的家庭更有可能持有健康保险。破产带来的隐性保险效应扭曲了保险选择决策。通过微观模拟模型计算，我们发现，最优的庇古式罚款是《平价医疗法案》规定平均罚款的四分之三。

abstract.text: Imperfect information and inattention to energy costs are important potential motivations for energy efficiency standards and subsidies. We evaluate these motivations in the lightbulb market using a theoretical model and two randomized experiments. We derive welfare effects as functions of reduced-form sufficient statistics capturing economic and psychological parameters, which we estimate using a novel within-subject information disclosure experiment. The main results suggest that moderate subsidies for energy-efficient lightbulbs may increase welfare, but informational and attentional biases alone do not justify a ban on incandescent lightbulbs. Our results and techniques generate broader methodological insights into welfare analysis with misoptimizing consumers. (JEL D12, D83, H21, H31, L67, Q41, Q48)

10.1257/aer.20131564.abstractZh: 不完善的信息和对能源成本的忽视是制定能源效率标准和补贴的重要潜在动机。我们在灯泡市场中使用理论模型和两项随机实验来评估这些动机。我们通过使用一种新颖的被试内信息披露实验来估计经济和心理参数，从而将福利效应转化为简化形式的充分统计量。主要结果表明，对节能灯泡给予适度的补贴可能会提高福利，但仅依靠信息偏差和注意力偏差并不能成为禁止白炽灯泡的理由。我们的研究结果和技术为分析存在优化偏差的消费者的福利问题提供了更广泛的方法论见解。（JEL D12, D83, H21, H31, L67, Q41, Q48）

abstract.text: When entry is exogenous, strong buyers should be discriminated against weak buyers to maximize revenues (Myerson 1981). When entry is endogenous so that entrants' expected payoffs do not depend on the proposed mechanism, optimal discrimination takes a completely different form. The revenue-maximizing equilibrium requires that there should be no discrimination with respect to entrants irrespective of their ex ante characteristics. Besides, those buyers who always participate should be discriminated against entrants independently of their strength. These predictions are independent of the equilibrium selection when the number of potential entrants grows large. The optimality of first-price auctions is also discussed. (JEL D44, H57)

10.1257/aer.20131580.abstractZh: 当进入是外生的时，强势买家应该受到歧视，而弱势买家则应该得到优待，以最大化收入（Myerson 1981）。当进入是内生的，即进入者的预期收益不依赖于所提出的机制时，最优的歧视方式则完全不同。收入最大化的均衡要求无论进入者的先验特征如何，都不应存在歧视。此外，那些始终参与的买家应该受到与他们的实力无关的歧视。这些预测与潜在进入者数量较大时的均衡选择无关。同时，也讨论了第一价格拍卖的最优性。（JEL D44, H57）

abstract.text: The conventional wisdom since Yaari (1965) is that households without a bequest motive should fully annuitize their investments. Numerous frictions do not break this sharp result. We modify the Yaari framework by allowing a household's mortality risk itself to be stochastic due to health shocks. A lifetime annuity still helps to hedge longevity risk. But the annuity's remaining present value is correlated with medical costs, such as those for nursing home care, thereby reducing annuity demand, even without ad-hoc liquidity constraints. We find that most households should not hold a positive level of annuities, and many should hold negative amounts. (JEL D14, D82, G23, I12, J14, J26)

10.1257/aer.20131584.abstractZh: 自Yaari（1965年）以来，传统观点认为没有遗产动机的家庭应该完全将投资转化为年金。许多摩擦因素并不会破坏这一结论。我们通过允许家庭因健康冲击而面临死亡风险，对Yaari的框架进行了修改。终身年金仍然有助于对冲长寿风险。但是，年金的剩余现值与医疗费用相关，例如养老院护理费用，这会降低年金需求，即使没有特殊的流动性限制。我们发现，大多数家庭不应持有正水平的年金，而许多家庭应该持有负水平的年金。（JEL D14, D82, G23, I12, J14, J26）

abstract.text: We propose a new theory of exclusive dealing. The theory is based on the assumption that a dominant firm has a competitive advantage over its rivals, and that the buyers' willingness to pay for the product is private information. In this setting, the dominant firm can impose contractual restrictions on buyers without necessarily compensating them, implying that exclusive dealing contracts can be both profitable and anticompetitive. We discuss the general implications of the theory for competition policy and illustrate by examples its applicability to antitrust cases. (JEL D21, D43, D82, D86, K21, L13, L40)

10.1257/aer.20131664.abstractZh: 我们提出了一种关于独家交易的新理论。该理论基于这样一个假设：一家主导企业拥有相对于竞争对手的竞争优势，而买家对产品支付意愿的信息是私有的。在这种情况下，主导企业可以对买家施加合同限制，而无需给予补偿，这意味着独家交易合同既可能带来利润，也可能产生反竞争效应。我们讨论了该理论对竞争政策的一般影响，并通过实例说明了其在反垄断案件中的适用性。（JEL D21, D43, D82, D86, K21, L13, L40）

abstract.text: We develop and analyze a labor market model in which heterogeneous firms operate under decreasing returns and compete for labor by posting long-term contracts. Firms achieve faster growth by offering higher lifetime wages, which allows them to fill vacancies with higher probability, consistent with recent empirical findings. The model also captures several other regularities about firm size, job flows, and pay, and generates sluggish aggregate dynamics of labor market variables. In contrast to existing bargaining models with large firms, efficiency obtains and the model allows a tractable characterization over the business cycle. (JEL E24, J64, L11)

10.1257/aer.20131702.abstractZh: 我们开发并分析了一个劳动力市场模型，其中不同性质的企业在递减收益条件下运作，并通过签订长期合同来竞争劳动力。企业通过提供更高的终身工资来实现更快的增长，这使他们能够更有可能填补空缺职位，这与最近的实证研究结果一致。该模型还捕捉了关于企业规模、职位流动和薪酬的若干规律性现象，并导致劳动力市场变量的整体动态较为缓慢。与现有的大型企业谈判模型不同，该模型能够实现效率，并且能够在商业周期中提供一个易于处理的模型描述。（JEL E24, J64, L11）

abstract.text: This paper explores the impact of the introduction of the widely viewed MTV reality show 16 and Pregnant on teen childbearing. Our main analysis relates geographic variation in changes in teen childbearing rates to viewership of the show. We implement an instrumental variables (IV ) strategy using local area MTV ratings data from a pre-period to predict local area 16 and Pregnant ratings. The results imply that this show led to a 4.3 percent reduction in teen births. An examination of Google Trends and Twitter data suggest that the show led to increased interest in contraceptive use and abortion.

10.1257/aer.20140012.abstractZh: 本文探讨了广受关注的MTV真人秀节目《16 and Pregnant》对青少年生育率的影响。我们的主要分析将青少年生育率变化的地理差异与节目的收视率联系起来。我们采用了工具变量策略，利用节目播出前当地的MTV收视率数据来预测《16 and Pregnant》的收视率。研究结果表明，该节目导致青少年生育率降低了4.3%。对Google趋势和Twitter数据的分析表明，该节目引发了人们对避孕方法和堕胎的更多兴趣。

abstract.text: We study the direct and spillover effects of local state capacity in Colombia. We model the determination of state capacity as a network game between municipalities and the national government. We estimate this model exploiting the municipality network and the roots of local state capacity related to the presence of the colonial state and royal roads. Our estimates indicate that local state capacity decisions are strategic complements. Spillover effects are sizable, accounting for about 50 percent of the quantitative impact of an expansion in local state capacity, but network effects driven by equilibrium responses of other municipalities are much larger. (JEL D85, H41, H77, O17, O18)

10.1257/aer.20140044.abstractZh: 我们研究了哥伦比亚地方国家能力的直接效应和溢出效应。我们将地方国家能力的形成建模为市镇与国家政府之间的网络博弈。我们通过利用市镇网络以及与地方国家能力相关的殖民政府存在和皇家道路等因素来估算这一模型。我们的估算表明，地方国家能力的决策是战略性的互补关系。溢出效应相当显著，约占地方国家能力扩展所带来的量化影响的50%，而由其他市镇的均衡反应所驱动的网络效应则更大。（JEL D85, H41, H77, O17, O18）

abstract.text: Using data from Pennsylvania and an array of empirical techniques to control for confounding factors, we recover hedonic estimates of property value impacts from nearby shale gas development that vary with water source, well productivity, and visibility. Results indicate large negative impacts on nearby groundwater-dependent homes, while piped-water-dependent homes exhibit smaller positive impacts, suggesting benefits from lease payments. Results have implications for the debate over regulation of shale gas development. (JEL L71, Q35, Q53, R31)

10.1257/aer.20140079.abstractZh: 通过利用宾夕法尼亚州的数据以及一系列控制混杂因素的经验技术，我们得出了关于附近页岩气开发对房产价值影响的享乐估计值。这些影响随水源、井的生产效率和可见度而变化。结果表明，对依赖地下水的住宅有较大的负面影响，而依赖管道供水的住宅则受到较小的正面影响，这表明租赁付款可能带来一些好处。这些结果对关于页岩气开发监管的争论具有启示意义。（JEL L71, Q35, Q53, R31）

abstract.text: Apparently mistaken decisions are ubiquitous. To what extent does this reflect irrationality, as opposed to a rational trade-off between the costs of information acquisition and the expected benefits of learning? We develop a revealed preference test that characterizes all patterns of choice “mistakes” consistent with a general model of optimal costly information acquisition and identify the extent to which information costs can be recovered from choice data. (JEL D11, D81, D83)

10.1257/aer.20140117.abstractZh: 显然，错误的决策普遍存在。这种错误在多大程度上反映了非理性行为，还是信息获取成本与学习预期收益之间达成的一种理性权衡？我们开发了一种揭示偏好的测试方法，能够识别所有与最优信息获取成本模型相一致的“选择错误”模式，并确定信息成本可以在多大程度上从选择数据中得到恢复。（JEL D11, D81, D83）

abstract.text: In this paper we analyze elections when voters underestimate the correlation between their information sources (“correlation neglect”). We find that this cognitive bias can improve political outcomes. We show that the extreme beliefs which result from correlation neglect induce some voters to base their vote on information rather than on political preferences. We characterize conditions on the distribution of preferences under which this induces higher vote shares for the optimal policies and better information aggregation. (JEL D72, D83)

10.1257/aer.20140134.abstractZh: 在本文中，我们分析了选民低估信息来源之间相关性的情况，即“相关性忽视”。我们发现这种认知偏差可以改善政治结果。我们指出，由相关性忽视导致的极端信念促使一些选民依据信息而非政治偏好来投票。我们描述了偏好分布的条件，在这些条件下，这种偏好方式能够提升对最优政策的支持率，并改善信息整合效果。（JEL D72, D83）

abstract.text: We explore how changes in ownership affect the productivity and profitability of producers. Using detailed data from the Japanese cotton spinning industry at the turn of the last century, we find that acquired firms' production facilities were not on average less physically productive than the plants of the acquiring firms before acquisition. They were much less profitable, however, due to higher inventory levels and lower capacity utilization—differences that reflected problems in managing the uncertainties of demand. After acquisitions, less profitable acquired plants saw drops in inventories and gains in capacity utilization that raised both their productivity and profitability levels. (JEL D24, G32, G34, L11, L25, L66, N65)

10.1257/aer.20140150.abstractZh: 我们探讨了所有权变更如何影响生产者的生产效率和盈利能力。通过利用上个世纪初日本棉纺行业的详细数据，我们发现被收购企业的生产设施在收购前平均而言并不比收购方自身的工厂生产效率低。然而，由于库存水平较高和产能利用率较低，这些被收购企业的盈利能力明显较差——这些差异反映了在管理需求不确定性方面的问题。在收购之后，盈利能力较差的被收购企业通过减少库存和提高产能利用率，提升了生产效率和盈利能力。（JEL D24, G32, G34, L11, L25, L66, N65）

abstract.text: We propose a new abstract definition of equilibrium in the spirit of competitive equilibrium: a profile of alternatives and a public ordering (expressing prestige, price, or a social norm) such that each agent prefers his assigned alternative to all lower-ranked ones. The equilibrium operates in an abstract setting built upon a concept of convexity borrowed from convex geometry. We apply the concept to a variety of convex economies and relate it to Pareto optimality. The “magic” of linear equilibrium prices is put into perspective by establishing an analogy between linear functions in the standard convexity and “primitive orderings” in the abstract convexity. (JEL I11, I18, J44, K13)

10.1257/aer.20140270.abstractZh: 我们提出了一种新的均衡抽象定义，其理念源自竞争均衡：一种包含替代方案的配置，以及一种表达声望、价格或社会规范的公共排序，使得每个主体都更倾向于选择其被分配的替代方案，而非所有排名较低的方案。这种均衡在一个基于凸性概念的抽象框架中运作，该概念借鉴自凸几何学。我们将这一概念应用于多种凸形经济模型，并将其与帕累托最优性联系起来。通过建立标准凸性中的线性函数与抽象凸性中的“原始排序”之间的类比，我们揭示了线性均衡价格的“魔力”。(JEL I11, I18, J44, K13)

abstract.text: This paper considers the normative implications of technical change for tax policy design. A task-to-talent assignment model of the labor market is embedded into an optimal tax problem. Technical change modifies equilibrium wage growth across talents and the substitutability of talents across tasks. The overall optimal policy response is to reduce marginal income taxes on low to middle incomes, while raising those on middle to high incomes. The reform favors those in the middle of the income distribution, reducing their average taxes while lowering transfers to those at the bottom. (JEL D31, H21, H23, H24, J31, O33)

10.1257/aer.20140466.abstractZh: 本文探讨了技术变革对税收政策设计的规范意义。将劳动力市场的任务-人才分配模型嵌入到最优税收问题中。技术变革改变了不同人才之间的均衡工资增长以及不同任务之间人才的可替代性。总体最优政策反应是降低低至中等收入的边际所得税，同时提高中等至高收入的边际所得税。这一改革有利于收入分布中层的群体，减少他们的平均税收负担，同时降低对低收入群体的转移支付。（JEL D31, H21, H23, H24, J31, O33）

abstract.text: Faced with numerous potential catastrophes—nuclear and bioterrorism, mega-viruses, climate change, and others—which should society attempt to avert? A policy to avert one catastrophe considered in isolation might be evaluated in cost-benefit terms. But because society faces multiple catastrophes, simple cost-benefit analysis fails: even if the benefit of averting each one exceeds the cost, we should not necessarily avert them all. We explore the policy interdependence of catastrophic events, and develop a rule for determining which catastrophes should be averted and which should not. (JEL D61, Q51, Q54)

10.1257/aer.20140806.abstractZh: 面对众多潜在的灾难——核灾难、生物恐怖主义、超级病毒、气候变化等——社会应该尝试避免哪些灾难？单独考虑避免某一灾难的政策时，可以通过成本效益分析来评估。但由于社会面临的是多种灾难，简单的成本效益分析并不适用：即使避免每一种灾难的效益超过其成本，我们也不一定会避免所有这些灾难。我们探讨了灾难性事件之间的政策相互依赖性，并提出了一种规则，以确定哪些灾难应该被避免，哪些则不必避免。（JEL D61, Q51, Q54）

abstract.text: We analyze strategic speculators’ incentives to trade on information in a model where firm value is endogenous to trading, due to feedback from the financial market to corporate decisions. Trading reveals private information to managers and improves their real decisions, enhancing fundamental value. This feedback effect has an asymmetric effect on trading behavior: it increases (reduces) the profitability of buying (selling) on good (bad) news. This gives rise to an endogenous limit to arbitrage, whereby investors may refrain from trading on negative information. Thus, bad news is incorporated more slowly into prices than good news, potentially leading to overinvestment. (JEL D83, G12, G14)

10.1257/aer.20141271.abstractZh: 我们在一个模型中分析了战略投机者的交易动机，该模型认为企业价值因金融市场对企业决策的反馈而内生性地发生变化。交易行为向管理者揭示了私人信息，并改善了他们的实际决策，从而提升了企业的基本价值。这种反馈效应对交易行为产生了不对称的影响：它增加了（减少了）在利好或坏消息情况下进行买卖的盈利能力。这导致套利行为受到内生性的限制，投资者可能会避免在负面信息上进行交易。因此，坏消息被纳入价格的速度比好消息慢，这可能导致过度投资。（JEL D83, G12, G14）

abstract.text: We present results from a “corruption game” (a dictator game modified so that recipients can take a side payment in exchange for accepting a reduction in the overall size of the pie). Dictators (silently) treated to be able to take more of the recipient's tokens, took more of them. They were also more likely to believe that recipients had accepted side payments, even if there was a prize for accuracy. The results favor the hypothesis that people avoid altruistic actions by distorting beliefs about others' altruism. (JEL C72, D63, D64, D83)

10.1257/aer.20141409.abstractZh: 我们展示了“腐败游戏”的结果（一种经过修改的独裁游戏，让接受者可以接受额外的报酬，以换取整体利益规模的减少）。独裁者（默默无闻地）认为可以获取更多的接受者代币，因此他们获取了更多的代币。他们也更有可能相信接受者已经接受了额外的报酬，即使存在准确判断的奖励。这些结果支持了这样一个假设：人们通过扭曲对他人利他行为的认知来避免采取利他行为。（JEL C72, D63, D64, D83）
