abstract.text: We estimate a model of importers in Hungarian microdata and conduct counterfactual analysis to investigate the effect of imported inputs on productivity. We find that importing all input varieties would increase a firm’s revenue productivity by 22 percent, about one-half of which is due to imperfect substitution between foreign and domestic inputs. Foreign firms use imports more effectively and pay lower fixed import costs. We attribute one-quarter of Hungarian productivity growth during the 1993–2002 period to imported inputs. Simulations show that the productivity gain from a tariff cut is larger when the economy has many importers and many foreign firms. (JEL D24, F13, F14, L60)

10.1257/aer.20150443.abstractZh: 我们在匈牙利微观数据中估算了一个进口商模型，并进行了反事实分析，以研究进口投入对生产率的影响。我们发现，如果所有投入品都来自进口，企业的收入生产率将提高22%，其中约一半是由于外国和国内投入品之间的替代不完全造成的。外国企业更高效地使用进口品，并且固定进口成本更低。我们认为，在1993年至2002年期间，匈牙利生产率增长的四分之一归因于进口投入。模拟结果显示，当经济中有许多进口商和许多外国企业时，关税降低带来的生产率提升更为显著。（JEL D24, F13, F14, L60）

abstract.text: The U.S. health-care sector is large and growing—health-care spending in 2011 amounted to $2.7 trillion and 18 percent of GDP. Approximately half of health-care output is allocated via markets. In this paper, we analyze the industrial organization literature on health-care markets, focusing on the impact of competition on price, quality, and treatment decisions for health-care providers and health insurers. We conclude with a discussion of research opportunities for industrial organization economists, including opportunities created by the U.S. Patient Protection and Affordable Care Act. (JEL J15, J24, J71, J81, K31)

10.1257/jel.53.2.235.abstractZh: 美国的医疗保健行业规模庞大且持续增长——2011年医疗保健支出达到2.7万亿美元，占GDP的18%。大约一半的医疗保健产出通过市场分配。在本文中，我们分析了关于医疗保健市场的产业组织文献，重点关注竞争对医疗保健提供者和健康保险公司价格、质量和治疗决策的影响。最后，我们讨论了产业组织经济学家的研究机会，包括《美国患者保护与平价医疗法案》带来的机遇。（JEL J15, J24, J71, J81, K31）

abstract.text: Three separate pay-for-performance programs affect the amount of Medicare payment for inpatient services to about 3,400 US hospitals. These payments are based on hospital performance on specified measures of quality of care. A growing share of Medicare hospital payments (6 percent by 2017) are dependent upon how hospitals perform under the Hospital Readmissions Reduction Program, the Value-Based Purchasing Program, and the Hospital-Acquired Condition Reduction Program. In 2015 four of five hospitals subject to these programs will be penalized under one or more of them, and more than one in three major teaching hospitals will be penalized under all three. Interactions among these programs should be considered going forward, including overlap among measures and differences in scoring performance.

10.1377/hlthaff.2015.0158.abstractZh: 三种不同的绩效付费计划影响着约3,400家美国医院在住院服务方面的医疗保险支付金额。这些支付基于医院在护理质量方面的表现。越来越多的医疗保险医院支付（到2017年占比达6%）取决于医院在住院再入院减少计划、基于价值的采购计划以及医院获得性疾病减少计划下的表现。2015年，受这些计划影响的五家医院中有四家会因此受到处罚，而超过三分之一的知名教学医院将在所有三个计划下都面临处罚。未来应考虑这些计划之间的相互作用，包括不同指标之间的重叠以及评分标准的差异。

abstract.text: Este trabalho caracteriza e discute a privatização da gestão do sistema municipal de saúde na cidade de São Paulo, Brasil, com base em uma perspectiva administrativista e política. A metodologia consistiu em levantamento bibliográfico e análise de legislação e documentos públicos. A pesquisa demonstrou que embora a lei de Organizações Sociais (OS) seja de 2006, metade da privatização da gestão ainda é regulada por um ajuste provisório anterior, o convênio. Em 2011, 61% dos serviços eram geridos por entidades privadas que, em 2012, receberam 44% do orçamento da saúde. As vinte entidades envolvidas incluem cinco dos dez maiores grupos privados de serviços médicos do país. Órgãos fiscalizadores evidenciam falhas de controle nos contratos de gestão, mas os convênios, que apresentam controle mais frágil, têm sido invisíveis à fiscalização. Por fim, o marco legal é instável. Valendo-se da experiência paulistana, discute-se o caráter político vs. técnico da regulação da gestão privada no Sistema Único de Saúde (SUS).

10.1590/0102-311x00015914.abstractZh: 本研究以行政学和政治视角为基础，对巴西圣保罗市市政卫生系统管理的私有化进行了特征描述和讨论。研究方法包括文献调研以及法律法规和公共文件的分析。研究结果表明，尽管《社会组织法》制定于2006年，但市政卫生系统管理的一半私有化仍受先前临时协议的限制。2011年，61%的服务由私人机构管理，这些机构在2012年获得了卫生预算的44%。参与其中的二十个私人机构中，有五个是该国十大最大的医疗服务私人集团。监管机构指出，管理合同存在控制漏洞，而那些控制较弱的协议则被监管机构忽视。最后，相关的法律框架并不稳定。基于圣保罗的经验，本文探讨了在单一卫生系统中对私人管理进行监管的政治性与技术性因素。

abstract.text: We examine the long-term impact of expansions to Medicaid and the State Children's Health Insurance Program that occurred in the 1980's and 1990's. With administrative data from the IRS, we calculate longitudinal health insurance eligibility from birth to age 18 for children in cohorts affected by these expansions, and we observe their longitudinal outcomes as adults. Using a simulated instrument that relies on variation in eligibility by cohort and state, we find that children whose eligibility increased paid more in cumulative taxes by age 28. These children collected less in EITC payments, and the women had higher cumulative wages by age 28. Incorporating additional data from the Medicaid Statistical Information System (MSIS), we find that the government spent $872 in 2011 dollars for each additional year of Medicaid eligibility induced by the expansions. Putting this together with the estimated increase in tax payments discounted at a 3% rate, assuming that tax impacts are persistent in percentage terms, the government will recoup 56 cents of each dollar spent on childhood Medicaid by the time these children reach age 60. This return on investment does not take into account other benefits that accrue directly to the children, including estimated decreases in mortality and increases in college attendance. Moreover, using the MSIS data, we find that each additional year of Medicaid eligibility from birth to age 18 results in approximately 0.58 additional years of Medicaid receipt. Therefore, if we scale our results by the ratio of beneficiaries to eligibles, then all of our results are almost twice as large.

10.3386/w20835.abstractZh: 我们研究了20世纪80年代和90年代 Medicaid和州儿童健康保险计划扩展对长期影响的分析。通过美国国税局提供的行政数据，我们计算了受这些扩展影响的儿童从出生到18岁的长期健康保险资格情况，并观察了他们成年后的长期结果。利用基于不同队列和州之间资格变化的模拟工具，我们发现资格增加的儿童在28岁时缴纳的累计税款更多。这些儿童从EITC中获得的收入较少，而女性到28岁的累计工资则更高。结合来自Medicaid统计信息系统（MSIS）的额外数据，我们发现政府因这些扩展而额外获得的每一年 Medicaid资格，在2011年的货币价值上花费了872美元。假设税收影响在百分比上具有持久性，将这些费用与以3%的折现率计算的税收增加额结合起来，政府在这批儿童达到60岁时，每花费1美元在儿童 Medicaid上，将获得56美分的回报。这种投资回报并未考虑直接惠及儿童的其他福利，包括估计的死亡率下降和大学入学率的增加。此外，利用MSIS数据，我们发现从出生到18岁的每一年 Medicaid资格增加，大约意味着额外的0.58年 Medicaid服务。因此，如果我们按照受益人与资格人的比例来缩放我们的结果，那么所有的结果几乎都是原来的两倍。

abstract.text: Many economic transactions are prohibited—even in the absence of health or safety concerns or negative externalities—because of ethical concerns that cause these exchanges to be perceived as “repugnant” if conducted through a market. Establishing a system of payments for human organs is a particularly relevant example given its implications for public health; in almost all countries, these payments are prohibited because they are considered morally unacceptable—a prohibition that societies seem to accept despite the long waitlists and high death rates for people needing a transplant. We investigate how deeply rooted these attitudes are and, in particular, whether providing information on how a price mechanism can help alleviate the organ shortage changes people’s opinions about the legalization of these transactions. We conducted a survey experiment with 3,417 subjects in the U.S. and found that providing information significantly increased support for payments for organs from a baseline of 52% to 72%, and this increase applied to most of the relevant subgroups of the analyzed sample. Additional analyses on the support for other morally controversial activities show that attitude changes in response to information depend on the type of activity under consideration and interactions with other beliefs.

10.3386/w20866.abstractZh: 许多经济交易被禁止——即使在没有健康或安全方面的担忧或负面外部性的情况下——因为道德上的顾虑使得这些交易在通过市场进行时会被视为“令人反感”的。建立人体器官支付系统就是一个特别相关的例子，因为它对公共健康有着重要的影响；在几乎所有国家，这种支付行为都被禁止，因为它们被认为在道德上是不可接受的——尽管存在漫长的等待名单和需要移植的人较高的死亡率，社会似乎仍然接受这种禁令。我们研究了这些态度有多根深蒂固，特别是提供有关价格机制如何帮助缓解器官短缺的信息是否会改变人们对这些交易合法化的看法。我们在美国对3,417名受试者进行了调查实验，发现提供相关信息显著增加了对器官支付的支持，从基线水平的52%上升到72%，而且这种支持增加适用于分析样本中的大多数相关子群体。对其它道德上存在争议的活动支持的额外分析表明，对信息的反应态度变化取决于所考虑的活动类型以及其他信念的相互作用。

abstract.text: Drugs like bevacizumab ($50,000 per treatment episode) and ipilimumab ($120,000 per episode) have fueled the perception that the launch prices of anticancer drugs are increasing over time. Using an original dataset of 58 anticancer drugs approved between 1995 and 2013, we find that launch prices, adjusted for inflation and drugs’ survival benefits, increased by 10%, or about $8,500, per year. Although physicians are not penalized for prescribing costly drugs, they may be reluctant to prescribe drugs with prices that exceed subjective standards of fairness. Manufacturers may set higher launch prices over time as standards evolve. Pricing trends may also reflect manufacturers’ response to expansions in the 340B Drug Pricing Program, which requires manufacturers to provide steep discounts to eligible providers.

10.3386/w20867.abstractZh: 像贝伐单抗（每次治疗费用为50,000美元）和伊匹木单抗（每次治疗费用为120,000美元）这样的药物，使得人们认为抗癌药物的上市价格随着时间的推移而不断上涨。通过利用1995年至2013年间批准的58种抗癌药物的原始数据集，我们发现，考虑到通货膨胀和药物的生存效益后，这些药物的价格每年上涨了10%，约8,500美元。尽管医生在开处方昂贵药物时不会受到惩罚，但他们可能会不愿意开出价格超出主观公平标准的药物。随着标准的演变，制造商可能会逐步提高上市价格。定价趋势也可能反映了制造商对340B药物定价计划扩展的响应，该计划要求制造商向符合条件的供应商提供大幅折扣。

abstract.text: At the end of 1998, China launched a government-run mandatory insurance program, the Urban Employee Basic Medical Insurance (UEBMI), to replace the previous medical insurance system. Using the UEBMI reform in China as a natural experiment, this study identify variations in patient cost sharing that were imposed by the UEBMI reform and examine their effects on the demand for health-care services. Using data from the 1991-2006 waves of the China Health and Nutrition Survey, we find that the increased cost sharing is associated with decreased outpatient medical care utilization and expenditures but not with decreased inpatient care utilization and expenditures. Patients from low- and middle-income households, or in less-serious medical situations are found to be more sensitive to prices. We observe little impact on patient health, as measured by self-reported poor health status.

10.3386/w20873.abstractZh: 1998年底，中国推出了由政府主导的强制性保险计划——城市职工基本医疗保险（UEBMI），以取代之前的医疗保险体系。本研究以中国的UEBMI改革为自然实验，分析改革带来的患者费用分担变化，并探讨这些变化对医疗服务需求的影响。通过1991至2006年中国健康与营养调查的数据分析，我们发现费用分担的增加与门诊医疗服务的利用和支出减少有关，但与住院医疗服务的利用和支出减少无关。来自低收入和中等收入家庭的患者，或处于较轻微医疗状况的患者，对价格更为敏感。此外，患者健康状况的自报结果显示，这种费用分担变化对其健康几乎没有影响。

abstract.text: Local opinion leaders may play a key role in easing information frictions associated with technology adoption. This paper analyzes the influence of physician investigators who lead clinical trials for new cancer drugs. By comparing diffusion patterns across 21 new cancer drugs, we separate correlated regional demand for new technology from information spillovers. Patients in the lead investigator's region are initially 36% more likely to receive the new drug, but utilization converges within four years. We also find that “superstar ” physician authors, measured by trial role or citation history, have broader influence than less prominent authors.

10.3386/w20878.abstractZh: 地方舆论领袖在缓解与技术采用相关的信息摩擦方面可能发挥关键作用。本文分析了负责新抗癌药物临床试验的医生研究人员的影响力。通过比较21种新抗癌药物的扩散模式，我们将新技术的相关区域需求与信息溢出效应区分开来。最初，在主导研究者所在地区的患者中，接受新药物的可能性高出36%，但四年之内利用率趋于一致。我们还发现，以试验角色或引用历史来衡量的“超级明星”医生作者，其影响力比不太突出的作者更为广泛。

abstract.text: Young people with private health insurance sometimes transition to the public health insurance safety net after they get sick, but popular sources of cross-sectional data obscure how frequently these transitions occur. We use longitudinal data on almost all hospital visits in New York from 1995 to 2011. We show that young privately insured individuals with diagnoses that require more hospital visits in subsequent years are more likely to transition to public insurance. If we ignore the longitudinal transitions in our data, we obscure over 80% of the value of public health insurance to the young and privately insured.

10.3386/w20887.abstractZh: 拥有私人健康保险的年轻人有时在生病后会转向公共健康保险的安全网络，但现有的横断面数据无法反映这种转换发生的频率。我们使用了1995年至2011年间纽约几乎所有住院记录的纵向数据。研究表明，那些被诊断出需要多次住院的年轻私人保险持有者更有可能转向公共保险。如果我们忽略数据中的纵向转换，那么公共健康保险对年轻人和私人保险持有者的价值将减少80%以上。

abstract.text: We quantify the impact of scientific grant funding at the National Institutes of Health (NIH) on patenting by pharmaceutical and biotechnology firms. Our paper makes two contributions. First, we use newly constructed bibliometric data to develop a method for flexibly linking specific grant expenditures to private-sector innovations. Second, we take advantage of idiosyncratic rigidities in the rules governing NIH peer review to generate exogenous variation in funding across research areas. Our results show that NIH funding spurs the development of private-sector patents: a $10 million boost in NIH funding leads to a net increase of 2.3 patents. Though valuing patents is difficult, we report a range of estimates for the private value of these patents using different approaches.

10.3386/w20889.abstractZh: 我们量化了美国国立卫生研究院（NIH）的科研资助对制药和生物技术公司专利申请的影响。我们的论文有两个贡献点。首先，我们利用新构建的文献计量数据，开发了一种灵活的方法，将具体的科研资助支出与私营部门的创新活动联系起来。其次，我们利用NIH同行评审规则中的特殊性刚性，产生了不同研究领域的资金差异。我们的结果显示，NIH的资助促进了私营部门专利的发展：每增加1000万美元的NIH资金，专利数量就会增加2.3项。尽管评估专利价值很困难，但我们使用不同的方法报告了这些专利的私人价值范围。

abstract.text: A growing literature examines the effects of economic variables on obesity, typically focusing on only one or a few factors at a time. We build a more comprehensive economic model of body weight, combining the 1990-2010 Behavioral Risk Factor Surveillance System with 27 state-level variables related to general economic conditions, labor supply, and the monetary or time costs of calorie intake, physical activity, and cigarette smoking. Controlling for demographic characteristics and state and year fixed effects, changes in these economic variables collectively explain 37% of the rise in BMI, 43% of the rise in obesity, and 59% of the rise in class II/III obesity. Quantile regressions also point to large effects among the heaviest individuals, with half the rise in the 90th percentile of BMI explained by economic factors. Variables related to calorie intake – particularly restaurant and supercenter/warehouse club densities – are the primary drivers of the results.

10.3386/w20892.abstractZh: 越来越多的研究探讨了经济变量对肥胖的影响，但通常只关注一个或几个因素。我们构建了一个更为全面的经济模型来描述体重变化，该模型结合了1990-2010年的行为风险因素监测系统以及27个与整体经济状况、劳动力供应以及摄入热量、体力活动和吸烟的货币或时间成本相关的州级变量。在控制人口统计特征以及州和年份固定效应后，这些经济变量的变化共同解释了BMI上升的37%、肥胖上升的43%以及II/III级肥胖上升的59%。分位数回归分析还表明，最重的人群受到较大的经济因素影响，BMI在第90百分位的上升幅度中，有半数可以由经济因素解释。与摄入热量相关的变量——尤其是餐厅和超市/仓储俱乐部密度——是这些结果的主要驱动因素。

abstract.text: A large economics literature has shown long term impacts of birth weight on adult outcomes, including IQ and earnings that are often robust to sibling or twin fixed effects. We examine potential mechanisms underlying these effects by incorporating findings from the genetics and neuroscience literatures. We use a sample of siblings combined with an “orchids and dandelions hypothesis”, where the IQ of genetic dandelions is not affected by in utero nutrition variation but genetic orchids thrive under advantageous conditions and wilt in poor conditions. Indeed, using variation in three candidate genes related to neuroplasticity (APOE, BDNF, and COMT), we find substantial heterogeneity in the associations between birth weight and adult outcomes, where part of the population (i.e., “dandelions”) is not affected by birth weight variation. Our results help uncover why birth weight affects adult outcomes.

10.3386/w20895.abstractZh: 大量经济学文献已经证明了出生体重对成年后结果的影响，包括智商和收入，这些影响通常能够抵抗兄弟姐妹或双胞胎的固定效应。我们通过结合遗传学和神经科学领域的研究发现，来探讨这些影响的潜在机制。我们选取了兄弟姐妹样本，并运用了“兰花与蒲公英假说”：遗传上的“蒲公英”个体不会受到子宫内营养差异的影响，而“兰花”则能在有利条件下茁壮成长，在恶劣条件下则会枯萎。实际上，通过研究与神经可塑性相关的三个候选基因（APOE、BDNF和COMT）的变异，我们发现出生体重与成年后结果之间的关联存在显著的异质性，其中一部分人群（即“兰花”）并不受出生体重变化的影响。我们的研究结果有助于揭示出生体重为何会影响成年后的结果。

abstract.text: How does competition affect innovation and how it is financed in R&D-intensive firms? We study the interaction between competition, R&D investments, and the financing choices of such firms using data on biopharmaceutical firms. To motivate the empirical hypotheses, we develop a model for such firms in which their capital structure and amounts invested in R&D as well as existing assets are all determined in response to the degree of competition in the industry. The key predictions are that, as competition increases, such firms will: (1) increase R&D investment relative to investment in assets-in-place that support existing products; (2) carry more cash and maintain less net debt; and (3) experience declining betas but greater total stock return volatility due to higher idiosyncratic risk. While the focus is on the biopharmaceutical industry, the results are broadly applicable to other R&Dintensive industries as well. We provide empirical support for these predictions. In order to deal with the endogeneity issue introduced by the fact that a firm's R&D investments and the product-market competition it faces influence each other, we provide further evidence through a differences-in-differences analysis.

10.3386/w20903.abstractZh: 竞争如何影响创新，以及研发密集型企业的研发资金是如何筹措的？我们研究了竞争、研发投资以及这些企业的融资选择之间的相互作用，使用了生物制药企业的数据作为研究基础。为了验证这些实证假设，我们为这类企业建立了一个模型，该模型中的资本结构、研发投资金额以及现有资产都取决于行业内的竞争程度。主要预测结果表明，随着竞争加剧，这类企业将：(1) 增加研发投资，而非用于支持现有产品的固定资产投资；(2) 持有更多现金，并维持较低的净债务；(3) β值下降，但由于特异性风险增加，总股票回报的波动性会更大。虽然研究重点是生物制药行业，但这些结果同样适用于其他研发密集型行业。我们为这些预测提供了实证支持。为了处理因企业研发投资与其面临的产品市场竞争相互影响所带来的内生性问题，我们通过差异组分析进一步提供了证据。

abstract.text: Econometric estimates of the responsiveness of health-related consumer demand to higher prices are often key ingredients for policy analysis. Drawing on several examples, especially that of cigarette demand, we review the potential advantages and challenges of synthesizing econometric evidence on the price-responsiveness of consumer demand. We argue that the overarching goal of research synthesis in this context is to provide policy-relevant evidence for broad brush conclusions and propose three main criteria to select among research synthesis methods. We also contribute a new empirical exercise that puts the results of previous research synthesis to the test. In particular, we ask whether the “best” consensus estimates of the price-elasticity of smoking help predict trends in smoking from 1995 to 2010. The demographics of the smoking population in our baseline year predict a downward trend in smoking even if cigarette prices remained constant. Average cigarette prices, however, more than doubled in real terms by 2010. We find that the observed declines in smoking over this period are considerably smaller than smoking demographics combined with prior consensus elasticity estimates would predict. Our results suggest that these consensus estimates may have systematically overestimated the price responsiveness of cigarette demand.

10.3386/w20906.abstractZh: 对与健康相关的消费需求对价格上涨的反应进行计量经济学估计，通常是政策分析的关键要素。通过几个例子，特别是香烟需求的情况，我们回顾了综合计量经济学证据以分析消费需求价格反应可能带来的优势与挑战。我们认为，在这种背景下，研究综合的总体目标是为宏观结论提供政策相关的证据，并提出了选择研究方法的三项主要标准。我们还提供了一个新的实证练习，以检验先前研究综合的结果。具体来说，我们探讨了“最佳”的共识估计的吸烟价格弹性是否能够帮助预测1995年至2010年间吸烟趋势的变化。即使香烟价格保持不变，我们基准年份的吸烟人口统计数据也预示着吸烟数量将呈下降趋势。然而，到2010年，平均香烟价格实际翻了一番多。我们发现，在此期间观察到的吸烟数量下降幅度明显小于吸烟人口统计数据与先前共识弹性估计所预测的幅度。我们的结果表明，这些共识估计可能系统性地高估了香烟需求的价格反应能力。

abstract.text: Under the Affordable Care Act, individual states have discretion in how they define coverage regions, within which insurers must charge the same premium to buyers of the same age, family structure, and smoking status. We exploit variation in these definitions to investigate whether the size of the coverage region affects outcomes in the ACA marketplaces. We find large consequences for small and rural markets. When states combine small counties with neighboring urban areas into a single region, the included rural markets see .6 to .8 more active insurers, on average, and savings in annual premiums of between $200 and $300.

10.3386/w20907.abstractZh: 根据《平价医疗法案》的规定，各州在定义覆盖区域方面具有自主权，但保险公司必须向相同年龄、家庭结构和吸烟状况的消费者收取相同的保费。我们利用这些定义上的差异来研究覆盖区域的大小是否会影响《平价医疗法案》市场中的结果。研究发现，对于小型和农村市场来说，这种差异会产生显著的影响。当各州将小型县与邻近的城市区域合并为一个区域时，这些农村市场平均会拥有更多活跃的保险公司，并且年保费节省幅度在200美元到300美元之间。

abstract.text: We study the evolution of individual labor earnings over the life cycle using a large panel data set of earnings histories drawn from U.S. administrative records. Using fully nonparametric methods, our analysis reaches two broad conclusions. First, earnings shocks display substantial deviations from lognormality---the standard assumption in the incomplete markets literature. In particular, earnings shocks display strong negative skewness and extremely high kurtosis---as high as 30 compared with 3 for a Gaussian distribution. The high kurtosis implies that in a given year, most individuals experience very small earnings shocks, and a small but non-negligible number experience very large shocks. Second, these statistical properties vary significantly both over the life cycle and with the earnings level of individuals. We also estimate impulse response functions of earnings shocks and find important asymmetries: positive shocks to high-income individuals are quite transitory, whereas negative shocks are very persistent; the opposite is true for low-income individuals. Finally, we use these rich sets of moments to estimate econometric processes with increasing generality to capture these salient features of earnings dynamics.

10.3386/w20913.abstractZh: 我们研究了个体劳动收入在生命周期中的演变情况，使用了来自美国行政记录的大量面板数据。通过完全非参数方法进行分析，我们得到了两个主要结论。首先，收入冲击与对数正态分布的标准假设存在显著偏差——这是不完全市场文献中的标准假设。具体而言，收入冲击表现出强烈的负偏度以及极高的峰度，其峰度高达30，而高斯分布的峰度仅为3。高峰度意味着在某一特定年份，大多数个体的收入冲击非常微小，但也有少数个体会经历非常大的收入冲击。其次，这些统计特性在生命周期内以及随着个体收入水平的改变而显著变化。我们还估计了收入冲击的脉冲响应函数，并发现了重要的不对称性：对高收入个体的正面冲击非常短暂，而负面冲击则非常持久；对于低收入个体来说则相反。最后，我们利用这些丰富的统计信息来估计具有更高通用性的计量经济过程，以捕捉收入动态的这些显著特征。

abstract.text: Older scientists are often seen as less open to new ideas than younger scientists. We put this assertion to an empirical test. Using a measure of new ideas derived from the text of nearly all biomedical scientific articles published since 1946, we compare the tendency of younger and older researchers to try out new ideas in their work. We find that papers published in biomedicine by younger researchers are more likely to build on new ideas. Collaboration with a more experienced researcher matters as well. Papers with a young first author and a more experienced last author are more likely to try out newer ideas than papers published by other team configurations. Given the crucial role that the trying out of new ideas plays in the advancement of science, our results buttress the importance of funding scientific work by young researchers.

10.3386/w20920.abstractZh: 通常认为，年长的科学家比年轻的科学家更不乐于接受新想法。我们对这一说法进行了实证检验。通过采用一种基于1946年以来几乎所有生物医学科学文章文本得出的新想法衡量指标，我们比较了年轻和年长研究人员在其工作中尝试新想法的倾向。我们发现，由年轻研究人员在生物医学领域发表的论文更有可能建立在新的想法之上。与更有经验的研究人员的合作同样重要。由年轻的第一作者和更有经验的最终作者组成的论文，比由其他团队配置发表的论文更有可能尝试新的想法。鉴于尝试新想法在科学进步中的关键作用，我们的研究结果强调了为年轻研究人员提供资金支持的重要性。

abstract.text: Faster technological progress has long been considered a key potential benefit of agglomeration. Physical proximity to others may help inventors adopt new ideas in their work by increasing awareness about which new ideas exist and by enhancing understanding of the properties and usefulness of new ideas through a vigorous debate on the ideas' merits (Marshall, 1920). We test a key empirical prediction of this theory: that inventions in large cities build on newer ideas than inventions in smaller cities. We analyze the idea inputs of nearly every US patent granted during 1836–2010. We find that a larger city size provided a considerable advantage in inventive activities during most of the 20th century but that in recent decades this advantage has eroded.

10.3386/w20921.abstractZh: 更快的技术进步长期以来被认为是聚集效应的一个关键潜在好处。与其他人的物理邻近可能有助于发明家在工作中采纳新想法，通过增加对新想法存在的认识，并通过关于这些想法的优点的热烈讨论，增强对新想法特性和实用性的理解（Marshall, 1920）。我们测试了这一理论的一个关键实证预测：在大城市中诞生的发明往往基于比小城市中的发明更为新颖的想法。我们分析了1836年至2010年间美国几乎每一项专利的创意输入。我们发现，在20世纪的大部分时间里，较大的城市规模在发明活动方面提供了显著的优势，但在最近几十年中，这种优势已经减弱。

abstract.text: A key decision in research is whether to try out new ideas or build on more established ideas. In this paper, we evaluate which type of work is more likely to spur further invention. When recent advances create superior opportunities for invention, their adoption as research inputs in the invention process promotes technological progress. The gains from pursuing such innovative research paths may, however, be very limited as new ideas are often initially raw and poorly understood. We determine idea inputs in invention based on the text of nearly every US patent granted during 1836–2010. We find that inventions that build on new ideas early are more likely to spur subsequent invention than inventions that rely on ideas of older vintage. Our results are important because they suggest a benefit from encouraging and supporting innovative research that tries out new ideas — avoiding stagnation in technological advance.

10.3386/w20922.abstractZh: 研究中的一个关键决策是尝试新想法还是基于已有的想法进行发展。在本文中，我们评估哪种类型的工作更有可能促进进一步的创新。当最近的进展为创新创造了更优越的机会时，将这些进展作为创新过程中的研究输入将推动技术进步。然而，这种创新研究路径所带来的收益可能非常有限，因为新想法往往最初是未经充分理解的。我们基于1836年至2010年间授予的几乎所有美国专利的文本，确定了创新中的想法输入。我们发现，早期基于新想法进行的创新更有可能促进后续的创新，而依赖较老想法的创新则不太可能如此。我们的研究结果非常重要，因为它们表明，鼓励和支持尝试新想法的创新研究有助于避免技术进步停滞。

abstract.text: Prior studies suggest that consumer-directed health plans (CDHPs) -characterized by high deductibles and health care accounts- reduce health costs, but there is concern that enrollees indiscriminately reduce use of low-value services (e.g., unnecessary emergency department use) and high-value services (e.g., preventive care). We investigate how CDHP enrollees change use of pharmaceuticals for chronic diseases. We compare two large firms where nearly all employees were switched to CDHPs to firms with conventional health insurance plans. In the first firm’s CDHP, pharmaceuticals were subject to the deductible, while in the second firm pharmaceuticals were exempt. Employees in the first firm shifted the timing of drug purchases to periods with lower cost sharing and were more likely to use lower-cost drugs, but the largest effect of the CDHP was to reduce utilization. Employees in the second firm also reduced utilization, but did not shift the timing or use of low cost drugs.

10.3386/w20927.abstractZh: 先前的研究表明，以消费者为导向的健康计划（CDHPs）——其特点为较高的免赔额和医疗账户——能够降低健康成本。然而，人们担心参保者会无差别地减少低价值服务（如不必要的急诊就诊）和高价值服务（如预防性护理）的使用。我们研究了CDHP参保者对于慢性病的药物使用情况的变化。我们比较了两家大型公司：一家几乎所有员工都转向了CDHP，另一家则继续使用传统的健康保险计划。在第一家公司的CDHP中，药物费用需先支付免赔额，而在第二家公司中，药物费用则无需支付免赔额。第一家公司的员工将药物购买时间调整到了费用分摊较低的时期，并更倾向于使用成本较低的药物，但CDHP的最大效果还是降低了整体用药量。第二家公司的员工也减少了用药量，但并未调整药物购买时间或选择低成本药物。

abstract.text: Policy-makers have argued that providing public health insurance coverage to the uninsured lowers long-run costs by reducing the need for expensive hospitalizations and emergency department visits later in life. In this paper, we provide evidence for such a phenomenon by exploiting a legislated discontinuity in the cumulative number of years a child is eligible for Medicaid based on date of birth. We find that having more years of Medicaid eligibility in childhood is associated with fewer hospitalizations and emergency department visits in adulthood for blacks. Our effects are particularly pronounced for hospitalizations and emergency department visits related to chronic illnesses and those of patients living in low-income neighborhoods. Furthermore, we find evidence suggesting that these effects are larger in states where the difference in the number of Medicaid-eligible years across the cutoff birthdate is greater. Calculations suggest that lower rates of hospitalizations and emergency department visits during one year in adulthood offset between 3 and 5 percent of the initial costs of expanding Medicaid.

10.3386/w20929.abstractZh: 政策制定者认为，为未参加医疗保险的人群提供保险可以降低长期成本，因为这样可以减少日后昂贵的住院和急诊就诊需求。在本文中，我们通过利用基于出生日期的儿童获得医疗补助资格年数的法定不连续性，为这一现象提供了证据。我们发现，儿童时期获得医疗补助资格的年数越多，成年后黑人的住院和急诊就诊次数就越少。对于与慢性病相关的住院和急诊就诊，以及居住在低收入社区的患者来说，这种效应尤为明显。此外，我们发现，在医疗补助资格年数差异较大的州，这些效应更为显著。计算表明，在成年期一年内，住院和急诊就诊率的降低可以抵消扩大医疗补助计划初始成本的3%到5%。

abstract.text: We explore trends over time in the labor force participation of veterans and non-veterans and investigate whether these patterns are consistent with a rising role for the Veterans’ Affairs Disability Compensation (DC) program, which pays benefits to veterans with service-connected disabilities and has grown rapidly since 2000. Using 35 years of March CPS data, we find that veterans’ labor force participation declined over time in a way that coincides closely with DC growth and that veterans have become more sensitive to economic shocks. Our findings suggest that DC program growth has contributed to recent declines in veterans’ labor force participation.

10.3386/w20932.abstractZh: 我们探讨了退伍军人与非退伍军人劳动力参与率随时间的变化趋势，并研究了这些模式是否与退伍军人事务残疾补偿计划的作用增强相一致。该计划向因服役相关残疾而获得福利的退伍军人提供补助，自2000年以来发展迅速。通过利用35年的3月CPS数据，我们发现退伍军人的劳动力参与率随时间下降，这一趋势与残疾补偿计划的增长紧密相关，同时退伍军人对经济冲击的敏感度也有所提高。我们的研究结果表明，残疾补偿计划的增长导致了退伍军人劳动力参与率的近期下降。

abstract.text: This study uses individual-level longitudinal data from Iceland, a country that experienced a severe economic crisis in 2008 and substantial recovery by 2012, to investigate the extent to which the effects of a recession on health behaviors are lingering or short-lived and to explore trajectories in health behaviors from pre-crisis boom, to crisis, to recovery. Health-compromising behaviors (smoking, heavy drinking, sugared soft drinks, sweets, fast food, and tanning) declined during the crisis, and all but sweets continued to decline during the recovery. Health-promoting behaviors (consumption of fruit, fish oil, and vitamin/ minerals and getting recommended sleep) followed more idiosyncratic paths. Overall, most behaviors reverted back to their pre-crisis levels or trends during the recovery, and these short-term deviations in trajectories were probably too short-lived in this recession to have major impacts on health or mortality. A notable exception is for alcohol consumption, which declined dramatically during the crisis years, continued to fall (at a slower rate) during the recovery, and did not revert back to the pre-crisis upward trend during our observation period. These lingering effects, which directionally run counter to the pre-crisis upward trend, suggest that alcohol is a potential pathway by which recessions improve health and/or reduce mortality.

10.3386/w20950.abstractZh: 本研究利用冰岛的个体级纵向数据进行分析，冰岛在2008年经历了严重的经济危机，但在2012年之前实现了显著的经济复苏。研究旨在探讨经济衰退对健康行为的影响是否具有持久性，以及健康行为从危机前的繁荣时期到危机再到复苏时期的演变轨迹。在危机期间，危害健康的行为（如吸烟、酗酒、含糖饮料、甜食、快餐和日晒）有所减少，而在经济复苏期间，除甜食外，其他行为均持续下降。促进健康的行为（如食用水果、鱼油、维生素和矿物质，以及遵循推荐的睡眠时间）则呈现出更为独特的演变路径。总体而言，大多数行为在复苏期间回到了危机前的水平或趋势，这些短期的变化可能在这一经济衰退中并不足以对健康或死亡率产生重大影响。一个显著的例外是酒精消费，在危机期间大幅下降，在复苏期间继续下降（但速度较慢），并且在我们的观察期内并未恢复到危机前的上升趋势。这些持续存在的效应与危机前的上升趋势方向相反，这表明酒精可能是经济衰退改善健康和/或降低死亡率的一个潜在途径。

abstract.text: Older wealthholders spend down assets much more slowly than predicted by classic life-cycle models. This paper introduces health-dependent utility into a model in which preferences for bequests, expenditures when in need of long-term care (LTC), and ordinary consumption combine with health and longevity uncertainty to explain saving behavior. To sharply identify motives, it develops strategic survey questions (SSQs) that elicit stated preferences. The model is estimated using these SSQs and wealth data from the Vanguard Research Initiative. A robust finding is that the desire to self-insure against long-term-care risk explains a substantial fraction of the wealthholding of older Americans.

10.3386/w20973.abstractZh: 较老的财富持有者的资产消耗速度远低于经典生命周期模型所预测的。本文将健康相关的效用因素纳入模型中，该模型综合考虑了对遗产的偏好、在需要长期护理时的支出以及日常消费，并结合健康与寿命的不确定性来解释储蓄行为。为了更清晰地识别动机，本文开发了战略调查问卷，以收集受访者明确的偏好信息。该模型基于这些调查问卷和Vanguard研究机构的财富数据进行了估计。研究结果表明，为避免长期护理风险而进行的自我保险行为，解释了美国老年人财富持有量的相当一部分。

abstract.text: Medicare Part D enrollees face a complicated decision problem: they must dynamically choose prescription drug consumption in each period given difficult- to-find prices and a non-linear budget set. We use Medicare Part D claims data from 2006-2009 to estimate a flexible model of consumption that accounts for non-linear budget sets, dynamic incentives due to myopia and uncertainty, and price salience. By using variation away from kink points, we are able to estimate structural models with a linear regression of consumption on coverage range prices. We then compare performance under several candidate models of expectations and coverage phase weighting. The estimates suggest small marginal price elasticities and substantial myopia; we also find evidence that salient plan characteristics impact consumption beyond their effect on out-of-pocket prices. A hyperbolic discounting model which allows for salient plan characteristics fits the data well, and outperforms both rational models and alternative behavioral models.

10.3386/w20976.abstractZh: Medicare Part D的参保者面临着一个复杂的决策问题：他们必须在难以找到的价格和非线性的预算限制下，动态地选择每个时期的处方药消费量。我们利用2006-2009年的Medicare Part D索赔数据，建立了一个灵活的消费模型，该模型考虑了非线性预算限制、由于近视和不确定性导致的动态激励效应以及价格的重要性。通过避免拐点，我们能够建立一个结构模型，该模型将消费量与覆盖范围的定价关系通过线性回归来表示。然后，我们比较了几种预期和覆盖阶段权重模型下的模型表现。估计结果显示，边际价格弹性较小，而近视程度较高；我们还发现，显著的计划特征对消费的影响超出了其对自付费用的影响范围。一个允许显著计划特征影响的双曲贴现模型与数据非常吻合，并且其表现优于理性模型和替代的行为模型。

abstract.text: We study the impact of regulating product entry and quality information requirements on an oligopoly equilibrium and consumer welfare. Product testing can reduce consumer uncertainty, but also increase entry costs and delay entry. Using variation between EU and US medical device regulations, we document patterns consistent with valuable learning from more stringent US requirements. To derive welfare implications, we pair the data with a model of supply, demand, and testing regulation. US policy is indistinguishable from the policy that maximizes total surplus in our estimated model, while the EU could benefit from more testing. “Post-market surveillance” could further increase surplus.

10.3386/w20981.abstractZh: 我们研究了产品进入监管以及质量信息要求对寡头均衡和消费者福利的影响。产品测试可以降低消费者的不确定性，但也会增加进入成本并延缓进入市场的时间。通过对比欧盟和美国医疗器械法规的差异，我们发现从更严格的美国要求中获得的宝贵经验是显而易见的。为了得出福利影响，我们将数据与供应、需求和测试监管模型相结合。在我们计算的模型中，美国的政策与最大化总剩余的政策并无区别，而欧盟则可以从更多的测试中受益。“上市后监管”可能会进一步增加剩余收益。

abstract.text: We develop a flexible test for changes in the SES-mortality gradient over time that directly accounts for changes in the distribution of education, the most commonly used marker of SES. We implement the test for the period between 1984 and 2006 using microdata from the Census, CPS, and NHIS linked to death records. Using our flexible test, we find that the evidence for a change in the education-mortality gradient is not as strong and universal as previous research has suggested. Our results indicate that the gradient increased for females during this time period, but we cannot rule out that the gradient among males has not changed. Informally, the results suggest that the changes for females are mainly driven by the bottom of the education distribution.

10.3386/w20993.abstractZh: 我们开发了一种灵活的测试方法，用于随时间变化的SES-死亡率梯度变化，该方法直接考虑了教育分布的变化，而教育分布是衡量SES最常用的指标。我们使用1984年至2006年的微观数据，结合人口普查、犯罪与人口调查以及死亡记录数据，对这一时间段进行了分析。通过我们的灵活测试方法，我们发现教育-死亡率梯度变化的证据并不像先前研究所认为的那样普遍和强烈。我们的研究结果表明，在这段时间内，女性的死亡率梯度有所上升，但我们无法排除男性死亡率梯度没有变化的可能性。从非正式的角度来看，这些结果表明，女性死亡率梯度变化主要是由教育分布的下限部分所驱动的。

abstract.text: We investigate the mechanisms underlying health promotion campaigns designed to eliminate open defecation in at-scale randomized field experiments in four countries: India, Indonesia, Mali, and Tanzania. Health promotion works through a number of mechanisms, including: providing information on the return to better behavior, nudging better behavior that one already knows is in her self-interest, and encouraging households to invest in health products that lower the marginal cost of good behavior. We find that health promotion generally worked through both convincing households to invest in in-home sanitation facilities and nudging increased use of those facilities. We also estimate the causal relationship between village open defecation rates and child height using experimentally induced variation in open defecation for identification. Surprisingly we find a fairly linear relationship between village open defecation rates and the height of children less than 5 years old. Fully eliminating open defecation from a village where everyone defecates in the open would increase child height by 0.44 standard deviations. Hence modest to small reductions in open defecation are unlikely to have a detectable effect on child height and explain why many health promotion interventions designed to reduce open defecation fail to improve child height. Our results suggest that stronger interventions that combine intensive health promotional nudges with subsidies for sanitation construction may be needed to reduce open defecation enough to generate meaningful improvements in child health.

10.3386/w20997.abstractZh: 我们研究了在印度、印度尼西亚、马里和坦桑尼亚四个国家进行的规模较大的随机实地实验中，旨在消除露天排便现象的健康促进活动的机制。健康促进通过多种机制发挥作用，包括：提供关于改善行为的益处信息，促使人们采取已知对自己有利的行为，以及鼓励家庭投资能够降低良好行为边际成本的卫生设施。我们发现，健康促进通常是通过说服家庭投资家庭卫生设施以及促使更多人使用这些设施来实现的。我们还利用实验性诱导的露天排便变化来估计村庄露天排便率与儿童身高之间的因果关系。令人惊讶的是，我们发现村庄露天排便率与5岁以下儿童身高之间存在相当线性的关系。在一个所有人都露天排便的村庄中，完全消除露天排便将使儿童身高增加0.44个标准差。因此，即使减少少量露天排便，也不太可能对儿童身高产生可检测的影响，这也解释了为什么许多旨在减少露天排便的健康促进干预措施未能改善儿童身高。我们的研究结果表明，可能需要更强有力的干预措施，将密集的健康促进激励措施与卫生设施建设的补贴相结合，才能有效减少露天排便，从而对儿童健康产生有意义的改善。

abstract.text: Regulatory policies designed to improve societal welfare by “nudging” consumers to make better choices are increasingly popular. The application of benefit-cost analysis (BCA) to this sort of regulation confronts difficult theoretical and applied issues. In this analysis we contribute a worked example of behavioral BCA of US anti-smoking policies. Our conceptual framework extends the standard market-based approach to BCA to allow for individual failures to make lifetime utility-maximizing choices of cigarette consumption. We discuss how our market-based approach compares to the health benefits approach and the “consumer surplus offset” controversy in recent BCAs of several health-related regulations. We use a dynamic population model to make counterfactual simulations of smoking prevalence rates and cigarette demand over time. In our retrospective BCA the simulation results imply that the overall impact of antismoking policies from 1964 – 2010 is to reduce total cigarette consumption by 28 percent. At a discount rate of 3 percent the 1964-present value of the consumer benefits from anti-smoking policies through 2010 is estimated to be $573 billion ($2010). Although we are unable to develop a hard estimate of the policies’ costs, we discuss evidence that suggests the consumer benefits substantially outweigh the costs. We then turn to a prospective BCA of future anti-smoking FDA regulations. At a discount rate of 3 percent the 2010-present value of the consumer benefits 30 years into the future from a simulated FDA tobacco regulation is estimated to be $100 billion. However, the nature of potential FDA tobacco regulations suggests that they might impose additional costs on consumers that make it less clear that the net benefits of the regulations will be positive.

10.3386/w20998.abstractZh: 旨在通过“引导”消费者做出更优选择来改善社会福祉的监管政策越来越受到重视。将收益-成本分析应用于此类监管时，会面临复杂的理论和应用问题。在本分析中，我们提供了一个关于美国反吸烟政策的行为性收益-成本分析的实例。我们的概念框架扩展了标准的市场基础收益-成本分析方法，以考虑个体在做出终身效用最大化选择时可能遇到的困难。我们讨论了我们的市场基础方法与健康效益方法以及近期几项健康相关监管中的“消费者剩余抵消”争议之间的比较。我们使用动态人口模型对吸烟率及香烟需求随时间的变化进行反事实模拟。在回顾性收益-成本分析中，模拟结果表明，1964年至2010年间反吸烟政策的总体影响是减少了28%的香烟总消费量。在3%的折现率下，1964年至今，反吸烟政策带来的消费者收益估计为5730亿美元（2010年价值）。尽管我们无法对政策成本进行精确估算，但我们有证据表明，消费者收益远远超过了成本。接下来，我们探讨了未来FDA反吸烟法规的潜在收益-成本分析。在3%的折现率下，模拟的FDA烟草监管在未来30年内给消费者带来的收益估计为1000亿美元。然而，潜在的FDA烟草法规的性质表明，它们可能会给消费者带来额外的成本，这使得法规的净收益是否为正变得不那么明确。

abstract.text: Work schedules play an important role in utilizing labor in organizations. In this study of emergency department physicians in shift work, schedules induce two distortions: First, physicians "slack off" by accepting fewer patients near end of shift (EOS). Second, physicians distort patient care, incurring higher costs as they spend less time on patients accepted near EOS. Examining how these effects change with shift overlap reveals a tradeoff between the two. Within an hour after the normal time of work completion, physicians are willing to spend hospital resources eight times more than their market wage to preserve their leisure. Accounting for overall costs, I find that physicians slack off at approximately second-best optimal levels.

10.3386/w21002.abstractZh: 工作排班在组织中劳动力的利用中起着重要作用。本研究针对轮班工作的急诊科医生进行了分析，发现排班存在两种扭曲现象：首先，医生在轮班结束时接受的患者数量减少，从而导致“懈怠”现象；其次，医生在照顾患者时花费的时间减少，导致患者护理质量下降，进而增加成本。通过考察轮班重叠情况下的这些影响，可以发现两者之间存在权衡。在正常工作完成时间之后的一个小时内，医生愿意花费相当于市场工资八倍的医院资源来保持自己的休息时间。综合考虑整体成本后，我发现医生在懈怠时的程度大致处于次优水平。

abstract.text: Preventives are sold ex ante, before disease status is realized, while treatments are sold ex post. Even if the mean of the ex ante distribution of consumer values is the same as that ex post, the shape of the distributions may differ, generating a difference between the surplus each product can extract. If, for example, consumers differ only in ex ante disease risk, then a monopolist would have more difficulty extracting surplus with a preventive than with a treatment because treatment consumers, having contracted the disease, no longer differ in disease risk. We show that the ratio of preventive to treatment producer surplus can be arbitrarily small, in particular when the distribution of consumer values has a Zipf shape and the disease is rare. The firm's bias toward treatments can be reversed, for example, if the source of private information is disease severity learned ex post. The difference between the producer surplus earned from the products can result in distorted R&D incentives; the deadweight loss from this distortion can be as large as the entire producer-surplus difference. Calibrations for HIV and heart attacks based on risk factors in the U.S. population suggest that the distribution of disease risk is sufficiently Zipf-similar to generate substantial differences between producer surplus from preventives and treatments. Empirically, we find that proxies for the Zipf-similarity of the disease-risk distribution are associated a significantly lower likelihood of vaccine development but not drug development.

10.3386/w21012.abstractZh: 预防措施是在疾病状况出现之前就进行销售的，而治疗措施则是在疾病发生后才进行销售的。即使消费者在预防措施和治疗措施上的价值分布的平均值相同，分布的形状仍可能有所不同，从而导致每种产品所能获取的剩余收益存在差异。例如，如果消费者在预防措施和治疗措施上的差异仅在于疾病风险，那么垄断者通过预防措施获取剩余收益的难度会比通过治疗措施更大，因为已经患病的患者在疾病风险上不再存在差异。我们表明，预防措施与治疗方法之间的生产者剩余比率可以非常小，尤其是在消费者价值分布具有Zipf形状且疾病较为罕见的情况下。如果私人信息的来源是事后得知的疾病严重程度，那么企业倾向于治疗措施的倾向可以被逆转。由此产生的生产者剩余差异可能导致研发激励的扭曲；这种扭曲造成的无谓损失可能与生产者剩余差异本身一样大。基于美国人口中的风险因素对HIV和心脏病发作的校准表明，疾病风险分布与Zipf分布足够相似，足以使预防措施和治疗措施产生的生产者剩余存在显著差异。从经验上看，我们发现，疾病风险分布的Zipf相似性越低，疫苗开发的可能性就越低，而药物开发的可能性则不会降低。

abstract.text: In an effort to improve breastfeeding, the Oregon WIC Program tested whether a relatively low-cost telephone peer counseling initiative to support breastfeeding could increase the initiation and duration of exclusive breastfeeding among its participants. They conducted a large randomized field experiment (RFE) with over 1900 women from four WIC agencies in the state. In this study we use data from the RFE along with administrative data from the rest of the state to assess whether the results from the RFE can be extended to other agencies in the state. We find small or non-existent effects of peer counseling in the non-experimental settings, which suggest that the experimental estimates may reflect Hawthorne effects. We present evidence of selection into RFE in that exclusive breastfeeding among the controls is significantly greater than among women who were offered but declined to participate in the RFE as well as from women in the rest of the state who had no access to peer counseling. We conclude that despite the strong internal validity of the RFE, extending the program to other agencies in the state would have a limited impact at best on exclusive breastfeeding.

10.3386/w21013.abstractZh: 为了改善母乳喂养状况，俄勒冈州WIC计划测试了一种相对低成本的电话同伴咨询计划，该计划旨在支持母乳喂养，是否能够帮助参与者增加母乳喂养的起始时间和持续时间。他们在该州四个WIC机构中进行了大规模的随机实地实验，涉及1900多名女性。本研究利用实地实验的数据以及该州其他机构的行政数据，来评估实地实验的结果是否可以推广到该州的其他机构。我们发现，在非实验环境中，同伴咨询的效果很小或根本没有，这表明实验中的估计结果可能反映了霍桑效应。我们还发现了一些证据，表明在对照组中，母乳喂养的比例显著高于那些被邀请但拒绝参与实验的妇女，以及该州其他无法获得同伴咨询的妇女。我们得出结论，尽管实地实验的内部有效性很强，但将该计划推广到该州的其他机构，对母乳喂养的影响最多也是有限的。

abstract.text: Economists think of medical innovation as a valuable but risky good, producing health benefits but increasing financial risk. This perspective overlooks how innovation can lower physical risks borne by healthy patients facing the prospect of future disease. We present an alternative framework that accounts for all these aspects of value and links them to the value of health insurance. We show that any innovation worth buying reduces overall risk, thereby generating positive insurance value on its own. We conduct two empirical exercises to assess the significance of our insights. First, we calculate that conventional methods underestimate the value of historical health gains by 30-80%. Second, we examine a large set of medical technologies and calculate that insurance value on average adds 100% to the conventional valuation of those treatments. Moreover, we find that the physical risk-reduction value of these technologies is ten times greater than the financial risk they pose and the corresponding value of health insurance that insures this financial risk. Our analysis also suggests standard methods disproportionately undervalue treatments for the most severe illnesses, where physical risk to consumers is most costly.

10.3386/w21015.abstractZh: 经济学家将医疗创新视为一种有价值但具有风险性的商品，它能带来健康益处，但同时也增加了财务风险。这种观点忽略了创新如何降低健康患者未来患病时所面临的身体风险。我们提出了一种替代框架，综合考虑了这些价值方面，并将其与健康保险的价值联系起来。我们发现，任何值得购买的创新都能降低整体风险，从而自身产生积极的保险价值。我们通过两项实证研究来评估我们的见解的重要性。首先，我们计算出传统方法低估了历史健康收益的30-80%。其次，我们研究了一组大型医疗技术，发现保险价值平均增加了这些治疗方法的传统估值100%。此外，我们发现这些技术的身体风险降低价值是其所带来的财务风险价值的十倍，以及为这种财务风险提供保障的健康保险相应价值。我们的分析还表明，传统方法过度低估了对最严重疾病的治疗方法的估值，因为这些治疗方法对消费者的身体风险最为严重。

abstract.text: Drawing on administrative records of nearly 4 million births in Canada as well as macro data from the US and Australia, we provide a comprehensive account of rising C-section rates. We explicitly consider the contributions of the changing characteristics of mothers, births, and physicians as well as changing financial incentives for C-section deliveries. These factors account for at most one-half of the increase in C-section rates. The majority of the remaining increase in C-sections over the period 1994-2011 occurred in the early 2000s. We overview the relative contributions that the Hannah Breech Trial and technological change may have played in this development.

10.3386/w21022.abstractZh: 基于加拿大近400万例出生记录的行政数据，以及美国和澳大利亚的宏观数据，我们全面分析了剖宫产率上升的原因。我们明确考虑了母亲、分娩过程和医生特征的变化，以及剖宫产分娩的财务激励因素的变化对这些变化的贡献。这些因素最多只能解释剖宫产率上升的一半原因。1994年至2011年期间，剖宫产率上升的其余部分主要出现在21世纪初。我们概述了汉娜剖腹产试验和技术变革在这一发展过程中可能发挥的相对作用。

abstract.text: The Medicare Part D program relies on consumer choice to provide insurers with incentives to offer low-priced, high-quality pharmaceutical insurance plans. We demonstrate that consumers switch plans infrequently and search imperfectly. We estimate a model of consumer plan choice with inattentive consumers and show that high observed premiums are consistent with insurers profiting from consumer inertia. We estimate the reduction in steady state plan premiums if all consumers were attentive. An average consumer could save $1050 over three years; government savings in the same period could amount to $1.3 billion or 1% of the cost of subsidizing the relevant enrollees.

10.3386/w21028.abstractZh: Medicare Part D计划依靠消费者的选择来激励保险公司提供价格低廉、质量高的药品保险计划。我们发现，消费者更换保险计划的情况很少，且搜索行为也不够完善。我们建立了一个包含“疏忽型消费者”的保险计划选择模型，并表明较高的实际保费与保险公司从消费者惰性中获利的情况是一致的。我们还估算了如果所有消费者都具备注意力的话，保险计划保费会下降多少。平均而言，消费者在三年内可以节省1050美元；政府在同一时期可以节省13亿美元，这相当于补贴相关参保人的成本的1%。

abstract.text: “Consumer-Directed” Health Plans (CDHPs) combine high deductibles with personal medical accounts and are intended to reduce health care spending through greater patient cost sharing. Prior research shows that CDHPs reduce spending in the first year. However, there is little research on the impact of CDHPs over the longer term. We add to this literature by using data from 13 million individuals in 54 large US firms to estimate the effects of a firm offering CDHPs on health care spending up to three years post offer. We use a difference-in-differences analysis and to further strengthen identification, we balance observables within firm, over time by developing weights through a machine learning algorithm. We find that spending is reduced for those in firms offering CDHPs in all three years post. The reductions are driven by spending decreases in outpatient care and pharmaceuticals, with no evidence of increases in emergency department or inpatient care.

10.3386/w21031.abstractZh: “以消费者为导向”的健康计划结合了高免赔额和个人医疗账户，旨在通过增加患者的费用分担来减少医疗保健支出。先前的研究表明，这类计划在第一年能够减少支出。然而，关于这类计划长期影响的研究相对较少。我们利用来自54家美国大型企业的1300万人的数据，来估算提供此类计划的公司在计划实施后的三年内对医疗保健支出的影响。我们采用差异-差异分析方法来进一步增强研究结果的可靠性，并通过机器学习算法为不同时间点的企业内部变量分配权重。研究发现，提供此类计划的公司在计划实施后的所有三年中，医疗保健支出均有所减少。这种减少主要源于门诊护理和药品支出的下降，而急诊科和住院护理方面的支出并未出现增加。

abstract.text: We measure the impact of direct-to-consumer television advertising (DTCA) by drug manufacturers. Our identification strategy exploits shocks to local advertising markets generated by idiosyncrasies of the political advertising cycle as well as a regulatory intervention affecting a single product. We find that a 10% increase in the number of a firm's ads leads to a 0.76% increase in revenue, while the same increase in rival advertising leads to a 0.55% decrease in firm revenue. Results also indicate that a 10% increase in category advertising produces a 0.2% revenue increase for non-advertised drugs. Both the business-stealing and spillover effects would not be detected through OLS. Decomposition using micro data confirms that the effect is due mostly to new customers as opposed to switching among current customers. Simulations show that an outright ban on DTCA would have modest effects on the sales of advertised drugs as well as on non-advertised drugs.

10.3386/w21045.abstractZh: 我们通过药物制造商直接面向消费者的电视广告来衡量其影响。我们的识别策略利用了政治广告周期的特殊性以及针对单一产品的监管干预对当地广告市场产生的冲击。我们发现，一家公司的广告数量增加10%，会导致其收入增加0.76%；而竞争对手的广告数量增加相同幅度，则会导致该公司收入减少0.55%。结果还表明，药品类别广告数量增加10%，会使未接受广告的药品收入增加0.2%。通过OLS分析无法检测到商业掠夺效应和溢出效应。使用微观数据进行的分解表明，这种效应主要来自于新客户，而非当前客户的转换行为。模拟结果显示，对直接面向消费者的电视广告进行全面禁止，对广告药品以及未接受广告的药品的销售影响较小。

abstract.text: We propose a model of narrow framing in insurance and test it using data from a new module we designed and fielded in the Health and Retirement Study. We show that respondents subject to narrow framing are substantially less likely to buy long-term care insurance than average. This effect is distinct from, and much larger than, the effects of risk aversion or adverse selection, and it offers a new explanation for why people underinsure their later-life care needs.

10.3386/w21048.abstractZh: 我们提出了一个关于保险中狭义框架效应的模型，并使用我们在“健康与退休研究”中设计并收集的数据对该模型进行了测试。结果表明，处于狭义框架下的受访者购买长期护理保险的可能性明显低于平均水平。这种效应与风险规避或逆向选择的影响不同，且其影响程度远大于后者。这一发现为解释人们为何未能充分保障晚年护理需求提供了新的解释。

abstract.text: Despite plausible mechanisms, little research has evaluated potential changes in health behaviors as a result of the Medicaid expansions of the 1980s and 1990s for pregnant women. Accordingly, we provide the first national study of the effects of Medicaid on health behaviors for pregnant women. We exploit exogenous variation from the Medicaid income eligibility expansions for pregnant women and children during late-1980s through mid-1990s to examine effects on several prenatal health behaviors and health outcomes using U.S. vital statistics data. We find that increases in Medicaid eligibility were associated with increases in smoking and decreases in weight gain during pregnancy. Raising Medicaid eligibility by 12 percentage-points increased rates of any prenatal smoking and smoking more than five cigarettes daily by 0.7-0.8 percentage point. Medicaid expansions were associated with a reduction in pregnancy weight-gain by about 0.6%. These effects diminish at higher levels of eligibility, which is consistent with crowd-out from private to public insurance. Importantly, our evidence is consistent with ex-ante moral hazard although income effects are also at play. The worsening of health behaviors may partly explain why Medicaid expansions have not been associated with substantial improvement in infant health.

10.3386/w21049.abstractZh: 尽管有合理的机制，但关于1980年代和1990年代医疗补助扩展对孕妇健康行为潜在影响的研究却很少。因此，我们进行了首次关于医疗补助对孕妇健康行为影响的全国性研究。我们利用1980年代末至1990年代中期医疗补助收入资格扩展带来的外部变化，通过美国人口统计数据来考察其对多种产前健康行为及健康结果的影响。研究发现，医疗补助资格的增加与吸烟率的上升以及孕期体重增加的减少有关。将医疗补助资格提高12个百分点，会使任何产前吸烟率和每日吸烟超过五支香烟的比例分别增加0.7-0.8个百分点。医疗补助扩展还与孕期体重增加的减少有关，减少幅度约为0.6%。这些影响在更高的资格水平下会减弱，这与从私人保险转向公共保险的现象一致。重要的是，我们的研究结果与事前道德风险理论相符，尽管收入效应也起着作用。健康行为的恶化可能部分解释了为什么医疗补助扩展并未带来婴儿健康的显著改善。

abstract.text: There is widespread agreement that the US healthcare system wastes as much as 5% of GDP, yet little consensus on what care is actually unproductive. This partly arises because of the endogeneity of patient choice of treatment location. This paper uses the effective random assignment of patients to ambulance companies to generate comparisons across similar patients treated at different hospitals. We find that assignment to hospitals whose patients receive large amounts of care over the three months following a health emergency do not have meaningfully better survival outcomes compared to hospitals whose patients receive less. Outcomes are related to different types of treatment intensity, however: patients assigned to hospitals with high levels of inpatient spending are more likely to survive to one year, while those assigned to hospitals with high levels of outpatient spending are less likely to do so. This adverse effect of outpatient spending is predominately driven by spending at skilled nursing facilities (SNF) following hospitalization. These results offer a new type of quality measure for hospitals based on utilization of SNFs. We find that patients quasi-randomized to hospitals with high rates of SNF discharge have poorer outcomes, as well as higher downstream spending once conditioning on initial hospital spending.

10.3386/w21050.abstractZh: 普遍认为，美国的医疗系统浪费了高达5%的GDP，但关于哪些医疗服务实际上是不经济的，目前还没有达成共识。这部分原因是由于患者选择治疗地点的内生性问题。本文通过对患者进行随机分配到不同救护车公司的实验，来比较在不同医院接受治疗的相似患者的情况。研究发现，在健康突发事件发生后的三个月内，被分配到那些患者接受大量治疗的医院，其生存结果并不比那些患者接受较少治疗的患者更好。然而，结果与不同类型的治疗强度有关：被分配到住院费用较高的医院的患者，一年内存活的可能性更高；而被分配到门诊费用较高的医院的患者，存活的可能性则较低。门诊费用带来的负面影响主要源于住院后的护理设施支出。这些结果为医院提供了一种新的质量衡量标准，即基于护理设施的使用情况。我们发现，被准随机分配到护理设施出院率较高的医院的患者，其生存结果较差，并且在初始医院支出的基础上，其后续支出也更高。

abstract.text: Community traumatic events such as mass shootings, terrorist attacks, and natural or man-made disasters have the potential to disrupt student learning in numerous ways. For example, these events can reduce instructional time by causing teacher and student absences, school closures, and disturbances to usual classroom routines. Similarly, they might also disrupt home environments. This paper uses a quasi-experimental research design to identify the effects of the 2002 “Beltway Sniper” attacks on student achievement in Virginia’s public elementary schools. In order to identify the causal impact of these events, the empirical analysis uses a difference-in-differences strategy that exploits geographic variation in schools’ proximity to the attacks. The main results indicate that the attacks significantly reduced school-level proficiency rates in schools within five miles of an attack. Evidence of a causal effect is most robust for math proficiency rates in the third and fifth grades, and third grade reading proficiency, suggesting that the shootings caused a decline in school proficiency rates of about five to nine percentage points. Particularly concerning from an equity standpoint, these effects appear to be entirely driven by achievement declines in schools that serve higher proportions of racial minority and socioeconomically disadvantaged students. Finally, results from supplementary analyses suggest that these deleterious effects faded out in subsequent years.

10.3386/w21055.abstractZh: 诸如大规模枪击、恐怖袭击以及自然或人为灾难等社区性创伤事件，可能会以多种方式扰乱学生的学习。例如，这些事件可能导致教师和学生缺席、学校停课，以及日常课堂秩序的混乱。同样，它们也可能扰乱家庭环境。本文采用准实验研究设计，来探讨2002年“环城枪手”袭击对弗吉尼亚州公立小学学生学业成绩的影响。为了确定这些事件的因果效应，实证分析采用了差异-差异策略，利用学校与袭击地点的地理距离差异来进行分析。主要结果表明，距离袭击地点五英里以内的学校，其学业成绩显著下降。在数学成绩方面，三年级和五年级的成绩下降最为明显，三年级的阅读成绩也出现了下降，这表明枪击事件导致学校学业成绩下降了约5%至9%。从公平的角度来看，这些影响似乎完全是由服务更多种族少数群体和社会经济地位较低学生的学校所承受的。最后，补充分析的结果表明，这些负面影响在随后几年逐渐消失。

abstract.text: Drug overdoses involving opioid analgesics have increased dramatically since 1999, representing one of the United States’ top public health crises. Opioids have legitimate medical functions, but improving access may increase abuse rates even among those not prescribed the drugs given that opioids are frequently diverted to nonmedical use. We have little evidence about the causal relationship between increased medical access to opioids and spillovers resulting in abuse. We use the introduction of the Medicare Prescription Drug Benefit Program (Part D) as a large and differential shock to the geographic supply of opioids. We compare growth in opioid supply and abuse rates in states with large 65+ population shares to states with smaller elderly population shares with a focus on abuse among the Medicare-ineligible population. Part D increased opioid utilization for the 65+ population, and we show that this increase in utilization led to significant growth in the overall supply of opioids in high elderly share states relative to low elderly share states. This relative expansion in opioid supply resulted in an escalation in opioid-related substance abuse treatment admissions and opioid-related mortality among the Medicare-ineligible population, implying meaningful spillovers to individuals who did not experience any change in prescription drug benefits. The evidence suggests that increased opioid supply is associated with economically-important levels of diversion for nonmedical purposes. Our estimates imply that a 10% increase in medical opioid distribution leads to a 7.4% increase in opioid-related deaths and a 14.1% increase in substance abuse treatment admission rates for the Medicare-ineligible population.

10.3386/w21072.abstractZh: 自1999年以来，涉及阿片类镇痛药的药物过量事件急剧增加，这已成为美国最严重的公共卫生危机之一。阿片类药物具有合法的医疗用途，但即使对于那些未被处方这些药物的人来说，改善获取途径也可能增加滥用率，因为阿片类药物经常被转用于非医疗用途。关于增加阿片类药物医疗使用与滥用之间的因果关系，我们的证据非常有限。我们以医疗保险处方药物福利计划（Part D）的引入作为对阿片类药物地理供应的一次重大冲击。我们比较了阿片类药物供应和滥用率在老年人口比例较高的州与老年人口比例较低的州之间的差异，重点关注那些不符合医疗保险资格的人群中的滥用情况。Part D增加了65岁以上人群的阿片类药物使用量，我们发现这种使用量的增加导致老年人口比例较高的州相对于老年人口比例较低的州，阿片类药物的整体供应显著增加。这种阿片类药物供应的相对增加导致了不符合医疗保险资格的人群中阿片类药物相关物质滥用治疗入院率和阿片类药物相关死亡率的上升，这意味着这种影响对于那些在处方药福利方面没有发生变化的个体也是显著的。证据表明，阿片类药物供应的增加与非医疗用途的转移密切相关。我们的估计表明，阿片类药物医疗分配的每增加10%，就会导致不符合医疗保险资格的人群中阿片类药物相关死亡人数增加7.4%，物质滥用治疗入院率增加14.1%。

abstract.text: Nonprofit charitable organizations are exempt from most taxes, including local property taxes, but U.S. cities and towns increasingly request that nonprofits make payments in lieu of taxes (known as PILOTs). Strictly speaking, PILOTs are voluntary, though nonprofits may feel pressure to make them, particularly in high-tax communities. Evidence from Massachusetts indicates that PILOT rates, measured as ratios of PILOTs to the value of local tax-exempt property, are higher in towns with higher property tax rates: a one percent higher property tax rate is associated with a 0.2 percent higher PILOT rate. PILOTs appear to discourage nonprofit activity: a one percent higher PILOT rate is associated with 0.8 percent reduced real property ownership by local nonprofits, 0.2 percent reduced total assets, and 0.2 percent lower revenues of local nonprofits. These patterns are consistent with voluntary PILOTs acting in a manner similar to low-rate, compulsory real estate taxes.

10.3386/w21088.abstractZh: 非营利慈善组织大多可以免交各种税款，包括地方财产税。然而，美国各城市越来越多地要求这些组织缴纳替代性税款，即 PILOT 费用。严格来说，Pilot 费用是自愿性质的，但非营利组织可能会感受到压力，尤其是在高税收地区。马萨诸塞州的证据表明，Pilot 费用与当地免税财产价值的比例越高，该比例就越高：财产税税率每提高1%，Pilot 费用就会相应增加0.2%。Pilot 费用似乎会抑制非营利组织的活动：Pilot 费用每提高1%，当地非营利组织的实际房地产所有权会减少0.8%，总资产会减少0.2%，收入也会减少0.2%。这些现象表明，自愿缴纳的 Pilot 费用与低税率的强制性房地产税具有类似的作用。

abstract.text: The standard Medicare Part D drug insurance contract is nonlinear—with reduced subsidies in a coverage gap—resulting in a dynamic purchase problem. We consider enrollees who arrived near the gap early in the year and show that they should expect to enter the gap with high probability, implying that, under a benchmark model with neoclassical preferences, the gap should impact them very little. We find that these enrollees have flat spending in a period before the doughnut hole and a large spending drop in the gap, providing evidence against the benchmark model. We structurally estimate behavioral dynamic drug purchase models and find that a price salience model where enrollees do not incorporate future prices into their decision making at all fits the data best. For a nationally representative sample, full price salience would decrease enrollee spending by 31%. Entirely eliminating the gap would increase insurer spending 27%, compared to 7% for generic-drug-only gap coverage.

10.3386/w21104.abstractZh: 标准的Medicare Part D药品保险合同是非线性的——在保险覆盖缺口期间补贴减少，这导致了一个动态购买问题。我们考虑了那些在年初接近缺口时开始参保的参保人员，并发现他们很可能会进入这个缺口，这意味着在一个具有新古典偏好基准模型中，缺口对他们的影响应该非常小。我们发现，这些参保人员在 doughnut hole 之前的支出是稳定的，而在缺口期间则会出现大幅支出下降，这提供了反对基准模型的证据。我们通过结构性方法估计了行为动态药品购买模型，发现一个价格显著性模型——即参保人员在决策过程中完全不考虑未来的价格变化——最符合数据特征。对于具有全国代表性的样本，全价价格显著性会使参保人员的支出减少31%。而完全消除缺口则会使保险公司的支出增加27%，相比之下，仅使用仿制药的缺口覆盖则只会增加7%。

abstract.text: Sex differences in mortality (SDIM) vary over time and place as a function of social, health, and medical circumstances. The magnitude of these variations, and their response to large socioeconomic changes, suggest that biological differences cannot fully account for sex differences in survival. We document “stylized facts” about SDIM with which any theory will have to contend. We draw on a wide swath of mortality data, including probability of survival to age 70 by county in the United States, the Human Mortality Database data for 18 high-income countries since 1900, and mortality data within and across developing countries over time periods for which reasonably reliable data are available. We show that, in each of the periods of economic development after the onset of demographic and epidemiologic transition, cross-sectional variation in SDIM exhibits a consistent pattern of female resilience to mortality under adversity. Moreover, as societies develop, M/F survival first declines and then increases, a “SDIM transition” embedded within the demographic and epidemiologic transitions.

10.3386/w21114.abstractZh: 性别差异在死亡率上的表现随时间、地点的变化而变化，这与社会、健康和医疗环境有关。这些变化的幅度以及它们对重大社会经济变化的反应表明，生物学差异无法完全解释性别差异对生存的影响。我们记录了关于SDIM的“典型事实”，任何理论都必须面对这些事实。我们利用了大量的死亡数据，包括美国各县的70岁生存概率、1900年以来18个高收入国家的人类死亡数据库数据，以及有可靠数据的不同发展中国家的死亡数据。我们发现，在人口统计和流行病学转变之后的每个经济发展阶段，SDIM的横向差异都表现出女性在逆境中具有持续生存能力的模式。此外，随着社会的发展，男女的生存率先是下降，然后上升，这种“SDIM转变”是人口统计和流行病学转变的一部分。

abstract.text: Using novel data describing the healthfulness of household food purchases and the retail landscapes consumers face, we measure the role of access in explaining why wealthier and more educated households purchase healthier foods. We find that spatial differences in access, though significant, are small relative to spatial differences in the nutritional content of sales. Socioeconomic disparities in nutritional consumption exist even among households with equivalent access, and the healthfulness of household consumption responds minimally to improvements in local retail environments. Our results indicate that access-improving policies alone will eliminate less than one third of existing socioeconomic disparities in nutritional consumption. This paper has been subsumed by the authors’ later combined work

10.3386/w21126.abstractZh: 通过利用描述家庭食品购买健康性以及消费者所面临的零售环境的新数据，我们衡量了获取途径在解释为何较富裕和受教育程度较高的家庭购买更健康食品中的作用。我们发现，尽管获取途径的空间差异显著，但相对于销售产品营养含量的空间差异而言，这些差异相对较小。即使是在获取途径相当相同的家庭中，营养消费的社会经济差异仍然存在，而家庭消费的健康性对当地零售环境的改善反应甚微。我们的结果表明，仅通过改善获取途径的政策，无法消除现有的社会经济差异所带来的营养消费方面的不平等现象，这种不平等程度不到三分之一。本文的研究结果已被作者后续的联合研究所涵盖。

abstract.text: Choices are frequently made from lists where there is by necessity some ordering of options. In such situations individuals can exhibit both primacy bias towards the first option and recency bias towards the last option. We examine this phenomenon in a particularly interesting context: consumer response to the ordering of economics papers in an email announcement issued by the National Bureau of Economic Research (NBER). Each Monday morning Eastern Standard Time (EST) the NBER issues a “New This Week” (NTW) email that lists all of the working papers that have been issued in the past week. This email goes to more than 23,000 subscribers, both inside and outside academia, and the placement order is based on random factors. We show that despite the randomized list placement, papers that are listed first each week are about 30% more likely to be viewed, downloaded, and cited over the next two years. Lower ranking on the list leads to fewer views and downloads, but not cites; however, there is also some recency bias, with the last paper listed receiving more views, downloads and cites. The results are robust to a wide variety of specification checks and are present for both all viewers/downloaders, and for academic institutions in particular. These results suggest that even among expert searchers, list-based searches can be manipulated by list placement.

10.3386/w21141.abstractZh: 人们通常从一系列选项中进行选择，这些选项必然存在某种排序。在这种情况下，个体可能会表现出对第一个选项的优先偏好，以及对最后一个选项的近期偏好。我们在一个特别有趣的背景下研究了这一现象：消费者对于美国国家经济研究局（NBER）发布的电子邮件公告中经济学论文的排序反应。每周一东部标准时间，NBER会发布一封“本周新刊”电子邮件，列出过去一周发布的所有工作论文。这封邮件会发送给23,000多名订阅者，包括学术界和非学术界的人士，而论文的排序是基于随机因素进行的。研究表明，尽管排序是随机的，但每周首先列出的论文在接下来的两年里被查看、下载和引用的概率大约高出30%。在列表中的排名较低则会导致较少的查看量和下载量，但引用次数却不会减少；不过，也存在一定的近期偏好现象，即最后列出的论文获得更多的查看量、下载量和引用次数。这些结果在多种统计检验中都是稳健的，并且适用于所有读者/下载者，尤其是学术机构。这些结果表明，即使是在专家搜索者中，基于列表的搜索也可能受到列表排序的影响。

abstract.text: We discuss how evidence and theory can be combined to provide insight on the appropriate subsidy level for health products, focusing on the specific case of deworming. Although intestinal worm infections can be treated using safe, low-cost drugs, some have challenged the view that mass school-based deworming should be a policy priority. We review well-identified research which both uses experimental or quasi-experimental methods to demonstrate causal relationships and adequately accounts for epidemiological externalities from deworming treatment, including studies of deworming campaigns in the Southern United States, Kenya, and Uganda. The existing evidence shows consistent positive impacts on school participation in the short run and on academic test scores, employment, and income in the long run, while suggesting that most parents will not pay for deworming treatment that is not fully subsidized. There is also evidence for a fiscal externality through higher future tax revenue, which may exceed the cost of the program. Our analysis suggests that the economic benefits of school-based deworming programs are likely to exceed their costs in places where worm infestations are endemic. This would likely be the case even if the benefits were only a fraction of estimates in the existing literature.

10.3386/w21148.abstractZh: 我们探讨了如何将证据与理论相结合，以了解健康产品的适当补贴水平，重点关注驱虫这一具体领域。虽然肠道寄生虫感染可以通过安全且低成本的药物治疗，但有些人质疑大规模学校驱虫是否应作为政策优先事项。我们回顾了多项经过充分验证的研究，这些研究采用实验或准实验方法证明因果关系，并充分考虑了驱虫治疗的流行病学外部性，包括在美国南部、肯尼亚和乌干达进行的驱虫活动研究。现有证据表明，短期内驱虫措施对学校参与度有积极影响，长期则对学术成绩、就业和收入有正面影响。同时，研究指出，大多数家长不会愿意为未得到充分补贴的驱虫治疗付费。此外，还有证据表明，驱虫措施会带来更高的未来税收收入，这可能超过项目的成本。我们的分析表明，在寄生虫感染普遍的地区，学校驱虫项目的经济效益很可能超过其成本。即便这些效益只是现有文献估计值的一小部分，这种情况也很有可能发生。

abstract.text: We provide the first estimates of the potential impact of climate change on human capital, focusing on the impacts from both short-run weather and long-run climate. Exploiting the longitudinal structure of the NLSY79 and random fluctuations in weather across interviews, we identify the effect of temperature in models with child-specific fixed effects. We find that short-run changes in temperature lead to statistically significant decreases in cognitive performance on math (but not reading) beyond 26C (78.8F). In contrast, our long-run analysis, which relies upon long-difference and rich cross-sectional models, reveals no statistically significant relationship between climate and human capital. This finding is consistent with the notion that adaptation, particularly compensatory behavior, plays a significant role in limiting the long run impacts from short run weather shocks.

10.3386/w21157.abstractZh: 我们首次估算了气候变化对人类资本的潜在影响，重点关注短期天气和长期气候的影响。通过利用NLSY79的纵向结构以及不同访谈中天气的随机波动，我们在包含儿童特定固定效应的模型中确定了温度的影响。我们发现，短期温度的变化会导致数学认知能力在26摄氏度（78.8华氏度）以上出现显著下降（但阅读能力不受影响）。相比之下，我们的长期分析依赖于长期差异和丰富的横截面模型，发现气候与人力资本之间不存在统计学上的显著关系。这一发现与“适应行为，尤其是补偿性行为，在限制短期天气冲击的长期影响方面起着重要作用”的观点一致。

abstract.text: The recent expansion of health-plan choice has been touted as increasing competition and enabling people to choose plans that fit their needs. This study provides new evidence challenging these proposed benefits of expanded health-insurance choice. We examine health-insurance decisions of employees at a large U.S. firm where a new plan menu included a large share of financially dominated options. This menu offers a unique litmus test for evaluating choice quality since standard risk preferences and beliefs about one’s health cannot rationalize enrollment into the dominated plans. We find that a majority of employees – and in particular, older workers, women, and low earners – chose dominated options, resulting in substantial excess spending. Most employees would have fared better had they instead been enrolled in the single actuarially-best plan. In follow-up hypothetical-choice experiments, we observe similar choices despite far simpler menus. We find these choices reflect a severe deficit in health insurance literacy and naïve considerations of health risk and price, rather than a sensible comparison of plan value. Our results challenge the standard practice of inferring risk attitudes and assessing welfare from insurance choices, and raise doubts whether recent health reforms will deliver their promised benefits.

10.3386/w21160.abstractZh: 近期，健康保险选择范围的扩大被宣传为增加竞争，并让人们能够选择符合自身需求的保险计划。本研究提供了新的证据，对扩大健康保险选择所带来的好处提出了质疑。我们调查了一家美国大型公司的员工健康保险决策情况，该公司提供的新保险计划菜单中包含了大量财务上占优的选项。这一菜单为评估选择质量提供了一个独特的测试工具，因为标准的风险偏好和对自身健康状况的认知无法解释为何人们会选择这些占优的保险计划。我们发现，大多数员工——尤其是年龄较大的员工、女性以及收入较低的员工——选择了这些占优的保险计划，导致他们产生了大量的额外支出。如果员工选择的是在精算上最优的单一保险计划，他们的状况可能会更好。在后续的假设性选择实验中，尽管菜单要简单得多，但观察到的选择结果仍然相似。我们发现，这些选择反映了人们在健康保险知识方面的严重匮乏，以及对健康风险和价格的简单化处理，而不是对保险计划价值的合理比较。我们的研究结果挑战了从保险选择推断风险态度和评估福利的标准做法，并让人对近期健康改革能否带来预期的好处产生怀疑。

abstract.text: After highly publicized lawsuits against McDonald’s in 2002, 26 states adopted Commonsense Consumption Acts (CCAs) – aka ‘Cheeseburger Bills’ – that greatly limit fast food companies’ liability for weight-related harms. We provide the first evidence of the effects of CCAs using plausibly exogenous variation in the timing of CCA adoption across states. In two-way fixed effects models, we find that CCAs significantly increased stated attempts to lose weight and consumption of fruits and vegetables among heavy individuals. We also find some evidence that CCAs increased employment in fast food. Finally, we find that CCAs significantly increased the number of company-owned McDonald’s restaurants and decreased the number of franchise-owned McDonald’s restaurants in a state. Overall our results provide novel evidence supporting a key prediction of tort reform – that it should induce individuals to take more care – and show that industry-specific tort reforms can have meaningful effects on market outcomes.

10.3386/w21170.abstractZh: 在2002年针对麦当劳的广泛诉讼之后，26个州通过了《常识消费法案》——也被称为“奶酪汉堡法案”——这些法案大大限制了快餐公司在与体重相关的危害方面的责任。我们首次提供了关于这些法案影响的证据，通过在不同州采取这些法案的时间上进行合理的外生变量分析。在双向固定效应模型中，我们发现这些法案显著增加了超重人群减肥的意愿以及水果和蔬菜的消费量。我们还发现，这些法案在一定程度上促进了快餐行业的就业增长。最后，我们发现这些法案显著增加了某州内麦当劳公司自有的餐厅数量，同时减少了特许经营麦当劳餐厅的数量。总体而言，我们的研究结果提供了支持侵权法改革的一个关键预测的新证据——即该改革应该促使人们更加注意自己的健康——并表明行业特定的侵权法改革可以对市场结果产生有意义的影响。

abstract.text: This study considers the effects of the kingpin strategy, an approach to fighting organized crime in which law-enforcement efforts focus on capturing the leaders of criminal organizations, on community violence in the context of Mexico's drug war. Newly constructed historical data on drug-trafficking organizations' areas of operation at the municipality level and monthly homicide data allow us to control for a rich set of fixed effects and to leverage variation in the timing of kingpin captures to estimate their effects. This analysis indicates that kingpin captures have large and sustained effects on the homicide rate in the municipality of capture and smaller but significant effects on other municipalities where the kingpin's organization has a presence, supporting the notion that removing kingpins can have destabilizing effects throughout an organization that are accompanied by escalations in violence.

10.3386/w21171.abstractZh: 本研究探讨了“核心人物策略”对墨西哥毒品战争背景下社区暴力的影响。该策略是一种打击有组织犯罪的方法，其核心是集中执法力量抓捕犯罪组织的头目。通过构建关于毒品犯罪组织在市级范围内的活动区域的新历史数据，以及每月的凶杀数据，我们可以控制一系列固定效应，并利用核心人物被捕时间的变化来估算其影响。分析表明，核心人物的抓捕对被捕地区的凶杀率有显著且持续的影响，对其他有该组织存在的地区则产生较小但显著的影响，这支持了去除核心人物可能会对整个组织造成不稳定性的观点，并伴随暴力行为的升级。

abstract.text: In this paper, we shed new light on a long-standing puzzle: In India, Muslim children are substantially more likely than Hindu children to survive to their first birthday, even though Indian Muslims have lower wealth, consumption, educational attainment, and access to state services. Contrary to the prior literature, we show that the observed mortality advantage accrues not to Muslim households themselves but rather to their neighbors, who are also likely to be Muslim. Investigating mechanisms, we provide a collage of evidence suggesting externalities due to poor sanitation are a channel linking the religious composition of neighborhoods to infant mortality.

10.3386/w21184.abstractZh: 在本文中，我们对一个长期存在的谜题进行了新的探讨：在印度，穆斯林儿童存活到一岁的概率远高于印度教儿童，尽管印度穆斯林的财富、消费水平、教育程度以及获取公共服务的能力都较低。与以往的研究不同，我们发现这种死亡率上的优势并非来自穆斯林家庭本身，而是来自他们的邻居，这些邻居同样可能也是穆斯林。通过研究相关机制，我们收集了一系列证据，表明由于卫生条件差所导致的外部性，可能是将社区宗教构成与婴儿死亡率联系起来的一个途径。

abstract.text: To combat a growing obesity problem, Mexico imposed a nationwide tax on drinks with added sugar, popularly referred to as a “soda tax,” effective January 2014. I analyze data on taxed and untaxed products collected as part of Mexico’s Consumer Price Index program to estimate how prices responded to the tax. Prices of regular sodas jumped by more than the amount of the tax in the month that the tax took effect. The prices of other taxed drinks also rose, though by a smaller amount. Diet soda prices rose as well, suggesting that consumers may have substituted toward diet sodas after regular sodas became taxable. The prices of bottled water, pure (untaxed) juices, and milk were largely unchanged. A companion analysis of untaxed comparison products showed no general price increases around the time that the soda tax was imposed.

10.3386/w21197.abstractZh: 为了应对日益严重的肥胖问题，墨西哥于2014年1月实施了针对含糖饮料的全国性税收政策，这一政策被称为“苏打税”。本文通过分析墨西哥消费者价格指数项目收集到的含糖饮料征税与非征税产品的数据，来估算税收对价格的影响。在税收实施当月，普通苏打水的价格上涨幅度超过了税收金额。其他含糖饮料的价格也有所上升，但幅度较小。无糖苏打水的价格也上涨了，这表明在普通苏打水被征税后，消费者可能转向购买无糖苏打水。瓶装水、纯果汁和牛奶的价格基本保持不变。对未征税的对比产品的分析显示，在苏打税实施期间，这些产品的价格并没有普遍上涨。

abstract.text: This study assesses whether mental health interventions can improve academic outcomes for justice-involved youth. Only a limited number of studies have linked justice policies to outcomes beyond crime, particularly education, which carries large monetary and non-monetary benefits. The current study relies on detailed administrative data and unique policy rules under which youth are assigned to behavioral treatment programs. The administrative data allow for a rich set of controls for observed family- and youth-specific heterogeneity. In addition, the treatment assignment rules create a discontinuity among youth who are deemed eligible or not eligible for treatment, rules which the study exploits empirically to address the non-random selection bias in estimating plausibly causal effects of treatment eligibility and treatment receipt. Estimates indicate that certain types of intensive mental health intervention can lower dropout and increase high-school completion for justice-involved youth. Effects on grades are negative or not significant, possibly due to the greater retention of less academically-skilled students. We also assess heterogeneity in the treatment effects, and find that the effects on dropout tend to be greater among youth believed to be less academically engaged prior to treatment.

10.3386/w21206.abstractZh: 本研究评估了心理健康干预是否能改善涉及司法问题的青少年的学业成绩。仅有少数研究将司法政策与除犯罪之外的其他成果联系起来，尤其是教育领域，因为教育不仅带来经济收益，还带来非经济收益。本研究基于详细的行政数据以及青少年被分配到行为治疗项目的独特政策规则。行政数据提供了丰富的控制变量，以解释家庭和青少年层面的异质性。此外，治疗分配规则使得被认为有资格或不符合资格接受治疗的青少年之间存在差异，研究者通过实证分析利用这些规则来消除估计治疗资格和治疗接受效果时的非随机选择偏差。研究结果表明，某些类型的强化心理健康干预可以降低青少年辍学率并提高其高中毕业率。对成绩的影响则呈负面或不显著，这可能是由于学术能力较弱的学生更容易被保留下来。我们还评估了治疗效果中的异质性，发现对于那些在接受治疗前被认为学术参与度较低的青少年来说，治疗效果更为显著。

abstract.text: The SSI program provides cash assistance to some of the nation’s most vulnerable elderly, blind, and disabled residents. In this paper, we briefly summarize the history of the SSI program and present descriptive evidence on caseload composition and trends. We discuss relevant conceptual issues and empirical evidence focused on four key issues. First, we describe the advantages and disadvantages of categorical eligibility requirements and we show that the SSI caseload has become increasingly comprised of difficult-to-verify conditions, namely pain and mental disabilities. Second, we describe systematic disincentives to accumulate earnings and assets inherent in the SSI program design, but emphasize that the more relevant set of questions for the SSI population are related to the full disability requirement for eligibility. Third, we describe the questions and research about long-term benefits and costs to program participants, in terms of whether the program adequately and appropriately serves the needs of disabled individuals and their family members. And fourth, we present information and evidence about program spillovers, both across programs and across federal and state levels of government. Throughout the paper we make numerous explicit references to areas where further study is warranted and open research questions remain. SSI is an important part of the U.S. safety net, but particular features of the program raise questions about whether there is a more effective way to provide income support for individuals with work-limiting disabilities and families with disabled the children. Our goal for this paper is to systematically present the issues for scholars and policy-makers to consider and explore.

10.3386/w21209.abstractZh: SSI计划为美国一些最弱势的老年人、盲人和残疾人提供现金援助。在本文中，我们简要总结了SSI计划的历史，并提供了关于案件构成和趋势的描述性数据。我们讨论了与四个关键问题相关的概念性和实证证据。首先，我们描述了分类资格要求的优缺点，并表明SSI案件越来越多地涉及难以核实的情况，即疼痛和精神残疾。其次，我们描述了SSI计划设计中固有的积累收入和资产的系统性障碍，但强调对SSI计划参与者来说，更相关的问题是与完全残疾资格要求相关的问题。第三，我们描述了关于计划参与者长期利益和成本的问题和研究，即该计划是否充分且恰当地满足了残疾人士及其家庭的需求。第四，我们提供了关于计划溢出效应的信息和证据，包括跨计划以及跨联邦和州政府层面的溢出效应。在整篇文章中，我们多次明确指出需要进一步研究的地方，以及仍存在的开放研究问题。SSI是美国社会保障体系的重要组成部分，但该计划的某些特点引发了关于是否有更有效的方法来为有工作限制残疾的人士及其有残疾子女的家庭提供收入支持的问题。本文的目标是为学者和政策制定者系统地呈现这些问题，以便他们进行思考和探索。

abstract.text: When a patient arrives at the Emergency Room with acute myocardial infarction (AMI), the provider on duty must quickly decide how aggressively the patient should be treated.
