Using Florida data on all such patients from 1992-2014, we decompose practice style into two components: The provider’s probability of conducting invasive procedures on the average patient (which we characterize as aggressiveness), and the responsiveness of the choice of procedure to the patient’s characteristics. We show that within hospitals and years, patients with more aggressive providers have consistently higher costs and better outcomes. Since all patients benefit from higher utilization of invasive procedures, targeting procedure use to the most appropriate patients benefits these patients at the expense of the less appropriate patients. We also find that the most aggressive and responsive physicians are young, male, and trained in top 20 schools.

10.3386/w21218.abstractZh: 当一名患者因急性心肌梗死被送往急诊室时，值班医生必须迅速决定应以何种程度积极治疗该患者。利用1992年至2014年佛罗里达州的相关数据，我们将医疗实践风格分解为两个组成部分：医生对普通患者进行侵入性手术的概率（我们将其称为“攻击性”），以及手术选择对患者特征的响应程度。研究表明，在相同或相近的医院和年份中，由攻击性更强的医生治疗的患者的治疗成本更高，但治疗效果更好。由于所有患者都能从更频繁地使用侵入性手术中受益，因此针对最合适的患者进行手术选择，既能让这些患者受益，又能减少那些不太适合接受此类手术的患者所受的困扰。我们还发现，最具攻击性和响应能力的医生通常是年轻男性，并且毕业于排名前20的医学院校。

abstract.text: In most US health insurance markets, plans face strong incentives to “upcode” the patient diagnoses they report to the regulator, as these affect the risk-adjusted payments plans receive. We show that enrollees in private Medicare plans generate 6% to 16% higher diagnosis-based risk scores than they would under fee-for-service Medicare, where diagnoses do not affect most provider payments. Our estimates imply upcoding generates billions in excess public spending and significant distortions to firm and consumer behavior. We show that coding intensity increases with vertical integration, suggesting a principal-agent problem faced by insurers, who desire more intense coding from the providers with whom they contract.

10.3386/w21222.abstractZh: 在美国大多数健康保险市场中，保险计划面临着强烈的动机，倾向于向监管机构报告更严重的患者诊断，因为这些诊断会影响保险计划所获得的风险调整支付。我们的研究表明，私人Medicare计划的参保者所得到的基于诊断的风险评分比按服务收费的Medicare计划高出6%到16%，而在按服务收费的Medicare计划中，诊断并不影响大多数提供者的支付。我们的估计表明，过度编码会导致公共支出增加数十亿美元，并对企业和消费者的行为造成显著扭曲。我们还发现，编码强度随着垂直整合程度的提高而增加，这表明保险公司面临着一个委托-代理问题，他们希望从与其合作的提供者那里获得更严格的编码。

abstract.text: The economics of stratified medicine depend critically on setting the cut-off score of the companion diagnostic (CDx). This action integrates scientific, clinical, ethical and commercial considerations, and simultaneously determines the value of the stratified medicine to developers, providers, payers and patient. Setting a high cut-off ensures a larger response by excluding more non-responders but also denies treatment to patients who would respond. This creates ethical and clinical concerns, and limits market size. Setting a low cut-off includes more patients who can benefit but includes more non-responders with commensurate costs, side effects and lost time. CDx’s capture little value under current reimbursement and exclusivity protections. Combined with low CDx investment incentives for generic drug manufacturers, little CDx development occurs for older legacy drugs. Therefore payers face an asymmetric situation of novel stratified medicines raising public health and payers’ costs, but no CDx’s for legacy treatments to reduce costs. It would be in payers’ interests to rediscover their heritage of direct investment in diagnostic development.

10.3386/w21233.abstractZh: 分层医疗的经济学问题关键在于如何设定辅助诊断工具的阈值。这一决策涉及科学、临床、伦理和商业方面的考量，同时决定了分层医疗对开发者、医疗服务提供者、支付方和患者的价值。设定较高的阈值可以通过排除更多无反应者来提升治疗效果，但同时也可能让有反应的患者无法获得治疗。这引发了伦理和临床上的问题，并限制了市场规模。而设定较低的阈值则会让更多患者受益，但同时也伴随着更多无反应者，且这些无反应者的治疗成本、副作用和误工时间都相当高。在当前的报销政策和独家保护机制下，辅助诊断工具的价值有限。再加上仿制药制造商在辅助诊断工具开发方面的投资激励不足，导致老药的发展也受到限制。因此，支付方面临着一种不对称的情况：新型分层医疗能够提升公共健康和支付方的成本，而老药则缺乏辅助诊断工具来降低成本。因此，支付方重新投资诊断工具的开发将符合其利益。

abstract.text: The premature cancer mortality rate has been declining in Canada, but there has been considerable variation in the rate of decline across cancer sites. I analyze the effect that pharmaceutical innovation had on premature cancer mortality in Canada during the period 2000-2011, by investigating whether the cancer sites that experienced more pharmaceutical innovation had larger declines in the premature mortality rate, controlling for changes in the incidence rate. The estimates imply that pharmaceutical innovation during the period 1985-1996 reduced the number of years of potential life lost to cancer before age 75 in 2011 by 105,366. The cost per life-year before age 75 gained from previous pharmaceutical innovation is estimated to have been 2730 USD. The evidence suggests that, even if these drugs had been sold at branded rather than generic prices, the cost per life-year gained would have been below 11,000 USD, a figure well below even the lowest estimates of the value of a life-year gained.

10.3386/w21239.abstractZh: 加拿大的早发性癌症死亡率一直在下降，但不同癌症类型的下降幅度存在显著差异。本文通过分析2000至2011年期间药物创新对加拿大早发性癌症死亡率的影响，探讨了在控制发病率变化的情况下，那些受益于更多药物创新的癌症类型是否出现了更大的早发性死亡率下降。研究结果表明，1985至1996年期间的药物创新使2011年因癌症而在75岁之前失去的潜在寿命年数减少了105,366年。从先前药物创新中获得的每岁寿命年的成本估计为2730美元。证据表明，即使这些药物以品牌而非仿制药的价格出售，每岁寿命年的成本也低于11,000美元，这一数字远低于对每岁寿命年收益的最低估计。

abstract.text: Comparing self-reports to administrative data records on diagnosis and prescription drug use, we find that survey respondents under-report mental health conditions 36% of the time when asked about diagnosis and about 20% of the time when asked about prescription drug use. Survey respondents are significantly less likely to under-report other conditions such as diabetes or hypertension. This behavior is consistent with a model in which mental health illnesses are stigmatized and agents have incentives to hide such traits from others. We show that differential under-reporting of depression is correlated with age, gender, and ethnicity and that these characteristics also predict a lower probability of mental health treatment, suggesting that stigma can play an important role in determining health-seeking behavior.

10.3386/w21240.abstractZh: 通过比较自我报告与行政数据记录中关于诊断和处方药物使用的信息，我们发现调查受访者在回答关于诊断问题时有36%的时间低估了心理健康状况，而在回答关于处方药物使用问题时则有约20%的时间低估了相关情况。与糖尿病或高血压等其他疾病相比，调查受访者低估这些疾病的情况明显较少。这种行为与一种模型相符，即心理健康疾病存在污名化现象，个体有动机隐藏这些特征。我们还发现，抑郁症的低估行为与年龄、性别和种族有关，而这些特征也预示着寻求心理健康治疗的可能性较低，这表明污名化在决定健康寻求行为方面起着重要作用。

abstract.text: A long theoretical literature has analyzed optimal patent policy design, yet there is very little empirical evidence on a key parameter needed to apply these models in practice: the relationship between patent strength and research investments. I argue that the dearth of empirical evidence on this question reflects two key challenges: the difficulty of measuring specific research investments, and the fact that finding variation in patent protection is difficult. I then summarize the findings of two recent studies which have made progress in starting to overcome these empirical challenges by combining new datasets measuring biomedical research investments with novel sources of variation in the effective intellectual property protection provided to different inventions. The first study, Budish, Roin, and Williams (forthcoming), documents evidence consistent with patents affecting the rate and direction of research investments in the context of cancer drug development. The second study, Williams (2013), documents evidence that one form of intellectual property rights on the human genome had quantitatively important impacts on follow-on scientific research and commercial development. I discuss the relevance of both studies for patent policy, and discuss directions for future research.

10.3386/w21246.abstractZh: 大量的理论文献已经分析了最优专利政策的设计，然而，关于将这些模型应用于实践所需的关键参数——专利强度与研发投入之间的关系——的实证证据却非常少。我认为，这种实证证据的匮乏反映了两个主要挑战：一是难以准确衡量具体的研发投入，二是难以发现专利保护程度的变化。接下来，我将总结两项近期研究的发现，这些研究通过结合新的生物医学研发投入数据集以及不同发明所享有的有效知识产权保护程度的新变数来源，开始克服这些实证挑战。第一项研究由Budish、Roin和Williams撰写，即将发表，该研究记录了与专利相关的证据，这些证据表明专利对癌症药物研发中的研发投入率和方向产生了影响。第二项研究由Williams（2013年）完成，该研究指出，对人类基因组的一种知识产权形式对后续科学研究和商业化发展产生了重要的定量影响。我还将讨论这两项研究对专利政策的意义，并探讨未来研究的方向。

abstract.text: The saving patterns of retired U.S. households pose a challenge to the basic life-cycle model of saving. The observed patterns of out-of-pocket medical expenses, which rise quickly with age and income during retirement, and heterogeneous lifespan risk, can explain a significant portion U.S. savings during retirement. However, more work is needed to disentangle these precautionary saving motives from other motives, such as the desire to leave bequests. An important complementary question is why households do not buy more insurance against these risks. Going beyond total savings and looking at its components, including housing, and looking at other portfolio choices can help shed light on these questions.

10.3386/w21268.abstractZh: 退休美国家庭的储蓄模式对基本生命周期储蓄模型提出了挑战。在退休期间，个人医疗开支随年龄和收入的增加而迅速上升，且寿命风险存在差异，这些现象可以解释美国人在退休期间的大量储蓄。然而，还需要进一步研究以区分这些预防性储蓄动机与其他动机，例如留下遗产的意愿。另一个重要的补充问题是，为什么家庭不购买更多针对这些风险的保险。除了总体储蓄之外，还需要考察其组成部分，包括住房支出，以及其他投资组合选择，这有助于解答这些问题。

abstract.text: We use data from the Medicare Current Beneficiary Survey (MCBS) to document the medical spending of Americans aged 65 and older. We find that medical expenses more than double between ages 70 and 90 and that they are very concentrated: the top 10% of all spenders are responsible for 52% of medical spending in a given year. In addition, those currently experiencing either very low or very high medical expenses are likely to find themselves in the same position in the future. We also find that the poor consume more medical goods and services than the rich and have a much larger share of their expenses covered by the government. Overall, the government pays for 65% of the elderly's medical expenses. Despite this, the expenses that remain after government transfers are even more concentrated among a small group of people. Thus, government health insurance, while potentially very valuable, is far from complete. Finally, while medical expenses before death can be large, on average they constitute only a small fraction of total spending, both in the aggregate and over the life cycle. Hence, medical expenses before death do not appear to be an important driver of the high and increasing medical spending found in the U.S.

10.3386/w21270.abstractZh: 我们利用《医疗保险当前受益人调查》的数据来记录65岁及以上美国人的医疗支出情况。研究发现，70至90岁之间的医疗支出翻了两倍以上，且支出高度集中：在某一特定年份中，支出最高的10%人群承担了52%的医疗支出。此外，那些目前医疗支出极低或极高的群体，未来也很可能保持同样的状况。我们还发现，穷人消耗的医疗产品和服务比富人更多，而且他们的支出中有更大比例由政府承担。总体而言，政府承担了65%的老年人医疗支出。尽管如此，在政府转移支付之后剩余的支出仍然高度集中在少数人手中。因此，虽然政府健康保险可能非常有价值，但它远非完善。最后，尽管死亡前的医疗支出可能很大，但平均而言，它仅占总支出的一小部分，无论是在总量上还是在整个生命周期内都是如此。因此，死亡前的医疗支出似乎并不是美国居高不下且不断增长的医疗支出的重要驱动因素。

abstract.text: Despite a near-continuous decline over the past 20 years, the teen birth rate in the United States continues to be higher than that of other developed countries. Given that over three- quarters of teen births are unintended at conception and that over a third of unplanned births are to women using contraception, many have advocated for promoting the use of long-acting reversible contraceptives (LARCs), which are more effective at preventing pregnancy than more commonly used contraceptives. In order to speak to the degree to which increasing access to LARCs can reduce teen birth rates, this paper analyzes the first large-scale policy intervention to promote and improve access to LARCs in the United States: Colorado’s Family Planning Initiative. We estimate its effects using a difference-in-differences approach, comparing the changes in teen birth rates in Colorado counties with Title X clinics (which received funding) to the changes observed in other US counties with Title X clinics. The results of this analysis indicate that the $23 million program reduced the teen birth rate by approximately 5% in the four years following its implementation, providing support for the notion that increasing access to LARCs is a mechanism through which policy can reduce teenage childbearing.

10.3386/w21275.abstractZh: 尽管在过去20年中生育率持续下降，美国的青少年生育率仍然高于其他发达国家。由于超过四分之三的青少年生育是在无意识的情况下发生的，而超过三分之一的非计划生育是给使用避孕措施的女性所生的孩子，许多人主张推广长效可逆避孕措施的使用，因为这些措施在防止怀孕方面比常用的避孕措施更为有效。为了探讨增加长效可逆避孕措施的可及性在多大程度上能够降低青少年生育率，本文分析了美国首个大规模推动和改善长效可逆避孕措施可及性的政策干预措施——科罗拉多州的家庭计划计划。我们采用差异-差异方法估算其效果，比较了科罗拉多州有Title X诊所的县与没有Title X诊所的其它美国县在青少年生育率方面的变化。分析结果显示，这项耗资2300万美元的计划在实施后的四年里将青少年生育率降低了约5%，这支持了增加长效可逆避孕措施的可及性是政策减少青少年生育的一个有效手段的观点。

abstract.text: Suicide rates, life evaluation, and measures of affect are all plausible measures of the mental health and wellbeing of populations. Yet in the settings we examine, correlations between suicide and measured wellbeing are at best inconsistent. Differences in suicides between men and women, between Hispanics, blacks, and whites, between age groups for men, between countries or US states, between calendar years, and between days of the week, do not match differences in life evaluation. By contrast, reports of physical pain are strongly predictive of suicide in many contexts. The prevalence of pain is increasing among middle-aged Americans, and is accompanied by a substantial increase in suicides and deaths from drug and alcohol poisoning. Our measure of pain is now highest in middle age—when life evaluation and positive affect are at a minimum. In the absence of the pain epidemic, suicide and life evaluation are likely unrelated, leaving unresolved whether either one is a useful overall measure of population wellbeing.

10.3386/w21279.abstractZh: 自杀率、生活评估以及情感测量都是衡量人群心理健康和福祉的合理指标。然而，在我们研究的各种情况下，自杀与测量到的福祉之间的相关性最多只是不一致的。男性与女性之间、西班牙裔与黑人以及白人之间的自杀率差异、不同年龄组之间的自杀率差异、不同国家或美国州之间的自杀率差异、不同日历年度之间的自杀率差异，以及不同星期几之间的自杀率差异，与生活评估的结果并不一致。相比之下，在许多情况下，身体疼痛的报告与自杀行为有很强的相关性。美国中年人群中的疼痛发生率正在上升，同时自杀率和因药物及酒精中毒导致的死亡人数也显著增加。我们的疼痛测量结果显示，疼痛的发生率在中年时期达到最高——此时生活评估和积极情感都处于最低水平。如果没有疼痛问题，自杀率与生活评估可能并无关联，因此目前尚无法确定这两者中哪一个可以作为衡量人群福祉的有效指标。

abstract.text: American hospitals are required to provide emergency medical care to the uninsured. We use previously confidential hospital financial data to study the resulting uncompensated care, medical care for which no payment is received. We use both panel-data methods and case studies from state-wide Medicaid disenrollments and find that the uncompensated care costs of hospitals increase in response to the size of the uninsured population. The results suggest that each additional uninsured person costs local hospitals $900 each year in uncompensated care. Similarly, the closure of a nearby hospital increases the uncompensated care costs of remaining hospitals. Increases in the uninsured population also lower hospital profit margins, which suggests that hospitals cannot simply pass along all increased costs onto privately insured patients. For-profit hospitals are less affected by these factors, suggesting that non-profit hospitals serve a unique role as part of the social insurance system.

10.3386/w21290.abstractZh: 美国医院有义务为未投保的患者提供紧急医疗服务。我们利用之前公开的医院财务数据来研究由此产生的无补偿护理，即医院收取费用却无法获得相应报酬的医疗服务。我们通过面板数据方法和来自各州医疗补助计划撤销案例的研究发现，医院的无补偿护理成本会随着未投保人口规模的增加而上升。研究结果表明，每增加一名未投保患者，当地医院每年需承担900美元的无补偿护理费用。同样，附近一家医院的关闭也会增加其他医院的无补偿护理成本。未投保人口的增加还会降低医院的利润率，这表明医院不能简单地将所有增加的成本转嫁给私人保险患者。营利性医院受这些因素的影响较小，这表明非营利医院在社会保障体系中扮演着独特的角色。

abstract.text: The efficiency of publicly-subsidized, privately-provisioned social insurance programs depends on the interaction between strategic insurers and the subsidy mechanism. We study this interaction in the context of Medicare's prescription drug coverage program. We find that the observed mechanism is successful in keeping "raise-the-subsidy" incentives relatively low, acts much like a at voucher, and obtains a level of welfare close to the optimal voucher. Across a range of counterfactuals, we find that more efficient subsidy mechanisms share three features: they retain the marginal elasticity of demand, limit the exercise of market power, and preserve the link between prices and marginal costs.

10.3386/w21298.abstractZh: 公共补贴、私人提供的社会保险项目的效率取决于战略性保险公司与补贴机制之间的互动。我们在医疗保险处方药物覆盖项目的背景下研究了这种互动。我们发现，所观察到的机制在保持“提高补贴”的激励相对较低方面是成功的，其作用类似于代金券，并且获得的福利水平接近最优代金券水平。通过一系列反事实分析，我们发现更高效的补贴机制具有三个特点：它们保留了需求的边际弹性，限制了市场力量的行使，并保持了价格与边际成本之间的联系。

abstract.text: Unlike performance incentives for private sector managers, little is known about performance incentives for managers in public sector bureaucracies. Through a randomized trial in rural China, we study performance incentives rewarding school administrators for reducing student anemia—as well as complementarity between incentives and orthogonally assigned discretionary resources. Large (but not small) incentives and unrestricted grants both reduced anemia, but incentives were more cost-effective. Although unrestricted grants and small incentives do not interact, grants fully crowd-out the effect of larger incentives. Our findings suggest that performance incentives can be effective in bureaucratic environments, but they are not complementary to discretionary resources.

10.3386/w21302.abstractZh: 与私营部门管理者的绩效激励不同，关于公共部门官僚机构的绩效激励知之甚少。通过在中国农村进行的随机试验，我们研究了以奖励学校管理者减少学生贫血为目标的绩效激励措施，以及激励措施与正交分配的自主资源之间的互补性。虽然大型（而非小型）激励措施和无限制拨款都能减少贫血现象，但激励措施更具成本效益。尽管无限制拨款和小型激励措施不会相互作用，但拨款完全抵消了较大激励措施的效果。我们的研究结果表明，绩效激励在官僚环境中可能是有效的，但它们并不与自主资源相补充。

abstract.text: In recent years, the increased use of “big data” and statistical techniques to score potential transactions has transformed the operation of insurance and credit markets. In this paper, we observe that these widely-used scores are statistical objects that constitute a one-dimensional summary of a potentially much richer heterogeneity, some of which may be endogenous to the specific context in which they are applied. We demonstrate this point empirically using rich data from the Medicare Part D prescription drug insurance program. We show that the “risk scores,” which are designed to predict an individualʼs drug spending and are used by Medicare to customize reimbursement rates to private insurers, do not distinguish between two different sources of spending: underlying health, and responsiveness of drug spending to the insurance contract. Naturally, however, these two determinants of spending have very different implications when trying to predict counterfactual spending under alternative contracts. As a result, we illustrate that once we enrich the theoretical framework to allow individuals to have heterogeneous behavioral responses to the contract, strategic incentives for cream skimming still exist, even in the presence of “perfect” risk scoring under a given contract.

10.3386/w21304.abstractZh: 近年来，随着“大数据”和统计技术的广泛应用，对潜在交易进行评分已成为保险和信贷市场运作的重要方式。本文指出，这些被广泛使用的评分结果实际上是统计对象，它们仅能概括出潜在上更为复杂的异质性现象，其中一些异质性可能是特定应用场景下的内生因素。我们通过Medicare Part D处方药保险项目的丰富数据进行了实证验证，发现用于预测个人药物支出的“风险评分”并未区分两种不同的支出来源：基础健康状况以及药物支出对保险合同的响应程度。然而，当试图根据不同的合同预测反事实支出时，这两种支出决定因素会产生截然不同的影响。因此，我们表明，一旦我们丰富了理论框架，允许个体对合同有异质性的行为反应，即使在“完美”的风险评分条件下，仍存在通过策略性行为获取额外收益的可能性。

abstract.text: We develop a set of frameworks for valuing Medicaid and apply them to welfare analysis of the Oregon Health Insurance Experiment, a Medicaid expansion for low-income, uninsured adults that occurred via random assignment. Our baseline estimates of Medicaid's welfare benefit to recipients per dollar of government spending range from about $0.2 to $0.4, depending on the framework, with at least two-fifths – and as much as four-fifths – of the value of Medicaid coming from a transfer component, as opposed to its ability to move resources across states of the world. In addition, we estimate that Medicaid generates a substantial transfer, of about $0.6 per dollar of government spending, to the providers of implicit insurance for the low-income uninsured. The economic incidence of these transfers is critical for assessing the social value of providing Medicaid to low-income adults relative to alternative redistributive policies.

10.3386/w21308.abstractZh: 我们开发了一套评估医疗补助价值的框架，并将其应用于对俄勒冈健康保险实验的福利分析。该实验是通过随机分配方式为低收入、无保险成年人提供的医疗补助扩展计划。我们对医疗补助对受助人的福利效益的基线估计，每美元政府支出带来的效益在0.2美元到0.4美元之间，具体数值取决于所使用的框架。其中，至少有五分之二，甚至高达五分之四的医疗补助价值来源于转移支付，而非其将资源跨州转移的能力。此外，我们估计医疗补助为低收入无保险人群提供的隐性保险提供者带来了约0.6美元的转移支付，每美元政府支出。这些转移的经济影响对于评估为低收入成年人提供医疗补助相对于其他再分配政策的社会价值至关重要。

abstract.text: Using data from the state and national Youth Risk Behavior Surveys for the period 1991-2005, Carpenter and Cook (2008) found a strong, negative relationship between cigarette taxes and youth smoking. We revisit this relationship using four additional waves of YRBS data (2007, 2009, 2011, and 2013). Our results suggest that youths have become much less responsive to cigarette taxes since 2005. In fact, we find little evidence of a negative relationship between cigarette taxes and youth smoking when we restrict our attention to the period 2007-2013.

10.3386/w21311.abstractZh: Carpenter和Cook在2008年的研究中使用1991-2005年期间的国家和州级青少年风险行为调查数据，发现香烟税与青少年吸烟之间存在强烈的负相关关系。我们重新利用这四次额外的YRBS数据（2007年、2009年、2011年和2013年）来研究这一关系。我们的结果显示，自2005年以来，青少年对香烟税的反应明显减弱。实际上，当我们仅关注2007-2013年期间的数据时，我们发现几乎没有证据表明香烟税与青少年吸烟之间存在负相关关系。

abstract.text: One of the most robust findings in health economics is that higher-educated individuals tend to be in better health. This paper tests whether health disparities across education are to some extent due to differences in reporting error across education. We test this hypothesis using data from the pooled National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey (NHANES) Continuous for 1999-2012, which include both self-reports and objective verification for an extensive set of health behaviors and conditions, including smoking, obesity, high blood pressure, high cholesterol and diabetes. We find that college graduates are more likely to give false negative reports of obesity and high total cholesterol; one possible explanation for this is social desirability bias. However, college graduates are also significantly less likely to give false positive reports of smoking, obesity, high cholesterol, and diabetes. Because there are far more truly negative people (who are less likely to give a false positive report) than truly positive people (who are more likely to give a false negative report), we find that college graduates report their health significantly more accurately overall.

10.3386/w21317.abstractZh: 在健康经济学领域，最有力的发现之一是，受教育程度较高的个体往往健康状况更好。本文旨在探讨教育水平差异所导致的健康差异是否在某种程度上源于不同教育背景下的报告误差。我们采用1999年至2012年连续进行的全国健康与营养调查数据来验证这一假设，该调查涵盖了吸烟、肥胖、高血压、高胆固醇和糖尿病等一系列健康行为和状况，并同时提供了自我报告和客观验证数据。研究发现，大学毕业生在肥胖和高总胆固醇方面的错误报告率较高；一种可能的解释是社交期望偏差。然而，大学毕业生在吸烟、肥胖、高胆固醇和糖尿病方面的错误报告率则明显较低。由于真正处于负面状况的人（更不可能出现错误报告）远多于真正处于正面状况的人（更有可能出现错误报告），因此我们发现，大学毕业生在整体健康报告方面的准确性显著提高。

abstract.text: We utilize panel data from the Health and Retirement Study to investigate the impact of retirement on physical and mental health, life satisfaction, and health care utilization. Because poor health can induce retirement, we instrument for retirement using eligibility for Social Security and employer sponsored pensions and coverage by the Social Security earnings test. We find strong evidence that retirement improves both health and life satisfaction. While the impact on life satisfaction occurs within the first 4 years of retirement, many of the improvements in health show up 4 or more years later, consistent with the view that health is a stock that evolves slowly. We find little evidence that retirement influences health care utilization.

10.3386/w21326.abstractZh: 我们利用《健康与退休研究》的面板数据，来探讨退休对身体健康、心理健康、生活满意度以及医疗保健利用的影响。由于健康状况不佳可能导致退休，我们通过社会保障资格、雇主提供的养老金以及社会保障收入测试来作为退休的工具变量。我们发现，退休确实能够改善健康状况和生活满意度。虽然生活满意度的改善在退休后的前4年内出现，但许多健康状况的改善则出现在4年或更长时间之后，这与健康是一种缓慢发展的资产的观点一致。我们发现，退休对医疗保健利用的影响很小。

abstract.text: While recent research finds strong evidence that birth order affects children’s outcomes such as education, IQ scores, and earnings, the evidence for effects on health is more limited. This paper uses a large dataset on the population of Norway and focuses on the effect of birth order on a range of health and health-related behaviors, outcomes not previously available in datasets of this magnitude. Interestingly, we find complicated effects of birth order. First-borns are more likely to be overweight, to be obese, and to have high blood pressure and high triglycerides. So, unlike education or earnings, there is no clear first-born advantage in health. However, later-borns are more likely to smoke and have poorer self-reported physical and mental health. They are also less likely to report that they are happy. We find that these effects are largely unaffected by conditioning on education and earnings, suggesting that these are not the only important pathways to health differentials by birth order. When we explore possible mechanisms, we find that smoking early in pregnancy is more prevalent for first pregnancies than for later ones. However, women are more likely to quit smoking during their first pregnancy than during later ones, and first-borns are more likely to be breast-fed. These findings suggest a role for early maternal investment in determining birth order effects on health.

10.3386/w21337.abstractZh: 近期的研究发现，出生顺序确实会影响儿童的教育、智商和收入等结果，但关于其对健康影响的证据则较为有限。本文利用挪威人口的大规模数据集，重点研究了出生顺序对一系列健康及相关行为的影响，这些结果在如此大规模的数据集中是前所未有的。有趣的是，我们发现出生顺序的影响相当复杂。长子或长女更容易出现超重、肥胖、高血压和高甘油三酯等问题。因此，与教育或收入不同，长子或长女在健康方面并没有明显的优势。然而，晚出生的孩子更有可能吸烟，并且自我报告的身体和心理健康状况较差。他们也更不可能表示自己很快乐。我们发现，这些影响在很大程度上不受教育和收入的影响，这表明教育和收入并非决定出生顺序对健康影响的唯一重要因素。当我们探讨可能的机制时，发现怀孕初期吸烟的情况在首次怀孕时更为普遍，而在后续怀孕时则较少见。此外，女性在首次怀孕时更有可能戒烟，而长子或长女更有可能接受母乳喂养。这些发现表明，母亲在怀孕早期的投资在决定出生顺序对健康的影响方面起着重要作用。

abstract.text: Many medical marijuana patients report using marijuana to alleviate chronic pain from musculoskeletal problems and other sources. If marijuana is used as a substitute for powerful and addictive pain relievers in medical marijuana states, a potential overlooked positive impact of medical marijuana laws may be a reduction in harms associated with opioid pain relievers, a far more addictive and potentially deadly substance. To assess this issue, we study the impact of medical marijuana laws on problematic opioid use. We use two measures of problematic use: treatment admissions for opioid pain reliever addiction from the Treatment Episode Data Set (TEDS) and state-level opioid overdose deaths in the National Vital Statistics System (NVSS). Using both standard differences-in-differences models as well as synthetic control models, we find that states permitting medical marijuana dispensaries experience a relative decrease in both opioid addictions and opioid overdose deaths compared to states that do not. We find no impact of medical marijuana laws more broadly; the mitigating effect of medical marijuana laws is specific to states that permit dispensaries. We evaluate potential mechanisms. Our findings suggest that providing broader access to medical marijuana may have the potential benefit of reducing abuse of highly addictive painkillers.

10.3386/w21345.abstractZh: 许多医用大麻患者报告使用大麻来缓解由肌肉骨骼问题及其他原因引起的慢性疼痛。如果在医用大麻州，大麻被用作强力且易上瘾的止痛药的替代品，那么医用大麻法律可能带来的一个被忽视的积极影响是减少与阿片类止痛药相关的危害，因为阿片类药物更具成瘾性且可能致命。为了评估这一问题，我们研究了医用大麻法律对阿片类药物滥用的影响。我们使用两种衡量滥用情况的指标：治疗事件数据集中的阿片类止痛药成瘾治疗入院记录，以及国家生命统计系统中的州级阿片类药物过量死亡数据。通过标准差异-差异模型以及合成控制模型，我们发现允许医用大麻诊所存在的州，阿片类成瘾和阿片类药物过量死亡的发生率相对较低。我们发现医用大麻法律在更广泛层面上并没有影响；其缓解作用仅限于允许设立诊所的州。我们还评估了潜在的机制。我们的研究结果表明，提供更广泛的医用大麻使用机会，可能有助于减少对高度成瘾性止痛药的滥用。

abstract.text: Research is needed to understand the extent to which environmental factors mediate links between genetic risk and the development of smoking behaviors. The Vietnam-era draft lottery offers a unique opportunity to investigate whether genetic susceptibility to smoking is influenced by risky environments in young adulthood. Access to free or reduced-price cigarettes coupled with the stress of military life meant conscripts were exposed to a large, exogenous shock to smoking behavior at a young age. Using data from the Health and Retirement Study (HRS), we interact a genetic risk score for smoking initiation with instrumented veteran status in an instrumental variables (IV) framework to test for genetic moderation (i.e. heterogeneous treatment effects) of veteran status on smoking behavior and smoking-related morbidities. We find evidence that veterans with a high genetic predisposition for smoking were more likely to become regular smokers, smoke heavily, and are at a higher risk of being diagnosed with cancer or hypertension at older ages. Smoking behavior was significantly attenuated for high-risk veterans who attended college after the war, indicating post-service schooling gains from veterans’ use of the GI Bill may have reduced tobacco consumption in adulthood.

10.3386/w21348.abstractZh: 需要进行研究以了解环境因素在遗传风险与吸烟行为发展之间的关联中所起的作用。越南时期的彩票制度提供了一个独特的机会，可以用来研究遗传上的吸烟倾向是否受到青年时期风险环境的影響。由于可以免费或低价购买香烟，再加上军旅生活的压力，新兵在年轻时就面临着巨大的外部冲击，影响了他们的吸烟行为。我们利用《健康与退休研究》的数据，将吸烟开始的遗传风险评分与退伍军人的身份变量相结合，通过工具变量框架来检验退伍军人身份对吸烟行为和吸烟相关疾病的遗传调节作用。我们发现，具有较高吸烟遗传倾向的退伍军人更有可能成为长期吸烟者，吸烟量更大，并且在老年时患癌症或高血压的风险更高。对于在战后接受大学教育的高风险退伍军人来说，吸烟行为显著减少，这表明退伍军人利用GI法案获得的受教育机会可能减少了他们在成年后的烟草消费。

abstract.text: This paper provides new evidence on how household labor supply responds to fatal and severe non-fatal health shocks in the short- and medium-run. To identify the causal effects of these shock realizations, we leverage administrative data on families' health and labor market outcomes, and construct counterfactuals to affected households by using households that experience the same shock but a few years in the future. We find that fatal health shocks lead to an immediate increase in the surviving spouses' labor supply and that this effect is entirely driven by families who experience significant income losses. Accordingly, widows, who face large income losses when their husbands die, increase their labor force participation by more than 11%; while widowers, who are significantly more financially stable, slightly decrease their labor supply. Notably, however, the patterns of sensitivity to comparable income changes are similar across genders. In contrast to fatal shocks, we find that non-fatal health shocks—in particular, heart attacks or strokes—have no meaningful effects on spousal labor supply, consistent with the adequate insurance coverage for the associated foregone income. Overall, the results point to self-insurance as a driving mechanism for the family labor supply responses that we estimate. Combined with a stylized model, our findings suggest efficient ways to target government transfers through existing social insurance programs.

10.3386/w21352.abstractZh: 本文提供了新的证据，揭示了家庭劳动力供给在短期和中期对致命性和严重性非致命健康冲击的反应。为了识别这些冲击的因果效应，我们利用关于家庭健康和劳动力市场结果的行政数据，并通过使用在未来几年内经历相同冲击但时间稍晚的家庭来构建反事实情景。我们发现，致命健康冲击会立即导致幸存配偶的劳动力供给增加，而这一效应完全由那些遭受重大收入损失的家庭所驱动。因此，当丈夫去世时面临巨大收入损失的寡妇，其劳动力参与率增加了超过11%；而财务状况更为稳定的丧偶者，其劳动力供给则略有下降。然而，值得注意的是，对可比收入变化的敏感性模式在性别之间是相似的。与致命冲击不同，我们发现非致命健康冲击——特别是心脏病发作或中风——对配偶劳动力供给没有显著影响，这与相关收入损失的充分保险覆盖相一致。总体而言，这些结果表明，自我保险是我们估计的家庭劳动力供给反应的一个驱动机制。结合一个简化的模型，我们的发现为通过现有的社会保险计划来定向分配政府转移支付提供了有效的方法。

abstract.text: This paper shows that health is an important determinant of labor market vulnerability during large economic crises. Using data on adults during Sweden’s unexpected economic crisis in the early 1990s, we show that early and later life health are important determinants of job loss after the crisis, but not before. Adults who were born with worse health (proxied by birth weight) and those who experience hospitalizations (and especially so for mental health related issues) in the pre-crisis period, are much more likely to lose their jobs and go on unemployment insurance after the crisis. These effects are concentrated in the private sector that happened to be more affected by the crisis. The results hold while controlling for individual education and occupational sorting prior to the crisis, and for controlling for family level characteristics by exploiting health differences within twin pairs. We conclude that poor health (both in early life and as adults) is an important indicator of vulnerability during economic shocks.

10.3386/w21353.abstractZh: 本文指出，在重大经济危机期间，健康状况是劳动力市场脆弱性的重要决定因素。通过研究20世纪90年代初瑞典突发经济危机期间成年人的数据，我们发现，早期和后期健康状况是危机后失业的重要决定因素，但在危机之前并非如此。那些出生时健康状况较差（以出生体重为指标）以及在危机前经历过住院治疗的成年人（尤其是与心理健康相关的问题），在危机后更有可能失业并领取失业救济金。这些影响主要集中在受危机影响较大的私营部门。研究结果在控制个体教育和职业分类因素后仍然成立，并且通过利用双胞胎间的健康差异来进一步控制家庭特征后，结果依然有效。我们得出结论，无论是早期还是成年后的健康状况不佳，都是经济冲击期间脆弱性的重要指标。

abstract.text: In this survey, we review the literature on the impact of exposure to the media. We cast a wide net and cover media impacts on education, family choices, labor and migration decisions, environmental choices, health, crime, public economics, attitudes, consumption and savings, and development economics. We stress five themes. First, the demand for entertainment plays a key role, with the economic impacts emerging largely as by-products. Second, to understand the media effects one cannot just focus on the direct effect of exposure but one needs to take into account the crowding-out of alternative activities (substitution effect). Third, the sources of identification play a critical role in determining what is known: credible estimates of short- and long run effects are available for some topics and some media but not for others. Fourth, most of the evidence on social and economic impacts is for exposure to the entertainment media such as television, as opposed to the printed press. Fifth, for the policy impacts both the substitution effect of media exposure and the demand for entertainment play an important role.

10.3386/w21360.abstractZh: 在这项调查中，我们回顾了关于媒体接触影响的文献。我们广泛涵盖了媒体对教育、家庭选择、劳动和迁移决策、环境选择、健康、犯罪、公共经济学、态度、消费和储蓄以及发展经济学的影响。我们强调了五个主题。首先，对娱乐活动的需求起着关键作用，其经济影响主要是副产品。其次，要理解媒体效应，不能仅仅关注直接接触的影响，还需要考虑替代活动的挤出效应。第三，识别来源在决定认知内容方面起着至关重要的作用：对于某些主题和某些媒体，可以获得短期和长期效应的可信估计，而对于其他媒体则无法获得这样的估计。第四，关于社会和经济影响的多数证据都是针对娱乐媒体（如电视）的接触，而不是印刷媒体。第五，对于政策影响而言，媒体接触的替代效应以及对娱乐活动的需求都起着重要作用。

abstract.text: The adoption of new clinical practice patterns by medical care providers is often challenging, even when they are believed to be both efficacious and profitable. This paper uses a randomized field experiment to examine the effects of temporary financial incentives paid to medical care clinics for the initiation of prenatal care in the first trimester of pregnancy. The rate of early initiation of prenatal care was 34% higher in the treatment group than in the control group while the incentives were being paid, and this effect persisted at least 24 months or more after the incentives ended. These results are consistent with a model where the incentives enable providers to address the fixed costs of overcoming organizational inertia in innovation, and suggest that temporary incentives may be effective at motivating improvements in long run provider performance at a substantially lower cost than permanent incentives.

10.3386/w21361.abstractZh: 医疗提供者采用新的临床实践模式往往具有挑战性，即使这些模式被认为既有效又盈利。本文通过随机实地实验来研究向医疗诊所支付临时财务激励措施对孕妇在孕早期开始产前护理的影响。在激励措施实施期间，治疗组的早期产前护理启动率比对照组高出34%，且这一效应在激励措施结束后的至少24个月或更长时间内仍然持续。这些结果与一种模型相符，即激励措施使提供者能够应对创新过程中组织惯性的固定成本，并表明临时激励措施可能在以远低于永久性激励的成本下，有效促进提供者长期绩效的改善。

abstract.text: Reported happiness provides a potentially useful way to evaluate unpriced goods and events; but measures of subjective well-being (SWB) often revert to the mean after responding to events, and this hedonic adaptation creates challenges for interpretation. Previous work tends to estimate time-invariant effects of events on happiness. In the presence of hedonic adaptation, this restriction can lead to biases, especially when comparing events to which people adapt at different rates. Our paper provides a flexible, extensible econometric framework that accommodates adaptation and permits the comparison of happiness-relevant life events with dissimilar hedonic adaptation paths. We present a method that is robust to individual fixed effects, imprecisely-dated data, and permanent consequences. The method is used to analyze a variety of events in the Health and Retirement Study panel. Many of the variables studied have substantial consequences for subjective well-being - consequences that differ greatly in their time profiles.

10.3386/w21365.abstractZh: 报告的幸福感提供了一种潜在有用的方式来评估未标价商品和事件；但是，主观幸福感指标在应对事件后往往会回归到平均水平，这种享乐适应现象给解释带来了挑战。以往的研究倾向于估计事件对幸福感的时间不变影响。在存在享乐适应的情况下，这种限制可能会导致偏差，尤其是在比较人们适应速度不同的事件时。我们的论文提供了一个灵活且可扩展的计量经济学框架，能够容纳适应现象，并允许比较与不同享乐适应路径相关的幸福相关生活事件。我们提出了一种对个体固定效应、不精确的数据记录和永久性后果都具有鲁棒性的方法。该方法被用于分析健康与退休研究小组中的各种事件。许多被研究的变量对主观幸福感有着显著的影响——这些影响的随时间变化模式差异很大。

abstract.text: This paper estimates the effects of post-and-hold laws on alcohol consumption and price. Post-and-hold laws require alcohol wholesalers to provide a list of prices to the state, which can be reviewed by retailers, competitors and the public. These laws were generally enacted at the end of prohibition with the intention of limiting alcohol consumption by raising prices. The laws may also have the unintended consequence of protecting small retailers. Recently, several large retailers have argued in court that these laws are counter to the Sherman Act, which limits anti-competitive behavior. This paper follows the recent paper by Cooper and Wright (2012) and adds new data and new statistical tests. Both difference-in–difference models and synthetic control models are employed. The estimation results provide no persuasive evidence of an effect of post-and-hold laws on the consumption of either beer, wine, or spirits. There is also no persuasive evidence that the laws increase the prices of these products. One possible explanation of this null effect is that the wholesale markets for alcohol are so highly regulated that post-and-hold laws have no discernable marginal effect. The empirical results presented in this paper do support alcohol excise taxes as effective means of reducing alcohol consumption.

10.3386/w21367.abstractZh: 本文估计了后置与持有法对酒精消费和价格的影响。后置与持有法要求酒精批发商向政府提供价格清单，零售商、竞争对手和公众可以对此进行查阅。这些法律通常在禁酒令结束后颁布，其目的是通过提高价格来限制酒精消费。这些法律还可能无意中保护小型零售商。最近，一些大型零售商在法庭上声称，这些法律违反了《谢尔曼法案》，该法案旨在限制反竞争行为。本文借鉴了Cooper和Wright（2012年）的最新研究，并增加了新的数据和新的统计检验方法。采用了差异-差异模型和合成控制模型。估计结果并未提供有力的证据表明后置与持有法对啤酒、葡萄酒或烈酒的消费有显著影响。也没有有力的证据表明这些法律提高了这些产品的价格。这种无效效果的一种可能解释是，酒精批发市场受到高度监管，因此后置与持有法没有明显的边际效应。本文的实证结果支持酒精消费税是减少酒精消费的有效手段。

abstract.text: Neoclassical and psychological models of consumer behavior often make divergent predictions for the welfare effects of paternalistic policies, leaving wide scope for researchers’ choice of a model to influence their policy conclusions. We develop a framework to reduce this model uncertainty and apply it to administrative data on consumer decision making in Medicare Part D. Consumers’ choices for prescription drug insurance plans can be explained by Abaluck and Gruber’s (AER 2011) model of utility maximization with psychological biases or by a neoclassical version of their model that precludes such biases. We evaluate these competing hypotheses using nonparametric tests of utility maximization and a trio of model validation tests. We find that 79% of enrollment decisions in Medicare Part D from 2006-2010 satisfied basic axioms of consumer preference theory under the assumptions of full information, zero transaction cost, and no measurement error. The validation tests provide evidence against widespread psychological biases. In particular, we find that precluding psychological biases improves the structural model’s out-of-sample predictions for consumer behavior.

10.3386/w21387.abstractZh: 新古典主义与心理学模型在预测家长式政策对福利的影响时往往存在分歧，这为研究者选择影响政策结论的模型提供了广泛的空间。我们提出了一个框架来减少模型的不确定性，并将其应用于Medicare Part D中消费者决策行为的行政数据。消费者选择处方药保险计划的行为可以通过Abaluck和Gruber在2011年提出的考虑心理偏差的效用最大化模型来解释，或者也可以通过一个排除此类心理偏差的新古典主义模型来解释。我们使用非参数效用最大化检验和三项模型验证测试来评估这些竞争假设。研究发现，在完全信息、零交易成本和无测量误差的假设下，2006-2010年间Medicare Part D的79%的参保决策符合消费者偏好理论的基本公理。验证测试提供了反对广泛存在的心理偏差的证据。特别是，我们发现排除心理偏差能够改善结构模型对消费者行为的样本外预测能力。

abstract.text: We study the effect of hospital adoption of electronic medical records (EMRs) on health outcomes, particularly patient safety indicators (PSIs). We find evidence of a positive impact of EMRs on PSIs via decision support rather than care coordination. Consistent with this mechanism, we find an EMR with decision support is more effective at reducing PSIs for less complicated cases, using several different metrics for complication. These findings indicate the negligible impacts for EMRs found by previous studies focusing on the Medicare population and/or mortality do not apply in all settings.

10.3386/w21389.abstractZh: 我们研究了医院采用电子病历对健康结果的影响，特别是患者安全指标。我们发现，电子病历通过决策支持而非护理协调对患者安全指标产生了积极影响。与此机制一致的是，我们发现具有决策支持的电子病历在减少较简单病例的患者安全指标方面更为有效，我们使用了多种不同的指标来衡量并发症。这些发现表明，先前针对医疗保险人群和/或死亡率的研究所发现的电子病历的微小影响并不适用于所有情况。

abstract.text: Household surveys, one of the main innovations in social science research of the last century, are threatened by declining accuracy due to reduced cooperation of respondents. While many indicators of survey quality have steadily declined in recent decades, the literature has largely emphasized rising nonresponse rates rather than other potentially more important dimensions to the problem. We divide the problem into rising rates of nonresponse, imputation, and measurement error, documenting the rise in each of these threats to survey quality over the past three decades. A fundamental problem in assessing biases due to these problems in surveys is the lack of a benchmark or measure of truth, leading us to focus on the accuracy of the reporting of government transfers. We provide evidence from aggregate measures of transfer reporting as well as linked microdata. We discuss the relative importance of misreporting of program receipt and conditional amounts of benefits received, as well as some of the conjectured reasons for declining cooperation and survey errors. We end by discussing ways to reduce the impact of the problem including the increased use of administrative data and the possibilities for combining administrative and survey data.

10.3386/w21399.abstractZh: 家庭调查是上个世纪社会科学研究中的一项重要创新，但其准确性正受到威胁，原因是受访者合作度的下降。尽管近年来许多调查质量指标持续下降，但相关文献大多关注的是非响应率的增加，而忽视了其他可能更为重要的因素。我们将这一问题分解为非响应率上升、数据插补以及测量误差三个方面，并记录了过去三十年中这些对调查质量构成威胁的因素的上升情况。在评估这些问题导致的偏差时，一个根本性的问题是缺乏一个基准或衡量真实性的标准，因此我们重点关注政府转移支付报告的准确性。我们提供了从总体转移支付报告数据以及相关微观数据中提取的证据。我们讨论了项目接收情况报告不准确以及所接收福利金额条件化问题的重要性，同时也探讨了导致合作度下降和调查误差的一些推测原因。最后，我们讨论了减少这些问题影响的方法，包括增加使用行政数据以及结合行政数据和调查数据的可能性。

abstract.text: We investigate whether individuals’ risk preferences change after experiencing a natural disaster, specifically, the 2011 Great East Japan Earthquake. Exploiting the panels of nationally representative surveys on risk preferences, we find that men who experienced greater intensity of the Earthquake became more risk tolerant after the Earthquake. Furthermore, these men gamble more, which is consistent with the direction of changes in risk preferences. We find no such pattern for women. Finally, the effects on men’s risk preferences are persistent even five years after the Earthquake at almost the same magnitude as those shortly after the Earthquake.

10.3386/w21400.abstractZh: 我们研究了个体在经历自然灾害后，其风险偏好是否会发生变化。具体来说，我们关注的是2011年东日本大地震。通过利用全国代表性调查数据来研究风险偏好，我们发现经历更大强度地震的男性在地震后变得更加容忍风险。此外，这些男性进行赌博的行为增多，这与风险偏好的变化方向一致。而对于女性来说，并未出现类似的趋势。最后，即使是在地震发生五年后，男性风险偏好的影响仍然持续存在，其程度与地震发生初期几乎相同。

abstract.text: Using birth records in Japan, where school entry rule is strictly enforced, this paper shows that more than 1,800 births a year are shifted from one week before the school entry cutoff date to one week following the cutoff date. Because older children perform better academically than their younger peers, parents who value potential long-term academic gains over the short-term gain of childcare cost savings do exploit birth timing as a means of early childhood investment. Heterogeneous responses by parents violate the assumption of regression discontinuity design that births around the school entry cutoff dates are random.

10.3386/w21402.abstractZh: 本文利用日本严格的入学规则，通过出生记录数据表明，每年有超过1800例出生情况被推迟到入学截止日期后的一周。由于年龄较大的孩子在学习成绩上优于年幼的同伴，那些更重视长期学术收益而非短期 childcare成本节省的父母，确实会利用出生时间作为早期儿童教育的投资手段。父母的不同反应打破了“回归不连续设计”的假设，即入学截止日期附近的出生是随机的。

abstract.text: We present the first direct evidence on the relative quality of public and private healthcare in a low-income setting, using a unique set of audit studies. We sent standardized (fake) patients to rural primary care providers in the Indian state of Madhya Pradesh, and recorded the quality of care provided and prices charged in each interaction. We report three main findings. First, most private providers lacked formal medical training, but they spent more time with patients and completed more essential checklist items than public providers, and were equally likely to provide a correct treatment. Second, we compare the performance of qualified public doctors across their public and private practices, and find that the same doctors exerted higher effort and were more likely to provide a correct treatment in their private practices. Third, in the private sector, we find that prices charged are positively correlated with provider effort and correct treatment, but also with unnecessary treatments. In the public sector, we find no correlation between provider salaries and any measure of quality. We develop a simple theoretical framework to interpret our results and show that in settings with low levels of effort in the public sector, the benefits of higher diagnostic effort in the private sector may outweigh the costs of market incentives to over treat. These differences in provider effort may partly explain the dominant market share of fee-charging private providers even in the presence of a system of free public healthcare.

10.3386/w21405.abstractZh: 我们首次直接证明了在低收入环境下，公共医疗与私人医疗的相对质量差异，通过一系列独特的审计研究。我们向印度中央邦的农村初级保健提供者发送了标准化的“假”患者，并记录每次诊疗过程中提供的医疗服务质量及收费情况。我们的主要发现如下：首先，大多数私人医疗服务提供者缺乏正式的医学培训，但他们与患者相处的时间更长，完成的基本检查项目也更多，且提供正确治疗的可能性与公共医疗服务提供者相当。其次，我们比较了在公共和私人诊所工作的合格公共医生的表现，发现同一位医生在私人诊所中付出的努力更大，提供正确治疗的可能性也更高。第三，在私人医疗领域，我们发现收费与服务提供者的努力程度及正确治疗情况呈正相关，但也与不必要的治疗有关。在公共医疗领域，我们没有发现服务提供者的薪资与服务质量之间存在相关性。我们提出了一个简单的理论框架来解释这些结果，并表明在公共医疗领域投入不足的情况下，私人医疗领域更高的诊断投入可能会抵消过度治疗的成本。这些服务提供者的努力差异可能部分解释了即使在免费公共医疗体系存在的情况下，收费私人医疗服务提供者仍占据主导地位的原因。

abstract.text: We consider the welfare consequences of nudges and other behavioral economic devices to encourage exercise habit formation. We analyze a randomized trial of nudged exercise commitment contracts in the context of a time-inconsistent intertemporal utility maximization model of the demand for exercise. The trial follows more than 4,000 people seeking to make exercise commitments. Each person was randomly nudged towards making longer (20 weeks) or shorter (8 weeks) exercise commitment contracts. Our empirical analysis shows that people who are interested in exercise commitment contracts choose longer contracts when nudged to do so, and are then more likely to meet their pre-stated exercise goals. People are also more likely to enroll in a subsequent commitment contract after the original expires if they receive a nudge for a longer duration initial contract. Our theoretical analysis of the welfare implications of these effects shows conditions under which nudges can reduce utility even when they succeed in the goal of promoting habitual exercise.

10.3386/w21406.abstractZh: 我们研究了通过激励措施和其他行为经济手段来促进运动习惯形成的福利效应。我们分析了一项关于运动承诺合同的随机试验，该试验是在一个时间不一致的跨期效用最大化模型框架下进行的，该模型描述了人们对运动的需求。试验涉及4000多人，他们都在尝试做出运动承诺。参与者被随机引导选择更长的（20周）或更短（8周）的运动承诺合同。我们的实证分析表明，对运动承诺合同感兴趣的人在受到激励后会选择更长的合同，并且更有可能实现他们预先设定的运动目标。如果参与者因受到激励而选择了更长的初始合同，他们也更有可能在原始合同到期后再签订新的承诺合同。我们对这些效应的福利影响的理论分析表明，在某些情况下，即使激励措施成功促进了习惯性运动，它们也可能降低效用。

abstract.text: This paper investigates the biological standard of living toward the end of Spanish rule. We investigate levels, trends, and determinants of physical stature from the birth cohorts of the 1860s to the 1890s using data on 23,000 Filipino soldiers enlisted by the U.S. military between 1901 and 1913. We use truncated regression technique for estimating average height and use province level information for investigating the determinants of biological wellbeing. The results indicate a decline of more than 1.5 cm cm (0.6 inches) in the height of soldiers born between the early 1870s and the late 1880s. The decline in heights at the end of the 19th century occurred at a time when there was an expansion of commercial activity in cash crop production for export. Heights did not regain the level of the 1870s until the late 1930s and early 1940s. We also find that at 159.3 cm (62.7 inches), the average height of soldiers born in the mid-1870s was very short even for the time. The low biological standard of living in late 19th century was not due to the tropical disease environment alone since taller men were found in the same period in other parts of Asia.

10.3386/w21410.abstractZh: 本文研究了西班牙统治末期菲律宾人的生物生活水平。我们利用1901年至1913年间美国军队征募的23,000名菲律宾士兵的数据，研究了1860年代至1890年代出生的人群的身高水平、变化趋势及其决定因素。采用截断回归技术估算平均身高，并利用省级数据来研究生物健康水平的决定因素。研究结果表明，1870年代初期至1880年代末期出生的士兵身高下降了1.5厘米以上。这一身高下降发生在19世纪末，当时商业活动集中在现金作物的生产出口上。直到1930年代末和1940年代初，士兵的身高才恢复到1870年代的水平。我们还发现，1870年代中期出生的士兵平均身高为159.3厘米，这一身高在当时属于非常低的水平。19世纪末菲律宾人的低生物生活水平并非仅由热带疾病环境造成，因为在同一时期，亚洲其他地区的男性身高也较低。

abstract.text: We analyze the economic consequences for less developed countries of investing in female health. In so doing we introduce a novel micro-founded dynamic general equilibrium framework in which parents trade off the number of children against investments in their education and in which we allow for health-related gender differences in productivity. We show that better female health speeds up the demographic transition and thereby the take-off toward sustained economic growth. By contrast, male health improvements delay the transition and the take-off because ceteris paribus they raise fertility. According to our results, investing in female health is therefore an important lever for development policies. However, and without having to assume anti-female bias, we also show that households prefer male health improvements over female health improvements because they imply a larger static utility gain. This highlights the existence of a dynamic trade-off between the short-run interests of households and long-run development goals. Our numerical analysis shows that even small changes in female health can have a strong impact on the transition process to a higher income level in the long run. Our results are robust with regard to a number of extensions, most notably endogenous investment in health care.

10.3386/w21411.abstractZh: 我们分析了在女性健康方面进行投资对欠发达国家经济后果的影响。为此，我们引入了一种新的基于微观数据的动态一般均衡框架，在该框架中，父母需要在子女数量与教育和健康投资之间进行权衡，同时我们还考虑了健康相关性别差异对生产力的影响。研究表明，女性健康的改善能够加速人口转型，从而促进经济的持续增长。相反，男性健康的改善则会延迟这一转型过程，因为在其他条件不变的情况下，男性健康的改善会提高生育率。根据我们的研究结果，投资于女性健康是发展政策中的一个重要手段。然而，无需假设对女性的偏见，我们也发现家庭更倾向于改善男性健康，因为这意味着更大的静态效用收益。这凸显了家庭短期利益与长期发展目标之间存在的动态权衡。我们的数值分析表明，即使女性健康的微小变化，也能在长期内对向更高收入水平转型的过程产生显著影响。我们的研究结果在多种扩展情况下仍然具有稳健性，尤其是关于医疗健康投资的内生性方面。

abstract.text: In both its costs and the number of its enrollees, Medicaid is the largest means-tested transfer program in the United States. It is also a fundamental part of the health care system, providing health insurance to low-income families, indigent seniors, disabled adults and, in some states, low-income adults more broadly. This paper reviews the history and structure of the Medicaid program and the large body of economic research that it has spawned in the nearly half century since it was established. We begin by summarizing the program’s history, goals and current rules. We then present program statistics, mainly related to enrollment and expenditures. Finally we turn to the research on the impact of Medicaid on a broad range of outcomes, discussing theoretical and methodological issues important for understanding these effects and reviewing the empirical literature, describing what has been learned thus far, investigating areas where studies seem to reach different conclusions and pointing to areas where we believe additional research would be fruitful.

10.3386/w21425.abstractZh: 在成本和参保人数方面，医疗补助是美国规模最大的按需转移支付计划。它也是医疗保健体系的重要组成部分，为低收入家庭、贫困老年人、残疾成年人提供健康保险，在某些州，还涵盖更广泛的低收入成年人。本文回顾了医疗补助计划的历史和架构，以及自其建立以来近半个世纪中产生的大量经济研究。我们首先总结了该计划的历史、目标和现行规定。接着，我们介绍了与参保和支出相关的计划统计数据。最后，我们探讨了医疗补助对一系列结果的影响，讨论了理解这些影响的重要理论和方法论问题，并回顾了相关实证文献，描述了迄今为止的研究成果，分析了研究结论存在差异的领域，并指出了我们认为需要进一步研究的领域。

abstract.text: This study estimates long-run impacts of a child health investment, exploiting community-wide experimental variation in school-based deworming. The program increased labor supply among men and education among women, with accompanying shifts in labor market specialization. Ten years after deworming treatment, men who were eligible as boys stay enrolled for more years of primary school, work 17% more hours each week, spend more time in non-agricultural self-employment, are more likely to hold manufacturing jobs, and miss one fewer meal per week. Women who were in treatment schools as girls are approximately one quarter more likely to have attended secondary school, halving the gender gap. They reallocate time from traditional agriculture into cash crops and non-agricultural self-employment. We estimate a conservative annualized financial internal rate of return to deworming of 32%, and show that mass deworming may generate more in future government revenue than it costs in subsidies.

10.3386/w21428.abstractZh: 本研究通过利用社区范围内学校驱虫项目的实验性差异，估算了儿童健康投资对长期影响的效应。该项目增加了男性的劳动力供应和女性的教育水平，并伴随着劳动力市场专业化的变化。在驱虫治疗十年后，符合条件的男性男孩继续就读小学，每周工作时间增加17%，从事非农业自雇工作的时间增多，更有可能从事制造业工作，每周错过的一餐也减少了一顿。接受治疗的女性女孩则更有可能完成中学教育，性别差距缩小了一半。她们将时间从传统农业转向经济作物种植和非农业自雇工作。我们估算出驱虫治疗的保守年化财务内部回报率为32%，并表明大规模驱虫治疗可能带来的未来政府收入收益超过其补贴成本。

abstract.text: This paper examines the long-term impacts on health and healthy behaviors of two of the oldest and most widely cited U.S. early childhood interventions evaluated by the method of randomization with long-term follow-up: the Perry Preschool Project (PPP) and the Carolina Abecedarian Project (ABC). There are pronounced gender effects strongly favoring boys, although there are also effects for girls. Dynamic mediation analyses show a significant role played by improved childhood traits, above and beyond the effects of experimentally enhanced adult socioeconomic status. These results show the potential of early life interventions for promoting health.

10.3386/w21454.abstractZh: 本文探讨了通过随机化方法并长期随访评估的两种最古老且被广泛引用的美国早期儿童干预措施对健康和健康行为长期影响的效应。这两种干预措施分别是佩里学前教育项目（PPP）和卡罗莱纳字母启蒙项目（ABC）。尽管对女孩也有积极影响，但结果明显显示男孩受到显著的优势影响。动态中介分析表明，改善儿童时期的特质在促进健康方面起着重要作用，这超出了实验性增强的成人社会经济地位的影响范围。这些结果展示了早期干预措施在促进健康方面的潜力。

abstract.text: Obesity and diet-related chronic disease are increasing problems worldwide. In response, many governments have enacted or are considering taxes on energy-dense foods. Perhaps the most commonly-recommended policy is a tax on sugar-sweetened beverages (SSBs). This paper estimates the extent to which a tax on SSBs is passed through to consumers in the form of higher prices. We examine the first city-level tax on SSBs in the U.S., which was enacted by the voters of Berkeley, California in November, 2014. We collected the prices of various brands and sizes of SSBs and other beverages before and after the implementation of the tax from a near-census of convenience stores and supermarkets in Berkeley, California. We also collected prices from stores in a control city: San Francisco, where in a similar voter referendum failed despite majority support. Estimates from difference-in-differences models indicate that, across all brands and sizes of products examined, 43.1 percent (95 percent confidence interval: 27.7 percent - 58.4 percent) of the Berkeley tax was passed on to consumers. The estimates also are consistent with cross-border shopping. For each mile of distance between the store and the closest store selling untaxed SSBs, pass-through rose 33.3 percent for 2-liter bottles and 25.8 percent for 12-packs of 12-ounce cans.

10.3386/w21465.abstractZh: 肥胖症和与饮食相关的慢性疾病是全球日益严重的问题。为此，许多政府已经实施了或正在考虑对高能量密度食品征税。或许最常被推荐的政策是对含糖饮料征税。本文估算了含糖饮料征税在多大程度上以更高的价格形式传递给了消费者。我们研究了美国首个城市级别的含糖饮料征税政策，该政策于2014年11月由加利福尼亚州伯克利的选民通过。我们收集了伯克利地区便利店和超市在征税前后各种品牌和规格的含糖饮料及其他饮料的价格。我们还收集了对照城市旧金山的价格数据，在那里类似的选民公投虽然获得了多数支持，但最终未能通过。差异模型估计表明，对于所有被研究的品牌和规格的产品，伯克利地区的征税有43.1%（95%置信区间：27.7%至58.4%）传递给了消费者。这些估计结果也与跨境购物情况一致。对于商店与最近的未征税含糖饮料销售点之间的每英里距离，2升瓶装的含糖饮料的传递比例增加了33.3%，而12盎司装12瓶装的含糖饮料则增加了25.8%。

abstract.text: We describe the broad range of uncertainties faced by the developers of medical technologies. Empirically, we estimate the asset market incidence of two realizations of uncertainties we classify as within-market policy risks. The events we analyze concern the intellectual property of Myriad Genetics, Inc., an American molecular diagnostics firm. In June 2013, the Supreme Court invalidated several of Myriad's intellectual property claims. Subsequently, the Center for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) re-evaluated the reimbursements it pays for the services at issue in the Supreme Court's ruling. Each of these events moved Myriad's market capitalization by several hundred million dollars, or on the order of 20 percent. Myriad's exposure to the realization of these events reflected the concentration of its revenue streams among the affected services. We discuss the implications of the risks we analyze for the total volume of medical innovation and for its organization across firms.

10.3386/w21469.abstractZh: 我们描述了医疗技术开发者面临的广泛不确定性。通过实证分析，我们估算了两种不确定性在资产市场中的影响，并将这两种不确定性归类为市场内部政策风险。我们分析的事件涉及美国分子诊断公司Myriad Genetics, Inc.的知识产权问题。2013年6月，最高法院撤销了Myriad的几项知识产权主张。随后，医疗保险和医疗补助服务中心（CMS）重新评估了最高法院裁决中涉及的服务报销标准。这两个事件分别使Myriad的市值减少了数亿美元，约占20%。Myriad面临这些事件的风险，反映了其收入来源集中在受影响的服务上。我们讨论了所分析的风险对医疗创新总量以及企业组织的影响。

abstract.text: How do peers influence the impact of incentives? Despite much work on incentives, little is known about the spillover effects of incentives. We investigate two mechanisms by which these effects can occur: through peers' actions and peers' incentives. In a field experiment on snack choice (grapes versus cookies), we randomize who receives incentives, the fraction of peers incentivized, and whether or not it can be observed that peers' choices are incentivized among over 1,500 children in the school lunchroom. Incentives increase the likelihood of initially choosing grapes. However, peer spillover effects can be large enough to undo these positive effects.

10.3386/w21481.abstractZh: 同伴如何影响激励的效果？尽管关于激励的研究很多，但关于激励的溢出效应却知之甚少。我们研究了两种可能导致这种效应的机制：通过同伴的行为和同伴的激励。在一个关于零食选择的实地实验中（选择葡萄还是饼干），我们随机分配了哪些人会收到激励、激励同伴的比例，以及是否可以让其他同伴观察到同伴的选择受到激励。在1500多名儿童参与的学校午餐室中，激励确实增加了最初选择葡萄的可能性。然而，同伴的溢出效应可能足够大，以至于抵消了这些积极效果。

abstract.text: We examine how long-term care insurance (LTCI) affects family outcomes expected to be sensitive to LTCI, including utilization of informal care and spillover effects on children. An instrumental variables approach allows us to address the endogeneity of LTCI coverage. LTCI coverage induces less informal caregiving, suggesting the presence of intra-family moral hazard. We also find that children are less likely to co-reside or live nearby parents with LTCI and more likely to work full-time, suggesting that significant economic gains from private LTCI could accrue to the younger generation.

10.3386/w21483.abstractZh: 我们研究了长期护理保险对家庭结果的影响，这些结果通常对长期护理保险较为敏感，包括非正式护理的使用以及对子女的影响。通过工具变量方法，我们能够解决长期护理保险覆盖程度的内生性问题。研究发现，长期护理保险覆盖程度会降低非正式护理的需求，这表明存在家庭内部的道德风险。此外，我们还发现，有长期护理保险的父母的孩子不太可能共同居住或住在父母附近，而且更有可能从事全职工作，这表明私人长期护理保险可以为年轻一代带来显著的经济收益。

abstract.text: Prior literature has documented a positive association between income and cognitive function at older ages, however, the extent to which this association represents causal effects is unknown. In this study, we use an exogenous change in Social Security income due to amendments to the Social Security Act in the 1970s to identify the causal impact of Social Security income on cognitive function of elderly individuals. We find that higher benefits led to significant improvements in cognitive function and that these improvements in cognition were clinically meaningful. Our results suggest that interventions even at advanced ages can slow the rate of decline in cognitive function.

10.3386/w21484.abstractZh: 先前的研究已经记录了老年时期收入与认知功能之间的正相关关系，但这种关联是否具有因果效应尚不清楚。在本研究中，我们通过分析1970年代社会保障法修正案导致的社会保障收入变化，来探讨社会保障收入对老年人认知功能的因果影响。我们发现，较高的社会保障福利水平显著提升了认知功能，且这些认知能力的改善具有临床意义。我们的研究结果表明，即使在高龄阶段，采取干预措施也可以减缓认知功能的衰退速度。

abstract.text: In this paper, we estimate how hospital ownership of physicians’ practices affects their patients’ hospital choices. We match data on the hospital admissions of Medicare beneficiaries, including the identity of their admitting physician, with data on the identity of the owner of the admitting physician’s practice. We find that a hospital's ownership of an admitting physician’s practice dramatically increases the probability that the physician's patients will choose the owning hospital. We also find that patients are more likely to choose a high-cost, low-quality hospital when their admitting physician’s practice is owned by that hospital.

10.3386/w21497.abstractZh: 在本文中，我们研究了医院对医生诊所的拥有权如何影响患者选择医院的行为。我们将医疗保险受益人住院的数据，包括其接诊医生的身份，与医生诊所所有者的相关信息进行匹配。研究发现，医院拥有医生诊所会显著增加该医生的患者选择该医院的可能性。此外，我们还发现，当接诊医生的诊所由该医院拥有时，患者更有可能选择费用高、质量低的医院。

abstract.text: Implicit in the drug-approval process is a trade-off between Type I and Type II error. We explore the application of Bayesian decision analysis (BDA) to minimize the expected cost of drug approval, where relative costs are calibrated using U.S. Burden of Disease Study 2010 data. The results for conventional fixed-sample randomized clinical-trial designs suggest that for terminal illnesses with no existing therapies such as pancreatic cancer, the standard threshold of 2.5% is substantially more conservative than the BDA-optimal threshold of 27.9%. However, for relatively less deadly conditions such as prostate cancer, 2.5% is more risk-tolerant or aggressive than the BDA-optimal threshold of 1.2%. We compute BDA-optimal sizes for 25 of the most lethal diseases and show how a BDA-informed approval process can incorporate all stakeholders’ views in a systematic, transparent, internally consistent, and repeatable manner.

10.3386/w21499.abstractZh: 在药物审批过程中，存在一个关于第一类错误和第二类错误的权衡。我们探讨了贝叶斯决策分析在最小化药物审批预期成本中的应用，其中相对成本是根据2010年美国疾病负担研究的数据进行校准的。对于尚无现有疗法的致命疾病，如胰腺癌，传统的固定样本随机临床试验设计的标准阈值2.5%明显低于贝叶斯决策分析所推荐的最优阈值27.9%。然而，对于相对危险性较低的疾病，如前列腺癌，2.5%的阈值比贝叶斯决策分析所推荐的1.2%的阈值更为宽容或激进。我们计算了25种最致命疾病的贝叶斯决策分析最优样本量，并展示了如何以系统、透明、内部一致且可重复的方式，将所有利益相关者的意见纳入药物审批流程中。

abstract.text: Empirical models of demand for–and, often, supply of–differentiated products are widely used in practice, typically employing parametric functional forms and distributions of consumer heterogeneity. We review some recent work studying identification in a broad class of such models. This work shows that parametric functional forms and distributional assumptions are not essential for identification. Rather, identification relies primarily on the standard requirement that instruments be available for the endogenous variables–here, typically, prices and quantities. We discuss the kinds of instruments needed for identification and how the reliance on instruments can be reduced by nonparametric functional form restrictions or better data. We also discuss results on discrimination between alternative models of oligopoly competition.

10.3386/w21500.abstractZh: 关于差异化产品需求的实证模型，以及通常的供给模型，在实践中被广泛使用，这些模型通常采用参数化的函数形式和消费者异质性的分布描述。我们回顾了一些关于这类模型识别方法的最新研究。研究表明，参数化的函数形式和分布假设并非识别的必要条件。实际上，识别主要依赖于一个标准要求，即需要为内生变量提供相应的工具变量——在这里，通常是价格和数量。我们讨论了识别所需的工具变量的类型，以及如何通过非参数化的函数形式限制或更好的数据来减少对工具变量的依赖。我们还讨论了关于寡头竞争不同模型之间差异性的研究结果。

abstract.text: Over the last five decades, broad changes in the US health care system have dramatically influenced growth in health care expenditures. These structural changes have also influenced the trajectory of the health economics research. This paper reviews some of the seminal health economics papers (measured by citations) and identifies the salient factors driving the growth of medical expenditures. We find that the research identified – and was strongly influenced by – four eras of expenditure growth: (1) coverage expansion; (2) experimentation with financial incentives; (3) the managed care backlash; and (4) a golden era of declining expenditure growth. We conclude by discussing some themes from this research suggesting optimism that, going forward, we can curb excess expenditure growth above GDP growth without harming population health.

10.3386/w21501.abstractZh: 在过去的五十年里，美国医疗保健系统的重大变革对医疗支出的增长产生了深远影响。这些结构性变化也影响了健康经济学研究的轨迹。本文回顾了一些具有代表性的健康经济学论文（以引用次数衡量），并确定了推动医疗支出增长的主要因素。我们发现，研究所识别出的支出增长经历了四个阶段：（1）覆盖范围扩大；（2）对财务激励的实验；（3）管理式医疗的反弹；（4）支出增长下降的黄金时代。最后，本文讨论了这些研究中的一些主题，表明未来我们可以在不损害人口健康的情况下，抑制超出GDP增长的过度支出增长。

abstract.text: This paper examines the impact of universal, free, and easily accessible primary healthcare on population health as measured by age-specific mortality rates, focusing on a nationwide socialized medicine program implemented in Turkey. The Family Medicine Program (FMP), launched in 2005, assigns each Turkish citizen to a specific state-employed family physician who offers a wide range of primary healthcare services that are free-of-charge. Furthermore, these services are provided at family health centers, which operate on a walk-in basis and are located within the neighborhoods in close proximity to the patients. To identify the causal impact of the FMP, we exploit the variation in its introduction across provinces and over time. Our estimates indicate that the FMP caused the mortality rate to decrease by 25.6% among infants, 7.7% among the elderly, and 22.9% among children ages 1-4. These estimates translate into 2.6, 1.29, and 0.13 fewer deaths among infants, the elderly, and children ages 1-4, respectively. Furthermore, the effects appear to strengthen over time. We also show evidence to suggest that the FMP has contributed to an equalization of mortality across provinces. Finally, our calculations indicate that each family physician saves about 0.15, 0.46, and 0.005 lives among infants, the elderly, and children ages 1- 4 per province every year.

10.3386/w21510.abstractZh: 本文探讨了全民、免费且易于获取的基本医疗服务对人口健康的影响，具体通过年龄特定的死亡率来衡量，重点关注土耳其实施的一项全国性社会化医疗计划。该家庭医学计划于2005年启动，为每位土耳其公民分配一名由州政府雇用的家庭医生，提供一系列免费的基本医疗服务。这些服务在家庭健康中心提供，这些中心采用预约制，且位于患者附近的社区内。为了分析家庭医学计划的因果效应，我们研究了其在不同省份及时间上的实施差异。我们的估计表明，该计划使婴儿死亡率降低了25.6%，老年人死亡率降低了7.7%，1-4岁儿童死亡率降低了22.9%。这些数字分别意味着婴儿、老年人和1-4岁儿童死亡人数减少了2.6、1.29和0.13人。此外，这些效应似乎随着时间的推移而增强。我们还发现，家庭医学计划有助于各省份之间死亡率的均衡。最后，我们的计算表明，每个家庭医生每年为各省份的婴儿、老年人和1-4岁儿童分别挽救了约0.15、0.46和0.005条生命。

abstract.text: We test whether the generosity of employer-sponsored health insurance facilitates the exercise of market power by hospitals. We construct indices of health plan generosity and the price and volume of hospital services using data from Truven MarketScan for 601 counties from 2001-2007. We use variation in the industry and union status of covered workers within a county over time to identify the causal effects of generosity. Although OLS estimates fail to reject the hypothesis that generosity facilitates the exercise of hospital market power, IV estimates show a statistically significant and economically important positive effect of plan generosity on hospital prices in uncompetitive markets, but not in competitive markets. Our results suggest that most of the aggregate effect of hospital market structure on prices found in previous work may be coming from areas with generous plans.

10.3386/w21513.abstractZh: 我们测试了雇主赞助的医疗保险的慷慨程度是否有助于医院行使市场权力。我们使用Truven MarketScan的数据，针对2001-2007年间601个县的医疗计划慷慨程度、医院服务的价格及数量等指标进行了分析。通过考察各县内受覆盖工人的行业及工会状态随时间的变化，我们试图确定慷慨程度对医院市场权力的影响。尽管普通最小二乘法估计未能否定慷慨程度有助于医院行使市场权力的假设，但工具变量估计显示，在非竞争市场中，医疗计划的慷慨程度对医院价格有显著且重要的正面影响，但在竞争市场中则没有这种效应。我们的研究结果表明，先前关于医院市场结构对价格影响的研究中发现的整体效应，可能主要来自于那些医疗计划较为慷慨的地区。

abstract.text: Poor water quality and sanitation are leading causes of mortality and disease in developing countries. However, interventions providing toilets in rural areas have not substantially improved health, likely because of incomplete coverage and low usage. This paper estimates the impact of an integrated water and sanitation improvement program in rural India that provided household-level water connections, latrines, and bathing facilities to all households in approximately 100 villages. The estimates suggest that the intervention was effective, reducing treated diarrhea episodes by 30-50%. These results are evident in the short term and persist for 5 years or more. The annual cost is approximately US$60 per household.

10.3386/w21521.abstractZh: 水质差和卫生条件差是发展中国家死亡和疾病的主要原因。然而，在农村地区提供厕所的干预措施并未显著改善健康状况，这可能是由于覆盖范围不完整以及使用率较低所致。本文估算了在印度农村地区实施一项综合水与卫生设施改善计划的效果，该计划为大约100个村庄的所有家庭提供了家庭级的水源连接、厕所和沐浴设施。估算结果显示，该干预措施有效，使经治疗的腹泻病例减少了30-50%。这些结果在短期内明显，并且持续了5年或更长时间。每年的成本约为每户60美元。

abstract.text: Dynamic discrete choice (DDC) models are not identified nonparametrically, but the non-identification of models does not necessarily imply the non-identification of counterfactuals. We derive novel results for the identification of counterfactuals in DDC models, such as non- additive changes in payoffs or changes to agents' choice sets. In doing so, we propose a general framework that allows the investigation of the identification of a broad class of counterfactuals (covering virtually any counterfactual encountered in applied work). To illustrate the results, we consider a firm entry/exit problem numerically, as well as an empirical model of agricultural land use. In each case, we provide examples of both identified and non-identified counterfactuals of interest.

10.3386/w21527.abstractZh: 动态离散选择模型并非通过非参数方式被识别，但模型的非识别并不一定意味着反事实的不可识别。我们为动态离散选择模型中反事实的识别提出了新的方法，例如收益的非加性变化或代理人选择集的变化。为此，我们提出了一个通用框架，可以研究广泛类别的反事实的识别（几乎涵盖了应用工作中遇到的所有反事实）。为了说明这些结果，我们通过数值方法研究了一个企业进入/退出问题，以及一个农业用地使用的实证模型。在每种情况下，我们都提供了已识别和未识别的反事实的例子。

abstract.text: Health insurance markets face two forms of adverse selection problems. On the demand side, adverse selection leads to plan price distortions and inefficient sorting of consumers across health plans. On the supply side, adverse selection creates incentives for plans to inefficiently distort benefits to attract profitable enrollees. These problems can be addressed by features of health plan payment systems such as reinsurance, risk adjustment, and premium categories. In this paper, we develop Harberger- type measures of the efficiency consequences of price and benefit distortions under a given payment system. Our measures are valid, that is, based on explicit economic models of adverse selection. Our measures are complete, in that they are able to incorporate multiple features of plan payment systems. Finally, they are practical, in that they are based on the ex ante data available to regulators and researchers during the design phase of payment system development, prior to observing actual insurer and consumer behavior. After developing the measures, we illustrate their use by comparing the performance of the payment system planned for implementation in the ACA Marketplaces in 2017 to several policy alternatives. We show that, in protecting against both types of selection problems, a payment system that incorporates reinsurance and prospective risk adjustment out-performs the planned payment system which includes only concurrent risk adjustment.

10.3386/w21531.abstractZh: 健康保险市场面临两种形式的逆向选择问题。在需求方面，逆向选择导致计划价格扭曲以及消费者对不同健康计划的无效排序。在供应方面，逆向选择促使计划机构通过无效的方式扭曲福利以吸引盈利的参保者。这些问题可以通过健康计划支付系统的某些特性来解决，例如再保险、风险调整以及保费类别。在本文中，我们开发了基于Harberger类型的指标，用于衡量在给定支付系统下价格和福利扭曲的效率后果。我们的指标是有效的，因为它们基于明确的逆向选择经济模型。这些指标也是完整的，因为它们能够涵盖计划支付系统的多种特性。最后，这些指标是实用的，因为它们基于在支付系统开发设计阶段可供监管机构和研究人员使用的先验数据，而在实际观察保险公司和消费者行为之前。在开发这些指标之后，我们通过比较2017年ACA市场计划中采用的支付系统与几种替代方案的性能来说明它们的应用。我们表明，在防范这两种选择问题时，采用再保险和前瞻性风险调整的支付系统比仅采用同时性风险调整的计划系统表现更好。

abstract.text: I take advantage of regulatory and pricing dynamics in Medicare Part D to empirically explore interactions among adverse selection, switching costs, and regulation. I first document novel evidence of adverse selection and switching costs within Part D using detailed administrative data. I then estimate a contract choice and pricing model in order to quantify the importance of switching costs for risk-sorting, and for policies that may affect risk sorting. I first find that in Part D, switching costs help sustain an adversely-selected equilibrium and are likely to mute the ability of ACA policies to improve risk allocation across contracts, leading to higher premiums for some enrollees. I then estimate that, overall, decreasing the cost of active decision-making in the Part D environment could lead to a substantial gain in consumer surplus of on average $400-$600 per capita, which is around 20%-30% of average annual per capita drug spending.

10.3386/w21541.abstractZh: 我利用Medicare Part D中的监管和定价机制，通过实证研究来探讨逆向选择、转换成本与监管之间的相互作用。首先，我使用详细的行政数据记录了Part D中逆向选择和转换成本的新证据。接着，我建立了一个契约选择与定价模型，以量化转换成本在风险分类中的重要性，以及可能影响风险分类的政策的影响。研究发现，在Part D中，转换成本有助于维持逆向选择的均衡，并且可能会削弱ACA政策改善合同间风险分配的能力，导致一些参保人的保费上升。此外，研究还估计，降低Part D环境中主动决策的成本，可以带来平均每人400-600美元的消费者剩余增加，这一数值约占人均年度药物支出的20%-30%。

abstract.text: This paper examines the impact of potential fetal malnutrition on the academic proficiency of Muslim students in Denmark. We account for the endogeneity of fetal malnutrition by using the exposure to the month of Ramadan during time in utero as a natural experiment, under the assumption that some Muslim women might have fasted during Ramadan when they were pregnant. In some of our specifications, we use a sample of students from predominantly non-Muslim countries as an additional control group to address potential seasonality in cognitive outcomes in a difference-in-differences framework. Our outcome measures are the standardized test scores from the national exams on the subjects of Danish, English, Math, and Science administered by the Danish Ministry of Education. Our results indicate that fetal exposure to Ramadan has a negative impact on the achievement scores of Muslim students, especially females. Our analysis further reveals that most of these effects are concentrated on the children with low socioeconomic status (SES) background. These results indicate that fetal insults such as exposure to malnutrition may not only hamper the cognitive development of children subject to such conditions, but it may also complicate the efforts of policy-makers in improving the human capital, health, and labor market outcomes of low-SES individuals. Our findings highlight the importance of interventions designed to help economically disadvantaged women during pregnancy.

10.3386/w21545.abstractZh: 本文探讨了胎儿营养不良对丹麦穆斯林学生学业成绩的影响。我们通过使用子宫内时期接触斋月这一自然实验来考察胎儿营养不良的内生性，假设一些穆斯林女性在怀孕期间可能曾在斋月期间禁食。在某些模型设定中，我们使用来自非穆斯林国家的学生样本作为额外的对照组，以处理认知结果可能存在的季节性差异。我们的结果指标是丹麦教育部组织的丹麦语、英语、数学和科学等科目的标准化考试成绩。研究结果表明，胎儿在斋月期间的暴露对穆斯林学生的成绩有负面影响，尤其是女性学生。进一步分析发现，这些影响主要集中在低社会经济地位背景的儿童身上。这些结果表明，如营养不良等胎儿损伤不仅可能阻碍处于此类条件下的儿童的认知发展，还可能使政策制定者在改善低社会经济地位个体的人力资本、健康状况和劳动力市场结果方面面临更多挑战。我们的研究强调了为经济弱势女性提供孕期干预措施的重要性。

abstract.text: Existing research has investigated the effect of early childhood educational interventions on the child’s later-life outcomes. These studies have found limited impact of supplementary programs on children’s cognitive skills, but sustained effects on personality traits. We examine how a positive change in unearned household income affects children’s emotional and behavioral health and personality traits. Our results indicate that there are large beneficial effects of improved household financial wellbeing on children’s emotional and behavioral health and positive personality trait development. Moreover, we find that these effects are most pronounced for children who are lagging behind their peers in these measures before the intervention. Increasing household incomes reduce differences across adolescents with different levels of initial emotional-behavioral symptoms and personality traits. We also examine potential channels through which the increased household income may contribute to these positive changes. Parenting and relationships within the family appear to be an important mechanism. We also find evidence that a sub-sample of the population moves to census tracts with better income levels and educational attainment.

10.3386/w21562.abstractZh: 现有研究探讨了早期儿童教育干预对儿童后期生活结果的影响。这些研究发现，补充性项目对儿童的认知技能影响有限，但对人格特质则有持续的影响。我们研究了家庭收入增加对儿童情绪与行为健康以及人格特质的正面影响。研究结果表明，家庭财务状况的改善对儿童的情绪与行为健康以及人格特质的积极发展具有显著的正面效果。此外，我们发现，对于那些在干预前在这些指标上落后于同龄人的儿童来说，这些效果尤为明显。家庭收入的增加减少了青少年之间在初始情绪行为症状及人格特质方面的差异。我们还探讨了家庭收入增加可能带来这些积极变化的潜在途径。父母教养方式及家庭内部关系似乎是一个重要的机制。此外，我们还发现，部分人口会迁移到收入水平更高、教育程度更高的社区。

abstract.text: This paper estimates the change in net (of subsidy) financial burden (“the price of responsibility”) and in welfare that would be experienced by a large nationally representative sample of the “non-poor” uninsured if they were to purchase Silver or Bronze plans on the ACA exchanges. The sample is the set of full-year uninsured persons represented in the Current Population Survey for the pre-ACA period with incomes above 138 percent of the federal poverty level. The estimated change in financial burden compares out-of-pocket payments by income stratum in the pre-ACA period with the sum of premiums (net of subsidy) and expected cost sharing (net of subsidy) for benchmark Silver and Bronze plans, under various assumptions about the extent of increased spending associated with obtaining coverage. In addition to changes in the financial burden, our welfare estimates incorporate the value of additional care consumed and the change in risk premiums for changes in exposure to out-of-pocket payments associated with coverage, under various assumptions about risk aversion. We find that the average financial burden will increase for all income levels once insured. Subsidy-eligible persons with incomes below 250 percent of the poverty threshold likely experience welfare improvements that offset the higher financial burden, depending on assumptions about risk aversion and the value of additional consumption of medical care. However, even under the most optimistic assumptions, close to half of the formerly uninsured (especially those with higher incomes) experience both higher financial burden and lower estimated welfare; indicating a positive “price of responsibility” for complying with the individual mandate. The percentage of the sample with estimated welfare increases is close to matching observed take-up rates by the previously uninsured in the exchanges.

10.3386/w21565.abstractZh: 本文估算了如果“非贫困人口”在ACA交换平台上购买银级或铜级保险，其净财务负担（“责任成本”）以及福利状况会发生怎样的变化。样本为在ACA实施前的当前人口调查中，收入超过联邦贫困线138%的全年无保险人群。估算的财务负担变化是将ACA实施前的自付费用与不同收入阶层的费用进行比较，同时考虑不同假设下，获得保险所带来的额外支出。除了财务负担的变化外，我们的福利估算还考虑了额外医疗服务的价值以及因保险覆盖而产生的风险溢价变化。研究发现，一旦参保，所有收入水平的人的平均财务负担都会增加。收入低于贫困线250%的符合条件的个人，其福利状况可能会得到改善，从而抵消较高的财务负担，但这取决于对风险规避性的假设以及额外医疗服务的价值。然而，即使在最乐观的假设下，仍有接近一半的原无保险人群（尤其是收入较高的人群）面临更高的财务负担和较低的福利状况，这表明遵守个人强制保险规定确实会带来一定的“责任成本”。在样本中，估计福利增加的百分比与之前未参保人员在交换中实际接受服务的比例大致一致。

abstract.text: Several countries rely on regulated health plan competition to combine affordability of health plans with incentives for cost containment and quality improvement. Typically, these policies include premium regulation supplemented with risk equalization to compensate health plans for predictable variation in medical spending. An extensive empirical literature shows, however, that even the state-of-the-art risk equalization models undercompensate some risk groups and overcompensate others, leaving systematic incentives for risk selection. A natural approach to reducing under or overcompensation for a group is to include membership in that group as an indicator in the risk equalization model. For several types of indicators, however, inclusion can be problematic or infeasible. This paper introduces and illustrates an alternative approach to reducing over or undercompensation in such cases: constraining the estimated coefficients of the risk equalization model so as to limit over or undercompensation. Our empirical illustration is based on administrative data on medical spending and risk characteristics of nearly all individuals with basic health insurance in the Netherlands. We evaluate empirically the benefits of constraints in terms of reduced under or overcompensation on indicators omitted from the Dutch risk equalization model and their costs in terms of increased under or overcompensation on indicators included in the model. Our findings imply that the benefits of introducing constraints can be worth the costs.
