Constrained regression adds a tool for developing risk equalization models that can improve the overall economic performance of health plan payment schemes.

10.3386/w21570.abstractZh: 一些国家通过规范的医疗计划竞争，将医疗计划的可负担性与成本控制及质量提升的激励措施相结合。通常，这些政策包括保费监管，并辅以风险均衡机制，以补偿医疗计划因医疗费用波动而产生的不确定性。然而，大量的实证研究表明，即使是最先进的风险均衡模型，也未能充分补偿某些风险群体，而过度补偿了其他群体，从而导致了系统性的风险选择激励。减少某一群体被过度或不足补偿的自然方法是，在风险均衡模型中将该群体的成员身份作为指标纳入。然而，对于某些类型的指标，这种纳入可能会存在问题或不可行。本文介绍了一种替代方法，用于减少此类情况下的过度或不足补偿：限制风险均衡模型的估计系数，从而限制过度或不足补偿的发生。我们的实证分析基于荷兰几乎所有基本医疗保险参保者的医疗支出和风险特征的相关行政数据。我们实证评估了在限制指标方面减少过度或不足补偿所带来的好处，以及模型中包含的指标导致过度或不足补偿所带来的成本。我们的研究发现表明，引入这些限制措施所带来的好处可能值得付出相应的成本。约束回归为开发能够改善医疗计划支付方案整体经济绩效的风险均衡模型提供了一种工具。

abstract.text: There is strong evidence that short-run fluctuations in air pollution negatively impact infant health and contemporaneous adult health, but there is less evidence on the causal link between long-term exposure to air pollution and increased adult mortality. This project estimates the impact of long-term exposure to air pollution on mortality by leveraging quasi-random variation in pollution levels generated by wind patterns near major highways. We combine geocoded data on the residence of every decedent in Los Angeles over three years, high-frequency wind data, and Census Short Form data. Using these data, we estimate the effect of downwind exposure to highway-generated pollutants on the age-specific mortality rate by using bearing to the nearest major highway as an instrument for pollution exposure. We find that doubling the percentage of time spent downwind of a highway increases mortality among individuals 75 and older by 3.6 to 6.8 percent. These estimates are robust and economically significant.

10.3386/w21578.abstractZh: 有强有力的证据表明，短期内空气污染波动会对婴儿健康和成人健康产生负面影响，但关于长期暴露于空气污染与成人死亡率增加之间的因果关系，证据则相对较少。本项目通过利用主要高速公路附近风型产生的污染水平准随机变化，来估算长期暴露于空气污染对死亡率的影响。我们结合了洛杉矶三年内每位逝者居住地的地理编码数据、高频风数据以及人口普查简表数据。利用这些数据，我们通过以最近的主要高速公路为风向作为污染暴露的指示器，来估算下风向暴露于高速公路产生的污染物对特定年龄死亡率的影响。研究发现，下风向高速公路的时间比例翻倍时，75岁及以上人群的死亡率会增加3.6%至6.8%。这些估计结果具有稳健性，并且在经济上具有重要意义。

abstract.text: The ranking of scientific journals is important because of the signal it sends to scientists about what is considered most vital for scientific progress. Existing ranking systems focus on measuring the influence of a scientific paper (citations)—these rankings do not reward journals for publishing innovative work that builds on new ideas. We propose an alternative ranking based on the proclivity of journals to publish papers that build on new ideas, and we implement this ranking via a text-based analysis of all published biomedical papers dating back to 1946. Our results show that our neophilia ranking is distinct from citation-based rankings. Prior theoretical work suggests an active role for our neophilia index in science policy. Absent an explicit incentive to pursue novel science, scientists under-invest in innovative work because of a coordination problem: for work on a new idea to flourish, many scientists must decide to adopt it in their work. Rankings that are based purely on influence thus do not provide sufficient incentives for publishing innovative work. By contrast, adoption of the neophilia index as part of journal-ranking procedures by funding agencies and university administrators would provide an explicit incentive for journals to publish innovative work and thus help solve the coordination problem by increasing scientists’ incentives to pursue innovative work.

10.3386/w21579.abstractZh: 科学期刊的排名非常重要，因为它向科学家传递了关于什么对科学进步最为重要的信号。现有的排名系统侧重于衡量科学论文的引用量——这些排名并不奖励那些基于新想法发表的创新性工作。我们提出了一种基于期刊倾向于发表基于新想法论文的替代性排名方法，并通过对1946年以来所有发表的生物医学论文进行文本分析来实现这一排名。我们的结果显示，基于新想法的排名与基于引用的排名有所不同。先前的理论研究表明，我们的新想法指数在科学政策中发挥着积极作用。如果没有明确的激励措施来推动创新研究，科学家就会因协调问题而忽视创新性工作：要想让基于新想法的研究蓬勃发展，许多科学家必须决定将其纳入自己的工作中。因此，仅基于影响力的排名并不能提供足够的激励来推动创新性工作的发表。相比之下，如果资助机构和大学管理者将新想法指数作为期刊排名的一部分，就能为期刊提供明确的激励，促使它们发表创新性工作，从而通过增加科学家追求创新工作的动力来解决协调问题。

abstract.text: There is substantial evidence on the impact of gaining insurance on healthcare service utilization and financing. Less is known about the effects of losing insurance. We study a large-scale and sudden Medicaid eligibility contraction in Tennessee in August 2005 to understand the impacts of losing Medicaid on the use and financing of hospitalizations. The use of Medicaid as the expected payer for hospitalizations fell by 27.6%, with some offsetting through other payers. The findings also suggest a 4.6% decline in overall hospital service utilization in Tennessee, though this coefficient estimate is only marginally statistically significant. These findings indicate that the substantial Medicaid coverage losses projected under recent federal legislation are likely to affect hospital care and its financing among Americans with lower incomes who rely on this program for insurance coverage.

10.3386/w21580.abstractZh: 有大量证据表明，获得保险对医疗服务的使用和融资有显著影响。而失去保险的影响则知之甚少。我们研究了2005年8月田纳西州发生的大规模、突然的医疗补助资格缩减情况，以了解失去医疗补助对住院服务的使用和融资的影响。以医疗补助作为住院的预期支付方的情况减少了27.6%，不过其他支付方在一定程度上弥补了这一损失。研究还显示，田纳西州的整体住院服务使用量下降了4.6%，尽管这一系数估计仅具有轻微的统计显著性。这些发现表明，根据最近的联邦立法，医疗补助的显著覆盖损失可能会影响到依赖该计划获得保险覆盖的低收入美国人的医院护理及其融资。

abstract.text: Models having multivariate probit and related structures arise often in applied health economics. When the outcome dimensions of such models are large, however, estimation can be challenging owing to numerical computation constraints and/or speed. This paper suggests the utility of estimating multivariate probit (MVP) models using a chain of bivariate probit estimators. The proposed approach offers two potential advantages over standard multivariate probit estimation procedures: significant reductions in computation time; and essentially unlimited dimensionality of the outcome set. The time savings arise because the proposed approach does not rely simulation methods; the dimension advantage arises because only pairs of outcomes are considered at each estimation stage. Importantly, the proposed approach provides a consistent estimator of all the MVP model's parameters under the same assumptions required for consistent estimation based on standard methods, and simulation exercises suggest no loss of estimator precision.

10.3386/w21593.abstractZh: 在应用性健康经济学中，常常会出现具有多变量Probit及相关结构的模型。然而，当这类模型的结果维度较大时，由于数值计算的限制和/或速度问题，估计过程可能会变得困难。本文提出了一种使用一系列双变量Probit估计器来估计多变量Probit模型的方案。与标准多变量Probit估计方法相比，该方法具有两个潜在优势：显著减少计算时间；以及结果集的维度几乎不受限制。之所以能节省时间，是因为该方法不依赖模拟方法；而维度优势则源于每个估计阶段仅考虑结果对。重要的是，该方法能够在基于标准方法进行一致估计所需的相同假设下，为所有多变量Probit模型参数提供一个一致的估计器，且模拟实验表明估计器的精度没有下降。

abstract.text: While less-educated women are more likely to give birth as teenagers, there is scant evidence the relationship is causal. We investigate this possibility using variation in compulsory schooling laws (CSLs) to identify the impact of formal education on teen fertility for a large sample of women drawn from multiple waves of the Canadian Census. We find that greater CSL-induced schooling reduces the probability of giving birth as a teenager by roughly two to three percentage points. We find evidence that education affects the timing of births in a way that strongly implies an “incarceration” effect of education. In particular, we find large negative impacts of education on births to young women aged seventeen and eighteen, but little evidence of an effect after these ages, consistent with the idea that being enrolled in school deters fertility in a contemporaneous manner. Our findings are robust to the inclusion of several province-level characteristics including multiple dimensions of school quality, expenditures on public programs and region-specific time trends.

10.3386/w21594.abstractZh: 虽然受教育程度较低的女性更有可能在青少年时期生育，但几乎没有证据表明这种关系是因果关系。我们通过研究不同省份的义务教育法律差异，来探讨正规教育对青少年生育率的影响。从加拿大人口普查的多轮数据中选取大量样本进行研究，发现更严格的义务教育法律会降低青少年生育的概率，大约降低两个到三个百分点。我们还发现，教育对生育时间的影响表明，教育具有“抑制生育”的作用。具体来说，我们发现教育对17岁和18岁的年轻女性生育有显著的负面影响，但在这些年龄之后，这种影响就较小了，这与学校教育能够同时抑制生育的观点一致。我们的研究结果在纳入多个省级特征后仍然保持稳定，包括学校质量的多个维度、公共项目的支出以及地区特定的时间趋势。

abstract.text: There is an increasing perception among policy makers that food stamp benefits contribute positively to adult obesity rates. We show that these results are heavily dependent on one's assumptions regarding the accuracy of reported food stamp participation. When allowing for misreporting, we find no evidence that SNAP participation significantly increases the probability of being obese or overweight among adults. Our results also highlight the inherent bias and inconsistency of common point estimates when ignoring misreporting, with treatment effects from instrumental variable methods exceeding the non-parametric upper bounds by over 200% in some cases.

10.3386/w21596.abstractZh: 政策制定者越来越意识到，食品券福利对成人肥胖率的负面影响。我们的研究表明，这些结果在很大程度上取决于人们对食品券参与情况的准确性假设。在考虑误报因素后，我们发现食品券参与并不会显著增加成年人肥胖或超重的概率。我们的结果还揭示了忽略误报时常见点估计方法的固有偏差和不一致性，在某些情况下，工具变量方法得出的处理效应比非参数上限高出200%以上。

abstract.text: Individuals with obesity often appear reluctant to undertake dietary changes. Evaluating the reasons for this reluctance, as well as appropriate policy responses, is hampered by a lack of data on behavioral response to dietary advice. I use household scanner data to estimate food purchase response to a diagnosis of diabetes, a common complication of obesity. I infer diabetes diagnosis within the scanner data from purchases of glucose testing products. Households engage in statistically significant but small calorie reductions following diagnosis. The changes are sufficient to lose 4 to 8 pounds in the first year, but are only about 10% of what would be suggested by a doctor. The scanner data allows detailed analysis of changes by food type. In the first month after diagnosis, healthy foods increase and unhealthy foods decrease. However, only the decreases in unhealthy food persist. Changes are most pronounced on large, unhealthy, food categories. Those individuals whose pre-diagnosis diet is concentrated in one or a few foods groups show bigger subsequent calorie reductions, with these reductions occurring primarily occurring in these largest food groups. I suggest the facts may be consistent with a psychological framework in which rule-based behavior change is more successful. I compare the results to a policy of taxes or subsidies.

10.3386/w21600.abstractZh: 肥胖人群往往不愿意进行饮食改变。要评估这种不愿改变的原因以及相应的政策响应，缺乏关于人们对饮食建议行为反应的数据。我利用家庭调查数据来估算糖尿病诊断后食品购买情况，糖尿病是肥胖的常见并发症。通过购买血糖测试产品，我在调查数据中推断出糖尿病的诊断。诊断后，家庭在热量摄入上出现了显著但较小的减少。这些改变足以在一年内减轻4到8磅体重，但仅约为医生建议的减少量的一半。调查数据允许对食品类型的改变进行详细分析。诊断后的第一个月，健康食品购买量增加，而不健康食品购买量减少。然而，只有不健康食品购买的减少持续存在。在大型、不健康食品类别上，变化最为明显。那些在诊断前饮食集中在某一或少数几个食品类别的人群，在随后的热量减少幅度更大，这些减少主要发生在这些最大的食品类别中。我认为这些现象可能与一种心理框架相符，即基于规则的行为改变更为有效。我将这些结果与税收或补贴政策进行了比较。

abstract.text: The conventional wisdom in health economics is that idiosyncratic features of the healthcare sector leave little scope for market forces to allocate consumers to higher performance producers. However, we find robust evidence across a variety of conditions and performance measures that higher quality hospitals tend to have higher market shares at a point in time and expand more over time. Moreover, we find that the relationship between performance and allocation is stronger among patients who have greater scope for hospital choice, suggesting a role for patient demand in allocation in the hospital sector. Our findings suggest that the healthcare sector may have more in common with “traditional” sectors subject to standard market forces than is often assumed.

10.3386/w21603.abstractZh: 在健康经济学领域，传统观点认为医疗行业的特殊性使得市场力量在将消费者分配到性能更高的医疗机构方面几乎没有作用。然而，我们在多种条件和绩效指标下发现了有力的证据：高质量的医院往往在某个时间点拥有更高的市场份额，并且随着时间的推移能够进一步扩张。此外，我们发现，在患者拥有更多选择医院机会的情况下，绩效与分配之间的关系更为紧密，这表明患者需求在医疗机构的分配中起着重要作用。我们的研究结果表明，医疗行业可能与“传统”行业有更多的共同点，这些行业受到标准的市场力量的影响。

abstract.text: This analysis summarizes prior research and uses national, state and county level data from the United States from 1976-2013 to examine whether the mortality effects of economic crises differ in kind from those of the more typical fluctuations. The tentative conclusion is that economic crises affect mortality rates (and presumably other measures of health) in the same way as less severe downturns: namely, they lead to improvements in physical health. The effects of severe national recessions in the United States, appear to have a beneficial effect on mortality that is roughly twice as strong as that predicted due to the elevated unemployment rates alone while the higher predicted rate of suicides during typical periods of economic weakness is approximately offset during severe recessions. No consistent pattern is obtained for more localized economic crises occurring at the state level – some estimates suggest larger protective mortality effects while others indicate offsetting deleterious consequences.

10.3386/w21604.abstractZh: 该分析总结了先前的研究，并使用了1976年至2013年美国国家级、州级和县级数据，以探讨经济危机对死亡率的影响是否与较为典型的经济波动有所不同。初步结论是，经济危机对死亡率（以及其他健康指标）的影响方式与较轻微的经济衰退相同：即它们能够改善身体健康状况。在美国，严重的经济衰退似乎对死亡率有积极的影响，其效果大约是仅因失业率上升所预测效果的两倍；而在经济疲软期间，较高的自杀率预计会有所上升，但在严重经济衰退期间，这种负面影响会被抵消。对于发生在州级的局部经济危机，并未发现一致的模式——一些估计表明其具有更大的保护性影响，而另一些则表明其带来的负面影响会被抵消。

abstract.text: Many studies suggest that years of formal schooling completed is the most important correlate of good health. There is much less consensus as to whether this correlation reflects causality from more schooling to better health. The relationship may be traced in part to reverse causality and may also reflect “omitted third variables” that cause health and schooling to vary in the same direction. The past five years (2010-2014) have witnessed the development of a large literature focusing on the issue just raised. I deal with that literature and what can be learned from it in this paper. I conclude that there is enough conflicting evidence in the studies that I have reviewed to warrant more research on the question of whether more schooling does in fact cause better health outcomes.

10.3386/w21609.abstractZh: 许多研究表明，完成多年的正规学校教育是健康的重要影响因素。然而，关于这种关联是否反映了从更多教育到更好健康的因果关系，目前尚无一致意见。这种关系可能部分是由于逆向因果关系造成的，也可能反映了“遗漏的第三变量”导致健康和教育在同一方向上变化。过去五年（2010-2014年）中，关于这一问题的研究文献得到了快速发展。本文探讨了这些文献以及从中可以得出的结论。我得出结论，在我所审查的研究中，存在足够多的矛盾证据，这要求进一步研究更多关于更多教育是否确实能带来更好健康结果的问题。

abstract.text: In many developed countries, children now begin their formal schooling at an older age. However, a growing body of empirical studies provides little evidence that such schooling delays improve educational and economic outcomes. This study presents new evidence on whether school starting age influences student outcomes by relying on linked Danish survey and register data that include several distinct, widely used, and validated measures of mental health that are reported out-of-school among similarly aged children. We estimate the causal effects of delayed school enrollment using a "fuzzy" regression-discontinuity design based on exact dates of birth and the fact that, in Denmark, children typically enroll in school during the calendar year in which they turn six. We find that a one-year delay in the start of school dramatically reduces inattention/hyperactivity at age 7 (effect size = -0.7), a measure of self regulation with strong negative links to student achievement. We also find that this large and targeted effect persists at age 11. However, the estimated effects of school starting age on other mental-health constructs, which have weaker links to subsequent student achievement, are smaller and less persistent.

10.3386/w21610.abstractZh: 在许多发达国家，儿童现在在较年长的年龄开始正式上学。然而，越来越多的实证研究并未证明这种上学延迟能够改善教育和经济成果。本研究通过利用丹麦的调查和登记数据，提出了关于入学年龄是否会影响学生表现的新证据。这些数据包含了多种被广泛使用且经过验证的心理健康指标，这些指标是在同龄儿童辍学后报告的。我们基于准确的出生日期，并考虑到在丹麦，儿童通常在满六岁的那一年开始上学，使用“模糊”回归-不连续设计来估计延迟入学所带来的因果效应。研究发现，入学年龄推迟一年会显著减少7岁时的注意力缺陷/多动症状（效应量=-0.7），而注意力缺陷/多动症状与学生的学业成绩有着强烈的负相关关系。此外，这一显著且有针对性的效应在11岁时仍然存在。然而，对于其他与学业成绩关联较弱的心理健康指标，入学年龄的效应则较小且不太持久。

abstract.text: Naturally-occurring yellow sand outbreaks, which are produced by winds flowing to Korea from China and Mongolia, create air pollution. Although there is seasonal pattern of this phenomenon, there exists substantial variation in its timing, strength and location from year to year. Thus, exposure to the intensity of air pollution exhibits significant randomness and unpredictability. To warn residents about air pollution in general, and about these dust storms in particular, Korean authorities issue different types of public alerts. Using birth certificate data on more than 1.5 million babies born between 2003 and 2011, we investigate the impact of air pollution, and the avoidance behavior triggered by pollution alerts on various birth outcomes. We find that exposure to air pollution during pregnancy has a significant negative impact on birth weight, the gestation weeks of the baby, and the propensity of the baby being low weight. Public alerts about air quality during pregnancy have a separate positive effect on fetal health. We show that Korean women do not time their pregnancy according to expected yellow dust exposure, and that educated women’s pregnancy timing is not different from those who are less-educated. The results provide evidence for the effectiveness of pollution alert systems in promoting public health. They also underline the importance of taking into account individuals’ avoidance behavior when estimating the impact of air quality on birth outcomes. Specifically, we show that the estimated impact of air pollution on infant health is reduced by half when the preventive effect of public health warnings is not accounted for.

10.3386/w21613.abstractZh: 自然发生的黄色沙尘暴是由从中国和中亚吹向韩国的风引起的，会导致空气污染。虽然这种现象存在季节性规律，但其发生时间、强度和地点每年都有所不同。因此，人们所面临的空气污染强度具有显著的随机性和不可预测性。为了提醒居民注意空气污染，尤其是这些沙尘暴，韩国当局会发布不同类型的公共警报。我们利用2003年至2011年间出生的150多万名婴儿的出生证明数据，研究空气污染的影响以及污染警报引发的避免行为对各种出生结果的影响。研究发现，孕期接触空气污染会对婴儿出生体重、妊娠周数以及低体重的出生风险产生显著的负面影响。关于孕期空气质量的公共警报对胎儿健康有积极的影响。我们发现，韩国女性并不会根据预期的黄色沙尘暴暴露时间来安排怀孕时间，而且受过教育的女性怀孕时间并不比受教育程度较低的女性有所不同。这些结果证明了污染警报系统在促进公共健康方面的有效性。同时，这些结果也强调了在评估空气质量对出生结果的影响时，需要考虑个人的避免行为。具体来说，我们发现，如果不考虑公共卫生警告的预防性作用，空气污染对婴儿健康的估计影响会减半。

abstract.text: A set of randomized experiments shed light on how markets and information influence household decisions to adopt nutritional innovations. Of 400 Indian villages, we randomly assigned half to an intervention where all shopkeepers were offered the option to sell a new salt, fortified with both iron and iodine (and not just iodine) at 50% discount. Within treatment villages, we conducted additional interventions: an increase in retailer margin (for one or several shopkeepers), the screening of an “edutainment” movie on the benefits of double-fortified salt, a flyer informing households of the product’s availability, and free distribution to a subset of households. We find that two interventions – showing the short film and offering an incentive to all shopkeepers – significantly increased usage: both by 5.5 percentage points, or over 50%, over take up without intervention, three years after launch. For comparison, only about half of households given the salt for free actually consumed it.

10.3386/w21616.abstractZh: 一系列随机实验揭示了市场和信息如何影响家庭对营养创新产品的采纳决策。在400个印度村庄中，我们随机将一半村庄纳入干预组，所有店主都有机会以50%的折扣销售一种添加了铁和碘（而不仅仅是碘）的新盐。在干预组内部，我们还实施了其他干预措施：提高零售商的利润空间（针对一个或多个店主）、放映一部关于双强化盐益处的“教育娱乐”电影、向家庭分发宣传该产品的传单，以及免费向部分家庭提供该产品。我们发现，通过放映短片并向所有店主提供激励措施这两项干预措施，使盐的使用率显著提高了5.5个百分点，超过了干预前的水平。相比之下，只有大约一半免费获得该盐的家庭真正使用了这种盐。

abstract.text: We explore the in- and out- of sample robustness of tests for consumer choice inconsistencies based on parameter restrictions in parametric models, with a focus on tests proposed by Ketcham, Kuminoff and Powers (2015). We start by arguing that non-parametric alternatives are inherently conservative with respect to detecting mistakes (and one specific test proposed by KKP is incorrect). We then consider several proposed robustness checks of parametric models and argue that they do not separately identify misspecification and choice inconsistencies. We also show that, when implemented using a comprehensive goodness of fit measure, the Keane and Wolpin (2007) test of out of sample forecasting demonstrates that a model allowing for choice inconsistencies forecasts substantially better than one that does not. Finally, we explore the robustness of our 2011 results to alternative normative assumptions.

10.3386/w21617.abstractZh: 我们探讨了基于参数模型中的参数限制来检验消费者选择不一致性的方法的样本内和样本外稳健性，重点关注Ketcham、Kuminoff和Powers在2015年提出的检验方法。我们首先指出，非参数替代方法在检测错误方面本质上更为保守（尤其是KKP提出的某个特定检验方法是不正确的）。接着，我们考虑了几种针对参数模型的稳健性检验方法，并认为这些方法无法单独识别模型误设和选择不一致问题。我们还展示了，当使用全面的拟合优度度量标准时，Keane和Wolpin在2007年提出的样本外预测检验表明，允许选择不一致性的模型比不允许的模型预测效果要好得多。最后，我们探讨了我们的2011年研究结果在替代规范假设下的稳健性。

abstract.text: Since 2012 the Congressional Budget Office has included an estimate of the market value of government-provided health insurance coverage in its measures of household income. We follow this practice for both public and private health insurance to capture the impact of greater access to government-provided health insurance for working-age people with disabilities, whose value rose in 2010 dollars from $11.7B in 1980 to $114.3B in 2012. We then consider the more general implications of incorporating estimates of the market price of insurance, equivalent to that provided by the government, into policy analyses in a post-Affordable Care Act world.

10.3386/w21629.abstractZh: 自2012年以来，国会预算办公室在其家庭收入统计中包含了政府提供的健康保险市场价值的估算。我们采用这一做法，无论是公共保险还是私人保险，都是为了捕捉政府提供的健康保险对残疾工作年龄人群的影响。这些保险的价值在2010年的美元价值上从1980年的117亿美元上升到了2012年的1143亿美元。接下来，我们考虑在《平价医疗法案》实施后的时代，将政府提供的保险市场价格的估算纳入政策分析中的更普遍意义。

abstract.text: Measuring consumer responsiveness to medical care prices is a central issue in health economics and a key ingredient in the optimal design and regulation of health insurance markets. We study consumer responsiveness to medical care prices, leveraging a natural experiment that occurred at a large self-insured firm which required all of its employees to switch from an insurance plan that provided free health care to a non-linear, high deductible plan. The switch caused a spending reduction between 11.79%-13.80% of total firm-wide health spending. We decompose this spending reduction into the components of (i) consumer price shopping (ii) quantity reductions and (iii) quantity substitutions, finding that spending reductions are entirely due to outright reductions in quantity. We find no evidence of consumers learning to price shop after two years in high-deductible coverage. Consumers reduce quantities across the spectrum of health care services, including potentially valuable care (e.g. preventive services) and potentially wasteful care (e.g. imaging services). We then leverage the unique data environment to study how consumers respond to the complex structure of the high-deductible contract. We find that consumers respond heavily to spot prices at the time of care, and reduce their spending by 42% when under the deductible, conditional on their true expected end-of-year shadow price and their prior year end-of-year marginal price. In the first-year post plan change, 90% of all spending reductions occur in months that consumers began under the deductible, with 49% of all reductions coming for the ex ante sickest half of consumers under the deductible, despite the fact that these consumers have quite low shadow prices. There is no evidence of learning to respond to the true shadow price in the second year post-switch.

10.3386/w21632.abstractZh: 衡量消费者对医疗价格的反应是健康经济学中的一个核心问题，也是设计和优化医疗保险市场的关键要素。我们研究了消费者对医疗价格的反应，通过一项在一家大型自保公司发生的自然实验来进行研究。该公司在要求所有员工从提供免费医疗的保险计划转向采用高免赔额、非线性的保险计划后，发现总医疗支出减少了11.79%至13.80%。我们将这一支出减少分解为以下三个部分：(i)消费者价格选择；(ii)数量减少；(iii)数量替代。研究发现，支出减少完全是由于数量的直接减少。我们没有发现消费者在高免赔额保险覆盖两年后学会了价格选择的行为。消费者在各类医疗服务中减少了消费，包括可能具有价值的服务（如预防服务）和可能浪费的服务（如影像服务）。然后，我们利用独特的数据环境来研究消费者对高免赔额合同复杂结构的反应。我们发现，消费者在就医时非常关注即时价格，在免赔额条件下，他们的支出减少了42%，这一结果基于他们真实的预期年末影子价格以及前一年的年末边际价格。在计划变更后的第一年，90%的支出减少发生在消费者开始享受免赔额服务的月份，其中49%的减少发生在原本最健康的消费者身上，尽管这些消费者的影子价格相当低。在第二年，没有证据表明消费者学会了根据真实的影子价格做出反应。

abstract.text: Advances in the study of partial identification allow applied researchers to learn about parameters of interest without making assumptions needed to guarantee point identification. We discuss the roles that assumptions and data play in partial identification analysis, with the goal of providing information to applied researchers that can help them employ these methods in practice. To this end, we present a sample of econometric models that have been used in a variety of recent applications where parameters of interest are partially identified, highlighting common features and themes across these papers. In addition, in order to help illustrate the combined roles of data and assumptions, we present numerical illustrations for a particular application, the joint determination of wages and labor supply. Finally we discuss the benefits and challenges of using partially identifying models in empirical work and point to possible avenues of future research.

10.3386/w21641.abstractZh: 在部分识别研究方面的进展使得应用研究人员能够在不做假设以保证点识别的情况下，了解感兴趣的参数。我们讨论了假设和数据在部分识别分析中的作用，旨在为应用研究人员提供信息，帮助他们在实际工作中运用这些方法。为此，我们展示了一组在最近的应用中被使用的计量经济模型样本，这些模型中的参数被部分识别，同时强调了这些论文中的共同特征和主题。此外，为了帮助说明数据和假设的结合作用，我们为一个特定应用——工资和劳动力供给的联合确定——提供了数值示例。最后，我们讨论了在实证工作中使用部分识别模型的好处和挑战，并指出了未来研究的可能方向。

abstract.text: Why do private insurers closely link their physician payment rates to the Medicare fee schedule despite its well-known limitations? We ask to what extent this relationship reflects the use of Medicare's relative price menu as a benchmark, in order to reduce transaction costs in a complex pricing environment. We analyze 91 million claims from a large private insurer, which represent $7.8 billion in spending over four years. We estimate that 75 percent of services, accounting for 55 percent of spending, are benchmarked to Medicare's relative prices. The Medicare-benchmarked share is higher for services provided by small physician groups. It is lower for capital-intensive treatment categories, for which Medicare's average-cost reimbursements deviate most from marginal cost. When the insurer deviates from Medicare's relative prices, it adjusts towards the marginal costs of treatment. Our results suggest that providers and private insurers coordinate around Medicare's menu of relative payments for simplicity, but innovate when the value of doing so is likely highest.

10.3386/w21642.abstractZh: 为什么私人保险公司会将医生薪酬与Medicare的收费标准紧密联系起来，尽管后者存在众所周知的局限性？我们探讨这种关系在多大程度上反映了将Medicare的相对价格体系作为基准的做法，以此来降低复杂定价环境中的交易成本。我们分析了来自一家大型私人保险公司的9100万份索赔记录，这些记录代表了四年期间78亿美元的支出。我们估计，有75%的服务费用是根据Medicare的相对价格来确定的，这些服务占总支出的55%。对于由小型医生团队提供的服务，以Medicare的相对价格作为基准的比例更高。而对于资本密集型治疗类别，这一比例则较低，因为这些类别的Medicare的平均成本报销与边际成本存在较大偏差。当保险公司偏离Medicare的相对价格时，它会调整至治疗的边际成本。我们的研究结果表明，医疗服务提供者和私人保险公司为了简单起见，会围绕Medicare的相对价格体系进行协调，但在这种做法可能带来最大价值的时刻，他们会进行创新。

abstract.text: In order to better understand what threatens vulnerable populations’ access to primary care, it is important to understand the factors associated with closing safety-net clinics. This paper examines how a clinic’s financial position, productivity, and community characteristics are associated with its risk of closure. We examine patterns of closures among private-run primary care clinics (PCCs) in California between 2006 and 2012. We use a discrete-time proportional hazard model to assess relative hazard ratios of covariates, and a random-effect hazard model to adjust for unobserved heterogeneity among PCCs. We find that lower net income from patient care, smaller amount of government grants, and lower productivity were associated with significantly higher risk of PCC closure. We also find that federally qualified health centers (FQHCs) and non-FQHCs generally faced the same risk factors of closure. These results underscore the critical role of financial incentives in the long-term viability of safety-net clinics.

10.3386/w21648.abstractZh: 为了更好地理解哪些因素威胁到弱势人群获得初级保健服务的机会，了解导致安全网诊所关闭的相关因素至关重要。本文研究了诊所的财务状况、运营效率以及社区特征与其关闭风险之间的关系。我们研究了2006年至2012年间加州私营初级保健诊所的关闭情况，并使用离散时间比例风险模型来评估各变量的相对风险比，同时采用随机效应风险模型来校正不同诊所之间的异质性。研究发现，来自患者护理的净收入较低、政府拨款较少以及运营效率低下与初级保健诊所关闭风险显著增加有关。此外，联邦认证健康中心和非联邦认证健康中心在关闭风险方面通常面临相同的因素。这些结果强调了财务激励在确保安全网诊所长期生存中的关键作用。

abstract.text: There is considerable controversy over the use of private insurers to deliver public health insurance benefits. We investigate the efficiency consequences of patients enrolling in Medicare Advantage (MA), private managed care organizations that compete with the traditional fee-for-service Medicare program. We use exogenous shocks to MA enrollment arising from plan exits from New York counties in the early 2000s, and utilize unique data that links hospital inpatient utilization to Medicare enrollment records. We find that individuals who were forced out of MA plans due to plan exit saw very large increases in hospital utilization. These increases appear to arise through plans both limiting access to nearby hospitals and reducing elective admissions, yet they are not associated with any measurable reduction in hospital quality or patient mortality.

10.3386/w21650.abstractZh: 关于使用私人保险公司提供公共健康保险福利的问题，存在相当大的争议。我们研究了患者加入Medicare Advantage计划（一种与传统的按服务收费的Medicare计划竞争的私人管理式护理组织）所带来的效率影响。我们通过2000年代初纽约县计划退出事件对Medicare Advantage计划的注册情况施加了外部冲击，并利用将医院住院使用率与Medicare注册记录联系起来的独特数据进行分析。我们发现，由于计划退出而被迫离开Medicare Advantage计划的个体，其医院使用率出现了显著上升。这种上升似乎既是因为这些计划限制了患者使用附近医院的途径，也因为减少了选择性住院的情况，但并未伴随医院质量或患者死亡率的任何可测量下降。

abstract.text: Policymakers are increasingly interested in reducing healthcare costs and inefficiencies through innovative payment strategies. These strategies may have heterogeneous impacts across geographic areas, potentially reducing or exacerbating geographic variation in healthcare spending. In this paper, we exploit a major payment reform for home health care to examine whether reductions in reimbursement lead to differential changes in treatment intensity and provider costs depending on the level of competition in a market. Using Medicare claims, we find that while providers in more competitive markets had higher average costs in the pre-reform period, these markets experienced larger proportional reductions in treatment intensity and costs after the reform relative to less competitive markets. This led to a convergence in spending across geographic areas. We find that much of the reduction in provider costs is driven by greater exit of “high-cost” providers in more competitive markets.

10.3386/w21654.abstractZh: 政策制定者越来越关注通过创新的支付策略来降低医疗保健成本和低效性。这些策略在不同地理区域可能会产生不同的影响，可能会减少或加剧医疗保健支出的地域差异。在本文中，我们以家庭健康护理的支付改革为例，研究报销金额的减少是否会导致治疗强度和提供者成本的变化因市场的竞争程度而异。通过利用Medicare的索赔数据，我们发现，在改革前，竞争更激烈的市场中的提供者平均成本更高，但改革后，这些市场的治疗强度和成本比例都比竞争较弱的市场有所减少。这导致各地理区域的支出趋于一致。我们发现，提供者成本的降低很大程度上是由于在竞争更激烈的市场中，“高成本”提供者的退出率更高所导致的。

abstract.text: We compare student academic performance in traditional twice-a-week and compressed once-a-week lecture formats in introductory microeconomics between one semester in which students were randomly assigned into the formats and another semester when students were allowed to choose their format. In each semester we offered the same course with the sections taught at the same times in the same classrooms by the same professors using the same book, software and lecture slides. Our study design is modeled after a doubly randomized preference trial (DRPT), which provides insights regarding external validity beyond what is possible from a single randomized study. Our goal is to assess whether having a choice modifies the treatment effect of format. Students in the compressed format of the randomized arm of the study scored -0.19 standard deviations less on the combined midterm and final (p<.01) and -0.14 standard deviation less in choice arm (p<.01). There was little evidence of selection bias in choice of format. Future analyses of online learning formats employing randomization should consider DRPT designs to enhance the generalizability of results.

10.3386/w21656.abstractZh: 我们比较了传统每周两次和压缩每周一次授课形式在入门微观经济学课程中的学生学业表现。在第一次学期中，学生被随机分配到这两种授课形式中，而在第二次学期中，学生可以选择自己的授课形式。在这两个学期中，我们提供了相同的课程，由相同的教授在同一时间、同一教室使用相同的教材、软件和幻灯片进行授课。我们的研究设计借鉴了双重随机偏好试验（DRPT）的方法，这种方法能够提供更深入的关于外部效度的见解，而这些见解是单一随机研究无法提供的。我们的目标是评估选择授课形式是否会影响授课效果。在随机实验的压缩授课形式中，学生的期中成绩和期末成绩平均相差-0.19标准差（p<.01），而在选择授课形式的学生中，成绩相差-0.14标准差（p<.01）。在选择授课形式方面，几乎没有选择偏差的迹象。未来对在线学习形式的分析应考虑使用DRPT设计，以提高结果的普适性。

abstract.text: We investigate whether patents on human genes have affected follow-on scientific research and product development. Using administrative data on successful and unsuccessful patent applications submitted to the US Patent and Trademark Office, we link the exact gene sequences claimed in each application with data measuring follow-on scientific research and commercial investments. Using this data, we document novel evidence of selection into patenting: patented genes appear more valuable—prior to being patented—than non-patented genes. This evidence of selection motivates two quasi-experimental approaches, both of which suggest that on average gene patents have had no quantitatively important effect on follow-on innovation.

10.3386/w21666.abstractZh: 我们研究了人类基因专利是否影响了后续科学研究和产品开发。通过美国专利商标局提供的成功与失败的专利申请数据，我们将每项申请中声称的精确基因序列与衡量后续科学研究和商业投资的数据进行了关联。利用这些数据，我们发现了一个新的选择机制：在获得专利之前，被专利化的基因比未被专利化的基因更具价值。这一选择机制促使我们采用了两种准实验方法，这两种方法均表明，总体而言，基因专利对后续创新并没有产生显著的定量影响。

abstract.text: Pharmaceutical firms currently spend over $4 billion on direct-to-consumer advertising (DTCA) of prescription drugs, a nearly 30-fold increase since 1993 that has led to much debate about its value to patients. We examine how DTCA influences drug utilization along the extensive and intensive margins by exploiting a large and plausibly exogenous shock to DTCA driven by the introduction of Medicare Part D in 2006. Using data on advertising for local media markets from Nielsen, we show that Part D led to large relative increases in DTCA in geographic areas with a high concentration of Medicare beneficiaries compared to areas with a low concentration. We examine the effects of this sudden differential increase in advertising on non-elderly individuals to isolate the effects of advertising on drug utilization from the direct effects of Part D. Using data from pharmacy claims, we find substantial differential increases in drug utilization that mirror the increases in DTCA after Part D. These effects are driven both by increased take-up of treatment and improved drug adherence. Our results imply significant spillovers from Medicare Part D onto the under-65 population and an important role for non-price factors in influencing prescription drug utilization.

10.3386/w21714.abstractZh: 制药公司目前在处方药的直接面向消费者广告上投入了超过40亿美元，这一数字自1993年以来增加了近30倍，引发了关于其对患者价值的广泛讨论。我们通过利用2006年医疗保险D部分引入后对直接面向消费者广告的显著影响，来研究这种广告方式如何影响药物的使用情况，尤其是在广泛和密集的药品市场中。利用Nielsen提供的当地媒体市场广告数据，我们发现，在医疗保险受益人数量较多的地区，与受益人数量较少的地区相比，D部分的引入导致了直接面向消费者广告的显著增加。我们进一步研究了这种突然增加的广告对非老年人个体的影响，以分离出广告对药物使用的影响与D部分直接带来的影响。通过药房索赔数据，我们发现药物使用的增加与直接面向消费者广告的增加相呼应。这些影响既源于治疗方式的增加，也源于药物依从性的改善。我们的研究结果表明，医疗保险D部分对65岁以下人群有显著的溢出效应，并且非价格因素在影响处方药使用方面起着重要作用。

abstract.text: We conduct the first study on the impacts of prenatal exposure to a uniquely identified large polluter, a coal-fired power plant located near the border of two states, on the birth outcomes of the downwind state. For mothers who live as far as 20 to 40 miles away but downwind of the power plant, being exposed to power plant emissions, in particular sulfur dioxide, during the first month of pregnancy could increase the likelihood of having full-term babies but with low birth weight, an indicator of slow fetal growth, by as much as 42 percent. This adverse impact could be driven by reactive sulfur species-induced intrauterine oxidative stress, arising from maternal exposure to emissions of sulfur dioxide, whose travelling from the emission source to the downwind region has been confirmed in the Portland Rule. In light of EPA’s continual efforts in regulating power plant emissions, our study is aimed at broadening the scope of cross-border pollution analysis by taking into account adverse infant heath impacts from upwind polluters, which can burden the downwind states disproportionately.

10.3386/w21723.abstractZh: 我们进行了首次研究，探讨了一个特定大型污染源——位于两个州边界附近的燃煤发电厂——在产前暴露对其下风州出生结果的影响。对于居住在距离发电厂20至40英里范围内但处于下风方向地区的母亲来说，在妊娠第一个月暴露于发电厂排放物，尤其是二氧化硫，可能会使她们生育足月婴儿但出生体重偏低的可能性增加42%。这种不良影响可能是由于母体暴露于二氧化硫排放物后，在子宫内产生的活性硫物种引起的氧化应激所致。波特兰规则已经证实了二氧化硫从排放源传播到下风区域的过程。鉴于美国环保署持续努力监管发电厂排放物，我们的研究旨在扩大跨境污染分析的范围，考虑来自上风污染源对婴儿健康的负面影响，因为这些影响可能会不成比例地影响下风州。

abstract.text: One of the main purposes of the Patient Protection and Affordable Care Act (ACA) is to enable Americans to make more productive use of their time. This is apparent in the rationale given for the ACA’s extension of dependent care coverage, which requires employer-sponsored insurance plans that cover the children of insured workers to continue to cover these dependents until they turn 26. While a number of studies have examined the effect of the ACA’s dependent coverage provision on work, none that we are aware has examined other uses of time. If, as predicted, the provision reduced the amount of time young adults work, the question arises, what have these young adults done with this time? A related question is whether the change has made them better off. We use the American Time Use Survey (2003-2013) to assess how the ACA’s dependent coverage mandate has affected labor supply among young adults, and to provide some of the first evidence on time use other than working, such as educational activities, obtaining medical care, and pursuing leisure activities. Estimates suggest that the ACA’s dependent coverage provision has reduced labor supply and job-lock, as well as the duration of the average doctor’s visit, including time spent waiting for and receiving medical care, among persons ages 19-25. The latter effect is consistent with a substitution from hospital ER utilization to greater routine physician care. The extra time has gone into socializing, and to a lesser extent, into education and job search. Availability of insurance and change in work time appear to have increased young adults’ subjective well-being, enabling them to spend time on activities they view as more meaningful than those they did before insurance became available.

10.3386/w21725.abstractZh: 《患者保护与可负担医疗保健法案》的主要目的之一，是让美国人能够更高效地利用时间。这一点在法案延长 Dependent Care 覆盖范围的理由中表现得非常明显。该法案要求雇主提供的保险计划必须覆盖被保险工人的子女，并持续覆盖这些受抚养人直至他们年满 26 岁。虽然已有多项研究探讨了《患者保护与可负担医疗保健法案》中关于 Dependent Care 条款对工作时间的影响，但据我们所知，尚未有研究探讨时间利用的其他方面。如果如预期那样，该条款减少了年轻人的工作时间，那么问题来了：这些年轻人将这段时间用于了什么？另一个相关的问题是，这一变化是否让他们生活得更好。我们利用《美国时间利用调查》的数据（2003-2013 年）来评估《患者保护与可负担医疗保健法案》中关于 Dependent Care 的强制规定对年轻人劳动力供应的影响，并首次提供了关于时间利用的其他方面的数据，例如教育活动、获取医疗服务以及休闲活动。估计结果显示，《患者保护与可负担医疗保健法案》中关于 Dependent Care 的条款减少了年轻人的劳动力供应和就业锁定现象，同时也缩短了平均就诊时间，包括等待和接受医疗服务的时间。后一种影响与从医院急诊就诊转向更常规的医生护理有关。额外的时间被用于社交活动，以及在较小程度上用于教育和求职。保险的可获得性和工作时间的改变似乎提升了年轻人的主观幸福感，使他们能够把时间花在他们认为比在保险普及之前更有意义的活动上。

abstract.text: We exploit recent molecular genetics evidence on the genetic basis of arsenic excretion and unique information on family links among respondents living in different environments from a large panel survey within a theoretical framework incorporating optimizing behavior to uncover the hidden costs of arsenic poisoning in Bangladesh. We provide for the first time estimates of the effects of the ingestion and retention of inorganic arsenic on direct measures of cognitive and physical capabilities as well as on the schooling attainment, occupational structure, entrepreneurship and incomes of the rural Bangladesh population. We also provide new estimates of the effects of the consumption of foods grown and cooked in arsenic-contaminated water on individual arsenic concentrations. The estimates are based on arsenic biomarkers obtained from a sample of members of rural households in Bangladesh who are participants in a long-term panel survey following respondents and their coresident household members over a period of 26 years.

10.3386/w21741.abstractZh: 我们利用最新的分子遗传学证据来研究砷排泄的遗传基础，并结合大规模面板调查中关于不同环境下居民之间家庭关系的独特信息，以及优化行为的理论框架，以揭示孟加拉国砷中毒的隐性成本。我们首次估算了无机砷的摄入和滞留对孟加拉国农村人口认知和体力能力、教育水平、职业结构、创业能力和收入的直接影响。我们还提供了关于在含砷水中种植和烹饪的食物对个体砷浓度的新估算结果。这些估算基于从孟加拉国农村家庭样本中获得的砷生物标志物数据，这些样本是长期面板调查的一部分，对受访者及其核心家庭成员进行了26年的跟踪研究。

abstract.text: Recent research suggests that parental job loss has negative effects on children's outcomes, including their academic achievement and long-run educational and labor market outcomes. In this paper we turn our attention to the effects of parental job loss on children's health. We combine health data from 16 waves of the Medical Expenditure Panel Survey, which allows us to use a fixed effects specification and still have a large sample of parental job displacements. We find that paternal job loss is detrimental to the physical and mental health of children in low-socioeconomic status (SES) families, increasing their incidence of injuries and mental disorders. We separately find that maternal job loss leads to reductions in the incidence of infectious illness among children in high-SES families, possibly resulting from substitution of maternal care for market-based childcare services. Increases in public health insurance coverage compensate for a large share of the loss in private coverage that follows parental displacement, and we find no significant changes in routine or diagnostic medical care.

10.3386/w21745.abstractZh: 近期研究表明，父母失业会对子女的成长产生负面影响，包括他们的学业成绩以及长期的教育和劳动力市场表现。在本文中，我们重点关注父母失业对子女健康的影响。我们结合《医疗支出面板调查》的16个数据波期的健康数据，从而能够采用固定效应模型进行分析，同时仍拥有大量父母失业的样本数据。研究发现，父亲失业会对低社会经济地位家庭中的儿童的身体和心理健康造成不利影响，增加儿童受伤和精神障碍的发生几率。此外，我们还发现，母亲失业会导致高社会经济地位家庭中的儿童传染病发病率下降，这可能是由于母亲提供的照顾替代了市场化的儿童保育服务所致。公共健康保险覆盖率的提高可以弥补父母失业后私人保险覆盖率的较大损失，而常规或诊断性医疗服务的状况则没有显著变化。

abstract.text: A large literature has analyzed pricing inefficiencies in health insurance markets due to adverse selection, typically assuming informed, active consumers on the demand side of the market. However, recent evidence suggests that many consumers have information frictions that lead to suboptimal health plan choices. As a result, policies such as information provision, plan recommendations, and smart defaults to improve consumer choices are being implemented in many applied contexts. In this paper we develop a general framework to study insurance market equilibrium and evaluate policy interventions in the presence of choice frictions. Friction-reducing policies can increase welfare by facilitating better matches between consumers and plans, but can decrease welfare by increasing the correlation between willingness-to-pay and costs, exacerbating adverse selection. We identify relationships between the underlying distributions of consumer (i) costs (ii) surplus from risk protection and (iii) choice frictions that determine whether friction-reducing policies will be on net welfare increasing or reducing. We extend the analysis to study how policies to improve consumer choices interact with the supply-side policy of risk-adjustment transfers and show that the effectiveness of the latter policy can have important implications for the effectiveness of the former. We implement the model empirically using proprietary data on insurance choices, utilization, and consumer information from a large firm. We leverage structural estimates from prior work with these data and highlight how the model's micro-foundations can be estimated in practice. In our specific setting, we find that friction-reducing policies exacerbate adverse selection, essentially leading to the market fully unraveling, and reduce welfare. Risk-adjustment transfers are complementary, substantially mitigating the negative impact of friction-reducing policies, but having little effect in their absence.

10.3386/w21759.abstractZh: 大量文献分析了由于逆向选择导致的健康保险市场定价效率低下问题，通常假设需求方有信息充分、积极活跃的消费者。然而，最新证据表明，许多消费者存在信息障碍，导致健康计划选择不尽理想。因此，诸如提供信息、推荐计划以及实施智能默认设置等政策被应用于许多实际场景中，以改善消费者的选择。在本文中，我们构建了一个通用框架来研究保险市场均衡，并评估在选择障碍存在的情况下政策干预的效果。减少摩擦的政策可以通过促进消费者与计划之间的更好匹配来提高福利，但也可能通过增加支付意愿与成本之间的相关性而降低福利，从而加剧逆向选择问题。我们确定了消费者成本、风险保护带来的收益以及选择障碍之间的关联，这些关联决定了减少摩擦的政策是会增加还是减少净福利。我们进一步分析了改善消费者选择的政策与风险调整转移等供应侧政策之间的相互作用，并发现后者的有效性对前者的效果有重要影响。我们利用一家大型公司的专有数据，对保险选择、使用情况以及消费者信息进行了实证分析。我们利用了先前研究中的结构估计数据，并强调了如何在实践中估算模型的微观基础。在我们的具体情境下，我们发现减少摩擦的政策会加剧逆向选择问题，最终导致市场完全崩溃，并降低福利水平。风险调整转移措施是互补的，能够显著减轻减少摩擦政策带来的负面影响，但在这些措施缺失的情况下，其效果有限。

abstract.text: We use Danish diabetes registry and health insurance data to analyze the extent, consequences, and determinants of under-use and overuse of oral anti-diabetic drugs. Less than half of patients consume the appropriate amount of medication--between 90% and 110% of the amount prescribed by their doctors. The life expectancy of patients consuming the appropriate amount is 2.5 years greater than that of patients consuming less than 70% of the prescribed amount, and 3.2 years greater than that of patients consuming more than 130% of the prescribed amount, controlling for time since diagnosis, insulin dependence, comorbidities, age, gender and education. Patients consuming the appropriate amount are also less likely to be hospitalized than under- or over-users. Pharmaceutical innovation appears to have reduced medication under-use and overuse: patients using newer drugs are significantly more likely to consume the appropriate amount, controlling for socioeconomic factors, average number of pills and average daily out-of-pocket costs. Defined Daily Doses published by the World Health Organization substantially overstate the appropriate level of consumption of these medications. Patients who don’t adhere to recommended medication regimens may also disregard other physician instructions. Medication under-use and overuse could easily be monitored to identify patients at risk and enact interventions.

10.3386/w21780.abstractZh: 我们利用丹麦糖尿病登记处和健康保险数据来分析口服抗糖尿病药物使用不足和过度使用的程度、后果及其决定因素。不到一半的患者能够按照医生处方剂量正确用药——其用药量在医生处方剂量的90%到110%之间。与用药量低于处方剂量的患者相比，正确用药的患者预期寿命增加2.5年；与用药量超过处方剂量130%的患者相比，预期寿命增加3.2年。这一差异在控制诊断时间、胰岛素依赖、合并症、年龄、性别和教育水平等因素后仍然显著。正确用药的患者住院的可能性也低于使用不足或过度用药的患者。药品创新似乎减少了药物使用不足和过度使用的现象：使用新型药物的患者在控制社会经济因素、平均服药数量和平均每日自付费用后，正确用药的可能性显著更高。世界卫生组织发布的每日限定剂量数据明显高估了这些药物的适当用药量。不遵循推荐用药方案的患者也可能忽视其他医生的指示。通过监测药物使用不足和过度使用的现象，可以及时发现高风险患者并采取干预措施。

abstract.text: Insurance plan design has important implications for consumer welfare. In this paper, we model insurance design in the Medicare prescription drug coverage market and show that strategic private insurer incentives impose a fiscal externality on the traditional Medicare program. We document that plans covering medical expenses have more generous drug coverage than plans that are only responsible for prescription drug spending, which translates into higher drug utilization by enrollees. The effect is driven by drugs that reduce medical expenditure and treat chronic conditions. Our equilibrium model of plan design endogenizes plan characteristics and accounts for selection; the model estimates confirm that differential incentives to internalize medical care offsets can explain disparities across plans. Counterfactuals show that strategic insurer incentives are as important as selection in determining endogenous plan characteristics.

10.3386/w21783.abstractZh: 保险计划设计对消费者福利具有重要影响。在本文中，我们对医疗保险处方药物覆盖市场中的保险设计进行了建模，并表明战略性私人保险公司的激励措施对传统医疗保险计划产生了财政外部性。我们发现，涵盖医疗费用的保险计划比仅负责处方药物支出的计划具有更全面的药物覆盖，这导致参保人的药物使用率更高。这种效应主要源于能够减少医疗开支并治疗慢性疾病的药物。我们的计划设计均衡模型能够内生化计划特征，并解释选择因素；模型估计结果表明，内部化医疗服务的不同激励措施可以解释不同计划之间的差异。反事实分析表明，战略性保险公司的激励措施与选择因素一样，在决定计划内生特征方面起着重要作用。

abstract.text: The FDA is considering using its regulatory authority over the tobacco industry to promote public health by restricting the advertising of menthol cigarettes. In this paper we contribute new empirical evidence on the effects of magazine advertisements for menthol cigarettes on cigarette demand. Unlike previous research on cigarette advertising and demand, we use individual-level data and a measure of advertising exposure based on each consumer’s magazine-reading habits. These data allow us to control for individual heterogeneity that influences both advertising exposure and cigarette demand. We exploit quasi-experimental variation in advertising exposure in the 2000s created by sharply different supply-side variation in menthol and non-menthol advertising. We examine the importance of controlling for heterogeneity by estimating simple models relating advertising exposure to behavior and then adding specifications that take advantage of the richness of our individual-level data. We examine advertising effects on multiple margins of cigarette demand. Our empirical results do not provide any evidence that menthol advertising in magazines affects cigarette demand at various margins: the probability of menthol use; smoking participation; the number of cigarettes smoked per day; the probability of a past-year quit attempt; and anti-smoking attitudes among teens.

10.3386/w21790.abstractZh: 美国食品药品监督管理局正在考虑利用其对烟草行业的监管权力，通过限制薄荷烟的广告投放来促进公众健康。在本文中，我们提供了关于薄荷烟杂志广告对香烟需求影响的新实证证据。与以往关于香烟广告和需求的研究不同，我们使用了个体层面的数据，并基于每个消费者的杂志阅读习惯来衡量广告曝光程度。这些数据使我们能够控制影响广告曝光和香烟需求的个体异质性。我们利用2000年代因薄荷烟与非薄荷烟广告在供应方面存在显著差异而产生的广告曝光方面的准实验变化。我们通过估计将广告曝光与行为相关的简单模型，并添加利用个体层面数据丰富性的模型参数，来考察控制异质性的重要性。我们研究了广告对香烟需求多个方面的影响。我们的实证结果并未表明杂志中的薄荷烟广告会影响香烟需求的各个方面：包括使用薄荷烟的概率、吸烟参与度、每天吸烟数量、过去一年戒烟尝试的概率以及青少年中的反吸烟态度等。

abstract.text: Demand for insurance can be driven by high risk aversion or high risk. We show how to separately identify risk preferences and risk types using only choices from menus of insurance plans. Our revealed preference approach does not rely on rational expectations, nor does it require access to claims data. We show what can be learned non-parametrically from variation in insurance plans, offered separately to random cross-sections or offered as part of the same menu to one cross-section. We prove that our approach allows for full identification in the textbook model with binary risks and extend our results to continuous risks. We illustrate our approach using the Massachusetts Health Insurance Exchange, where choices provide informative bounds on the type distributions, especially for risks, but do not allow us to reject homogeneity in preferences.

10.3386/w21797.abstractZh: 保险需求可能由高风险厌恶或高风险驱动。我们展示了如何仅通过保险计划菜单中的选择来分别识别风险偏好和风险类型。我们的显示偏好方法不依赖于理性预期，也不需要访问索赔数据。我们展示了如何从保险计划的差异中非参数地获取信息，这些计划可以分别提供给随机样本，也可以作为同一菜单的一部分提供给一个样本。我们证明，我们的方法在具有二元风险的教科书模型中能够实现完全识别，并将我们的结果扩展到连续风险。我们使用马萨诸塞州健康保险交易所的数据来说明我们的方法，这些数据提供了关于风险类型分布的信息，但并未使我们能够排除偏好的一致性。

abstract.text: We use insurance claims data covering 28 percent of individuals with employer-sponsored health insurance in the US to study the variation in health spending on the privately insured, examine the structure of insurer-hospital contracts, and analyze the variation in hospital prices across the nation. Health spending per privately insured beneficiary differs by a factor of three across geographic areas and has a very low correlation with Medicare spending. For the privately insured, half of the spending variation is driven by price variation across regions and half is driven by quantity variation. Prices vary substantially across regions, across hospitals within regions, and even within hospitals. For example, even for a near homogenous service such as lower-limb MRIs, about a fifth of the total case-level price variation occurs within a hospital in the cross-section. Hospital market structure is strongly associated with price levels and contract structure. Prices at monopoly hospitals are 12 percent higher than those in markets with four or more rivals. Monopoly hospitals also have contracts that load more risk on insurers (e.g. they have more cases with prices set as a share of their charges). In concentrated insurer markets the opposite occurs – hospitals have lower prices and bear more financial risk. Examining the 366 merger and acquisitions that occurred between 2007 and 2011, we find that prices increased by over 6 percent when the merging hospitals were geographically close (e.g. 5 miles or less apart), but not when the hospitals were geographically distant (e.g. over 25 miles apart).

10.3386/w21815.abstractZh: 我们利用涵盖美国28%拥有雇主提供健康保险个体的保险索赔数据，研究私人保险客户在健康支出方面的差异，分析保险公司与医院之间的合同结构，并分析全国范围内医院价格的变化。私人保险客户的支出在不同地区差异达三倍，且与Medicare支出的相关性极低。对于私人保险客户而言，支出差异的一半是由地区间的价格差异引起的，另一半则是由数量差异引起的。不同地区的价格差异很大，同一地区内的医院之间也存在价格差异，甚至同一医院内部也存在价格差异。例如，即使是像下肢MRI这样的近似同质服务，约五分之一的总价格差异也发生在同一医院内部。医院的市场结构与价格水平及合同结构密切相关。垄断医院的定价比拥有四家或更多竞争对手的市场高出12%。垄断医院还签订了将更多风险转嫁给保险公司的合同（例如，它们处理的病例数量较多，且价格作为其收费的一部分）。在保险公司集中的市场中，情况则相反——医院的价格较低，但承担更多的财务风险。通过对2007年至2011年间发生的366起并购案例进行分析，我们发现，当合并的医院地理位置相近（例如相距5英里或更少）时，价格上升了6%以上，而当医院地理位置相距较远（例如超过25英里）时，价格并未发生变化。

abstract.text: This paper studies the implications of individuals’ knowledge of future job loss for the existence of an unemployment insurance (UI) market. Learning about job loss leads to consumption decreases and spousal labor supply increases. This suggests existing willingness to pay estimates for UI understate its value. But, it yields new estimation methodologies that account for and exploit responses to learning about future job loss. Although my new willingness to pay estimates exceed previous estimates, I estimate much larger frictions imposed by private information. This suggests privately-traded UI policies would be too adversely selected to be profitable, at any price.

10.3386/w21819.abstractZh: 本文研究了个人对未来失业信息的了解对失业保险市场存在性的影响。了解失业信息会导致消费减少和配偶劳动力供给增加。这表明现有的失业保险支付意愿估计值低估了其价值。但是，本文提出了新的估计方法，能够考虑并利用对未来失业信息的反应。尽管我的新支付意愿估计值高于之前的估计值，但我估计了由私人信息带来的更大摩擦。这表明，以任何价格进行私人交易的失业保险政策都过于不利，无法盈利。

abstract.text: This paper considers the degree to which events that intensify partying increase sexual assault. Estimates are based on panel data from campus and local law-enforcement agencies and an identification strategy that exploits plausibly random variation in the timing of Division 1 football games. The estimates indicate that these events increase daily reports of rape with 17-24 year old victims by 28 percent. The effects are driven largely by 17-24 year old offenders and by offenders unknown to the victim, but we also find significant effects on incidents involving offenders of other ages and on incidents involving offenders known to the victim.

10.3386/w21828.abstractZh: 本文探讨了活动增多是否会增加性侵犯行为。研究基于校园和当地执法机构的面板数据，并采用了一种利用一级橄榄球比赛时间随机变化的识别策略。研究结果表明，这些活动使17至24岁受害者的强奸案件报告数量增加了28%。这些影响主要源于17至24岁的犯罪者以及受害者不认识的犯罪者，但我们也发现，对其他年龄段的犯罪者以及受害者认识的犯罪者所涉及的案件也有显著的影响。

abstract.text: We incorporate a search-theoretic model of imperfect competition into an otherwise standard model of asymmetric information with unrestricted contracts. We develop a methodology that allows for a sharp analytical characterization of the unique equilibrium, and then use this characterization to explore the interaction between adverse selection, screening, and imperfect competition. We show how the structure of equilibrium contracts—and hence the relationship between an agent’s type, the quantity he trades, and the corresponding price—is jointly determined by the severity of adverse selection and the concentration of market power. This suggests that quantifying the effects of adverse selection requires controlling for the market structure. We also show that increasing competition and reducing informational asymmetries can be detrimental to welfare. This suggests that recent attempts to increase competition and reduce opacity in markets that suffer from adverse selection could potentially have negative, unforeseen consequences.

10.3386/w21833.abstractZh: 我们将一个关于不完全竞争的搜索理论模型纳入一个原本标准的非对称信息与无限制合同模型之中。我们开发了一种方法，能够清晰地分析独特均衡状态，并利用这一分析来探讨逆向选择、筛选机制与不完全竞争之间的相互作用。我们发现，均衡合同的构成——以及代理人类型、交易数量与相应价格之间的关系——是由逆向选择的严重程度和市场权力的集中程度共同决定的。这表明，在量化逆向选择的影响时，必须考虑市场结构因素。此外，我们还发现，增加竞争和减少信息不对称性可能会对福利产生负面影响。这意味着，最近那些试图通过增加竞争和减少因逆向选择导致的市场不透明性而带来的努力，可能会带来一些意想不到的负面后果。

abstract.text: We examined the effect of the expansion of Medicaid eligibility under the Affordable Care Act on health insurance coverage and labor supply of low-educated and low-income adults. We found that the Medicaid expansions were associated with large (e.g., 50 percent) increases in Medicaid coverage and corresponding decreases in the proportion uninsured. There was relatively little change in private insurance coverage, although the expansions tended to decrease such coverage slightly. In terms of labor supply, estimates indicated that the Medicaid expansions had little effect on work effort despite the substantial changes in health insurance coverage. Most estimates suggested that the expansions increased work effort, although not significantly.

10.3386/w21836.abstractZh: 我们研究了《平价医疗法案》下医疗补助资格扩展对低教育水平及低收入成年人的健康保险覆盖率和劳动力供应的影响。研究发现，医疗补助的扩展导致医疗补助覆盖率大幅增加（例如，增加了50%），同时无保险的比例相应下降。私人保险覆盖率的变动相对较小，尽管这些扩展措施略微减少了私人保险覆盖。在劳动力供应方面，估计结果显示，尽管健康保险覆盖率发生了显著变化，但医疗补助的扩展对工作努力程度的影响不大。大多数估计表明，这些扩展措施虽然没有显著地增加工作努力，但确实有所提升。

abstract.text: We study the identification through instruments of a nonseparable function that relates a continuous outcome to a continuous endogenous variable. Using group and dynamical systems theories, we show that full identification can be achieved under strong exogeneity of the instrument and a dual monotonicity condition, even if the instrument is discrete. When identified, the model is also testable. Our results therefore highlight the identifying power of strong exogeneity when combined with monotonicity restrictions.

10.3982/ecta10038.abstractZh: 我们研究了通过工具变量来识别一个不可分离函数的过程，该函数将一个连续的结果与一个连续的内生变量联系起来。利用群体和动态系统理论，我们证明了在工具变量具有强外生性且满足双单调性条件的情况下，即使工具变量是离散的，也能实现完全识别。当模型被识别后，它也是可检验的。因此，我们的研究结果强调了在单调性限制与强外生性结合使用时，识别能力的有效性。

abstract.text: Least favorable distribution, composite hypothesis, maximin tests, Economic Theory, Applied Economics, Econometrics

10.3982/ecta10535.abstractZh: 最不利分配，复合假设，最大最小值检验，经济理论，应用经济学，计量经济学

abstract.text: We demonstrate the asymptotic equivalence between commonly used test statistics for out-of-sample forecasting performance and conventional Wald statistics. This equivalence greatly simplifies the computational burden of calculating recursive out-of-sample test statistics and their critical values. For the case with nested models, we show that the limit distribution, which has previously been expressed through stochastic integrals, has a simple representation in terms of -distributed random variables and we derive its density. We also generalize the limit theory to cover local alternatives and characterize the power properties of the test.

10.3982/ecta10581.abstractZh: 我们证明了常用的样本外预测性能检验统计量与传统的Wald统计量之间的渐近等价性。这种等价性大大简化了计算递归样本外检验统计量及其临界值的工作量。对于嵌套模型的情况，我们展示了之前通过随机积分表达的极限分布，可以用-分布随机变量来简单表示，并推导出了其密度函数。我们还将极限理论推广到局部替代情况，并描述了检验的功效特性。

abstract.text: We develop a model of the market for federal funds that explicitly accounts for its two distinctive features: banks have to search for a suitable counterparty, and once they meet, both parties negotiate the size of the loan and the repayment. The theory is used to answer a number of positive and normative questions: What are the determinants of the fed funds rate? How does the market reallocate funds? Is the market able to achieve an efficient reallocation of funds? We also use the model for theoretical and quantitative analyses of policy issues facing modern central banks.

10.3982/ecta10586.abstractZh: 我们开发了一个联邦基金市场的模型，该模型明确考虑了市场的两个独特特征：银行必须寻找合适的交易对手，一旦找到交易对手，双方就会协商贷款的规模和还款方式。该理论被用来回答一系列实证性和规范性的问题：联邦基金利率的决定因素是什么？市场如何重新分配资金？市场是否能够实现资金的有效重新分配？我们还利用该模型对现代中央银行面临的政策问题进行了理论和定量分析。

abstract.text: The paper analyzes dynamic principal–agent models with short period lengths. The two main contributions are: (i) an analytic characterization of the values of optimal contracts in the limit as the period length goes to 0, and (ii) the construction of relatively simple (almost) optimal contracts for fixed period lengths. Our setting is flexible and includes the pure hidden action or pure hidden information models as special cases. We show how such details of the underlying information structure affect the optimal provision of incentives and the value of the contracts. The dependence is very tractable and we obtain sharp comparative statics results. The results are derived with a novel method that uses a quadratic approximation of the Pareto boundary of the equilibrium value set.

10.3982/ecta10656.abstractZh: 本文分析了具有短周期长度的动态主体-代理模型。两个主要贡献是：(i) 对周期长度趋近于0时最优合约价值的解析描述；(ii) 为固定周期长度构建相对简单（几乎）最优的合约。我们的模型设置具有灵活性，并包含纯隐藏行动或纯隐藏信息模型作为特殊情况。我们展示了底层信息结构的这些细节如何影响激励的最优提供以及合约的价值。这种依赖关系非常易于处理，我们获得了精确的比较静态结果。这些结果是通过一种新颖的方法得出的，该方法使用了均衡价值集的帕累托边界的二次近似。

abstract.text: The paper proposes a dynamic version of the frictionless Becker-Shapley-Shubik marriage matching model with transferable utility. Its primary objective is to develop a tractable model that rationalizes the marriage distribution of ‘who marries whom’ by age. This behavioral dynamic model rationalizes a new marriage matching function. An empirical methodology that relies on the equilibrium outcomes of the model identies the marital preferences over spouses. This framework also allows the inverse problem of computing the vector of aggregate marriages given a new distribution of available single individuals and estimated preferences to be solved. The solution to this inverse problem has been shown to exist under mild conditions. This paper also develops a simple test of the model’s empirical validity. Using aggregate data of new marriages and available single men and women in the US in 1970, 1980 and 1990, I investigate the changes in the gains to marriage over this period.

10.3982/ecta10675.abstractZh: 本文提出了一种动态版本的摩擦 없는 Becker-Shapley-Shubik婚姻匹配模型，该模型包含可转移效用。其主要目标是开发一个易于处理的模型，以解释“谁与谁结婚”这一婚姻分配问题。这一行为动态模型提出了一种新的婚姻匹配函数。一种基于模型均衡结果的实证方法，用于确定人们对配偶的婚姻偏好。该框架还允许解决一个逆问题，即在给定新的单身个体分布和估计的偏好情况下，计算总体婚姻向量。在适当的条件下，该逆问题的解是存在的。本文还提出了一种简单的模型实证有效性检验方法。利用1970年、1980年和1990年美国新婚姻数据以及可用的单身男女数据，我研究了这一时期婚姻带来的收益变化。

abstract.text: We develop a new parametric estimation procedure for option panels observed with error. We exploit asymptotic approximations assuming an ever increasing set of option prices in the moneyness (cross-sectional) dimension, but with a fixed time span. We develop consistent estimators for the parameters and the dynamic realization of the state vector governing the option price dynamics. The estimators converge stably to a mixed-Gaussian law and we develop feasible estimators for the limiting variance. We also provide semiparametric tests for the option price dynamics based on the distance between the spot volatility extracted from the options and one constructed nonparametrically from high-frequency data on the underlying asset. Furthermore, we develop new tests for the day-by-day model fit over specific regions of the volatility surface and for the stability of the risk-neutral dynamics over time. A comprehensive Monte Carlo study indicates that the inference procedures work well in empirically realistic settings. In an empirical application to S&P 500 index options, guided by the new diagnostic tests, we extend existing asset pricing models by allowing for a flexible dynamic relation between volatility and priced jump tail risk. Importantly, we document that the priced jump tail risk typically responds in a more pronounced and persistent manner than volatility to large negative market shocks.

10.3982/ecta10719.abstractZh: 我们开发了一种新的参数估计方法，用于观测到误差的选项面板数据。我们利用了渐近近似方法，假设在货币性维度上，选项价格集合不断增加，但时间跨度是固定的。我们为参数以及控制选项价格动态的状态向量的动态实现开发了一致估计量。这些估计量稳定地收敛到混合高斯分布，并且我们还开发了用于极限方差的可行估计量。我们还提供了基于选项中的现货波动率与从基础资产的高频数据中非参数构造的波动率之间的差距的半参数测试。此外，我们为特定波动区域上的日模型拟合以及风险中性动态随时间的稳定性开发了新的测试。全面的蒙特卡洛研究表明，这些推断方法在现实背景下表现良好。在一个针对标准普尔500指数选项的经验应用中，我们借助新的诊断测试，扩展了现有的资产定价模型，允许波动率与定价跳跃尾部风险之间建立灵活的动态关系。重要的是，我们发现定价跳跃尾部风险对大型负面市场冲击的反应通常比波动率更为显著和持久。

abstract.text: This paper considers inference on functionals of semi/nonparametric conditional moment restrictions with possibly nonsmooth generalized residuals, which include all of the (nonlinear) nonparametric instrumental variables (IV) as special cases. These models are often ill-posed and hence it is difficult to verify whether a (possibly nonlinear) functional is root-n estimable or not. We provide computationally simple, unified inference procedures that are asymptotically valid regardless of whether a functional is root-n estimable or not. We establish the following new useful results: (1) the asymptotic normality of a plug-in penalized sieve minimum distance (PSMD) estimator of a (possibly nonlinear) functional; (2) the consistency of simple sieve variance estimators for the plug-in PSMD estimator, and hence the asymptotic chi-square distribution of the sieve Wald statistic; (3) the asymptotic chi-square distribution of an optimally weighted sieve quasi likelihood ratio (QLR) test under the null hypothesis; (4) the asymptotic tight distribution of a non-optimally weighted sieve QLR statistic under the null; (5) the consistency of generalized residual bootstrap sieve Wald and QLR tests; (6) local power properties of sieve Wald and QLR tests and of their bootstrap versions; (7) asymptotic properties of sieve Wald and SQLR for functionals of increasing dimension. Simulation studies and an empirical illustration of a nonparametric quantile IV regression are presented.

10.3982/ecta10771.abstractZh: 本文探讨了在可能具有非光滑广义残差的情况下，对半/非参数条件矩限制函数的推断问题，这些模型包含了所有非线性非参数工具变量作为特殊情况。这类模型往往存在不适定性问题，因此很难验证某个可能非线性的函数是否可以进行根数估计。我们提出了一种计算简单、统一的推断方法，该方法在无论函数是否可以进行根数估计的情况下都具有渐近有效性。我们得出了以下新的重要结果：(1) 对于可能非线性的函数，插补惩罚筛选最小距离估计量的渐近正态性；(2) 插补PSMD估计量的简单筛选方差估计量的一致性，以及筛选Wald统计量的渐近卡方分布；(3) 在零假设下，最优加权筛选准似然比检验的渐近卡方分布；(4) 在零假设下，非最优加权筛选QLR统计量的渐近紧分布；(5) 广义残差自举筛选Wald和QLR检验的一致性；(6) 筛选Wald和QLR检验及其自举版本的局部功效特性；(7) 对于维度递增的函数，筛选Wald和SQLR的渐近性质。文中还提出了模拟研究和一个非参数分位数工具变量回归的实证案例。

abstract.text: This study provides causal evidence that a shock to the relative supply of inputs to production can (1) affect the direction of technological progress and (2) lead to a rebound in the relative price of the input that became relatively more abundant (the strong induced-bias hypothesis). I exploit the impact of the U.S. Civil War on the British cotton textile industry, which reduced supplies of cotton from the Southern United States, forcing British producers to shift to lower-quality Indian cotton. Using detailed new data, I show that this shift induced the development of new technologies that augmented Indian cotton. As these new technologies became available, I show that the relative price of Indian/U.S. cotton rebounded to its pre-war level, despite the increased relative supply of Indian cotton. This is the first paper to establish both of these patterns empirically, lending support to the two key predictions of leading directed technical change theories.

10.3982/ecta10811.abstractZh: 本研究提供了因果证据，表明生产投入的相对供应发生变动时，可能会（1）影响技术进步的方向，以及（2）导致相对较为充裕的投入品价格回升（即所谓的“强诱导偏差假说”）。我以美国内战对英国棉纺织业的影响为例，该事件导致美国南部的棉花供应减少，迫使英国生产商转向使用质量较低的印度棉花。通过详细的新数据分析，我发现这种转变促使了新技术的发展，从而提升了印度棉花的性能。随着这些新技术的普及，印度棉花与美国棉花之间的相对价格回升至战前的水平，尽管印度棉花的相对供应有所增加。这是第一篇实证验证这两种现象的研究，为那些关于技术变革理论的关键预测提供了支持。

abstract.text: We propose a method to set identify bounds on the sharing rule for a general collective household consumption model. Unlike the effects of distribution factors, the level of the sharing rule cannot be uniquely identified without strong assumptions on preferences across households. Our new results show that, though not point identified without these assumptions, strong bounds on the sharing rule can be obtained. We get these bounds by applying revealed preference restrictions implied by the collective model to the household's continuous aggregate demand functions. We obtain informative bounds even if nothing is known about whether each good is public, private, or assignable within the household, though having such information tightens the bounds. We apply our method to US PSID data, obtaining narrow bounds that yield useful conclusions regarding the effects of income and wages on intrahousehold resource sharing, and on the prevalence of individual (as opposed to household level) poverty.

10.3982/ecta10839.abstractZh: 我们提出了一种方法，用于为一般的集体家庭消费模型中的分享规则设定识别界限。与分配因素的影响不同，如果没有对家庭间偏好的强假设，分享规则的水平是无法被唯一确定的。我们的新结果表明，尽管在没有这些假设的情况下无法实现完全识别，但仍然可以获得对分享规则的强限制。我们通过将集体模型所蕴含的显示偏好限制应用于家庭的连续总需求函数来获得这些限制。即使不知道每种商品是公共的、私有的还是可以在家庭内部分配的，我们仍然可以获得有信息量的限制。我们将我们的方法应用于美国的PSID数据，得到了较为狭窄的限制，这些限制有助于我们了解收入和工资对家庭内部资源分享的影响，以及个体贫困与家庭层面贫困的普遍性。

abstract.text: A sequence of experiments documents static and dynamic “preference reversals” between sooner-smaller and later-larger rewards, when the sooner reward could be immediate. The theoretically motivated design permits separate identification of time consistent, stationary, and time invariant choices. At least half of the subjects are time consistent, but only three-quarters of them exhibit stationary choices. About half of subjects with time inconsistent choices have stationary preferences. These results challenge the view that present-bias preferences are the main source of time inconsistent choices.

10.3982/ecta10872.abstractZh: 一系列实验记录了在较早期、较小的奖励与较后期、较大的奖励之间存在的静态和动态“偏好逆转”现象，其中较早期的奖励可能是即时的。该实验设计具有理论依据，能够分别识别出时间一致的、静态的以及时间不变的偏好。至少一半的受试者具有时间一致的偏好，但只有四分之三的受试者表现出静态偏好。大约一半具有时间不一致偏好的受试者也表现出静态偏好。这些结果挑战了当前认为当前偏见偏好是时间不一致偏好主要来源的观点。

abstract.text: This paper develops a quantitative model of internal city structure that features agglomeration and dispersion forces and an arbitrary number of heterogeneous city blocks. The model remains tractable and amenable to empirical analysis because of stochastic shocks to commuting decisions, which yield a gravity equation for commuting flows. To structurally estimate agglomeration and dispersion forces, we use data on thousands of city blocks in Berlin for 1936, 1986 and 2006 and exogenous variation from the city’s division and reunification. We estimate substantial and highly localized production and residential externalities. We show that the model with the estimated agglomeration parameters can account both qualitatively and quantitatively for the observed changes in city structure. We show how our quantitative framework can be used to undertake counterfactuals for changes in the organization of economic activity within cities in response for example to changes in the transport network.

10.3982/ecta10876.abstractZh: 本文发展了一个关于城市内部结构的定量模型，该模型包含聚集力和分散力，以及任意数量的异质街区。由于对通勤决策的随机冲击，该模型仍然具有可处理性，并且适合进行实证分析。这些随机冲击产生了通勤流动的重力方程。为了对聚集力和分散力进行结构性估计，我们使用了1936年、1986年和2006年柏林数千个街区的数据，以及城市分裂与重新统一带来的外部因素。我们估计了大量且高度局部化的生产和居住外部性。研究表明，带有估计出的聚集参数的模型能够定性且定量地解释城市结构变化的观察结果。我们还展示了如何利用这一定量框架来研究城市内部经济活动组织方式的变化，例如，这些变化可能是对交通网络变化的响应。

abstract.text: This paper axiomatizes an intertemporal version of the maxmin expected-utility model. It employs two axioms specific to a dynamic setting. The first requires that smoothing consumption across states of the world is more beneficial to the individual than smoothing consumption across time. Such behavior is viewed as the intertemporal manifestation of ambiguity aversion. The second axiom extends Koopmans' notion of stationarity from deterministic to stochastic environments.

10.3982/ecta10886.abstractZh: 本文对maxmin期望效用模型的时间跨维度版本进行了公理化描述。文中采用了两个专为动态环境设计的公理。第一个公理指出，在多个时间状态下平滑消费对个人而言比在时间上平滑消费更有益。这种行为被视为不确定性厌恶在时间跨维度上的体现。第二个公理将Koopmans提出的稳定性概念从确定性环境扩展到了随机环境。

abstract.text: We develop a strategic theory of counterfeiting as a multi-market large game. Bad guys choose whether to counterfeit, and what quality to produce. Opposing them is a continuum of good guys who select a costly verification effort. In equilibrium, counterfeiters produce better quality at higher notes, but verifiers try sufficiently harder that verification still improves. We develop a graphical framework for deducing comparative statics. Passed and counterfeiting rates vanish for low and high notes. Our predictions are consistent with time series and cross-sectional patterns in a unique data set assembled largely from the Secret Service.

10.3982/ecta10975.abstractZh: 我们发展了一种针对伪造行为的战略理论，将其视为一个多市场大博弈。造假者会决定是否进行伪造以及生产何种质量的伪造品。与之相对的是一群“好人”，他们会投入昂贵的验证成本。在均衡状态下，伪造者会生产更高面值、质量更好的伪造品，而验证者则会付出更大的努力，使得验证效果得到提升。我们构建了一个图形化框架来推导比较静态结果。对于低面值和高面值产品，通过率和伪造率都会趋于零。我们的预测与从美国特勤局收集到的独特数据集中的时间序列和横截面数据一致。

abstract.text: This paper develops a generalized Roy model with human capital accumulation, moral hazard, and career concerns. We identify and estimate the model with a large panel that matches data on publicly listed firms to information on their executives. The structural estimates obtained are used to decompose the firm-size pay gap. We find that although total compensation and incentive pay increase with firm size, certainty-equivalent pay decreases with firm size. In larger firms, and for more highly ranked executives, weaker signal quality about effort results in higher risk premiums. This risk premium accounts for roughly 80 percent of the firm-size gap in total compensation. Larger firms are also willing to pay more than smaller ones to attract executives. Finally, the estimated coefficients on human capital accumulation from formal education and experience gained from different firms are individually significant, but their collective effect on firm-size pay differentials nets out.

10.3982/ecta11020.abstractZh: 本文发展了一个包含人力资本积累、道德风险以及职业关切的广义Roy模型。我们通过一个大型面板数据集对模型进行了识别与估计，该数据集将上市公司数据与其高管信息进行了匹配。所获得的结构估计结果被用来分解企业规模与薪酬差距的关系。研究发现，尽管总薪酬和激励性薪酬随企业规模增加，但相当于确定性的薪酬却随企业规模减小。在规模较大的企业中，对于排名较高的高管来说，努力程度信号质量的降低会导致更高的风险溢价。这一风险溢价大约占企业规模薪酬差距的80%。此外，较大型企业为了吸引高管，愿意支付比小型企业更高的薪酬。最后，从正式教育以及在不同企业获得的经验中得出的关于人力资本积累的估计系数各自都具有显著性，但它们对企业规模薪酬差异的集体影响却相互抵消。

abstract.text: When people interact in familiar settings, social conventions usually develop so that people tend to disregard alternatives outside the convention. For rational players to usually restrict attention to a block of conventional strategies, no player should prefer to deviate from the block when others are likely to act conventionally and rationally inside the block. We explore two set-valued concepts, coarsely and finely tenable blocks, that formalize this notion for finite normal-form games. We then identify settled equilibria, which are Nash equilibria with support in minimal tenable blocks. For a generic class of normal-form games, our coarse and fine concepts are equivalent, and yet they differ from standard solution concepts on open sets of games. We demonstrate the nature and power of the solutions by way of examples. Settled equilibria are closely related to persistent equilibria but are strictly more selective on an open set of games. With fine tenability, we obtain invariance under the insertion of a subgame with a unique totally mixed payoff-equivalent equilibrium, a property that other related concepts have not satisfied.

10.3982/ecta11048.abstractZh: 当人们处于熟悉的情境中进行互动时，通常会形成一些社会惯例，人们往往倾向于忽略这些惯例之外的选择。对于理性的玩家来说，他们通常会将注意力集中在一系列符合惯例的策略上，因此没有玩家会愿意在其他人可能遵循这些惯例策略的情况下偏离这些策略。我们探讨了两种集合值概念——粗略可维持的策略集和精细可维持的策略集，这些概念为有限的正常形式博弈提供了形式化的描述。然后，我们定义了“既定均衡”，即那些在最小可维持策略集中有支撑的纳什均衡。对于一类通用的正常形式博弈，我们的粗略和精细可维持概念是等价的，但它们与开放博弈集上的标准解概念有所不同。我们通过实例展示了这些解的性质与力量。既定均衡与持久均衡密切相关，但在开放博弈集上则具有更强的选择性。通过精细可维持的概念，我们获得了在插入一个具有唯一完全混合支付等价均衡的子博弈时不变的性质，这一性质是其他相关概念所不具备的。

abstract.text: We formalize the Keynesian insight that aggregate demand driven by sentiments can generate output fluctuations under rational expectations. When production decisions must be made under imperfect information about demand, optimal decisions based on sentiments can generate stochastic self-fulfilling rational expectations equilibria in standard economies without persistent informational frictions, externalities, non-convexities or strategic complementarities in production. The models we consider are deliberately simple, but could serve as benchmarks for more complicated equilibrium models with additional features.

10.3982/ecta11085.abstractZh: 我们将凯恩斯主义的观点形式化：在理性预期假设下，由情绪驱动的总需求能够引发产出波动。当生产决策必须在对需求信息不完全了解的情况下做出时，基于情绪的最优决策可以在标准经济体系中产生随机的自我实现理性预期均衡，而无需持续的信息摩擦、外部性、非凸性或生产的战略互补性。我们考虑的模型虽然简单，但可以作为具有更多特性的复杂均衡模型的基准。

abstract.text: This paper presents a test of the exogeneity of a single explanatory variable in a multivariate model. It does not require the exogeneity of the other regressors or the existence of instrumental variables. The fundamental maintained assumption is that the model must be continuous in the explanatory variable of interest. This test has power when unobservable confounders are discontinuous with respect to the explanatory variable of interest, and it is particularly suitable for applications in which that variable has bunching points. An application of the test to the problem of estimating the effects of maternal smoking in birth weight shows evidence of remaining endogeneity, even after controlling for the most complete covariate specification in the literature.

10.3982/ecta11231.abstractZh: 本文对多元模型中单个解释变量的外生性进行了检验。该检验不要求其他回归变量的外生性或工具变量的存在。基本假设是模型在感兴趣的解释变量上必须是连续的。当不可观测的混杂因素在感兴趣的解释变量上不连续时，该检验具有效力，尤其适用于那些该变量存在聚集点的应用场景。将该检验应用于估计母亲吸烟对出生体重影响的案例，结果显示即使在控制了文献中最为完整的协变量后，仍然存在内生性。

abstract.text: This supplementary material contains proofs, additional tables and figures, and extensions discussed in the main paper.

10.3982/ecta11237.abstractZh: 这份补充材料包含了主论文中的证明、额外表格和图表，以及讨论的扩展内容。

abstract.text: Are there times when durable spending is less responsive to economic stimulus? We argue that aggregate durable expenditures respond more sluggishly to economic shocks during recessions because microeconomic frictions lead to declines in the frequency of households' durable adjustment. We show this by first using indirect inference to estimate a heterogeneous agent incomplete markets model with fixed costs of durable adjustment to match consumption dynamics in PSID microdata. We then show that aggregating this model delivers an extremely procyclical Impulse Response Function (IRF) of durable spending to aggregate shocks. For example, the response of durable spending to an income shock in 1999 is estimated to be almost twice as large as if it occurred in 2009. This procyclical IRF holds in response to standard business cycle shocks as well as in response to various policy shocks, and it is robust to general equilibrium. After estimating this robust theoretical implication of micro frictions, we provide additional direct empirical evidence for its importance using both cross-sectional and time-series data.

10.3982/ecta11254.abstractZh: 是否存在经济刺激对耐用消费反应减弱的情况？我们认为，在经济衰退期间，总体耐用消费对经济冲击的反应更为迟缓，这是因为微观经济摩擦导致家庭进行耐用消费调整的频率下降。我们通过使用间接推断方法来估计一个具有固定耐用调整成本的异质代理人不完全市场模型，以匹配PSID微观数据中的消费动态。然后我们发现，将这一模型汇总后，耐用消费的脉冲响应函数对总体冲击的反应具有极强的顺周期性。例如，1999年经济冲击对耐用消费的响应估计是2009年发生的类似冲击的两倍左右。这种顺周期性的脉冲响应函数不仅适用于标准经济周期冲击，也适用于各种政策冲击，并且这种效应在一般均衡分析中也是稳健的。在估计了微观摩擦的稳健理论含义之后，我们通过横截面数据和时间序列数据提供了额外的直接实证证据，进一步证明了其重要性。

abstract.text: This paper introduces time-varying grouped patterns of heterogeneity in linear panel data models. A distinctive feature of our approach is that group membership is left unrestricted. We estimate the parameters of the model using a “grouped fixed-effects” estimator that minimizes a least squares criterion with respect to all possible groupings of the cross-sectional units. Recent advances in the clustering literature allow for fast and efficient computation. We provide conditions under which our estimator is consistent as both dimensions of the panel tend to infinity, and we develop inference methods. Finally, we allow for grouped patterns of unobserved heterogeneity in the study of the link between income and democracy across countries.

10.3982/ecta11319.abstractZh: 本文介绍了线性面板数据模型中异质性随时间变化的分组模式。我们方法的一个独特特点是允许组间成员关系不受限制。我们使用“分组固定效应”估计器来估计模型参数，该估计器以最小二乘准则为基础，对所有可能的横截面单位分组进行优化。聚类研究的最新进展使得计算变得快速且高效。我们提出了条件，在这些条件下，当面板的两个维度趋于无穷大时，我们的估计器仍然具有一致性，并且我们还开发了推断方法。最后，我们在研究国家间收入与民主之间的联系时，允许存在未观察到的异质性分组模式。

abstract.text: This paper presents a new method for the analysis of moral hazard principal-agent problems. The new approach avoids the stringent assumptions on the distribution of outcomes made by the classical first-order approach and instead only requires the agent's expected utility to be a rational function of the action. This assumption allows for a reformulation of the agent's utility maximization problem as an equivalent system of equations and inequalities. This reformulation in turn transforms the principal's utility maximization problem into a nonlinear program. Under the additional assumptions that the principal's expected utility is a polynomial and the agent's expected utility is rational in the wage, the final nonlinear program can be solved to global optimality.
