The paper also shows how to first approximate expected utility functions that are not rational by polynomials, so that the polynomial optimization approach can be applied to compute an approximate solution to non-polynomial problems. Finally, the paper demonstrates that the polynomial optimization approach extends to principal-agent models with multi-dimensional action sets.

10.3982/ecta11351.abstractZh: 本文提出了一种分析道德风险主体-代理问题的新方法。该新方法避免了经典一阶方法对结果分布所做的严格假设，仅要求代理人的期望效用是行为的理性函数。这一假设使得代理人的效用最大化问题可以重新表述为一组等价的方程和不等式。这种重新表述将委托人的效用最大化问题转化为一个非线性规划问题。在额外假设下，即委托人的期望效用是多项式，代理人的期望效用在工资上是理性的情况下，最终的非线性规划问题可以求解到全局最优解。本文还展示了如何先用多项式近似非理性期望效用函数，从而将多项式优化方法应用于计算非多项式问题的近似解。最后，本文证明了多项式优化方法可以扩展到具有多维行动集的主体-代理模型。

abstract.text: The absence of self-control is often viewed as an important correlate of persistent poverty.Using a standard intertemporal allocation problem with credit constraints faced by an individual with quasihyperbolic preferences, we argue that poverty damages the ability to exercise self-control.Our theory invokes George Ainslie's notion of "personal rules," interpreted as subgame-perfect equilibria of an intrapersonal game played by a time-inconsistent decision maker.Our main result pertains to situations in which the individual is neither so patient that accumulation is possible from every asset level, nor so impatient that decumulation is unavoidable from every asset level.Such cases always possess a threshold level of assets above which personal rules support unbounded accumulation, and a second threshold below which there is a "poverty trap": no personal rule permits the individual to avoid depleting all liquid wealth.In short, poverty perpetuates itself by undermining the ability to exercise self-control.Thus even temporary policies designed to help the poor accumulate assets may be highly effective.We also explore the implications for saving with easier access to credit, the demand for commitment devices, the design of accounts to promote saving, and the variation of the marginal propensity to consume across classes of resource claims.

10.3982/ecta11374.abstractZh: 缺乏自我控制能力通常被视为持续贫困的一个重要因素。我们采用一个标准的跨时期分配问题模型，其中个体面临信用约束，并且具有准超凸偏好。我们认为，贫困会损害个体行使自我控制能力的能力。我们的理论借鉴了乔治·安斯利的“个人规则”概念，将其解释为时间不一致的决策者所进行的内部博弈的子博弈完美均衡。我们的主要研究结果适用于这样一种情况：个体既不具备从每个资产水平积累资产的耐心，也不具备从每个资产水平避免资产减少的紧迫感。在这种情况下，总是存在一个资产阈值，超过这个阈值，个人规则支持无限制的资产积累；而低于这个阈值时，就会出现“贫困陷阱”：没有任何个人规则能够阻止个体耗尽所有流动资产。简而言之，贫困通过削弱个体行使自我控制能力的能力而自我延续。因此，即使是为了帮助贫困人口积累资产而制定的临时政策也可能非常有效。我们还探讨了与更容易获得信贷相关的储蓄行为、对承诺机制的需求、促进储蓄的账户设计，以及不同资源类别下的消费倾向变化等问题。

abstract.text: There is a widely held view within the general public that large corporations should act in the interests of a broader group of agents than just their shareholders (the stakeholder view). This paper presents a framework where this idea can be justified. The point of departure is the observation that a large firm typically faces endogenous risks that may have a significant impact on the workers it employs and the consumers it serves. These risks generate externalities on these stakeholders which are not internalized by shareholders. As a result, in the competitive equilibrium, there is under-investment in the prevention of these risks. We suggest that this under-investment problem can be alleviated if firms are instructed to maximize the total welfare of their stakeholders rather than shareholder value alone (stakeholder equilibrium). The stakeholder equilibrium can be implemented by introducing new property rights (employee rights and consumer rights) and instructing managers to maximize the total value of the firm (the value of these rights plus shareholder value). If there is only one firm, the stakeholder equilibrium is Pareto optimal. However, this is not true with more than one firm and/or heterogeneous agents, which illustrates some of the limits of the stakeholder model.

10.3982/ecta11455.abstractZh: 在公众中普遍存在一个观点，即大型公司应该为更广泛的利益相关者群体而非仅仅为股东的利益行事（即利益相关者视角）。本文提出了一个框架，以证明这一观点的合理性。其出发点是观察到大型公司通常面临一些内生性风险，这些风险可能对所雇用的员工和服务对象的消费者产生重大影响。这些风险会对这些利益相关者产生外部性影响，而这些外部性并未被股东所考虑。因此，在竞争均衡中，对预防这些风险的投入不足。我们认为，如果公司被要求最大化所有利益相关者的总福利，而不仅仅是股东价值，那么这种投入不足的问题就可以得到缓解（即利益相关者均衡）。通过引入新的产权（员工权利和消费者权利），并要求管理者最大化公司的总价值（这些权利的价值加上股东价值），可以实现利益相关者均衡。如果只有一家公司，那么利益相关者均衡是帕累托最优的。然而，当存在多家公司和/或异质性的利益相关者时，这一结论就不成立了，这也揭示了利益相关者模型的一些局限性。

abstract.text: We develop a parsimonious model to study the equilibrium and socially optimal decisions of banks to enter, trade in, and possibly exit, an OTC market. Although we endow all banks with the same trading technology, banks' optimal entry and trading decisions endogenously lead to a realistic market structure composed of dealers and customers with distinct trading patterns. We decompose banks' entry incentives into incentives to hedge risk and incentives to make intermediation profits. We show that dealer banks enter more than is socially optimal. In the face of large negative shocks, they may also exit more than is socially optimal when markets are not perfectly resilient.

10.3982/ecta11477.abstractZh: 我们开发了一个简约模型，用于研究银行进入、交易以及可能退出场外市场时的均衡状况和社会最优决策。尽管我们赋予所有银行相同的交易技术，但银行的最优进入和交易决策会内生性地形成由交易商和客户组成的现实市场结构，这些交易商和客户具有不同的交易模式。我们将银行的进入动机分解为风险对冲动机和中介利润动机。研究表明，交易银行进入的数量往往超过社会最优水平。在面临重大负面冲击时，当市场不具备完美的韧性时，它们退出的数量也可能超过社会最优水平。

abstract.text: We examine the link between the threat of violence and democratization in the context of the Great Reform Act passed by the British Parliament in 1832. We geo‐reference the so‐called Swing riots, which occurred between the 1830 and 1831 parliamentary elections, and compute the number of these riots that happened within a 10 km radius of the 244 English constituencies. Our empirical analysis relates this constituency‐specific measure of the threat perceptions held by the 344,000 voters in the Unreformed Parliament to the share of seats won in each constituency by pro‐reform politicians in 1831. We find that the Swing riots induced voters to vote for pro‐reform politicians after experiencing first‐hand the violence of the riots.

10.3982/ecta11484.abstractZh: 我们研究了1832年英国议会通过的大改革法案背景下，暴力威胁与民主化进程之间的联系。我们将1830年至1831年议会选举期间发生的所谓“摇摆骚乱”进行地理定位分析，并计算了这些骚乱在距离244个英国选区10公里范围内的发生次数。我们的实证分析将这种针对特定选区的威胁感知与1831年各选区中支持改革的政治人物所赢得的席位比例联系起来。研究发现，摇摆骚乱让选民在亲身体验了骚乱的暴力之后，转而投票支持改革派政治人物。

abstract.text: This paper studies the effects of an electronic voting technology that introduced visual aids in Brazilian elections and facilitated voting for the less educated. Estimates exploiting a regression discontinuity design embedded in its phase-in through time indicate that electronic voting reduced residual (error-ridden and uncounted) votes and generated the de facto enfranchisement of a large fraction (11%) of the electorate. This enhanced political participation of less educated (poorer) voters is then shown to have: (1) increased the number of state legislators that are themselves less educated; and (2) shifted government spending towards public health care, a policy that is particularly beneficial to the poor; leading to (3) improved health services utilization (pre-natal visits) by less educated mothers and (4) reduced occurrence of low-weight births in this group. No effects on health care utilization by more educated mothers and on the weight of their newborns are found. The results are consistent with the predictions of political economy models and demonstrate that electronic voting can promote the political empowerment of the poor and raise their living standards.

10.3982/ecta11520.abstractZh: 本文研究了在巴西选举中引入视觉辅助工具的电子投票技术对投票行为的影响，以及该技术如何为受教育程度较低的选民提供便利。通过回归不连续设计进行的分析表明，电子投票减少了无效票和未统计的投票，并使很大一部分选民（11%）获得了实际投票权。这种对受教育程度较低（且经济条件较差）选民的政治参与度的提升表现为：1）有更多受教育程度较低的州议员；2）政府支出更多地投向公共医疗保健领域，这对贫困人口尤为有利；3）受教育程度较低的母亲的健康服务利用率提高（如产前检查）；4）该群体中低体重出生婴儿的发生率降低。对于受教育程度较高的母亲及其新生儿的医疗保健使用情况，并未发现任何影响。这些结果与政治经济学模型的预测一致，表明电子投票能够提升贫困人口的政治地位，并提高他们的生活水平。

abstract.text: Our paper provides a complete characterization of leverage and default in binomial economies with financial assets serving as collateral. First, our Binomial No-Default Theorem states that any equilibrium is equivalent (in real allocations and prices) to another equilibrium in which there is no default. Thus actual default is irrelevant, though the potential for default drives the equilibrium and limits borrowing. This result is valid with arbitrary preferences and endowments, arbitrary promises, many assets and consumption goods, production, and multiple periods. We also show that the no-default equilibrium would be selected if there were the slightest cost of using collateral or handling default. Second, our Binomial Leverage Theorem shows that equilibrium LT V for non-contingent debt contracts is the ratio of the worst-case return of the asset to the riskless rate of interest. Finally, our Binomial Leverage-Volatility theorem provides a precise link between leverage and volatility.

10.3982/ecta11618.abstractZh: 我们的论文对以金融资产作为抵押品的二项经济中的杠杆效应和违约行为进行了全面的描述。首先，我们的二项无违约定理指出，任何均衡在真实分配和价格上等同于另一个没有违约的均衡。因此，实际违约是无关紧要的，尽管违约的可能性会驱动均衡并限制借贷行为。这一结果适用于任意的偏好和初始条件、任意的承诺、多种资产和消费商品、生产以及多个时期。我们还表明，如果使用抵押品或处理违约存在轻微的成本，那么无违约均衡会被选择。其次，我们的二项杠杆定理表明，非偶然性债务合同的均衡杠杆比率等于资产最差情况下的回报与无风险利率之比。最后，我们的二项杠杆-波动性定理提供了杠杆效应与波动性之间的精确联系。

abstract.text: This paper concerns the two-stage game introduced in Nash (1953). It formalizes a suggestion made (but not pursued) by Nash regarding equilibrium selection in that game, and hence offers an arguably more solid foundation for the “Nash bargaining with endogenous threats” solution. Analogous reasoning is then applied to an infinite horizon game to provide equilibrium selection in two-person repeated games with contracts. In this setting, issues about enforcement of threats are much less problematic than in Nash's static setting. The analysis can be extended to stochastic games with contracts.

10.3982/ecta11711.abstractZh: 本文探讨了Nash在1953年提出的双阶段博弈。该文对Nash关于该博弈中均衡选择的建议进行了形式化表述（尽管Nash并未进一步推进这一思路），从而为“具有内生威胁的Nash讨价还价”解决方案提供了更为坚实的基础。随后，类似的推理方法被应用于无限期限博弈，以在两人重复博弈中确定均衡选择。在这种情境下，关于威胁执行的问题比Nash静态模型中的情况要少得多。该分析还可以扩展到具有合约的随机博弈。

abstract.text: Many violations of the Independence axiom of Expected Utility can be traced to subjects' attraction to risk-free prospects. The key axiom in this paper, Negative Certainty Independence (Dillenberger, 2010), formalizes this tendency. Our main result is a utility representation of all preferences over monetary lotteries that satisfy Negative Certainty Independence together with basic rationality postulates. Such preferences can be represented as if the agent were unsure of how to evaluate a given lottery p; instead, she has in mind a set of possible utility functions over outcomes and displays a cautious behavior: she computes the certainty equivalent of p with respect to each possible function in the set and picks the smallest one. The set of utilities is unique in a well-defined sense. We show that our representation can also be derived from a "cautious" completion of an incomplete preference relation.

10.3982/ecta11733.abstractZh: 许多违反期望效用独立性公理的情况，都可以追溯到受试者对无风险前景的偏好。本文中的关键公理——负确定性独立性（Dillenberger, 2010），正是对这一倾向的正式表述。我们的主要成果是一种效用表示方式，用于描述所有满足负确定性独立性以及基本理性假设的货币彩票偏好。这种偏好可以被表示为：如果代理人不确定如何评估某个彩票p，那么她会考虑一组可能的效用函数，并表现出谨慎的行为：她会计算p相对于该集合中的每个可能函数的确定性等价值，并选择最小的那个。这组效用函数在某种明确的意义上是唯一的。我们证明，这种表示方式也可以从对不完整偏好关系的“谨慎”补全中推导出来。

abstract.text: This paper develops a theory of optimal provision of commitment devices to people who value both commitment and flexibility, and whose preferences differ in the degree of time inconsistency. If time inconsistency is observable, both a planner and a monopolist provide devices that help each person commit to the efficient level of flexibility. But the combination of unobservable time inconsistency and preference for flexibility causes an adverse-selection problem. To solve it, the monopolist and (possibly) the planner curtail flexibility in the device for a more inconsistent person at both ends of the efficient choice range, and may have to add unused options to, or even distort, the device for a less inconsistent person. This theory has normative and positive implications for private and public provision of commitment devices.

10.3982/ecta11851.abstractZh: 本文提出了一种关于为既重视承诺又重视灵活性的人群提供最优承诺装置的理论。这些人的偏好在时间不一致性程度上存在差异。如果时间不一致性是可观测的，那么规划者和垄断者都能提供有助于人们选择高效灵活性的装置。然而，不可观测的时间不一致性与对灵活性的偏好相结合，会导致逆向选择问题。为了解决这个问题，垄断者和（可能的）规划者会在高效选择范围的两端，为时间不一致性更强的人减少灵活性，并且可能需要为时间不一致性较低的人增加未使用的选项，甚至对装置进行调整。这一理论对私人部门和公共部门提供承诺装置具有规范和实证意义。

abstract.text: This paper analyzes South Africa's Free Basic Water Policy, under which households receive a free water allowance equal to the World Health Organization's recommended minimum of 6 kiloliters per month. I structurally estimate residential water demand, evaluate the welfare eects of free water, and provide optimal price schedules derived from a social planner's problem. I use a unique dataset of monthly metered billing data for 60,000 households for 2002-2008 from a particularly disadvantaged suburb of Pretoria. The dataset contains rich price variation across 18 dierent nonlinear tarischedules, and includes a policy experiment which removed the free allowance. I …nd that without government subsidy, the mean monthly consumption would decrease from 12.6 to 5.6 kiloliters, which is below the clean water consumption recommended by the WHO. However, it is possible to reallocate the current subsidy to form an optimal tari¤ without a free allowance, which would increase welfare while leaving the water provider's revenue unchanged. This optimal tariwould also reduce the number of households consuming below the WHO-recommended level.

10.3982/ecta11917.abstractZh: 本文分析了南非的免费基本供水政策，根据该政策，家庭每月可获得的免费用水量等于世界卫生组织推荐的最低标准，即6千升。本文对住宅用水需求进行了结构性估算，评估了免费供水的福利效应，并基于社会规划者问题提出了最优价格方案。我们使用了2002至2008年间来自比勒陀利亚一个特别贫困郊区的60,000户家庭的月度计量账单数据。该数据集包含了18种不同非线性定价方案的丰富价格变化信息，并包含了一个取消免费供水的政策实验。研究发现，如果没有政府补贴，平均每月用水量将从12.6千升降至5.6千升，这一数值低于世界卫生组织推荐的清洁用水标准。然而，可以通过将现有补贴重新分配，形成一种无需免费供水的最优定价方案，从而提升福利水平，同时保持供水企业的收入不变。这种最优定价方案还将减少用水量低于世界卫生组织推荐标准的家庭数量。

abstract.text: It is well known that the finite-sample properties of tests of hypotheses on the cointegrating vectors in vector autoregressive models can be quite poor, and that current solutions based on Bartlett-type corrections or bootstrap based on unrestricted parameter estimators are unsatisfactory, in particular in those cases where also asymptotic chi^2 tests fail most severely. In this paper, we solve this inference problem by showing the novel result that a bootstrap test where the null hypothesis is imposed on the bootstrap sample is asymptotically valid. That is, not only does it have asymptotically correct size, but, in contrast to what is claimed in existing literature, it is consistent under the alternative. Compared to the theory for bootstrap tests on the co-integration rank (Cavaliere, Rahbek, and Taylor (2012)), establishing the validity of the bootstrap in the framework of hypotheses on the co-integrating vectors requires new theoretical developments, including the introduction of multivariate Ornstein–Uhlenbeck processes with random (reduced rank) drift parameters. Finally, as documented by Monte Carlo simulations, the bootstrap test outperforms existing methods.

10.3982/ecta11952.abstractZh: 众所周知，在向量自回归模型中，对协整向量假设检验的有限样本性质可能相当差，而目前基于Bartlett型修正或基于无限制参数估计量的自助法解决方案并不令人满意，尤其是在渐近卡方检验也表现最差的情况下。在本文中，我们通过展示一个新颖的结果来解决这一推断问题：当原假设在自助样本上被提出时，自助法检验在渐近意义上是有效的。也就是说，它不仅具有渐近正确的显著性水平，而且与现有文献中的说法相反，它在备择假设下也是一致的。与Cavaliere、Rahbek和Taylor（2012）关于协整秩的自助法检验理论相比，要在协整向量假设框架下建立自助法的有效性，需要新的理论发展，包括引入具有随机（降秩）漂移参数的多变量Ornstein–Uhlenbeck过程。最后，通过蒙特卡洛模拟验证，自助法检验的表现优于现有方法。

abstract.text: This paper develops a specification test for instrument validity in the heterogeneous treatment effect model with a binary treatment and a discrete instrument. The strongest testable implication for instrument validity is given by the condition for nonnegativity of point‐identifiable compliers' outcome densities. Our specification test infers this testable implication using a variance‐weighted Kolmogorov–Smirnov test statistic. The test can be applied to both discrete and continuous outcome cases, and an extension of the test to settings with conditioning covariates is provided.

10.3982/ecta11974.abstractZh: 本文提出了一种针对异质性处理效应模型中二元处理与离散工具变量的工具变量有效性的检验方法。对工具变量有效性的最强可检验含义是由点可识别的遵从者结果密度非负条件所给出的。我们的检验方法采用方差加权Kolmogorov–Smirnov检验统计量来推断这一可检验含义。该检验适用于离散和连续结果情况，并且还提供了将检验扩展到包含条件协变量的情形。

abstract.text: Strategic choice data from a carefully chosen set of ring‐network games are used to obtain individual‐level estimates of higher‐order rationality. The experimental design exploits a natural exclusion restriction that is considerably weaker than the assumptions underlying alternative designs in the literature. In our data set, 93 percent of subjects are rational, 71 percent are rational and believe others are rational, 44 percent are rational and hold second‐order beliefs that others are rational, and 22 percent are rational and hold at least third‐order beliefs that others are rational.

10.3982/ecta11983.abstractZh: 本研究利用精心挑选的环形网络博弈中的战略选择数据，获得了个体层面的高阶理性估计。实验设计利用了一种自然性的排除限制，这种限制比文献中其他设计所基于的假设要弱得多。在我们的数据集中，93%的参与者具有理性思维，71%的参与者既具有理性思维又认为他人也具有理性思维，44%的参与者具有二阶信念，认为他人也具有理性思维，而22%的参与者至少具有三阶信念，认为他人也具有理性思维。

abstract.text: We consider a group of strategic agents who must each repeatedly take one of two possible actions. They learn which of the two actions is preferable from initial private signals and by observing the actions of their neighbors in a social network. We show that the question of whether or not the agents learn efficiently depends on the topology of the social network. In particular, we identify a geometric “egalitarianism” condition on the social network that guarantees learning in infinite networks, or learning with high probability in large finite networks, in any equilibrium. We also give examples of nonegalitarian networks with equilibria in which learning fails.

10.3982/ecta12058.abstractZh: 我们考虑一组战略性代理人，他们必须反复选择两种可能的行动之一。他们通过初始的私人信号以及观察社交网络中其他代理人的行为，来学习哪种行动更优。我们发现，代理人是否能够高效学习，取决于社交网络的拓扑结构。具体来说，我们确定了社交网络上的一个几何“平等主义”条件，该条件保证了在无限网络中能够学习，或者在大型有限网络中以高概率学习到任何均衡状态。我们还给出了一些非平等主义网络的例子，这些网络中的均衡状态会导致学习失败。

abstract.text: We consider a large market where auctioneers with private reservation values compete for bidders by announcing cheap-talk messages. If auctioneers run efficient first-price auctions, then there always exists an equilibrium in which each auctioneer truthfully reveals her type. The equilibrium is constrained efficient, assigning more bidders to auctioneers with larger gains from trade. The choice of the trading mechanism is crucial for the result. Most notably, the use of second-price auctions (equivalently, ex post bidding) leads to the non-existence of any informative equilibrium. We examine the robustness of our finding in various dimensions, including finite markets and equilibrium selection.

10.3982/ecta12103.abstractZh: 我们考虑一个大型市场，其中拥有私人保留价值的拍卖师通过发布廉价信息来争夺投标者。如果拍卖师运行高效的第一价格拍卖，那么总存在一个均衡状态，在这种状态下，每个拍卖师都会真实披露自己的类型。这种均衡是受限的，即交易收益更大的拍卖师会吸引更多的投标者。交易机制的选择对结果至关重要。最值得注意的是，使用第二价格拍卖（即事后投标）会导致没有任何信息性均衡的存在。我们检验了我们的发现在不同维度下的稳健性，包括有限市场和均衡选择等方面。

abstract.text: We analyze the Vickrey mechanism for auctions of multiple identical goods when the players have both Knightian uncertainty over their own valuations and incomplete preferences. In this model, the Vickrey mechanism is no longer dominant-strategy, and we prove that all dominant-strategy mechanisms are inadequate. However, we also prove that, in undominated strategies, the social welfare produced by the Vickrey mechanism in the worst case is not only very good, but also essentially optimal.

10.3982/ecta12131.abstractZh: 我们分析了在参与者对自身估值存在奈特不确定性且偏好不完全的情况下，对多个相同商品进行拍卖时的维克里机制。在该模型中，维克里机制不再是最优策略，我们证明了所有最优策略机制都是不充分的。然而，我们也证明了，在无支配策略的情况下，维克里机制在最坏情况下产生的社会福利不仅非常理想，而且本质上是最优的。

abstract.text: We quantify the importance of trade credit chains for the propagation of corporate bankruptcies. Our results show that trade creditors (suppliers) that issue more trade credit are more exposed to trade debtor (customer) failures, both in terms of the likelihood of experiencing a debtor failure and the loss given failure. We further document that the credit loss invoked by a debtor failure imposes a substantially enhanced bankruptcy risk on the creditors. The propagation mechanism is mitigated for creditors that are less levered, cash rich, and highly profitable, and enhanced in R&D intense industries and during economic downturns.

10.3982/ecta12148.abstractZh: 我们量化了贸易信贷链对企业破产传播的重要性。我们的研究结果表明，发放更多贸易信贷的贸易债权人（供应商）更容易面临贸易债务人（客户）的失败，无论是在遭遇债务人失败的可能性方面，还是在失败带来的损失方面。我们还发现，债务人失败导致的信用损失会显著增加债权人的破产风险。对于那些负债较少、现金充裕且盈利能力强的债权人来说，这种传播机制的影响较小；而在研发密集型行业和经济衰退期间，这种影响则会加剧。

abstract.text: This paper characterizes an equilibrium payoff subset for dynamic Bayesian games as discounting vanishes. Monitoring is imperfect, transitions may depend on actions, types may be correlated and values may be interdependent. The focus is on equilibria in which players report truthfully. The characterization generalizes that for repeated games, reducing the analysis to static Bayesian games with transfers. With independent private values, the restriction to truthful equilibria is without loss, except for the punishment level; if players withhold their information during punishment-like phases, a folk theorem obtains.

10.3982/ecta12182.abstractZh: 本文描述了动态贝叶斯博弈中一种均衡收益子集的特征，即当折现消失时的情况。监控是不完善的，转换可能取决于行动，类型可能存在相关性，价值也可能相互依赖。本文关注的是玩家如实报告的均衡。这一描述可以推广到重复博弈，将分析简化为具有转移行为的静态贝叶斯博弈。在独立私有价值的条件下，限制为真实均衡是没有损失的，除了惩罚水平；如果玩家在类似惩罚的阶段隐瞒信息，则会出现一种民间定理。

abstract.text: We develop a behavioral axiomatic characterization of Subjective Expected Utility (SEU) under risk aversion. Given is an individual agent's behavior in the market: assume a finite collection of asset purchases with corresponding prices. We show that such behavior satisfies a "revealed preference axiom" if and only if there exists a SEU model (a subjective probability over states and a concave utility function over money) that accounts for the given asset purchases.

10.3982/ecta12273.abstractZh: 我们提出了一种在风险厌恶条件下主观期望效用（SEU）的行为公理表征方法。给定的是个体代理人在市场中的行为：假设有一系列有限的资产购买行为及其对应的价格。我们证明，这样的行为满足“揭示偏好公理”当且仅当存在一个SEU模型（即关于状态的主观概率以及关于金钱的凹效用函数），该模型能够解释给定的资产购买行为。

abstract.text: This paper studies two-sided matching markets with non-transferable utility when the number of market participants grows large. We consider a model in which each agent has a random preference ordering over individual potential matching partners, and agents' types are only partially observed by the econometrician. We show that in a large market, the inclusive value is a sufficient statistic for an agent's endogenous choice set with respect to the probability of being matched to a spouse of a given observable type. Furthermore, while the number of pairwise stable matchings for a typical realization of random utilities grows at a fast rate as the number of market participants increases, the inclusive values resulting from any stable matching converge to a unique deterministic limit. We can therefore characterize the limiting distribution of the matching market as the unique solution to a fixed-point condition on the inclusive values. Finally we analyze identification and estimation of payoff parameters from the asymptotic distribution of observable characteristics at the level of pairs resulting from a stable matching.

10.3982/ecta12299.abstractZh: 本文研究了市场参与者数量大量增长时，具有不可转移效用的双边匹配市场。我们考虑了一个模型，在该模型中，每个代理人对潜在的匹配对象都有一个随机偏好排序，而代理人的类型仅被计量经济学家部分观测到。我们证明了在大型市场中，包容性价值是代理人内生选择集的一个充分统计量，该选择集与匹配到给定可观测类型配偶的概率有关。此外，尽管在随机效用的典型实现下，随着市场参与者数量的增加，成对稳定匹配的数量会以快速的速度增长，但任何稳定匹配所得到的包容性价值都会收敛到一个唯一的确定性极限。因此，我们可以将匹配市场的极限分布描述为包容性价值满足固定点条件的唯一解。最后，我们分析了从稳定匹配产生的可观测特征的渐近分布中识别并估计收益参数的方法。

abstract.text: For an arbitrary data set D = {(p, x)} ⊆ (ℝ+m∖ {0}) × ℝ+m, finite or infinite, it is shown that the following three conditions are equivalent: (a) D satisfies GARP; (b) D can be rationalized by a utility function; (c) D can be rationalized by a utility function that is quasiconcave, nondecreasing, and that strictly increases when all its coordinates strictly increase. Examples of infinite data sets satisfying GARP are provided for which every utility rationalization fails to be lower semicontinuous, upper semicontinuous, or concave. Thus condition (c) cannot be substantively improved upon.

10.3982/ecta12345.abstractZh: 对于任意一个数据集D = {(p, x)} ⊆ (ℝ+m∖ {0}) × ℝ+m，无论是有限的还是无限的，可以证明以下三个条件是等价的：(a) D满足GARP条件；(b) D可以通过效用函数进行合理化；(c) D可以通过一个准凹函数进行合理化，该函数是非递减的，并且当所有坐标严格增加时，该函数会严格增加。提供了一些满足GARP条件的无限数据集的例子，对于这些数据集，每次效用合理化都无法使其保持下半连续、上半连续或凹性。因此，条件(c)实际上无法得到改进。

abstract.text: We study markets in which agents first make investments and are then matched into potentially productive partnerships. Equilibrium investments and the equilibrium matching will be efficient if agents can simultaneously negotiate investments and matches, but we focus on markets in which agents must first sink their investments before matching. Additional equilibria may arise in this sunk-investment setting, even though our matching market is competitive. These equilibria exhibit inefficiencies that we can interpret as coordination failures. All allocations satisfying a constrained efficiency property are equilibria, and the converse holds if preferences satisfy a separability condition. We identify sufficient conditions (most notably, quasiconcave utilities) for the investments of matched agents to satisfy an exchange efficiency property as well as sufficient conditions (most notably, a single crossing property) for agents to be matched positive assortatively, with these conditions then forming the core of sufficient conditions for the efficiency of equilibrium allocations.

10.3982/ecta12349.abstractZh: 我们研究的是这样一种市场：在这种市场中，参与者首先进行投资，然后被匹配到可能具有生产力的合作关系中。如果参与者能够同时协商投资和匹配过程，那么均衡投资和均衡匹配将是有效的。但我们的研究重点在于那些参与者必须先减少投资后才能进行匹配的市场。在这种投资减少的情况下，可能会出现额外的均衡状态，尽管我们的匹配市场是竞争性的。这些均衡状态表现出效率低下，我们可以将其解释为协调失败。所有满足约束性效率属性的分配都是均衡状态，如果偏好满足可分离性条件，则反之亦然。我们确定了一些充分条件（最显著的是准凹效用），这些条件确保了匹配后的投资者的投资能够满足交换效率属性。同时，我们也确定了充分条件（最显著的是单一交叉属性），这些条件确保了参与者能够以正 assortative 的方式被匹配，这些条件构成了均衡分配效率的充分条件核心。

abstract.text: This paper makes the following original contributions to the literature. (i) We develop a simpler analytical characterization and numerical algorithm for Bayesian inference in structural vector autoregressions (VARs) that can be used for models that are overidentified, just-identified, or underidentified. (ii) We analyze the asymptotic properties of Bayesian inference and show that in the underidentified case, the asymptotic posterior distribution of contemporaneous coefficients in an n-variable VAR is confined to the set of values that orthogonalize the population variance–covariance matrix of ordinary least squares residuals, with the height of the posterior proportional to the height of the prior at any point within that set. For example, in a bivariate VAR for supply and demand identified solely by sign restrictions, if the population correlation between the VAR residuals is positive, then even if one has available an infinite sample of data, any inference about the demand elasticity is coming exclusively from the prior distribution. (iii) We provide analytical characterizations of the informative prior distributions for impulse-response functions that are implicit in the traditional sign-restriction approach to VARs, and we note, as a special case of result (ii), that the influence of these priors does not vanish asymptotically. (iv) We illustrate how Bayesian inference with informative priors can be both a strict generalization and an unambiguous improvement over frequentist inference in just-identified models. (v) We propose that researchers need to explicitly acknowledge and defend the role of prior beliefs in influencing structural conclusions and we illustrate how this could be done using a simple model of the U.S. labor market

10.3982/ecta12356.abstractZh: 本文对经济学文献做出了以下原创性贡献：(i) 我们提出了一种更简单的贝叶斯推断分析表征方法和数值算法，适用于过识别、刚好识别或欠识别的结构向量自回归模型。(ii) 我们分析了贝叶斯推断的渐近性质，并表明在欠识别情况下，n变量自回归模型中同时系数的渐近后验分布被限制在使普通最小二乘残差的总体方差-协方差矩阵正交的一组数值上，后验分布的高度与先验分布的高度成正比。例如，在仅通过符号限制来识别的供需双变量自回归模型中，如果自回归残差之间的总体相关性为正，那么即使有无限多的数据样本，关于需求弹性的任何推断都只能来自先验分布。(iii) 我们为冲动响应函数提供了信息性先验分布的解析表征，这些先验分布在传统符号限制方法中对自回归模型是隐含的。作为结果(ii)的一个特例，我们注意到这些先验的影响在渐近情况下不会消失。(iv) 我们展示了在刚好识别的模型中，带有信息性先验的贝叶斯推断如何既是对频率主义推断的严格推广，又是对其的明确改进。(v) 我们建议研究人员需要明确承认并捍卫先验信念在影响结构结论中的作用，并通过一个简单的美国劳动力市场模型来说明如何做到这一点。

abstract.text: Internet advertising has been the fastest growing advertising channel in recent years, with paid search ads comprising the bulk of this revenue. We present results from a series of large-scale field experiments done at eBay that were designed to measure the causal effectiveness of paid search ads. Because search clicks and purchase intent are correlated, we show that returns from paid search are a fraction of non-experimental estimates. As an extreme case, we show that brand keyword ads have no measurable short-term benefits. For non-brand keywords, we find that new and infrequent users are positively influenced by ads but that more frequent users whose purchasing behavior is not influenced by ads account for most of the advertising expenses, resulting in average returns that are negative.

10.3982/ecta12423.abstractZh: 近年来，互联网广告成为增长最快的广告渠道，其中付费搜索广告占据了大部分收入。我们展示了在eBay进行的一系列大规模实地实验的结果，这些实验旨在衡量付费搜索广告的因果效果。由于搜索点击率和购买意图之间存在相关性，我们发现付费搜索广告的回报仅为非实验性估计值的一小部分。作为极端案例，我们发现品牌关键词广告在短期内没有任何可测量的好处。对于非品牌关键词，我们发现新用户和不太常使用互联网的用户会受到广告的正面影响，但那些购买行为不受广告影响的频繁用户则承担了大部分广告费用，导致平均回报为负。

abstract.text: This paper studies equilibrium and welfare in a class of regulated health insurance markets known as exchanges. We use detailed health plan choice and utilization data to model individual-level (i) projected health risk and (ii) risk preferences. We combine the estimated distributions of risk and risk preferences with a model of competitive insurance markets to predict allocations and prices

10.3982/ecta12480.abstractZh: 本文研究了一类被称为“交换市场”的监管型健康保险市场的均衡与福利问题。我们利用详细的健康计划选择和利用数据，对个体层面的（i）预期健康风险与（ii）风险偏好进行建模。通过将估计出的风险分布和风险偏好与竞争性保险市场模型相结合，来预测保险分配和价格。

abstract.text: Mechanism design enables a social planner to obtain a desired outcome by leveraging the players’ rationality and their beliefs. It is thus a fundamental, but yet unproven, intuition that the higher the level of rationality of the players, the better the set of obtainable outcomes. In this paper, we prove this fundamental intuition for players with possibilistic beliefs, a model long considered in epistemic game theory. Specifically, • We define a sequence of monotonically increasing revenue benchmarks for single-good auctions, G[superscript 0≤]G[superscript 1≤]G[superscript 2≤]···,where each G[superscript i] is defined over the players’ beliefs and G[superscript 0] is the second-highest valuation (i.e., the revenue benchmark achieved by the second-price mechanism). • We (1) construct a single, interim individually rational, auction mechanism that, without any clue about the rationality level of the players, guarantees revenue G[superscript k] if all players have rationality levels ≥ k + 1, and (2) prove that no such mechanism can guarantee revenue even close to G[superscript k] when at least two players are at most level- k rational.

10.3982/ecta12563.abstractZh: 机制设计使得社会规划者能够利用参与者的理性及其信念来获得期望的结果。因此，一个基本的、但尚未被证实的直觉是：参与者的理性水平越高，可获得的结果集就越好。在本文中，我们为具有可能性信念的参与者证明了这一基本直觉，这一模型在认知博弈理论中已被长期考虑。具体来说，我们定义了一系列单调递增的单一商品拍卖收益基准，G[superscript 0]≤G[superscript 1]≤G[superscript 2]≤…，其中每个G[superscript i]都是基于参与者的信念来定义的，而G[superscript 0]是第二高估值（即第二价格机制所达到的收益基准）。我们（1）构建了一种单一的、临时的个体理性拍卖机制，即使不知道参与者的理性水平，只要所有参与者的理性水平≥k+1，该机制就能保证收益G[superscript k]；（2）证明了当至少有两个参与者的理性水平为最多k级时，没有任何机制能够保证接近G[superscript k]的收益。

abstract.text: Perturbed utility functions—the sum of expected utility and a non-linear perturba-tion function—provide a simple and tractable way to model various sorts of stochastic choice. We provide easily understood conditions that characterize this representation by generalizing the acyclicity condition used in revealed preference theory. We show how to relax Luce’s IIA condition to model cases where the agent finds it harder to discriminate between items in larger menus, and how to extend the perturbation-function approach to model choice overload and nested decisions. We also show that these representations correspond to a form of ambiguity-averse preferences for an agent who is uncertain about her true utility

10.3982/ecta12660.abstractZh: 扰动效用函数——即期望效用与非线性扰动函数之和——为模拟各种随机选择问题提供了一种简单且易于处理的模型。我们通过推广揭示偏好理论中使用的非循环性条件，提出了易于理解的条件来表征这种表示方法。我们展示了如何放宽Luce的IIA条件，以模拟代理人难以区分更大菜单中不同商品的情况，并扩展了扰动函数方法，以模拟选择过载和嵌套决策问题。我们还表明，这些表示方法对应于一种对不确定性厌恶的偏好形式，即代理人对其真实效用存在不确定性。

abstract.text: We propose a novel technique to boost the power of testing a high-dimensional vector H : θ = 0 against sparse alternatives where the null hypothesis is violated only by a couple of components. Existing tests based on quadratic forms such as the Wald statistic often suffer from low powers due to the accumulation of errors in estimating high-dimensional parameters. More powerful tests for sparse alternatives such as thresholding and extreme-value tests, on the other hand, require either stringent conditions or bootstrap to derive the null distribution and often suffer from size distortions due to the slow convergence. Based on a screening technique, we introduce a "power enhancement component", which is zero under the null hypothesis with high probability, but diverges quickly under sparse alternatives. The proposed test statistic combines the power enhancement component with an asymptotically pivotal statistic, and strengthens the power under sparse alternatives. The null distribution does not require stringent regularity conditions, and is completely determined by that of the pivotal statistic. As specific applications, the proposed methods are applied to testing the factor pricing models and validating the cross-sectional independence in panel data models.

10.3982/ecta12749.abstractZh: 我们提出了一种新颖的技术，用于增强对高维向量H进行检验的能力：θ = 0，针对稀疏替代假设，其中零假设仅被少数几个成分违反。现有的基于二次型的检验方法，如Wald统计量，由于在高维参数估计过程中误差的累积，往往会出现低功效的问题。而针对稀疏替代假设的更强大检验方法，如阈值检验和极值检验，则需要严格的条件下或通过自助法来推导零分布，并且常常会因为收敛速度慢而受到样本量失真的影响。基于一种筛选技术，我们引入了一个“功效增强组件”，在零假设下该组件的概率高度为零，但在稀疏替代假设下会迅速发散。所提出的检验统计量将功效增强组件与渐近临界统计量结合起来，从而在稀疏替代假设下增强检验的功效。零分布不需要严格的规律性条件，完全由临界统计量的分布决定。作为具体应用，所提出的方法被应用于检验因子定价模型，以及验证面板数据模型中的横截面独立性。

abstract.text: This paper examines some of the recent literature on the estimation of production functions.We focus on techniques suggested in two recent papers, Olley and Pakes (1996), and Levinsohn and Petrin (2003).While there are some solid and intuitive identification ideas in these papers, we argue that the techniques can suffer from functional dependence problems.We suggest an alternative approach that is based on the ideas in these papers, but does not suffer from the functional dependence problems and produces consistent estimates under alternative data generating processes for which the original procedures do not.

10.3982/ecta13408.abstractZh: 本文探讨了关于生产函数估计的最新文献。我们重点关注Olley和Pakes（1996年）以及Levinsohn和Petrin（2003年）两篇论文中提出的技术方法。虽然这些论文中包含了一些扎实且直观的识别方法，但我们认为这些技术可能存在函数依赖性问题。我们提出了一种替代方法，该方法基于上述论文中的思想，但避免了函数依赖性问题，并且能够在原始方法无法适用的不同数据生成过程下得到一致的估计结果。

abstract.text: This paper provides conditions under which the inequality constraints generated by either single agent optimizing behavior or the best response condition of multiple agent problems can be used as a basis for estimation and inference. An application illustrates how the use of these inequality constraints can simplify the analysis of complex behavioral models.

10.3982/ecta6865.abstractZh: 本文提出了一种条件，即无论是单个代理的优化行为还是多代理问题中的最佳响应条件所生成的不等式约束，都可以作为估计和推断的基础。一个应用案例说明了如何利用这些不等式约束来简化复杂行为模型的分析。

abstract.text: In this paper, I construct players' prior beliefs and show that these prior beliefs lead the players to learn to play an approximate Nash equilibrium uniformly in any infinitely repeated slightly perturbed game with discounting and perfect monitoring. That is, given any ε > 0, there exists a (single) profile of players' prior beliefs that leads play to almost surely converge to an ε-Nash equilibrium uniformly for any (finite normal form) stage game with slight payoff perturbation and any discount factor less than 1.

10.3982/ecta9332.abstractZh: 在本文中，我构建了玩家的先验信念，并证明了这些先验信念使得玩家能够在任何具有折扣效应和完美监控的无限重复且略有 perturbed 的博弈中，均匀地学习到近似纳什均衡。也就是说，对于任意的 ε > 0，存在一组玩家的先验信念配置，使得在任何具有轻微支付扰动且折扣因子小于1的（有限正规形式）阶段博弈中，玩家的行为几乎必然收敛到ε-纳什均衡。

abstract.text: We introduce methods for estimating nonparametric, nonadditive models with simultaneity. The methods are developed by directly connecting the elements of the structural system to be estimated with features of the density of the observable variables, such as ratios of derivatives or averages of products of derivatives of this density. The estimators are therefore easily computed functionals of a nonparametric estimator of the density of the observable variables. We consider in detail a model where to each structural equation there corresponds an exclusive regressor and a model with one equation of interest and one instrument that is included in a second equation. For both models, we provide new characterizations of observational equivalence on a set, in terms of the density of the observable variables and derivatives of the structural functions. Based on those characterizations, we develop two estimation methods. In the first method, the estimators of the structural derivatives are calculated by a simple matrix inversion and matrix multiplication, analogous to a standard least squares estimator, but with the elements of the matrices being averages of products of derivatives of nonparametric density estimators. In the second method, the estimators of the structural derivatives are calculated in two steps. In a first step, values of the instrument are found at which the density of the observable variables satisfies some properties. In the second step, the estimators are calculated directly from the values of derivatives of the density of the observable variables evaluated at the found values of the instrument. We show that both pointwise estimators are consistent and asymptotically normal.

10.3982/ecta9348.abstractZh: 我们介绍了一种用于估计具有同时性的非参数、非加性模型的方法。这些方法通过将待估计的结构系统的元素与可观测变量的密度特征直接联系起来而得到发展，例如导数比率或该密度导数的乘积平均值。因此，估计量可以很容易地作为可观测变量密度的非参数估计量的函数来计算。我们详细考虑了一个模型，在该模型中，每个结构方程对应一个独立的回归变量，以及一个包含一个感兴趣的方程和一个包含在第二个方程中的工具的模型。对于这两种模型，我们提供了基于可观测变量的密度和结构函数导数的观测等价性的新表征。基于这些表征，我们开发了两种估计方法。在第一种方法中，结构导数的估计量通过简单的矩阵求逆和矩阵乘法来计算，类似于标准最小二乘估计量，但矩阵的元素是非参数密度估计量的导数乘积的平均值。在第二种方法中，结构导数的估计量通过两个步骤来计算。第一步是找到使得可观测变量的密度满足某些性质的工具的值。第二步是直接从在找到的工具值处评估的可观测变量密度的导数来计算估计量。我们证明了这两种点估计量都是一致且渐近正态的。

abstract.text: In this paper we study the least squares (LS) estimator in a linear panel regression model with unknown number of factors appearing as interactive fixed effects. Assuming that the number of factors used in estimation is larger than the true number of factors in the data, we establish the limiting distribution of the LS estimator for the regression coefficients as the number of time periods and the number of cross-sectional units jointly go to infinity. The main result of the paper is that under certain assumptions the limiting distribution of the LS estimator is independent of the number of factors used in the estimation, as long as this number is not underestimated. The important practical implication of this result is that for inference on the regression coefficients one does not necessarily need to estimate the number of interactive fixed effects consistently.

10.3982/ecta9382.abstractZh: 在本文中，我们研究了在具有未知因子数量的线性面板回归模型中，最小二乘法估计量的分布。假设用于估计的因子数量大于数据中的真实因子数量，我们建立了当时间周期数量和横截面单位数量同时趋于无穷大时，回归系数最小二乘法估计量的极限分布。本文的主要结论是：在某些假设条件下，只要估计中使用的因子数量没有被低估，最小二乘法估计量的极限分布与用于估计的因子数量无关。这一结果具有重要的实际意义，即在对回归系数进行推断时，不一定需要一致地估计交互固定效应的数量。

abstract.text: Both aristocratic privileges and constitutional constraints in traditional monarchies can be derived from a ruler's incentive to minimize expected costs of moral-hazard rents for high officials. We consider a dynamic moral-hazard model of governors serving a sovereign prince, who must deter them from rebellion and hidden corruption which could cause costly crises. To minimize costs, a governor's rewards for good performance should be deferred up to the maximal credit that the prince can be trusted to pay. In the long run, we find that high officials can become an entrenched aristocracy with low turnover and large claims on the ruler. Dismissals for bad performance should be randomized to avoid inciting rebellions, but the prince can profit from reselling vacant offices, and so his decisions to dismiss high officials require institutionalized monitoring. A soft budget constraint that forgives losses for low-credit governors can become efficient when costs of corruption are low. [Former title: "Leadership, trust, and power: dynamic moral hazard in high office."

10.3982/ecta9737.abstractZh: 传统君主制中的贵族特权与宪法限制，均可归因于统治者为了最小化高官因道德风险而产生的预期成本而采取的激励措施。我们构建了一个动态的道德风险模型，其中统治者必须抑制高官的叛乱和隐性腐败行为，以避免引发代价高昂的危机。为了最小化成本，统治者应对高官的绩效奖励进行延迟支付，直至达到君主能够可靠支付的最大信用额度。从长远来看，我们发现高官可能会形成根深蒂固的贵族阶层，其更替率较低，且对统治者的依赖程度较高。对于表现不佳的高官，解雇措施应随机进行，以避免引发叛乱，但君主可以通过转售空缺职位获利，因此其解雇高官的决策需要制度化的监督。当腐败成本较低时，对信用较低的高官采取宽容的预算限制政策可能是有效的。[原标题："领导力、信任与权力：高官职位中的动态道德风险。"]

abstract.text: I consider nonparametric identification of nonseparable instrumental variables models with continuous endogenous variables. If both the outcome and first stage equations are strictly increasing in a scalar unobservable, then many kinds of continuous, discrete, and even binary instruments can be used to point-identify the levels of the outcome equation. This contrasts sharply with related work by Imbens and Newey, 2009 that requires continuous instruments with large support. One implication is that assumptions about the dimension of heterogeneity can provide nonparametric point-identification of the distribution of treatment response for a continuous treatment in a randomized controlled experiment with partial compliance.

10.3982/ecta9984.abstractZh: 我考虑了非参数识别非可分离工具变量模型与连续内生变量之间的关系。如果结果方程和第一阶段方程在某一标量不可观测变量上严格递增，那么可以使用多种类型的连续、离散甚至二元工具变量来点识别结果方程的各水平值。这与Imbens和Newey在2009年的相关工作形成鲜明对比，后者要求使用具有大覆盖范围的连续工具变量。其中一个含义是，关于异质性维度的假设可以为部分依从性随机对照实验中的连续处理效果分布提供非参数点识别方法。

abstract.text: Many health care systems collect and disseminate information on provider quality in order to facilitate patient choice and induce competitive behaviour amongst providers. The Department of Health in England has recently mandated the collection of patient-reported health outcome measures (PROMs) for the purpose of performance assessment and consumer information. This is the first attempt to routinely measure the gain in health that patients experience as the result of care and thus offer a more comprehensive picture of hospital quality than existing ‘failure measures’ such as mortality or readmission rates. In this paper we test whether hospital demand responds to hospital quality measures based on health gains in addition to more conventional measures. We estimate hospital choice models for elective hip replacement surgery using rich administrative data for all publicly-funded patients in the English NHS in 2010-2012. Our focus is on two key aspects of hospital choice: 1) the extent to which patients are more likely to choose hospitals which are expected to achieve larger improvements in patients’ health and 2) whether patients’ response to quality differs with their morbidity, as measured by pre-operative health status, and other characteristics such as age or income deprivation. In order to address potential endogeneity bias we implement an empirical strategy based on lagged explanatory variables, hospital fixed effects and a control group design based on demand for emergency hip replacement. Our results suggest that hospitals can increase demand by 9% if they increase the average health gains that patients experience by one standard deviation. Hospital demand has a higher elasticity with respect to average health gains than emergency readmission or mortality rates. Elective patients are twice as willing as emergency hip replacement patients to travel further for an increase in quality

https://openalex.org/W2141455516.abstractZh: 许多医疗保健系统收集并传播有关医疗服务质量的信息，以促进患者选择并激发医疗服务提供者之间的竞争行为。英国卫生部最近要求收集患者报告的健康结果指标（PROMs），以进行绩效评估并提供消费者信息。这是首次尝试常规测量患者因医疗服务而获得的健康改善，因此比现有的“失败指标”如死亡率或再入院率更能全面反映医院的质量。在本文中，我们测试了医院需求是否会对基于健康改善的医院质量指标作出反应，而不仅仅是更传统的指标。我们使用2010-2012年英格兰NHS所有公共资助患者的丰富行政数据，建立了关于择期髋关节置换手术的医院选择模型。我们的重点是两个关键方面：1）患者更可能选择那些预期能带来更大健康改善的医院；2）患者对质量的反应是否会随着他们的疾病状况而变化，这可以通过术前健康状况以及其他特征如年龄或收入贫困程度来衡量。为了应对潜在的内生性偏差，我们采用了基于滞后解释变量、医院固定效应以及基于紧急髋关节置换需求的控制组设计的实证策略。我们的结果表明，如果医院将患者平均获得的健康改善幅度提高一个标准差，那么医院的需求可以增加9%。与紧急再入院或死亡率相比，医院需求对平均健康改善的弹性更高。选择进行髋关节置换手术的患者，比起因质量提升而愿意长途旅行的患者，后者的意愿是前者的两倍。
